## Stored procedure: dbo.ActivityReport

```sql
-- =============================================  
-- Author:  <Apoorva Mishra>  
-- Create date: <14 Jun, 2012>  
-- Description: <A stored procedure to invoke queries for the ActivityReport form of Client Interfa>  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ActivityReport]   
 @dtFromDate DateTime,   
  @shouldGetCount bit,  
 @substrategy_ID int
AS  
BEGIN  

declare @dtToDate Datetime
Set @dtToDate = DATEADD(HOUR,1,@dtFromDate)

if(@shouldGetCount = 1)  
begin  
 SELECT COUNT(*) from vwAllTrades WHERE (Update_Time   BETWEEN  @dtFromDate AND  @dtToDate) AND Sub_Strategy_ID = @substrategy_ID
end 
  
else  
begin  
 SELECT * from vwAllTrades WHERE (Update_Time   BETWEEN  @dtFromDate AND  @dtToDate) AND Sub_Strategy_ID = @substrategy_ID
 
end  
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.AddSecurityToStrategyBanList

```sql
create procedure [dbo].[AddSecurityToStrategyBanList]
	@esteeID varchar(100),
	@banPermissionID int,
	@banAllSecForUnderlying bit,
	@substrategyID int,
	@userID int

as
begin
	if not exists (select * from esteemaster where Estee_ID = @esteeID)
		Begin  
			RAISERROR ('EsteeID does not exist in esteemaster.',16,1);
		end

	declare @banGroupID int
	if not exists (select * from BanGroup where BanGroupName = cast(@substrategyID as varchar))
	begin
		select @banGroupID = MAX(id) from BanGroup
		insert into BanGroup values (@banGroupID + 1,cast(@substrategyID as varchar),GETDATE(),GETDATE(),@userID,@userID)
	end

	select @banGroupID = ID from BanGroup where BanGroupName = cast(@substrategyID as varchar);

	if(@banAllSecForUnderlying = 0)
	begin
		delete from BanGroupSecurityList where EsteeID = @esteeID and BanGroupID = @banGroupID
		insert into BanGroupSecurityList values (@banGroupID, @esteeID, @banPermissionID, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID)
	end
	else
	begin

		declare @isin varchar(20)
		select @isin = ISIN from esteemaster where estee_id = @esteeID
	
		delete from BanGroupSecurityList where BanGroupID = @banGroupID
		and EsteeID in (select estee_id from esteemaster where ISIN = @isin)
	
		insert into BanGroupSecurityList
		select @banGroupID,Estee_ID, @banPermissionID, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID 
		from esteemaster e
		where isin = @isin	
	
	end

	if not exists (select * from BanGroupAllotment where BanGroupID = @banGroupID)
	begin
		declare @dimensionID int
		select @dimensionID = id from EsteeDimensions where Dimension = 'Strategy'
		insert into BanGroupAllotment values (@dimensionID, @substrategyID, @banGroupID, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), @userID, @userID)
	end

end

--AddSecurityToStrategyBanList 'IB0000000001IB0',4,1,9901,33

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.Adjustment

```sql
    
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Adjustment] @corpActionEffectiveDate date,        
@spotEsteeId nvarchar(50), -- spot estee_ID                  
@underlying_ticker varchar(50),        
@old_quantity_factor int, --Old quantity factor           
@new_quantity_factor int, --New quantity factor              
@ticksize decimal(10, 2),        
@price_factor decimal(10, 6), --if price decrease factor higher than 1              
@exchange_code varchar(5),        
@specialDividend decimal(10, 6) = NULL,        
@prevWorkingDate date = NULL,        
@updateSpecialDividend bit = 0,      
@shouldExecute bit = 1      
/*--exec Adjustment '2014-11-20','INE062A01012IS00','SBIN',1,10,0.05,10,'IS' */        
/*--(For special Dividend) exec Adjustment '2014-11-20','INE062A01012IS00','SBIN',1,1,0.05,1,'IS' , 9.5, '2014-11-19'  */       
AS        
BEGIN        
  BEGIN TRAN        
    DECLARE @rowsCount int        
    DECLARE @MaxRows int        
    DECLARE @Order_Type char        
    DECLARE @Order_Validity int        
    DECLARE @Price_Diff decimal(20, 2)        
    DECLARE @Broker_ID int        
    DECLARE @Account_ID int        
    DECLARE @Order_Source_ID varchar(50)        
    DECLARE @Remarks varchar(100)        
    DECLARE @Sub_Strategy_ID int        
    DECLARE @Comb_Status varchar(50)        
    DECLARE @status varchar(50)        
    DECLARE @isLast bit        
    DECLARE @Original_Order_ID int        
    DECLARE @New_Cancel_Modify varchar(1)        
    DECLARE @Created_By int        
    DECLARE @Updated_By int        
    DECLARE @NewOrderID int -- required when inserting cancel /modify order                  
    DECLARE @Creation_Time_In datetime        
    DECLARE @Order_ID int        
    DECLARE @OrderTrade_ID int        
    DECLARE @Trade_ID int        
    DECLARE @Creation_Time datetime        
    DECLARE @LinkID int        
    DECLARE @LinkIDOut int        
    DECLARE @estee_ID varchar(50)        
    DECLARE @new_estee_ID varchar(50)        
    DECLARE @Buy_Sell_Indicator int        
    DECLARE @Order_Quantity int        
    DECLARE @Order_Price decimal(20, 6)        
    DECLARE @Traded_Quantity int        
    DECLARE @Traded_Price decimal(20, 6)        
    DECLARE @Stop_Price decimal(20, 2)        
    DECLARE @Transaction_Cost decimal(20, 2)        
    DECLARE @net_qty int        
    DECLARE @Buy int        
    DECLARE @sell int        
    DECLARE @securitytype varchar(20)        
    DECLARE @strike_price decimal(10, 2)        
    DECLARE @integerval decimal(10, 2)        
    DECLARE @decimalval decimal(10, 2)        
    DECLARE @error varchar(50)        
    DECLARE @underlyingEsteeID varchar(50)        
    DECLARE @emsID int        
    DECLARE @isSpecialDiv bit        
    DECLARE @specialDivAmt decimal(10, 6)    
    DECLARE @Isoption int = 0 
	DECLARE @IsCash int = 0
 DECLARE @TEMPBALANCINGTRADES TABLE (        
   Order_Id int,        
   OrderTrade_Id int,        
   Trade_Id int,        
   Account_ID int,        
   Sub_Strategy_ID nvarchar(10),        
   Broker_ID int,        
   Estee_Id nvarchar(50),        
   Traded_Quantity int,        
   Traded_Price decimal(20, 4),        
   Ems_Id int,        
   status nvarchar(20),        
   Order_Source_ID nvarchar(50)        
    )        
   DECLARE @TEMPNEWBALANCINGTRADES TABLE (        
   Order_Id int,        
   OrderTrade_Id int,        
   Trade_Id int,        
   Account_ID int,        
   Sub_Strategy_ID nvarchar(10),        
   Broker_ID int,        
   Estee_Id nvarchar(50),        
   Traded_Quantity int,        
   Traded_Price decimal(20, 4),        
   Ems_Id int,        
   status nvarchar(20),        
   Order_Source_ID nvarchar(50)        
    )        
    CREATE TABLE #TempEmsServer (        
      SubStrategyID int,        
      EmsApplicationID int,        
      EMSEMBServerType varchar(50),        
      ExchangeCode varchar(5)        
    )        
    INSERT INTO #TempEmsServer        
    EXEC spGetMultiExchangeEMSForCUI        
    DECLARE @isin varchar(50)       
    SET @isin = SUBSTRING(@spotEsteeId, 0, 13)        
    DECLARE @date date        
    SET @date = CAST(@corpActionEffectiveDate AS date)        
    IF @prevWorkingDate IS NULL        
      SET @prevWorkingDate = @date        
    -- validate that there is a corporation action effective on the date passed in for the given underlying                  
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT        
        1        
      FROM CorporateActionTable        
      WHERE EffectiveDate = @corpActionEffectiveDate        
      AND UnderlyingEsteeId = RTRIM(@spotEsteeId)        
      AND Action <> '0')        
    BEGIN        
      PRINT 'There is no corporate action on the isin on the given date, please check the date. Aborting adjustment...'        
      GOTO ERROR_HANDLER        
    END      ELSE        
    BEGIN        
      --Validation for special dividend.           
      --If Action type for this security is SPECIAL DIVIDEND in corporate action table then only it would proceed further.          
      --Also if value in action column matches the value for @specialDividend parameter then only it would proceed further        
   if @exchange_code = 'BR'        
   begin        
   SELECT @isSpecialDiv = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CorporateActionTable WHERE EffectiveDate = @corpActionEffectiveDate AND UnderlyingEsteeId = RTRIM(@spotEsteeId)        
                             AND Action <> '0' AND ActionType = 'DIVIDEND') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END        
   end        
   else        
   begin        
      SELECT        
        @isSpecialDiv =        
                         CASE        
                           WHEN EXISTS (SELECT        
                               1        
                             FROM CorporateActionTable        
                             WHERE EffectiveDate = @corpActionEffectiveDate        
                             AND UnderlyingEsteeId = RTRIM(@spotEsteeId)        
                             AND Action <> '0'        
                             AND ActionType = 'SPECIAL DIVIDEND') THEN 1        
                           ELSE 0        
                         END        
  end        
      IF @isSpecialDiv = 1        
      BEGIN        
        PRINT 'This security has Special Dividend.'        
  if @exchange_code = 'BR'         
   begin        
    (SELECT @specialDivAmt = Action FROM CorporateActionTable WHERE EffectiveDate = @corpActionEffectiveDate AND UnderlyingEsteeId = RTRIM(@spotEsteeId)        
    AND Action <> '0' AND ActionType = 'DIVIDEND')        
   end        
  else        
   begin        
    (SELECT @specialDivAmt = Action FROM CorporateActionTable WHERE EffectiveDate = @corpActionEffectiveDate AND UnderlyingEsteeId = RTRIM(@spotEsteeId)        
    AND Action <> '0' AND ActionType = 'SPECIAL DIVIDEND')        
   end                
        IF @specialDivAmt <> @specialDividend and @updateSpecialDividend = 0        
        BEGIN        
          PRINT 'Special Dividend amount do not match as passed in SP and in corporateActionTable.'        
          IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0        
          BEGIN        
            PRINT 'Rolling back transaction'        
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION        
            PRINT 'Rolled back transaction'        
            RETURN        
          END        
        END        
      END        
      ELSE        
      BEGIN        
        IF @specialDividend IS NOT NULL        
          AND @specialDividend <> 0        
        BEGIN        
          PRINT 'Entry in corporateActionTable for ' + @spotEsteeId + ' is not present as an Action type = SPECIAL DIVIDEND'        
          IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0        
          BEGIN        
            PRINT 'Rolling back transaction'        
 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION        
            PRINT 'Rolled back transaction'        
            RETURN        
          END        
        END        
      END        
      PRINT 'Validated corporate action effective date, moving forward ....'        
    END        
    --- fetch the NET EOD position                  
    SET @rowscount = 1        
    DECLARE @localAllPositions TABLE (        
      Exchange_Code varchar(5),        
      securityName nvarchar(75),        
      Long int,        
      Short int,        
      TransactionCost decimal(20, 4),        
      Account_ID int,        
      SecurityType nvarchar(30),        
      Estee_ID nvarchar(50),        
      Sub_StrategyID varchar(5),        
      Broker_ID int,        
      PositionDate datetime,        
      AverageTradedPrice decimal(20, 4),        
      BuyValue decimal(20, 4),        
      SellValue decimal(20, 4),        
      AverageHoldingPrice decimal(20, 10),    
   Rule_id int     
    )        
    -- Creating temp table to store all the positions for the given date only.                  
    INSERT INTO @localAllPositions (Exchange_Code, securityName, Long, Short, TransactionCost, Account_ID, SecurityType, Estee_ID,        
    Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, PositionDate, AverageTradedPrice, BuyValue, SellValue, AverageHoldingPrice,Rule_id)        
    EXEC GetALLPositionsForGivenDateAndParameters @prevWorkingDate,        
                                                  NULL,        
                                                  NULL,        
                                                  NULL,        
                                                  @isin,        
                                           @exchange_code        
    IF @@ERROR <> 0        
    BEGIN        
      SET @error = @@ERROR        
      PRINT 'Error while getting all positions, error code - ' + @error        
      GOTO ERROR_HANDLER        
    END        
    DECLARE @localPositions TABLE (        
      rownum int IDENTITY (1, 1) PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,        
      securityName nvarchar(75),        
      Net int,        
      Long int,        
      Short int,        
      TransactionCost decimal(20, 4),        
      Account_ID int,        
      SecurityType nvarchar(30),        
      Estee_ID nvarchar(50),        
      Sub_StrategyID varchar(5),        
      Broker_ID int,        
      PositionDate datetime,        
      AverageTradedPrice decimal(20, 4),        
      BuyValue decimal(20, 4),        
      SellValue decimal(20, 4),        
      EMS_ID int        
    )        
    INSERT INTO @localPositions (securityName, Net, Long, Short, TransactionCost, Account_ID, SecurityType, Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID,        
    PositionDate, AverageTradedPrice, BuyValue, SellValue, EMS_ID)        
      SELECT        
        securityName,        
        CASE        
          WHEN long > short THEN long - short        
          WHEN short > long THEN (short - long) * -1        
        END AS Net,        
        Long,        
        Short,        
        TransactionCost,        
        Account_ID,        
        SecurityType,        
        Estee_ID,        
        Sub_StrategyID,        
        Broker_ID,        
        PositionDate,        
        AverageTradedPrice,        
        BuyValue,        
        SellValue,        
        e.EmsApplicationID        
      FROM @localAllPositions pos        
      LEFT JOIN #TempEmsServer e        
        ON pos.Sub_StrategyID = e.SubStrategyID        
        AND e.exchangeCode = SUBSTRING(pos.estee_id, 13, 2)        
      WHERE (long - short) <> 0        
    IF @@ERROR <> 0        
    BEGIN        
      SET @error = @@ERROR        
      PRINT 'Error while extracting net positions, error code - ' + @error        
      GOTO ERROR_HANDLER        
    END        
    SELECT       
      @MaxRows = COUNT(*)        
    FROM @localPositions        
    PRINT 'Found ' + CAST(@maxrows AS varchar(100)) + ' rows to adjust'        
    WHILE @rowsCount <= @MaxRows        
    BEGIN        
      SELECT        
        @broker_ID = broker_id,        
        @account_ID = account_ID,        
        @net_qty = net,        
        @order_price = AverageTradedPrice,        
        @estee_id = estee_id,        
        @sub_strategy_id = sub_strategyid,        
		@securitytype = securitytype,        
        @emsID = EMS_ID        
      FROM @localPositions        
      WHERE rownum = @rowscount        
      PRINT 'Starting row number - ' + CAST(@rowscount AS varchar(100))        
      SET @order_type = 1  -- limit order                  
      SET @order_validity = 0        
      SET @price_diff = 0        
      SET @order_source_id = 'Balancing'        
      SET @Remarks = @underlying_ticker + 'Adjustment'  -- for balance trades                  
      SET @comb_status = 'Complete'        
      SET @status = 'Executed'        
      SET @isLast = 1        
      SET @Original_Order_id = NULL        
      SET @New_Cancel_Modify = 'N'        
      SET @created_by = ''        
      SET @updated_by = ''        
      SET @creation_time = DATEADD(hh, 09, CAST(@corpActionEffectiveDate AS datetime))        
      SET @buy = 1        
      SET @sell = 2        
      SET @transaction_cost = 0        
      SET @linkID = -1       
      SET @neworderID = 0        
	  SET @strike_price = NULL           
      IF EXISTS (select 1 from SecurityType where TypeName = @securitytype and GroupID = 4)        
      SET @Isoption = 1        
      ELSE        
      SET @Isoption = 0  
	  IF EXISTS (select 1 from SecurityType where TypeName = @securitytype and GroupID = 5)
	  SET @IsCash = 1
	  ELSE
	  SET @IsCash = 0
      DECLARE @closePrice decimal(20, 6)        
      IF @specialDividend IS NOT NULL        
        AND @specialDividend > 0        
      BEGIN 
		if (@IsCash = 1 and @exchange_code <> 'BR' )
		BEGIN
			SET @rowsCount = @rowsCount + 1  
			CONTINUE
		END
        SELECT        
          @closePrice = Close_Price        
        FROM closingprice        
        WHERE Date = @prevWorkingDate        
        AND Estee_ID = @estee_ID        
        IF @@ERROR <> 0        
          OR @closePrice IS NULL        
          OR @closePrice = 0        
        BEGIN        
          SET @error = @@ERROR        
          PRINT 'Error while retrieving closing price for esteeID ' + @estee_ID        
          GOTO ERROR_HANDLER        
        END        
        SET @Order_Price = @closePrice        
        SELECT        
          @closePrice,        
          @Order_Price        
      END        
      -- create balancing trades and new trades using new estee id                  
      IF @net_qty > 0        
      BEGIN        
        -- balancing trade         
  if(@exchange_code != 'BR' OR @specialDividend is null OR @specialDividend = 0 OR (@exchange_code = 'BR' and @Isoption = 1 ))        
  Begin       
  SET @order_source_id = 'Balancing'        
  PRINT 'Balancing old estee id ' + @estee_id       
  if(@shouldExecute = 1)      
  BEGIN       
   EXEC sp_GetIDsBufferForBackDateOrder '1',        
            @Sub_Strategy_ID,        
         '1',   
    @corpActionEffectiveDate,      
         @Order_ID OUT        
   EXEC sp_GetIDsBufferForBackDateOrder '2',        
         @Sub_Strategy_ID,        
         '1',   
   @corpActionEffectiveDate,         
         @OrderTrade_ID OUT        
   EXEC sp_GetIDsBufferForBackDateOrder '3',        
         @Sub_Strategy_ID,        
         '1',    
   @corpActionEffectiveDate,        
         @Trade_ID OUT        
   EXEC spCreateOrder_move @order_type,        
         @order_validity,        
         @price_diff,        
         @broker_id,        
         @account_id,        
         @order_source_id,        
         @Remarks,        
         @sub_strategy_id,        
         @comb_status,        
         @underlying_ticker,        
         @status,        
         @isLast,       
         @Original_Order_id,        
         @New_Cancel_Modify,        
         @created_by,        
         @updated_by,        
         @neworderID,        
         @creation_time,        
         NULL,        
         @LinkID,        
         @LinkIDOut OUT,        
         NULL,        
         @estee_id,        
         @sell,        
         @net_qty,        
         @order_price,        
         @Creation_Time,        
         @Order_ID,        
         @OrderTrade_ID,        
         @Trade_ID,        
         @emsID       
  END      
        IF @@ERROR <> 0        
        BEGIN        
          SET @error = @@ERROR        
          PRINT 'Error while creating balancing trade for ' + @estee_ID + '; error - ' + CAST(@error AS varchar(500))        
          GOTO ERROR_HANDLER        
        END        
  Else        
   begin        
    insert into @TEMPBALANCINGTRADES        
    select @Order_ID,@OrderTrade_ID,@Trade_ID,@account_id,@sub_strategy_id,@broker_id,@estee_id, @net_qty, @order_price,@emsID,@status,@order_source_id        
   end        
        PRINT 'Created balancing trade for esteeID ' + @estee_id        
        PRINT ' old order price is ' + CAST(@order_price AS varchar)        
  END        
        
        IF @specialDividend IS NULL        
          OR @specialDividend = 0        
          SET @order_price = @order_price / @price_factor        
        ELSE        
  Begin        
    IF @exchange_code = 'BR' OR @Isoption=1        
   SET @order_price = @closePrice        
    else        
   SET @order_price = @closePrice - @specialDividend        
  End        
        PRINT 'new order price is ' + CAST(@order_price AS varchar)        
        SET @net_qty = (CAST(@net_qty AS bigint) * @new_quantity_factor) / @old_quantity_factor        
        SET @order_source_id = 'New Balancing'        
 IF EXISTS (select 1 from SecurityType where TypeName = @securitytype and GroupID = 4)        
        BEGIN            
           select @strike_price = Strike_Price FROM esteemaster WHERE Estee_ID = @estee_ID        
    IF @strike_price IS NULL OR @strike_price = 0        
   select @strike_price = Strike_Price FROM esteemaster_Archive WHERE Estee_ID = @estee_ID and status=1        
          IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @strike_price IS NULL OR @strike_price = 0        
          BEGIN        
            SET @error = @@ERROR        
            PRINT 'Error while retrieving strike price for esteeID ' + @estee_ID + ' strike price is ' + CAST(ISNULL(@strike_price, '') AS varchar(100))        
            GOTO ERROR_HANDLER        
          END        
         IF @specialDividend IS NULL OR @specialDividend = 0        
            SET @strike_price = @strike_price / @price_factor        
          ELSE        
            SET @strike_price = @strike_price - @specialDividend        
          SET @integerval = CAST(@strike_price AS int)        
          SET @decimalval = @strike_price - @integerval        
          SET @decimalval = ROUND(@decimalval / @ticksize, 0)        
          SET @decimalval = @decimalval * @ticksize        
          SET @strike_price = @integerval + @decimalval        
          IF @decimalval = 0        
            SET @new_estee_id = CAST(SUBSTRING(@estee_id, 1, 24) AS varchar) + CAST(CAST(@strike_price AS int) AS varchar)        
          ELSE        
            SET @new_estee_id = CAST(SUBSTRING(@estee_id, 1, 24) AS varchar) + Cast(Cast(@strike_price as float) as varchar)            
        END        
        ELSE           
          SET @new_estee_id = @estee_id

ERROR_HANDLER:

 select * from @TEMPNEWBALANCINGTRADES
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.Adjustment_Test_8thAug

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Adjustment_Test_8thAug] @corpActionEffectiveDate date,
@spotEsteeId nvarchar(50), -- spot estee_ID        
@underlying_ticker varchar(50),
@old_quantity_factor int, --Old quantity factor   
@new_quantity_factor int, --New quantity factor    
@ticksize decimal(10, 2),
@price_factor decimal(10, 6), --if price decrease factor higher than 1    
@exchange_code varchar(5),
@specialDividend decimal(10, 6) = NULL,
@prevWorkingDate date = NULL
/*--exec Adjustment '2014-11-20','INE062A01012IS00','SBIN',1,10,0.05,10,'IS' */
/*--(For special Dividend) exec Adjustment '2014-11-20','INE062A01012IS00','SBIN',1,1,0.05,1,'IS' , 9.5, '2014-11-19'  */
AS
BEGIN
  BEGIN TRAN
    DECLARE @rowsCount int
    DECLARE @MaxRows int
    DECLARE @Order_Type char
    DECLARE @Order_Validity int
    DECLARE @Price_Diff decimal(20, 2)
    DECLARE @Broker_ID int
    DECLARE @Account_ID int
    DECLARE @Order_Source_ID varchar(50)
    DECLARE @Remarks varchar(100)
    DECLARE @Sub_Strategy_ID int
    DECLARE @Comb_Status varchar(50)
    DECLARE @status varchar(50)
    DECLARE @isLast bit
    DECLARE @Original_Order_ID int
    DECLARE @New_Cancel_Modify varchar(1)
    DECLARE @Created_By int
    DECLARE @Updated_By int
    DECLARE @NewOrderID int -- required when inserting cancel /modify order        
    DECLARE @Creation_Time_In datetime
    DECLARE @Order_ID int
    DECLARE @OrderTrade_ID int
    DECLARE @Trade_ID int
    DECLARE @Creation_Time datetime
    DECLARE @LinkID int
    DECLARE @LinkIDOut int
    DECLARE @estee_ID varchar(50)
    DECLARE @new_estee_ID varchar(50)
    DECLARE @Buy_Sell_Indicator int
    DECLARE @Order_Quantity int
    DECLARE @Order_Price decimal(20, 6)
    DECLARE @Traded_Quantity int
    DECLARE @Traded_Price decimal(20, 6)
    DECLARE @Stop_Price decimal(20, 2)
    DECLARE @Transaction_Cost decimal(20, 2)
    DECLARE @net_qty int
    DECLARE @Buy int
    DECLARE @sell int
    DECLARE @securitytype varchar(20)
    DECLARE @strike_price decimal(10, 2)
    DECLARE @integerval decimal(10, 2)
    DECLARE @decimalval decimal(10, 2)
    DECLARE @error varchar(50)
    DECLARE @underlyingEsteeID varchar(50)
    DECLARE @emsID int
    DECLARE @isSpecialDiv bit
    DECLARE @specialDivAmt decimal(10, 6)
	DECLARE @Isoption int = 0
    CREATE TABLE #TempEmsServer (
      SubStrategyID int,
      EmsApplicationID int,
      EMSEMBServerType varchar(50),
      ExchangeCode varchar(5)
    )
    INSERT INTO #TempEmsServer
    EXEC spGetMultiExchangeEMSForCUI
    DECLARE @isin varchar(50)
    SET @isin = SUBSTRING(@spotEsteeId, 0, 13)
    DECLARE @date date
    SET @date = CAST(@corpActionEffectiveDate AS date)
    IF @prevWorkingDate IS NULL
      SET @prevWorkingDate = @date
    -- validate that there is a corporation action effective on the date passed in for the given underlying        
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT
        1
      FROM CorporateActionTable
      WHERE EffectiveDate = @corpActionEffectiveDate
      AND UnderlyingEsteeId = RTRIM(@spotEsteeId)
      AND Action <> '0')
    BEGIN
      PRINT 'There is no corporate action on the isin on the given date, please check the date. Aborting adjustment...'
      GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
      --Validation for special dividend.   
      --If Action type for this security is SPECIAL DIVIDEND in corporate action table then only it would proceed further.  
      --Also if value in action column matches the value for @specialDividend parameter then only it would proceed further
	  if @exchange_code = 'BR'
	  begin
	  SELECT @isSpecialDiv = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CorporateActionTable WHERE EffectiveDate = @corpActionEffectiveDate AND UnderlyingEsteeId = RTRIM(@spotEsteeId)
                             AND Action <> '0' AND ActionType = 'DIVIDEND') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
	  end
	  else
	  begin
      SELECT
        @isSpecialDiv =
                         CASE
                           WHEN EXISTS (SELECT
                               1
                             FROM CorporateActionTable
                             WHERE EffectiveDate = @corpActionEffectiveDate
                             AND UnderlyingEsteeId = RTRIM(@spotEsteeId)
                             AND Action <> '0'
                             AND ActionType = 'SPECIAL DIVIDEND') THEN 1
                           ELSE 0
                         END
		end
      IF @isSpecialDiv = 1
      BEGIN
        PRINT 'This security has Special Dividend.'
		if @exchange_code = 'BR' 
			begin
				(SELECT @specialDivAmt = Action FROM CorporateActionTable WHERE EffectiveDate = @corpActionEffectiveDate AND UnderlyingEsteeId = RTRIM(@spotEsteeId)
				AND Action <> '0' AND ActionType = 'DIVIDEND')
			end
		else
			begin
				(SELECT @specialDivAmt = Action FROM CorporateActionTable WHERE EffectiveDate = @corpActionEffectiveDate AND UnderlyingEsteeId = RTRIM(@spotEsteeId)
				AND Action <> '0' AND ActionType = 'SPECIAL DIVIDEND')
			end      
        IF @specialDivAmt <> @specialDividend
        BEGIN
          PRINT 'Special Dividend amount do not match as passed in SP and in corporateActionTable.'
          IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
          BEGIN
            PRINT 'Rolling back transaction'
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
            PRINT 'Rolled back transaction'
            RETURN
          END
        END
      END
      ELSE
      BEGIN
        IF @specialDividend IS NOT NULL
          AND @specialDividend <> 0
        BEGIN
          PRINT 'Entry in corporateActionTable for ' + @spotEsteeId + ' is not present as an Action type = SPECIAL DIVIDEND'
          IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
          BEGIN
            PRINT 'Rolling back transaction'
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
            PRINT 'Rolled back transaction'
            RETURN
          END
        END
      END
      PRINT 'Validated corporate action effective date, moving forward ....'
    END
    --- fetch the NET EOD position        
    SET @rowscount = 1
    DECLARE @localAllPositions TABLE (
      Exchange_Code varchar(5),
      securityName nvarchar(75),
      Long int,
      Short int,
      TransactionCost decimal(20, 4),
      Account_ID int,
      SecurityType nvarchar(30),
      Estee_ID nvarchar(50),
      Sub_StrategyID varchar(5),
      Broker_ID int,
      PositionDate datetime,
      AverageTradedPrice decimal(20, 4),
      BuyValue decimal(20, 4),
      SellValue decimal(20, 4),
      AverageHoldingPrice decimal(20, 10)
    )
    -- Creating temp table to store all the positions for the given date only.        
    INSERT INTO @localAllPositions (Exchange_Code, securityName, Long, Short, TransactionCost, Account_ID, SecurityType, Estee_ID,
    Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, PositionDate, AverageTradedPrice, BuyValue, SellValue, AverageHoldingPrice)
    EXEC GetALLPositionsForGivenDateAndParameters @prevWorkingDate,
                                                  NULL,
                                                  NULL,
                                                  NULL,
                                                  @isin,
                                                  @exchange_code
    IF @@ERROR <> 0
    BEGIN
      SET @error = @@ERROR
      PRINT 'Error while getting all positions, error code - ' + @error
      GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
    END
    DECLARE @localPositions TABLE (
      rownum int IDENTITY (1, 1) PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      securityName nvarchar(75),
      Net int,
      Long int,
      Short int,
      TransactionCost decimal(20, 4),
      Account_ID int,
      SecurityType nvarchar(30),
      Estee_ID nvarchar(50),
      Sub_StrategyID varchar(5),
      Broker_ID int,
      PositionDate datetime,
      AverageTradedPrice decimal(20, 4),
      BuyValue decimal(20, 4),
      SellValue decimal(20, 4),
      EMS_ID int
    )
    INSERT INTO @localPositions (securityName, Net, Long, Short, TransactionCost, Account_ID, SecurityType, Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID,
    PositionDate, AverageTradedPrice, BuyValue, SellValue, EMS_ID)
      SELECT
        securityName,
        CASE
          WHEN long > short THEN long - short
          WHEN short > long THEN (short - long) * -1
        END AS Net,
        Long,
        Short,
        TransactionCost,
        Account_ID,
        SecurityType,
        Estee_ID,
        Sub_StrategyID,
        Broker_ID,
        PositionDate,
        AverageTradedPrice,
        BuyValue,
        SellValue,
        e.EmsApplicationID
      FROM @localAllPositions pos
      LEFT JOIN #TempEmsServer e
        ON pos.Sub_StrategyID = e.SubStrategyID
        AND e.exchangeCode = SUBSTRING(pos.estee_id, 13, 2)
      WHERE (long - short) <> 0
    IF @@ERROR <> 0
    BEGIN
      SET @error = @@ERROR
      PRINT 'Error while extracting net positions, error code - ' + @error
      GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
    END
    SELECT
      @MaxRows = COUNT(*)
    FROM @localPositions
    PRINT 'Found ' + CAST(@maxrows AS varchar(100)) + ' rows to adjust'
    WHILE @rowsCount <= @MaxRows
    BEGIN
      SELECT
        @broker_ID = broker_id,
        @account_ID = account_ID,
        @net_qty = net,
        @order_price = AverageTradedPrice,
        @estee_id = estee_id,
        @sub_strategy_id = sub_strategyid,
        @securitytype = securitytype,
        @emsID = EMS_ID
      FROM @localPositions
      WHERE rownum = @rowscount
      PRINT 'Starting row number - ' + CAST(@rowscount AS varchar(100))
      SET @order_type = 1  -- limit order        
      SET @order_validity = 0
      SET @price_diff = 0
      SET @order_source_id = 'Balancing'
      SET @Remarks = @underlying_ticker + 'Adjustment'  -- for balance trades        
      SET @comb_status = 'Complete'
      SET @status = 'Executed'
      SET @isLast = 1
      SET @Original_Order_id = NULL
      SET @New_Cancel_Modify = 'N'
      SET @created_by = ''
      SET @updated_by = ''
      SET @creation_time = DATEADD(hh, 09, CAST(@corpActionEffectiveDate AS datetime))
      SET @buy = 1
      SET @sell = 2
      SET @transaction_cost = 0
      SET @linkID = 0
      SET @neworderID = 0
	  SET @strike_price = NULL	  
	  IF EXISTS (select 1 from SecurityType where TypeName = @securitytype and GroupID = 4)
		SET @Isoption = 1
	  ELSE
		SET @Isoption = 0
      DECLARE @closePrice decimal(20, 6)
      IF @specialDividend IS NOT NULL
        AND @specialDividend > 0
      BEGIN
        SELECT
          @closePrice = Close_Price
        FROM closingprice
        WHERE Date = @prevWorkingDate
        AND Estee_ID = @estee_ID
        IF @@ERROR <> 0
          OR @closePrice IS NULL
          OR @closePrice = 0
        BEGIN
          SET @error = @@ERROR
          PRINT 'Error while retrieving closing price for esteeID ' + @estee_ID
          GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
        END
        SET @Order_Price = @closePrice
        SELECT
          @closePrice,
          @Order_Price
      END
      -- create balancing trades and new trades using new estee id        
      IF @net_qty > 0
      BEGIN
        -- balancing trade 
		if(@exchange_code != 'BR' OR @specialDividend is null OR @specialDividend = 0 OR (@exchange_code = 'BR' and @Isoption = 1 ))
		Begin
        SET @order_source_id = 'Balancing'
        PRINT 'Balancing old estee id ' + @estee_id	
        EXEC sp_GetIDsBuffer '1',
                             @Sub_Strategy_ID,
                             '1',
                             @Order_ID OUT
        EXEC sp_GetIDsBuffer '2',
                             @Sub_Strategy_ID,
                             '1',
                             @OrderTrade_ID OUT
        EXEC sp_GetIDsBuffer '3',
                             @Sub_Strategy_ID,
                             '1',
                             @Trade_ID OUT
        EXEC spCreateOrder_move @order_type,
                                @order_validity,
                                @price_diff,
                                @broker_id,
                                @account_id,
                                @order_source_id,
                                @Remarks,
                                @sub_strategy_id,
                                @comb_status,
                                @underlying_ticker,
                                @status,
                                @isLast,
                                @Original_Order_id,
                                @New_Cancel_Modify,
                                @created_by,
                                @updated_by,
                                @neworderID,
                                @creation_time,
                                NULL,
                                @LinkID,
                                @LinkIDOut OUT,
                                NULL,
                                @estee_id,
                                @sell,
                                @net_qty,
                                @order_price,
                                @Creation_Time,
                                @Order_ID,
                                @OrderTrade_ID,
                                @Trade_ID,
                                @emsID
        IF @@ERROR <> 0
        BEGIN
          SET @error = @@ERROR
          PRINT 'Error while creating balancing trade for ' + @estee_ID + '; error - ' + CAST(@error AS varchar(500))
          GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
        END
        PRINT 'Created balancing trade for esteeID ' + @estee_id
        PRINT ' old order price is ' + CAST(@order_price AS varchar)
		END

        IF @specialDividend IS NULL
          OR @specialDividend = 0
          SET @order_price = @order_price / @price_factor
        ELSE
		Begin
		  IF @exchange_code = 'BR'
			SET @order_price = @closePrice
		  else
			SET @order_price = @closePrice - @specialDividend
		End
        PRINT 'new order price is ' + CAST(@order_price AS varchar)
        SET @net_qty = (CAST(@net_qty AS bigint) * @new_quantity_factor) / @old_quantity_factor
        SET @order_source_id = 'New Balancing'
	IF EXISTS (select 1 from SecurityType where TypeName = @securitytype and GroupID = 4)
        BEGIN		  
           select @strike_price = Strike_Price FROM esteemaster WHERE Estee_ID = @estee_ID
		  IF @strike_price IS NULL OR @strike_price = 0
			select @strike_price = Strike_Price FROM esteemaster_Archive WHERE Estee_ID = @estee_ID and status=1
          IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @strike_price IS NULL OR @strike_price = 0
          BEGIN
            SET @error = @@ERROR
            PRINT 'Error while retrieving strike price for esteeID ' + @estee_ID + ' strike price is ' + CAST(ISNULL(@strike_price, '') AS varchar(100))
            GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
          END
          IF @specialDividend IS NULL OR @specialDividend = 0
            SET @strike_price = @strike_price / @price_factor
          ELSE
            SET @strike_price = @strike_price - @specialDividend
          SET @integerval = CAST(@strike_price AS int)
          SET @decimalval = @strike_price - @integerval
          SET @decimalval = ROUND(@decimalval / @ticksize, 0)
          SET @decimalval = @decimalval * @ticksize
          SET @strike_price = @integerval + @decimalval
          IF @decimalval = 0
            SET @new_estee_id = CAST(SUBSTRING(@estee_id, 1, 24) AS varchar) + CAST(CAST(@strike_price AS int) AS varchar)
          ELSE
            SET @new_estee_id = CAST(SUBSTRING(@estee_id, 1, 24) AS varchar) + Cast(Cast(@strike_price as float) as varchar)		  
        END
        ELSE		 
          SET @new_estee_id = @estee_id	
		if(@exchange_code != 'BR' OR @specialDividend is null OR @specialDividend = 0 OR (@exchange_code = 'BR' and @Isoption = 1 ))
		BEGIN
        PRINT 'new estee id' + @new_estee_id
        PRINT 'Creating new trade for estee ID ' + @new_estee_id
        EXEC sp_GetIDsBuffer '1',
                             @Sub_Strategy_ID,
                             '1',
                             @Order_ID OUT
        EXEC sp_GetIDsBuffer '2',
                             @Sub_Strategy_ID,
                             '1',
                             @OrderTrade_ID OUT
        EXEC sp_GetIDsBuffer '3',
                             @Sub_Strategy_ID,
                             '1',
                             @Trade_ID OUT
        EXEC spCreateOrder_move @order_type,
                                @order_validity,
                                @price_diff,
                                @broker_id,
                                @account_id,
                                @order_source_id,
                                @Remarks,
                                @sub_strategy_id,
                                @comb_status,
                                @underlying_ticker,
                                @status,
                                @isLast,
                                @Original_Order_id,
                                @New_Cancel_Modify,
                                @created_by,
                                @updated_by,
                                @neworderID,
                                @creation_time,
                                NULL,
                                @LinkID,
                                @LinkIDOut OUT,
                                NULL,
                                @new_estee_ID,
                                @buy,
                                @net_qty,
                                @order_price,
                                @Creation_Time,
                                @Order_ID,
                                @OrderTrade_ID,
                                @Trade_ID,
                                @emsID
        PRINT 'Creating new trade for estee ID ' + @new_estee_id
        IF @@ERROR <> 0
        BEGIN
          SET @error = @@ERROR
          PRINT 'Error while creating new trade for ' + @new_estee_ID + '; error - ' + CAST(@error AS varchar(500))
          GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
        END
        PRINT ' Created new trade for estee ID - ' + @new_estee_ID
		END
      END
      ELSE
      BEGIN
        -- balancing trade        
        SET @net_qty = @net_qty * -1
		if(@exchange_code != 'BR' OR @specialDividend is null OR @specialDividend = 0 OR (@exchange_code = 'BR' and @Isoption = 1 ))
		BEGIN
        SET @order_source_id = 'Balancing'
        PRINT 'old estee id' + @estee_id
        EXEC sp_GetIDsBuffer '1',
                             @Sub_Strategy_ID,
                             '1',
                             @Order_ID OUT
        EXEC sp_GetIDsBuffer '2',
                             @Sub_Strategy_ID,
                             '1',
                             @OrderTrade_ID OUT
        EXEC sp_GetIDsBuffer '3',
                             @Sub_Strategy_ID,
                             '1',
                             @Trade_ID OUT
        EXEC spCreateOrder_move @order_type,
                                @order_validity,
                                @price_diff,
                                @broker_id,
                                @account_id,
                                @order_source_id,
                                @Remarks,
                                @sub_strategy_id,
                                @comb_status,
                                @underlying_ticker,
                                @status,
                                @isLast,
                                @Original_Order_id,
                                @New_Cancel_Modify,
                                @created_by,
                                @updated_by,
                                @neworderID,
                                @creation_time,
                                NULL,
                                @LinkID,
                                @LinkIDOut OUT,
                                NULL,
                                @estee_id,
                                @buy,
                                @net_qty,
                                @order_price,
                                @Creation_Time,
                                @Order_ID,
                                @OrderTrade_ID,
                                @Trade_ID,
                                @emsID
        IF @@ERROR <> 0
        BEGIN
          SET @error = @@ERROR
          PRINT 'Error while creating balancing trade for ' + @estee_ID + '; error - ' + CAST(@error AS varchar(500))
          GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
        END
        -- new trade        
        PRINT ' old order price is ' + CAST(@order_price AS varchar)
		END
        IF @specialDividend IS NULL OR @specialDividend = 0
          SET @order_price = @order_price / @price_factor
		ELSE IF @exchange_code = 'BR'
			SET @order_price = @closePrice
        ELSE
          SET @order_price = @closePrice - @specialDividend
        PRINT 'new order price is ' + CAST(@order_price AS varchar)
        SET @net_qty = (CAST(@net_qty AS bigint) * @new_quantity_factor) / @old_quantity_factor
        SET @order_source_id = 'New Balancing'
       IF EXISTS (select 1 from SecurityType where TypeName = @securitytype and GroupID = 4)
        BEGIN
          SELECT @strike_price = Strike_Price FROM esteemaster WHERE Estee_ID = @estee_ID
		   IF @strike_price IS NULL
            OR @strike_price = 0
			select @strike_price = Strike_Price FROM esteemaster_Archive WHERE Estee_ID = @estee_ID and status=1
          IF @@ERROR <> 0
            OR @strike_price IS NULL
            OR @strike_price = 0
          BEGIN
            SET @error = @@ERROR
            PRINT 'Error while retrieving strike price for esteeID ' + @estee_ID + ' strike price is ' + CAST(ISNULL(@strike_price, 0) AS varchar(100))
            GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
          END
          IF @specialDividend IS NULL
            OR @specialDividend = 0
            SET @strike_price = @strike_price / @price_factor
          ELSE
            SET @strike_price = @strike_price - @specialDividend
          SET @integerval = CAST(@strike_price AS int)
          SET @decimalval = @strike_price - @integerval
          SET @decimalval = ROUND(@decimalval / @ticksize, 0)
          SET @decimalval = @decimalval * @ticksize
          SET @strike_price = @integerval + @decimalval
          IF @decimalval = 0
            SET @new_estee_id = CAST(SUBSTRING(@estee_id, 1, 24) AS varchar) + CAST(CAST(@strike_price AS int) AS varchar)
          ELSE
            SET @new_estee_id = CAST(SUBSTRING(@estee_id, 1, 24) AS varchar) + Cast(Cast(@strike_price as float) as varchar)		 
        END
        ELSE	
          SET @new_estee_id = @estee_id
		if(@exchange_code != 'BR' OR @specialDividend is null OR @specialDividend = 0 OR (@exchange_code = 'BR' and @Isoption = 1 ))
		BEGIN
        PRINT 'new estee id' + @new_estee_id
        EXEC sp_GetIDsBuffer '1',
                             @Sub_Strategy_ID,
                             '1',
                             @Order_ID OUT
        EXEC sp_GetIDsBuffer '2',
                             @Sub_Strategy_ID,
                             '1',
                             @OrderTrade_ID OUT
        EXEC sp_GetIDsBuffer '3',
                             @Sub_Strategy_ID,
                             '1',
                             @Trade_ID OUT
        PRINT 'Creating new trade for new estee ID - ' + @new_estee_ID
        EXEC spCreateOrder_move @order_type,
                                @order_validity,
                                @price_diff,
                                @broker_id,
                                @account_id,
                                @order_source_id,
                                @Remarks,
                                @sub_strategy_id,
                                @comb_status,
                                @underlying_ticker,
                                @status,
                                @isLast,
                                @Original_Order_id,
                                @New_Cancel_Modify,
                                @created_by,
                                @updated_by,
                                @neworderID,
                                @creation_time,
                                NULL,
                                @LinkID,
                                @LinkIDOut OUT,
                                NULL,
                                @new_estee_ID,
                                @sell,
                                @net_qty,
                                @order_price,
                                @Creation_Time,
                                @Order_ID,
                                @OrderTrade_ID,
                                @Trade_ID,
                                @emsID
        IF @@ERROR <> 0
        BEGIN
          SET @error = @@ERROR
          PRINT 'Error while creating new trade for esteeID ' + @new_estee_ID + '; error - ' + CAST(@error AS varchar(500))
          GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
        END
        PRINT 'Created new trade for new estee ID - ' + @new_estee_ID
	  END
      END
      SELECT
        @rowsCount = @rowsCount + 1
    END
  COMMIT TRANSACTION
ERROR_HANDLER:
  IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
  BEGIN
    PRINT 'Rolling back transaction'
    ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
    PRINT 'Rolled back transaction'
  END
END -- procedure ends here.. 
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.ArchiveOrders

```sql
CREATE PROC [dbo].[ArchiveOrders]

AS
BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON

      DECLARE @CutOffDate  DATETIME
      SET @CutOffDate = DATEADD(mm, -3, DATEADD(dd, 0, DATEDIFF(dd, 0, GETDATE())))

      BEGIN TRAN

            SELECT * INTO TBLlINKORDERS_ARCHIVE FROM TBLlINKORDERS WHERE LINKid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT lINK_ID FROM TBLORDERS WHERE ORDER_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT ORDER_ID FROM TBLORDERTRADES WHERE CREATION_TIME < @CutOffDate)) 
            SELECT * INTO TBLORDERS_ARCHIVE FROM TBLORDERS WHERE ORDER_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT ORDER_ID FROM TBLORDERTRADES WHERE CREATION_TIME < @CutOffDate)
            SELECT * INTO TBLORDERTRADES_ARCHIVE FROM TBLORDERTRADES WHERE CREATION_TIME < @CutOffDate
            SELECT * INTO TBLTRADES_ARCHIVE FROM TBLTRADES WHERE ORDERTRADE_ID IN (SELECT  ORDERTRADE_ID FROM TBLORDERTRADES WHERE CREATION_TIME < @CutOffDate)
            SELECT * INTO TBLORDERTRAIL_ARCHIVE FROM TBLORDERTRAIL WHERE TRADE_ID IN ( SELECT TRADE_ID FROM TBLTRADES WHERE ORDERTRADE_ID IN (SELECT  ORDERTRADE_ID FROM TBLORDERTRADES WHERE CREATION_TIME < @CutOffDate))

          
--            DELETE FROM TBLORDERTRAIL WHERE TRADE_ID IN ( SELECT TRADE_ID FROM TBLTRADES WHERE ORDERTRADE_ID IN (SELECT  ORDERTRADE_ID FROM TBLORDERTRADES WHERE CREATION_TIME < @CutOffDate))
--            DELETE FROM TBLTRADES WHERE ORDERTRADE_ID IN (SELECT  ORDERTRADE_ID FROM TBLORDERTRADES WHERE CREATION_TIME < @CutOffDate)
--            DELETE FROM TBLORDERTRADES WHERE CREATION_TIME < @CutOffDate
--            DELETE FROM TBLORDERS WHERE ORDER_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT ORDER_ID FROM TBLORDERTRADES WHERE CREATION_TIME < @CutOffDate)
--            DELETE FROM TBLlINKORDERS WHERE LINKid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT lINK_ID FROM TBLORDERS WHERE ORDER_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT ORDER_ID FROM TBLORDERTRADES WHERE CREATION_TIME < @CutOffDate)) 

            INSERT INTO tblArchiveLog (
	        run_date, 
	        archive_date)
            VALUES (
            getDate(),
            @CutOffDate)
	     
          

            IF @@ERROR <> 0
            BEGIN
                  ROLLBACK TRAN
                  RAISERROR ('ERROR WHILE ARCHIVING ROLLBACK DONE', 16, 1)
                  RETURN -1
            END

          

      IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
      BEGIN
            COMMIT TRAN
            RETURN 0
      END

END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.AttributeRebate

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[AttributeRebate]
	@execIDs varchar(max) = null,
	@tokens varchar(100) = null,
	@date datetime
AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @TokenTable TABLE(token int)     
	INSERT into @TokenTable SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) from dbo.split(@tokens,',')

    select distinct otd.Sub_Strategy_ID, otl.Exec_ID, td.Buy_Sell_Indicator, e.token 
	from tblOrderTrail otl with(nolock)
	inner join tblTrades td with(nolock) on otl.Trade_ID = td.Trade_ID 
	inner join tblOrderTrades otd with(nolock) on td.OrderTrade_ID = otd.OrderTrade_ID
	inner join esteemaster e with(nolock) on e.Estee_ID = td.Estee_ID
	inner join @TokenTable t on t.token = e.Token
	where otl.Exec_ID in (@execIDs)
	and otl.Fill_Price > 0 
	and otd.creation_time > @date
	order by Exec_ID
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.BackofficeTrades

```sql
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[BackofficeTrades]                     

@acnt varchar(3),  
@Startdate date,    
@Enddate date          
       

AS                   
BEGIN 
SET NOCOUNT ON;

If  exists (select * from Account where exchange_code = 'SG' AND ACCOUNT_ID = @acnt)
BEGIN
Print cast ('As informed, script not supported for SGX Yet.' as VARCHAR (100)) 
GOTO ERROR_HANDLER  
END

If  not exists (select * from Account where exchange_code = 'SG' AND ACCOUNT_ID = @acnt)
BEGIN
--Trades with Estee_id in EsteeMaster_archive
select creation_date as 'Trade Date',account_id,execid as 'Execution ID',Exchange_Order_ID,ea.DataFeed_Ticker,
substring (v.estee_id,17,8) as 'Expiry',buy_sell_indicator,ea.lot_size,traded_quantity,traded_price, 
Traded_Price*Traded_Quantity as 'Trade Value', order_source_id, SUM((3-2*Buy_Sell_Indicator)*traded_quantity) 'Net Position'
from vwalltrades  v
left join esteemaster e ON e.Estee_ID = v.Estee_ID
left join EsteeMaster_archive ea ON (ea.Estee_ID = v.Estee_ID)
where creation_date >= @Startdate and creation_date <= @Enddate and account_id in (select * from dbo.split (@acnt,',') ) and v.status in ('executed','partially filled')
and ea.DataFeed_Ticker is not null
group by creation_date,account_id,execid,Exchange_Order_ID,ea.DataFeed_Ticker,v.estee_id,buy_sell_indicator,ea.lot_size,traded_quantity,traded_price,order_source_id
UNION
--Trades with Estee_id in EsteeMaster
select creation_date as 'Trade Date',account_id,execid as 'Execution ID',Exchange_Order_ID,e.DataFeed_Ticker,
substring (v.estee_id,17,8) as 'Expiry',buy_sell_indicator,e.lot_size,traded_quantity,traded_price, 
Traded_Price*Traded_Quantity as 'Trade Value', order_source_id,SUM((3-2*Buy_Sell_Indicator)*traded_quantity) 'Net Position'
from vwalltrades  v
left join esteemaster e ON e.Estee_ID = v.Estee_ID
left join EsteeMaster_archive ea ON (ea.Estee_ID = v.Estee_ID)
where creation_date >= @Startdate and creation_date <= @Enddate and account_id in (select * from dbo.split (@acnt,',')) and v.status in ('executed','partially filled')
and ea.DataFeed_Ticker is null
group by creation_date,account_id,execid,Exchange_Order_ID,e.DataFeed_Ticker,v.estee_id,buy_sell_indicator,e.lot_size,traded_quantity,traded_price,order_source_id
order by creation_date,account_id,execid,Exchange_Order_ID,buy_sell_indicator,traded_quantity,traded_price,order_source_id

END
end
ERROR_HANDLER:  

IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 BEGIN  
PRINT 'Rolling back transaction'  
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION  
PRINT 'Rolled back transaction'   
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.BackofficeTrades2

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[BackofficeTrades2]                           
    
@acnt varchar(3),      
@Startdate date,          
@Enddate date                
             
    
AS                         
BEGIN     
SET NOCOUNT ON;    
    
If  exists (select * from Account where exchange_code = 'SG' AND ACCOUNT_ID = @acnt)    
BEGIN    
Print cast ('As informed, script not supported for SGX Yet.' as VARCHAR (100))     
GOTO ERROR_HANDLER      
END    
    
If  not exists (select * from Account where exchange_code = 'SG' AND ACCOUNT_ID = @acnt)    
BEGIN    
select creation_date as 'Trade Date',account_id,v.Sub_Strategy_ID, e.Exchange_Code, c1.CurrencyCode as TradingCurrency,c2.CurrencyCode as SettlementCurrency, execid as 'Execution ID',Exchange_Order_ID,v.estee_id,st.typename 'Security_Type',  
ea.DataFeed_Ticker, substring (v.estee_id,17,8) as 'Expiry',buy_sell_indicator,ea.lot_size,traded_quantity,traded_price,   
Traded_Price*Traded_Quantity as 'Trade Value', order_source_id, (3-2*Buy_Sell_Indicator)*traded_quantity 'Net Position'   
from vwalltrades (nolock)  v left join esteemaster (nolock) e ON e.Estee_ID = v.Estee_ID   
left join EsteeMaster_archive (nolock) ea ON (ea.Estee_ID = v.Estee_ID) and ea.status = 1   
left join SecurityType st on st.typecode = isnull(ea.security_type,e.security_type)  
left join currency c1 on c1.id = e.tradingCurrency  
left join currency c2 on c2.id = e.settlementCurrency  
where creation_date >= @Startdate and creation_date <= @Enddate and account_id in (select * from dbo.split (@acnt,',') )   
and v.status in ('executed','partially filled') and isnull(ea.DataFeed_Ticker,e.DataFeed_Ticker) is null   
--and Order_Source_ID not in ('Balancing', 'Odin')  
union   
select creation_date as 'Trade Date',account_id,v.Sub_Strategy_ID, e.Exchange_Code,c1.CurrencyCode as TradingCurrency,c2.CurrencyCode as SettlementCurrency, execid as 'Execution ID',Exchange_Order_ID,v.estee_id,st.typename 'Security_Type',  
ea.DataFeed_Ticker, substring (v.estee_id,17,8) as 'Expiry',buy_sell_indicator,ea.lot_size,traded_quantity,traded_price,   
Traded_Price*Traded_Quantity as 'Trade Value', order_source_id, (3-2*Buy_Sell_Indicator)*traded_quantity 'Net Position'   
from vwalltrades  v left join esteemaster (nolock) e ON e.Estee_ID = v.Estee_ID   
left join EsteeMaster_archive (nolock) ea ON (ea.Estee_ID = v.Estee_ID) and ea.status = 1   
left join SecurityType st on st.typecode = isnull(ea.security_type,e.security_type)  
left join currency c1 on c1.id = e.tradingCurrency  
left join currency c2 on c2.id = e.settlementCurrency  
where creation_date >= @Startdate and creation_date <= @Enddate and account_id in (select * from dbo.split (@acnt,',') )   
and v.status in ('executed','partially filled') and isnull(ea.DataFeed_Ticker,e.DataFeed_Ticker) is not null   
--and Order_Source_ID not in ('Balancing', 'Odin')  
order by creation_date,account_id,v.Sub_Strategy_ID,execid,e.Exchange_Code,c1.CurrencyCode, c2.CurrencyCode,Exchange_Order_ID,v.estee_id,buy_sell_indicator,traded_quantity,traded_price,order_source_id     
    
END    
end    
ERROR_HANDLER:      
    
IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 BEGIN        
PRINT 'Rolling back transaction'        
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION        
PRINT 'Rolled back transaction'       
END 

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.Block_User

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Block_User]        
@userName varchar(50) = null,    
@roleName varchar(50) = null    
         
AS        
BEGIN  
 declare @blocked bit  
 set @blocked = (Select Blocked FROM LoginDetails WHERE Username = @userName)  
   
  IF(@blocked = 'True')  
      Select 0  
  ELSE  
   UPDATE LoginDetails SET Blocked = 1 WHERE Username = @userName  
    
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.BrokerLoginDetails

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[BrokerLoginDetails]
	@choice  int = 0,
	@password varchar(50) = null,
	@update   datetime =null,
	@oldpass1  varchar(50) = null,
	@oldpass2 varchar(50) = null,
	@flag int =0
	As
BEGIN
	if(@choice=0)
      select A.broker_id,username,A.Password,A.Old_Password1,A.Old_Password2,B.Broker_Name from BrokerLogon as A,Broker as B where A. Broker_id= B. Broker_id;
    else  if(@choice = 1)
      UPDATE BrokerLogon set Password = @password ,Last_Update_Time = @update, Old_Password1 = @oldpass1,Old_Password2 = @oldpass2,flag = @flag;
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.BulkInsertIntoLiveDataBar

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[BulkInsertIntoLiveDataBar]
@filePath varchar(max),  
@tableName varchar(300),  
@fieldTerminator varchar(100),  
@rowTerminator varchar(100),  
@statusMessage varchar(max) out  
/*  
this sp bulk inserts a given file on the local file system into an existing table provided that the list of columns in the file and in the table do not conflict  
in terms of sequence or in datatype  
*/  
AS  
BEGIN  
 BEGIN TRY  
   SET XACT_ABORT ON  
   BEGIN TRAN   
    SET @statusMessage='Starting for filepath-> '+@filePath+ ' tableName-> '+@tableName+ 'fieldTerminator-> ' +@fieldTerminator + 'rowTerminator-> ' +@rowTerminator  
    DECLARE @sqlStatement VARCHAR(MAX)  
    SET @statusMessage+='.Initiating Bulk insert'  
    SET @sqlStatement = 'BULK INSERT ' + @tableName+' FROM ''' + @filePath + ''' WITH ( FIRSTROW=2, FIELDTERMINATOR = '''+ @fieldTerminator+''', ROWTERMINATOR = '''+ @rowTerminator+''')'  
    SET @statusMessage+='.Executing : '+@sqlStatement  
    EXEC(@sqlStatement)  
    SET @statusMessage+='Rows affected : '+CAST(@@ROWCOUNT as varchar(100))  
   COMMIT TRAN  
   SET @statusMessage+='.Exiting successfully'  
   SET XACT_ABORT OFF  
 END TRY  
   
 BEGIN CATCH  
      SET @statusMessage+='Exception occured: '+ERROR_MESSAGE()+' ' +CAST(ERROR_NUMBER() AS VARCHAR(100)) + ' '+CAST (ERROR_LINE() AS VARCHAR(100))  
      ROLLBACK TRAN  
      SET XACT_ABORT OFF  
 END CATCH  
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.BulkInsertSelectiveIntoOrderExecStaging

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[BulkInsertSelectiveIntoOrderExecStaging]  
@filePath varchar(max),  
@emsApplicationID int,  
@statusMessage varchar(max) out  
/*
Does a bulk insert into Orderexecstaging table from the given file. We cant use the generic bulk insert sp here because, the file contains 1 column lesser than the table (emsapplicationid).
hence a direct bulk insert will not be possible. we are tackling this problem by first bulk inserting into a view(built on top of the table but does not contain the emsapplicationid column) and then updating the 
emsapplicationid column on the table
*/
as  
BEGIN  
 BEGIN TRY  
			  SET XACT_ABORT ON  
			  DECLARE @sqlStatement VARCHAR(MAX)    
			  DELETE FROM OrderExec_Staging WHERE EMSApplicationID=@emsApplicationID  
			  SET @statusMessage='.Initiating Bulk insert'  
			  SET @sqlStatement = 'BULK INSERT VWBulkInsert_OrderExecStaging FROM ''' + @filePath + ''' WITH ( FIELDTERMINATOR = '','', ROWTERMINATOR = ''\n'')'  
			  EXEC(@sqlStatement)  
			  SET @statusMessage+= 'Inserted into the view. Row count : '+CAST(@@ROWCOUNT as varchar(100))
			  UPDATE ORDEREXEC_STAGING set EMSApplicationID=@emsApplicationID where EMSApplicationID is null   
			 SET @statusMessage+= 'Updated ems id in original table. Row Count:  '+CAST(@@ROWCOUNT as varchar(100)) 
 END TRY  
 BEGIN CATCH  
			  SET @statusMessage+='Exception occured: '+ERROR_MESSAGE()+' ' +CAST(ERROR_NUMBER() AS VARCHAR(100)) + ' '+CAST (ERROR_LINE() AS VARCHAR(100))  
			  SET XACT_ABORT OFF  
 END CATCH  
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.calculateCPUUtilization

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[calculateCPUUtilization]
@Server varchar(16),  
@Asofdate datetime
AS
BEGIN

declare @PlatformType varchar(50)
select @PlatformType=OS from EsteeServers where IP=@Server
if @PlatformType = 'Linux'
select Server,SUM(CPU) as CPU, sum (Memory) as Memory,sum (ThreadCount) as ThreadCount, MAX(CpuCoreNo)+1 as NumOfCores  from PerfTrackerData where AsOfDate >= @Asofdate and AsOfDate < @Asofdate+1  and Server =@Server  group by  AsOfDate,Server
else 
select Server, CPU, Memory,ThreadCount,0 as NumOfCores from PerfTrackerData where AsOfDate >= @Asofdate and AsOfDate < @Asofdate+1 and ProcessName = 'ServerCPU' and Server =@Server

END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.CalculatePercentile

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[CalculatePercentile]    
@TABLENAME VARCHAR(100),    
@COLUMNNAME VARCHAR(100),    
@CONDITION VARCHAR(3000),  
@PERCENTILE DECIMAL(5,2),    
@RESULT DECIMAL(20,5) OUT    
/*  
sp to calculate percentile on any given table, on a specific column (Which contains numeric datatype). Pass the percentile as a percentage number without dividing by 100  
*/  
AS    
BEGIN    
 CREATE TABLE #TEMPPROCESS  
(  
 ID [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,  
 VALUE DECIMAL(20,5)  
)  
  
 DECLARE @QUERY VARCHAR(MAX)    
 IF(LEN(@CONDITION)>0)  
    SET @QUERY=' INSERT INTO #TEMPPROCESS(VALUE) SELECT '+@COLUMNNAME+' FROM '+@TABLENAME+' WHERE '+@CONDITION+' ORDER BY '+@COLUMNNAME +' ASC'    
 ELSE  
 SET @QUERY=' INSERT INTO #TEMPPROCESS(VALUE) SELECT '+@COLUMNNAME+' FROM '+@TABLENAME+' ORDER BY '+@COLUMNNAME +' ASC'       
 EXEC(@QUERY)    
     
 IF(@PERCENTILE>=100)    
 BEGIN    
  SET @RESULT=(SELECT TOP 1 VALUE FROM #TEMPPROCESS ORDER BY VALUE DESC)    
  RETURN    
 END    
     
 DECLARE @POSITION DECIMAL(20,5)    
 DECLARE @ROWCOUNT BIGINT    
   DECLARE @LEFTNUMBER DECIMAL(20,5)=0    
   DECLARE @RIGHTNUMBER DECIMAL(20,5)=0    
   DECLARE @N DECIMAL(20,5)    
       
 SELECT @ROWCOUNT=COUNT(*) FROM #TEMPPROCESS    
 SET @POSITION = ((@ROWCOUNT+1)*@PERCENTILE)/100
 SET @N=(@PERCENTILE/100.0)*(@ROWCOUNT-1)+1.0    
     
 IF(@POSITION>=1)    
  BEGIN    
   DECLARE @CALVALUE INT    
   SET @CALVALUE=FLOOR(@N)    
   SET @LEFTNUMBER= (SELECT VALUE FROM #TEMPPROCESS WHERE ID=@CALVALUE)    
   SET @RIGHTNUMBER=(SELECT VALUE FROM #TEMPPROCESS WHERE ID=@CALVALUE+1)    
  END    
 ELSE    
  BEGIN    
   SET @LEFTNUMBER=(SELECT VALUE FROM #TEMPPROCESS WHERE ID=1)    
   SET @RIGHTNUMBER=(SELECT VALUE FROM #TEMPPROCESS WHERE ID=2)    
  END    
 IF(@LEFTNUMBER=@RIGHTNUMBER)    
  SET @RESULT=@LEFTNUMBER    
 ELSE    
  BEGIN    
   DECLARE @PART DECIMAL(20,5)    
   SET @PART=@N-FLOOR(@N)    
   SET @RESULT=@LEFTNUMBER+@PART*(@RIGHTNUMBER-@LEFTNUMBER)    
  END    
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.CalculatePercentileForTimeLog

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[CalculatePercentileForTimeLog]  
@PERCENTILE DECIMAL(20,5)   
AS  
BEGIN  
CREATE TABLE #TEMPPERCENTILEROW  
(  
 PERCENTILE DECIMAL(20,5),  
 T1 DECIMAL(20,5),  
 T2 DECIMAL(20,5),  
 T3 DECIMAL(20,5),  
 T4 DECIMAL(20,5),  
 T5 DECIMAL(20,5),  
 T6 DECIMAL(20,5),  
 T7 DECIMAL(20,5),  
 T8 DECIMAL(20,5),
 T9 DECIMAL(20,5),
 T10 DECIMAL(20,5),  
 T11 DECIMAL(20,5), 
 emsapplicationid int  
)  
 DECLARE EMSAPPIDCURSOR CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT EMSAPPLICATIONID FROM TIMECONSOLIDATED  
 DECLARE @EMSAPPLICATIONID DECIMAL(20,5)  
 DECLARE @RESULT1 DECIMAL(20,5)  
 DECLARE @RESULT2 DECIMAL(20,5)  
 DECLARE @RESULT3 DECIMAL(20,5)  
 DECLARE @RESULT4 DECIMAL(20,5)  
 DECLARE @RESULT5 DECIMAL(20,5)  
 DECLARE @RESULT6 DECIMAL(20,5)  
 DECLARE @RESULT7 DECIMAL(20,5)  
 DECLARE @RESULT8 DECIMAL(20,5)  
 DECLARE @RESULT9 DECIMAL(20,5)
 DECLARE @RESULT10 DECIMAL(20,5)
 DECLARE @RESULT11 DECIMAL(20,5)
 DECLARE @CONDITION VARCHAR(1000)  
 OPEN EMSAPPIDCURSOR  
 FETCH NEXT FROM EMSAPPIDCURSOR INTO @EMSAPPLICATIONID  
 WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS=0)  
 BEGIN  
    SET @CONDITION='EMSAPPLICATIONID='+CAST(@EMSAPPLICATIONID AS VARCHAR(100))  
    EXEC CALCULATEPERCENTILE 'TIMECONSOLIDATED','T1',@CONDITION,@PERCENTILE,@RESULT1 OUT  
    EXEC CALCULATEPERCENTILE 'TIMECONSOLIDATED','T2',@CONDITION,@PERCENTILE,@RESULT2 OUT  
    EXEC CALCULATEPERCENTILE 'TIMECONSOLIDATED','T3',@CONDITION,@PERCENTILE,@RESULT3 OUT  
    EXEC CALCULATEPERCENTILE 'TIMECONSOLIDATED','T4',@CONDITION,@PERCENTILE,@RESULT4 OUT  
    EXEC CALCULATEPERCENTILE 'TIMECONSOLIDATED','T5',@CONDITION,@PERCENTILE,@RESULT5 OUT  
    EXEC CALCULATEPERCENTILE 'TIMECONSOLIDATED','T6',@CONDITION,@PERCENTILE,@RESULT6 OUT  
    EXEC CALCULATEPERCENTILE 'TIMECONSOLIDATED','T7',@CONDITION,@PERCENTILE,@RESULT7 OUT  
    EXEC CALCULATEPERCENTILE 'TIMECONSOLIDATED','T8',@CONDITION,@PERCENTILE,@RESULT8 OUT  
    EXEC CALCULATEPERCENTILE 'TIMECONSOLIDATED','T9',@CONDITION,@PERCENTILE,@RESULT9 OUT
    EXEC CALCULATEPERCENTILE 'TIMECONSOLIDATED','T10',@CONDITION,@PERCENTILE,@RESULT10 OUT
    EXEC CALCULATEPERCENTILE 'TIMECONSOLIDATED','T11',@CONDITION,@PERCENTILE,@RESULT11 OUT
    INSERT INTO #TEMPPERCENTILEROW  
    SELECT @PERCENTILE,@RESULT1,@RESULT2,@RESULT3,@RESULT4,@RESULT5,@RESULT6,@RESULT7,@RESULT8,@RESULT9,@RESULT10,@RESULT11,@EMSAPPLICATIONID  
    FETCH NEXT FROM EMSAPPIDCURSOR INTO @EMSAPPLICATIONID  
 END  
 CLOSE EMSAPPIDCURSOR  
 DEALLOCATE EMSAPPIDCURSOR  
 SELECT * FROM #TEMPPERCENTILEROW  
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.ChangeRequestState

```sql
-- =============================================    
-- Author:  <Author,,Name>    
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>    
-- Description: <Description,,>    
-- =============================================    
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ChangeRequestState]    
 @RequestID int,    
 @UserID varchar(255),  
 @status bit   ,
 @error varchar(255) output   
AS    
BEGIN     

set @error = ''  
  
 declare @TotalCount int     
 declare @ApprovedCount int   
  
 select @TotalCount = COUNT(*) from  RCFApprovalRequest where  ReqID=@RequestID      
  
 select @ApprovedCount = COUNT(*) from  RCFApprovalRequest where  ReqID=@RequestID and ApprovalStatus='A'      
  
 if(@TotalCount =@ApprovedCount)     
  
 begin       
  
  set @error = 'Can not update the request as request is already approved.'  
  
  return  
  
 end     

 insert into RCFRequest_archive select * from RCFRequest where ReqID=@RequestID     
 update RCFRequest set Status=@status,RequestedTime=GETDATE() where ReqID=@RequestID     
    
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.CheckBODData

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[CheckBODData]  
(  
 @ValidationNode varchar(30),  
 @CurrentDate DATE,  
 @PreviousDate DATE,  
 @Remarks VARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT,  
 @Status INT OUTPUT  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 SET NOCOUNT ON;  
 set @Remarks = ''  
 set @Status = 0  
 IF @ValidationNode = 'Estee Master'  
 BEGIN  
  /********************** Validate EsteeMaster ************************/  
  SELECT @Remarks += emb.Estee_ID + ' Missing in EsteeMaster please check.' + CHAR(13), @Status = 3 FROM esteemaster em (NOLOCK)  
  RIGHT JOIN EsteeMaster_backup emb (NOLOCK) ON em.Estee_ID = emb.Estee_ID  
  where  
  ((em.Security_Type NOT IN (SELECT TypeCode FROM SecurityType WHERE GroupID = 5) AND em.Expiry_Date >= @CurrentDate)  
   OR (em.Security_Type NOT IN (SELECT TypeCode FROM SecurityType WHERE GroupID = 5) AND emb.Expiry_Date >= @CurrentDate))   
   AND em.Estee_ID IS NULL  
  
  SELECT @Remarks += 'ISIN may be wrong for Estee id ' + Estee_id + CHAR(13), @Status = 3 FROM esteemaster WHERE LEN(ISIN)<>12  
  
  SELECT @Remarks += source + ' Job not ran.' + CHAR(13) , @Status = 3 FROM (  
  SELECT DISTINCT source FROM esteemaster (NOLOCK) WHERE AsOfDate < @PreviousDate AND Source <> 'Manual') x  
  
  SELECT @Remarks += CASE WHEN COUNT(*)<> 84 THEN 'Incomplete Estee Master. Please check.' ELSE '' END,   
  @Status = CASE WHEN COUNT(*)= 84 AND @Status <> 3 THEN 1 ELSE 3 END FROM (  
  SELECT SUBSTRING(estee_id,13,2) +'_'+ SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2) 'Security Type',COUNT(estee_id) Count  
  FROM esteemaster NOLOCK WHERE ASOFDATE >=@PreviousDate  
  GROUP BY SUBSTRING(estee_id,13,2),SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2))x  
  
 END  
  
 ELSE IF @ValidationNode = 'Closing Price'  
 BEGIN  
  /********************** Validate Closing Price ************************/  
  SELECT @Remarks += 'Closing Price missing for Estee ID '+ dp.Estee_ID + CHAR(13) FROM closingprice cp (NOLOCK)  
  RIGHT JOIN DailyPositions dp (NOLOCK) ON cp.Estee_ID = dp.Estee_ID  
  INNER JOIN esteemaster em (NOLOCK) ON cp.Estee_ID = em.Estee_ID  
  WHERE dp.PositionDate = @PreviousDate AND cp.Date = @PreviousDate AND cp.Estee_ID IS NULL AND em.Expiry_Date >= GETDATE()  
  
  SELECT @Remarks += 'Closing Price missing for Estee ID '+ sr.EsteeID + CHAR(13) FROM closingprice cp (NOLOCK)  
  RIGHT JOIN subscription_realtime sr (NOLOCK) ON cp.Estee_ID = sr.EsteeID  
  INNER JOIN esteemaster em (NOLOCK) ON sr.EsteeID = em.Estee_ID  
  WHERE cp.Date = @PreviousDate AND cp.Estee_ID IS NULL AND em.Expiry_Date >= GETDATE()  
  
  SELECT @Remarks += CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> 70 THEN 'Incomplete Closing Price. Please check.' ELSE '' END,   
  @Status = CASE WHEN COUNT(*)= 70 AND @Status <> 3 THEN 1 ELSE 3 END FROM (  
  SELECT SUBSTRING(estee_id,13,2) +'_'+ SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2) 'Security Type',COUNT(estee_id) Count  
  FROM closingprice NOLOCK WHERE Date =@PreviousDate  
  GROUP BY SUBSTRING(estee_id,13,2),SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2))x  
 END  
   
 ELSE IF @ValidationNode = 'Span Data'  
 BEGIN  
  /********************** Validate SpanData ************************/  
  SELECT @Remarks += 'Span Date missing for Estee ID '+ dp.Estee_ID + CHAR(13) FROM SpanData sd (NOLOCK)  
  RIGHT JOIN DailyPositions dp (nolock) on sd.EsteeID = dp.Estee_ID  
  INNER JOIN esteemaster em (nolock) on dp.Estee_ID = em.Estee_ID  
  WHERE dp.PositionDate = '2014-06-11' AND sd.date = '2014-06-12' AND sd.esteeID IS NULL AND em.Expiry_Date >= @CurrentDate  
  
  SELECT @Remarks += 'Span Date missing for Estee ID '+ sr.EsteeID + CHAR(13) FROM SpanData sd (NOLOCK)  
  RIGHT JOIN subscription_realtime sr (nolock) on sd.EsteeID = sr.EsteeID  
  INNER JOIN esteemaster em (nolock) on sr.EsteeID = em.Estee_ID  
  WHERE sd.date = '2014-06-12' AND sd.esteeID IS NULL AND em.Expiry_Date >= @CurrentDate  
  
  SELECT @Remarks += CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> 48 THEN 'Incomplete Span Data. Please check.' ELSE '' END,   
  @Status = CASE WHEN COUNT(*)= 48 AND @Status <> 3 THEN 1 ELSE 3 END FROM (  
  SELECT SUBSTRING(esteeID,13,2) +'_'+ SUBSTRING(esteeID,15,2) 'Security Type',COUNT(esteeID) Count  
  FROM SpanData NOLOCK WHERE Date =@PreviousDate  
  GROUP BY SUBSTRING(esteeID,13,2),SUBSTRING(esteeID,15,2))x  
 END  
   
 ELSE IF @ValidationNode = 'Price Band'  
 BEGIN  
  /********************** Price Band ************************/  
  SELECT @Remarks += CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> 26 THEN 'Incomplete Price Band. Please check.' ELSE '' END,   
  @Status = CASE WHEN COUNT(*)= 26 AND @Status <> 3 THEN 1 ELSE 3 END FROM (  
  SELECT SUBSTRING(Estee_Id,13,2) +'_'+ SUBSTRING(Estee_Id,15,2) 'Security Type',COUNT(Estee_Id) Count  
  FROM PriceBands NOLOCK WHERE AsOfDate =@CurrentDate  
  GROUP BY SUBSTRING(Estee_Id,13,2),SUBSTRING(Estee_Id,15,2))x  
 END  
   
 ELSE IF @ValidationNode = 'Index Data'  
 BEGIN  
  /********************** Index Data ************************/  
  SELECT @Remarks += CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> 2 THEN 'Incomplete Index Data. Please check.' ELSE '' END,   
  @Status = CASE WHEN COUNT(*)= 2 AND @Status <> 3 THEN 1 ELSE 3 END FROM (  
  SELECT SUBSTRING(Estee_Id,13,2) 'Security Type',COUNT(Estee_Id) Count  
  FROM IndexTable NOLOCK WHERE AsOfDate =@PreviousDate  
  GROUP BY SUBSTRING(Estee_Id,13,2))x  
  
  SELECT @Remarks += CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> 2 THEN 'Incomplete NSE Index Data. Please check.' ELSE '' END,   
  @Status = CASE WHEN COUNT(*)= 2 AND @Status <> 3 THEN 1 ELSE 3 END FROM (  
  SELECT Index_ISIN,COUNT(1) Count  
  FROM NSEIndexData NOLOCK WHERE AsOfDate =@PreviousDate  
  GROUP BY Index_ISIN)x  
 END  
  
 ELSE IF @ValidationNode = 'Position Limit'  
 BEGIN  
  /********************** Validate Position Limit ************************/  
  SELECT @Remarks += CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> 135 THEN 'Incomplete Position Limit. Please check.' ELSE '' END,   
  @Status = CASE WHEN COUNT(*)<> 135 THEN 3 ELSE 1 END FROM PositionLimit NOLOCK   
  WHERE DATE =@PreviousDate AND ISNULL(UndlEsteeID,'')<>''  
 END  
  
 ELSE IF @ValidationNode = 'Corporate Actions'  
 BEGIN  
  /********************** Validate Corporate Action ************************/  
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CorporateActionTable NOLOCK WHERE LastUpdateTime >=@PreviousDate)  
  BEGIN  
   SELECT @Remarks += 'Found ' + ActionType + ' in Estee ID ' + UnderlyingEsteeId + '. Datails are ' + Remarks FROM CorporateActionTable NOLOCK   
   INNER JOIN DailyPositions ON Estee_ID = Underlying_Ticker  
   WHERE PositionDate = @PreviousDate AND EffectiveDate = @PreviousDate AND (ActionType LIKE '%SPLIT%' OR ActionType LIKE '%BONUS%')  
   SET @Status = 1  
  END  
  ELSE  
  SET @Status = 3  
  SET @Remarks = 'Corporateaction job not ran.'  
 END  
  
 ELSE IF @ValidationNode = 'Daily Volatility'  
 BEGIN  
  /********************** Validate Daily Volatility ************************/  
  SELECT @Remarks += CASE WHEN COUNT(*) < 5 THEN 'Incomplete Daily Volatility. Please check.' ELSE '' END,   
  @Status = CASE WHEN COUNT(*) < 5 THEN 3 ELSE 1 END FROM (  
  SELECT SUBSTRING(esteeID,13,2) +'_'+ SUBSTRING(esteeID,15,2) 'Security Type',COUNT(esteeID) Count  
  FROM SpanData NOLOCK WHERE Date =@PreviousDate  
  GROUP BY SUBSTRING(esteeID,13,2),SUBSTRING(esteeID,15,2))x  
 END  
  
 ELSE IF @ValidationNode = 'Order Quantity Limit'  
 BEGIN  
  /********************** Validate Order Quantity Limit ************************/  
  SELECT @Remarks += CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> 2 THEN 'Incomplete Order Quantity Limit. Please check.' ELSE '' END,   
  @Status = CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> 2 THEN 3 ELSE 1 END FROM (  
  SELECT Exchange_Code,COUNT(1) Count  
  FROM OrderQuantityLimit NOLOCK WHERE AsOfDate =@CurrentDate  
  GROUP BY Exchange_Code)x  
 END  
  
 ELSE IF @ValidationNode = 'Cross Margin Data'  
 BEGIN  
  /********************** Validate Cross Margin Data ************************/  
  SELECT @Remarks += CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> 182 THEN 'Incomplete CrossMarginData. Please check.' ELSE '' END,   
  @Status = CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> 182 THEN 3 ELSE 1 END FROM CrossMarginData NOLOCK WHERE date = @CurrentDate  
 END  
  
 ELSE IF @ValidationNode = 'Daily Position'  
 BEGIN  
  /********************** Validate Daily Position ************************/  
  SELECT @Remarks += CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> 12 THEN 'Position not reconciled. Please check.' ELSE '' END,   
  @Status = CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> 12 THEN 3 ELSE 1 END FROM (  
  SELECT SourceDB,Exchange_Code,COUNT(1) Count FROM GlobalDailyPositions where PositionDate = @PreviousDate  
  GROUP BY SourceDB,Exchange_Code) x  
 END  
  
 ELSE IF @ValidationNode = 'BSE ETI Structure'  
 BEGIN  
  /********************** Validate BSEETIStructure ************************/  
  SELECT @Remarks = CASE WHEN COUNT(*)<> 0 THEN 'BSEETIStructure not updated.' ELSE '' END,   
  @Status = CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> 0 THEN 3 ELSE 1 END FROM BSEETIStructure es (NOLOCK)  
  RIGHT JOIN esteemaster em (NOLOCK)ON em.Token = es.Token   
  INNER JOIN ValidCombos ON SecurityType = em.Security_Type AND ExchangeCode = em.Exchange_Code  
  WHERE em.Source = 'BSE_SecurityMaster_Upload' and IsTraded = 1 AND em.Token <>0 AND es.Estee_ID IS NULL  
  IF   
  @Status = 0  
  SET @Status = 1  
 END  
  
 ELSE IF @ValidationNode = 'NSE ESTEE Structure'  
 BEGIN  
  /********************** Validate NSEESTEEStructure ************************/  
  SELECT @Remarks = CASE WHEN COUNT(*)<>0 THEN 'NSEESTEEStructure not updated.' ELSE '' END,   
  @Status = CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> 0 THEN 3 ELSE 1 END FROM NSEESTEEStructure es (NOLOCK)   
  RIGHT JOIN esteemaster em (NOLOCK)ON em.Token = es.Token   
  INNER JOIN SecurityType st ON st.TypeCode = em.Security_Type  
  INNER JOIN ValidCombos ON SecurityType = em.Security_Type and ExchangeCode = em.Exchange_Code  
  WHERE em.Source = 'NSE_SecurityMaster_Upload' and IsTraded = 1 and em.Token <>0 and es.Estee_ID IS NULL  
  IF   
  @Status = 0  
  SET @Status = 1  
 END  
  
 ELSE IF @ValidationNode = 'Contract IDs'  
 BEGIN  
  /********************** Validate Contract id ************************/  
  SELECT @Remarks = CASE WHEN es.EsteeId <> gm.EsteeId THEN 'ContractIds not in sync' ELSE '' END,   
  @Status = CASE WHEN es.EsteeId <> gm.EsteeId THEN 3 ELSE 1 END FROM ContractIds es (NOLOCK)   
  INNER JOIN ContractIds gm (NOLOCK) ON es.ContractId = gm.ContractId  
  WHERE gm.ContractId = -1  
  IF   
  @Status = 0  
  SET @Status = 1  
 END  
 ELSE 
 BEGIN 
  SET @Remarks = 'Validation not support '+@ValidationNode  
  SET @Status = 2  
 END
 SET NOCOUNT OFF;  
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.CheckClearingOnHoliday

```sql
-- =============================================  
-- Author:  <Author,,Name>  
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>  
-- Description: <Description,,>  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[CheckClearingOnHoliday]   
 @Date DateTime,  
 @isTradingDay bit output ,
 @isClearingDay bit output
AS  
BEGIN  
 
	if	exists( SELECT 1 FROM tblholidaytrading Where Date = @Date)
	Begin
		set @isTradingDay = 1
		if	exists( SELECT 1 FROM tblholidaytrading Where Date = @Date AND Cash_Settlement_Flag =0) 
			set @isClearingDay = 0
		else
			set @isClearingDay = 1
	End

	else 
		set @isTradingDay = 0

END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.CheckSpace

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[CheckSpace] 
  
 
AS
 
 
      BEGIN
    
      DECLARE @tablename sysname
      DECLARE tables_cursor CURSOR
      FOR
      SELECT name FROM sysobjects WHERE type = 'U' ORDER BY name
      OPEN tables_cursor
      FETCH NEXT FROM tables_cursor INTO @tablename
      WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS <> -1)
     
     
      BEGIN
      EXEC ('sp_spaceused ' + @tablename) 
      FETCH NEXT FROM tables_cursor INTO @tablename
      END
      CLOSE tables_cursor
      DEALLOCATE tables_cursor
 
     
      END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.CleanDuplicateRecords

```sql
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[CleanDuplicateRecords] 
	@tableName Varchar(150),
	@groupBy Varchar(Max)
AS
BEGIN
		 
DECLARE @DuplicateDeletesql Varchar(Max) 
DECLARE @BackUpSQL Varchar(Max)
DECLARE @BackUpTable Varchar(Max)
SET @BackUpTable ='backup_' +@tableName+ '_'+ Convert(varchar(8),GETDATE(),112) 

IF OBJECT_ID(@BackUpTable,'U') is null 
  BEGIN
    --- Take Back up before making any change
	SET @BackUpSQL =  'Select * into ['  +  @BackUpTable  + '] from ['  + @tableName +']'
	--Print  @BackUpSQL
	EXEC ( @BackUpSQL)	

  END

--- Remove duplicate values 
	SET @DuplicateDeletesql = 'Delete  from [' + @tableName + '] where [' + @tableName +'].%%physloc%% Not In (Select Min (b.%%physloc%%) from [' +@tableName+ '] b  Group By '+ @groupBy + ')' 

	--Print  @DuplicateDeletesql	
	EXEC (@DuplicateDeletesql)

END

```
