## Function: dbo.ColumnSplit

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.ColumnSplit(
 @TEXT      varchar(8000)
,@COLUMN    tinyint
,@SEPARATOR char(1)
)RETURNS varchar(8000)
AS
  BEGIN
       DECLARE @POS_START  int = 1
       DECLARE @POS_END    int = CHARINDEX(@SEPARATOR, @TEXT, @POS_START)

       WHILE (@COLUMN >1 AND @POS_END> 0)
         BEGIN
             SET @POS_START = @POS_END + 1
             SET @POS_END = CHARINDEX(@SEPARATOR, @TEXT, @POS_START)
             SET @COLUMN = @COLUMN - 1
         END 

       IF @COLUMN > 1  SET @POS_START = LEN(@TEXT) + 1
       IF @POS_END = 0 SET @POS_END = LEN(@TEXT) + 1 

       RETURN SUBSTRING (@TEXT, @POS_START, @POS_END - @POS_START)
  END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.ComputeOrderExecData

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ComputeOrderExecData]            
@runDate Datetime,          
@serverIP varchar(50),            
@statusMessage varchar(max) out            
as            
BEGIN            
 SET @statusMessage=''            
BEGIN TRY         
      SET XACT_ABORT ON            
      BEGIN TRAN          
     SET @runDate=(select CAST(convert(char(11),@runDate,113) as datetime))          
     -----------input validation---------------------------------------------------------------------            
     IF(@serverIP IS NULL OR @serverIP='')            
     BEGIN            
      SET @statusMessage+='@serverIP IS NOT CORRECT. PLEASE VALIDATE THE INPUT'            
      RETURN            
     END            
                 
     -----------determining frequency of the server---------------------------------------------------------------------            
     DECLARE @FREQUENCY decimal(20,5)           
     SET @FREQUENCY=(SELECT top 1 FREQUENCY FROM EsteeServers WHERE IP=@serverIP)            
     IF @FREQUENCY IS NULL            
     BEGIN            
      SET @statusMessage+='FREQUENCY IS NOT SET FOR SERVER WITH IP :' + @serverIP            
      RETURN            
     END            
              
     SET @statusMessage+='STARTING WITH SERVERIP='+@serverIP+'  AND FREQUENCY='+CAST(@FREQUENCY AS VARCHAR(100))        
                
     ----MOVING DATA TO A SINGULAR TABLE for easy calculation---------------------------------------------------------        
       SET @statusMessage+='INSERTING FRESH ROWS INTO TIMECONSOLIDATED'         
       
       DELETE FROM TIMECONSOLIDATED            
       
    INSERT INTO TIMECONSOLIDATED       
    SELECT A.ORDERID,A.ORDERTRADEID,A.COUNTER1,A.COUNTER2,A.COUNTER3,O.COUNTER1,O.COUNTER2,O.COUNTER3,O.COUNTER4,O.COUNTER5,  
    A.COUNTER4,A.Counter5,
    isnull(OA.Counter1,0), -- Tick 11
    isnull(OA.Counter3,0), -- Tick 12
    isnull(OA.Counter4,0), -- Tick 13   
    (A.Counter3-A.Counter2)*1000000/@FREQUENCY, -- T1
    (O.Counter1-A.Counter2)*1000000/@FREQUENCY, -- T2
    (O.Counter2-O.Counter1)*1000000/@FREQUENCY,  -- T3
    (O.Counter4-O.Counter2)*1000000/@FREQUENCY,  -- T4
    (O.Counter5-O.Counter4)*1000000/@FREQUENCY,-- T5
    (A.Counter4-O.Counter5)*1000000/@FREQUENCY, -- T6
    (O.Counter3-O.Counter2)*1000000/@FREQUENCY,  -- T7
    (A.Counter4-A.Counter2)*1000000/@FREQUENCY,  -- T8
    (A.Counter5-A.Counter1)*1000000/@FREQUENCY,  -- T9
    
      case when isnull(OA.Counter1,0) = 0  
				then 0  
		  else                
				(OA.Counter1-O.Counter2) *1000000 /@FREQUENCY   --t10
		  end,  
  
	  case when isnull(OA.Counter4,0) = 0 or isnull(OA.Counter3,0) =0   
				then 0  
		  else  
				(OA.Counter4-OA.Counter3)*1000000  /@FREQUENCY    --t11
		  end,  
        
    o.emsapplicationid           
    FROM AcceptedTimeLog_Staging A           
    INNER JOIN OrderExec_Staging O            
   ON A.ORDERID=O.ORDERID AND A.ORDERTRADEID=O.ORDERTRADEID and A.Counter4 > 0 and O.Counter4 > 0 
   LEFT JOIN OrderExecforOwnAdapter_Staging OA on O.OrderTradeID = OA.OrderTradeID
   
              
    --COMPUTE THIS FORMULA TO COMPUTE MAX,MIN,AVG          
    CREATE TABLE #TEMPPERCENTILEROW          
    (          
     PERCENTILE DECIMAL(20,5),          
     T1 DECIMAL(20,5),          
     T2 DECIMAL(20,5),          
     T3 DECIMAL(20,5),          
     T4 DECIMAL(20,5),          
     T5 DECIMAL(20,5),          
     T6 DECIMAL(20,5),          
     T7 DECIMAL(20,5),          
     T8 DECIMAL(20,5),          
     T9 DECIMAL(20,5),  
     T10 DECIMAL(20,5),  
     T11 DECIMAL(20,5),       
   emsapplicationid int          
    )          
        
    ------compute percentile values for every column from t1 to t8  -----------------------        
       SET @statusMessage+='COMPUTING 99 PERCENTILE'         
    INSERT INTO #TEMPPERCENTILEROW EXEC CalculatePercentileForTimeLog 99          
    SET @statusMessage+='COMPUTING 95 PERCENTILE'         
    INSERT INTO #TEMPPERCENTILEROW EXEC CalculatePercentileForTimeLog 95          
    SET @statusMessage+='COMPUTING 50 PERCENTILE'         
    INSERT INTO #TEMPPERCENTILEROW EXEC CalculatePercentileForTimeLog 50          
              
    ----merge all results we got to get the result that is insertable into orderexec-------------------------        
    SET @statusMessage+='DELETING EXISTING RESULTS FROM ORDEREXEC'         
    delete from OrderExec where ServerID=@serverIP and DATE=@runDate        
        
    SET @statusMessage+='INSERTING FRESH RECORDS INTO ORDEREXEC TABLE'         
    ;with finalComputedoutput as          
    (          
    select 'Min' as parameter,MIN(t1) as t1,MIN(t2) as t2,MIN(t3) as t3,MIN(T4) as t4,MIN(T5) as t5,MIN(T6) as t6,MIN(T7) as t7,MIN(T8) as t8,MIN(T9) as t9,MIN(T10) as t10,MIN(T11) as t11,EMSAPPLICATIONID from timeconsolidated GROUP BY EMSAPPLICATIONID   
  
       
    UNION ALL          
    select 'Max'  as parameter,MAX(t1) as t1,MAX(t2) as t2,MAX(t3) as t3,MAX(T4) as t4,MAX(T5) as t5,MAX(T6) as t6,MAX(T7) as t7,MAX(T8) as t8,MAX(T9) as t9,MAX(T10) as t10,MAX(T11) as t11,EMSAPPLICATIONID from timeconsolidated  GROUP BY EMSAPPLICATIONID 
  
         
    UNION ALL          
    select 'Mean'  as parameter,AVG(t1) as t1,AVG(t2) as t2,AVG(t3) as t3,AVG(T4) as t4,AVG(T5) as t5,AVG(T6) as t6,AVG(T7) as t7,AVG(T8) as t8,AVG(T9) as t9,AVG(T10) as t10,AVG(T11) as t11,EMSAPPLICATIONID from timeconsolidated  GROUP BY EMSAPPLICATIONID
  
          
    UNION ALL          
    SELECT 'Percentile_99'  as parameter,T1,T2,T3,T4,T5,T6,T7,T8,T9,T10,T11,emsapplicationid FROM #TEMPPERCENTILEROW WHERE PERCENTILE=99          
    UNION ALL          
    SELECT 'Percentile_95'  as parameter,T1,T2,T3,T4,T5,T6,T7,T8,T9,T10,T11,emsapplicationid FROM #TEMPPERCENTILEROW WHERE PERCENTILE=95          
    UNION ALL          
    SELECT 'Percentile_50'  as parameter,T1,T2,T3,T4,T5,T6,T7,T8,T9,T10,T11,emsapplicationid FROM #TEMPPERCENTILEROW WHERE PERCENTILE=50          
    ) ,        
    counttable as        
    (        
    select emsapplicationid as emsapplicationid,COUNT(*) as count from timeconsolidated group by emsapplicationid        
    )        
    insert into orderexec        
    select @rundate,parameter,@serverIP,t1,t2,t3,t4,t5,t6,t7,t8,CT.count,t9,FO.emsapplicationid,t10,t11 from finalComputedoutput  FO        
    inner join counttable CT       
    on FO.emsapplicationid=ct.emsapplicationid         
    COMMIT TRAN        
    SET XACT_ABORT OFF        
END TRY        
        
BEGIN CATCH        
     ROLLBACK TRAN        
     SET @statusMessage+='Exception occured: '+ERROR_MESSAGE()+' ' +CAST(ERROR_NUMBER() AS VARCHAR(100)) + ' '+CAST (ERROR_LINE() AS VARCHAR(100))            
     SET XACT_ABORT OFF            
END CATCH        
END

```

## Function: dbo.Conv_DateTime

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[Conv_DateTime](@id int, @it int)  
RETURNS DATETIME  
AS  
BEGIN  
DECLARE @vt char(6), @d char(8), @dt datetime  
SELECT @d = convert(varchar, @id)  
  
IF len(@it) = 5  
SET @vt = '0' + convert(char,@it)  
ELSE if len(@it) = 4  
SET @vt = '00' + convert(char,@it)  
ELSE if len(@it) = 3  
SET @vt = '000' + convert(char,@it)  
ELSE if len(@it) = 2  
SET @vt = '0000' + convert(char,@it)  
ELSE if len(@it) = 1  
SET @vt = '00000' + convert(char,@it)  
ELSE if len(@it) = 6  
SET @vt = convert(char,@it)  
SELECT @dt = left (@d,4) + '-' + substring(@d,5,2) + '-' + right(@d,2) + ' ' + left(@vt,2) + ':' + substring(@vt, 3,2) + ':' + right(@vt, 2)  
RETURN (@dt)  
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.create_Bhav_derivatives

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[create_Bhav_derivatives]   
 @Bhavcopy_derivatives_path varchar (max),  
 @dataSource varchar(50)  
AS  
  
BEGIN  
  
 Delete from [Bhavcopy_derivatives]    
    
 exec sp_modify_bhavcopy_derivatives_preinsert    
    
 EXEC('BULK INSERT Bhavcopy_derivatives FROM ''' + @Bhavcopy_derivatives_path + ''' WITH ( FIRSTROW = 2, FIELDTERMINATOR ='','', ROWTERMINATOR =''\n'')')    
    
 exec sp_modify_bhavcopy_derivatives_postinsert    
    
 DELETE FROM Bhavcopy_DERIVATIVES WHERE SYMBOL IS NULL     
 DELETE FROM Bhavcopy_DERIVATIVES WHERE INSTRUMENT != 'OPTIDX' AND INSTRUMENT != 'FUTIDX' AND INSTRUMENT != 'OPTSTK'  AND INSTRUMENT != 'FUTSTK' and INSTRUMENT !='FUTIVX'     
    
 DELETE FROM Bhavcopy_DERIVATIVES WHERE  [Bhavcopy_Derivatives].SYMBOL NOT IN    
 (     
  SELECT DISTINCT([Bhavcopy_ISIN].SYMBOL) FROM [Bhavcopy_ISIN]    
   UNION ALL    
  SELECT DISTINCT([ISINMaster].ExchangeTicker) FROM [ISINMaster] where ExchangeCode='IS' and [ISINMaster].DataSource = @dataSource  
 )    
   
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.create_bhav_equity

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[create_bhav_equity] @Bhavcopy_equity_path varchar (max)  
AS

BEGIN

BEGIN TRANSACTION  
Truncate table [Bhavcopy_Equity]  
EXEC('BULK INSERT Bhavcopy_Equity FROM ''' + @Bhavcopy_equity_path + ''' WITH ( FIRSTROW = 2, FIELDTERMINATOR ='','', ROWTERMINATOR ='',\n'')')  
DELETE  FROM Bhavcopy_Equity WHERE SERIES NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT SERIES  FROM Bhavcopy_Equity WHERE SERIES like 'EQ' OR SERIES like 'N%' OR  SERIES like 'D%' )

UPDATE Bhavcopy_Equity   
SET  Bhavcopy_Equity.ISIN  =   esteemaster.ISIN   
FROM esteemaster   
WHERE esteemaster.Exchange_Code='IS' and esteemaster.Underlying_Ticker = Bhavcopy_Equity.SYMBOL  and esteemaster.Series=Bhavcopy_Equity.Series
AND  (  
esteemaster.ISIN  <> Bhavcopy_Equity.ISIN  
OR Bhavcopy_Equity.ISIN IS NULL  
)  
AND  
esteemaster.security_type  in ( 0,4,22,23)  

If @@error <> 0 BEGIN  
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION  
RETURN 1  
END  
COMMIT TRANSACTION  

END

```

```sql
	ALTER TABLE [Bhavcopy_Equity] DROP COLUMN [ISIN]

UPDATE	Bhavcopy_Equity
```

```sql
   Series [Varchar](10) NULL,  
   Instrument_Type [int] NULL,  
   [Source] [varchar] (max) NULL,  
   TradingCurrency int NULL,  
   SettlementCurrency int NULL    
  ) ON [PRIMARY]      
      
 -- archive records where ISIN, ticker of token has changed for existing esteeID      
 INSERT INTO EsteeMaster_archive (Estee_ID, DataFeed_Ticker, Underlying_Ticker,ISIN,Exchange_Code,Security_Type,Option_Type,Strike_Price,Tick_Size,Lot_Size,Expiry_Date,Status,Last_update_time,Token,TOKEN2,Expiry_Date2,Quote_Size,AsOfDate,SERIES, Instrument_Type, 
 [Source], TradingCurrency, SettlementCurrency)  
 SELECT bckp.Estee_ID, bckp.DataFeed_Ticker, bckp.Underlying_Ticker,bckp.ISIN,bckp.Exchange_Code,bckp.Security_Type,bckp.Option_Type,bckp.Strike_Price,bckp.Tick_Size,bckp.Lot_Size,bckp.Expiry_Date,bckp.Status,bckp.Last_update_time,bckp.Token,bckp.TOKEN2,bckp.Expiry_Date2,  
 bckp.Quote_Size,bckp.AsOfDate,bckp.SERIES, bckp.Instrument_Type, bckp.[Source], bckp.TradingCurrency, bckp.SettlementCurrency    
 from EsteeMaster_backup as bckp      
 INNER JOIN EsteeMaster as e   
 on bckp.Estee_ID = e.Estee_ID   
 WHERE bckp.Exchange_Code = @exchange_Code and   
 bckp.[Source] = @source and  
   (bckp.DataFeed_Ticker!= e.DataFeed_Ticker or       
    bckp.Underlying_Ticker!= e.Underlying_Ticker or       
    bckp.ISIN!= e.ISIN or       
    bckp.Token!= e.Token or      
    bckp.TOKEN2!= e.TOKEN2 or  
    bckp.TradingCurrency != e.TradingCurrency or  
    bckp.SettlementCurrency != e.SettlementCurrency)      
         
      
 --archive expired and non traded contracts       
 INSERT INTO EsteeMaster_archive (Estee_ID, DataFeed_Ticker, Underlying_Ticker,ISIN,Exchange_Code,Security_Type,Option_Type,Strike_Price,Tick_Size,Lot_Size,Expiry_Date,Status,Last_update_time,Token,TOKEN2,Expiry_Date2,Quote_Size,AsOfDate,SERIES, Instrument_Type, [Source], TradingCurrency, SettlementCurrency)    
 SELECT bckp.Estee_ID, bckp.DataFeed_Ticker, bckp.Underlying_Ticker,bckp.ISIN,bckp.Exchange_Code,bckp.Security_Type,bckp.Option_Type,bckp.Strike_Price,bckp.Tick_Size,bckp.Lot_Size,bckp.Expiry_Date,bckp.Status,bckp.Last_update_time,bckp.Token,bckp.TOKEN2,bckp.Expiry_Date2, bckp.Quote_Size,bckp.AsOfDate,bckp.SERIES, bckp.Instrument_Type, bckp.[Source], bckp.TradingCurrency, bckp.SettlementCurrency    
 from EsteeMaster_backup as bckp      
 where bckp.Exchange_Code = @exchange_Code   
 and bckp.[Source] = @source  
 and  
 bckp.Estee_ID not in (      
  SELECT e.Estee_ID       
  from EsteeMaster as e       
  where e.Exchange_Code = @exchange_Code  
  and e.[Source] = @source  
    )      
          
 --we expect to have unique active records by esteeid in esteemasterarchive, mark all older records with status = 0      
 update e      
 set e.status = 0      
 from esteemaster_archive e      
 inner join (select estee_id, MAX(asofdate) asofdate from EsteeMaster_archive group by Estee_ID) x on x.Estee_ID = e.Estee_ID and x.asofdate <> e.AsOfDate      
END 
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.create_IndexComponents

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[create_IndexComponents] 
	@IndexComponents_path varchar (max)
AS
BEGIN

IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SYSOBJECTS WHERE NAME = 'IndexDataTable')
	DROP TABLE IndexDataTable
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[IndexDataTable](
	[Index_Flg] [varchar](50) NULL,
	[Symbol] [varchar](50) NULL,
	[Series] [char](5) NULL,
	[Security] [varchar](50) NULL,
	[Issue_Cap] [decimal](18, 0) NULL,
	[Close_Price] [decimal](18, 2) NULL,
	[Mkt_Cap] [decimal](18, 0) NULL,
	[weightage] [decimal](18, 2) NULL
) 

EXEC('BULK INSERT IndexDataTable FROM ''' + @IndexComponents_path + ''' WITH ( FIRSTROW = 2, FIELDTERMINATOR ='','', ROWTERMINATOR =''\n'')')

DELETE FROM [IndexDataTable] WHERE Index_Flg = ''


END

--select * from [IndexDataTable]

```

```sql
											select e.ISIN,
											(SUM(Traded_Quantity)*( SUM(Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price) / SUM(Traded_Quantity) )*3.3 * 0.0001),
											SUM(Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price) / SUM(Traded_Quantity) Traded_Price,
											CASE vw.Buy_Sell_Indicator
												WHEN 1 THEN 'B'
												WHEN 2 THEN 'S'
												ELSE NULL
											END AS Side,
											SUM(Traded_Quantity) Traded_Quantity ,
											@runDate + RIGHT('00000' + CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS VARCHAR(5)), 5) AS ExternalId ,	  
											'N' ,
											'Trade' ,
											'BBARS_Estee' ,
											'GSI' ,
											'GSCO' ,
											'Estee_Default',
											@runDate ,
											CONVERT( nchar(8), @tplus2date, 112 ),
											'BRL' ,
											'1',
											'69286540' ,
											'TRS',
											'Equity',
											'BRL',
											u.SEDOL
											from vwalltrades vw inner join esteeMaster e on vw.Estee_Id = e.Estee_Id 
                                            inner join #temp t on t.ssid = vw.sub_strategy_id
											left join unique_isin_sedol_map u on e.ISIN = u.ISIN
                                            where vw.creation_date = @rundate and vw.status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and vw.Traded_Quantity >= 0
                                            and vw.order_source_id not like '%Balancing%'
                                            and vw.order_source_id <> 'ECM'
											and vw.Account_ID = @AccountId
                                            group by e.ISIN, vw.Buy_Sell_Indicator, u.SEDOL
												                                        
									drop table #temp
								

						select * from #New_Table

						drop table #New_Table
					
				

END;
```

```sql
	[Soft Dollars] NVARCHAR(255) default '',

EXEC GetTPlusXWorkingDate @runDate,@ExchangeSegment, @workingDaysToAdd, @tPlus2Date OUTPUT;
EXEC GetTPlusXWorkingDate @runDate,@ExchangeSegment, @workingDaysToAdd1, @tPlus1Date OUTPUT;




Insert into #New_Table([ISIN],[Commissions],[Trade Price],[Side],[Trade Quantity],[External ID],[Operation Code],[Transaction Type],[Book],[Prime Broker],[Execution Broker],[Bundle],[Trade Date],[Settlement Date],[Settle Currency],[FX Rate],[Custodian Account],[Financing Type],[Security Type],[Security Currency],[Sedol],[Bloomberg Ticker] )		
											select
											case
												when substring(e.Estee_ID,15,2) in (01,05,11) then ''
												else e.ISIN
											end as ISIN,
											--(SUM(Traded_Quantity)*( SUM(Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price) / SUM(Traded_Quantity) )*3.3 * 0.0001),
											case 
												when substring(e.Estee_ID,15,2) in (01,05,11) then ROUND((SUM(Traded_Quantity)*( SUM(Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price) / SUM(Traded_Quantity) )*0.48 * 0.0001),2)
												else ROUND((SUM(Traded_Quantity)*( SUM(Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price) / SUM(Traded_Quantity) )*2.225 * 0.0001),2)
											end as comission,
											case
												when substring(e.Estee_ID,15,2) in (01,05,11) then SUM(Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price)*Power(10,em.EsteeFactor)/ SUM(Traded_Quantity)
												else SUM(Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price)/ SUM(Traded_Quantity)
											end as Traded_Price,
											CASE vw.Buy_Sell_Indicator
												WHEN 1 THEN 'B'
												WHEN 2 THEN 'S'
												ELSE NULL
											END AS Side,
											case
												when substring(e.Estee_ID,15,2) in (01,05,11) then Sum(Traded_Quantity)/Lot_Size
												else Sum(Traded_Quantity)
											end as Traded_Quantity,
											@runDate + RIGHT('00000' + CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + 10000 AS VARCHAR(5)), 5) AS ExternalId ,	  
											'N' ,
											'Trade' ,
											'Estee' ,
											'GSCO' ,
											'GSCO' ,
											'BRAZIL-INDEX-ARB-EST',
											@runDate ,
											case 
												when substring(e.Estee_ID,15,2) in (01,05,11) then CONVERT( nchar(8), @tplus1date, 112 )
												else CONVERT( nchar(8), @tplus2date, 112 )
											end,
											'BRL' ,
											'1',
											'69414258' ,
											'TRS',
											case
												when substring(e.Estee_ID,15,2) in (01,05,11) then 'Future'
												else 'Equity'
											end as Security_Type,
											'BRL',
											ISNULL(ism.SEDOL,''),
											isNull(tbb.BBTicker,'')
											from vwalltrades vw inner join esteeMaster e on vw.Estee_Id = e.Estee_Id 
											left join unique_isin_sedol_map ism on e.ISIN = ism.ISIN
											left join TickertoBBTicker tbb on tbb.ticker = e.DataFeed_Ticker
											left join EsteeMultiplierFactor (nolock) em on e.ISIN = em.ISIN and e.Exchange_Code = em.ExchangeCode
                                            where vw.creation_date = @rundate and vw.status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and vw.traded_quantity > 0
                                            and vw.order_source_id not like '%Balancing%'
                                            and vw.order_source_id <> 'ECM'
											and vw.Account_ID = @AccountId
                                            group by e.ISIN,vw.Buy_Sell_Indicator, ism.SEDOL, tbb.BBTicker,e.Estee_ID, e.Lot_Size,em.EsteeFactor

						select * from #New_Table


						drop table #New_Table
					
				

END;

											
```

```sql
											END AS Side,
```

```sql
											'69297802' ,
											'TRS',
											'Equity',
											'BRL',
											ism.SEDOL
											from vwalltrades vw inner join esteeMaster e on vw.Estee_Id = e.Estee_Id 
                                            inner join #temp t on t.ssid = vw.sub_strategy_id
											inner join ISINSedolMapping ism on e.ISIN = ism.ISIN
                                            where vw.creation_date = @rundate and vw.status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and vw.traded_quantity > 0
                                            and vw.order_source_id not like '%Balancing%'
                                            and vw.order_source_id <> 'ECM'
											and vw.Account_ID = @AccountId
                                            group by e.ISIN,vw.Buy_Sell_Indicator, ism.SEDOL
												                                        
									drop table #temp
								

						select * from #New_Table


						drop table #New_Table
					
				

END;
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.CreatePositionRule

```sql
CREATE proc CreatePositionRule    
 @Name varchar(500),    
 @Exchanges varchar(50),    
 @securityType varchar(500),    
 @longshort int,  
 @ruleID int = null, 
@LimitType varchar(10)    ,
 @returnValue int out  
 AS    
 BEGIN    
 if(@ruleID = '' or @ruleID is null)   
 BEGIN  
 insert into PositionMeasureRule values(@Name,@Exchanges,@securityType,@longshort,@LimitType)    
 set @returnValue = @@IDENTITY  
 END  
else  
BEGIN  
 update PositionMeasureRule set RuleName = @Name , ExchangeCode = @Exchanges , SecurityType = @securityType , LongShort  = @longshort,LimitType=@LimitType where RuleID = @ruleID  
 set @returnValue = @ruleID  
 END  
 END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.CreatePrimaryKey

```sql
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[CreatePrimaryKey]  
 @tableName Varchar(128),  
 @PrimaryKeyColumn Varchar(Max)   
AS  
BEGIN  
   

DECLARE @PrimaryKeyCreationSQL Varchar(Max)  


If  not exists( select c.name, p.name,p.type_desc,p.TYPE FROM sys.objects p  inner join sys.objects c on c.object_id = p.parent_object_id and p.TYPE ='PK'
WHERE  c.name = @tableName and c.TYPE= 'U')
	BEGIN  

	 SET @PrimaryKeyCreationSQL = ' ALTER TABLE [' + @tableName +']'
 							  + ' ADD CONSTRAINT PK_' +@tableName +
 							  +' Primary Key(' +@PrimaryKeyColumn+')'

	Print ''
	 Exec (  @PrimaryKeyCreationSQL )
	 Print ' Primary key created for table' + @tableName  + ' on ' + @PrimaryKeyColumn
	 END  
Else 
	BEGIN
		Print ' Primary Key Already exists on  ' +@tableName
	END
	 
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.cuiAuthenticateUser

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cuiAuthenticateUser]  
 @userName varchar(50),
 @password varchar(50)
 AS  
BEGIN  
 SET NOCOUNT ON;  
   IF NOT EXISTS(Select 1 From LoginDetails Where  username = @username )  
	BEGIN   
		Return( 1) -- Invalid Username 
	END  
   ELSE    
	BEGIN   
		IF NOT EXISTS(Select 1 From LoginDetails Where  username = @username and [password] = @password)  
		BEGIN   
			Return( 2) -- Invalid Username and Password  
		END  
		ELSE    
		BEGIN   
			IF NOT EXISTS(Select 1 From LoginDetails Where username = @username and [password] = @password and Blocked = 0)  
			BEGIN   
				Return(3) -- Blocked
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF NOT EXISTS(select 1 from UserPasswordHistory p inner join LoginDetails l on p.UserID = l.UserID where l.Username = @username)
				BEGIN
					Return(6) --First Login
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					DECLARE @passwordexpiry int = 30
					SELECT  @passwordexpiry = Value from DataInit where ApplicationID = (select top 1 ApplicationID from EsteeApplications where ApplicationName = 'Client.Interface') and Parameter = 'Password_Expiry'
					IF EXISTS(Select 1 From LoginDetails Where  username = @username and [password] = @password and blocked = 0 and DateAdd(dd,@passwordexpiry,PasswordChangedTime) < getdate())
					BEGIN
						Return(4) --Password Expired
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						Return(0) --User Valid
					END
				END
			END  
		END 
    END
END  
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cuiChangeUserPassword]  
  @userID int,  
  @newPassword varchar(200) = '',  
  @updatedBy int,

AS  
BEGIN   
 SET NOCOUNT ON;  
	UPDATE LoginDetails   
	SET [Password] = @newPassword   
	,PasswordchangedTime = GETDATE()   
	,UpdatedDate = GETDATE()   
	,UpdatedBy = @updatedBy  
	,Blocked = @blocked
	WHERE UserID = @userID

	values(

	,GETDATE())    
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.cuiCreateNewUser

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE cuiCreateNewUser       
  @username varchar(50) = null,              
  @password varchar(50) = null,              
  @firstname varchar(50) = null,              
  @lastname varchar(50) = null,              
  @roles varchar(1000)= null,        
  @email varchar(100) = null,              
  @updateby varchar(25)= null,      
  @IsCachedata bit = null,  
  @isOTPRequired bit=null,
  @consentStrategy varchar(max)='',
  @userID int output      
        
AS      
BEGIN      
 SET NOCOUNT ON;      
 set @userID = 0      
 If Exists(select * from LoginDetails where Username = @username)      
 Begin      
  return 0;      
 End      
       
 Insert into LoginDetails      
 (FirstName, LastName, Username, Password, Last_Login_Time, Email, PasswordchangedTime,Blocked,UpdatedBy,UpdatedDate,IsOTPRequired,userConsentStrategy)               
    Values      
    (@firstname, @lastname, @username, @password, GETDATE(), @email, getdate(),0,@updateby,getdate(),@isOTPRequired,@consentStrategy);       
          
    declare @roleMap table      
    (      
  roleName varchar(50)        
    )       
          
    set @userID = (select userID from LoginDetails where Username = @username)      
          
    insert into @roleMap SELECT * from Split(@roles,',')      
          
    insert into UserRoles      
    select @userID, r.Role_ID from Roles r inner join @roleMap rm on rm.roleName = r.Role_Name          
      
    if(@IsCachedata is not null AND @IsCachedata = 1)  
    BEGIN  
    insert into UserDataCacheSettings  
    select @userID, 1  
    END  
    ELSE  
    BEGIN  
    insert into UserDataCacheSettings  
    select @userID, 0  
    END  
END 

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.cuiGetAllUsersAndPremittedStrategies

```sql
  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cuiGetAllUsersAndPremittedStrategies]  
AS  
BEGIN  
 SET NOCOUNT ON;  
  
 select UserID,(FirstName + ' ' + LastName) UserName from LoginDetails where Blocked = 0 order by FirstName;   
  
 select distinct Strategy_ID, sg.StrategyName as Strategy_Name, (Strategy_Id + ' - ' + sg.StrategyName) as StrategyDisplayName   
 from Strategy_New sn inner join StrategyGroup sg on sn.Strategy_Id = sg.StrategyID  
 order by Strategy_Id;   
  
 select distinct us.UserID, us.strategy_id, sg.StrategyName as Strategy_Name   
 from UserStrategies us inner join Strategy_New sn on sn.Strategy_Id = us.strategy_id
 inner join StrategyGroup sg on sn.Strategy_Id = sg.StrategyID 
where us.Dimension_id=6  
 Order by UserID, strategy_id  
  
END  
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.cuiGetEsteeID

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cuiGetEsteeID]        
 @exchangeCode CHAR(10),        
 @securityTypeCode int,        
 @Symbol VARCHAR(50),        
 @expiry1 DATETIME = NULL,        
 @expiry2 DATETIME = NULL,        
 @strikePrice DECIMAL(18,2) = NULL        
AS        
BEGIN        
 SET NOCOUNT ON;        
         
 IF (@expiry1 IS NULL) --SPOT        
 BEGIN        
  SELECT estee_id         
  FROM esteemaster          
  WHERE Status = 1         
  AND Exchange_Code = @exchangeCode        
  AND Security_Type = @securityTypeCode        
  AND Underlying_Ticker = @Symbol        
 END        
         
 IF (@expiry1 IS NOT NULL AND @expiry2 IS NULL AND @strikePrice IS NULL) --FUTURE        
 BEGIN        
  SELECT estee_id         
  FROM esteemaster         
  WHERE Status = 1         
  AND Exchange_Code = @exchangeCode        
  AND Security_Type = @securityTypeCode        
  AND Underlying_Ticker = @Symbol        
  AND convert (date,Expiry_Date,110) = convert (date, @expiry1,110)              
 END        
         
 IF(@expiry1 IS NOT NULL AND @expiry2 IS NULL AND @strikePrice IS NOT NULL) -- OPTIONS        
 BEGIN        
  SELECT estee_id         
  FROM esteemaster        
  WHERE Status = 1         
  AND Exchange_Code = @exchangeCode        
  AND Security_Type = @securityTypeCode        
  AND Underlying_Ticker = @Symbol        
  AND convert (date,Expiry_Date,110) = convert (date, @expiry1,110)         
  AND strike_price = @strikePrice        
 END        
         
 IF(@expiry1 IS NOT NULL AND @expiry2 IS NOT NULL AND @strikePrice IS NULL) -- SPREAD        
 BEGIN        
  SELECT estee_id         
  FROM esteemaster       
  WHERE Status = 1         
  AND Exchange_Code = @exchangeCode        
  AND Security_Type = @securityTypeCode      
  AND Underlying_Ticker = @Symbol        
  AND convert (date,Expiry_Date,110) = convert (date, @expiry1,110)        
  AND Expiry_Date2 = @expiry2    
 END        
        
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.cuiGetMarketData

```sql
-- =============================================  
-- Author:  Megha Rani  
-- Create date: 2012-11-19  
-- Description: Returns Market data  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cuiGetMarketData]  
AS  
BEGIN  
 SELECT DISTINCT B.Broker_ID, B.Broker_Name,A.exchange_Code   
 FROM Broker B   
 INNER JOIN tblBrokerAccount BA ON B.Broker_ID=BA.broker_id   
 INNER JOIN Account A ON A.Account_ID = BA.account_id   
 WHERE B.Status='Active'   
 ORDER BY Broker_Name   
   
 SELECT A.Account_ID AS account_id,A.Account_Name AS account_name, A.exchange_code, A.ExchangeAccountName   
 FROM Account AS A   
 INNER JOIN  tblBrokerAccount AS BA ON A.Account_ID = BA.account_id  
   
 SELECT * FROM Exchange  
   
 SELECT * FROM tblBrokerAccount WHERE is_Active = 1  
   
 SELECT * FROM ExchangeSegment  
   
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.cuiGetPnLReport

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[cuiGetPnLReport]    
     
@startdate datetime,  
@enddate datetime     
    
AS      
BEGIN      
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED      
  
DECLARE @maxdate TABLE (strategy_id VARCHAR(50), date DATETIME)      
  
INSERT INTO @maxdate (strategy_id, date)      
SELECT strategy_id, MAX(date)   
FROM AllocatorData WHERE DATE BETWEEN @startdate AND @enddate GROUP BY Strategy_Id        
  
SELECT ex.name AS Exchange  
, a.strategy_id  
, n.substrategy_name  
, a.mandate  
, a.moneydeployed
, a.SquareOffPnL as MTDSqOffPnL
, a.ExpiryPnL as MTDExpiryPnL
, a.DailySqOffPnL as DailySqOffPnL 
, a.dailyexpirypnl as DailyExpiryPnL
, CAST(CAST(a.Turnover AS DECIMAL)/10000000 AS DECIMAL(10,4)) AS TurnOver --in crores  
, CONVERT(decimal(15,2),CashDelta)/100000 CashDelta  
, CONVERT(decimal(15,2),CashGamma)/100000 CashGamma   
FROM allocatordata a  WITH (NOLOCK)     
INNER JOIN @maxdate m ON m.strategy_id = a.Strategy_Id and m.[date] = a.[Date]  
INNER JOIN strategy_new n WITH (NOLOCK) ON n.substrategy_id = a.strategy_id        
INNER JOIN Exchange ex ON ex.code = a.Exchange_Code  
where a.strategy_id NOT IN (SELECT Account_ID FROM Account)   
AND a.dailyexpirypnl NOT IN ('0')   
AND a.[Date] BETWEEN @startdate AND @enddate  
ORDER BY a.Strategy_Id    
  
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.cuiGetSecurityTicker

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cuiGetSecurityTicker]    
 @esteeID VARCHAR(50)   
AS    
BEGIN    
 SET NOCOUNT ON;    
     
   IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 * FROM CommodityMaster WHERE Estee_ID = @esteeID)  
 BEGIN  
  SELECT  DISTINCT  EsteeID, DataFeed_Ticker, Underlying_Ticker, Ex.name as Exchange, Token, '-' AS LTP, '-' AS LTQ    
  ,CONVERT(TIME,GETDATE(),1) AS LTT,  '-' AS BidP, '-' AS BidQ, '-' AS ASkP, '-' AS ASkQ    
  , '-' AS BidP2, '-' AS BidQ2, '-' AS ASkP2, '-' AS ASkQ2, '-' AS BidP3, '-' AS BidQ3    
  , '-' AS ASkP3, '-' AS ASkQ3, '-' AS BidP4, '-' AS BidQ4, '-' AS ASkP5, '-' AS ASkQ5    
  , '-' AS BidP5, '-' AS BidQ5, '-' AS ASkP4, '-' AS ASkQ4, '-' AS VWAP, '-' AS OI, '-' AS ATP    
  , '-' AS TTQ, '-' AS TTV, '-' AS TBQ, '-' AS TSQ  
  , Cast(M.Quote_Size as varchar(10)) as PriceQuotationUnit  
  , '-' AS QtyUnit  
  , GETDATE() AS STT,cur.CurrencyCode as CurrencyCode     
  FROM Subscription_RealTime S     
  INNER JOIN EsteeMASter M On S.EsteeID = M.Estee_ID  
  INNER JOIN Exchange EX on M.Exchange_Code = EX.code
  INNER JOIN Currency cur on cur.ID = EX.CurrencyID       
  WHERE M.Status=1     
  and esteeid = @esteeID     
  ORDER BY Token, Underlying_Ticker;    
 END  
 ELSE  
 BEGIN  
  SELECT  DISTINCT  EsteeID, DataFeed_Ticker, Underlying_Ticker, Ex.name as Exchange,Token, '-' AS LTP, '-' AS LTQ    
  ,CONVERT(TIME,GETDATE(),1) AS LTT,  '-' AS BidP, '-' AS BidQ, '-' AS ASkP, '-' AS ASkQ    
  , '-' AS BidP2, '-' AS BidQ2, '-' AS ASkP2, '-' AS ASkQ2, '-' AS BidP3, '-' AS BidQ3    
  , '-' AS ASkP3, '-' AS ASkQ3, '-' AS BidP4, '-' AS BidQ4, '-' AS ASkP5, '-' AS ASkQ5    
  , '-' AS BidP5, '-' AS BidQ5, '-' AS ASkP4, '-' AS ASkQ4, '-' AS VWAP, '-' AS OI, '-' AS ATP    
  , '-' AS TTQ, '-' AS TTV, '-' AS TBQ, '-' AS TSQ  
  , CAST(C.QuotationUnit as varchar(10)) + ' ' + C.QuotationMetric AS PriceQuotationUnit  
  , C.DeliveryUnit AS QtyUnit  
  , GETDATE() AS STT,cur.CurrencyCode as CurrencyCode    
  FROM Subscription_RealTime S     
  INNER JOIN EsteeMASter M On S.EsteeID = M.Estee_ID   
  INNER JOIN Exchange EX on M.Exchange_Code = EX.code
  INNER JOIN Currency cur on cur.ID = EX.CurrencyID   
  INNER JOIN CommodityMaster C ON C.Estee_ID = M.Estee_ID  
  WHERE M.Status=1      
  and esteeid = @esteeID     
  ORDER BY Token, Underlying_Ticker;    
 END  
   
    
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.cuiGetStrategiesForUser

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cuiGetStrategiesForUser]     
 @userId INT,  
 @activeOnly BIT  
AS  
BEGIN  
 -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from  
 -- interfering with SELECT statements.  
 SET NOCOUNT ON;  
  
   
 SELECT DISTINCT S.Strategy_ID, sg.StrategyName as Strategy_Name  
 FROM UserStrategies US INNER JOIN Strategy_New S ON US.strategy_id = S.Strategy_Id  
 inner join StrategyGroup sg on S.Strategy_Id = sg.StrategyID  
 WHERE UserID = @userId and S.Strategy_Status IN (1,@activeOnly)   and US.dimension_id=6  
      
 SELECT S.Strategy_Id, sg.StrategyName as Strategy_Name, S.SubStrategy_Id, S.SubStrategy_Name, S.InvestmentFundID  
 FROM UserStrategies US INNER JOIN Strategy_New S on US.strategy_id = S.Strategy_Id  
 inner join StrategyGroup sg on S.Strategy_Id = sg.StrategyID  
 WHERE UserID= @userId and S.Strategy_Status IN (1,@activeOnly)   and US.dimension_id=6 
   
END  
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cuiGetTicker]

AS
BEGIN
	SELECT  DISTINCT  M.Estee_ID AS EsteeID,  M.DataFeed_Ticker,M.Underlying_Ticker, Ex.name as Exchange, cur.CurrencyCode as Currency   
  ,C.DeliveryUnit as QtyUnit      
  , CAST(C.QuotationUnit as varchar(10)) + ' ' + C.QuotationMetric as PriceQuotationUnit
  ,Token       
  FROM EsteeMaster M  
  INNER JOIN Exchange EX on M.Exchange_Code = EX.code
  INNER JOIN Currency cur on cur.ID = EX.CurrencyID
  INNER JOIN CommodityMaster C ON C.Estee_ID = M.Estee_ID   
  WHERE M.Status=1    
  AND M.Estee_ID = @esteeId
  UNION  
  SELECT  DISTINCT  M.Estee_ID AS EsteeID, M.DataFeed_Ticker,M.Underlying_Ticker,  Ex.name as Exchange, cur.CurrencyCode as Currency  
  , '-' as QtyUnit      
  , Cast(M.Quote_Size as varchar(10)) as PriceQuotationUnit
  ,  Token           
  FROM EsteeMaster M
  INNER JOIN Exchange EX on M.Exchange_Code = EX.code
  INNER JOIN Currency cur on cur.ID = EX.CurrencyID
  WHERE M.Status=1    
  AND M.Estee_ID = @esteeId      
  and @esteeId not in (select distinct Estee_ID from CommodityMaster)    
  ORDER BY Token, DataFeed_Ticker;
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.cuiGetUserProfile

```sql
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[cuiGetUserProfile]      
@userName VARCHAR(50)      
AS      
      
BEGIN      
 SET NOCOUNT ON;      
 DECLARE @UserID INT = 0      
 SELECT @UserID = UserID FROM LoginDetails WHERE Username = @UserName      
 SELECT * FROM cuiVWformPermission with(nolock) WHERE UserID = @UserID and AccessTypeName = 'Editable'      
 UNION      
 SELECT * FROM cuiVWformPermission with(nolock) WHERE UserID = @UserID and AccessTypeName = 'ReadOnly'                        
 AND PermissionName NOT IN (SELECT PermissionName FROM cuiVWformPermission WHERE UserID = @UserID and AccessTypeName = 'Editable')                        
      
 exec GetUserStrategy @UserID        
                        
 SELECT r.Role_ID, r.Role_Name FROM Roles r                                          
 INNER JOIN UserRoles ur with(nolock) on ur.Role_ID = r.Role_ID                                          
 INNER JOIN LoginDetails ld with(nolock) on ld.UserID = ur.User_ID                                          
 WHERE ld.UserID = @UserID                                          
                        
 SELECT L.*,U.CacheData FROM LoginDetails L with(nolock) left join UserDataCacheSettings U with(nolock) on L.UserID = U.UserID                         
 WHERE L.UserID = @UserID                                                   
                        
 SELECT  DISTINCT  S.Value AS EsteeID,  M.DataFeed_Ticker,M.Underlying_Ticker, Ex.name as Exchange, cur.CurrencyCode as Currency                                                 
  ,coalesce(C.DeliveryUnit,'-') as QtyUnit                               
  , coalesce(CAST(C.QuotationUnit as varchar(10)) + ' ' + C.QuotationMetric,Cast(M.Quote_Size as varchar(10))) as PriceQuotationUnit                                            
  ,Token                                                     
  FROM UserPreferences S                                                   
  INNER JOIN EsteeMaster M with(nolock) ON S.Value = M.Estee_ID                                               
  INNER JOIN Exchange EX with(nolock) on M.Exchange_Code = EX.code                                            
  INNER JOIN Currency cur with(nolock) on cur.ID = EX.CurrencyID                                            
  LEFT JOIN CommodityMaster C with(nolock) ON C.Estee_ID = M.Estee_ID                                                 
  WHERE M.Status=1                                                  
  and S.UserID = @UserID                                             
  ORDER BY Token, DataFeed_Ticker;                                    
                        
 select distinct RPP.RiskParamId,RP.RiskParamName, RPP.AccessTypeID, cast(max(cast(RPP.AllStrategies as tinyint)) as bit) as AllStrategies                                    
  from RiskParameterPermissions RPP                                    
  join UserRoles UR on RPP.Role_id = UR.Role_ID                                    
  join RiskParameters RP on Rpp.RiskParamId = Rp.RiskParamId                                    
  where UR.User_ID =@UserID                                    
  group by Rpp.RiskParamId, Rp.RiskParamName, RPP.AccessTypeID                                    
        
  select * from StrategyForm   order by ColOrder                  
      
   select Strategy_ID as dimension_value from UserStrategies where dimension_id=2 and UserID=@UserID  

   select * from DisableHierarchy where userID = @UserID

END   


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.cuiGetUserSubscribedSecurities

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cuiGetUserSubscribedSecurities]    
 @userID int = 0    
AS    
BEGIN    
 SET NOCOUNT ON;    
  
  SELECT  DISTINCT  S.Value AS EsteeID, DataFeed_Ticker As [Security], Ex.name as Exchange, cur.CurrencyCode as Currency
  , '-' AS LTP, '-' AS LTQ,  '-' AS BidP, '-' AS BidQ   
  , '-' AS ASkP, '-' AS ASkQ  
  ,C.DeliveryUnit as QtyUnit      
  , CAST(C.QuotationUnit as varchar(10)) + ' ' + C.QuotationMetric as PriceQuotationUnit
  , CONVERT(TIME,GETDATE(),1) AS LTT,  Token       
  FROM UserPreferences S     
  INNER JOIN EsteeMaster M ON S.Value = M.Estee_ID   
  INNER JOIN Exchange EX on M.Exchange_Code = EX.code
  INNER JOIN Currency cur on cur.ID = EX.CurrencyID
  INNER JOIN CommodityMaster C ON C.Estee_ID = M.Estee_ID   
  WHERE M.Status=1    
  and S.UserID = @userID       
  UNION  
  SELECT  DISTINCT  S.Value AS EsteeID, DataFeed_Ticker As [Security], Ex.name as Exchange, cur.CurrencyCode as Currency
  , '-' AS LTP, '-' AS LTQ,  '-' AS BidP, '-' AS BidQ   
  , '-' AS ASkP, '-' AS ASkQ  
  , '-' as QtyUnit      
  , Cast(M.Quote_Size as varchar(10)) as PriceQuotationUnit
  , CONVERT(TIME,GETDATE(),1) AS LTT,  Token           
  FROM UserPreferences S     
  INNER JOIN EsteeMaster M ON S.Value = M.Estee_ID  
  INNER JOIN Exchange EX on M.Exchange_Code = EX.code
  INNER JOIN Currency cur on cur.ID = EX.CurrencyID
  WHERE M.Status=1    
  and S.UserID = @userID       
  and S.Value not in (select distinct Estee_ID from CommodityMaster)    
  ORDER BY Token, DataFeed_Ticker;   
    
    
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.cuiUpdateRolesPermission

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cuiUpdateRolesPermission]
	@permissionID int,
	@roles varchar(max),
	@accessType varchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @tempRoleAccessID table
	(
		roleName varchar(20),
		accessTypeName varchar(20)
	)

	Select IDENTITY(int,1,1) AS RowNumber
	, items
	INTO #rolesTempTable
	from Split(@roles, ',')

	Select IDENTITY(int,1,1) AS RowNumber
	, items
	INTO #accessTypeTempTable
	from Split(@accessType, ',')


	insert into @tempRoleAccessID   
	select rt.items, at.items  
	from #rolesTempTable rt inner join #accessTypeTempTable at on rt.RowNumber = at.RowNumber

	Drop table #rolesTempTable
	drop table #accessTypeTempTable
	
	Delete from tblRolesPermission where PermissionID = @permissionID

	insert into tblRolesPermission 
	select  r.role_ID,@permissionID,at.AccessTypeID
	from @tempRoleAccessID as t
	inner join Roles r on r.Role_Name = t.roleName
	inner join tblAccessType at on at.AccessTypeName = t.accessTypeName

END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.cuiUpdateUserStrategies

```sql
  
  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cuiUpdateUserStrategies]  
 @userID int,  
 @strategies varchar(max)  
AS  
BEGIN   
 SET NOCOUNT ON;  
   
 declare @tempUserStrategies table  
 (  
  strategyID int  
 )  
   
 insert into @tempUserStrategies   
 select s.items from Split(@strategies, ',') as s  --Convert(varchar(10), s.items)  
   
 Delete from UserStrategies where UserID = @userID  
 insert into UserStrategies   
 select @userID,t.strategyID,6 from @tempUserStrategies as t  
   
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.cuiUserLoginDetails

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE cuiUserLoginDetails             
@choice int =0,                
@password varchar(50) = null,                
@last_Login_Time datetime = null,            
@userName varchar(50) = null,          
@blocked bit = null,      
@updatedBy int = 4,    
@userRolesString varchar(200) = null,  
@userCache bit = null,
@isOTPRequired bit=null,
@consentStrategy varchar(max)=''
AS                
BEGIN                
                
 SET NOCOUNT ON;        
   
 IF(@choice =1)   --Gets all distinct users and their respective roles  
    SELECT ld.UserID, ld.firstName, ld.LastName, r.Role_Name, r.Role_ID ,ld.Username, ld.[Password], ld.blocked, U.CacheData,ld.IsOTPRequired,ld.userConsentStrategy from LoginDetails LD                
    FULL OUTER JOIN UserRoles UR ON LD.UserID = UR.User_ID                 
    FULL OUTER JOIN Roles R ON UR.Role_ID = R.Role_ID   
    FULL OUTER JOIN UserDataCacheSettings U ON U.UserID = LD.UserID              
   
 IF(@choice =2)   --Modify user roles, bloced status, password  
  BEGIN      
  DECLARE @userID int      
  SET @userID = (Select [UserID] FROM LoginDetails where UserName = @userName)      
  UPDATE LoginDetails set Password =@password, PasswordchangedTime = GETDATE(), Blocked = @blocked , UpdatedBy =@updatedBy, UpdatedDate = getdate(),IsOTPRequired=@isOTPRequired,userConsentStrategy=@consentStrategy        
  WHERE UserName = @userName              
  
  DELETE userroles WHERE [user_ID] = (@userID)      
  DECLARE @UserRoles TABLE(RoleName varchar(100))        
  INSERT into @UserRoles(RoleName)      
  SELECT * from dbo.split(@userRolesString,',')      
  
  DECLARE @UserRolesNew TABLE(UserID int, RoleID int)        
  INSERT into @UserRolesNew(UserID, RoleID)      
  SELECT @userID, Role_ID FROM Roles R INNER JOIN @UserRoles UR      
  ON R.Role_Name = UR.RoleName      
  
  INSERT INTO userroles      
  SELECT * FROM  @UserRolesNew    
  
  IF Exists(Select 1 from UserDataCacheSettings where UserID = @userID)  
 UPDATE UserDataCacheSettings SET CacheData = @userCache WHERE UserID = @userID  
  ELSE  
 INSERT INTO UserDataCacheSettings VALUES(@userID, @userCache)  
  END      
   
 IF(@choice = 3)           
  SELECT Username, Password, ISNULL(Blocked, 0) AS Blocked from LoginDetails WHERE Username = @userName          
   
 IF(@choice = 4)           
  SELECT Role_Name from LoginDetails LD           
  INNER JOIN UserRoles UR ON LD.UserID = UR.User_ID               
  INNER JOIN Roles R ON UR.Role_ID = R.Role_ID          
  WHERE Username = @userName          
END  


```

```sql
Create View [dbo].[cuiVWformPermission] as 
 SELECT DISTINCT p.PermissionName,  at.AccessTypeName,ld.UserID  
	 FROM LoginDetails ld   
	 INNER JOIN UserRoles ur on ur.User_ID = ld.UserID  
	 INNER JOIN tblRolesPermission rp on rp.RoleID = ur.Role_ID   
	 INNER JOIN tblPermissions p on rp.PermissionID = p.PermissionID  
	 INNER JOIN tblAccessType at on at.AccessTypeID =rp.AccessTypeID
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.dba_runCHECKDB

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[dba_runCHECKDB]
    @dbName           nvarchar(max) = NULL, -- Database name. If NULL, will check all databases
    @PHYSICAL_ONLY    bit     = 0,          -- Set to 1 to perform physical check only. Defaults to 0.
    @allMessages      bit     = 0,          -- Set to 1 to return all the messages generated by DBCC
                                            -- Set to 0 to return one summary message for each database (default)  
    @log_to_table     bit     = 0,          -- Set to 1 to enable logging to table DBCC_CHECKDB_HISTORY
    @help             bit     = 0,
	@dbmail_profile   sysname = NULL,       -- DBMail profile to use when sending the results
    @dbmail_recipient sysname = NULL	    -- DBMail recipient
AS
BEGIN
  
    SET NOCOUNT,
        XACT_ABORT,
        QUOTED_IDENTIFIER,
        ANSI_NULLS,
        ANSI_PADDING,
        ANSI_WARNINGS,
        ARITHABORT,
        CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
  
    IF @help = 1
    BEGIN
        SELECT *
        FROM (
                      SELECT '@dbname nvarchar(max) = NULL','Database name.'
            UNION ALL SELECT '','''Database'' checks a single database'
            UNION ALL SELECT '','NULL checks all databases'
            UNION ALL SELECT '','''Database1,Database2,...DatabaseN'' checks the databases in the list'
            UNION ALL SELECT '','''^Database1,^Database2,...^DatabaseN'' checks all databases except the ones in the list'
            UNION ALL SELECT '','Combinations of positive (not prefixed with ^) and negative (prefixed with ^) elements'
            UNION ALL SELECT '','considers positive elements only. Use negative elements alone.'
            UNION ALL SELECT '',''
            UNION ALL SELECT '@PHYSICAL_ONLY bit = 0','If set to 1, performs CHECKDB WITH PHYSICAL_ONLY'
            UNION ALL SELECT '',''
            UNION ALL SELECT '@allMessages bit = 0','If set to 1, returns all the messages generated by DBCC'
            UNION ALL SELECT '','If set to 0, returns a summary message for each database'
            UNION ALL SELECT '',''
            UNION ALL SELECT '@dbmail_profile sysname = NULL','The dbmail profile to use to send out the email.'
            UNION ALL SELECT '','NULL uses the global dbmail profile'
            UNION ALL SELECT '',''
            UNION ALL SELECT '@dbmail_recipient sysname = NULL','The address that will receive the email.'
            UNION ALL SELECT '','If set to NULL disables sending the email and returns a result set.'
            UNION ALL SELECT '','If not NULL sends the email without returning a result set'
            UNION ALL SELECT '',''
            UNION ALL SELECT '@log_to_table bit = 0','If set to 1, stores the results in the table DBCC_CHECKDB_HISTORY.'
            UNION ALL SELECT '','If the table does not exists, it will create the table for you.'
            UNION ALL SELECT '','When logging to a table, a result set is not returned.'
            UNION ALL SELECT '',''
            UNION ALL SELECT '@help bit = 0','If set to 1 displays this help.'
        ) AS h (
                [-----parameter------------------------------------------------------]
            ,[-----description----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------]
        )
  
        RETURN
    END
  
    DECLARE @version int
    DECLARE @sql nvarchar(4000)
    DECLARE @ErrorMessage nvarchar(2048)
    DECLARE @body nvarchar(max)
  
    DECLARE @Message nvarchar(4000)
    DECLARE @Severity int
    DECLARE @State int
  
    -- determine major version: DBCC output can be different
    SELECT @version = CAST(REPLACE(CAST(SERVERPROPERTY('ProductVersion') AS char(2)),'.','') AS int)
    -- Clean up the @dbname parameter
    -- Remove leading/trailing spaces
    SET @dbname = LTRIM(RTRIM(@dbname))
    -- Remove leading commas
    WHILE LEFT(@dbname,1) = ','
    SET @dbname = SUBSTRING(@dbname, 2, LEN(@dbname))
    -- Remove trailing commas
    WHILE RIGHT(@dbname,1) = ','
    SET @dbname = SUBSTRING(@dbname, 1, LEN(@dbname)-1)
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..##DBCC_OUTPUT') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE ##DBCC_OUTPUT
  
     -- SQL2005, SQL2008, SQL2008R2 produce this output
    -- except for the columns explicitly marked as new in SQL 2012
    CREATE TABLE ##DBCC_OUTPUT(
        Error int NULL,
        [Level] int NULL,
        State int NULL,
        MessageText nvarchar(2048) NULL,
        RepairLevel nvarchar(22) NULL,
        Status int NULL,
        DbId int NULL, -- was smallint in SQL2005
        DbFragId int NULL,      -- new in SQL2012
        ObjectId int NULL,
        IndexId int NULL,
        PartitionId bigint NULL,
        AllocUnitId bigint NULL,
        RidDbId smallint NULL,  -- new in SQL2012
        RidPruId smallint NULL, -- new in SQL2012
        [File] smallint NULL,
        Page int NULL,
        Slot int NULL,
        RefDbId smallint NULL,  -- new in SQL2012
        RefPruId smallint NULL, -- new in SQL2012
        RefFile smallint NULL,
        RefPage int NULL,
        RefSlot int NULL,
        Allocation smallint NULL
    )
  
    -- Add a computed column
    ALTER TABLE ##DBCC_OUTPUT ADD Outcome AS
        CASE
            WHEN Error = 8989 AND MessageText LIKE '%0 allocation errors and 0 consistency errors%' THEN 0
            WHEN Error <> 8989 THEN NULL
            ELSE 1
        END
  
    -- Add an identity column to sort results when sending the email
    ALTER TABLE ##DBCC_OUTPUT ADD RowId int IDENTITY(1,1)
  
    DECLARE @localTran bit
    IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0
    BEGIN
        SET @localTran = 1
        BEGIN TRANSACTION LocalTran
    END
  
    BEGIN TRY
  
        -- Create the history table if needed
        IF @log_to_table = 1
            AND OBJECT_ID('DBCC_CHECKDB_HISTORY') IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SELECT TOP(0)
                RowId,
                Error,
                [Level],
                State,
                MessageText,
                RepairLevel,
                Status,
                DbId,
                DbFragId,
                CAST(NULL AS sysname) AS DatabaseName,
                ObjectId,
                IndexId,
                PartitionId,
                AllocUnitId,
                RidDbId,
                RidPruId,
                [File],
                Page,
                Slot,
                RefDbId,
                RefPruId,
                RefFile,
                RefPage,
                RefSlot,
                Allocation,
                Outcome,
                GETDATE() AS RunDate
            INTO DBCC_CHECKDB_HISTORY
            FROM ##DBCC_OUTPUT
  
            ALTER TABLE DBCC_CHECKDB_HISTORY
                ADD CONSTRAINT PK_DBCC_CHECKDB_HISTORY PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED(RowId)
        END
  
        -- Open a cursor on the matching databases (version dependant)
  
        DECLARE c_databases CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD
        FOR
        SELECT QUOTENAME(name) AS name
        FROM master.sys.databases
        WHERE (
                @dbname IS NULL
                OR ',' + @dbname + ',' NOT LIKE '%,[^!^]%' ESCAPE '!'
                OR ',' + @dbname + ',' LIKE '%,' + name + ',%'
                OR ',' + @dbname + ',' LIKE '%,' + REPLACE(QUOTENAME(name),'[','[[]') + ',%'
            )
            AND ',' + ISNULL(@dbname,'') + ',' NOT LIKE '%,!^' + name + ',%' ESCAPE '!'
            AND ',' + ISNULL(@dbname,'') + ',' NOT LIKE '%,!^' + REPLACE(QUOTENAME(name),'[','[[]') + ',%' ESCAPE '!'
            AND state_desc = 'ONLINE'
            AND is_read_only = 0
            AND source_database_id IS NULL -- Exclude Snapshots
            AND name <> 'tempdb'
  
        OPEN c_databases
        FETCH NEXT FROM c_databases INTO @dbName
  
        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
  
            -- Build a SQL string
            SET @sql = 'DBCC CHECKDB('+ @dbName +') WITH TABLERESULTS, ALL_ERRORMSGS '
  
            IF @PHYSICAL_ONLY = 1
                SET @sql = @sql + ', PHYSICAL_ONLY '
  
            BEGIN TRY
  
                IF @version > 8 AND @version < 11
                BEGIN
                    -- SQL2005/2008 use this column list
                    INSERT INTO ##DBCC_OUTPUT (
                        Error,
                        [Level],
                        State,
                        MessageText,
                        RepairLevel,
                        Status,
                        DbId,
                        ObjectId,
                        IndexId,
                        PartitionId,
                        AllocUnitId,
                        [File],
                        Page,
                        Slot,
                        RefFile,
                        RefPage,
                        RefSlot,
                        Allocation
                    )
                    EXEC(@sql)
                END
  
                IF @version >= 11
                BEGIN
                    -- SQL2012 uses all columns
                    INSERT INTO ##DBCC_OUTPUT (
                        Error,
                        [Level],
                        State,
                        MessageText,
                        RepairLevel,
                        Status,
                        DbId,
                        DbFragId,
                        ObjectId,
                        IndexId,
                        PartitionId,
                        AllocUnitId,
                        RidDbId,
                        RidPruId,
                        [File],
                        Page,
                        Slot,
                        RefDbId,
                        RefPruId,
                        RefFile,
                        RefPage,
                        RefSlot,
                        Allocation
                    )
                    EXEC(@sql)
                END
  
            END TRY
            BEGIN CATCH
                SELECT  @ErrorMessage = 'Unable to run DBCC on database ' + @dbName + ': ' + ERROR_MESSAGE()
  
                INSERT INTO ##DBCC_OUTPUT (Error, MessageText)
                SELECT Error = 8989,
                       MessageText = @ErrorMessage
  
            END CATCH
  
            FETCH NEXT FROM c_databases INTO @dbName
        END
  
        CLOSE c_databases
        DEALLOCATE c_databases
  
        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM ##DBCC_OUTPUT
        )
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR('No database matches the name specified.',10,1)
        END
  
        IF @log_to_table = 1
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO DBCC_CHECKDB_HISTORY (
                Error,
                [Level],
                State,
                MessageText,
                RepairLevel,
                Status,
                DbId,
                DbFragId,
                DatabaseName,
                ObjectId,
                IndexId,
                PartitionId,
                AllocUnitId,
                RidDbId,
                RidPruId,
                [File],
                Page,
                Slot,
                RefDbId,
                RefPruId,
                RefFile,
                RefPage,
                RefSlot,
                Allocation,
                Outcome,
                RunDate
            )
            SELECT
                Error,
                [Level],
                State,
                MessageText,
                RepairLevel,
                Status,
                DbId,
                DbFragId,
                DatabaseName = ISNULL(DB_NAME(DbId),'resourcedb'),
                ObjectId,
                IndexId,
                PartitionId,
                AllocUnitId,
                RidDbId,
                RidPruId,
                [File],
                Page,
                Slot,
                RefDbId,
                RefPruId,
                RefFile,
                RefPage,
                RefSlot,
                Allocation,
                Outcome,
                RunDate = GETDATE()
            FROM ##DBCC_OUTPUT
            WHERE Error = 8989
                OR @allMessages = 1
                OR DbId IN (
                    SELECT DbId
                    FROM ##DBCC_OUTPUT
                    WHERE Error = 8989
                        AND Outcome = 1
                )
        END
  
        -- Build the final SQL statement
        SET @sql =
            'SELECT ISNULL(DB_NAME(DbId),''resourcedb'') AS DatabaseName, ' +
                CASE @allMessages
                    WHEN 1 THEN '*'
                    ELSE 'MessageText, Outcome'
                END + '
            FROM ##DBCC_OUTPUT
            WHERE 1 = 1 ' +
            CASE @allMessages WHEN 1 THEN '' ELSE 'AND Error = 8989' END
  
        IF @dbmail_recipient IS NULL
        BEGIN
            -- Query DBCC output directly
            EXEC(@sql)
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            -- Pipe DBCC output to a variable
            SET @sql = '
                SELECT @body = (
                    SELECT ISNULL(MessageText,'''') + char(10) AS [text()]
                    FROM ( ' + @sql + ' AND Error = 8989 ) AS src
                    ORDER BY 1 DESC
                    FOR XML PATH('''')
                )'
  
            EXEC sp_executesql @sql, N'@body nvarchar(max) OUTPUT', @body OUTPUT
  
		
			-- Send CHECKDB report
			Declare @sub varchar(500)
			SET @sub = 'CHECK DB Report for Server :- ' + @@SERVERNAME
           		
            BEGIN
  
                EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail
                    @profile_name = @dbmail_profile,
                    @recipients   = @dbmail_recipient,
                    @subject      = @sub,
                    @body         = @body,
                    @importance   = 'High',
                    @query        = '
                        SET NOCOUNT ON;
                        SELECT TOP(15000) ISNULL(DB_NAME(DbId),''resourcedb'') + '' -'' AS DatabaseName, MessageText
                        FROM ##DBCC_OUTPUT WITH (NOLOCK)
                        WHERE DbId IN (
                            SELECT DbId
                            FROM ##DBCC_OUTPUT WITH (NOLOCK)
                            WHERE Error = 8989 AND Outcome = 1   
                        )
                        ORDER BY RowId ASC ',
                    @attach_query_result_as_file = 1,
                    @query_result_no_padding     = 1,
                    @query_result_header         = 0,
                    @exclude_query_output        = 1,
                    @query_attachment_filename   = 'DBCC_CHECKDB_Errors.log'
  
            END
			  
        END
  
        IF @localTran = 1 AND XACT_STATE() = 1
            COMMIT TRAN LocalTran
  
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..##DBCC_OUTPUT') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE ##DBCC_OUTPUT
  
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
  
        SELECT  @Message = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
                @Severity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),
                @State = ERROR_STATE()
  
        IF @localTran = 1 AND XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRAN
  
        RAISERROR ( @Message, @Severity, @State)
  
    END CATCH
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.DBMerge_Async

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[DBMerge_Async]                      
@date datetime = '01-01-1001',  
@subStrategyID varchar(100)  
AS                      
BEGIN 

declare @rowsCount int      
declare @MaxRows int
declare  @Order_Type varchar(10)
declare  @Order_Validity int
declare  @Price_Diff decimal(20,10)
declare  @Broker_ID int
declare  @Account_ID int
declare  @Order_Source_ID varchar(50)
declare  @Remarks varchar(100)
declare  @Sub_Strategy_ID int  
declare  @Comb_Status varchar(50)
declare  @Underlying_Ticker varchar(50)
declare  @status varchar(50)
declare  @isLast bit
declare  @New_Cancel_Modify varchar(1)
declare  @Created_By int
declare  @Updated_By int
declare  @NewOrderID int -- required when inserting cancel /modify order  
declare  @Creation_Time_In datetime
declare  @Order_ID int
declare  @OrderTrade_ID int
declare  @Creation_Time DateTime
declare  @LinkID int
declare  @LinkIDOut int
declare  @Exchg_Order_ID varchar(50)
declare  @broker_order_id varchar(50)
declare  @participant_id varchar(50)
declare	 @estee_ID varchar(50)
declare	 @Buy_Sell_Indicator int
declare	 @Order_Quantity int
declare	 @Order_Price decimal(20,4)
declare	 @Traded_Quantity int
declare	 @Traded_Price decimal(20,10)
declare	 @Stop_Price decimal(20,4)
declare	 @Transaction_Cost decimal(20,4)
declare	 @Trade_ID int
DECLARE @intErrorCode INT

--- fetch the required trades

declare @max_Order_id int
select @max_Order_id = max(Order_ID) from vwalltrades 

declare @max_OrderTrade_id int
select @max_OrderTrade_id = max(OrderTrade_ID) from vwalltrades 

declare @max_Trade_id int
select @max_Trade_id = max(Trade_ID) from vwalltrades 

DECLARE @TempSelect TABLE ( 
rownum int IDENTITY(1,1) Primary key not null,
[Order_Type] [varchar](10),
[Order_Validity] [int], 
[Broker_ID] [int], 
[Account_ID] [int] NOT NULL,
[Order_Source_ID] [varchar](50) NULL,
[Broker_Order_ID] [varchar](50) NULL,
[Exchange_Order_ID] [varchar](50) NULL,
[Comb_Status] [varchar](50) NULL,
[Sub_Strategy_ID] [int] NOT NULL,
[Underlying_Ticker] [varchar](50) NULL,
[Estee_ID] [varchar](50) NOT NULL,
[Buy_Sell_Indicator] [int] NOT NULL,
[Order_Quantity] [int] NOT NULL,
[Order_Price] [decimal](20, 4) NULL,
[Traded_Quantity] [int] NULL,
[Traded_Price] [decimal](20, 10) NULL,
[Stop_Price] [decimal](20, 4) NULL,
[Transaction_Cost] [decimal](20, 4) NULL,
[Status] [varchar](50) NOT NULL,
[islast] [bit] NOT NULL,
[Creation_Time] [datetime] NOT NULL,
[Update_Time] [datetime] NOT NULL,
[Created_By] [int] NULL,
[Updated_By] [int] NULL,
[New_Cancel_Modify] [varchar](50) NULL,
[Remarks] [varchar](300) NULL,
[Price_Diff] [decimal](20, 4) NULL,
[Participant_ID] [Varchar] (50) NULL
 )

INSERT INTO @TempSelect (
[Order_Type],
[Order_Validity], 
[Broker_ID], 
[Account_ID],
[Order_Source_ID],
[Broker_Order_ID] ,
[Exchange_Order_ID],
[Comb_Status],
[Sub_Strategy_ID],
[Underlying_Ticker],
[Estee_ID],
[Buy_Sell_Indicator],
[Order_Quantity],
[Order_Price],
[Traded_Quantity],
[Traded_Price],
[Stop_Price],
[Transaction_Cost],
[Status],
[islast],
[Creation_Time],
[Update_Time],
[Created_By],
[Updated_By],
[New_Cancel_Modify],
[Remarks],
[Price_Diff],
[Participant_ID]
)
SELECT 
[Order_type],
[Order_Validity], 
[Broker_ID], 
[Account_ID],
[Order_Source_ID],
[Broker_Order_ID] ,
[Exchange_Order_ID],
[Comb_Status],
[Sub_Strategy_ID],
[Underlying_Ticker],
[Estee_ID],
[Buy_Sell_Indicator],
[Order_Quantity],
[Order_Price],
[Traded_Quantity],
[Traded_Price],
[Stop_Price],
[Transaction_Cost],
[Status],
[islast],
[Creation_Time],
[Update_Time],
[Created_By],
[Updated_By],
[New_Cancel_Modify],
[Remarks],
[Price_Diff],
[Participant_ID]
 FROM [dbo].vwAllTrades where 
--FROM [191.191.191.100].[estee].[dbo].vwAllTrades where 
--order_id in ('1022612') and status in ('Partially Filled', 'Executed')
sub_strategy_id = @subStrategyID and datediff(dd, creation_time, @date) = 0 and status in ('Partially Filled', 'Executed')
Order by Exchange_Order_ID;

SELECT * FROM @TempSelect 
select @MaxRows=count(*) from @TempSelect

--- LOOP STARTS HERE

set @rowscount = 1

BEGIN TRANSACTION

WHILE @rowsCount <= @MaxRows
	BEGIN
set @max_Order_id = @max_Order_id + 1
set @max_OrderTrade_id = @max_OrderTrade_id + 1
set @max_Trade_id = @max_Trade_id + 1

		SELECT
		@order_type = [order_type],
		@order_validity = [order_validity],  
		@price_diff = [price_diff],
		@order_source_id = [order_source_id],
		@Remarks = [Remarks],
		@comb_status = [Comb_status],
		@underlying_ticker = [underlying_ticker],
		@status = [status],
		@isLast = [ISLAST],
		@New_Cancel_Modify = [NEW_CANCEL_MODIFY],
		@created_by = [CREATED_BY],
		@updated_by = [UPDATED_BY],
		@creation_time = [CREATION_TIME],
		@buy_sell_indicator = [BUY_SELL_INDICATOR],
		@transaction_cost = [TRANSACTION_COST],
		@broker_ID = [broker_id], 
		@account_ID = [account_ID],
		@estee_id = [estee_id],
		@sub_strategy_id = [Sub_Strategy_ID],
		@order_quantity = [ORDER_QUANTITY],
		@order_price = [ORDER_price],
		@traded_quantity = [TRADED_QUANTITY],
		@traded_price = [TRADED_PRICE],
		@stop_price = [STOP_PRICE],
		@Exchg_Order_ID = [EXCHANGE_ORDER_ID],
		@Broker_Order_ID = [BROKER_ORDER_ID],
		@Participant_ID = [Participant_ID]
		from @TempSelect where rownum = @rowscount

		insert into tblOrders ([order_ID], [order_type], [order_validity], [broker_id], [account_ID], 
		[order_source_id], [BROKER_ORDER_ID], [EXCHANGE_ORDER_ID], [Comb_status], [Sub_Strategy_ID], 
		[underlying_ticker], [Participant_ID])
		values (@max_Order_id, @order_type, @order_validity, @broker_id, @account_ID, 
		@order_source_id, @BROKER_ORDER_ID, @Exchg_Order_ID, @Comb_status, @Sub_Strategy_ID, 
		@underlying_ticker, @Participant_ID)
		SELECT @intErrorCode = @@ERROR
						  IF (@intErrorCode <> 0)
								BEGIN
									  SELECT @intErrorCode
										ROLLBACK TRANSACTION 
									  RETURN
								END

		insert into tblOrderTrades ([OrderTrade_ID], [Order_ID], [status], [ISLAST], 
		[CREATION_TIME],Update_Time, [CREATED_BY], [UPDATED_BY], [NEW_CANCEL_MODIFY], [Remarks], [price_diff])
		values (@max_OrderTrade_id, @max_Order_id, @status, @ISLAST, 
		@CREATION_TIME,getdate(), @CREATED_BY, @UPDATED_BY, @NEW_CANCEL_MODIFY, @Remarks, @price_diff)
		SELECT @intErrorCode = @@ERROR
						  IF (@intErrorCode <> 0)
								BEGIN
									  SELECT @intErrorCode
										ROLLBACK TRANSACTION 
									  RETURN
								END

		insert into tblTrades ([Trade_ID], [OrderTrade_ID], [estee_id], [BUY_SELL_INDICATOR], [ORDER_QUANTITY], 
		[ORDER_price], [TRADED_QUANTITY], [TRADED_PRICE], [STOP_PRICE], [TRANSACTION_COST])
		values (@max_Trade_id, @max_OrderTrade_id, @estee_id, @BUY_SELL_INDICATOR, @ORDER_QUANTITY, 
		@ORDER_price, @TRADED_QUANTITY, @TRADED_PRICE, @STOP_PRICE, @TRANSACTION_COST)
		SELECT @intErrorCode = @@ERROR
						  IF (@intErrorCode <> 0)
								BEGIN
									  SELECT @intErrorCode
										ROLLBACK TRANSACTION 
									  RETURN
								END

set @rowscount = @rowscount + 1
END

COMMIT TRANSACTION 

insert into tblAllocatedIDs (Max_Order_ID, Max_OrderTrade_ID, Max_Trade_ID)
values (@max_Order_id, @max_OrderTrade_id, @max_Trade_id)
SELECT @intErrorCode = @@ERROR
                  IF (@intErrorCode <> 0)
                        BEGIN
                              SELECT @intErrorCode
							  RETURN
                        END
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.DeleteBorrowTransactions

```sql

	 

  
CREATE PROCEDURE DeleteBorrowTransactions  
-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here  
@date DATE, @updateTime DATETIME, @updatedBy INT, @borrowTransactions BORROWTRANSACTIONTYPE READONLY  
AS  
     BEGIN  
         -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from  
         -- interfering with SELECT statements.  
         SET NOCOUNT ON;  
  
         -- Insert statements for procedure here  
         BEGIN TRY  
             BEGIN TRANSACTION;  
  
       Delete from StockBorrowPositions where PositionDate>=@date  
  
             INSERT INTO [StockBorrowDeletedTransactions] (Date, id, ExchangeCode, AccountId,SubstrategyId, SecurityName, EsteeId, TransactionType, InterestRate,  
    BorrowDate, MaturityDate, SettlementType, Quantity, UpdatedBy, UpdateTime)  
                    SELECT sbt.Date, sbt.id, sbt.ExchangeCode, sbt.AccountId, sbt.SubstrategyId, sbt.SecurityName, sbt.EsteeId,   
    sbt.TransactionType, sbt.InterestRate, sbt.BorrowDate, sbt.MaturityDate, sbt.SettlementType, sbt.Quantity, @updatedBy, @updateTime  
                      FROM StockBorrowTransactions sbt  
                      JOIN @borrowTransactions bt ON sbt.id = bt.Id  
                                                     AND sbt.SubStrategyId = bt.SubstrategyId  
                                                     AND sbt.AccountId = bt.AccountId  
                                                     AND sbt.EsteeId = bt.EsteeId  
                                                     AND sbt.TransactionType = bt.TransactionType  
                                                     AND sbt.BorrowDate = bt.BorrowDate  
                     WHERE sbt.Date = @date;  
  
             DELETE sbt  
               FROM StockBorrowTransactions sbt  
               JOIN @borrowTransactions bt ON sbt.id = bt.Id  
                                              AND sbt.SubStrategyId = bt.SubstrategyId  
                                              AND sbt.AccountId = bt.AccountId  
                                              AND sbt.EsteeId = bt.EsteeId  
                                              AND sbt.TransactionType = bt.TransactionType  
                                              AND sbt.BorrowDate = bt.BorrowDate  
              WHERE sbt.Date = @date;  
             COMMIT TRANSACTION;  
         END TRY  
         BEGIN CATCH  
             DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT;  
             SELECT @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();  
             IF(XACT_STATE()) <> 0  
             BEGIN  
                 PRINT 'Rolling back transaction.';  
                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;  
             END;  
             RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, @ErrorSeverity, @ErrorState);  
         END CATCH;  
     END;  

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.DeleteFromTable

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[DeleteFromTable]
@tableName varchar(300)
/*
this sp deleted entries from a particular table passed as parameter
*/
AS  
BEGIN  
 BEGIN TRY  
   SET XACT_ABORT ON  
   BEGIN TRAN 
				DECLARE @sqlStatement VARCHAR(MAX) 
				SET @sqlStatement = 'DELETE FROM ' + @tableName			
				EXEC(@sqlStatement)  
   COMMIT TRAN  
   
   SET XACT_ABORT OFF  
 END TRY  
   
 BEGIN CATCH  
 				  ROLLBACK TRAN  
				  SET XACT_ABORT OFF  
 END CATCH  
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.DeleteTradesDataForArchiveDate

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Megha Goel
-- Create date: 24 June 2014
-- Description:	Get Archive Table row count
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[DeleteTradesDataForArchiveDate]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@archiveDate date
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	declare @archiveDatePlusOne date
	declare @dbName varchar(255), @serverIP as varchar(255)
	set @archiveDatePlusOne = DATEADD(dd,1, @archiveDate)
	SELECT @dbName = DB_NAME()
	SET @serverIP = Cast(CONNECTIONPROPERTY('local_net_address') as varchar(255))
	BEGIN TRY
		DECLARE @Rows INT, @batchSize int
		SET @Rows = 1
		Set @batchSize = 30000
		PRINT 'Deleting data from Trades table for date '+ Convert(varchar(10),@archiveDate,120)
		WHILE (@Rows > 0)
		BEGIN
			DELETE TOP (@batchSize) FROM [Trades] WHERE Creation_Date=@archiveDate  
			SET @Rows = @@ROWCOUNT
		END	
		SET @Rows = 1
		PRINT 'Deleting data from OrderTrades table for date '+ Convert(varchar(10),@archiveDate,120)
		WHILE (@Rows > 0)
		BEGIN
			DELETE TOP (@batchSize) FROM [OrderTrades] WHERE Creation_Date=@archiveDate  
			SET @Rows = @@ROWCOUNT
		END
	    SET @Rows = 1
		PRINT 'Deleting data from Order table for date '+ Convert(varchar(10),@archiveDate,120)
		WHILE (@Rows > 0)
		BEGIN
			DELETE TOP (@batchSize) FROM [Order] WHERE Creation_Date=@archiveDate  
			SET @Rows = @@ROWCOUNT
		END
		IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME='tblOrderTrail') and 
			(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SourceDestinationDBMapForArchival WHERE SourceServer=@serverIP and SourceDatabase=@dbname and SourceTable='tblOrderTrail')
			OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SourceDestinationDBMapForArchival WHERE DestinationServer=@serverIP and DestinationDatabase=@dbname and DestinationTable='tblOrderTrail'))
		BEGIN
			PRINT 'Deleting data from tblOrderTrail table for date '+ Convert(varchar(10),@archiveDate,120)
			SET @Rows = 1
			WHILE (@Rows > 0)
			BEGIN
				DELETE TOP (@batchSize) FROM [tblOrderTrail] WHERE Exec_Time>=@archiveDate and Exec_Time < @archiveDatePlusOne
				SET @Rows = @@ROWCOUNT
			END
		END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);
		DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;
		DECLARE @ErrorState INT;
		SELECT 
			@ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
			@ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),
			@ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();
		-- Use RAISERROR inside the CATCH block to return error
		-- information about the original error that caused
		-- execution to jump to the CATCH block.
		RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage, -- Message text.
		           @ErrorSeverity, -- Severity.
		           @ErrorState -- State.
		           );
	END CATCH
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.DisableAllTriggers

```sql
create Procedure [dbo].[DisableAllTriggers]

AS
Declare @string varchar(8000)
Declare @tableName nvarchar(500)
Declare cur cursor
for select name as tbname from sysobjects where id in(select parent_obj from sysobjects where xtype='tr')  and name<>'bloomberg dividend data'
open cur
fetch next from cur into @tableName
while @@fetch_status = 0
begin
set @string ='Alter table '+ @tableName + ' Disable trigger all'
exec (@string)
Fetch next from cur into @tableName
end
close cur
deallocate cur


```

## Function: dbo.DoubleSplit

```sql
/*Sample
@list = '1:9797,2:9898'
@Delimiter1 = ','
@Delimiter2 = ':'

@temptable --->
Col1		Col2
1			9797
2			9898
*/
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.DoubleSplit(
								@list       VARCHAR(MAX),
								@Delimiter1 CHAR(1),
								@Delimiter2 CHAR(1)
)
RETURNS @temptable TABLE(
												 Col1 VARCHAR(MAX),
												 Col2 VARCHAR(MAX)
)
AS
		 BEGIN

				 INSERT INTO @temptable
				 SELECT Col1 = LEFT(dsk.Items, sl.SplitLocation - 1), Col2 = SUBSTRING(dsk.Items, sl.SplitLocation+1, LEN(dsk.Items))
				 FROM   dbo.Split(@list, @Delimiter1) AS dsk
								CROSS APPLY(VALUES(ISNULL(NULLIF(CHARINDEX(@Delimiter2, dsk.Items, 1), 0), 1))) AS sl(SplitLocation);
				 RETURN;
		 END;


```

## View definition: dbo.EsteeServers

```sql
CREATE VIEW EsteeServers
AS 
select es.ID,es.Name,isnull(es1.NatIP,es.IP) IP,es.frequency,es.ServiceURL,es.LocationCode,isnull(es1.NatWANIP,es.WanIP) WanIP,es.ExchangeIP,isnull(es1.NatWANIP2, es.WanIP2) WanIP2,es.OS from EsteeServersProd es
left join EsteeServerNatIPs es1 on es.IP = es1.IP and es1.LocationCode in (select LocationCode from MyLocationCode)

```

## Function: dbo.fnGetExpiry

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetExpiry](@date datetime)
RETURNS TABLE
AS

return (select EXPIRY_DATE from 
(
		Select DISTINCT TOP 100 EXPIRY_DATE           
		FROM          
		(          
			select expiry_date from esteemaster where status = 1  and Exchange_Code='IS'
            and expiry_date != '' and expiry_date >= cast(convert(varchar,@date,110) as datetime)  and security_type between 0 and 9           
			Union          
			select expiry_date from esteemaster_archive 
           where  Exchange_Code='IS' and status = 1 and expiry_date != '' and expiry_date >= cast(convert(varchar,@date,110) as datetime) and security_type between 0 and 9             
		) X Order by X.Expiry_Date asc 

Union 
		Select DISTINCT TOP 100 EXPIRY_DATE           
		FROM          
		(          
			select expiry_date from esteemaster where status = 1 
            and  Exchange_Code='IS' and expiry_date != '' and expiry_date >= cast(convert(varchar,@date,110) as datetime)  and security_type between 10 and 14           
			Union          
			select expiry_date from esteemaster_archive 
           where  Exchange_Code='IS' and status = 1 and expiry_date != '' and expiry_date >= cast(convert(varchar,@date,110) as datetime) and security_type between 10 and 14             
		) X Order by X.Expiry_Date asc 
) Z )

```
