## Function: dbo.FullStrategydetails

```sql
CREATE function [dbo].[FullStrategydetails]           
()    
Returns table as    
return    
    
SELECT DISTINCT sn.Strategy_ID, SG.StrategyName as Strategy_Name,sn.SubStrategy_Id, sn.SubStrategy_Name, sn.Strategy_Status,     
sn.ownerUserID, l.FirstName + ' ' +l.LastName as StrategyOwner,                            
sba.AccountID,A.Account_Type,A.Account_Name, a.exchange_Code,  a.Segment, sn.AlgoID,                       
d.Value as EMS_QUEUE, s.IP as IP,s.LocationCode, ap.StartTime,ap.stoptime,sc.ID as StrategyCategoryID,           
sc.Name as StrategyCategoryName,f.id as FundID,f.name,a.ClearingAccountID, BEPnlType,E.EMS_Application_ID, D3.Value AS LinuxInterfaceIP,e.PlatformType,ean.ID,ean.ApplicationName, lau.*        
FROM  Strategy_New sn                          
LEFT JOIN LoginDetails l on l.UserID = sn.ownerUserID    
LEFT JOIN StrategyGroup SG with(nolock) on sn.Strategy_Id = SG.StrategyID                            
LEFT JOIN LoginDetails li with(nolock) on li.UserID = SG.Owner                            
LEFT JOIN StrategyBrokerAccount sba with(nolock) on sba.subStrategyID = sn.SubStrategy_Id                            
LEFT JOIN Account a with(nolock) on sba.accountID = a.Account_ID          
LEFT JOIN ClearingAccount CA (nolock) on A.ClearingAccountID = CA.ClearingAccountID                        
LEFT JOIN tblBrokerAccount BA with(nolock) on a.Account_ID = BA.account_id                                                  
LEFT JOIN EsteeApplications e  with(nolock) on e.SubStrategy_ID = sn.SubStrategy_Id     
left join EsteeApplicationNames ean on ean.ID = e.AppNameID  
LEFT JOIN Datainit d with(nolock) on d.ApplicationID = e.ApplicationID                                              
LEFT JOIN EsteeServers s with(nolock) on s.ID = e.EsteeServer_ID                  
LEFT JOIN StrategyCategory sc with(nolock) on sc.ID = SG.CategoryID      
LEFT JOIN InvestmentFund f with(nolock) on f.id = sc.FundID     
LEFT JOIN DataInit d1 with(nolock) on d.ApplicationID = d1.ApplicationID and d1.Parameter = 'EMBServerType'                   
LEFT JOIN DataInit d3 with(nolock) on d.ApplicationID = d3.ApplicationID and d3.Parameter = 'Platform_Linux_InterfaceIP'                  
LEFT JOIN ApplicationSchedule ap with(nolock) on ap.ApplicationId = e.ApplicationID            
left join LauncherInfo lau on e.ApplicationID = lau.AppId    
WHERE (d.Parameter = 'EMSQueueName' OR d.Parameter IS NULL)                  
AND e.SubStrategy_ID IS NOT NULL                   
AND sn.Strategy_Status = 1 
```

## Function: dbo.FuncGetAllLinkedOrdersForGivenDateRange

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FuncGetAllLinkedOrdersForGivenDateRange](@fromDate datetime, @toDate datetime)          
returns @temptable TABLE (DataFeedTicker nvarchar(75), TotalLockedProfit decimal(20, 4),   
 TotalRealizedProfit decimal(20, 4), NetProfit decimal(20, 4), TransactionCost decimal(20, 4), Account_ID int,   
 Estee_ID nvarchar(75), Sub_StrategyID varchar(5), Broker_ID int, LinkID int, Status nvarchar(25),   
 LinkedOrderDate datetime, Total_Positions int, Total_MTM decimal(20, 4), Total_Money_Deployed decimal(20, 4))          
as          
begin       
 INSERT INTO @temptable(DataFeedTicker, TotalLockedProfit, TotalRealizedProfit, NetProfit,   
  TransactionCost, Account_ID, Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, LinkID, Status, LinkedOrderDate)     
    SELECT         
  MIN(E.DataFeed_Ticker) AS DataFeed_Ticker,        
  ISNULL(Sum(link.LockedProfit) / count(LinkID), 0) AS Total_Locked_Profit,         
  ISNULL(SUM(link.RealizedProfit) / count(LinkID), 0) AS Total_Realised_Profit,         
  ISNULL(SUM(link.LockedProfit + link.RealizedProfit - link.TransactionCost) / count(LinkID), 0) AS NetProfit,         
  ISNULL(SUM(link.TransactionCost) / count(LinkID), 0) AS Total_TC,         
  Account_ID,         
  MIN((case          
   When SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 15, 2) in ('05', '06','07') then SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 0, 15) + '04'         
   When SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 15, 2) in ('01', '02','03')  then SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 0, 15) + '00'        
   Else SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 0, 15)  
   End)) AS Estee_ID,        
  MIN(OrdTra.Sub_Strategy_ID) AS SubStrategy_ID,         
  Broker_ID,        
  Ord.Link_ID,        
  ISNULL(link.PositionStatus, 'Closed')  As Position_Status,         
  min(OrdTra.Creation_Time) AS TradeDate         
  FROM         
  tblLinkOrders link WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tblOrders Ord WITH (NOLOCK) ON link.LinkID = Ord.Link_ID        
  INNER JOIN tblOrderTrades OrdTra WITH (NOLOCK) ON Ord.Order_ID = OrdTra.Order_ID        
  INNER JOIN tblTrades Tra WITH (NOLOCK) ON OrdTra.OrderTrade_ID = Tra.OrderTrade_ID        
  INNER JOIN esteemaster E ON SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 1, 12) = E.ISIN        
  WHERE  E.Exchange_Code='IS' and E.Status=1 and OrdTra.Creation_Time Between @fromDate and @toDate        
  AND OrdTra.status  IN ('Executed', 'Partially Filled')        
  GROUP BY Ord.Broker_ID, Ord.Link_ID, SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 0, 15), Account_ID, link.PositionStatus
return          
end

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetAccounts

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetAccounts]
@IsActiveOnly bit = 1 --if 0 then all accounts else only active
,@exchanges varchar(100) = null
AS
BEGIN
 DECLARE @localExchangeCode TABLE(Exchange_Code char(2))

   IF(@exchanges is null OR @exchanges = '')  BEGIN                    
     insert into @localExchangeCode select code from Exchange          
   END ELSE BEGIN                    
     INSERT into @localExchangeCode SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) from dbo.split(@exchanges,',')                    
   END           

SELECT A.Account_ID as account_id,A.Account_Name as account_name 
	FROM Account as A
		INNER JOIN tblBrokerAccount as BA 
			ON A.Account_ID = BA.account_id AND BA.is_active in (1, case @IsActiveOnly when 0 then 0 else 1 end)
		INNER JOIN Broker B
			ON B.Broker_ID = BA.broker_id AND B.Status in ('Active', case @IsActiveOnly when 0 then 'Inactive' else 'Active' end)
		INNER JOIN @localExchangeCode l on l.Exchange_Code = A.Exchange_Code             
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetAccountsEligibleForIntradayTC

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetAccountsEligibleForIntradayTC]
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	SELECT DISTINCT 
	ab.accountid,  
	st.TypeCode AS SecurityTypeCode , 
	st.TypeName AS SecurityTypeName
	FROM ApplicableBrokerage ab  
	INNER JOIN BrokerProducts bp ON bp.ID = ab.BrokerProductID  
	INNER JOIN SecurityType st ON st.TypeCode = bp.securitytype
	WHERE bp.TransactionType = 'Intraday'

END

```

```sql
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@subStrategyId int

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetAggregationList

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetAggregationList]   
 @applicationID int  
AS  
BEGIN  
 SET NOCOUNT ON;   
 select R.*,D.DimensionName from RiskControlConfig R  
 inner join ParameterDimension D on R.DimensionID = D.DimensionId  
 where applicationID = @applicationID and ShouldAggregate = 1    
  
 -- Dimension List  
 Declare @dimensionMap table (DimensionID int, DimensionName varchar(50), DimensionValue varchar(10))  
 
 
 --StrategyAccount  
 Declare @isGlobal bit  
 Declare @dimValue varchar(1000)  
 select @isGlobal = IsGlobal, @dimValue = DimensionValue  
 from RiskControlConfig R   
    inner join ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
    where ApplicationID = @applicationID and D.DimensionName = 'StrategyAccount'  
   
 IF(@dimValue IS NOT NULL)      
  BEGIN  
   insert into @dimensionMap  
   select distinct R.DimensionID,D.DimensionName, cast(A.Account_ID AS varchar(10)) + '_' + Cast(SN.SubStrategy_Id AS varchar(10)) DimensionValue  
   from Account A  
   inner join Exchange E on E.code = A.exchange_Code   
   inner join RiskControlConfig R on R.applicationID = @applicationID  
   inner join ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
   inner join StrategyBrokerAccount SBA on SBA.accountID = A.Account_ID  
   inner join Strategy_New SN on SN.SubStrategy_Id = SBA.subStrategyID  
   where A.Status = 'Active'   
   and R.ShouldAggregate = 1   
   and D.DimensionName = 'StrategyAccount'  
   and SN.Strategy_Status = 1
  END  
  ELSE    
  BEGIN       
   insert into @dimensionMap  
   select distinct R.DimensionID,D.DimensionName, cast(A.Account_ID AS varchar(10)) + '_' + Cast(SN.SubStrategy_Id AS varchar(10)) DimensionValue
   from Account A  
   inner join Exchange E on E.code = A.exchange_Code  
   inner join RiskControlConfig R on R.applicationID = @applicationID   
   inner join ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
   inner join StrategyBrokerAccount SBA on SBA.accountID = A.Account_ID  
   inner join Strategy_New SN on SN.SubStrategy_Id = SBA.subStrategyID  
   where A.Status = 'Active'   
   and R.ShouldAggregate = 1   
   and D.DimensionName = 'StrategyAccount'  
   and SN.Strategy_Status = 1  
  END
 
 select @isGlobal = IsGlobal, @dimValue = DimensionValue  
 from RiskControlConfig R   
    inner join ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
    where ApplicationID = @applicationID and D.DimensionName = 'Account'  
   
 IF(@dimValue IS NOT NULL)  
 BEGIN  
  INSERT INTO @dimensionMap  
  SELECT DISTINCT R.DimensionID,D.DimensionName, A.ClearingAccountID DimensionValue   
  FROM Account A   
  INNER JOIN RiskControlConfig R on R.applicationID = @applicationID  
  INNER JOIN ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
  WHERE A.ClearingAccountID in (select * from dbo.Split(@dimValue,',')) and R.ShouldAggregate = 1   
 END    
 ELSE     
 BEGIN  
  IF(@isGlobal = 1) -- GLOBAL  
  BEGIN  
   insert into @dimensionMap  
   select distinct R.DimensionID,D.DimensionName, A.Account_ID DimensionValue  
   from Account A  
   inner join Exchange E on E.code = A.exchange_Code  
   inner join EsteeServers ES on ES.LocationCode = E.LocationCode  
   inner join EsteeApplications EA on EA.EsteeServer_ID = ES.ID  
   inner join RiskControlConfig R on R.applicationID = @applicationID  
   inner join ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
   inner join StrategyBrokerAccount SBA on SBA.accountID = A.Account_ID  
   inner join Strategy_New SN on SN.SubStrategy_Id = SBA.subStrategyID  
   where A.Status = 'Active'   
   and R.ShouldAggregate = 1   
   and D.DimensionName = 'Account'  
   and SN.Strategy_Status = 1  
   and EA.ApplicationID in (select ApplicationID from EsteeApplications   
           where appnameid = (select ID from EsteeApplicationNames   
              where ApplicationName = 'Estee.Allocator'))  
  END  
  ELSE    
  BEGIN       
   insert into @dimensionMap  
   select distinct R.DimensionID,D.DimensionName, A.Account_ID DimensionValue  
   from Account A  
   inner join Exchange E on E.code = A.exchange_Code  
   inner join EsteeServers ES on ES.LocationCode = E.LocationCode  
   inner join EsteeApplications EA on EA.EsteeServer_ID = ES.ID  
   inner join RiskControlConfig R on R.applicationID = EA.ApplicationID  
   inner join ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
   inner join StrategyBrokerAccount SBA on SBA.accountID = A.Account_ID  
   inner join Strategy_New SN on SN.SubStrategy_Id = SBA.subStrategyID  
   where A.Status = 'Active'   
   and R.ShouldAggregate = 1   
   and D.DimensionName = 'Account'  
   and SN.Strategy_Status = 1  
   and EA.ApplicationID = @applicationID  
  END  
 END   
   
 select @isGlobal = IsGlobal, @dimValue = DimensionValue  
 from RiskControlConfig R   
    inner join ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
    where ApplicationID = @applicationID and D.DimensionName = 'ClearingAccount'  
  
 IF(@dimValue IS NOT NULL)  
 BEGIN  
  INSERT INTO @dimensionMap  
  SELECT DISTINCT R.DimensionID,D.DimensionName, A.ClearingAccountID DimensionValue   
  FROM Account A   
  INNER JOIN RiskControlConfig R on R.applicationID = @applicationID  
  INNER JOIN ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
  WHERE A.ClearingAccountID in (select * from dbo.Split(@dimValue,',')) and R.ShouldAggregate = 1   
 END  
 ELSE   
 BEGIN  
  IF(@isGlobal = 1) -- GLOBAL  
  BEGIN  
   insert into @dimensionMap  
   select distinct R.DimensionID,D.DimensionName, A.ClearingAccountID DimensionValue  
   from Account A  
   inner join Exchange E on E.code = A.exchange_Code  
   inner join EsteeServers ES on ES.LocationCode = E.LocationCode  
   inner join EsteeApplications EA on EA.EsteeServer_ID = ES.ID  
   inner join RiskControlConfig R on R.applicationID = @applicationID  
   inner join ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
   inner join StrategyBrokerAccount SBA on SBA.accountID = A.Account_ID  
   inner join Strategy_New SN on SN.SubStrategy_Id = SBA.subStrategyID  
   where A.Status = 'Active'   
   and R.ShouldAggregate = 1   
   and D.DimensionName = 'ClearingAccount'  
   and SN.Strategy_Status = 1  
   and EA.ApplicationID in (select ApplicationID from EsteeApplications where appnameid = (select ID from EsteeApplicationNames where ApplicationName = 'Estee.Allocator'))  
  END  
  ELSE  
  BEGIN       
   insert into @dimensionMap  
   select distinct R.DimensionID,D.DimensionName, A.ClearingAccountID DimensionValue  
   from Account A  
   inner join Exchange E on E.code = A.exchange_Code  
   inner join EsteeServers ES on ES.LocationCode = E.LocationCode  
   inner join EsteeApplications EA on EA.EsteeServer_ID = ES.ID  
   inner join RiskControlConfig R on R.applicationID = EA.ApplicationID  
   inner join ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
   inner join StrategyBrokerAccount SBA on SBA.accountID = A.Account_ID  
   inner join Strategy_New SN on SN.SubStrategy_Id = SBA.subStrategyID  
   where A.Status = 'Active'   
   and R.ShouldAggregate = 1   
   and D.DimensionName = 'ClearingAccount'  
   and SN.Strategy_Status = 1  
   and EA.ApplicationID = @applicationID  
  END  
 END     
  
 --Fund  
 select @dimValue = DimensionValue   
 from RiskControlCOnfig R  
 inner join ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
 where ApplicationID = @applicationID and D.DimensionName = 'Fund'   
  
 if(@dimValue IS NULL)  
 BEGIN  
  insert into @dimensionMap  
  select distinct R.DimensionID, D.DimensionName, F.id DimensionValue  
  from InvestmentFund F  
  inner join RiskControlConfig R on R.applicationID = @applicationID  
  inner join ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID   
  where R.ShouldAggregate = 1   
  and D.DimensionName = 'Fund'  
 END  
 ELSE  
 BEGIN  
  insert into @dimensionMap  
  SELECT distinct R.DimensionID, D.DimensionName, F.id  DimensionValue  
  FROM InvestmentFund F   
  INNER JOIN RiskControlConfig R on R.applicationID = @applicationID  
  INNER JOIN ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
  WHERE F.id in (select * from dbo.Split(@dimValue,',')) and R.ShouldAggregate = 1   
 END  
  
 --StrategyGroup  
 select @dimValue = DimensionValue   
 from RiskControlCOnfig R  
 inner join ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
 where ApplicationID = @applicationID and D.DimensionName = 'StrategyGroup'  
  
 if(@dimValue IS NULL)  
 BEGIN  
  insert into @dimensionMap  
  select distinct R.DimensionID, D.DimensionName, SN.Strategy_Id  
  from Strategy_New SN  
  inner join RiskControlConfig R on R.applicationID = @applicationID  
  inner join ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID   
  where R.ShouldAggregate = 1   
  and D.DimensionName = 'StrategyGroup'  
 END  
 ELSE  
 BEGIN  
  insert into @dimensionMap  
  SELECT distinct R.DimensionID, D.DimensionName, SN.Strategy_Id  DimensionValue  
  FROM Strategy_New SN  
  INNER JOIN RiskControlConfig R on R.applicationID = @applicationID  
  INNER JOIN ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
  WHERE SN.Strategy_Id in (select * from dbo.Split(@dimValue,',')) and R.ShouldAggregate = 1   
 END  
    
 --StrategyOwner    
 select @dimValue = DimensionValue from RiskControlCOnfig R  
 inner join ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
 where ApplicationID = @applicationID and D.DimensionName = 'StrategyOwner'  
   
 if(@dimValue IS NULL)  
 BEGIN  
  insert into @dimensionMap  
  select distinct R.DimensionID, D.DimensionName, SN.ownerUserID  
  from Strategy_New SN  
  inner join RiskControlConfig R on R.applicationID = @applicationID  
  inner join ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID   
  where R.ShouldAggregate = 1   
  and D.DimensionName = 'StrategyOwner'  
 END  
 ELSE  
 BEGIN  
  insert into @dimensionMap  
  SELECT distinct R.DimensionID, D.DimensionName, SN.ownerUserID  DimensionValue  
  FROM Strategy_New SN  
  INNER JOIN RiskControlConfig R on R.applicationID = @applicationID  
  INNER JOIN ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
  WHERE SN.ownerUserID in (select * from dbo.Split(@dimValue,',')) and R.ShouldAggregate = 1   
 END  
  
 --StrategyAccountGroup    
 select @dimValue = DimensionValue from RiskControlCOnfig R  
 inner join ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
 where ApplicationID = @applicationID and D.DimensionName = 'StrategyCategory'  
  
 if(@dimValue IS NULL)  
 BEGIN  
  insert into @dimensionMap  
  select distinct R.DimensionID, D.DimensionName, sc.ID  
  from StrategyCategory sc  
  inner join RiskControlConfig R on R.applicationID = @applicationID  
  inner join ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID   
  where R.ShouldAggregate = 1   
  and D.DimensionName = 'StrategyCategory'  
 END  
 ELSE  
 BEGIN  
  insert into @dimensionMap  
  SELECT distinct R.DimensionID, D.DimensionName, sc.ID DimensionValue  
  FROM StrategyCategory sc  
  INNER JOIN RiskControlConfig R on R.applicationID = @applicationID  
  INNER JOIN ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
  WHERE sc.ID in (select * from dbo.Split(@dimValue,',')) and R.ShouldAggregate = 1   
 END  
  
 --StrategyCategoryAccount    
 select @dimValue = DimensionValue from RiskControlCOnfig R  
 inner join ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
 where ApplicationID = @applicationID and D.DimensionName = 'StrategyCategoryClearingAccount'  
  
 if(@dimValue IS NULL)  
 BEGIN  
  insert into @dimensionMap  
  select distinct R.DimensionID, D.DimensionName, cast(sc.id AS varchar(10)) + '_' + cast(ca.ClearingAccountID AS varchar(10)) DimensionValue  
  from dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount sba  
  INNER JOIN Strategy_new sn ON sba.subStrategyID=sn.SubStrategy_Id  
  INNER JOIN dbo.StrategyGroup sg ON sn.Strategy_Id=sg.StrategyID  
  INNER JOIN dbo.StrategyCategory sc ON sg.CategoryID = sc.ID  
  INNER JOIN dbo.Account a ON sba.accountID = a.Account_ID AND a.Status='Active'  
  INNER JOIN dbo.ClearingAccount ca ON a.ClearingAccountID=ca.ClearingAccountID   
  inner join RiskControlConfig R on R.applicationID = @applicationID  
  inner join ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID   
  where R.ShouldAggregate = 1   
  and D.DimensionName = 'StrategyCategoryClearingAccount'  
 END  
 ELSE  
 BEGIN  
  insert into @dimensionMap  
  SELECT distinct R.DimensionID, D.DimensionName,cast(sc.id AS varchar(10)) + '_' + cast(ca.ClearingAccountID AS varchar(10)) DimensionValue  
  from dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount sba  
  INNER JOIN Strategy_new sn ON sba.subStrategyID=sn.SubStrategy_Id  
  INNER JOIN dbo.StrategyGroup sg ON sn.Strategy_Id=sg.StrategyID  
  INNER JOIN dbo.StrategyCategory sc ON sg.CategoryID = sc.ID  
  INNER JOIN dbo.Account a ON sba.accountID = a.Account_ID AND a.Status='Active'  
  INNER JOIN dbo.ClearingAccount ca ON a.ClearingAccountID=ca.ClearingAccountID  
  INNER JOIN RiskControlConfig R on R.applicationID = @applicationID  
  INNER JOIN ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
  WHERE cast(sc.id AS varchar(10)) + '_' + cast(ca.ClearingAccountID AS varchar(10)) in (select * from dbo.Split(@dimValue,',')) and R.ShouldAggregate = 1   
 END  
  
 --Legal ENtity  
 select @dimValue = DimensionValue   
 from RiskControlCOnfig R  
 inner join ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
 where ApplicationID = @applicationID and D.DimensionName = 'LegalEntity'   
  
 if(@dimValue IS NULL)  
 BEGIN  
  insert into @dimensionMap  
  select distinct R.DimensionID, D.DimensionName, LE.LegalEntityId DimensionValue  
  from LegalEntity LE  
  inner join RiskControlConfig R on R.applicationID = @applicationID  
  inner join ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID   
  where R.ShouldAggregate = 1   
  and D.DimensionName = 'LegalEntity'  
 END  
 ELSE  
 BEGIN  
  insert into @dimensionMap  
  SELECT distinct R.DimensionID, D.DimensionName, LE.LegalEntityId  DimensionValue  
  FROM LegalEntity LE    
  INNER JOIN RiskControlConfig R on R.applicationID = @applicationID  
  INNER JOIN ParameterDimension D on D.DimensionId = R.DimensionID  
  WHERE LE.LegalEntityId in (select * from dbo.Split(@dimValue,',')) and R.ShouldAggregate = 1   
 END  
  
 select distinct * from @dimensionMap    
  
 EXEC GetUserStrategy  
  
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetAllCashPositions

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetAllCashPositions]  
@currentDate datetime = null,  
@lastWorkingDate datetime = null,
@listexchange varchar(500) = null  
AS                        

BEGIN      
 DECLARE @usePositionTable BIT
 
-- Creating temp table to store all the cash positions for the given date only.          
   DECLARE @TempDailyPositions TABLE(ExchangeCode char(2), SecurityName nvarchar(75), Long int, Short int,           
   TransactionCost decimal(20,4), Account_ID int, SecurityType nvarchar(30), Estee_ID nvarchar(50),           
   Sub_StrategyID  varchar(5), Broker_ID int, PositionDate datetime, AverageTradedPrice decimal(20,4),           
   BuyValue decimal(20,4), SellValue decimal(20,4))        

	DECLARE @localExchangeCode TABLE(ExchangeCode char(2))  
	IF(@listexchange is null OR @listexchange = '') BEGIN        
		INSERT into @localExchangeCode values ('IS')  
		INSERT into @localExchangeCode values ('IB')       
	END ELSE BEGIN        
		INSERT into @localExchangeCode SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) from dbo.split(@listexchange,',')        
	END    
    
 
 IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 * from dailypositions WHERE positiondate = @currentDate AND Exchange_Code in (select Exchange_Code from @localExchangeCode))  
 BEGIN
      IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 * from dailypositions WHERE positiondate = @lastWorkingDate AND Exchange_Code in (select Exchange_Code from @localExchangeCode))
      BEGIN set @usePositionTable = 1 END
 END
 
 IF @usePositionTable = 1
 BEGIN
	select isnull(dp.Exchange_Code,dp1.Exchange_Code) Exchange_Code ,
		ISNULL(dp.SecurityName,dp1.SecurityName) SecurityName,
		isnull(dp.Long,0) - isnull(dp1.Long,0) Long, 
		isnull(dp.Short,0) - isnull(dp1.Short,0) Short, 
		isnull(dp.TransactionCost,0) - isnull(dp1.TransactionCost,0) TransactionCost, 
		isnull(dp.Account_ID,dp1.Account_ID) Account_ID, 
		isnull(dp.SecurityType,dp1.SecurityType) SecurityType,              
		isnull(dp.Estee_ID,dp1.Estee_ID) Estee_ID, 
		isnull(dp.Sub_StrategyID,dp1.Sub_StrategyID) Sub_StrategyID, 
		isnull(dp.Broker_ID,dp1.Broker_ID) Broker_ID, 
		@currentDate PositionDate,
		(((isnull(dp.BuyValue,0) - isnull(dp1.BuyValue,0)) - (isnull(dp.SellValue,0) - isnull(dp1.SellValue,0)))/ ((isnull(dp.Long,0) - isnull(dp1.Long,0))-(isnull(dp.Short,0) - isnull(dp1.Short,0)) )) AverageTradedPrice,
		isnull(dp.BuyValue,0) - isnull(dp1.BuyValue,0) BuyValue, 
		isnull(dp.SellValue,0) - isnull(dp1.SellValue,0) SellValue
	from
		(select * 
			 from DailyPositions d
			 INNER JOIN @localExchangeCode l on l.ExchangeCode = d.Exchange_Code  
			 where PositionDate = @currentDate
			 and SecurityType = 'EQUITYSPOT'			 
		) dp
	full join
		(select *
			from DailyPositions d1
			INNER JOIN @localExchangeCode l on l.ExchangeCode = d1.Exchange_Code  
			where PositionDate = @lastWorkingDate
			and SecurityType = 'EQUITYSPOT'
		) dp1
	on (dp.Estee_ID = dp1.Estee_ID
	and dp.Account_ID = dp1.Account_ID
	and dp.Sub_StrategyID = dp1.Sub_StrategyID
	and dp.Broker_ID = dp1.Broker_ID)  
	where ISNULL((dp.Long - dp.Short),0)-ISNULL((dp1.Long - dp1.Short),0)<>0
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
    
--declare @rowsCount int        
  INSERT INTO @TempDailyPositions(ExchangeCode, SecurityName, Long, Short, TransactionCost, Account_ID, SecurityType,              
  Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, PositionDate, AverageTradedPrice, BuyValue, SellValue)        

  Select MIN(X.ExchangeCode) as ExchangeCode, MIN(SecurityName) AS SecurityName, sum(Long) AS Long, sum(Short) AS Short,           
  SUM(Total_TC) AS TransactionCost, Account_ID AS Account_ID, MIN(ST.TypeName) AS SecurityType,           
  X.Estee_ID AS Estee_ID, X.Sub_StrategyID, X.BROKER_ID, @currentDate AS PositionDate,           
  AVG(ATP) AS AverageTradedPrice,  (AVG(ATP) * sum(Long)) AS BuyValue,           
  (AVG(ATP) * sum(Short)) AS SellValue        
  FROM (           
  SELECT          
  Min(ISNULL(E.Exchange_Code, EA.Exchange_Code)) as ExchangeCode,
  Min(ISNULL(E.Underlying_Ticker, EA.Underlying_Ticker)) as Underlying_Ticker,          
  MIN(Tra.Estee_ID) AS Estee_ID,          
  MIN(ISNULL(ISNULL(E.DataFeed_Ticker, EA.DataFeed_Ticker), dbo.GetDatePartNameForEsteeID(Tra.Estee_ID))) AS SecurityName,          
  MIN(Ord.Sub_Strategy_ID)  as Sub_StrategyID,          
  sum(case buy_sell_indicator when 1 then Tra.Traded_Quantity else 0 end) Long,           
  sum(case buy_sell_indicator when 2 then Tra.Traded_Quantity else 0 end) Short,          
  Avg(Traded_Price) ATP,          
  CASE SUM(Tra.Traded_Quantity)          
  WHEN 0 THEN          
  0          
  ELSE          
  Sum(case buy_sell_indicator when 1 then Tra.Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price else - Tra.Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price end)/sum(case Tra.buy_sell_indicator when 1 then Tra.Traded_Quantity else Tra.Traded_Quantity end)           
  END          
  AS Traded_Price,           
  0 AS Total_Money_Deployed,           
  SUM(Tra.Transaction_Cost) Total_TC,           
  MIN(Convert(VARCHAR(20), OrdTra.creation_time, 112)) as Date,          
  MIN(Convert(VARCHAR(20), OrdTra.creation_time, 113)) As Trade_Date,          
  Tra.trade_ID AS TradeID,          
  MIN(B.BROKER_ID) AS BROKER_ID,          
  Min(B.Broker_Name) AS BrokerName,           
  MIN(A.Account_ID) AS Account_ID,          
  MIN(case buy_sell_indicator when 2 then 'SHORT' else 'LONG' end) AS Side,          
  MIN(ISNULL(E.ISIN, EA.ISIN)) AS ISIN          
  FROM           
  [Order] Ord WITH (NOLOCK) 
  INNER JOIN OrderTrades OrdTra WITH (NOLOCK) ON Ord.Order_ID = OrdTra.Order_ID and Ord.Creation_Date = OrdTra.Creation_Date         
  INNER JOIN Trades Tra WITH (NOLOCK) ON OrdTra.OrderTrade_ID = Tra.OrderTrade_ID and OrdTra.Order_ID = Tra.Order_ID and OrdTra.Creation_Date = Tra.Creation_Date                    
  INNER JOIN Broker B ON Ord.Broker_ID = B.Broker_ID           
  INNER JOIN ACCOUNT A ON ISNULL(Ord.Account_ID, 1) = A.Account_ID          
  LEFT OUTER JOIN ESTEEMASTER E ON E.Estee_ID =  Tra.Estee_ID  and E.Status=1
  LEFT OUTER JOIN EsteeMaster_archive EA ON EA.Estee_ID =  Tra.Estee_ID  and EA.Status = 1
  WHERE datediff(dd, OrdTra.creation_Date, @currentDate) = 0  
  AND (len(Tra.Estee_ID) < 17 AND OrdTra.creation_Date >= '10-30-2009' )  
  AND OrdTra.status IN ('Executed', 'Partially Filled')        
  GROUP BY Tra.Trade_ID          
  ) X            
  inner join SecurityType ST ON ST.TypeCode = substring(X.Estee_ID, 15, 2)
  INNER JOIN @localExchangeCode l on l.ExchangeCode = x.ExchangeCode   
  GROUP BY X.Broker_ID, X.Account_ID, X.Estee_ID, X.Sub_StrategyID           
  ORDER BY MIN(SecurityName)        
    
 select ExchangeCode, SecurityName, Long, Short, TransactionCost, Account_ID, SecurityType,         
 Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, PositionDate, AverageTradedPrice, BuyValue, SellValue    
 from @TempDailyPositions where datediff(dd, positiondate, @currentDate) = 0 AND (Long - Short) <> 0 
 END
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetAllClearingAccounts

```sql
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetAllClearingAccounts]
AS
     BEGIN
         DECLARE @AccId TABLE(AccId  INT, Active INT);
		 DECLARE @dimensionId INT; 
		 SELECT @dimensionId = PD.DimensionId  
          FROM dbo.ParameterDimension AS PD  
          WHERE PD.DimensionName = 'ClearingAccount';  
         INSERT INTO @AccId
         SELECT DISTINCT
                accountID, 1
         FROM StrategyBrokerAccount sba
              INNER JOIN Strategy_New sn ON sba.subStrategyID = sn.SubStrategy_Id
         WHERE sn.Strategy_Status = 1;
         SELECT ISNULL(a.Account_ID,0) as Account_ID, c.ClearingAccountID, c.ClearingAccountName, c.BaseCurrencyID, c.AvailableBalance, c.haircut, c.loss, c.releasedbalance, 
		 ISNULL(AC.status, 0) AS Active, c.Description, a.exchange_Code AS Exchange_Code,
		c.LegalEntityId, c.BondBalance, c.BondHaircut, c.CashBondMultiplier, c.BrokerBalance, c.FutureAllocation ,c.ClearingExchange,  
		case when cl.dimensionvalue is null then 0 else 1 END AS isColoAggregation , cl.LocationCode, ISNULL(usd.EmailID, '') AS EmailID, ISNULL(usd.CCList, '') AS CCList
         FROM Account a
              RIGHT JOIN ClearingAccount c ON a.ClearingAccountID = c.ClearingAccountID
              LEFT JOIN @AccId temp ON temp.AccId = a.Account_ID
              LEFT JOIN(SELECT ACC.ClearingAccountID, MAX(CASE ACC.Status
                                                              WHEN 'Active'
                                                              THEN 1
                                                              ELSE 0
                                                          END) AS status
                        FROM dbo.Account AS ACC		
               GROUP BY ACC.ClearingAccountID) AS AC ON ac.ClearingAccountID = c.ClearingAccountID
			LEFT JOIN(select * from ColoGroupLevelAggregation where DimensionId = @dimensionId) cl on cl.DimensionValue = c.ClearingAccountID
			LEFT JOIN(select * from UserMappingDetails where DimensionID = @dimensionId) usd on usd.DimensionValue = c.ClearingAccountID
     END;
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetAllIntradayPositionForCM

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Shubham
-- Create date: 2025-02-25
-- Description:	SP to fetch intraday trades for NSE CM EMS in case of intraday restart
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE GetAllIntradayPositionForCM 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@date datetime = NULL,
    @listSubStrategyID varchar(max) = NULL,  -- for set of strategies
    @listexchange varchar(500) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;

	DECLARE @localExchangeCode TABLE (Exchange_Code char(2))
    DECLARE @SubStrategy TABLE (subStrategyID int)

	IF (@listSubStrategyID IS NOT NULL AND @listSubStrategyID != '')
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @SubStrategy 
            SELECT * FROM dbo.split(@listSubStrategyID, ',')
		END

	-- Default exchange is NSE/IS
	IF (@listexchange IS NULL OR @listexchange = '')
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @localExchangeCode 
            SELECT code FROM Exchange e WHERE e.code = 'IS'
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @localExchangeCode 
            SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) FROM dbo.split(@listexchange, ',')
        END

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT 
            X.Exchange_Code,
            MIN(SecurityName) AS SecurityName,
            SUM(Long) AS Long,
            SUM(Short) AS Short,
            SUM(Total_TC) AS TransactionCost,
            Account_ID,
            MIN(ST.TypeName) AS SecurityType,
            X.Estee_ID,
            X.Sub_StrategyID,
            X.BROKER_ID,
            @date AS PositionDate,
            CASE 
                WHEN (SUM(Long) - SUM(Short)) = 0 THEN 0
                ELSE (SUM(Long*Traded_Price) - SUM(Short*Traded_Price))/(SUM(Long) - SUM(Short))
            END AS AverageTradedPrice,
            SUM(Long*Traded_Price) AS BuyValue,
            SUM(Short*Traded_Price) AS SellValue,
            0 AS AverageHoldingPrice
        FROM (
            SELECT
                ISNULL(E.Exchange_Code, '') AS Exchange_Code,
                ISNULL(E.Underlying_Ticker, '') AS Underlying_Ticker,
                Tra.Estee_ID AS Estee_ID,
                ISNULL(E.DataFeed_Ticker, '') AS SecurityName,
                Ord.Sub_Strategy_ID AS Sub_StrategyID,
                CASE buy_sell_indicator WHEN 1 THEN Tra.Traded_Quantity ELSE 0 END AS Long,
                CASE buy_sell_indicator WHEN 2 THEN Tra.Traded_Quantity ELSE 0 END AS Short,
                Tra.Traded_Price,
                0 AS Total_Money_Deployed,
                Tra.Transaction_Cost AS Total_TC,
                CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), OrdTra.creation_time, 112) AS Date,
                CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), OrdTra.creation_time, 113) AS Trade_Date,
                Tra.trade_ID AS TradeID,
                B.BROKER_ID AS BROKER_ID,
                B.Broker_Name AS BrokerName,
                A.Account_ID AS Account_ID,
                CASE buy_sell_indicator WHEN 2 THEN 'SHORT' ELSE 'LONG' END AS Side,
                ISNULL(E.ISIN, '') AS ISIN,
                ISNULL(E.Expiry_Date, '') AS ExpiryDate
            FROM
                [Order] Ord
                INNER JOIN OrderTrades OrdTra ON Ord.Order_ID = OrdTra.Order_ID AND Ord.Creation_Date = OrdTra.Creation_Date
                INNER JOIN Trades Tra ON OrdTra.OrderTrade_ID = Tra.OrderTrade_ID AND OrdTra.Order_ID = Tra.Order_ID AND OrdTra.Creation_Date = Tra.Creation_Date
                INNER JOIN Broker B ON Ord.Broker_ID = B.Broker_ID
                INNER JOIN ACCOUNT A ON ISNULL(Ord.Account_ID, 1) = A.Account_ID
                INNER JOIN @SubStrategy ss ON ss.subStrategyID = Ord.Sub_Strategy_ID
                LEFT OUTER JOIN ESTEEMASTER E ON E.Estee_ID = Tra.Estee_ID AND E.Status = 1
            WHERE 
                DATEDIFF(dd, OrdTra.Creation_Date, @date) = 0
                AND OrdTra.status IN ('Executed', 'Partially Filled')
				AND Tra.ApplyTC = 1
        ) X
        INNER JOIN SecurityType ST ON ST.TypeCode = SUBSTRING(X.Estee_ID, 15, 2)
        INNER JOIN @localExchangeCode l ON l.Exchange_Code = x.Exchange_Code
        WHERE 
            (LEN(x.estee_id) = 16)
        GROUP BY 
            X.Exchange_Code, X.Broker_ID, X.Account_ID, X.Sub_StrategyID, X.Estee_ID
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetAllLinkedOrdersForGivenDateRange

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetAllLinkedOrdersForGivenDateRange]                
@fromDate datetime = null,  
@toDate datetime = null  
AS                
BEGIN       
SELECT   
 MIN(E.DataFeed_Ticker) AS DataFeed_Ticker,  
 ISNULL(Sum(link.LockedProfit) / count(LinkID), 0) AS Total_Locked_Profit,   
 ISNULL(SUM(link.RealizedProfit) / count(LinkID), 0) AS Total_Realised_Profit,   
 ISNULL(SUM(link.LockedProfit + link.RealizedProfit - link.TransactionCost) / count(LinkID), 0) AS NetProfit,   
 ISNULL(SUM(link.TransactionCost) / count(LinkID), 0) AS Total_TC,   
 Account_ID,   
 MIN((case    
  When SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 15, 2) in ('05', '06','07') then SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 0, 15) + '04'   
  When SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 15, 2) in ('01', '02','03')  then SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 0, 15) + '00'  
  End))   
  AS Estee_ID,   
 OrdTra.Sub_Strategy_ID AS SubStrategy_ID,   
 Broker_ID,  
 Ord.Link_ID,  
 ISNULL(link.PositionStatus, 'Closed')  As Position_Status,   
 min(OrdTra.Creation_Time) AS TradeDate   
 FROM tblLinkOrders link 
 INNER JOIN [Order] Ord ON link.LinkID = Ord.Link_ID and Ord.Creation_Date >= @fromDate and Ord.Creation_Date < @toDate
 INNER JOIN OrderTrades OrdTra ON Ord.Order_ID = OrdTra.Order_ID and Ord.Creation_Date = OrdTra.Creation_Date  
 INNER JOIN Trades Tra ON OrdTra.OrderTrade_ID = Tra.OrderTrade_ID and OrdTra.Order_ID = Tra.Order_ID and OrdTra.Creation_Date = Tra.Creation_Date  
 INNER JOIN esteemaster E ON SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 1, 12) = SUBSTRING(E.Estee_ID,0,13)
 WHERE E.Status = 1 and E.Exchange_code='IS' and OrdTra.Creation_Date >= @fromDate and OrdTra.Creation_Date < @toDate  
 AND OrdTra.status  IN ('Executed', 'Partially Filled')  
 AND SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 15, 2) NOT IN ('00', '04')  
 GROUP BY Ord.Broker_ID, Ord.Link_ID, SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 0, 15), Account_ID,  
 OrdTra.Sub_Strategy_ID, link.PositionStatus  
 UNION  
 SELECT  
 MIN(E.DataFeed_Ticker) AS DataFeed_Ticker,  
 0 AS Total_Locked_Profit,   
 sum(traded_quantity*traded_price*(case buy_sell_indicator when 1 then -1 else 1 end) ) AS Total_Realised_Profit,   
 sum(traded_quantity*traded_price*(case buy_sell_indicator when 1 then -1 else 1 end) ) AS NetProfit,  
 sum(transaction_cost) AS Total_TC,   
 Account_id,   
 Tra.Estee_ID,   
 OrdTra.Sub_Strategy_ID,   
 Broker_ID,  
 Ord.Link_ID AS Link_ID,  
 'Closed' AS Position_Status, --As by default all the positions in the dir are closed.  
 min(convert(varchar, OrdTra.Creation_Time, 112)) AS Date  
 FROM  
 tblLinkOrders link WITH (NOLOCK) 
 INNER JOIN [Order] Ord WITH (NOLOCK) ON link.LinkID = Ord.Link_ID and Ord.Creation_Date >= @fromDate and Ord.Creation_Date < @toDate   
 INNER JOIN OrderTrades OrdTra WITH (NOLOCK) ON Ord.Order_ID = OrdTra.Order_ID and Ord.Creation_Date = OrdTra.Creation_Date   
 INNER JOIN Trades Tra WITH (NOLOCK) ON OrdTra.OrderTrade_ID = Tra.OrderTrade_ID and OrdTra.Order_ID = Tra.Order_ID and OrdTra.Creation_Date = Tra.Creation_Date   
 INNER JOIN esteemaster E ON tra.Estee_ID = E.Estee_ID  
 where E.Status=1 and E.Exchange_code='IS' and OrdTra.Creation_Date >= @fromDate and OrdTra.Creation_Date < @toDate --datediff(dd, Creation_Time, '08-26-2009') = 0  
 AND OrdTra.status IN ('Executed','Partially Filled')  
 and SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 15, 2) IN ('00', '04')   
 GROUP BY Ord.Broker_ID, Ord.Link_ID, convert(varchar, OrdTra.Creation_Date, 112), Tra.Estee_ID, Ord.Account_ID,   
 OrdTra.Sub_Strategy_ID  
   
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetAllocatorData

```sql
Create PROCEDURE dbo.GetAllocatorData  
-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here              
   @startDate   DATE,  
   @endDate     DATE,  
   @userId      INT,  
   @dimensionId INT  = NULL,  
   @substrategyList ListString READONLY  
AS  
  BEGIN  
   DECLARE @dimensionValueName TABLE(  
             dimensionId    INT,  
             dimensionValue VARCHAR(50),  
             dimensionName  VARCHAR(255)  
   );  
   INSERT INTO @dimensionValueName  
   EXEC GetNameByDimensionId 
     @dimensionId, @substrategyList;   
	 
	DECLARE @StrategyAccount TABLE(ssId int, accId int)    
	Insert into @StrategyAccount
	SELECT ParseName(Replace(ListItem, '_', '.'), 2) , ParseName(Replace(ListItem, '_', '.'), 1)  FROM   @substrategyList 
   -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from              
   -- interfering with SELECT statements.              
   SET NOCOUNT ON;  
   CREATE TABLE #lastIntraDayDates(  
       exchangeCode VARCHAR(10),  
       asOfDate     DATETIME  
   );  
   INSERT INTO #lastIntraDayDates  
   SELECT Exchange_Code, MAX(date)  
   FROM   AllocatorData  
   WHERE  IsIntraday = 0  
    AND CONVERT(DATE, [Date]) >= CONVERT(DATE, @startdate)  
    AND CONVERT(DATE, [Date]) <= CONVERT(DATE, @enddate)  
   GROUP BY Exchange_Code, CONVERT(DATE, [Date]);  
   SELECT CONVERT(DATE, [Date]) AS Date, AD.Strategy_Id AS ID, AD.Account_Id AS Account_ID, dv.dimensionName AS Name, AD.ParentDimensionValue, c.CurrencyCode AS Currency, AD.Mandate AS [Margin Mandate], MoneyDeployed AS [MTD Money Deployed], ExpiryPnL AS 
  
[MTD ExpiryPnl], SquareOffPnL AS [MTD SqOffPnl], DailySqOffPnL AS [FTD SqOffPnl], DailyExpiryPnL AS [FTD ExpiryPnl], TransactionCost AS [MTD TxCost], OptionsPayOut AS [MTD Option Payout], CashPayOut AS [MTD Cash Payout], FutMTM AS [MTD future MTM], Margin
  
 AS Margin, TplusX AS [Margin(T+x)], CashGamma AS [Cash Gamma], CashDelta AS [Cash Delta], TurnOver AS [FTD Turnover], MaxDrawDown AS [MTD MDD], PerDayBrokerage AS [FTD Brokerage], EsteeMargin, AD.BEPnL AS [MTD BE PNL], AD.DailyBEPnL AS [FTD BE PNL], AD.ModelPnL AS [MTD Model PnL], AD.DailyModelPnL AS [FTD Model PnL],  
  AD.ESTPlusOne, AD.ESTPlusFive, AD.ESMAX, AD.LRTPlusOne, AD.LRTPlusFive, AD.LRMAX, AD.ConversionRate, AD.ParentDimensionID, AD.Rebate,AD.FTDMoneyDeployed,AD.DimensionValue AS [Dimension Value],AD.GrossExposure as [Gross Exposure]  ,AD.MISCCharges  
   ,AD.PremiumTurnover AS [FTD Premium Turnover],AD.FTDNetCashPayout as [FTD Net CashPayout]  
   FROM   AllocatorData AS AD  
    INNER JOIN #lastIntraDayDates AS LIDD ON AD.Exchange_Code = LIDD.exchangeCode  
               AND AD.Date = LIDD.asOfDate  
    INNER JOIN @dimensionValueName AS dv ON AD.DimensionValue = dv.dimensionValue  
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Currency AS c ON AD.Currency = c.ID  
   WHERE  AD.IsIntraday = 0  
    AND ad.DimensionTypeID = ISNULL(@dimensionId, ad.DimensionTypeID)  
   ORDER BY date, id;  
  END  


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetAllocatorIPForStrategy

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Megha Goel
-- Create date: 30 August, 2013
-- Description:	Get Allocator IP corresponding to EMS
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetAllocatorIPForStrategy] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@substrategyId int
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select ES1.ip
    from EsteeApplications EA
    inner join EsteeApplications EA1 on EA.EMS_Application_ID = EA1.ApplicationID and EA.SubStrategy_ID = @substrategyId
    inner join EsteeServers ES on EA1.EsteeServer_ID = ES.ID
    inner join EsteeServers ES1 on ES.LocationCode = ES1.LocationCode
    inner join EsteeApplications EA2 on EA2.EsteeServer_ID = ES1.ID and EA2.ApplicationName ='ALLOCATOR'  

END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetAllPositionsForGivenDate

```sql
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetAllPositionsForGivenDate]                              
 @date datetime = null,           
 @isAllPositions bit = 1,  
 @listSubStrategyID varchar(max)  = null,  -- for set of strategies   
 @listexchange varchar(500) = null,    
 @useDailyPositionsTable bit = 0,  --do not calculate the position from the trades, force usage of table  
 @strategystatuscheck bit = 0,   
 @applicationID int = -1  
AS                              
    
BEGIN         
 SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;    
    
 DECLARE @localExchangeCode TABLE(Exchange_Code char(2))        
 DECLARE @local_TempExpiryDates TABLE(ExpiryDate datetime)  
 DECLARE @SubStrategy TABLE(subStrategyID int)  
   
  
 IF @isAllPositions = 1 BEGIN         
   EXEC GetAllPositionsForGivenDateAndParameters @date,'','',@listSubStrategyID,'', @listexchange, @useDailyPositionsTable, @strategystatuscheck, @applicationID  
 END  
     
 ELSE  BEGIN -- get positions for a specific date only not up to the given date     
   
 IF (@applicationID <= 0) AND (@listSubStrategyID is null OR @listSubStrategyID = '') BEGIN  
  INSERT INTO @SubStrategy SELECT DISTINCT SubStrategy_Id FROM Strategy_New WHERE Strategy_Status IN (1, case @strategystatuscheck when 0 then 0 else 1 end)  
 END ELSE IF (@applicationID > 0) BEGIN  
  INSERT into @SubStrategy   
  exec GetStrategiesByApplicationID @applicationID, @strategystatuscheck     
 END ELSE BEGIN                      
  INSERT into @SubStrategy SELECT * from dbo.split(@listSubStrategyID,',')                      
 END   
   
   IF(@listexchange is null OR @listexchange = '')  BEGIN              
     insert into @localExchangeCode select code from Exchange    
   END ELSE BEGIN              
     INSERT into @localExchangeCode SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) from dbo.split(@listexchange,',')              
   END     
         
     INSERT INTO @local_TempExpiryDates(ExpiryDate)      
     select EXPIRY_DATE from fnGetExpiry(cast(convert(varchar,@date,110) as datetime)) order by EXPIRY_DATE asc      
    
     Select X.Exchange_Code,MIN (SecurityName) SecurityName,       
     sum(Long) AS Long,       
     sum(Short) AS Short,           
     SUM(Total_TC) AS TransactionCost,       
     Account_ID,      
     MIN(ST.TypeName) AS SecurityType,           
     X.Estee_ID,      
     X.Sub_StrategyID,       
     X.BROKER_ID,       
     @date AS PositionDate,           
     CASE (sum(Long) - sum(Short)) WHEN 0 THEN 0      
     ELSE (sum(Long*Traded_Price) - sum(Short*Traded_Price))/(sum(Long) - sum(Short))       
     END AS AverageTradedPrice,          
     sum(Long*Traded_Price) AS BuyValue,           
     sum(Short*Traded_Price) AS SellValue ,      
     0 AS AverageHoldingPrice       
     FROM (           
      SELECT  ISNULL(E.Exchange_Code, EA.Exchange_Code) as Exchange_Code,    
      ISNULL(E.Underlying_Ticker, EA.Underlying_Ticker) as Underlying_Ticker,          
      Tra.Estee_ID AS Estee_ID,          
      ISNULL(E.DataFeed_Ticker, EA.DataFeed_Ticker) AS SecurityName,          
      Ord.Sub_Strategy_ID  as Sub_StrategyID,          
      case buy_sell_indicator when 1 then Tra.Traded_Quantity else 0 end Long,           
      case buy_sell_indicator when 2 then Tra.Traded_Quantity else 0 end Short,          
      Tra.Traded_Price,          
      0 AS Total_Money_Deployed,           
      Tra.Transaction_Cost AS Total_TC,           
      Convert(VARCHAR(20), OrdTra.creation_time, 112) as Date,          
      Convert(VARCHAR(20), OrdTra.creation_time, 113) As Trade_Date,          
      Tra.trade_ID AS TradeID,          
      B.BROKER_ID AS BROKER_ID,          
      B.Broker_Name AS BrokerName,           
      A.Account_ID AS Account_ID,          
      case buy_sell_indicator when 2 then 'SHORT' else 'LONG' end AS Side,          
      ISNULL(E.ISIN, EA.ISIN) AS ISIN    ,  
   ISNULL(E.Expiry_Date, EA.Expiry_Date) AS ExpiryDate,        
   ISNULL(Ord.Link_ID,-1) as Rule_Id      
      FROM           
      [Order] Ord     
      INNER JOIN OrderTrades OrdTra ON Ord.Order_ID = OrdTra.Order_ID and Ord.Creation_Date = OrdTra.Creation_Date          
      INNER JOIN Trades Tra ON OrdTra.OrderTrade_ID = Tra.OrderTrade_ID and OrdTra.Order_ID = Tra.Order_ID and OrdTra.Creation_Date = Tra.Creation_Date               
      INNER JOIN Broker B ON Ord.Broker_ID = B.Broker_ID           
      INNER JOIN ACCOUNT A ON ISNULL(Ord.Account_ID, 1) = A.Account_ID     
      INNER JOIN @SubStrategy ss ON ss.subStrategyID = Ord.Sub_Strategy_ID        
      LEFT OUTER JOIN ESTEEMASTER E ON E.Estee_ID =  Tra.Estee_ID and  E.Status=1    
      LEFT OUTER JOIN EsteeMaster_archive EA ON EA.Estee_ID =  Tra.Estee_ID  and EA.Status = 1        
      WHERE DateDiff(dd, OrdTra.Creation_Date, @date) = 0   
      AND OrdTra.status IN ('Executed', 'Partially Filled')        
      ) X            
     inner join SecurityType ST ON ST.TypeCode = substring(X.Estee_ID, 15, 2)        
     INNER JOIN @localExchangeCode l on l.Exchange_Code = x.Exchange_Code       
     WHERE (x.ExpiryDate IN (Select ExpiryDate from @local_TempExpiryDates)                
     OR len(x.estee_id) = 16)       
     GROUP BY X.Exchange_Code,X.Broker_ID, X.Account_ID, X.Sub_StrategyID,X.Rule_Id, X.Estee_ID              
      
  END     
END    
  
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetAllPositionsForGivenDateAndParameters

```sql

Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetAllPositionsForGivenDateAndParameters]                                           
 @date date = null,                            
 @listAccountID varchar(max) = null, -- for set of accounts                             
 @listBrokerID varchar(100)  = null, -- for set of broker accounts                             
 @listSubStrategyID varchar(max)  = null,  -- for set of strategies                          
 @listEsteeID varchar(max) = null,   -- for set of (ISIN)                     
 @listexchange varchar(500) = null,                
 @useDailyPositionsTable bit = 0,  --do not calculate the position from the trades, force usage of table                
 @strategystatuscheck bit = 0,        
 @applicationID int = -1        
AS         
BEGIN                   
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;  
    SET NOCOUNT ON;  
    DECLARE @dateplusone DATETIME  
    DECLARE @Account TABLE(Account_ID int, Exchange_Code varchar(4))  
    DECLARE @Broker TABLE(Broker_ID int)  
    DECLARE @SubStrategy TABLE(SubStrategy_Id int)  
    DECLARE @EsteeTable TABLE(ISIN varchar(50))  
    DECLARE @TempExpiryDates TABLE(ExpiryDate datetime)  
    DECLARE @TempDailyPositions TABLE(Exchange_Code [char](10),SecurityName nvarchar(75), Long bigint, Short bigint,  
                                      TransactionCost decimal(30,10), Account_ID int, SecurityType nvarchar(30), Estee_ID nvarchar(50),  
                                      Sub_StrategyID  varchar(5), Broker_ID int, PositionDate datetime, AverageTradedPrice decimal(30,10),  
                                      BuyValue decimal(30,10), SellValue decimal(30,10),AverageHoldingPrice decimal(30,10),Rule_Id int)  
    DECLARE @ExchangeCode TABLE(Exchange_Code [char](10))  
    IF (@listAccountID is null OR @listAccountID = '') BEGIN  
        INSERT INTO @Account  
             SELECT account_ID,exchange_Code FROM account WITH(NOLOCK)  
    END  
    ELSE BEGIN  
        INSERT INTO @Account  
             SELECT A.items,AC.exchange_Code  
               FROM dbo.split(@listAccountID,',') A  
         INNER JOIN Account AC WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.items = AC.Account_ID  
    END  
    IF(@listBrokerID IS NULL OR @listBrokerID = '') BEGIN  
        INSERT INTO @Broker SELECT broker_ID FROM Broker WITH(NOLOCK)  
    END  
    ELSE BEGIN  
        INSERT INTO @Broker  
             SELECT B.items  
               FROM dbo.split(@listBrokerID,',') B  
         INNER JOIN Broker BR WITH(NOLOCK) ON B.items = BR.Broker_ID  
    END  
    IF (@applicationID <= 0) AND (@listSubStrategyID is null OR @listSubStrategyID = '') BEGIN  
            INSERT INTO @SubStrategy  
        SELECT DISTINCT SubStrategy_Id  
                   FROM Strategy_New WITH(NOLOCK)  
                  WHERE Strategy_Status IN (1, CASE @strategystatuscheck WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)  
    END  
    ELSE IF (@applicationID > 0) BEGIN  
        INSERT INTO @SubStrategy  
               EXEC GetStrategiesByApplicationID @applicationID, @strategystatuscheck  
        DELETE S  
          FROM @SubStrategy S  
     LEFT JOIN Strategy_New SN WITH(NOLOCK) ON S.SubStrategy_Id = SN.SubStrategy_Id  
           AND Strategy_Status IN (1, CASE @strategystatuscheck WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)  
         WHERE SN.SubStrategy_Id IS NULL  
    END  
    ELSE BEGIN  
        INSERT INTO @SubStrategy  
        SELECT S.items  
          FROM dbo.split(@listSubStrategyID,',') S  
    INNER JOIN Strategy_New SN WITH(NOLOCK) ON S.items = SN.SubStrategy_Id  
           AND SN.Strategy_Status IN (1, CASE @strategystatuscheck WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)  
    END  
  
   
  
    IF(@listEsteeID IS NOT NULL AND @listEsteeID <> '') BEGIN  
        INSERT INTO @EsteeTable SELECT * FROM dbo.split(@listEsteeID,',')  
    END  
  
   
  
    IF(@listexchange IS NULL OR @listexchange = '') BEGIN  
        INSERT INTO @ExchangeCode SELECT CODE FROM Exchange WITH(NOLOCK)  
    END  
  
   
  
    ELSE BEGIN  
        INSERT INTO @ExchangeCode  
             SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items))  
            FROM dbo.split(@listexchange,',')  E  
         INNER JOIN Exchange EX WITH(NOLOCK) ON LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) = EX.code  
    END  
    SET @dateplusone = DATEADD(dd, 1,  @date)  
    DECLARE @lastSavedDateTable TABLE(lastSavedDate date, Exchange_Code char(4),bitNeedIncremental BIT)  
    DECLARE @exchangeLevelMaxTradeDate TABLE (Exchange_Code char(4), maxDate Date)  
    DECLARE @minLastSavedDate date  
    INSERT INTO @lastSavedDateTable  
        SELECT COALESCE(MAX(positiondate), DATEADD(dd,-1, @date)) AS lastSavedDate,EC.Exchange_Code,  
               CASE WHEN MAX(positiondate) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(positiondate) <> @date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END  
         FROM @ExchangeCode EC  
    LEFT JOIN DailyPositions dp WITH(NOLOCK) on dp.Exchange_Code = EC.Exchange_Code and dp.PositionDate <=@date  
     GROUP BY EC.Exchange_Code  
  
   
  
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @lastSavedDateTable WHERE bitNeedIncremental = 1) AND @useDailyPositionsTable = 0  
    BEGIN  
        SELECT @minLastSavedDate = MIN(lastSavedDate) FROM @lastSavedDateTable  
        INSERT INTO @exchangeLevelMaxTradeDate  
             SELECT EC.exchange_Code, MAX(creation_date)  
               FROM @Account a  
         INNER JOIN [Order] o WITH(NOLOCK) ON o.Account_ID = a.Account_ID  
         INNER JOIN @ExchangeCode EC ON EC.Exchange_Code = A.exchange_Code  
              WHERE o.Creation_Date > @minLastSavedDate  
           GROUP BY EC.Exchange_Code  
           UPDATE LST  
              SET bitNeedIncremental =0  
             FROM @lastSavedDateTable LST  
        LEFT JOIN @exchangeLevelMaxTradeDate E ON LST.Exchange_Code = E.Exchange_Code  
            WHERE E.Exchange_Code IS NULL OR E.maxDate <= LST.lastSavedDate  
    END  
  
   
  
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @lastSavedDateTable WHERE bitNeedIncremental =1) OR @useDailyPositionsTable = 1 -- dont need incremental data, just get the position from the daily position  
    BEGIN  
        INSERT INTO @TempDailyPositions(Exchange_Code,SecurityName, Long, Short, TransactionCost, Account_ID, SecurityType,  
                                    Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, PositionDate, AverageTradedPrice, BuyValue,  
                                    SellValue,AverageHoldingPrice,Rule_Id)  
             SELECT dp.Exchange_Code,SecurityName, Long, Short, TransactionCost, dp.Account_ID, SecurityType, Estee_ID,  
                    Sub_StrategyID, dp.Broker_ID, PositionDate, AverageTradedPrice, BuyValue, SellValue ,AverageHoldingPrice  ,dp.Rule_ID
               FROM dailypositions dp WITH(NOLOCK)  
         INNER JOIN @Account A ON dp.Account_ID = A.Account_ID  
         INNER JOIN @SubStrategy sn ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = dp.Sub_StrategyID  
         INNER JOIN @Broker B ON dp.Broker_ID = B.Broker_ID  
         INNER JOIN @lastSavedDateTable LST ON dp.exchange_Code = LST.exchange_Code AND dp.PositionDate = LST.lastSavedDate  
    END  
    ELSE BEGIN --get combined position from dailyposition and trade  
        SELECT @minLastSavedDate = MIN(lastsaveddate) FROM @lastSavedDateTable WHERE bitNeedIncremental =1  
        INSERT INTO @TempDailyPositions(Exchange_Code,SecurityName, Long, Short, TransactionCost, Account_ID, SecurityType,  
                    Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, PositionDate, AverageTradedPrice, BuyValue, SellValue,AverageHoldingPrice,Rule_Id)  
        --get position from trades > lastsavedposition  
          SELECT Exchange_Code, MIN(Y.SecurityName) as SecurityName, SUM(Y.Long) AS Long, SUM(Y.Short) AS Short, SUM(Y.TransactionCost) AS TransactionCost,  
                 Y.Account_ID, Y.SecurityType, Y.Estee_ID, Y.Sub_StrategyID, Y.BROKER_ID, @date AS PositionDate,  
                 CASE (SUM(y.Long - y.Short)) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(BuyValue + SellValue )/SUM(y.long + y.short) 
                 END AS averagetradedprice,  
                 SUM(BuyValue) as BuyValue, SUM(SellValue) AS SellValue, 0 AS AverageHoldingPrice  , Y.Rule_Id
            FROM (  
                    SELECT Exchange_Code, MIN(X.SecurityName) as SecurityName, SUM(Long) AS Long, SUM(Short) AS Short, SUM(Total_TC) AS TransactionCost,  
                           Account_ID , MIN(ST.TypeName) AS SecurityType, X.Estee_ID , X.Sub_StrategyID, BROKER_ID, @date AS PositionDate,  
                           CASE (SUM(Long) - SUM(Short)) WHEN 0 THEN 0  
                           ELSE (SUM(Long*Traded_Price) + SUM(Short*Traded_Price))/(SUM(Long) + SUM(Short)) END AS AverageTradedPrice,  
                           SUM(Long*Traded_Price) AS BuyValue, SUM(Short*Traded_Price) AS SellValue, 0 AS AverageHoldingPrice  , X.Rule_Id
                      FROM (  
                                SELECT ISNULL(E.Exchange_Code, EA.Exchange_Code) AS Exchange_Code, Tra.Estee_ID AS Estee_ID,  
                                       ISNULL(E.DataFeed_Ticker, EA.DataFeed_Ticker) AS SecurityName,  
                                       Ord.Sub_Strategy_ID  AS Sub_StrategyID,  
                                       CASE buy_sell_indicator WHEN 1 THEN Tra.Traded_Quantity ELSE 0 END Long,  
                                       CASE buy_sell_indicator WHEN 2 THEN Tra.Traded_Quantity ELSE 0 END Short,  
            CASE When ISNULL(E.Exchange_Code, EA.Exchange_Code) = 'BR' AND  CONVERT(int,substring(ISNULL(E.Estee_ID, EA.Estee_ID), 15, 2)) in (35,36) THEN  
          Power(10,5)/Power(1 + (Tra.Traded_Price)*1.0/100, CAST(dbo.GetTradingHolidaysUsingBankingTable(OrdTra.Creation_Date  ,   
          cast(isnull(E.Expiry_Date,EA.Expiry_Date) as date),ISNULL(E.Exchange_Code, EA.Exchange_Code),'CD','T') as FLOAT)/252)   
          ELSE Tra.Traded_Price end As Traded_Price ,  
            Tra.Transaction_Cost AS Total_TC, B.BROKER_ID AS BROKER_ID, A.Account_ID AS Account_ID,  
                                       CASE buy_sell_indicator WHEN 2 THEN 'SHORT' ELSE 'LONG' END AS Side  ,ISNULL(Ord.Link_ID,-1) as Rule_Id
                                  FROM [Order] Ord WITH(NOLOCK)  
                            INNER JOIN OrderTrades OrdTra WITH(NOLOCK) ON Ord.Creation_Date = OrdTra.Creation_Date  
                                   AND Ord.Order_ID = OrdTra.Order_ID  
                            INNER JOIN Trades Tra WITH(NOLOCK) ON OrdTra.OrderTrade_ID = Tra.OrderTrade_ID  
                                   AND OrdTra.Creation_Date = Tra.Creation_Date and OrdTra.Order_ID = Tra.Order_ID  
                            INNER JOIN @Broker B ON Ord.Broker_ID = B.Broker_ID  
                            INNER JOIN @Account A ON ISNULL(Ord.Account_ID, 1) = A.Account_ID  
                            INNER JOIN @SubStrategy SN ON SN.SubStrategy_Id = Ord.Sub_Strategy_ID  
                            INNER JOIN @lastSavedDateTable LST ON A.exchange_Code = LST.exchange_Code  
                               AND LST.bitNeedIncremental = 1 AND Ord.Creation_Date > LST.lastSavedDate  
                       LEFT OUTER JOIN ESTEEMASTER E WITH(NOLOCK) ON E.Estee_ID =  Tra.Estee_ID   and E.Status=1  
                       LEFT OUTER JOIN EsteeMaster_archive EA WITH(NOLOCK) ON EA.Estee_ID =  Tra.Estee_ID and EA.Status=1  
                                 WHERE OrdTra.Status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and Ord.Creation_Date < @dateplusone  
                                   AND Ord.Creation_Date> @minLastSavedDate  
                                   AND (ISNULL(e.Expiry_Date, ea.Expiry_Date) >= @date OR  
                                       (LEN(Tra.Estee_ID) < 17 AND Ord.creation_Date >= '10-30-2009'))  
                         --for cash trade ********* bcoz of some problem in database we do only for creation_time >= '10-30-2009'  
                            ) X  
                INNER JOIN SecurityType ST WITH(NOLOCK) ON ST.TypeCode = SUBSTRING(X.Estee_ID, 15, 2)  
                  GROUP BY X.Exchange_Code,X.Broker_ID, X.Account_ID, X.Sub_StrategyID, X.Rule_Id, X.Estee_ID 
                 UNION ALL  
                -- saved position  
                    SELECT dp.Exchange_Code,SecurityName, Long, Short, TransactionCost, dp.Account_ID, SecurityType,  
                           Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, dp.Broker_ID, PositionDate, AverageTradedPrice, BuyValue, SellValue ,AverageHoldingPrice  ,Rule_ID
                      FROM dailypositions dp WITH(NOLOCK)  
                INNER JOIN @Account A ON dp.Account_ID = A.Account_ID  
                INNER JOIN @SubStrategy sn ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = dp.Sub_StrategyID  
                INNER JOIN @Broker B ON dp.Broker_ID = B.Broker_ID  
                INNER JOIN @lastSavedDateTable LST ON dp.exchange_Code = LST.exchange_Code and dp.PositionDate = LST.lastSavedDate  
            ) AS Y  
        GROUP BY Y.Exchange_code,Y.Broker_ID, Y.Account_ID, Y.Sub_StrategyID,Y.Rule_Id, Y.Estee_ID, Y.SecurityType  
    END  
    IF(@listEsteeID is not null AND @listEsteeID <> '') BEGIN  
           DELETE T  
             FROM @TempDailyPositions T  
        LEFT JOIN @EsteeTable E ON SUBSTRING(T.Estee_ID, 1, 12) = E.ISIN  
            WHERE E.ISIN is null  
    END  
    SELECT Exchange_code,SecurityName, Long, Short, TransactionCost, Account_ID, SecurityType,  
           Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, PositionDate, AverageTradedPrice, BuyValue, SellValue,AverageHoldingPrice  ,Rule_Id
      FROM @TempDailyPositions  
END   


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetAllPositionsForGivenDateAndParametersIncludingTrades

```sql

Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetAllPositionsForGivenDateAndParametersIncludingTrades]   
 @date date = null,   
 @prevDate date = null,                           
 @listAccountID varchar(max) = null, -- for set of accounts                             
 @listBrokerID varchar(100)  = null, -- for set of broker accounts                             
 @listSubStrategyID varchar(max)  = null,  -- for set of strategies                          
 @listEsteeID varchar(max) = null,   -- for set of (ISIN)                     
 @listexchange varchar(500) = null,                
 @useDailyPositionsTable bit = 0,  --do not calculate the position from the trades, force usage of table                
 @strategystatuscheck bit = 0  
As  
Begin  
 DECLARE @Account TABLE(Account_ID int, Exchange_Code varchar(4))  
 DECLARE @Broker TABLE(Broker_ID int)  
 DECLARE @SubStrategy TABLE(SubStrategy_Id int)  
 DECLARE @ExchangeCode TABLE(Exchange_Code [char](10))  
 IF (@listAccountID is null OR @listAccountID = '') BEGIN  
  INSERT INTO @Account  
    SELECT account_ID,exchange_Code FROM account WITH(NOLOCK)  
 END  
 ELSE BEGIN  
  INSERT INTO @Account  
    SELECT A.items,AC.exchange_Code  
      FROM dbo.split(@listAccountID,',') A  
   INNER JOIN Account AC WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.items = AC.Account_ID  
 END  
 IF(@listBrokerID IS NULL OR @listBrokerID = '') BEGIN  
  INSERT INTO @Broker SELECT broker_ID FROM Broker WITH(NOLOCK)  
 END  
 ELSE BEGIN  
  INSERT INTO @Broker  
    SELECT B.items  
      FROM dbo.split(@listBrokerID,',') B  
   INNER JOIN Broker BR WITH(NOLOCK) ON B.items = BR.Broker_ID  
 END  
 IF (@listSubStrategyID is null OR @listSubStrategyID = '') BEGIN  
   INSERT INTO @SubStrategy  
  SELECT DISTINCT SubStrategy_Id  
       FROM Strategy_New WITH(NOLOCK)  
      WHERE Strategy_Status IN (1, CASE @strategystatuscheck WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)  
 END  
 ELSE BEGIN  
  INSERT INTO @SubStrategy  
  SELECT S.items  
    FROM dbo.split(@listSubStrategyID,',') S  
 INNER JOIN Strategy_New SN WITH(NOLOCK) ON S.items = SN.SubStrategy_Id  
     AND SN.Strategy_Status IN (1, CASE @strategystatuscheck WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)  
 END  
 IF(@listexchange IS NULL OR @listexchange = '') BEGIN  
  INSERT INTO @ExchangeCode SELECT CODE FROM Exchange WITH(NOLOCK)  
 END  
 ELSE BEGIN  
  INSERT INTO @ExchangeCode  
    SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items))  
      FROM dbo.split(@listexchange,',')  E  
   INNER JOIN Exchange EX WITH(NOLOCK) ON LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) = EX.code  
 END  
 CREATE TABLE #TempDailyPositionsForPrevDate(Exchange_Code [CHAR](10), SecurityName NVARCHAR(75), Long INT, Short INT, TransactionCost DECIMAL(30, 10), Account_ID INT, SecurityType NVARCHAR(30), Estee_ID NVARCHAR(50),   
           Sub_StrategyID VARCHAR(5), Broker_ID INT, PositionDate DATETIME, AverageTradedPrice DECIMAL(30, 10), BuyValue DECIMAL(30, 10), SellValue DECIMAL(30, 10), AverageHoldingPrice DECIMAL(30, 10), Rule_Id int);  
 CREATE TABLE #TempDailyPositionsForDate(Long INT, Short INT, Account_ID INT, Estee_ID NVARCHAR(50), Sub_StrategyID VARCHAR(5), PositionDate DATETIME, BuyValue DECIMAL(30, 10), SellValue DECIMAL(30, 10), Rule_Id int);  
 INSERT INTO #TempDailyPositionsForPrevDate  
 EXEC GetAllPositionsForGivenDateAndParameters @prevDate, @listAccountID, @listBrokerID, @listSubStrategyID, @listEsteeID, @listexchange, @useDailyPositionsTable, @strategystatuscheck  
 INSERT INTO #TempDailyPositionsForDate (long, short, Account_ID, Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, PositionDate, BuyValue, SellValue,Rule_Id)  
 SELECT SUM(Y.Long) AS Long, SUM(Y.Short) AS Short, Y.Account_ID,Y.Estee_ID, Y.Sub_StrategyID,  @date AS PositionDate, Sum(y.BuyValue), Sum(y.SellValue)  , Rule_Id
 FROM (SELECT SUM(Long) AS Long, SUM(Short) AS Short,   
 Account_ID, X.Estee_ID, X.Sub_StrategyID,@date AS PositionDate, Sum(BuyValue) as BuyValue, Sum(SellValue) as SellValue , X.Rule_Id
 FROM (SELECT Tra.Estee_ID AS Estee_ID,   
 Ord.Sub_Strategy_ID AS Sub_StrategyID,  
 CASE buy_sell_indicator WHEN 1 THEN Tra.Traded_Quantity ELSE 0 END Long,  
 CASE buy_sell_indicator WHEN 2 THEN Tra.Traded_Quantity ELSE 0 END Short,   
 Tra.Traded_Price,   Ord.Account_ID AS Account_ID,  
 CASE buy_sell_indicator WHEN 2 THEN 'SHORT' ELSE 'LONG' END AS Side,  
 CASE buy_sell_indicator WHEN 1 THEN Tra.Traded_Quantity * Tra.Traded_Price ELSE 0 END BuyValue,  
 CASE buy_sell_indicator WHEN 2 THEN Tra.Traded_Quantity * Tra.Traded_Price ELSE 0 END SellValue  ,
 ISNULL(Ord.Link_ID, -1) as Rule_Id  
 FROM [Order] Ord WITH (NOLOCK)  
 INNER JOIN OrderTrades OrdTra WITH (NOLOCK) ON Ord.Creation_Date = OrdTra.Creation_Date  
 AND Ord.Order_ID = OrdTra.Order_ID  
 INNER JOIN Trades Tra WITH (NOLOCK) ON OrdTra.OrderTrade_ID = Tra.OrderTrade_ID  
 AND OrdTra.Creation_Date = Tra.Creation_Date  
 AND OrdTra.Order_ID = Tra.Order_ID  
 INNER JOIN @Broker B ON Ord.Broker_ID = B.Broker_ID  
 INNER JOIN @Account A ON ISNULL(Ord.Account_ID, 1) = A.Account_ID  
 INNER JOIN @SubStrategy SN ON SN.SubStrategy_Id = Ord.Sub_Strategy_ID  
 LEFT OUTER JOIN ESTEEMASTER E WITH (NOLOCK) ON E.Estee_ID = Tra.Estee_ID AND E.Status = 1  
 LEFT OUTER JOIN EsteeMaster_archive EA WITH (NOLOCK) ON EA.Estee_ID = Tra.Estee_ID AND EA.Status = 1  
 WHERE OrdTra.Status IN('Executed', 'Partially Filled')  
 AND Ord.Creation_Date = @date  
 AND (ISNULL(e.Expiry_Date, ea.Expiry_Date) >= @date   
 OR (LEN(Tra.Estee_ID) < 17  
 AND Ord.creation_Date >= '10-30-2009')  
 )--for cash trade ********* bcoz of some problem in database we do only for creation_time >= '10-30-2009'  
 ) X  
 INNER JOIN SecurityType ST WITH (NOLOCK) ON ST.TypeCode = SUBSTRING(X.Estee_ID, 15, 2)  
 GROUP BY X.Account_ID, X.Sub_StrategyID,X.Rule_Id, X.Estee_ID  
 UNION ALL  
 -- saved position  
 SELECT Long, Short, Account_ID,Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, @date, BuyValue, SellValue, Rule_Id FROM #TempDailyPositionsForPrevDate  
 ) AS Y  
 GROUP BY Y.Account_ID, Y.Sub_StrategyID,Y.Rule_Id,Y.Estee_ID;  
 select * from #TempDailyPositionsForDate      
 drop table #TempDailyPositionsForDate  
 drop table #TempDailyPositionsForPrevDate  
End  



```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetAllRiskLimits

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetAllRiskLimits]    
@DimensionIDList varchar(max)=NULL,  
@dimensionValue varchar(20)=NULL,  
@userID int = NULL    
AS    
BEGIN    
--Declare @DimensionIDList varchar(max) = '1,2,3,6,7,9,11'  
--declare @dimensionValue  varchar(20)=NULL 
-------------------Logic for tempDate and cut off time check--------------------------------------
DECLARE @tempDate DATE = CONVERT(date,getdate())
DECLARE @cutOffTime TIME
DECLARE @tempDateTime TIME = CONVERT(TIME,GETDATE())
DECLARE @minDate DATE = '0001-01-01'
SELECT @cutOffTime = value from datainit where ApplicationID = 0 and Parameter = 'TradeDateCutOffTime'

IF @tempDateTime between '00:00:00' and @cutOffTime
BEGIN
	SET @tempDate = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE() - 1)
END 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DECLARE @Dimension TABLE(dimension_ID int)    
  IF(@DimensionIDList != '')    
  BEGIN  
     INSERT into @Dimension SELECT * from dbo.split(@DimensionIDList,',')  
  END  
  Declare @count INT  
  Select @count = MIN(dimension_ID) from @Dimension  
  While(@count >= 0)  
  BEGIN  
  Declare @DimensionID int  
  Select  top 1 @DimensionID = dimension_ID from @Dimension order by dimension_ID 
  
  select * into #tempRL FROM 
  (
  select 
  isnull(rl.DimensionId, rlOri.DimensionId) DimensionId 
  ,isnull(rl.RiskParamId, rlOri.RiskParamId) RiskParamId
 , isnull(rl.DimensionValue, rlOri.DimensionValue)  DimensionValue
,isnull(rl.RiskParameterValue, rlOri.RiskParameterValue) RiskParameterValue
,isnull(rl.ID, rlOri.ID) ID 
from (select * from RiskLimits where date = @tempDate) rl 
right join
 ( select * from RiskLimits rlOri where Date = @minDate) rlOri 
 on rl.DimensionId = rlOri.DimensionId and rl.DimensionValue = rlOri.DimensionValue and rl.RiskParamId = rlOri.RiskParamId) RiskLimitTab
   
  SELECT RL.DimensionId, DimensionName,RL.DimensionValue, RiskParamName, RiskParameterValue ,RL.ID  
   FROM #tempRL RL inner join RiskParameters RP on  RL.RiskParamId = RP.RiskParamId  
   inner join ParameterDimension pd on RL.Dimensionid = pd.Dimensionid  
   WHERE RL.DimensionID  =  ISNULL(@DimensionID,Rl.Dimensionid)  
   AND RL.DimensionValue = ISNULL(@dimensionValue, RL.DimensionValue)
   
   drop table #tempRL
  
   delete from @Dimension where dimension_ID = @DimensionID  
   Select @count = MIN(dimension_ID) from @Dimension  
  END  
END  


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetAlreadyAccountedTrades

```sql

CREATE procedure [dbo].[GetAlreadyAccountedTrades]  
@runDate datetime,  
@emsApplicationId int = null
AS
if(@emsApplicationId is null)
	begin
		select tot.OrderTrade_ID,tt.Trade_ID,tt.Traded_Quantity, tord.Account_ID, tot.Sub_Strategy_ID, tt.Estee_ID, tt.Buy_Sell_Indicator, tt.ExecID,   
		tord.Order_ID, tt.Transaction_Cost, tt.Traded_Price, tord.Exchange_Order_ID, tord.Order_Source_ID, ISNULL(tord.Link_ID,-1) as Rule_ID 
		from [Order] tord  
		inner join OrderTrades tot with(nolock) on tord.Creation_Date = tot.Creation_Date and tord.Order_ID = tot.Order_ID  
		inner join Trades tt with (nolock) on tot.OrderTrade_ID = tt.OrderTrade_ID and tot.Creation_Date = tt.Creation_Date and tot.Order_ID = tt.Order_ID  
		where tot.Status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and tord.Creation_Date >= @runDate and tord.Creation_Date < @runDate + 1
		ORDER BY Estee_ID, Update_Time
	end
else
	begin
		select tot.OrderTrade_ID,tt.Trade_ID,tt.Traded_Quantity, tord.Account_ID, tot.Sub_Strategy_ID, tt.Estee_ID, tt.Buy_Sell_Indicator, tt.ExecID,   
		tord.Order_ID, tt.Transaction_Cost, tt.Traded_Price, tord.Exchange_Order_ID, tord.Order_Source_ID, ISNULL(tord.Link_ID,-1) as Rule_ID
		from [Order] tord  
		inner join OrderTrades tot with(nolock) on tord.Creation_Date = tot.Creation_Date and tord.Order_ID = tot.Order_ID  
		inner join Trades tt with (nolock) on tot.OrderTrade_ID = tt.OrderTrade_ID and tot.Creation_Date = tt.Creation_Date and tot.Order_ID = tt.Order_ID  
		where tot.Status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and tord.Creation_Date >= @runDate and tord.Creation_Date < @runDate + 1 and tord.Ems_ID = @emsApplicationId 
		ORDER BY Estee_ID, Update_Time
	end


```

```sql
-- =============================================

-- Create date: 26 June 2013
-- Description:	Returns application details for which entries required in subscription_realtime
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE GetApplicationsForSubscription 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
  
	select ea.ApplicationID,ea.ApplicationName,(cast(ea.ApplicationID as varchar(255)) + ' - ' + ea.ApplicationName) as 	ApplicationIdName,  di.Value, es.LocationCode from EsteeApplications ea

	order by ApplicationId, ApplicationName
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.getasyncusertradedvalue

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[getasyncusertradedvalue]
@SSID INT,
@NumDays INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT 
        ems_id AS userId,
        SUM(Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price) AS TotalTradedValue
    FROM 
        [dbo].[vwalltrades] WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE 
        Sub_Strategy_ID = @SSID
        AND Creation_Date >= DATEADD(DAY, -@NumDays, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
        AND Creation_Date <= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
        AND Status IN ('Executed', 'Partially Filled')
    GROUP BY 
        ems_id;
END


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetAUMData

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetAUMData]
@fromDate datetime = 0,                                     
@toDate datetime = null,                             
@brokerID decimal = null,                                      
@accounts nvarchar(1000) = '',  
@subStrategies nvarchar(4000) = ''                            
AS                                      
BEGIN                        

 DECLARE @Account TABLE(accountID int)    
 if(@accounts is null OR @accounts = '')  
 begin  
  INSERT into @Account Select account_ID from account  
 end  
 else  
 begin  
  INSERT into @Account SELECT * from dbo.split(@accounts,',')  
 end 

 DECLARE @SubStrategy TABLE(subStrategyID int)     
 if(@subStrategies = '0')  
 begin  
  INSERT into @SubStrategy SELECT * from dbo.split(@subStrategies,',')  
  INSERT into @SubStrategy Select distinct subStrategy_ID from strategy_New  
 end
 else
 begin
  INSERT into @SubStrategy SELECT * from dbo.split(@subStrategies,',')  
 end

 SELECT SUM(Cash_Paid) AS Cash_Paid, 
 MIN(Date) AS Date, 
 SUM(CashTransactionCost) AS CashTransactionCost, 
 SUM(FnOTransactionCost) AS FnOTransactionCost,                       
 SUM(FutureMTMBrokerNet) AS FutureMTMBrokerNet, 
 SUM(NetOptionValue) AS NetOptionValue, 
 SUM(FuturePayout) AS FuturePayout,
 SUM(OptionPayout) AS OptionPayout, 
 SUM(DailyFOMargin) AS DailyFOMargin,                       
 SUM(ISNULL(DailyFOMargin, 0) + ISNULL(BaseCumFnOMargin, 0)) AS CombinedFOM,
 SUM(ISNULL(CashPayment, 0)) AS CashPayment,                      
 SUM(ISNULL((Cash_Paid + FDR + FutureMTMBrokerNet + OtherCharges + DailyFOMargin + CMBuy + CMSell + OptionPayout + NetAssignmentValue), 0)) AS DNCF,                      
 
 SUM(ISNULL(FutureMTMBrokerNet, 0)) AS CumMTMNet,                       
 SUM(ISNULL(NetAssignmentValue, 0)) AS NetAssignmentValue,                      
 SUM(ISNULL(NetAssignmentValue, 0)) AS CumNetAssignmentValue,                      
 MIN(account_id) AS account_id, 
 MIN(broker_id) AS broker_id, 
 SUM(NetOptionValue) AS NetOptionValue,                    
 SUM(ISNULL(OptionPayout, 0)) AS CumOptionPayout,    
 SUM(ISNULL(CashBalance, 0) + ISNULL(BaseCumCashBalance, 0)) BaseCumCashBalance,  
 SUM(ISNULL(AUM, 0)) AS AUM  
 from ledgerbalance lb                       
 WHERE Date >= @fromDate AND Date < @toDate 
 AND Broker_ID = @brokerID 
 AND Account_ID IN (Select accountID FROM @Account) 
 AND StrategyID IN (Select subStrategyID FROM @SubStrategy)
 ORDER BY Date              
                      
END

```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetbannedSecurities]   
@AccountList varchar(100) = null,  
@SubStrategy_ID int   
AS  
BEGIN  
 DECLARE @localAccountList TABLE(AccountID int)   
  
   IF(@AccountList is null OR @AccountList = '')  BEGIN                        
     insert into @localAccountList select Account_ID from Account              
   END ELSE BEGIN                        
     INSERT into @localAccountList SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) from dbo.split(@AccountList,',')                        
   END       
  select estee_id,Account_ID,  ban_status from   
(  
select t.estee_id as estee_ID, t.ban_status as ban_status, l.AccountID as Account_ID from tblBanSecurities t join @localAccountList l on t.substrategy_id=@SubStrategy_ID   
  
union select f.estee_id as estee_ID, f.ban_status as ban_status, l.AccountID as Account_ID from FIIBanSecurities f join @localAccountList l on l.AccountID=f.account_id 
)  BANNED
  
  
  END
```
