## Stored procedure: dbo.GetBannedSecurityList

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetBannedSecurityList]  
 @ssID INT = NULL,  
 @accID INT = NULL,  
 @exCode varchar(2) = NULL  
  
AS  
  
BEGIN  
  
 SET NOCOUNT OFF  
     
   
 BEGIN TRY   
  
 DECLARE @fundID INT  
   
 --VALIDITY CHECKS BEGIN  
 IF (@accID IS NULL AND @exCode IS NULL)  
 BEGIN   
  RAISERROR ('StoredProc : GetBannedSecurityList; Neither of the two fields : Exchange, Account was passed. At least one is mandatory.',16,1);   
 END  
   
 IF (@accID IS NULL AND @exCode IS NOT NULL)  
 BEGIN  
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM Exchange WHERE code = @exCode)  
  BEGIN  
   RAISERROR ('StoredProc : GetBannedSecurityList; INVALID EXCHANGE.',16,1);   
  END  
 END  
   
   
 IF (@accID IS NOT NULL AND @exCode IS NULL)  
 BEGIN   
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM Account WHERE Account_ID = @accID)  
  BEGIN  
   RAISERROR ('StoredProc : GetBannedSecurityList; INVALID ACCOUNT.',16,1);   
  END  
  
  SELECT @exCode = exchange_Code FROM Account WHERE Account_ID = @accID  
 END  
   
 IF (@accID IS NOT NULL AND @exCode IS NOT NULL)  
 BEGIN   
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM Account WHERE Account_ID = @accID AND exchange_Code = @exCode)  
  BEGIN  
   RAISERROR ('StoredProc : GetBannedSecurityList; INVALID ACCOUNT-EXCHANGE COMBINATION.',16,1);   
  END  
  
  SELECT @exCode = exchange_Code FROM Account WHERE Account_ID = @accID  
 END  
   
 IF(@ssID IS NOT NULL)  
 BEGIN  
  IF(@accID IS NULL)  
  BEGIN  
   SELECT @accID = A.Account_ID FROM StrategyBrokerAccount SBA   
   INNER JOIN Account A ON A.Account_ID = SBA.accountID   
   WHERE SBA.subStrategyID = @ssID AND A.exchange_Code = @exCode  
  END  
   
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM StrategyBrokerAccount WHERE subStrategyID = @ssID AND accountID = @accID)  
  BEGIN  
   RAISERROR ('StoredProc : GetBannedSecurityList; INVALID STRATEGY-ACCOUNT COMBINATION.',16,1);  
  END  
  
  SELECT @fundID = InvestmentFundID FROM Strategy_New WHERE SubStrategy_Id = @ssID  
 END   
 --VALIDITY CHECKS END  
   
 --PROC BEIGN   
   
 DECLARE @subscribedBanGroups TABLE   
 (  
  banGroupID INT   
 )  
   
   
   
  
 INSERT INTO @subscribedBanGroups  
 SELECT DISTINCT BanGroupID FROM BanGroupAllotment WHERE DimensionValue in (@exCode, cast(@accID as varchar),cast(@ssID as varchar), CAST(@fundID as varchar))   
 
 IF(@ssID IS NULL)
	 BEGIN  
		 ;WITH X AS   
		 (  
		  SELECT E.EsteeID, Max(P.Severity) AS Severity   
		  FROM BanGroupSecurityList E   
		  INNER JOIN @subscribedBanGroups T ON T.banGroupID = E.BanGroupID  
		  INNER JOIN BanPermission P ON P.ID = E.BanPermissionID  
		  GROUP BY E.EsteeID   
		 )   
		 SELECT X.EsteeID, B.BanPermission FROM X   
		 INNER JOIN BanPermission B ON B.Severity = X.Severity
		 ORDER BY X.EsteeID  
	 END
 ELSE
	 BEGIN
		;WITH X AS   
		 (  
		  SELECT E.EsteeID, Max(P.Severity) AS Severity   
		  FROM BanGroupSecurityList E		  
		  INNER JOIN @subscribedBanGroups T ON T.banGroupID = E.BanGroupID  
		  INNER JOIN subscription_realtime SR on SR.EsteeID = E.EsteeID
		  INNER JOIN BanPermission P ON P.ID = E.BanPermissionID  
		  INNER JOIN Strategy_New SN ON SN.SubStrategy_Name = SR.Strategy_Name
		  where SN.SubStrategy_Id = @ssID
		  GROUP BY E.EsteeID   
		 )   
		 SELECT X.EsteeID, B.BanPermission FROM X   
		 INNER JOIN BanPermission B ON B.Severity = X.Severity   		 
		 ORDER BY X.EsteeID  
	 END
   
   
 --PROC END  
   
   
 END TRY    
   
 BEGIN CATCH    
   
   
      
  DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);  
  DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;  
  DECLARE @ErrorState INT;  
    
  SELECT @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),  
      @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),  
      @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();  
    
  -- RAISERROR inside the CATCH block will return error information about the original error that caused execution to jump to the CATCH block.  
  RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage, -- Message text.  
       @ErrorSeverity, -- Severity.  
       @ErrorState -- State.  
       );  
 END CATCH     
   
END   
  
--UNIT TEST  
  
--Parameter Combinations  
--substrategyID accountID exchangeCode Validity check for VALID   Fetch Test  
--null   null  null   invalid          EXEC GetBannedSecurityList null,null,null  
--null   null  not null  valid  existing record in db   EXEC GetBannedSecurityList null,null,'IS'  
--null   not null null   valid  existing record in db exCode EXEC GetBannedSecurityList null,21,null  
--null   not null not null  valid  existing record in db   EXEC GetBannedSecurityList null,21,'IS'  
--not null  null  null   invalid          EXEC GetBannedSecurityList 8112,null,null  
--not null  null  not null  valid  existing record in db accID EXEC GetBannedSecurityList 1215,null,'IS'  
--not null  not null null   valid  existing record in db exCode EXEC GetBannedSecurityList 5162,60,null  
--not null  not null not null  valid  existing record in db   EXEC GetBannedSecurityList 1208,10,'IS'
```

```sql
AS

	if @substrategyID = -1
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetBODPositionsForGivenDate

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetBODPositionsForGivenDate]  
 @date datetime,  
 @prevDate datetime,  
 @isAllPositions bit = 1,    
 @listSubStrategyID varchar(max)  = null,  -- for set of strategies     
 @listexchange varchar(500) = null,      
 @useDailyPositionsTable bit = 0,  --do not calculate the position from the trades, force usage of table    
 @strategystatuscheck bit = 0,     
 @applicationID int = -1    
AS                                
      
BEGIN           
 SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;     
   
 DECLARE @TempPositions TABLE(Exchange_Code varchar(2), SecurityName varchar(100), Long bigint, Short bigint, TransactionCost decimal(20,6),   
 Account_ID int, SecurityType varchar(50), Estee_ID varchar(50), Sub_StrategyID int, Broker_ID int, PositionDate Date, AverageTradedPrice decimal(20,6),   
 BuyValue decimal(20,6), SellValue decimal(20,6), AverageHoldingPrice decimal(20,6), RuleId int)
   
 insert into @TempPositions  
 select Min(isnull(e.Exchange_Code, ea.Exchange_Code)) Exchange_Code, Min(isnull(e.DataFeed_Ticker, ea.DataFeed_Ticker)) SecurityName,  
 sum(case when vw.Buy_Sell_Indicator = 1 then vw.Traded_Quantity else 0 end) Long, sum(case when vw.Buy_Sell_Indicator = 2 then vw.Traded_Quantity else 0 end) Short, 0 TransactionCost,  
 vw.Account_ID, Min(s.TypeName) SecurityType, vw.Estee_ID, vw.Sub_Strategy_ID, vw.Broker_ID, @prevDate PositionDate, 0 AverageTradedPrice,   
 sum(case when vw.Buy_Sell_Indicator = 1 then vw.Traded_Quantity * vw.Traded_Price else 0 end) BuyValue, sum(case when vw.Buy_Sell_Indicator = 2 then vw.Traded_Quantity * vw.Traded_Price else 0 end) SellValue, 0 AverageHoldingPrice, vw.Link_ID RuleId  
 from vwalltrades vw left join EsteeMaster (nolock) e on vw.Estee_ID = e.Estee_ID  
 left join EsteeMaster_archive (nolock) ea on vw.Estee_ID = ea.Estee_ID and ea.Status = 1  
 inner join SecurityType s on s.TypeCode = ISNULL(e.security_type, ea.security_type)  
 where Creation_Date = @date and vw.status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and RTRIM(LTRIM(Order_Source_ID)) in ('Balancing','New Balancing')  
 group by vw.Broker_ID, vw.Account_ID, vw.Sub_Strategy_ID, vw.Link_ID, vw.Estee_ID  
  
 insert into @TempPositions  
 exec GetAllPositionsForGivenDate @prevDate, @isAllPositions, @listSubStrategyID, @listexchange, @useDailyPositionsTable, @strategystatuscheck, @applicationID   
  
 select Min(Exchange_Code) Exchange_Code, Min(SecurityName) SecurityName, Sum(Long) Long, Sum(Short) Short, Sum(TransactionCost) TransactionCost, Min(Account_ID) Account_ID,   
 Min(SecurityType) SecurityType, Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, Min(PositionDate) PositionDate, sum(AverageTradedPrice) AverageTradedPrice, Sum(BuyValue) BuyValue, Sum(SellValue) SellValue, Sum(AverageHoldingPrice) AverageHoldingPrice, -1 as RuleId   
 into #finalPosition  
 from @TempPositions   
 group by Broker_ID, Account_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Estee_ID  
  
 select * from #finalPosition where Long <> Short  
 drop table #finalPosition  
   
END  


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetBrokerageChargeByTurnover

```sql

Create procedure [dbo].[GetBrokerageChargeByTurnover]  
AS  
select distinct bc.[Key], bc.SlabIndex, bc.Charge, bc.ChargeByStep, bc.TurnoverCalcType, ts.LowerLimit, ts.UpperLimit,
isnull(toc.ChargeType, 0) ChargeType , toc.EsteeId as EsteeId, isnull(ts.IsMonthly,0) IsMonthly, isnull(toc.SecurityGroupId,1) SecurityGroupId, bc.ChargesCapKey 
from BrokerageCharges bc   
left join TurnOverCalcType toc on toc.TurnoverCalcType = bc.TurnoverCalcType  
left join TurnoverSlabs ts ON( bc.[TurnoverKey] = ts.[Key] and bc.SlabIndex = ts.SlabIndex)  
order by bc.[Key], bc.SlabIndex, ts.LowerLimit   

select distinct bc.[Key], bcc.[Key] ChargesCapKey, bcc.MinCap, bcc.MinCapType, bcc.MaxCap, bcc.MaxCapType, bcc.PrecisionType, bcc.EnabledAtOrderLevel
from BrokerageChargesCapDetails bcc inner join BrokerageCharges bc
on bc.ChargesCapKey = bcc.[Key]
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetBuySellValueForGivenDateRange

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetBuySellValueForGivenDateRange]                    
@fromDate datetime = null,    
@toDate datetime = null,  
@accountID int = null  
AS       
 BEGIN 
 SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED
               
 SELECT SUM(X.BuySellValue) AS BuySellValue, X.buy_sell_indicator FROM   
 (  
 SELECT CASE (buy_sell_indicator)  
 WHEN 1 THEN  
  CASE(substring(estee_id, 15, 2))  
  WHEN 05 THEN  
   Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price  
  WHEN 01 THEN  
   Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price  
  WHEN 02 THEN  
   Traded_Quantity * (CONVERT(float, substring(estee_id, 25, len(estee_id))) + Traded_Price)  
  WHEN 03 THEN  
   Traded_Quantity * (CONVERT(float, substring(estee_id, 25, len(estee_id))) + Traded_Price)  
  WHEN 06 THEN  
   Traded_Quantity * (CONVERT(float, substring(estee_id, 25, len(estee_id))) + Traded_Price)  
  WHEN 07 THEN  
   Traded_Quantity * (CONVERT(float, substring(estee_id, 25, len(estee_id))) + Traded_Price)  
  END   
 WHEN 2 THEN  
  CASE(substring(estee_id, 15, 2))  
  WHEN 05 THEN  
   Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price * -1  
  WHEN 01 THEN  
   Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price * -1  
  WHEN 02 THEN  
   Traded_Quantity * (CONVERT(float, substring(estee_id, 25, len(estee_id))) + Traded_Price) * -1  
  WHEN 03 THEN  
   Traded_Quantity * (CONVERT(float, substring(estee_id, 25, len(estee_id))) + Traded_Price) * -1  
  WHEN 06 THEN  
   Traded_Quantity * (CONVERT(float, substring(estee_id, 25, len(estee_id))) + Traded_Price) * -1  
  WHEN 07 THEN  
   Traded_Quantity * (CONVERT(float, substring(estee_id, 25, len(estee_id))) + Traded_Price) * -1  
  END   
 END AS BuySellValue,  
 buy_sell_indicator,  
 underlying_ticker,  
 estee_id
from [Order] o
inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID
inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID
where ot.Status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and o.Creation_Date >= @fromDate and o.Creation_Date < @toDate 
     AND account_ID = @accountID AND substring(estee_id, 15, 2) NOT IN (00, 04)
 ) X  
 GROUP BY X.buy_sell_indicator   
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetCheckList

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetCheckList]     
 @date datetime,  
 @jobType nvarchar(10)  
AS    
BEGIN    
 -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from    
 -- interfering with SELECT statements.    
 SET NOCOUNT ON;    
 DECLARE @tempJobType TABLE(JobType varchar(10))  
 if(@jobType = 'Daily' OR @jobType = 'OnExpiry')  
 begin  
 INSERT INTO @tempJobType SELECT Type FROM jobtypes WHERE Type IN ('BOD', 'EOD', 'EXP')  
 end  
 else if(@jobType = 'Monthly')  
 begin  
 INSERT INTO @tempJobType SELECT Type FROM jobtypes WHERE Type IN ('BOM', 'EOM')  
 end  
 else if(@jobType = 'Quarterly')  
 begin  
 INSERT INTO @tempJobType SELECT Type FROM jobtypes WHERE Type IN ('BOQ', 'EOQ')  
 end  
 else if(@jobType = 'Yearly')  
 begin  
 INSERT INTO @tempJobType SELECT Type FROM jobtypes WHERE Type IN ('BOY', 'EOY')  
 end  
   
 if not exists(select 1 from JobsCheckList where datediff(dd, Date, @date) = 0)    
 begin     
  Insert into JobsCheckList (ID, date, status, checked, comments) Select ID, @date, 0, 0, '' From JobView    
                 WHERE JobType IN (SELECT JobType FROM @tempJobType)  
 end     
     
  Select Job,     
  ISNULL((Select [Status]From JobsCheckList JCL Where datediff(dd, Date, @date) = 0 and JCL.ID = JV.ID),0)[Status],    
  ISNULL((Select Checked From JobsCheckList JCL Where datediff(dd, Date, @date) = 0 and JCL.ID = JV.ID),0) Checked,    
  convert(varchar(10), @date, 101 ) Date,     
  ISNULL((Select ISNULL(Comments, '')From JobsCheckList JCL Where date = @date and JCL.ID = JV.ID),'') Comments,    
  [Description],    
  JobType,JobCategory, convert(varchar(8), CutOffTime, 108 ) CutOffTime ,AssignedTo, CheckedBy, Automated , AlternateCheckedBy, AssignedPerson, CheckedPerson, AlternateCheckPerson,ExchangeCode
 From  JobView JV   
 WHERE JobType IN (SELECT JobType FROM @tempJobType)  
 Order by CutOffTime ASC    
    
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetComponentsForGivenIndex

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE GetComponentsForGivenIndex @EXCHANGE_CODE VARCHAR(2), @INDEXSPOTID VARCHAR(100), @DATE DATE, @SECURITYTYPES VARCHAR(100), @INCLUDEINDEX BIT
AS
     BEGIN
         DECLARE @INDEXCOMPONENTS TABLE(ESTEEID VARCHAR(50));

         --- GET INDEX COMPONENTS FROM INDEXTABLE. IF INCLUDEINDEXIS SET TO 1, INCLUDE THE INDEX ITSELF IN THE RESULT, ELSE DONT.
         IF @INCLUDEINDEX = 1
         BEGIN
             INSERT INTO @INDEXCOMPONENTS
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                           T.Member_Estee_ID
                      FROM IndexTable AS T
                     WHERE T.Estee_ID = @INDEXSPOTID
                           AND T.Estee_ID <> T.Member_Estee_ID
                           AND YEAR(T.AsOfDate) = YEAR(@DATE)
                           AND MONTH(T.AsOfDate) = MONTH(@DATE)
                           AND DAY(T.AsOfDate) = DAY(@DATE)
                    UNION
                    SELECT @INDEXSPOTID;
         END;
         ELSE
         BEGIN
             INSERT INTO @INDEXCOMPONENTS
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                           T.Member_Estee_ID
                      FROM IndexTable AS T
                     WHERE T.Estee_ID = @INDEXSPOTID
                           AND T.Estee_ID <> T.Member_Estee_ID
                           AND YEAR(T.AsOfDate) = YEAR(@DATE)
                           AND MONTH(T.AsOfDate) = MONTH(@DATE)
                           AND DAY(T.AsOfDate) = DAY(@DATE);
         END;

         -- SELECT ALL THE CONTRACTS OF THE COMPONENETS SELECTED ABOVE WHICH ARE OF SECURITY TYPES PASSED AS ARG TO THE SP.
         SELECT E.Estee_ID
           FROM ESTEEMASTER AS I
           INNER JOIN EsteeMaster AS E ON I.ISIN = E.ISIN
                                          AND E.Exchange_Code = I.Exchange_Code
          WHERE E.Security_Type IN(SELECT *
                                     FROM dbo.Split(@SECURITYTYPES, ',')
                                  )
                AND I.Estee_ID IN(SELECT ESTEEID
                                    FROM @INDEXCOMPONENTS
                                 );

     END;
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetCrossMarginDataForETF

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetCrossMarginDataForETF]
	 @Date datetime   
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select c.date,e.IndexEsteeID EtfEsteeID, e.IndexEsteeID ConstituentEsteeID, c.Units * e.Units Units, c.IndexEsteeID BenchmarkIndex, c.Units EquivalentIndexUnits 
	from CrossMarginData c
	inner join CrossMarginData e on c.IndexEsteeID = e.ConstituentEsteeID and e.date = '1901-01-01'
	where c.date = @Date and c.ConstituentEsteeID = c.IndexEsteeID
	UNION
	select c.date,e.indexesteeid EtfEsteeID, c.ConstituentEsteeID, c.Units, c.IndexEsteeID BenchmarkIndex, null EquivalentIndexUnits
	from CrossMarginData c
	inner join CrossMarginData e on e.ConstituentEsteeID = c.IndexEsteeID and e.date = '1901-01-01'
	where c.date = @Date and c.ConstituentEsteeID <> c.IndexEsteeID
	order by EtfEsteeID, ConstituentEsteeID

END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetCurrenyForCrossExchangeStrategies

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetCurrenyForCrossExchangeStrategies]
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select s1.subStrategyID
	, e1.code as ex1
	, a1.Account_ID as acc1
	, c1.CurrencyCode as curr1 
	, e2.code as ex2
	, a2.Account_ID as acc2
	, c2.CurrencyCode as curr2 
	from StrategyBrokerAccount s1 
	inner join StrategyBrokerAccount s2 on s2.subStrategyID = s1.subStrategyID
	inner join Account a1 on a1.Account_ID = s1.accountID
	inner join Exchange e1 on a1.exchange_Code = e1.code
	inner join Currency c1 on c1.ID = e1.CurrencyID
	inner join Account a2 on a2.Account_ID = s2.accountID
	inner join Exchange e2 on a2.exchange_Code = e2.code
	inner join Currency c2 on c2.ID = e2.CurrencyID
	where s1.accountID < s2.accountID 
	and e1.code <> e2.code
	and c1.CurrencyCode <> c2.CurrencyCode

END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetDataStoreDetails

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetDataStoreDetails]	
AS
BEGIN

 declare @DataStoreDetails table(DataStoreName varchar(250), LocationCode varchar(250),DataStoreType varchar(50), DataStoreClass varchar(50),     
   DefaultDataStore bit, ConnectionPoolSize numeric, encryptedConString varbinary(255), DataStoreConnectionString varchar(4000))    
        
insert into @DataStoreDetails    
select DataStoreName,LocationCode,DataStoreType,DataStoreClass,DefaultDataStore, ConnectionPoolSize,DataStoreConnectionString,''
from DataStoreMetadata with (nolock)
 
     
 DECLARE @dataStoreName varchar(250), @locationCode varchar(250),@dataStoreType varchar(50), 
 @encryptedConString varbinary(255), @decryptedConString varchar(4000)    
 
 DECLARE decryptionCursor CURSOR LOCAL SCROLL STATIC     
 FOR     
 Select DataStoreName, LocationCode, DataStoreType, encryptedConString FROM @DataStoreDetails    
 OPEN decryptionCursor -- open the cursor    
     
 FETCH NEXT FROM decryptionCursor INTO @dataStoreName, @locationCode, @dataStoreType, @encryptedConString
    exec esteeEncryptionKey.dbo.spDecrypt @encryptedConString, @decryptedConString out    
      
    update @DataStoreDetails set DataStoreConnectionString = @decryptedConString 
    where DataStoreName = @dataStoreName and LocationCode = @locationCode and DataStoreType=@dataStoreType
        
 WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0     
 BEGIN     
 FETCH NEXT FROM decryptionCursor INTO @dataStoreName, @locationCode, @dataStoreType, @encryptedConString 
	exec esteeEncryptionKey.dbo.spDecrypt @encryptedConString, @decryptedConString out    
      
    update @DataStoreDetails set DataStoreConnectionString = @decryptedConString 
    where DataStoreName = @dataStoreName and LocationCode = @locationCode and DataStoreType=@dataStoreType  
 
 END    
     
 CLOSE decryptionCursor -- close the cursor    
 DEALLOCATE decryptionCursor     
     
 select DataStoreName,LocationCode,DataStoreType,DataStoreClass,DefaultDataStore, ConnectionPoolSize,DataStoreConnectionString from @DataStoreDetails   
END
```

## Function: dbo.GetDatePartName

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>


-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[GetDatePartName] 
(
	@DateTime datetime
)
RETURNS Varchar(10)
AS
BEGIN
Declare @Return varchar(10) 

set @Return = cast(Day(@DateTime) as char(2)) 

if(LEN(@Return)=1)
	set @Return = '0'+ @Return

if(Month(@DateTime) =1)
	set @Return = @Return + 'JAN'
else 
if(Month(@DateTime) =2)
	set @Return = @Return + 'FEB'
else 
if(Month(@DateTime) =3)
	set @Return = @Return + 'MAR'
else 
if(Month(@DateTime) =4)
	set @Return = @Return + 'APR'
else 
if(Month(@DateTime) =5)
	set @Return = @Return + 'MAY'
else 
if(Month(@DateTime) =6)
	set @Return = @Return + 'JUN'
else 
if(Month(@DateTime) =7)
	set @Return = @Return + 'JUL'
else 
if(Month(@DateTime) =8)
	set @Return = @Return + 'AUG'
else 
if(Month(@DateTime) =9)
	set @Return = @Return + 'SEP'
else 
if(Month(@DateTime) =10)
	set @Return = @Return + 'OCT'
else 
if(Month(@DateTime) =11)
	set @Return = @Return + 'NOV'
else 
if(Month(@DateTime) =12)
	set @Return = @Return + 'DEC'


return @Return

END

```

## Function: dbo.GetDatePartNameForEsteeID

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>


-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[GetDatePartNameForEsteeID] 
(
	@estee_ID nvarchar(50)
)
RETURNS Varchar(200)
AS
BEGIN
Declare @Return varchar(200) 

declare @underlying_Ticker nvarchar(50)
set @underlying_Ticker = (Select top 1 Underlying_Ticker FROM EsteeMaster WHERE  Exchange_Code='IS' and Status=1 and  SUBSTRING(estee_ID, 1,12) = SUBSTRING(@estee_ID, 1,12))
--select @underlying_Ticker

declare @security_TypeCode nvarchar(5)
set @security_TypeCode = (select SUBSTRING(@estee_ID, 15,2))
--select @security_TypeCode

declare @option_type nvarchar(50)
set @option_type =

(SELECT CASE  
	When @security_TypeCode = 2 then 'CA'
	When @security_TypeCode = 3 then 'PA'
	When @security_TypeCode = 6 then 'CE'
	When @security_TypeCode = 7 then 'PE'
	End AS OptionType)
--select @option_type

declare @monYear nvarchar(11)
declare @expiry_Date datetime
set @expiry_Date = (select SUBSTRING(@estee_ID, 17,8))
if(len(@expiry_Date) > 0)
begin
	set @monYear = (select substring(CONVERT(CHAR(4), @expiry_Date, 120), 3, 2) + UPPER(CONVERT(CHAR(3), @expiry_Date, 100)))
end
--select @monYear

declare @lenEsteeID nvarchar(50)
set @lenEsteeID = len(@estee_ID)

declare @strike_Price nvarchar(5)
if(@lenEsteeID > 24)
begin
	set @strike_Price = (select SUBSTRING(@estee_ID, 25, len(@estee_ID) - 24))
end

set @Return =

(SELECT CASE  
	When @security_TypeCode = 0 then @underlying_Ticker
	When @security_TypeCode = 1 then @underlying_Ticker + @monYear + 'FUT'
	When @security_TypeCode = 2 and @option_type = 'CA' then @underlying_Ticker + @monYear + @strike_Price + 'CA'
	When @security_TypeCode = 3 and @option_type = 'PA' then @underlying_Ticker + @monYear + @strike_Price + 'PA'
	When @security_TypeCode = 4 then @underlying_Ticker
	When @security_TypeCode = 5 then @underlying_Ticker + @monYear + 'FUT'
	When @security_TypeCode = 6 and @option_type = 'CE' then @underlying_Ticker + @monYear + @strike_Price + 'CE'
	When @security_TypeCode = 7 and @option_type = 'PE' then @underlying_Ticker + @monYear + @strike_Price + 'PE'
End AS TempReturn)

return @Return

END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetDeliveredPositions

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetDeliveredPositions]    
@currentDate datetime = null,  
@listAccount varchar(500) = null    
AS                            
  
BEGIN          
DECLARE @localAccountList TABLE(ExchangeCode int)      
 IF(@listAccount is null OR @listAccount = '') BEGIN            
  INSERT into @localAccountList select account_id from account      
 END ELSE BEGIN            
  INSERT into @localAccountList SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) from dbo.split(@listAccount,',')            
 END        
Declare @nextdate Datetime  
Set @nextdate =  DATEADD( DAY, 1,@currentDate);  
  
  
Select dd.PositionDate,  
 dd.AccountID,  
 dd.EsteeID,  
 dd.AccountID,  
 dd.ClearingInSell,  
 dd.Delivered,  
 dd.ClearingInBuy,   
isnull(netlongintraday,0) as netlongIntraday,   
isnull(netshortintraday,0) as netShortIntraday  
from DeliveredDailyPosition dd join   
 (  
  select MAX(positiondate)as positiondate,Exchange_Code from DailyPositions  where positiondate <=@currentdate group by Exchange_Code  
    
      
 )  
 as d on d.Exchange_Code = substring(dd.EsteeID,13,2) and d.positiondate = dd.PositionDate  
 left join   
 (  
  select SUM(traded_quantity*(2-Buy_Sell_Indicator)) as netlongintraday,SUM(traded_quantity*(Buy_Sell_Indicator-1)) as netshortintraday, Account_ID, estee_id   
  FROM vwAllTrades  
  where account_id in (select * from @localAccountList) and Status in ('executed','partially filled')  
  and Creation_Date >= @currentdate and  Creation_Date < @nextdate and len(estee_id)=16 group by Account_ID, estee_id   
 )as t  
on t.Account_ID = dd.AccountID and dd.EsteeID = t.Estee_ID and dd.positiondate < @currentDate  
      
END  
  
  
--getdeliveredpositions '2012-12-12' ,'10,50,15,21'

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetDematBODPositionsForGivenDate

```sql
-- =============================================  
-- Author:  Shubham  
-- Create date: 2024-07-26  
-- Description: Procdure to fetch Demat position wrt Account, Strategy Account  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetDematBODPositionsForGivenDate]   
 -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here  
 @date datetime,      -- Will be last working date   
 @listAccountID varchar(max) = null, -- for set of accounts  
 @listSubStrategyID varchar(max)  = null,  -- for set of strategies   
 @listexchange varchar(500) = null,   
 @strategystatuscheck bit = 0,  
 @applicationID int = -1  
AS  
BEGIN  
 -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from  
 -- interfering with SELECT statements.  
 SET NOCOUNT ON;  
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;   
    DECLARE @dateplusone DATETIME      
    SET @dateplusone = DATEADD(dd, 1,  @date)   
  
    DECLARE @Broker TABLE(Broker_ID int)    
    DECLARE @Account TABLE(Account_ID int, Exchange_Code varchar(4))   
    DECLARE @SubStrategy TABLE(SubStrategy_Id int)  
    DECLARE @ExchangeCode TABLE(Exchange_Code [char](10))    
  
    -- Insert statements for procedure here  
 -- Account  
 IF (@listAccountID is null OR @listAccountID = '') BEGIN    
        INSERT INTO @Account    
             SELECT account_ID,exchange_Code FROM account WITH(NOLOCK)    
    END    
    ELSE BEGIN    
        INSERT INTO @Account    
             SELECT A.items,AC.exchange_Code    
               FROM dbo.split(@listAccountID,',') A    
         INNER JOIN Account AC WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.items = AC.Account_ID    
    END   
  
 -- SSID  
 IF (@applicationID <= 0) AND (@listSubStrategyID is null OR @listSubStrategyID = '') BEGIN    
            INSERT INTO @SubStrategy    
        SELECT DISTINCT SubStrategy_Id    
                   FROM Strategy_New WITH(NOLOCK)    
                  WHERE Strategy_Status IN (1, CASE @strategystatuscheck WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)    
    END    
    ELSE IF (@applicationID > 0) BEGIN    
        INSERT INTO @SubStrategy    
               EXEC GetStrategiesByApplicationID @applicationID, @strategystatuscheck    
        DELETE S    
          FROM @SubStrategy S    
     LEFT JOIN Strategy_New SN WITH(NOLOCK) ON S.SubStrategy_Id = SN.SubStrategy_Id    
           AND Strategy_Status IN (1, CASE @strategystatuscheck WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)    
         WHERE SN.SubStrategy_Id IS NULL    
    END    
    ELSE BEGIN    
        INSERT INTO @SubStrategy    
        SELECT S.items    
          FROM dbo.split(@listSubStrategyID,',') S    
    INNER JOIN Strategy_New SN WITH(NOLOCK) ON S.items = SN.SubStrategy_Id    
           AND SN.Strategy_Status IN (1, CASE @strategystatuscheck WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)    
    END  
  
 -- Exchange  
 IF(@listexchange IS NULL OR @listexchange = '') BEGIN    
        INSERT INTO @ExchangeCode SELECT CODE FROM Exchange WITH(NOLOCK)    
    END  
 ELSE BEGIN    
        INSERT INTO @ExchangeCode    
             SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items))    
            FROM dbo.split(@listexchange,',')  E    
         INNER JOIN Exchange EX WITH(NOLOCK) ON LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) = EX.code    
    END  
   
 DECLARE @FinalBODPositions TABLE(Exchange_Code varchar(2), PositionDate Date, Estee_ID varchar(50),   
 Sub_StrategyID int, Account_ID int, Position bigint, Long bigint, Short bigint, ErrorFlag BIT)  
   
 insert into @FinalBODPositions  
 select Min(isnull(dp.Exchange_Code, '')) Exchange_Code, Min(isnull(dp.PositionDate, '')),  
 dp.Estee_ID, dp.Sub_StrategyID, dp.Account_ID, SUM(dp.MinimumSaleableQuantity) as Position, MAX(d.Long), MAX(d.Short), CASE WHEN ((MAX(d.Long) IS NULL AND MAX(d.Short) IS NULL) OR (SUM(d.Long - d.Short) != SUM(dp.MinimumSaleableQuantity))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 
END AS ErrorFlag  
 FROM DailyDematPositionsByStrategy dp WITH(NOLOCK)   
 LEFT JOIN DailyPositions d WITH(NOLOCK) ON ((dp.PositionDate = d.PositionDate) AND (dp.Account_ID = d.Account_ID) AND (dp.Sub_StrategyID = d.Sub_StrategyID) AND (dp.Estee_ID = d.Estee_ID))  
    --INNER JOIN @SubStrategy sn ON sn.subStrategyID = dp.Sub_StrategyID OR dp.Sub_StrategyID = -1  
 --INNER JOIN ContractIDs ci WITH(NOLOCK) ON ci.EsteeId = dp.Estee_ID  
 INNER JOIN @Account A ON dp.Account_ID = A.Account_ID  
 INNER JOIN tblBrokerAccount T ON A.Account_ID = T.account_id  
    INNER JOIN @SubStrategy sn ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = dp.Sub_StrategyID  
    WHERE dp.PositionDate = @date  
 group by dp.Account_ID, dp.Sub_StrategyID, dp.Estee_ID  
  
 select Exchange_Code, PositionDate, Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Account_ID, Position, Long, Short, ErrorFlag  
 from @FinalBODPositions   
 WHERE Position <> 0  
  
END  
  
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetEmsLoginDetailsForExchange

```sql
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  
-- =============================================  
-- Author:  Megha Goel  
-- Create date: 16 May 2013  
-- Description: Get EMS users and password from database for given exchange  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE GetEmsLoginDetailsForExchange   
 -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
 @exchangeCode varchar(2), 
 @ipList ListString ReadOnly  
AS  
BEGIN  
 -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from  
 -- interfering with SELECT statements.  
 SET NOCOUNT ON; 
  
 declare @EmsEncryptedLogins table(EMSApplicationID int, EMSClientName varchar(50),ExchangeCode varchar(2), IP varchar(16),   
   UserId varchar(40), [Password] varbinary(255), DecryptedPassword varchar(4000))  
  
    -- Insert statements for procedure here  
insert into @EmsEncryptedLogins  
select EMSApplicationID,ea.name as EMSClientName,ea.exchangeCode, es.IP, UserId,Password, null   
from ExchangeAdapterLoginDetails EALD   
join ExchangeAdapter EA on EALD.exchangeAdapterID = EA.ID  
join esteeapplications e on eald.emsapplicationid = e.applicationid
join esteeservers es on e.esteeserver_id = es.id   
join @ipList ips on es.IP = ips.ListItem
where exchangeCode=@exchangeCode and EA.name <> 'NEST'  
   
 DECLARE @emsApplicationId varchar(40), @encryptedPassword varbinary(255), @decryptedPassword varchar(4000)  
   
 DECLARE decryptionCursor CURSOR LOCAL SCROLL STATIC   
 FOR   
 Select EMSApplicationID, [password] FROM @EmsEncryptedLogins  
 OPEN decryptionCursor -- open the cursor  
   
 FETCH NEXT FROM decryptionCursor INTO @emsApplicationId, @encryptedPassword     
    exec esteeEncryptionKey.dbo.spDecrypt @encryptedPassword, @decryptedPassword out  
    
    update @EmsEncryptedLogins set decryptedPassword = @decryptedPassword where [Password]= @encryptedPassword  and EMSApplicationID=@emsApplicationId  
      
 WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0   
 BEGIN   
 FETCH NEXT FROM decryptionCursor INTO @emsApplicationId, @encryptedPassword      
   
 exec esteeEncryptionKey.dbo.spDecrypt @encryptedPassword, @decryptedPassword out  
    
    update @EmsEncryptedLogins set decryptedPassword = @decryptedPassword where [Password]= @encryptedPassword  and EMSApplicationID=@emsApplicationId  
 END  
   
 CLOSE decryptionCursor -- close the cursor  
 DEALLOCATE decryptionCursor   
   
 select EMSApplicationID,EMSClientName,ExchangeCode,IP,UserId,DecryptedPassword from @EmsEncryptedLogins  
   
END 


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.getEMSServerList

```sql
  
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.getEMSServerList
AS  
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;  
select ea.SubStrategy_ID, ea.EMS_Application_ID, ea.EsteeServer_ID as StrategyServer_ID,   
     es.IP as StrategyServerIP,   
     ea1.EsteeServer_ID as EMSServer_ID,  
     es1.IP as EMSServerIP,  
     es1.LocationCode as EMSLocationCode,  
     ISNULL(da.Value, 'MSMQ') EMSEMBServerType,
	 ISNULL(da1.Value, 'INLINE') OrderModuleComType
     from EsteeApplications ea   
     inner join Strategy_New sn on ea.SubStrategy_ID = sn.SubStrategy_Id and sn.Strategy_Status=1  
     inner join EsteeApplications ea1   
     on ea.EMS_Application_ID=ea1.ApplicationID inner join EsteeServers es   
     on es.ID = ea.EsteeServer_ID inner join EsteeServers es1  
     on es1.ID = ea1.EsteeServer_ID  
     left join DataInit da on da.substrategy_id = ea.SubStrategy_ID and da.Parameter = 'EMSEMBServerType'
	 left join DataInit da1 on da1.applicationid = ea.EMS_Application_ID and da1.Parameter = 'Platform_Linux_OrderModuleComType'  
     where ea.SubStrategy_ID is not null and ea.EMS_Application_ID is not null  
     and ea1.EsteeServer_ID is not null and ea.EsteeServer_ID is not null
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.getEMSTimeDetails

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[getEMSTimeDetails]      
@ssid char(10),    
@startdt date,    
@enddt date    
AS          
BEGIN          
    
  
select     
  SUBSTRING(Estee_ID, 13,2) as exchange,          
  case (SUBSTRING(Estee_ID, 15,2))    
      when '00' then 'EquitySpot'    
      when '01' then 'EquityDerv'    
      when '02' then 'EquityDerv'    
      when '03' then 'EquityDerv'    
      when '05' then 'IndexDerv'    
      when '06' then 'IndexDerv'    
      when '07' then 'IndexDerv'    
      when '11' then 'CurrDerv'    
      when '12' then 'CurrDerv'    
      when '13' then 'CurrDerv'    
      when '14' then 'CurrDerv'    
      when '16' then 'CurrDerv'    
      when '18' then 'CurrDerv'    
      when '20' then 'CommDerv'    
      when '21' then 'CommDerv'    
      else 'Undefined'    
      end as securityType,    
  case (Order_Validity)    
      when '0' then 'DAY'    
      when '1' then 'GTC'    
      when '3' then 'IOC'    
      when '4' then 'GTD'    
      else 'Undefined'    
      end as orderValidity,    
  case (Order_Type)    
      when '1' then 'MARKET'    
      when '2' then 'LIMIT'    
      when 'X' then 'SPREAD'    
      when 'Y' then 'TWOLEG'    
      when 'Z' then 'THREELEG'    
      when 'SL' then 'STOPLOSSLIMIT'    
      when 'SL-m' then 'STOPLOSSMARKET'    
      else 'Undefined'    
      end as orderType,    
      emstime    
      from vwAllTrades where Creation_Date >= @startdt and Creation_Date < @enddt and Sub_Strategy_ID = @ssid and emstime > 0
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetEMSToTraderMapping

```sql

CREATE procedure [dbo].[GetEMSToTraderMapping]          
@locationCode varchar(5) = null  
AS   
  
create table #TEMPMULTIEMS (SubStrategyID int, EMSApplicationID varchar(max))  
create table #TEMPMULTIEMS2 (SubStrategyID int, EMSApplicationID varchar(max))  
  
DECLARE cur1 CURSOR for select substrategy_id, value from datainit where Parameter in ('MultiEMS', 'MultiExchange')  
declare @sid int        
declare @listofems varchar(max)        
  
open cur1        
fetch next from cur1 INTO @sid, @listofems        
while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0        
begin        
      insert into #TEMPMULTIEMS (SubStrategyID, EMSApplicationID)        
      select @sid, * from dbo.Split(@listofems, ',')        
      fetch next from cur1 INTO @sid, @listofems        
end        
deallocate cur1        
  
insert into #TEMPMULTIEMS (SubStrategyID, EMSApplicationID)        
select substrategy_id,ems_application_id from EsteeApplications where substrategy_id is not null      
  
if(@locationCode is not null)  
 begin  
  insert into #TEMPMULTIEMS2  
  select t.*   
  from #TEMPMULTIEMS t   
  inner join EsteeApplications ea on t.SubStrategyID = ea.substrategy_id  
  inner join Strategy_New sn on sn.SubStrategy_Id = ea.SubStrategy_ID   
  inner join EsteeServers es on es.ID = ea.EsteeServer_ID   
  where es.LocationCode = @locationCode  
  and sn.Strategy_Status = 1  
 end  
else  
 begin  
  insert into #TEMPMULTIEMS2  
  select t.*   
  from #TEMPMULTIEMS t   
 end  
  
select distinct temp.SubStrategyID, SUBSTRING(temp.EMSApplicationID, 0, 7) EMSApplicationID, tb.Trader as UserId, r.items as Exchange_Code, tu.UserID ExgUserId, tu.ExchangeSegment Segment 
from #TEMPMULTIEMS2 temp        
inner join exchangeadapterlogindetails tb on tb.EMSApplicationID = SUBSTRING(temp.EMSApplicationID, 0, 7)  
inner join ExchangeAdapter ea on ea.ID = tb.exchangeAdapterID  
inner join TradersToUserID tu on tu.Trader = tb.Trader
cross apply dbo.Split(ea.exchangecode,',') as r  
  
drop table #TEMPMULTIEMS  
drop table #TEMPMULTIEMS2  
  

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetEsteeIDforHistoricalPrices

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetEsteeIDforHistoricalPrices] 
@Date DATETIME ,  
@tPlusXDate DATETIME
AS
BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #tempSecurityType(SecurityType INT, Percentage DECIMAL(6,2));
		INSERT INTO #tempSecurityType VALUES(12, 0.05)
        INSERT INTO #tempSecurityType VALUES(13, 0.05)
        CREATE TABLE #temp(Estee_ID VARCHAR(50), ExpiryDate DATETIME, UnderlyingEsteeId VARCHAR(50), SecurityType INT); 
		CREATE TABLE #NoOfContractsNeeded(Exchange_Code VARCHAR(2), SecurityType INT,ContractExpiryCycle INT, noofcontractneeded int);
		--to insert   number of contracts required according to monthly and weekly basis for next 4 months
		insert into #NoOfContractsNeeded
		select Exchange_Code,Security_Type,ContractExpiryCycle,0 from esteemaster
		update #NoOfContractsNeeded set noofcontractneeded=4 where ContractExpiryCycle=3 
		update #NoOfContractsNeeded set noofcontractneeded=18 where ContractExpiryCycle=2   
   SELECT DISTINCT E.Member_Estee_ID into #MissingIndexEsteeIds FROM IndexTable (nolock) E WHERE AsOfDate <= @tPlusXDate AND AsOfDate > @Date and Estee_ID <> Member_Estee_ID and substring(E.Estee_Id,13,2) in ('IS','SG','BR')  
   insert into #temp   
   select t.Member_Estee_ID, '',t.Member_Estee_ID, 1 from #MissingIndexEsteeIds t  
         INSERT INTO #temp  
                SELECT DISTINCT  
                       isnull(e.Estee_ID, ea.Estee_ID) Estee_ID, isnull(e.Expiry_Date, ea.Expiry_Date) Expiry_Date, isnull(e.UnderlyingEstee_Id,ea.UnderlyingEstee_Id) UnderlyingEstee_Id
                                     ,isnull(e.Security_Type, ea.Security_Type) Security_Type  
                  FROM subscription_realtime (nolock) s  
                  LEFT JOIN esteemaster (nolock) e ON s.EsteeID = e.Estee_ID  
                  LEFT JOIN EsteeMaster_archive (nolock) ea on ea.Estee_ID = s.EsteeID and ea.Status = 1 
                  INNER JOIN ValidCombos v ON v.SecurityType = isnull(e.Security_Type, ea.Security_Type)  
                                              AND v.ExchangeCode = isnull(e.Exchange_Code, ea.Exchange_Code)  
				  INNER JOIN Strategy_New (nolock) sn on sn.SubStrategy_Name=s.Strategy_Name    
                  WHERE v.IsTraded = 1  and s.Strategy_Name not like '%adash%' and sn.Strategy_Status = 1;  
         CREATE TABLE #TempDailyPositions(Exchange_Code [CHAR](10), SecurityName NVARCHAR(75), Long BIGINT, Short BIGINT, TransactionCost DECIMAL(30, 10), Account_ID INT, SecurityType NVARCHAR(30), Estee_ID NVARCHAR(50), Sub_StrategyID VARCHAR(5), Broker_ID INT,  
		 PositionDate DATETIME, AverageTradedPrice DECIMAL(30, 10), BuyValue DECIMAL(30, 10), SellValue DECIMAL(30, 10), AverageHoldingPrice DECIMAL(30, 10), RuleId INT);  
         INSERT INTO #TempDailyPositions  
         EXEC GetAllPositionsForGivenDateAndParameters  
              @date = @Date,  
              @UseDailyPositionsTable = 1;  
         INSERT INTO #temp  
                SELECT DISTINCT  
                       t.Estee_ID, isnull(e.Expiry_Date, ea.Expiry_Date) Expiry_Date, isnull(e.UnderlyingEstee_Id,ea.UnderlyingEstee_Id) UnderlyingEstee_Id
                                     ,isnull(e.Security_Type, ea.Security_Type) Security_Type  
                  FROM #TempDailyPositions t  
                  LEFT JOIN esteemaster (nolock) e ON t.Estee_ID = e.Estee_ID 
                  LEFT JOIN EsteeMaster_archive (nolock) ea on ea.Estee_ID = t.Estee_ID and ea.Status = 1
                  LEFT JOIN #temp t1 ON t.Estee_Id = t1.Estee_ID  
                 WHERE isnull(e.Status, ea.Status) = 1 AND t1.Estee_ID IS NULL and isnull(e.Security_Type,ea.Security_Type) not in ( select typecode from SecurityType where GroupID in (2,5))  
     UNION  
     SELECT DISTINCT  
                       t.Estee_ID, e.Expiry_Date, e.UnderlyingEstee_Id, e.Security_Type  
                  FROM #TempDailyPositions t  
                  INNER JOIN esteemaster (nolock) e ON t.Estee_ID = e.Estee_ID  
                  LEFT JOIN #temp t1 ON t.Estee_Id = t1.Estee_ID  
                 WHERE e.Status = 1 AND t1.Estee_ID IS NULL and t.Long <> t.short and e.Security_Type in ( select typecode from SecurityType where GroupID in (2,5))  
     UNION  
     select distinct t.Estee_ID, e.Expiry_Date, e.UnderlyingEstee_Id, e.Security_Type from Trades (nolock) t inner join esteemaster (nolock) e on t.estee_id = e.Estee_Id  
     where creation_date > @Date - 32 and e.Security_Type in ( select typecode from SecurityType where GroupID in (2,5));  
         --Query to include 4 expiries of options and 10% strike price range.    
         INSERT INTO #temp  
                SELECT DISTINCT  
                       A.Estee_ID, Expiry_Date, UnderlyingEstee_Id, Security_Type  
                  FROM(SELECT DISTINCT  
                              e.Estee_ID, e.Expiry_Date, e.UnderlyingEstee_Id, e.Security_Type  
                         FROM esteemaster (nolock) e  
                         JOIN SecurityType st ON e.Security_Type = st.TypeCode  
                                                 AND st.GroupID = 4  
                         JOIN closingprice (nolock) cp ON e.UnderlyingEstee_Id = cp.Estee_ID  
                                                 AND cp.Date = @date  
                         LEFT JOIN #tempSecurityType ts ON ts.SecurityType = st.TypeCode
                         JOIN #temp t ON e.UnderlyingEstee_Id = t.UnderlyingEsteeId  
                                         AND e.Security_Type = t.SecurityType  
                        WHERE DATEDIFF(m, @date, e.Expiry_Date) <= 4 AND
						e.Strike_Price IS NULL OR e.Strike_Price = 0 OR 
						e.Strike_Price BETWEEN cp.Close_Price * (1- isnull(ts.Percentage, 0.15)) AND cp.Close_Price * (1 + isnull(ts.Percentage, 0.15))
                      ) A  
                  LEFT JOIN #temp t ON A.estee_Id = t.Estee_ID  
                 WHERE t.Estee_ID IS NULL;  
         --Query to include 4 expiries of futures  
         INSERT INTO #temp  
                select distinct x.Estee_ID,x.Expiry_Date,x.UnderlyingEstee_Id,x.Security_Type from  (SELECT DISTINCT  
                       e.Estee_ID, e.Expiry_Date, e.UnderlyingEstee_Id, e.Security_Type,e.Exchange_Code,
					   dense_rank() over(partition by e.ContractExpiryCycle,e.Underlying_Ticker,e.Security_Type order by substring(e.Estee_ID,17,8),e.ContractExpiryCycle) as rank1   
                  FROM esteemaster (nolock) e  
                  JOIN SecurityType st ON st.GroupID = 3  
     AND e.Security_Type = st.TypeCode  
                  JOIN closingprice (nolock) cp ON e.UnderlyingEstee_Id = cp.Estee_ID  
                                          AND cp.Date = @Date  
                  JOIN #temp t ON e.UnderlyingEstee_Id = t.UnderlyingEsteeId  
                                  AND e.Security_Type = t.SecurityType  
          LEFT JOIN #temp t1 ON e.Estee_ID = t1.Estee_ID  
                 WHERE DATEDIFF(m, @date, Expiry_Date) <= 4  
                       AND t1.Estee_ID IS NULL) x  inner join #NoOfContractsNeeded t on t.Exchange_Code=x.Exchange_Code and t.SecurityType=x.Security_Type where
					   x.rank1<=t.noofcontractneeded  
		SELECT t.Estee_ID, ExpiryDate  
           FROM #temp t inner join esteemaster (nolock) e on t.Estee_ID = e.Estee_ID
         DROP TABLE #temp;  
     Drop table #TempDailyPositions  
  DROP TABLE #MissingIndexEsteeIds  
  DROP TABLE #tempSecurityType
  END


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetEsteeIDforHistoricalPrices_New

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetEsteeIDforHistoricalPrices_New]   

@Date DATETIME ,

@tPlusXDate DATETIME   

AS  

     BEGIN  

         CREATE TABLE #temp(Estee_ID VARCHAR(50), ExpiryDate DATETIME, UnderlyingEsteeId VARCHAR(50), SecurityType INT);  

		 SELECT DISTINCT E.Member_Estee_ID into #MissingIndexEsteeIds FROM IndexTable (nolock) E WHERE E.Member_Estee_ID NOT IN (SELECT B.Member_Estee_ID  FROM IndexTable (nolock) B WHERE  B.AsOfDate = @Date) AND AsOfDate <= @tPlusXDate AND AsOfDate > @Date

			insert into #temp		

			select t.Member_Estee_ID, '',t.Member_Estee_ID, 1 from #MissingIndexEsteeIds t

         INSERT INTO #temp  

                SELECT DISTINCT  

                       e.Estee_ID, e.Expiry_Date, e.UnderlyingEstee_Id, e.Security_Type  

                  FROM subscription_realtime (nolock) s  

                  INNER JOIN esteemaster (nolock) e ON s.EsteeID = e.Estee_ID  

                  INNER JOIN ValidCombos (nolock) v ON v.SecurityType = e.Security_Type  

                                              AND v.ExchangeCode = e.Exchange_Code  

				  INNER JOIN Strategy_New (nolock) sn on sn.SubStrategy_Name=s.Strategy_Name  

                  WHERE v.IsTraded = 1  and s.Strategy_Name not like '%adash%' and sn.Strategy_Status = 1;  

         CREATE TABLE #TempDailyPositions(Exchange_Code [CHAR](10), SecurityName NVARCHAR(75), Long BIGINT, Short BIGINT, TransactionCost DECIMAL(30, 10), Account_ID INT, SecurityType NVARCHAR(30), Estee_ID NVARCHAR(50), Sub_StrategyID VARCHAR(5), Broker_ID INT


, PositionDate DATETIME, AverageTradedPrice DECIMAL(30, 10), BuyValue DECIMAL(30, 10), SellValue DECIMAL(30, 10), AverageHoldingPrice DECIMAL(30, 10));  

         INSERT INTO #TempDailyPositions  

         EXEC GetAllPositionsForGivenDateAndParameters  

              @date = @Date,  

              @UseDailyPositionsTable = 1;  

         INSERT INTO #temp  

                SELECT DISTINCT  

                       t.Estee_ID, e.Expiry_Date, e.UnderlyingEstee_Id, e.Security_Type  

                  FROM #TempDailyPositions t  

                  INNER JOIN esteemaster (nolock) e ON t.Estee_ID = e.Estee_ID  

                  LEFT JOIN #temp t1 ON t.Estee_Id = t1.Estee_ID  

                 WHERE e.Status = 1 and t.Long <> t.Short

                       AND t1.Estee_ID IS NULL;  

         --Query to include 4 expiries of options and 10% strike price range.  

         INSERT INTO #temp  

                SELECT DISTINCT  

                       A.Estee_ID, Expiry_Date, UnderlyingEstee_Id, Security_Type  

                  FROM(SELECT DISTINCT  

                              e.Estee_ID, e.Expiry_Date, e.UnderlyingEstee_Id, e.Security_Type  

                         FROM esteemaster (nolock) e  

                         JOIN SecurityType (nolock) st ON e.Security_Type = st.TypeCode  

                                                 AND st.GroupID = 4  

                         JOIN closingprice (nolock) cp ON e.UnderlyingEstee_Id = cp.Estee_ID  

                                                 AND cp.Date = @date  

                                                 AND (e.Strike_Price IS NULL  

                                                      OR e.Strike_Price = 0  

                                                      OR e.Strike_Price BETWEEN cp.Close_Price * 0.85 AND cp.Close_Price * 1.15)  

                         JOIN #temp t ON e.UnderlyingEstee_Id = t.UnderlyingEsteeId  

                                         AND e.Security_Type = t.SecurityType  

                        WHERE DATEDIFF(m, @date, e.Expiry_Date) <= 4  

                      ) A  

                  LEFT JOIN #temp t ON A.estee_Id = t.Estee_ID  

                 WHERE t.Estee_ID IS NULL;  

         --Query to include 4 expiries of futures  

         INSERT INTO #temp  

                SELECT DISTINCT  

                       e.Estee_ID, e.Expiry_Date, e.UnderlyingEstee_Id, e.Security_Type  

                  FROM esteemaster (nolock) e  

                  JOIN SecurityType (nolock) st ON st.GroupID = 3  

     AND e.Security_Type = st.TypeCode  

                  JOIN closingprice (nolock) cp ON e.UnderlyingEstee_Id = cp.Estee_ID  

                                          AND cp.Date = @Date  

                  JOIN #temp t ON e.UnderlyingEstee_Id = t.UnderlyingEsteeId  

                                  AND e.Security_Type = t.SecurityType  

          LEFT JOIN #temp t1 ON e.Estee_ID = t1.Estee_ID  

                 WHERE DATEDIFF(m, @date, Expiry_Date) <= 4  

                       AND t1.Estee_ID IS NULL;  

         SELECT Estee_ID, ExpiryDate  

           FROM #temp;  

         DROP TABLE #temp;  

     Drop table #TempDailyPositions  

  DROP TABLE #MissingIndexEsteeIds

     END;

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetEsteeMaster

```sql
CREATE Procedure [dbo].[GetEsteeMaster]
@exchangeList varchar(200),
@securityTypes varchar(200)
As

Begin
	DECLARE @ExchangeCodes TABLE(Exchange_Code [char](10))
	DECLARE @secTypes TABLE(secType int)

	INSERT into @ExchangeCodes SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) from dbo.split(@exchangeList,',')
	INSERT into @secTypes SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) from dbo.split(@securityTypes,',')

	select Estee_ID from esteemaster where Exchange_Code in (select Exchange_Code from @ExchangeCodes)
	and Security_Type in (select secType from @secTypes)

End

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetEsteeMasterForExchange

```sql
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetEsteeMasterForExchange]       
 @ExchangeCodeList ListString readonly
AS      
 select em.Exchange_Code, Underlying_Ticker,em.DataFeed_Ticker ,em.Security_Type as SecurityType_Code, em.Expiry_Date,em.Expiry_Date2, em.Strike_Price,   
 em.Lot_Size,em.Estee_ID,ex.name as Exchange_Name,SUBSTRING(em.Estee_ID,1,16) as Estee_ID,st.TypeName as SecurityType_Name   
 from esteemaster em with (nolock)  
 inner join Exchange ex on ex.code = em.Exchange_Code  
 inner join SecurityType st on st.TypeCode= em.Security_Type   
 Where em.Status = 1  
 order by Exchange_Code,Underlying_Ticker,Security_Type,em.Expiry_Date,em.Expiry_Date2,em.Strike_Price
```

```sql
-- =============================================

-- Description:	Get ETF component for a given ETF and date
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetETFComponents] 
	@ETFEsteeID char(16),
	@AsOfDate date
AS
BEGIN
	Select MemberEsteeID, Quantity
	From ETFComponents
	Where ETFEsteeID = @ETFEsteeID
	and AsOfDate = @AsOfDate
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetExchangesTradedAtLocation

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Apoorva Mishra
-- Create date: 01 May 2013
-- Description:	Get list of all exchanges traded on a Trade centre
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetExchangesTradedAtLocation] 
	@LocationCode char(3)
AS
BEGIN
	select distinct A.exchange_Code 
	from EsteeApplications EA
	inner join EsteeServers ES
		on EA.EsteeServer_ID = ES.ID
		and ES.LocationCode = @LocationCode
		and EA.SubStrategy_ID is not null
	inner join Strategy_New SN
		on SN.SubStrategy_Id = EA.SubStrategy_ID
		and SN.Strategy_Status = 1
	inner join StrategyBrokerAccount SBA
		on SBA.subStrategyID = EA.SubStrategy_ID
	inner join Account A
		on SBA.accountID = A.Account_ID
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetExecIdList

```sql


CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetExecIdList]
	@date datetime
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	SELECT T.OrderTrade_ID, T.ExecID as Exec_ID 
	FROM Trades T
	WHERE T.Creation_Date = @date and T.Traded_Quantity > 0
	ORDER BY T.OrderTrade_ID
END



```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetFailedJobsReport

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[GetFailedJobsReport]
@startTime datetime
AS
select JobCode, ServerIP, StartDateTime, EndDateTime, ExecutionStatus, ArgumentPassed 
from JobHistory 
where JobCode not in (
select distinct jobcode from JobHistory where StartDateTime > @startTime
and ExecutionStatus in ('Successful') 
UNION
select 'MISC_FailedJobsReport' JobCode)
and StartDateTime > @startTime
and ExecutionStatus <> 'NotRunOnHoliday'
union
select JobCode, ServerIP, StartDateTime, EndDateTime, ExecutionStatus, ArgumentPassed   
from JobHistory   
where JobCode in (Select Distinct JobCode from JobHistory where ArgumentPassed NOT IN(
Select Distinct ArgumentPassed from JobHistory where StartDateTime > @startTime and (ExecutionStatus like 'Successful' OR ExecutionStatus like 'AlreadyRan' )
)and StartDateTime > @startTime)
and StartDateTime > @startTime
and ExecutionStatus not like 'Successful'
and ExecutionStatus not like 'NotRunOnHoliday' and (jobcode like '%MISC_ExpiryRollover_Process%')
order by StartDateTime, JobCode  

```
