## Function: dbo.GetFirstDateOfMonth

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[GetFirstDateOfMonth] (@date datetime)  
RETURNS datetime  
AS  
-- place the body of the function here  
BEGIN  
 DECLARE @firstDateOfMonth datetime  
 SET @firstDateOfMonth = CAST(FLOOR(CAST(@date AS DECIMAL(12, 5))) - (DAY(@date) - 1) AS DATETIME)  
 return @firstDateOfMonth
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetGivenDateRangeLinkedOrders

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetGivenDateRangeLinkedOrders]                
@fromDate datetime = null,  
@toDate datetime = null,  
@listAccountID nvarchar(100) = null,  
@listBrokerID nvarchar(100)  = null,  
@listSubStrategyID nvarchar(500)  = null,  
@listEsteeID varchar(max) = null,  
@listStatus nvarchar(200) = null  
AS                
BEGIN  
 DECLARE @toDatePlusOne datetime  
 SET @toDatePlusOne = DATEADD(d, 1, @toDate)  

  
 DECLARE @Account TABLE(accountID int)  
 if(@listAccountID is null OR @listAccountID = '')  
 begin  
  INSERT into @Account Select account_ID from account  
 end  
 else  
 begin  
  INSERT into @Account SELECT * from dbo.split(@listAccountID,',')  
 end  
  
 DECLARE @Broker TABLE(broker_id int)  
 if(@listBrokerID is null OR @listBrokerID = '')  
 begin  
  INSERT into @Broker Select broker_id from broker  
 end  
 else  
 begin  
  INSERT into @Broker SELECT * from dbo.split(@listBrokerID,',')  
 end  
  
 DECLARE @SubStrategy TABLE(subStrategyID int)   
 if(@listSubStrategyID is null OR @listSubStrategyID = '')  
 begin  
  INSERT into @SubStrategy Select distinct subStrategy_ID from strategy_New  
 end  
 else  
 begin  
  INSERT into @SubStrategy SELECT * from dbo.split(@listSubStrategyID,',')  
 end  
  
 DECLARE @EsteeTable TABLE(ISIN varchar(50))  
 DECLARE @EsteeTableTemp TABLE(ISIN varchar(50))  
 if(@listEsteeID is null OR @listEsteeID = '')  
 begin  
  INSERT into @EsteeTableTemp   
  Select SUBSTRING(estee_id,1,12) as ISIN from esteemaster  where  Exchange_Code='IS' and status=1
  INSERT into @EsteeTable SELECT distinct ISIN FROM @EsteeTableTemp  
 end  
 else  
 begin  
  INSERT into @EsteeTable SELECT * from dbo.split(@listEsteeID,',')  
 end  
  
 DECLARE @StatusTable TABLE(statusName varchar(50))  
  
 if(@listStatus is null OR @listStatus = '')  
 begin
	INSERT into @StatusTable SELECT 'Open'
	INSERT into @StatusTable SELECT 'Reversed'
	INSERT into @StatusTable SELECT 'Closed'
	INSERT into @StatusTable SELECT 'Complete'
	INSERT into @StatusTable SELECT 'InComplete'
 end
 else 
 begin
	INSERT into @StatusTable SELECT * from dbo.split(@listStatus,',')
 end
    --Declaring temp table to hold the result set to be returned.  
 DECLARE @tempDailyLinkedOrders TABLE(DataFeedTicker nvarchar(75), TotalLockedProfit decimal(20, 4),   
 TotalRealizedProfit decimal(20, 4), NetProfit decimal(20, 4), TransactionCost decimal(20, 4), Account_ID int,   
 Estee_ID nvarchar(75), Sub_StrategyID varchar(5), Broker_ID int, LinkID int, Status nvarchar(25),   
 LinkedOrderDate datetime, Total_Positions int, Total_MTM decimal(20, 4), Total_Money_Deployed decimal(20, 4))  
  
 --Declaring temp table to hold the result of the executing procedure whose purpose is to get the linked orders  
 --from the trades table.  
 DECLARE @tempDailyLinkedOrdersTrades TABLE(DataFeedTicker nvarchar(75), TotalLockedProfit decimal(20, 4),   
 TotalRealizedProfit decimal(20, 4), NetProfit decimal(20, 4), TransactionCost decimal(20, 4), Account_ID int,   
 Estee_ID nvarchar(75), Sub_StrategyID varchar(5), Broker_ID int, LinkID int, Status nvarchar(25),   
 LinkedOrderDate datetime, Total_Positions int, Total_MTM decimal(20, 4), Total_Money_Deployed decimal(20, 4))  
   
 declare @rowsCount int   
 --Checking if the table dailyLinkedorders contains the linked orders for the "from date".  
 set @rowsCount = (SELECT count(*) from dailyLinkedorders where datediff(dd, LinkedOrderDate, @fromDate) = 0)   
 if(@rowsCount > 0)   
 begin  
 --If it contains then checking whether this table contains the orders for the "to date".  
 set @rowsCount = (SELECT count(*) from dailyLinkedorders where datediff(dd, LinkedOrderDate, @toDate) = 0)   
 if(@rowsCount <= 0)  
 begin  
  --If it does not contain then combining the orders for the "to date" i.e recalculating from trades table  
  --and the given date range trades from the dailyLinkedorders table.  
  --Assuming that table dailyLinkedorders contains all the trades before the given "to date".  
  INSERT INTO @tempDailyLinkedOrdersTrades(DataFeedTicker, TotalLockedProfit, TotalRealizedProfit, NetProfit,   
  TransactionCost, Account_ID, Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, LinkID, Status, LinkedOrderDate,   
  Total_Positions, Total_MTM, Total_Money_Deployed)  
   select * from dbo.FuncGetAllLinkedOrdersForGivenDateRange(@toDate, @toDatePlusOne)  
--   exec GetAllLinkedOrdersForGivenDateRange @toDate, @toDatePlusOne   
  
  INSERT INTO @tempDailyLinkedOrders(Estee_ID, DataFeedTicker, LinkID, Total_Money_Deployed, TotalLockedProfit,   
  TotalRealizedProfit, Total_MTM, TransactionCost, NetProfit, Broker_ID, Account_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Status, LinkedOrderDate)  
  
  Select DLO.Estee_ID AS Estee_ID, DatafeedTicker AS Datafeed_Ticker, Linkid as Total_Positions,   
  0 as Total_Money_Deployed, TotalLockedProfit as Total_Locked_Profit,   
  TotalRealizedProfit as Total_Realised_Profit, 0 as Total_MTM, TransactionCost as Total_TC,   
  (TotalLockedProfit + TotalRealizedProfit - TransactionCost) AS NetProfit, DLO.Broker_ID AS Broker_ID,  
  Account_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Status, LinkedOrderDate   
  from DailyLinkedOrders DLO   
  where LinkedOrderDate >= @fromDate and LinkedOrderDate < @toDate  
  UNION ALL  
  Select Estee_ID AS Estee_ID, DatafeedTicker AS Datafeed_Ticker, Linkid as Total_Positions,   
  0 as Total_Money_Deployed, TotalLockedProfit as Total_Locked_Profit,   
  TotalRealizedProfit as Total_Realised_Profit, 0 as Total_MTM, TransactionCost as Total_TC,   
  (TotalLockedProfit + TotalRealizedProfit - TransactionCost) AS NetProfit, Broker_ID AS Broker_ID,  
  Account_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Status, LinkedOrderDate   
  from @tempDailyLinkedOrdersTrades  
  
 end  
 else  
 begin  
 --If all the date range orders can be found from the dailylinkedorders table. Then picking them from there.  
  INSERT INTO @tempDailyLinkedOrders(DataFeedTicker, Total_Positions, Total_Money_Deployed,   
     TotalLockedProfit, TotalRealizedProfit, NetProfit, Total_MTM, TransactionCost, Account_ID,   
     Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, LinkID, Status, LinkedOrderDate)  
  
  Select DatafeedTicker AS Datafeed_Ticker, Linkid as Total_Positions, 0 as Total_Money_Deployed,   
  TotalLockedProfit as Total_Locked_Profit, TotalRealizedProfit as Total_Realised_Profit,   
  (TotalLockedProfit + TotalRealizedProfit - TransactionCost) AS NetProfit, 0 as Total_MTM,   
  TransactionCost as Total_TC, Account_ID, DLO.Estee_ID AS Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, DLO.Broker_ID AS Broker_ID,  
  LinkID, DLO.Status, LinkedOrderDate  
  
  from DailyLinkedOrders DLO  
  where LinkedOrderDate >= @fromDate and LinkedOrderDate < @toDatePlusOne  
 end  
 end   
 else   
 begin  
 --If the table dailylinkedorders does not contain the orders then picking them from trades table.  
  INSERT INTO @tempDailyLinkedOrders(DataFeedTicker, TotalLockedProfit, TotalRealizedProfit, NetProfit,   
  TransactionCost, Account_ID, Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, LinkID, Status, LinkedOrderDate,   
  Total_Positions, Total_MTM, Total_Money_Deployed)  
   select * from dbo.FuncGetAllLinkedOrdersForGivenDateRange(@toDate, @toDatePlusOne)  
--   exec GetAllLinkedOrdersForGivenDateRange @fromDate, @toDatePlusOne  
 END  
  
 SELECT 
	Temp.DataFeedTicker, 
	TotalLockedProfit, 
	TotalRealizedProfit, 
	NetProfit, 
	TransactionCost, 
	Account_ID,   
	Temp.Estee_ID, 
	Sub_StrategyID,
	Temp.Broker_ID, 
	LinkID, 
	Temp.Status, 
	LinkedOrderDate, 
	Total_Positions,   
	Total_MTM, 
	Total_Money_Deployed  
 FROM @tempDailyLinkedOrders Temp  
	INNER JOIN Broker Bro ON Temp.Broker_ID = Bro.Broker_ID    
 where 
	 Bro.broker_id IN (Select broker_id FROM @Broker) 
	 and Temp.Account_ID IN (Select accountID FROM @Account)   
	 and Temp.Sub_StrategyID IN (Select subStrategyID FROM @SubStrategy) 
	 and Temp.Status IN (Select statusName FROM @StatusTable)   
	 and SUBSTRING(Temp.Estee_ID, 0,13) IN (Select ISIN FROM @EsteeTable)  
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetHierarchyForRCF

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetHierarchyForRCF]

	  @substrategyList INTEGERLISTTYPE READONLY

AS

	 BEGIN  

		 -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from  

		 -- interfering with SELECT statements.  

		 SET NOCOUNT ON;

		 DECLARE @Exchanges TABLE(

								  ClrAccId INT,

								  eCode    VARCHAR(500)

		 );

		 WITH cte(ClearingAccountID, Exchange_code)

			  AS (SELECT DISTINCT

						 ClearingAccountID, RTRIM(LTRIM(Exchange_code))

				  FROM   Account

				  WHERE  Status = 'Active')

			  INSERT INTO @Exchanges

			  SELECT                                   ClearingAccountID, STUFF(

																			   (

																				   SELECT ', '+exchange_Code

																				   FROM    cte

																				   WHERE  ClearingAccountID = Results.ClearingAccountID

																				   FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE

																			   ).value('(./text())[1]', 'VARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '') AS NameValues

			  FROM cte AS Results

			  GROUP BY ClearingAccountID;

		 -- Account-SCA  

		 SELECT DISTINCT

				14 AS ParentDimensionId, ca.ClearingAccountID AS ParentDimensionValue, ca.ClearingAccountID AS ParentId, ca.ClearingAccountName AS ParentName, 

				'' AS ParentExchange, c.CurrencyCode AS ParentCurrency, '' AS ParentOwner, 13 AS ChildDimensionId, CAST(SC.ID AS VARCHAR(10))+'_'+CAST(ca.ClearingAccountID AS VARCHAR(10)) AS ChildDimensionValue, 

				sc.ID AS ChildId, sc.Name AS ChildName, ex.eCode AS ChildExchange, c.CurrencyCode AS ChildCurrency, sc.Owner AS ChildOwner,'' as CoOwners

		 FROM   dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount AS sba

				JOIN Strategy_new AS sn ON sba.subStrategyID = sn.SubStrategy_Id

				JOIN dbo.StrategyGroup AS sg ON sn.Strategy_Id = sg.StrategyID

				JOIN StrategyCategory AS SC ON sg.CategoryID = sc.ID

				JOIN dbo.Account AS a ON sba.accountID = a.Account_ID

										 AND a.Status = 'Active'

				JOIN ClearingAccount AS ca ON ca.ClearingAccountID = a.ClearingAccountID

				JOIN @Exchanges AS ex ON ex.ClrAccId = A.ClearingAccountID

				INNER JOIN @substrategyList AS sl ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sl.n

				JOIN Currency AS c ON c.ID = ca.BaseCurrencyID

		 ORDER BY ParentId, ChildId;  

		 -- S - SA  

		 SELECT 1 AS ParentDimensionId, sn.SubStrategy_Id AS ParentDimensionValue, sn.SubStrategy_Id AS ParentId, 

		 sn.SubStrategy_Name AS ParentName, '' AS ParentExchange, C.CurrencyCode AS ParentCurrency, sn.ownerUserID AS ParentOwner,

		  3 AS ChildDimensionId, CAST(A.Account_ID AS VARCHAR(10))+'_'+CAST(sn.SubStrategy_Id AS VARCHAR(10)) AS ChildDimensionValue,

		   sn.SubStrategy_Id AS ChildId, sn.SubStrategy_Name AS ChildName, A.exchange_Code AS ChildExchange, A.currency AS ChildCurrency, sn.ownerUserID AS ChildOwner,'' as CoOwners

		 FROM   StrategyBrokerAccount AS sba

				INNER JOIN Account AS A ON sba.accountID = a.Account_ID

										   AND A.Status = 'Active'

				INNER JOIN Strategy_New AS sn ON sba.subStrategyID = sn.SubStrategy_Id

												 AND sn.Strategy_Status = 1

				INNER JOIN Currency AS C ON sn.BaseCurrencyID = C.ID

				INNER JOIN @substrategyList AS sl ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sl.n

		 ORDER BY ParentId, ChildId;  

		 -- SG -SA  

		 SELECT DISTINCT 6 AS ParentDimensionId, sg.StrategyID AS ParentDimensionValue, sg.StrategyID AS ParentId, 

		 sg.StrategyName AS ParentName, '' AS ParentExchange, C.CurrencyCode AS ParentCurrency, sg.Owner AS ParentOwner,

		  3 AS ChildDimensionId, CAST(A.Account_ID AS VARCHAR(10))+'_'+CAST(sn.SubStrategy_Id AS VARCHAR(10)) AS ChildDimensionValue, 

		  sn.SubStrategy_Id AS ChildId, sn.SubStrategy_Name AS ChildName, A.exchange_Code AS ChildExchange, A.currency AS ChildCurrency, sn.ownerUserID AS ChildOwner,sg.CoOwners as CoOwners

		 FROM   StrategyGroup AS sg

				INNER JOIN Strategy_New AS sn ON sg.StrategyID = sn.Strategy_Id

												 AND sn.Strategy_Status = 1

				INNER JOIN StrategyBrokerAccount AS sba ON sba.subStrategyID = sn.SubStrategy_Id

				INNER JOIN Account AS A ON sba.accountID = A.Account_ID

										   AND A.Status = 'Active'

				INNER JOIN @substrategyList AS sl ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sl.n

				INNER JOIN Currency AS C ON sg.CurrencyID = C.ID

		 ORDER BY ParentId, ChildId;  

		 --SC-SG  

		 SELECT DISTINCT 11 AS ParentDimensionId, sc.ID AS ParentDimensionValue, sc.ID AS ParentId, sc.Name AS ParentName,

		  '' AS ParentExchange, C.CurrencyCode AS ParentCurrency, sc.Owner AS ParentOwner, 6 AS ChildDimensionId, sg.StrategyID AS ChildDimensionValue, 

		  sg.StrategyID AS ChildId, sg.StrategyName AS ChildName, '' AS ChildExchange, C1.CurrencyCode AS ChildCurrency, sg.Owner AS ChildOwner,sc.CoOwners as  CoOwners

		 FROM   StrategyGroup AS sg

				INNER JOIN StrategyCategory AS sc ON sc.ID = sg.CategoryID

				INNER JOIN dbo.Strategy_New AS SN ON sn.Strategy_Id = sg.StrategyID

				INNER JOIN @substrategyList AS sl ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sl.n

				INNER JOIN Currency AS C ON sc.Currency = C.ID

				INNER JOIN Currency AS C1 ON sg.CurrencyID = C1.ID

		 ORDER BY ParentId, ChildId;  

		 --SC-SCA  

		 SELECT DISTINCT

				11 AS ParentDimensionId, sc.ID AS ParentDimensionValue, SC.ID AS ParentId, SC.Name AS ParentName, '' AS ParentExchange,

				 C.CurrencyCode AS ParentCurrency, sc.Owner AS ParentOwner, 13 AS ChildDimensionId, CAST(SC.ID AS VARCHAR(10))+'_'+CAST(ca.ClearingAccountID AS VARCHAR(10)) AS ChildDimensionValue,

				  ca.ClearingAccountID AS ChildId, ca.ClearingAccountName AS ChildName, ex.eCode AS ChildExchange, c.CurrencyCode AS ChildCurrency, sc.Owner AS ChildOwner,'' as CoOwners

		 FROM   dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount AS sba

				JOIN dbo.Strategy_New AS sn ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sba.subStrategyID

				JOIN dbo.StrategyGroup AS sg ON sn.Strategy_Id = sg.StrategyID

				JOIN StrategyCategory AS SC ON sg.CategoryID = sc.ID

				JOIN dbo.Account AS a ON sba.accountID = a.Account_ID

										 AND a.Status = 'Active'

				JOIN ClearingAccount AS ca ON ca.ClearingAccountID = a.ClearingAccountID

				JOIN @Exchanges AS ex ON ex.ClrAccId = ca.ClearingAccountID

				INNER JOIN @substrategyList AS sl ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sl.n

				INNER JOIN Currency AS C ON ca.BaseCurrencyID = C.ID

		 ORDER BY ParentId, ChildId;  

		 --LE-A

		 SELECT DISTINCT 15 AS ParentDimensionId, LE.LegalEntityId AS ParentDimensionValue, LE.LegalEntityId AS ParentId, LE.LegalEntityName AS ParentName, '' AS ParentExchange, C.CurrencyCode AS ParentCurrency, LE.OwnerId AS ParentOwner, 14 AS ChildDimensionId


, CA.ClearingAccountID AS ChildDimensionValue, CA.ClearingAccountID AS ChildId, CA.ClearingAccountName AS ChildName, ex.eCode AS ChildExchange, CAC.CurrencyCode AS ChildCurrency, '' AS ChildOwner,'' as CoOwners

		 FROM   LegalEntity AS LE

				JOIN ClearingAccount AS CA ON LE.LegalEntityId = CA.LegalEntityId

				INNER JOIN dbo.Account AS A ON CA.ClearingAccountID = A.ClearingAccountID

				INNER JOIN dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount AS SBA ON sba.accountID = a.Account_ID

				INNER JOIN dbo.Strategy_New AS SN ON SBA.subStrategyID = sn.SubStrategy_Id

				INNER JOIN @substrategyList AS sl ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sl.n

				INNER JOIN @Exchanges AS ex ON ex.ClrAccId = cA.ClearingAccountID

				INNER JOIN Currency AS C ON LE.BaseCurrencyID = C.ID

				INNER JOIN Currency AS CAC ON CA.BaseCurrencyId = CAC.ID

		 ORDER BY ParentId, ChildId;	 

		--LE-SC

		 select distinct 15 as ParentDimensionId, LE.LegalEntityId as ParentDimensionValue, LE.LegalEntityId as ParentId, LE.LegalEntityName as ParentName,LE.BaseCurrencyId as ParentCurrency,

				LE.OwnerId as ParentOwner, '' as ParentExchange,16 as ChildDimensionId, cast(LE.LegalEntityId AS varchar(10))+'_' +cast( SC.ID AS varchar(10)) as ChildDimensionValue, sc.ID as ChildId, SC.Name as ChildName, SC.Currency as ChildCurrency,

				SC.Owner as ChildOwner, '' as ChildExchange,sc.CoOwners as  CoOwners

				from LegalEntity LE

				inner join ClearingAccount CA on CA.LegalEntityId = le.LegalEntityId

				inner join Account A on A.ClearingAccountID=CA.ClearingAccountID

				inner join StrategyBrokerAccount sba on sba.accountID = A.Account_ID

				inner join Strategy_new sn on sn.SubStrategy_Id=sba.subStrategyID and sn.Strategy_Status=1

				inner join StrategyGroup Sg on sg.StrategyID = sn.Strategy_Id

				inner join StrategyCategory sc on sc.id =sg.CategoryID

				inner join @substrategyList sl on sn.SubStrategy_Id = sl.n

				order by ParentId, ChildId;

				--CA-SG
		SELECT DISTINCT

				14 AS ParentDimensionId, CA.ClearingAccountID AS ParentDimensionValue, CA.ClearingAccountID AS ParentId, CA.ClearingAccountName AS ParentName, '' AS ParentExchange,

				 C.CurrencyCode AS ParentCurrency, '' AS ParentOwner, 17 AS ChildDimensionId, cast(CA.ClearingAccountID AS varchar(10))+'_' +cast(SG.StrategyID AS varchar(10)) AS ChildDimensionValue,

				  Sg.StrategyID AS ChildId, Sg.StrategyName AS ChildName, ex.eCode AS ChildExchange, c.CurrencyCode AS ChildCurrency, sg.Owner AS ChildOwner,'' as CoOwners

		 FROM   dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount AS sba

				JOIN dbo.Strategy_New AS sn ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sba.subStrategyID

				JOIN dbo.StrategyGroup AS sg ON sn.Strategy_Id = sg.StrategyID

				JOIN StrategyCategory AS SC ON sg.CategoryID = sc.ID

				JOIN dbo.Account AS a ON sba.accountID = a.Account_ID

										 AND a.Status = 'Active'

				JOIN ClearingAccount AS ca ON ca.ClearingAccountID = a.ClearingAccountID

				JOIN @Exchanges AS ex ON ex.ClrAccId = ca.ClearingAccountID

				INNER JOIN @substrategyList AS sl ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sl.n

				INNER JOIN Currency AS C ON ca.BaseCurrencyID = C.ID

		 ORDER BY ParentId, ChildId;

		 --LE-SG
			select distinct 15 as ParentDimensionId, LE.LegalEntityId as ParentDimensionValue, LE.LegalEntityId as ParentId, LE.LegalEntityName as ParentName,LE.BaseCurrencyId as ParentCurrency,

				LE.OwnerId as ParentOwner, '' as ParentExchange,18 as ChildDimensionId, cast(LE.LegalEntityId AS varchar(10))+'_' +cast( Sg.StrategyID AS varchar(10)) as ChildDimensionValue, Sg.StrategyID as ChildId, Sg.StrategyName as ChildName, SG.CurrencyID as ChildCurrency,

				SG.Owner as ChildOwner, '' as ChildExchange,sc.CoOwners as  CoOwners

				from LegalEntity LE

				inner join ClearingAccount CA on CA.LegalEntityId = le.LegalEntityId

				inner join Account A on A.ClearingAccountID=CA.ClearingAccountID

				inner join StrategyBrokerAccount sba on sba.accountID = A.Account_ID

				inner join Strategy_new sn on sn.SubStrategy_Id=sba.subStrategyID and sn.Strategy_Status=1

				inner join StrategyGroup Sg on sg.StrategyID = sn.Strategy_Id

				inner join StrategyCategory sc on sc.id =sg.CategoryID

				inner join @substrategyList sl on sn.SubStrategy_Id = sl.n

				order by ParentId, ChildId;

			--SG-CA

			select distinct 6 as ParentDimensionId, SG.StrategyID as ParentDimensionValue, SG.StrategyID as ParentId, SG.StrategyName as ParentName, SG.CurrencyID as ParentCurrency,

			'' as ParentOwner,'' AS ParentExchange,

			19 as ChildDimensionId,   cast(SG.StrategyID AS varchar(10))+'_'+cast(CA.ClearingAccountID AS varchar(10)) as ChildDimensionValue, CA.ClearingAccountID as ChildId, CA.ClearingAccountName as ChildName, CA.BaseCurrencyID as ChildCurrency,

			'' as ChildOwner, ex.eCode as ChildExchange, sg.CoOwners as CoOwners

			from dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount sba

			inner join Strategy_new sn on sn.SubStrategy_Id=sba.subStrategyID and sn.Strategy_Status=1

			inner join StrategyGroup Sg on sg.StrategyID = sn.Strategy_Id

			inner join StrategyCategory sc on sc.id =sg.CategoryID

			inner join Account A on sba.accountID = A.Account_ID and A.Status='active'  

			inner join ClearingAccount CA on CA.ClearingAccountID = a.ClearingAccountID and A.Status='active'

			inner join @Exchanges ex on ex.ClrAccId = CA.ClearingAccountID

			inner join @substrategyList sl on sn.SubStrategy_Id = sl.n

			order by ParentId, ChildId

--Fund - SC      
select distinct 7 as ParentDimensionId, F.id as ParentDimensionValue, F.id as ParentId, F.name as ParentName, '' AS ParentExchange,
F.BaseCurrencyID as ParentCurrency,F.OwnerID as ParentOwner, 11 as ChildDimensionId, 
SC.ID as ChildDimensionValue, SC.ID as ChildId, SC.Name as ChildName,'' as ChildExchange, SC.Currency as ChildCurrency,    
Sc.Owner as ChildOwner, '' as CoOwners   
from StrategyCategory SC      
inner join InvestmentFund F on sc.FundId= F.id      
inner join StrategyGroup Sg on sc.ID=sg.CategoryID      
inner join Strategy_new sn on sn.Strategy_Id= sg.StrategyID and sn.Strategy_Status=1   
order by ParentId, ChildId

--SCCA-Strategy
SELECT DISTINCT
       13 AS ParentDimensionId, CAST(SC.ID AS VARCHAR(10))+'_'+CAST(ca.ClearingAccountID AS VARCHAR(10)) AS ParentDimensionValue,
       CAST(SC.ID AS VARCHAR(10))+'_'+CAST(ca.ClearingAccountID AS VARCHAR(10)) as ParentId,
       SC.Name + ' - ' + ca.ClearingAccountName AS ParentName,
       '' AS ParentExchange,
       C.CurrencyCode AS ParentCurrency,
       sc.Owner AS ParentOwner,
       3 AS ChildDimensionId,
	   CAST(A.Account_ID AS VARCHAR(10))+'_'+CAST(sn.SubStrategy_Id AS VARCHAR(10)) AS ChildDimensionValue,
       sn.SubStrategy_Id AS ChildId,
       sn.SubStrategy_Name AS ChildName,
       ex.eCode AS ChildExchange,
       C2.CurrencyCode AS ChildCurrency,
       sn.ownerUserID AS ChildOwner,
       '' AS CoOwners
FROM   dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount AS sba
       JOIN dbo.Strategy_New AS sn ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sba.subStrategyID AND sn.Strategy_Status = 1
       JOIN dbo.StrategyGroup AS sg ON sn.Strategy_Id = sg.StrategyID
       JOIN StrategyCategory AS SC ON sg.CategoryID = sc.ID
       JOIN dbo.Account AS a ON sba.accountID = a.Account_ID AND a.Status = 'Active'
       JOIN ClearingAccount AS ca ON ca.ClearingAccountID = a.ClearingAccountID
       JOIN @Exchanges AS ex ON ex.ClrAccId = ca.ClearingAccountID
       INNER JOIN @substrategyList AS sl ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sl.n
       INNER JOIN Currency AS C ON ca.BaseCurrencyID = C.ID
       INNER JOIN Currency AS C2 ON sn.BaseCurrencyID = C2.ID
ORDER BY ParentDimensionValue, ChildId

	 END;

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetHolidayList

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.GetHolidayList @Date              DATE,
                                   @ClearingOrTrading VARCHAR(1),
                                   @exchgCode         VARCHAR(2) = NULL
AS
     BEGIN
         -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from    
         SET NOCOUNT ON;
         DECLARE @TradingHours TABLE
         (Exchange   VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,
          Segment    VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,
          SubSession INT NOT NULL
         );
         DECLARE @holidays TABLE
         (Exchange    VARCHAR(2),
          Segment     VARCHAR(2),
          Subsession  INT,
          OverrideId  VARCHAR(16),
          description VARCHAR(255)
         );
         DECLARE @ExchgSegStatusList TABLE
         (ExchangeCode    VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,
          Segment         VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,
          OverrideId      VARCHAR(16),
          SubSession      INT NOT NULL,
          Remarks         VARCHAR(255),
          IsWorking       INT,
          IsNormalSession INT
         );
         INSERT INTO @TradingHours
                SELECT DISTINCT
                       ISNULL(T.Exchange, THO.Exchange) AS Exchange,
                       ISNULL(T.ExchangeSegments, THO.ExchangeSegments) AS ExchangeSegments,
                       ISNULL(T.SubSession, THO.SubSession) AS SubSession
                FROM TRADINGHOURS AS T
                     FULL JOIN TradingHoursOverride AS THO ON T.Exchange = THO.Exchange
                                                              AND T.ExchangeSegments = THO.ExchangeSegments
                                                              AND T.Session = THO.Session
                                                              AND T.SubSession = THO.SubSession
                                                              AND T.StartDate = THO.StartDate
                                                              AND T.EndDate = THO.EndDate
                WHERE ISNULL(T.IsNormalSession, THO.IsNormalSession) = 1
                      AND ISNULL(T.Exchange, THO.Exchange) = ISNULL(@exchgCode, ISNULL(T.Exchange, THO.Exchange))
                      AND @Date >= ISNULL(T.startDate, THO.startdate)
                      AND @Date <= ISNULL(T.EndDate, THO.EndDate);
         INSERT INTO @holidays
                SELECT DISTINCT
                       Exchange,
                       Segment,
                       SubSession,
                       NULL AS OVERRIDEID,
                       Description
                FROM holidays AS H
                WHERE exchange = ISNULL(@exchgCode, H.Exchange)
                      AND HolidayType = @ClearingOrTrading
                      AND H.Date = @Date;
         INSERT INTO @holidays
                SELECT DISTINCT
                       HO.Exchange,
                       HO.Segment,
                       HO.SubSession,
                       HO.OverrideId,
                       HO.Description
                FROM HolidaysOverride AS HO
                     LEFT JOIN @holidays AS H ON H.Exchange = HO.Exchange
                                                 AND H.Segment = HO.Segment
                                                 AND H.Subsession = hO.SubSession
                WHERE H.Exchange IS NULL
                      AND HO.exchange = ISNULL(@exchgCode, HO.Exchange)
                      AND HO.Date = @Date;
         INSERT INTO @ExchgSegStatusList
                SELECT TH.Exchange,
                       TH.Segment,
                       H.OverrideId,
                       Th.SubSession,
                       H.Description,
                       CASE
                           WHEN H.Exchange IS NULL
                           THEN 1
                           ELSE 0
                       END AS IsWorking,
                       1
                FROM @TradingHours AS TH
                     LEFT JOIN @holidays AS H ON TH.Exchange = H.Exchange
                                                 AND TH.Segment = h.Segment
                                                 AND TH.SubSession = h.Subsession
									    AND H.OverrideId IS null;

             INSERT INTO @ExchgSegStatusList
                SELECT H.Exchange,
                       H.Segment,
                       H.OverrideId,
                       h.SubSession,
                       H.Description,
                       0 IsWorking,
                       1
				FROM @holidays h WHERE h.OverrideId IS NOT NULL

         DECLARE @rtDayofWeek VARCHAR(10);
         SELECT @rtDayofWeek = DATENAME(dw, @date);
         UPDATE ES
           SET
               ES.isWorking = 0,
               ES.Remarks = 'Weekend:'+@rtDayofWeek
         FROM @ExchgSegStatusList ES
              INNER JOIN
         (
             SELECT Exchange,
                    ExchangeSegment,
                    CASE DATEPART(weekday, @Date)
                        WHEN 1
                        THEN Sunday
                        WHEN 2
                        THEN Monday
                        WHEN 3
                        THEN Tuesday
                        WHEN 4
                        THEN Wednesday
                        WHEN 5
                        THEN Thursday
                        WHEN 6
                        THEN Friday
                        WHEN 7
                        THEN Saturday
                    END AS IsWeekday
             FROM TradingWeekDays AS TW
             WHERE exchange = ISNULL(@exchgCode, TW.Exchange)
                   AND ClearingOrTrading = @ClearingOrTrading
         ) AS W ON ES.ExchangeCode = W.Exchange
                   AND ES.Segment = W.ExchangeSegment
         WHERE W.IsWeekday = 0
               AND ES.IsWorking = 1;

       
       
         --NOW CHECK IF ENTRIES IN @TBLOUTPUT WHERE ISWORKINGDAY=0, ARE PRESENT IN HOLIDAY TRADING OR NOT.    
         --IF YES, CHANGE THEIR ISWORKINGDAY BIT TO 1.       
         -- ALERT!!--- holiday trading as of now only contains holiday exceptions for entries in table holidays. holiday override does not require any exception table.     
         UPDATE T
           SET
               T.isWorking = 1,
               T.Remarks = 'HolidayTrading:'+HT.Description
         FROM @ExchgSegStatusList AS T
              INNER JOIN HOLIDAYTRADING AS HT ON HT.Exchange = T.ExchangeCode
                                                 AND HT.Segment = T.Segment
                                                 AND HT.SubSession = T.SubSession
              LEFT JOIN dbo.HolidaysOverride ho ON ht.Exchange=ho.Exchange
								AND ht.Segment= ho.Segment
								AND ht.SubSession=ho.SubSession
								AND ht.[Date]=ho.[Date]
								AND T.OverrideId=ho.OverrideId
         WHERE HT.HolidayType = @ClearingOrTrading
				AND ho.Exchange IS NULL
               AND HT.date = @Date;									  
         --AND T.OverrideId IS NULL


         UPDATE @ExchgSegStatusList
           SET
               isWorking = 1,
               Remarks = 'HolidayTrading:'+HT.Description
         FROM @ExchgSegStatusList AS T
              INNER JOIN HOLIDAYTRADINGOverride AS HT ON HT.Exchange = T.ExchangeCode
                                                         AND HT.Segment = T.Segment
                                                         AND HT.OverrideId = T.OverrideId
                                                         AND Ht.subsession = T.Subsession
         WHERE HT.Date = @date
               AND HT.HolidayType = @ClearingOrTrading;
         INSERT INTO @ExchgSegStatusList
                SELECT HT.Exchange,
                       HT.Segment,
                       HT.OverrideId,
                       HT.SubSession,
                       'HolidayTrading:'+HT.Description,
                       1,
                       1
                FROM @ExchgSegStatusList AS T
                     RIGHT JOIN HOLIDAYTRADINGOverride AS HT ON HT.Exchange = T.ExchangeCode
                                                                AND HT.Segment = T.Segment
                                                                AND T.OverrideId = HT.OverrideId
                                                                AND Ht.subsession = T.Subsession
                WHERE HT.Date = @date
                      AND HT.HolidayType = @ClearingOrTrading
                      AND Ht.Exchange = ISNULL(@exchgCode, ht.Exchange)
                      AND T.ExchangeCode IS NULL;
         UPDATE @ExchgSegStatusList
           SET
               Remarks = 'WorkingDay:'+@rtDayofWeek
         WHERE IsWorking = 1
               AND Remarks IS NULL;
         SELECT *
         FROM @ExchgSegStatusList;
     END;
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetincorrectargumentJobsReport

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[GetincorrectargumentJobsReport]



@startTime datetime



AS





select a.*, jp.StandardArgument from 

(select  JobCode,ServerIP,StartDateTime,EndDateTime,ExecutionStatus,ArgumentPassed

from JobHistory where startdatetime  > @startTime 

and ArgumentPassed not in (select distinct jp.StandardArgument from JobParameters_LastGoodState JP)) a

left join JobParameters_LastGoodState jp

ON LEFT(a.ArgumentPassed, LEN(a.ArgumentPassed) - CHARINDEX(' ', REVERSE(a.ArgumentPassed))) = jp.StandardArgument

where Jp.JobCode in ('BB_ClosingPrice_Download','BB_ClosingPrice_Upload','MISC_BODExpiryRollover_Process','NSE_Reconciler_Process','MSX_ClosingPriceCD_Upload','CME_Reconciler_Process')



Union



select JP.JobCode,JP.ServerIP,StartDateTime,EndDateTime,ExecutionStatus,ArgumentPassed,StandardArgument 

from JobParameters_LastGoodState JP

INNER JOIN JobHistory JH

ON JH.JobCode = JP.JobCode  

WHERE JH.SERVERIP = JP.SERVERIP 

AND startdatetime  > @startTime 

AND JH.ArgumentPassed <> JP.STANDARDARGUMENT 

AND JH.JobCode not in ('BB_ClosingPrice_Download','BB_ClosingPrice_Upload','MISC_BODExpiryRollover_Process','NSE_Reconciler_Process','MSX_ClosingPriceCD_Upload','CME_Reconciler_Process')



Union



select distinct JH.JobCode,JH.ServerIP,StartDateTime,EndDateTime,ExecutionStatus,ArgumentPassed,'Configuration Not Found in Table JobParameters_LastGoodState for the server' 

from JobParameters_LastGoodState JP

RIGHT JOIN JobHistory JH

ON JH.JobCode = JP.JobCode  AND JH.ServerIP = JP.ServerIP

WHERE startdatetime  > @startTime 

AND JP.StandardArgument is null 
AND JH.JobCode not in ('MISC_PresenceReport_Process')



```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetIndexData

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetIndexData]  
@indexEid varchar(50),  
@dateForCP date  
/*--exec GetIndexData 'IN0000000002IS04','20111003' */            
AS            
BEGIN            
  
declare @latest datetime  
set @latest = (select top 1 LastCheckedDate from IndexTable order by LastCheckedDate desc)   
select Member_Estee_ID,Weightage,InvestibleFactor,IssueCap,FFMarketCap,cast(SPI as decimal(30,28))as SPI,HasChanged,cp.Close_Price from IndexTable it   
inner join closingprice cp on cp.Estee_ID = it.Member_Estee_ID and cp.Date=@dateForCP  
where LastCheckedDate = @dateForCP and it.Estee_ID=@indexEid  
  
END

```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetIndexDataForFile]   
@FileName varchar(50),
@dataSource varchar(50)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 select IR.[ColumnName], IR.[IndexFlagInFile], IM.EsteeUndTicker, IM.ExchangeTicker, IM.ISIN  
 from ISINMaster IM  
 inner join IndexReference IR  
 on @FileName like IR.[FileName]  
 and IR.Index_ISIN = IM.ISIN  
 and IR.Exchange_Code = IM.ExchangeCode  
 where IM.DataSource = @dataSource
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetIndexDataForGivenDate

```sql
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetIndexDataForGivenDate]   
@IndexEsteeid VARCHAR(50),   
@dateForCP DATE,   
@runDate DATE  
AS  
     BEGIN  
  
         SELECT ESTEEMASTER.Underlying_Ticker AS DictKey, IndexTable.Member_Estee_ID AS Estee_ID, closingprice.Close_Price AS ClosePrice,   
     IndexTable.FFMarketCap AS FFMktCap, IndexTable.HasChanged AS HasChanged, IndexTable.InvestibleFactor AS InvestibleFactor,  
      IndexTable.IssueCap AS IssueCapital, IndexTable.Weightage AS Weightage, ISNULL(IndexTable.CappingFactor, 1) AS CappingFactor,   
  ISNULL(IndexMarketCap, 1) AS IndexMarketCap  , IndexTable.ClosingPrice as AdjustedClosingPrice
           FROM IndexTable  
           LEFT JOIN esteemaster ON IndexTable.Member_Estee_ID = esteemaster.Estee_ID  
           LEFT JOIN closingprice ON IndexTable.Member_Estee_ID = closingprice.Estee_ID  
                                     AND closingprice.Date = @dateForCP  
          WHERE IndexTable.Estee_ID = @IndexEsteeid  
                AND IndexTable.AsOfDate = @runDate  
                AND IndexTable.Estee_ID <> IndexTable.Member_Estee_ID;  
     END;  

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetInformationForOrder

```sql
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE PROCEDURE GetInformationForOrder
 @ExchangeCodeList ListString readonly
AS      
BEGIN  
  select distinct em.Exchange_Code,em.Underlying_Ticker,em.Security_Type,cm.QuotationMetric,cm.QuotationUnit  
  from esteemaster em with (nolock)  
  inner join @ExchangeCodeList ecl on em.Exchange_Code = ecl.ListItem  
  inner join CommodityMaster cm with (nolock) on em.Estee_ID = cm.Estee_ID  
  inner join ValidCombos vc with (nolock) on vc.ExchangeCode = em.Exchange_Code and vc.SecurityType = em.Security_Type  
    
  select distinct Exchange_Code,OrderType as OrderTypeCode, TFP.FIX_Name as OrderTypeName  
  from OrderFieldCombos OFS join tblFIXParameters TFP on OFS.OrderType = TFP.FIX_Value and TFP.FIX_Tag_Name='ORDERTYPE'  
  join @ExchangeCodeList ECL on OFS.Exchange_Code = ECL.ListItem   
   
  select distinct Exchange_Code,OrderType,Validity, SecurityType, SymbolCheck,ExpiryCheck,QuantityCheck,DisclosedQuantityCheck,  
  SecurityTypeCheck  
  from OrderFieldCombos OFS   
  join @ExchangeCodeList ECL on OFS.Exchange_Code = ECL.ListItem   
END 


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetIPLocationCodeMapping

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetIPLocationCodeMapping]  
@getOnlyLanIPs bit = 0  
AS    
BEGIN   
 IF @getOnlyLanIPs =0  
 BEGIN  
  SELECT IP,LocationCode from EsteeServers    
  union  
  SELECT WanIP,LocationCode from EsteeServers where WanIP is not null  
  union  
  SELECT ExchangeIP,LocationCode from EsteeServers where ExchangeIP is not null  
  union 
  SELECT WanIP2,LocationCode from EsteeServers where WanIP2 is not null  
 END  
 ELSE  
 BEGIN  
  SELECT DISTINCT IP,LocationCode from EsteeServers    
 END  
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.getISINSymbolMap

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE getISINSymbolMap  
AS  
BEGIN  
select  PositionISIN as ISIN,ISNULL( ExSymbols.RTDSymbol, max(DataFeed_Ticker)) as Symbol from   
(select distinct SUBSTRING(estee_id,0,13) as PositionISIN,ISIN,DataFeed_Ticker from esteemaster where Security_Type in(select TypeCode from SecurityType where GroupID=5) ) as ISINs   
left join (select distinct im.ISIN,RTDSymbol from ISINMaster  im inner join RTSContractsStaging rts on im.ExchangeTicker = rts.ContractName)as ExSymbols on ISINs.ISIN=ExSymbols.ISIN  
group by PositionISIN,ExSymbols.RTDSymbol  
END 
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetLedgerBalanceFigures

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetLedgerBalanceFigures]  
@beginDate datetime = 0,                                         
@endDate datetime = 0,
@brokerID decimal = null,                                          
@accounts nvarchar(1000) = null,  
@subStrategies nvarchar(4000) = null                                
AS                                          
BEGIN                            
                 
 DECLARE @Account TABLE(accountID int)          
 if(@accounts is null)        
 begin        
  INSERT into @Account Select account_ID from account        
 end        
 else        
 begin        
  INSERT into @Account SELECT * from dbo.split(@accounts,',')        
 end  
  
 DECLARE @SubStrategy TABLE(subStrategyID int)           
 if(@subStrategies is null)        
 begin        
  INSERT into @SubStrategy Select distinct subStrategy_ID from strategy_New        
 end    
 else    
 begin    
  INSERT into @SubStrategy SELECT * from dbo.split(@subStrategies,',')        
 end  
  
 SELECT ISNULL(SUM(((ISNULL(FutureMTMBrokerNet, 0) + ISNULL(CashMTM, 0))- (ISNULL(CashTransactionCost, 0) + ISNULL(FnOTransactionCost, 0)))), 0) AS NetMTMCash, 
 ISNULL(SUM((ISNULL(FutureMTMBrokerNet, 0)) - ISNULL(FnOTransactionCost, 0)), 0) AS NetMTMFutures
--SELECT *
 FROM LedgerBalance  
 WHERE (Date >= @beginDate AND Date < @endDate)
 AND StrategyID IN (Select subStrategyID FROM @SubStrategy)  
 AND Account_ID IN (Select accountID FROM @Account)  
                           
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetLedgerBalancesForAllocation

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetLedgerBalancesForAllocation]
@fromDate datetime = 0,                                   
@toDate datetime = null,                           
@listAccountID varchar(100) = null,    
@listBrokerID varchar(100)  = null
AS                                    
BEGIN                      
DECLARE @Account TABLE(accountID int)    
if(@listAccountID is null OR @listAccountID = '')  
begin  
 INSERT into @Account Select account_ID from account  
end  
else  
begin  
 INSERT into @Account SELECT * from dbo.split(@listAccountID,',')  
end  
  
DECLARE @Broker TABLE(brokerID int)    
if(@listBrokerID is null OR @listBrokerID = '')  
begin  
 INSERT into @Broker Select broker_ID from broker  
end  
else  
begin  
 INSERT into @Broker SELECT * from dbo.split(@listBrokerID,',')  
end

 SELECT Date, (FutureMTMBrokerNet) AS FutureMTMBrokerNet, OptionPayout,                     
 ISNULL((Select sum(DailyFOMargin) + Sum(ISNULL(BaseCumFnOMargin, 0))       
 From ledgerbalance ilb where ilb.broker_id = lb.broker_id and ilb.account_id = lb.account_id and ilb.date<= lb.date),0) CombinedFOM      
 ,lb.account_id, broker_id, A.Account_Name  
 from ledgerbalance lb INNER JOIN Account A ON lb.Account_ID = A.Account_ID
 WHERE Date >= @fromDate AND Date < @toDate AND Broker_ID IN (Select brokerID FROM @Broker)
 AND lb.Account_ID IN (Select accountID FROM @Account)                     
 ORDER BY Account_ID, Date            
END

```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetLegalEntityBaseCurrency]    
	@legalEntityId int = -1      
AS      
BEGIN      
 SET NOCOUNT ON;    
	if @legalEntityId = -1    
		select c.CurrencyCode, LE.LegalEntityId 
		from LegalEntity LE 
		inner join Currency c on LE.BaseCurrencyId = c.ID    
    else    
		select c.CurrencyCode, LE.LegalEntityId 
		from LegalEntity LE 
		inner join Currency c on LE.BaseCurrencyId = c.ID    
		where LE.LegalEntityId = @legalEntityId    
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetMaxOrderCountForStrategies

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetMaxOrderCountForStrategies]  

@dimensionID varchar(20)=NULL   

AS  

BEGIN  

-------------------Logic for tempDate and cut off time check--------------------------------------
DECLARE @tempDate DATE = CONVERT(date,getdate())
DECLARE @cutOffTime TIME
DECLARE @tempDateTime TIME = CONVERT(TIME,GETDATE())
DECLARE @minDate DATE = '0001-01-01'
SELECT @cutOffTime = value from datainit where ApplicationID = 0 and Parameter = 'TradeDateCutOffTime'

IF @tempDateTime between '00:00:00' and @cutOffTime
BEGIN
	SET @tempDate = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE() - 1)
END 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM RiskLimits RL WHERE RL.DATE = @tempDate)
BEGIN
	set @tempDate = @minDate;
END
SELECT DimensionValue, RiskParameterValue,rl.Date 

FROM RiskLimits RL 

inner join RiskParameters RP on  RL.RiskParamId = RP.RiskParamId   

inner join ParameterDimension pd on RL.Dimensionid = pd.Dimensionid  

WHERE RL.DimensionID  =ISNULL(1,RL.DimensionID)  

AND RP.RiskParamName = 'maxOrderCountPerWindow' and rl.Date = @tempDate

END 


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetMessagePenaltyInBrazil

```sql
  
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.GetMessagePenaltyInBrazil
@runDate date
AS
declare @startDate date  
declare @endDate date  
declare @maxA decimal
declare @maxB decimal
set @startDate = DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, @runDate), 0)  
set @endDate = DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, @runDate) + 1, 0)  

--Trade summary  
select a.EsteeId,a.UnderlyingEstee_Id,a.Security_Type, a.DataFeed_Ticker, a.Messages, a.Orders, isnull(b.Trades, 0) Trades, isnull(b.Volume, 0) Volume,c.Account_ID into #trade_data   
 from  
 (select EsteeId,omd.EmsId, isnull(em.UnderlyingEstee_Id,ea.UnderlyingEstee_Id) AS UnderlyingEstee_Id,isnull(em.Security_Type,ea.Security_Type) AS Security_Type, isnull(em.DataFeed_Ticker,ea.DataFeed_Ticker) AS DataFeed_Ticker, sum(omd.OrdersCount) Orders, SUM(omd.OrderTradesCount) Messages, SUM(omd.TradesCount) Trades  
from OrderMessageDetails omd left join esteemaster em with(nolock) on (omd.EsteeId = em.Estee_ID ) 
left join esteemaster_archive ea with(nolock)on (omd.EsteeId = ea.Estee_ID)
where tradedate >= @startDate and tradedate < @endDate   
and isnull(em.Status, ea.status) = 1
group by EsteeId, isnull(em.DataFeed_Ticker,ea.DataFeed_Ticker),isnull(em.UnderlyingEstee_Id,ea.UnderlyingEstee_Id),isnull(em.Security_Type,ea.Security_Type),omd.EmsId
) a left join  
(  
select estee_id, count(*) Trades, SUM(Traded_quantity * Traded_Price) Volume,ems_id from vwAllTrades   
where Creation_Date >= @startDate and Creation_Date < @endDate  
group by Estee_ID,ems_id   
) b 
on a.EsteeId = b.Estee_ID   
And a.emsid = b.Ems_id 
left join
(select distinct a.Account_ID, vw.EMSId from Account a inner join StrategyBrokerAccount sba on a.Account_ID = sba.accountID
inner join Strategy_New sn on sn.SubStrategy_Id = sba.subStrategyID
inner join vwSSConfig vw on vw.SSID = sn.SubStrategy_Id
where exchange_Code = 'BR' and sn.Strategy_Status = 1) c
on c.EMSId = a.EmsId
order by a.Messages desc  

select UnderlyingEstee_Id,Security_Type, Sum(Messages) Messages, Sum(Orders) Orders, Sum(Trades) Trades, Sum(Volume) Volume,Account_ID from #trade_data
group by UnderlyingEstee_Id, Security_Type, Account_ID order by UnderlyingEstee_Id
drop table #trade_data


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetMidDayBrokerageTurnOver

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetMidDayBrokerageTurnOver]  

@startdate datetime,       

@enddate datetime  

AS        

BEGIN  

      

 SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED               

 SELECT o.Account_ID,  
 sum(isnull(t.traded_quantity/e.Lot_Size,0)) as Lots,
  cast(sum(isnull(t.traded_quantity,0) * case                      

  when e.security_type in (2, 3, 6, 7, 12, 13) then t.traded_price + e.strike_price          

  else isnull(t.traded_price, 0)  

  end) as decimal (20,8)) As TurnOver,e.security_type 

  from [Order] o  

inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID  

inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID  

inner join esteemaster e with (nolock) on e.estee_id = t.estee_id and e.Status=1  

where ot.Status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and o.Creation_Date >= @startdate and o.Creation_Date < @enddate   

group by o.Account_ID,e.security_type     

      

END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetMidDayTurnOver

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[GetMidDayTurnOver]                   
@startdate datetime,                   
@enddate datetime              
AS                    
BEGIN              
                  
 SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED                           
 SELECT ot.Sub_Strategy_ID ,o.Account_ID , o.Ems_ID as EmsID ,t.estee_id, t.Buy_Sell_Indicator, cast(sum(isnull(t.traded_quantity,0) * case                                  
 when ISNULL(e.security_type,ea.security_type) in (2, 3, 6, 7, 12, 13) then                                  
 case isnull(t.buy_sell_indicator, 0)                                   
 when 1 then t.traded_price                                   
 else ISNULL(e.strike_price,ea.strike_price)                                
 end                                 
 else isnull(t.traded_price, 0)                                
 end) as decimal (20,8)) As TurnOver, Sum(Traded_Quantity/isnull(e.Lot_Size, ea.Lot_Size)) as Lots            
 from [Order] o            
inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID            
inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID            
left join esteemaster e with (nolock) on e.estee_id = t.estee_id and e.Status=1              
left join EsteeMaster_archive ea with (nolock) on ea.estee_id = t.estee_id and ea.Status=1              
where ot.Status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and o.Creation_Date >= @startdate and o.Creation_Date < @enddate 
and o.Order_Source_ID not in ('ECM','OdinDirectTransfer','ODIN','New Balancing','Balancing')  
group by ot.Sub_Strategy_ID, o.Account_ID, o.Ems_ID, t.Estee_ID, t.Buy_Sell_Indicator                  
                  
END 
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetMidDayTurnOver_new

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[GetMidDayTurnOver_new]       
@startdate datetime,       
@enddate datetime  
AS        
BEGIN  
      
 SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED           
 SELECT ot.Sub_Strategy_ID ,tor.Account_ID ,t.estee_id, t.Buy_Sell_Indicator, cast(sum(isnull(t.traded_quantity,0) * case                  
 when e.security_type in (2, 3, 6, 7, 12, 13) then                  
 case isnull(t.buy_sell_indicator, 0)                   
 when 1 then t.traded_price                   
 else e.strike_price                  
 end                 
 else isnull(t.traded_price, 0)                
 end)/10000000  as decimal (10,4)) As TurnOver      
 from tblTrades t WITH (NOLOCK, INDEX(IX_tbltrades_ordertrade))  
 INNER JOIN tblOrderTrades ot WITH (NOLOCK) ON t.OrderTrade_ID = ot.OrderTrade_ID         
 inner join tblOrders tor with (nolock) on tor.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID    
 inner join esteemaster e with (nolock) on e.estee_id = t.estee_id and e.Status=1      
 where ot.status in ('executed', 'partially filled')      
 and ot.creation_time between @startdate and @enddate  
 group by ot.Sub_Strategy_ID, tor.Account_ID, t.Estee_ID, t.Buy_Sell_Indicator    
      
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetMonthlyTurnOver

```sql
  CREATE PROCEDURE GetMonthlyTurnOver  
@startdate datetime,                     
@enddate datetime                
AS                      
BEGIN                
 SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED           
   
 select distinct aa.Account_ID into #temp from vwBrokerage vw inner join BrokerageCharges bc on vw.TurnoverTaxKey=bc.[Key]  
 inner join TurnoverSlabs ts on ts.[Key] = bc.TurnoverKey  
 inner join Account a on a.Account_ID= vw.accountid  
 inner join Account aa on a.exchange_Code = aa.exchange_Code  
 where ts.ismonthly = 1 and aa.Status = 'Active'         
 SELECT t.Creation_Date, t.Estee_ID EsteeId, sum(t.Traded_Quantity * t.Traded_Price) As TurnOver, Sum(Traded_Quantity/isnull(e.Lot_Size, ea.Lot_Size)) as Lots                   
 from [Order] o              
inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID              
inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID              
inner join #temp tt on tt.Account_ID = o.Account_ID  
left join esteemaster e with (nolock) on e.estee_id = t.estee_id and e.Status=1                
left join EsteeMaster_archive ea with (nolock) on ea.estee_id = t.estee_id and ea.Status=1  
where ot.Status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and o.Creation_Date >= @startdate and o.Creation_Date <= @enddate and o.Order_Source_ID not in ('ECM','OdinDirectTransfer','ODIN')  
group by t.Creation_Date, t.Estee_ID  
order by t.Creation_Date, t.Estee_ID  
  
drop table #temp  
END   
  
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetNameByDimensionId

```sql
Create PROCEDURE dbo.GetNameByDimensionId  
    @dimensionId     INT,  
	@substrategyList ListString READONLY 
AS  
     BEGIN  

	 DECLARE @StrategyAccount TABLE(ssId int, accId int)    
	Insert into @StrategyAccount
	SELECT ParseName(Replace(ListItem, '_', '.'), 2) , ParseName(Replace(ListItem, '_', '.'), 1)  FROM   @substrategyList

         IF @dimensionId = 1  
             BEGIN  
                 SELECT 1 AS DimensionId, CAST(substrategy_id AS VARCHAR(10)) AS ID, sn.SubStrategy_Name AS Name  
     FROM   dbo.Strategy_New AS sn  
	 INNER JOIN @StrategyAccount AS sa ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sa.ssId
	 INNER JOIN Account as a on a.Account_ID = sa.accId;
             END;  
         ELSE IF @dimensionId = 2  
             BEGIN  
                SELECT distinct 2 AS DimensionId, CAST(a.Account_ID AS VARCHAR(10)) AS ID, a.Account_Name AS Name  
       FROM   dbo.Account AS a  
        INNER JOIN dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount AS SBA ON sba.accountID = a.Account_ID  
        INNER JOIN dbo.Strategy_New AS SN ON SBA.subStrategyID = SN.SubStrategy_Id  
	   INNER JOIN @StrategyAccount AS sa ON SBA.subStrategyID = sa.ssId and sa.accId = SBA.accountID;
             END;  
         ELSE IF @dimensionId = 3  
             BEGIN  
                 SELECT 3 AS DimensionId, cast(a.Account_ID AS varchar(10)) + '_' + cast(sn.SubStrategy_Id AS varchar(10)) AS ID, 
				sn.SubStrategy_Name AS Name 
     FROM   dbo.Strategy_New AS sn  
	   INNER JOIN @StrategyAccount AS sa ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sa.ssId
		INNER JOIN Account as a on a.Account_ID = sa.accId and a.Status = 'Active';
     ---Even though this is StrategyAccount dimension, in AllocatorReport form, Strategy level data is shown on selecting this dimension and hence selecting Strategy level data. For StrategyAccount level, use the query commented below.  
                 --SELECT 3 AS DimensionId, cast(sba.accountID AS varchar(10)) + '_' + cast(sba.subStrategyID AS varchar(10)) AS ID , sn.SubStrategy_Name AS Name   
                 --FROM dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount sba  
                 --INNER JOIN Strategy_new sn ON sn.SubStrategy_Id=sba.subStrategyID  
                 --INNER JOIN dbo.Account a ON a.Account_ID = sba.accountID  
     --INNER JOIN @substrategyList AS sl ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sl.n;  
             END;  
         ELSE IF @dimensionId = 4  
             BEGIN  
                 SELECT distinct 4 AS DimensionId, CAST(b.Broker_ID AS VARCHAR(10)) AS ID, b.Broker_Name AS Name  
                 FROM dbo.Broker b;  
             END;  
         ELSE IF @dimensionId = 6  
             BEGIN  
                 SELECT distinct 6 AS DimensionId, sg.StrategyID AS ID, sg.StrategyName AS Name  
     FROM   dbo.StrategyGroup AS sg  
     INNER JOIN dbo.Strategy_New AS SN ON sn.Strategy_Id = sg.StrategyID  
	 INNER JOIN @StrategyAccount AS sa ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sa.ssId
	 INNER JOIN Account as a on a.Account_ID = sa.accId; 
             END;  
         ELSE IF @dimensionId = 7  
             BEGIN  
                 SELECT distinct 7 AS DimensionId, ID, Name  
     FROM   dbo.InvestmentFund AS f  
     INNER JOIN dbo.Strategy_New AS SN ON f.id = SN.InvestmentFundID  
	 INNER JOIN @StrategyAccount AS sa ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sa.ssId
	 INNER JOIN Account as a on a.Account_ID = sa.accId;
             END;  
         ELSE IF @dimensionId = 8  
             BEGIN  
                 SELECT distinct 8 AS DimensionId, code AS ID, Name  
                 FROM dbo.Exchange e;  
             END;  
         ELSE IF @dimensionId = 9  
             BEGIN  
                 SELECT DISTINCT  
                        9 AS DimensionId, sn.ownerUserID AS ID, ISNULL(ld.Username, '') AS Name  
                 FROM dbo.Strategy_New sn  
       LEFT JOIN dbo.LoginDetails ld ON sn.ownerUserID = ld.UserID  
					   INNER JOIN @StrategyAccount AS sa ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sa.ssId
						INNER JOIN Account as a on a.Account_ID = sa.accId;            
             END;  
         ELSE IF @dimensionId = 11  
             BEGIN  
                 SELECT distinct 11 AS DimensionId, sc.ID AS ID, sc.Name  
     FROM   dbo.StrategyCategory AS sc  
     INNER JOIN dbo.StrategyGroup AS SG ON sg.CategoryID = sc.ID  
     INNER JOIN strategy_new AS sn ON sn.Strategy_Id = sg.StrategyID  
	 INNER JOIN @StrategyAccount AS sa ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sa.ssId
	 INNER JOIN Account as a on a.Account_ID = sa.accId;  
             END;  
         ELSE IF @dimensionId = 13  
             BEGIN  
                  SELECT DISTINCT  
      13 AS DimensionId,  cast(sc.id AS varchar(10)) + '_' + cast(ca.ClearingAccountID AS varchar(10)) AS ID, sc.Name AS Name  
      FROM   dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount AS sba  
     INNER JOIN Strategy_new AS sn ON sba.subStrategyID = sn.SubStrategy_Id  
     INNER JOIN dbo.StrategyGroup AS sg ON sn.Strategy_Id = sg.StrategyID  
     INNER JOIN dbo.StrategyCategory AS sc ON sc.ID = sg.CategoryID  
     INNER JOIN dbo.Account AS a ON sba.accountID = a.Account_ID  
     INNER JOIN dbo.ClearingAccount AS ca ON ca.ClearingAccountID = a.ClearingAccountID  
	 INNER JOIN @StrategyAccount AS sa ON SBA.subStrategyID = sa.ssId and sa.accId = SBA.accountID;
     --INNER JOIN @substrategyList AS sl ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sl.n;  
                 --SELECT distinct 13, cast(sc.ID AS varchar(10)) +'_' + cast(ca.ClearingAccountID AS varchar(10)) AS ID,  
                 --sc.Name + '_' + ca.ClearingAccountName  
                 --FROM dbo.Strategy_New sn  
                 --JOIN dbo.StrategyGroup sg ON sn.Strategy_Id=sg.StrategyID  
                 --JOIN dbo.StrategyCategory sc ON sg.CategoryID= sc.ID  
                 --JOIN dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount sba ON sn.SubStrategy_Id=sba.subStrategyID  
                 --JOIN dbo.Account a ON sba.accountID=a.Account_ID  
                 --JOIN dbo.ClearingAccount ca ON a.ClearingAccountID=ca.ClearingAccountID  
             END;  
         ELSE IF @dimensionId = 14  
             BEGIN  
                 SELECT distinct 14 AS DimensionId, ca.ClearingAccountID AS ID, ca.ClearingAccountName AS Name  
     FROM   dbo.ClearingAccount AS ca  
      INNER JOIN dbo.Account AS A ON ca.ClearingAccountID = A.ClearingAccountID  
      INNER JOIN dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount AS SBA ON sba.accountID = a.Account_ID  
      INNER JOIN dbo.Strategy_New AS SN ON SBA.subStrategyID = SN.SubStrategy_Id  
	  INNER JOIN @StrategyAccount AS sa ON SBA.subStrategyID = sa.ssId and sa.accId = SBA.accountID;
             END;  
         ELSE IF @dimensionId = 15  
             BEGIN  
                 SELECT distinct 15 AS DimensionId, le.LegalEntityId AS ID, le.LegalEntityName AS Name  
     FROM   dbo.LegalEntity AS le  
      INNER JOIN dbo.ClearingAccount AS CA ON ca.LegalEntityId = LE.LegalEntityId  
      INNER JOIN dbo.Account AS A ON ca.ClearingAccountID = A.ClearingAccountID  
      INNER JOIN dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount AS SBA ON sba.accountID = a.Account_ID  
      INNER JOIN dbo.Strategy_New AS SN ON SBA.subStrategyID = SN.SubStrategy_Id   
	  INNER JOIN @StrategyAccount AS sa ON SBA.subStrategyID = sa.ssId and sa.accId = SBA.accountID;
             END;  
    ELSE IF @dimensionId = 16  
             BEGIN  
     SELECT distinct 16 AS DimensionId, cast(le.LegalEntityId AS varchar(10)) + '_' + cast(sc.id AS varchar(10)) AS ID  ,
	  le.LegalEntityName AS Name  
     FROM   dbo.LegalEntity AS le  
      INNER JOIN dbo.ClearingAccount AS CA ON ca.LegalEntityId = LE.LegalEntityId  
      INNER JOIN dbo.Account AS A ON ca.ClearingAccountID = A.ClearingAccountID  
      INNER JOIN dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount AS SBA ON sba.accountID = a.Account_ID  
      INNER JOIN dbo.Strategy_New AS SN ON SBA.subStrategyID = SN.SubStrategy_Id  
      INNER JOIN StrategyGroup Sg on sg.StrategyID = sn.Strategy_Id  
      INNER JOIN StrategyCategory sc on sc.id =sg.CategoryID  
	 INNER JOIN @StrategyAccount AS sa ON SBA.subStrategyID = sa.ssId and sa.accId = SBA.accountID;
             END;  
    ELSE IF @dimensionId = 17  
             BEGIN  
                 SELECT distinct 17 AS DimensionId, cast(CA.ClearingAccountID AS varchar(10)) + '_' + cast(Sg.StrategyID AS varchar(10)) AS ID, 
				 CA.ClearingAccountName  AS Name  
     FROM   dbo.ClearingAccount AS CA  
      INNER JOIN dbo.Account AS A ON ca.ClearingAccountID = A.ClearingAccountID  
      INNER JOIN dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount AS SBA ON sba.accountID = a.Account_ID  
      INNER JOIN dbo.Strategy_New AS SN ON SBA.subStrategyID = SN.SubStrategy_Id  
      INNER JOIN StrategyGroup Sg on sg.StrategyID = sn.Strategy_Id  
      INNER JOIN StrategyCategory sc on sc.id =sg.CategoryID  
	  INNER JOIN @StrategyAccount AS sa ON SBA.subStrategyID = sa.ssId and sa.accId = SBA.accountID;
             END;  
    ELSE IF @dimensionId = 18  
             BEGIN  
                 SELECT distinct 18 AS DimensionId, cast(le.LegalEntityId AS varchar(10)) + '_' + cast(Sg.StrategyID AS varchar(10))  AS ID,
				  le.LegalEntityName  AS Name  
     FROM   dbo.LegalEntity AS le  
      INNER JOIN dbo.ClearingAccount AS CA ON ca.LegalEntityId = LE.LegalEntityId  
      INNER JOIN dbo.Account AS A ON ca.ClearingAccountID = A.ClearingAccountID  
      INNER JOIN dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount AS SBA ON sba.accountID = a.Account_ID  
      INNER JOIN dbo.Strategy_New AS SN ON SBA.subStrategyID = SN.SubStrategy_Id  
      INNER JOIN StrategyGroup Sg on sg.StrategyID = sn.Strategy_Id  
      INNER JOIN StrategyCategory sc on sc.id =sg.CategoryID 
	  INNER JOIN @StrategyAccount AS sa ON SBA.subStrategyID = sa.ssId and sa.accId = SBA.accountID; 
             END;  
    ELSE IF @dimensionId = 19  
             BEGIN  
                 SELECT distinct 19 AS DimensionId,cast(Sg.StrategyID AS varchar(10)) + '_' + cast(CA.ClearingAccountID AS varchar(10)) As id,
				  Sg.StrategyName   AS Name  
     FROM   dbo.ClearingAccount AS CA  
      INNER JOIN dbo.Account AS A ON ca.ClearingAccountID = A.ClearingAccountID  
      INNER JOIN dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount AS SBA ON sba.accountID = a.Account_ID  
      INNER JOIN dbo.Strategy_New AS SN ON SBA.subStrategyID = SN.SubStrategy_Id  
      INNER JOIN StrategyGroup Sg on sg.StrategyID = sn.Strategy_Id  
      INNER JOIN StrategyCategory sc on sc.id =sg.CategoryID  
	  INNER JOIN @StrategyAccount AS sa ON SBA.subStrategyID = sa.ssId and sa.accId = SBA.accountID;
   END;  
END;

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetNeatLimit

```sql
CREATE Procedure [dbo].[GetNeatLimit]
@locationCode varchar(10) = null
AS
Declare @SeqNO int
Select @SeqNo=Max(SeqNo) from NeatLimit
SElECT	EX.name as Exchange,
        Trader,
        CR.CurrencyCode as Currency,
		FutureBuy as [Future Buy],
		FutureSell as [Future Sell],
		OptionBuy as [Option Buy],
		OptionSell as [Option Sell],
		CDFutureBuy as [CD Future Buy],
		CDFutureSell as [CD Future Sell],
		CDOptionBuy as [CD Option Buy],
		CDOptionSell as [CD Option Sell],
		CashBuy as [Cash Buy],
		CashSell as [Cash Sell],
		NL.LocationCode as Location
FROM	NeatLimit NL
INNER JOIN Exchange EX on NL.Exchange_Code = EX.code
INNER JOIN Currency CR on EX.CurrencyID = CR.ID
WHERE	SeqNo	=	@SeqNo
and (NL.locationCode = @locationCode OR Coalesce(@locationCode,'') ='')
order by Exchange,Trader

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetNextXExpiryFromRunDate

```sql
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Megha Goel
-- Create date: 10 july 2014
-- Description:	GetNextXExpiryFromRunDate
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE GetNextXExpiryFromRunDate
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@runDate Date,	
	@exchangeCode char(2),
	@listSecType LISTSTRING READONLY,
	@count int
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SELECT TOP (@count) * FROM
		(   SELECT DISTINCT e.Expiry_Date AS DATE 
		      FROM esteemaster e
		INNER JOIN @listSecType LS on E.Security_Type = LS.ListItem	
		     WHERE e.Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode 
			   AND e.Expiry_Date >= @runDate 
			   AND e.Status = '1'
		       AND e.Expiry_Date is not null

			UNION

			SELECT DISTINCT Expiry_Date AS DATE 
			  FROM esteemaster_archive E	 
		INNER JOIN @listSecType LS on E.Security_Type = LS.ListItem
			 WHERE Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode 
			   AND Status = '1' 
			   AND Expiry_Date >= @runDate
			   AND Expiry_Date IS NOT NULL
	) A order by a.date
END


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetNonWorkingSessionsForHoliday

```sql
CREATE proc GetNonWorkingSessionsForHoliday  
 @Exchange VARCHAR(2),    
    @ExchangeSegment VARCHAR(2),    
    @ClearingOrTrading VARCHAR(1),    
    @runDate DATE,  
 @overrideId varchar(50) = null  
AS  
BEGIN  
 DECLARE @nonWorkingSessions table([Session] varchar(50), Subsession int, OverrideId varchar(50),Exchange varchar(50),Segment varchar(50))  
 DECLARE @rtDayofWeek VARCHAR(10)    
 DECLARE @tradingonweekday INT    
 DECLARE @query nvarchar(max)  
 SELECT @rtDayofWeek = CASE DATEPART(weekday,@runDate)      
         WHEN 1 THEN 'Sunday'      
         WHEN 2 THEN 'Monday'      
         WHEN 3 THEN 'Tuesday'      
         WHEN 4 THEN 'Wednesday'      
         WHEN 5 THEN 'Thursday'      
         WHEN 6 THEN 'Friday'      
         WHEN 7 THEN 'Saturday'      
        END     
 SET @tradingonweekday = 0    
 SET @query = N'select @tradingonweekday = ' + @rtDayofWeek + ' from tradingweekdays where Exchange = '''   
    + @Exchange + ''' and ExchangeSegment = ''' + @ExchangeSegment + ''' and ClearingOrTrading = ''' + @ClearingOrTrading + ''''     
    
 EXECUTE sp_executesql @query, N'@tradingonweekday int output', @tradingonweekday output  
 IF @tradingonweekday =0  
 begin   
  insert into @nonWorkingSessions  
  select th.[Session],th.[Subsession],'',th.Exchange,th.ExchangeSegments from TradingHours th  
  left join holidaytrading ht on th.Exchange = ht.Exchange and th.ExchangeSegments = ht.Segment and th.SubSession = ht.SubSession  
  and ht.Date = @runDate  
  where th.Exchange=@Exchange and th.ExchangeSegments = @ExchangeSegment and @runDate > startDate and @runDate <EndDate and th.IsNormalSession =1  
  and ht.Exchange is null  
  union  
  select distinct th.[Session],th.[Subsession],th.OverrideId,th.Exchange,th.ExchangeSegments from TradingHoursOverride th  
  left join holidaytradingOverride ht on th.Exchange = ht.Exchange and th.ExchangeSegments = ht.Segment and th.SubSession = ht.SubSession  
  and ht.overrideId = th.OverrideId and ht.date = @rundate  
   where th.Exchange=@Exchange and th.ExchangeSegments = @ExchangeSegment and @runDate > startDate and @runDate <EndDate and th.IsNormalSession=1  
   and ht.exchange is null  
 end  
 ELSE  
 BEGIN  
  insert into @nonWorkingSessions  
  select [Session],[Subsession],OverrideId,Exchange,Segment from  
  (Select ho.[Session], ho.SubSession,'' as OverrideId,ho.Exchange,ho.Segment from Holidays ho Left join holidaytrading ht   
   on ho.Exchange = ht.Exchange and ho.Segment = ht.Segment and ho.HolidayType = ht.HolidayType and ho.Date = ht.Date and ho.SubSession = ht.SubSession  
   where ho.[Date] = @runDate  
   and ho.Exchange = @Exchange   
   and ho.Segment = @ExchangeSegment   
   and ho.HolidayType = @ClearingOrTrading and ht.Exchange is null   
  union   
    select distinct HO.Session, HO.Subsession,HO.OverrideId,HO.Exchange,HO.Segment from HolidaysOverride HO       
  left join  
  (select Session, SubSession, OverrideId,Exchange,ExchangeSegments from TradingHoursOverride where Exchange = @Exchange and ExchangeSegments = @ExchangeSegment   
   AND @runDate> StartDate and @runDate < EndDate and OverrideId = ISNULL(@OverrideId, OverrideId)  
  except  
  (Select HO.[Session],HO.SubSession,HO.OverrideId,HO.Exchange,HO.Segment from HolidaysOverride HO  
  Left join HolidayTradingOverride ht   
   on ho.Exchange = ht.Exchange and ho.Segment = ht.Segment and ho.HolidayType = ht.HolidayType  
    and ho.Date = ht.Date and ho.SubSession = ht.SubSession and ho.OverrideId = ht.OverrideId      
     where HO.[Date] = @rundate  
  and HO.Exchange = @Exchange   
  and HO.Segment = @ExchangeSegment   
  and HO.HolidayType = @ClearingOrTrading  
     and ht.Exchange is null  
  and HO.OverrideId = ISNULL(@OverrideId, HO.OverrideId))  
  ) A  
  on HO.Session = A.Session and HO.SubSession = A.SubSession and HO.OverrideId  = A.OverrideId  
  where A.Session is null and A.SubSession is null and HO.Exchange = @Exchange and HO.Segment = @ExchangeSegment   and HO.[Date] = @rundate 
  and HO.OverrideId = ISNULL(@OverrideId, HO.OverrideId)) B   
 END  
 insert into @nonWorkingSessions  
 select th.Session, th.SubSession,'',th.Exchange,th.ExchangeSegments from TradingHours th inner join  
 @nonWorkingSessions nws on th.SubSession = nws.Subsession and nws.OverrideId =''  
 where th.Exchange = @Exchange and th.ExchangeSegments = @ExchangeSegment and nws.Session ='All'  
 Delete from @nonWorkingSessions where Session='All' and OverrideId=''  
 select * from @nonWorkingSessions  
    
END  
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetOrderCountPerEMS

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetOrderCountPerEMS]
	@date DATE
AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	SELECT O.Ems_ID as EmsID, V.Segment ,
	COUNT(*) AS OrderCount  
	FROM Trades T WITH (NOLOCK)  
	INNER JOIN OrderTrades OT WITH (NOLOCK) ON OT.Order_ID = T.Order_ID AND OT.Creation_Date = T.Creation_Date AND OT.OrderTrade_ID = T.OrderTrade_ID   
	INNER JOIN [Order] O WITH (NOLOCK) ON OT.Order_ID = O.Order_ID AND OT.Creation_Date = O.Creation_Date
	INNER JOIN Account A ON A.Account_ID = O.Account_ID
	INNER JOIN ValidCombos V ON V.ExchangeCode = A.exchange_Code AND V.SecurityType = CAST(SUBSTRING(T.Estee_ID, 15, 2) AS INT)
	WHERE T.Creation_Date = @date
	AND O.Exchange_Order_ID <> 'NULL' -- DONOT COUNT INTERNAL EMS REJECTIONS AS NEW Orders  
	GROUP BY O.Ems_ID, V.Segment
   
   
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetOrderLatencyReport

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE GetOrderLatencyReport  
@runDate datetime  
AS    
BEGIN  
declare @weeklyDate datetime  
declare @historicalDate datetime   
declare @parameter varchar(20)  
set @weeklyDate = @runDate  - 7  
set @historicalDate = @weeklyDate - 100  
set @parameter = 'Percentile_99'  
    
select daily.ServerID, daily.ApplicationID,  
  cast((historical.hT8T12 - daily.T8T12)* 100/historical.hT8T12 as int) '% (H-D)[T8T12]', cast((historical.ht4 - daily.t4)* 100/historical.ht4 as int) '% (H-D)[T4]',  
  --(historical.hT8T12 - weekly.T8T12)* 100/historical.hT8T12 'PC (H-W)[T8T12]', (historical.ht4 - weekly.t4)* 100/historical.ht4 'PC (H-W)[T4]',  
  cast(historical.hT8T12 as int)/1000 'H-T8T12 ms', cast(daily.T8T12 as int)/1000 'D-T8T12 ms', --weekly.T8T12 'W-T8T12',  
  cast(historical.ht4 as int)/1000 'H-T4 ms', cast(daily.t4 as int)/1000 'D-T4 ms', --weekly.t4 'W-T4',  
  historical.Count/1000 'H-Count, K', daily.Count/1000 'D-Count, K', --weekly.[Count] 'W-Count'  
  case when (historical.hT8T12 - daily.T8T12)* 100/historical.hT8T12 < (historical.ht4 - daily.t4)* 100/historical.ht4 then (historical.hT8T12 - daily.T8T12)* 100/historical.hT8T12 else (historical.ht4 - daily.t4)* 100/historical.ht4 end 'sorter'    
 from     
  (    
  select MIN(serverid) ServerID, round(AVG(t8 - t12), 0) T8T12, round(avg(t4), 0) t4, AVG(CAST(count as int)) Count, ApplicationID     
  from OrderExec where Date = CAST(@runDate as Date) and Parameter = @parameter and count > 1000    
  group by ApplicationID    
  ) daily     
 left join    
 -- (    
 -- select MIN(serverid) ServerID, round(AVG(T8 - t12), 0) T8T12, round(avg(t4), 0) t4, AVG(CAST(count as int)) Count, ApplicationID     
 -- from OrderExec where Date >= @weeklyDate and Date < @runDate and Parameter = @parameter and count > 1000    
 -- group by ApplicationID    
 -- ) weekly on (weekly.ApplicationID = daily.ApplicationID)  
 --left join    
  (    
  select round(AVG(t8 - t12), 0) hT8T12, round(avg(t4), 0) ht4, AVG(CAST(count as int)) Count,ApplicationID     
  from OrderExec where Date >= @historicalDate and Date < @weeklyDate and Parameter = @parameter and count > 1000    
  group by ApplicationID  
  ) historical  
 on (historical.ApplicationID = daily.ApplicationID)  
order by sorter  
END 


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetOrderMessageDetails

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE GetOrderMessageDetails --GetOrderMessageDetails '2015-05-02'
@runDate date  
AS  

declare @startDate date
declare @endDate date  
set @startDate = DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, @runDate), 0)  
set @endDate = DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, @runDate) + 1, 0)  
  
--Charges  
select 0 SecurityType, NULL ISIN_EX, 60 Na, 0.006 Nb, 60000 F, 0.01 C into #charges union  
select 1, NULL, 60,    30, 60000, 0.01 union  
select 5, NULL, 60,    30, 60000, 0.01 union  
select 11, NULL, 60,    30, 60000, 0.01 union 
select 16, NULL, 60,    30, 60000, 0.01 union   
select 36, NULL, 60,    30, 60000, 0.01 union   
select 5, 'IN1000000001BR', 250,  100, 60000, 0.01  
  
--Trade summary  
select a.EsteeId, a.DataFeed_Ticker, a.Messages, a.Orders, isnull(b.Trades, 0) Trades, isnull(b.Volume, 0) Volume into #trade_data 
 from  
(select EsteeId, em.DataFeed_Ticker, sum(omd.OrdersCount) Orders, SUM(omd.OrderTradesCount) Messages, SUM(omd.TradesCount) Trades  
from OrderMessageDetails omd left join esteemaster em on (omd.EsteeId = em.Estee_ID )  
where tradedate >= @startDate and tradedate < @endDate   
group by EsteeId, em.DataFeed_Ticker  
--order by Messages desc  
) a left join
(  
select estee_id, count(*) Trades, SUM(Traded_quantity * Traded_Price) Volume from vwAllTrades   
where Creation_Date >= @startDate and Creation_Date < @endDate  
group by Estee_ID  
--order by Trades  
) b  
on a.EsteeId = b.Estee_ID  
order by a.Messages desc  
  
--Penalty Calculation  
select @startDate PenaltyMonth , p.EsteeID, p.DataFeed_Ticker, p.Messages, p.Trades, p.Volume, p.Na, p.F, p.C, p.PenaltyA, p.PenaltyB,
case when p.PenaltyA > 0 then p.PenaltyA else 0 end + case when p.PenaltyB > 0 then p.PenaltyB else 0 end 'Total Penalty'
from  
(  
 select td.EsteeID, td.DataFeed_Ticker, (Messages - c.Na * td.Trades  - c.F) * c.C PenaltyA, (Messages - c.Nb * td.Volume  - c.F) * c.C PenaltyB  
 ,Messages,  c.Na, td.Trades, td.Volume, c.F, c.C  
 from #trade_data td left join (select * from #charges where ISIN_EX is NULL) c on (CAST(SUBSTRING(td.esteeID, 15, 2) as int) = c.SecurityType)
 where SUBSTRING(td.esteeID, 0, 15) not in (select distinct isin_ex from #charges where ISIN_EX is not null)  
 UNION  
 select td.EsteeID, td.DataFeed_Ticker, (Messages - c.Na * td.Trades  - c.F) * c.C PenaltyA, (Messages - c.Nb * td.Volume  - c.F) * c.C PenaltyB  
 ,Messages,  c.Na, td.Trades, td.Volume, c.F, c.C  
 from #trade_data td left join #charges c on (CAST(SUBSTRING(td.esteeID, 15, 2) as int) = c.SecurityType)
 where SUBSTRING(td.esteeID, 0, 15) in (select distinct isin_ex from #charges where ISIN_EX is not null)  
 AND c.ISIN_EX is not null  
) p
order by p.Messages desc

drop table #charges  
drop table #trade_data
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetOrderThroughPutBySegment

```sql
--GetOrderThroughPutBySegment 200000, 300000, 'IS',null 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetOrderThroughPutBySegment]  
@startAppID int  
,@endAppID int  
,@exchangeCode varchar(2)  
,@rundate date = null  
AS  
  
IF @rundate is null  
set @rundate = getdate()  

INSERT INTO OrderThroughPutBySegment  
select @rundate, vt.sub_strategy_id, vc.Segment  
, DATEPART(HOUR, vt.Creation_Time) HH, DATEPART(MINUTE, vt.Creation_Time) MM, DATEPART(SECOND, vt.Creation_Time) SS  
, COUNT(*) 'Count'  
from vwalltrades vt(nolock)  
, ValidCombos vc( nolock)  
where vt.Creation_Date = @rundate
and cast (SUBSTRING(vt.Estee_ID, 15,2) as int) = vc.SecurityType  
and vc.ExchangeCode = @exchangeCode
and vt.Exchange_order_ID is not null
group by vt.sub_strategy_id, vc.Segment  
, DATEPART(HOUR, vt.Creation_Time), DATEPART(MINUTE, vt.Creation_Time), DATEPART(SECOND, vt.Creation_Time)  
order by vt.sub_strategy_id, vc.Segment  
, DATEPART(HOUR, vt.Creation_Time), DATEPART(MINUTE, vt.Creation_Time), DATEPART(SECOND, vt.Creation_Time)   
  
declare @p float  
declare @p1 float  
declare @p2 float  
  
set @p = .50  
set @p1 = .95  
set @p2 = .99;  
  
with e1 as (  
select sub_strategy_id, Segment, count, row_number() over(partition by sub_strategy_id, segment order by count, hour, minute, second desc) as PRN,   
count(*) over (partition by sub_strategy_id,  segment) as N  
from orderThroughPutBySegment where Date = @rundate  
), e2 as (  
select sub_strategy_id, Segment, count, PRN, N, 1 + (@p * (N-1)) as RN, 1 + (@p1 * (N-1)) as RN1, 1 + (@p2 * (N-1)) as RN2  
from e1  
), e3 as (  
select sub_strategy_id, Segment, count, N, PRN, RN, CEILING(RN) as CRN, FLOOR(RN) as FRN, RN1, CEILING(RN1) as CRN1, FLOOR(RN1) as FRN1, RN2, CEILING(RN2) as CRN2, FLOOR(RN2) as FRN2  
from e2  
), er as (  
select sub_strategy_id, Segment, count, N, PRN,   
RN, CRN, FRN, case when e3.CRN = e3.FRN and e3.CRN = e3.RN then 1 else 0 end as grp,  
RN1, CRN1, FRN1, case when e3.CRN1 = e3.FRN1 and e3.CRN1 = e3.RN1 then 1 else 0 end as grp1,  
RN2, CRN2, FRN2, case when e3.CRN2 = e3.FRN2 and e3.CRN2 = e3.RN2 then 1 else 0 end as grp2  
from e3  
)  
INSERT INTO OrderThroughPutPercentile  
select @rundate, sub_strategy_id, Segment, max(count) MaxCount, sum(count) OrderCount, sum(case grp  
                when 1 then (case PRN when RN then count end)  
                else (case PRN  
                     when FRN then (CRN - RN) * count  
                     when CRN then (RN - FRN) * count end)  
    end) as percentile_count  
    , sum(case grp1  
                when 1 then (case PRN when RN1 then count end)  
                else (case PRN  
                     when FRN1 then (CRN1 - RN1) * count  
                     when CRN1 then (RN1 - FRN1) * count end)  
    end) as percentile_count1  
    , sum(case grp2  
                when 1 then (case PRN when RN2 then count end)  
                else (case PRN  
                     when FRN2 then (CRN2 - RN2) * count  
                     when CRN2 then (RN2 - FRN2) * count end)  
    end) as percentile_count2  
    
from er  
group by sub_strategy_id, Segment  
order by sub_strategy_id, Segment

```
