## Stored procedure: dbo.GetPayInPayOutNumbers

```sql
    
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetPayInPayOutNumbers]                                  
 @date date = null,                  
 @AccountID int = null,    
 @BrokerID int  = null,    
 @exchange varchar(500)                    
AS                                  
--GetPayInPayOutNumbers '2012-08-17',19,3,'IS'    
BEGIN         
 DECLARE @dateplusone DATETIME       
 DECLARE @service_tax decimal(20,8)    
 SET @dateplusone = DateAdd(dd, 1,  @date)     
 select @service_tax = (select distinct Charge from BrokerageCharges inner join vwBrokerage on [Key] = ServiceTaxKey where AccountID=@AccountID and BrokerID=@BrokerID and ServiceTaxKey > 0 and TurnoverKey = -1)  
    
select TC.TotalTC,isnull(TC.TCFNO,0)as TCFNO,isnull(TC.TCOptions,0)as TCOptions,isnull(OptionTC.amtassigned,0) as amtassigned,isnull(OptionTC.tcForAssignedTrades,0) as tcForAssignedTrades,    
isnull(OptionTC.amtExercised,0) as amtExercised,isnull(OptionTC.tcForExercisedTrades,0) as tcForExercisedTrades from    
    
(    
 select ISNULL(Sum(ISNULL(Transaction_Cost-case when @AccountID in (10,50,60) then (1+@service_tax)*T.Brokerage else 0 end, 0)), 0)as TotalTC,    
 sum(    
    CASE When SUBSTRING(Estee_ID, 15,2) in ('01', '02', '03', '05', '06', '07','11','12','13','20','36') then    
     (    
       ISNULL(t.Transaction_Cost-(case when @AccountID in (10,50,60) then (1+@service_tax)*T.brokerage else 0 end), 0)    
     ) else  0 end    
     ) as TCFNO,    
    sum(    
   CASE When SUBSTRING(Estee_ID, 15,2) in ('02', '03', '06', '07', '12','13') then    
    (    
      ISNULL(t.Transaction_Cost-(case when @AccountID in (10,50,60) then (1+@service_tax)*T.brokerage else 0 end), 0)    
    ) else  0 end    
    ) as TCOptions    
 from [Order] O WITH (NOLOCK)      
 INNER JOIN OrderTrades OT  WITH (NOLOCK) ON O.Order_ID = OT.Order_ID and O.Creation_Date = OT.Creation_Date     
 INNER JOIN Trades T  WITH (NOLOCK) ON OT.ORderTrade_ID = T.ORderTrade_ID and OT.Order_ID = T.Order_ID and OT.Creation_Date = T.Creation_Date      
 WHERE O.Account_ID = @AccountID AND O.Broker_ID = @BrokerID and status in ('executed','Partially Filled')     
 and O.Creation_Date >= @date AND O.Creation_Date < @dateplusone    
)as TC,    
(    
  select sum(case Remarks WHEN 'assigned' THEN Traded_Price*Traded_Quantity else 0 end) as AmtAssigned,    
  sum(case Remarks WHEN 'assigned' THEN transaction_cost-(case @AccountID when 10 then (1+@service_tax)*T.Brokerage else 0 end) else 0 end) as tcforAssignedtrades,    
  sum(case Remarks WHEN 'exercised' THEN Traded_Price*Traded_Quantity else 0 end) as AmtExercised,    
  sum(case Remarks WHEN 'exercised' THEN transaction_cost-(case @AccountID when 10 then (1+@service_tax)*T.Brokerage else 0 end) else 0 end) as tcforExercisedtrades    
  from [Order] O WITH (NOLOCK)     
  INNER JOIN OrderTrades OT  WITH (NOLOCK) ON O.Order_ID = OT.Order_ID and O.Creation_Date = OT.Creation_Date     
  INNER JOIN Trades T  WITH (NOLOCK) ON OT.ORderTrade_ID = T.ORderTrade_ID and OT.Order_ID = T.Order_ID and OT.Creation_Date = T.Creation_Date     
  LEFT OUTER JOIN esteemaster E ON T.Estee_iD = E.Estee_ID and E.exchange_code = @exchange     
  LEFT OUTER JOIN esteemaster_archive EA ON T.Estee_iD = EA.Estee_ID and EA.exchange_code = @exchange       
  where E.Status=1 and EA.Status = 1     
  and O.Creation_Date >= @date AND O.Creation_Date < @dateplusone     
  and OT.status IN ('executed', 'Partially Filled') and remarks in ('assigned', 'exercised') and     
  remarks is not null and O.account_id = @AccountID and O.broker_id = @BrokerID     
)as OptionTC    
     
    
--query to get lotsize per esteeID    
SELECT SUM(ISNULL(X.AssignedLotSize, 0) - ISNULL(X.ExercisedLotSize, 0)) AS LotsPerEsteeID FROM     
 (      
  select case Remarks WHEN 'assigned' THEN sum(traded_quantity)/MIN(ISNULL(E.Lot_Size, EA.Lot_Size)) END AS AssignedLotSize, case Remarks WHEN 'exercised' THEN sum(traded_quantity)/MIN(ISNULL(E.Lot_Size, EA.Lot_Size)) END AS ExercisedLotSize, T.estee_id  

  
  
   
  from [Order] O WITH (NOLOCK)     
  INNER JOIN OrderTrades OT  WITH (NOLOCK) ON O.Order_ID = OT.Order_ID and O.Creation_Date = OT.Creation_Date      
  INNER JOIN Trades T  WITH (NOLOCK) ON OT.ORderTrade_ID = T.ORderTrade_ID and OT.Order_ID = T.Order_ID and OT.Creation_Date = T.Creation_Date     
  LEFT OUTER JOIN esteemaster E ON T.Estee_iD = E.Estee_ID and E.exchange_code = @exchange    
  LEFT OUTER JOIN esteemaster_archive EA ON T.Estee_iD = EA.Estee_ID and EA.Status = 1 and EA.exchange_code = @exchange     
  where E.Status=1 and O.Creation_Date >= @date AND O.Creation_Date < @dateplusone and OT.status IN ('executed', 'Partially Filled')     
  and remarks in ('assigned','exercised') and remarks is not null and account_id = @AccountID and broker_id = @BrokerID     
  group by remarks, T.estee_ID, T.Trade_ID     
 ) X     
 GROUP BY X.estee_ID ORDER BY X.estee_ID    
     
 END 
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetPayInPayOutNumbersNew

```sql
        
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetPayInPayOutNumbersNew]                                      
 @date date = null,   
 @exchange varchar(500)                        
AS                                      
  
--GetPayInPayOutNumbersNew '20201008','IS'  
BEGIN                        
  
select TC.Account_ID, TC.TotalTC,isnull(OptionTC.amtassigned,0) as amtassigned,isnull(OptionTC.tcForAssignedTrades,0) as tcForAssignedTrades,        
isnull(OptionTC.amtExercised,0) as amtExercised,isnull(OptionTC.tcForExercisedTrades,0) as tcForExercisedTrades from        
        
(        
 select A.Account_ID, Sum(ISNULL(Transaction_Cost, 0)) as TotalTC      
 from [Order] O WITH (NOLOCK)          
 INNER JOIN OrderTrades OT  WITH (NOLOCK) ON O.Order_ID = OT.Order_ID and O.Creation_Date = OT.Creation_Date         
 INNER JOIN Trades T  WITH (NOLOCK) ON OT.ORderTrade_ID = T.ORderTrade_ID and OT.Order_ID = T.Order_ID and OT.Creation_Date = T.Creation_Date  
 INNER JOIN Account A WITH (NOLOCK) on A.Account_ID = o.Account_ID  
 WHERE OT.status in ('executed','Partially Filled') and A.Status = 'Active'  
 and O.Creation_Date = @date   
 group by A.Account_ID  
)as TC LEFT JOIN       
(        
  select A.Account_ID, sum(case Remarks WHEN 'assigned' THEN Traded_Price*Traded_Quantity else 0 end) as AmtAssigned,        
  sum(case Remarks WHEN 'assigned' THEN transaction_cost else 0 end) as tcforAssignedtrades,        
  sum(case Remarks WHEN 'exercised' THEN Traded_Price*Traded_Quantity else 0 end) as AmtExercised,        
  sum(case Remarks WHEN 'exercised' THEN transaction_cost else 0 end) as tcforExercisedtrades        
  from [Order] O WITH (NOLOCK)         
  INNER JOIN OrderTrades OT  WITH (NOLOCK) ON O.Order_ID = OT.Order_ID and O.Creation_Date = OT.Creation_Date         
  INNER JOIN Trades T  WITH (NOLOCK) ON OT.ORderTrade_ID = T.ORderTrade_ID and OT.Order_ID = T.Order_ID and OT.Creation_Date = T.Creation_Date  
  INNER JOIN ACCOUNT A WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.Account_ID = O.Account_ID  
  LEFT OUTER JOIN esteemaster E WITH (NOLOCK) ON T.Estee_iD = E.Estee_ID and E.exchange_code = @exchange         
  LEFT OUTER JOIN esteemaster_archive EA WITH (NOLOCK) ON T.Estee_iD = EA.Estee_ID and EA.exchange_code = @exchange           
  where E.Status=1 and EA.Status = 1         
  and O.Creation_Date = @date     
  and OT.status IN ('executed', 'Partially Filled') and remarks in ('assigned', 'exercised') and         
  remarks is not null and A.Status = 'Active'  
  group by A.Account_ID  
)as OptionTC on TC.Account_ID = OptionTC.Account_ID                           
         
 END 
 

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetPnLReport

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[GetPnLReport]  
   
@startdate datetime,  
   
@enddate datetime   
  
AS  
BEGIN  
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED  
declare @maxdate table (strategy_id varchar(50), date datetime)  

insert into @maxdate (strategy_id, date)  
select strategy_id, MAX(date) 
from AllocatorData where DATE between @startdate and @enddate group by Strategy_Id    

SELECT a.Exchange_Code, a.strategy_id,n.substrategy_name, a.mandate, a.moneydeployed, a.dailyexpirypnl,    
cast(     sum(isnull(t.traded_quantity,0) * case            
when e.security_type in (2, 3, 6, 7, 12, 13) then            
case isnull(t.buy_sell_indicator, 0)             
when 1 then t.traded_price             
else e.strike_price            
end           
else isnull(t.traded_price, 0)          
end)/10000000  as decimal (10,4)) As TurnOver, a.PerDayBrokerage   
from allocatordata a  with (nolock)   
inner join @maxdate m on m.strategy_id = a.Strategy_Id and m.date = a.Date  
inner join ordertrades ot with (nolock) on ot.Sub_Strategy_ID = a.strategy_id 
and ot.status in ('executed', 'partially filled') 
and ot.creation_Date between @startdate and @enddate  
inner join trades t with (nolock) on t.ordertrade_id = ot.ordertrade_id and t.order_id = ot.order_id and t.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date  
inner join esteemaster e with (nolock) on e.estee_id = t.estee_id and e.Status=1    
inner join strategy_new n with (nolock) on n.substrategy_id = a.strategy_id    
where a.strategy_id not in (10,11,12,16) and a.dailyexpirypnl not in ('0') and a.Date between   @startdate and @enddate
group by a.Exchange_Code,   
a.strategy_id,  
n.substrategy_name,  
a.mandate,  
a.moneydeployed,  
a.dailyexpirypnl,  
a.PerDayBrokerage   
order by a.Strategy_Id  


END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetPositionInClearing

```sql
CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetPositionInClearing]  
 @positionDate date,  
 @exCode char(2)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 SET NOCOUNT ON;  
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DailyPositions WHERE PositionDate = @positionDate AND Exchange_Code = @exCode)  
 BEGIN  
  IF(@exCode <> 'IS')  
   BEGIN  
     SELECT SecurityName,Account_ID,Estee_ID,Sub_StrategyID,Broker_ID,PositionDate,InClearingFTD,Rule_ID FROM DailyPositions   
     WHERE PositionDate = @positionDate AND Exchange_Code = @exCode   
     AND  InClearingFTD IS NOT NULL AND InClearingFTD <> 0  
    END   
   ELSE  
   BEGIN   
     SELECT SecurityName,Account_ID,Estee_ID,Sub_StrategyID,Broker_ID,PositionDate,InClearingFTD, Rule_ID FROM DailyPositions   
     WHERE PositionDate = @positionDate AND Exchange_Code = @exCode   
     AND  InClearingFTD IS NOT NULL AND InClearingFTD <> 0  
     UNION  
     SELECT e.DataFeed_Ticker SecurityName,  
     10 Account_ID,--NSE PRO  
     e.Estee_ID Estee_ID,  
     4444 Sub_StrategyID,--AUCTION STARTEGY  
     3 Broker_ID,--BROKER = ESTEE   
     c.asofdate PositionDate,  
     c.shortQty InClearingFTD  ,
	 -1 Rule_ID
     FROM CashRecdOrDeliveredToExg c   
     INNER JOIN Esteemaster e ON c.symbol = e.underlying_ticker  
     INNER JOIN SecurityType s ON e.security_type = s.typecode  
     WHERE c.asofdate = @positionDate   
     AND e.security_type = 0   
     AND e.exchange_code = @exCode  
     AND c.deliverytype = 'R'  
   END  
 END  
  ELSE  
 BEGIN       
    SELECT ISNULL(E.DataFeed_Ticker, EA.DataFeed_Ticker) SecurityName,A.Account_ID,Tra.Estee_ID, Ord.Sub_Strategy_ID Sub_StrategyID,  
    B.BROKER_ID,OrdTra.Creation_Date PositionDate,sum((3-2* buy_sell_indicator)*Tra.Traded_Quantity) InClearingFTD , ISNULL(Link_ID,-1) as Rule_ID 
    FROM         
    [Order] Ord   
    INNER JOIN OrderTrades OrdTra ON Ord.Order_ID = OrdTra.Order_ID and Ord.Creation_Date = OrdTra.Creation_Date        
    INNER JOIN Trades Tra ON OrdTra.OrderTrade_ID = Tra.OrderTrade_ID and OrdTra.Order_ID = Tra.Order_ID and OrdTra.Creation_Date = Tra.Creation_Date             
    INNER JOIN Broker B ON Ord.Broker_ID = B.Broker_ID         
    INNER JOIN ACCOUNT A ON ISNULL(Ord.Account_ID, 1) = A.Account_ID  
    LEFT OUTER JOIN ESTEEMASTER E ON E.Estee_ID =  Tra.Estee_ID and  E.Status=1  
    LEFT OUTER JOIN EsteeMaster_archive EA ON EA.Estee_ID =  Tra.Estee_ID  and EA.Status = 1      
    WHERE OrdTra.Creation_Date = @positionDate  
    AND E.Exchange_Code = @exCode and LEN(Tra.Estee_ID) = 16  
    AND OrdTra.status IN ('Executed', 'Partially Filled')  
   GROUP BY ISNULL(E.DataFeed_Ticker, EA.DataFeed_Ticker),A.Account_ID,Tra.Estee_ID, Ord.Sub_Strategy_ID,B.BROKER_ID,OrdTra.Creation_Date,Link_ID  
   HAVING sum((3-2* buy_sell_indicator)*Tra.Traded_Quantity) <>0  
 END  
END  


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetPositionLimits

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetPositionLimits]          
@dimensionID int=NULL,          
@dimensionValue varchar(20)=NULL,          
@userID int = NULL ,         
@Exchanges varchar(20)=NULL        
AS          
BEGIN          
        
 if((@userID = -1 OR @userID IS NULL) AND   @exchanges is  null)          
 BEGIN           
  SELECT distinct DimensionName, DimensionValue, 'Position_'+ISIN+'_'+RuleName MeasureName, ExchangeCode, SecurityType, LongShort, LimitValue        
  FROM PositionLimits pl inner join ParameterDimension pd on pl.Dimensionid = pd.Dimensionid          
  inner join PositionMeasureRule pmr on  pmr.RuleID = pl.RuleID        
  WHERE pl.DimensionID  =ISNULL(@dimensionID,pl.DimensionID)        
  AND pl.DimensionValue = ISNULL(@dimensionValue, pl.DimensionValue)        
 END          
 ELSE          
 BEGIN     
IF  @exchanges is not null         
BEGIN    
SELECT distinct DimensionName, DimensionValue, 'Position_'+ISIN+'_'+RuleName MeasureName, ExchangeCode, SecurityType, LongShort, LimitValue        
  FROM PositionLimits pl inner join ParameterDimension pd on pl.Dimensionid = pd.Dimensionid          
  inner join PositionMeasureRule pmr on  pmr.RuleID = pl.RuleID       
  cross apply  dbo.Split(pmr.ExchangeCode,',') b     
  WHERE pl.DimensionID  =ISNULL(@dimensionID,pl.DimensionID)        
  AND pl.DimensionValue = ISNULL(@dimensionValue, pl.DimensionValue)    and   b.items in (select * from dbo.Split(@exchanges, ','))    
END    
ELSE    
BEGIN     
  SELECT DimensionName, DimensionValue, 'Position_'+ISIN+'_'+RuleName MeasureName, ExchangeCode, SecurityType, LongShort, LimitValue        
  from UserStrategies U            
  inner Join Strategy_New SN on SN.Strategy_ID = U.strategy_id         
  inner Join PositionLimits PL ON Right(PL.DimensionValue,4) = SN.SubStrategy_Id             
  inner join PositionMeasureRule PMR on  PL.RuleID = PMR.RuleID        
  inner join ParameterDimension pd on PL.Dimensionid = pd.Dimensionid            
  where U.UserID = @userID and PL.DimensionID  =ISNULL(@dimensionID,PL.DimensionID)        
  AND PL.DimensionValue = ISNULL(@dimensionValue, PL.DimensionValue)        
 END     
END        
END 
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetPositionLimitStrategyAccountMap

```sql




CREATE PROCEDURE GetPositionLimitStrategyAccountMap   
      @Account_List LISTSTRING READONLY  
AS  
     BEGIN  
  
         SELECT SubStrategyID, AccountID, 'TradingMember' DimensionType , REPLACE(ISNULL(NULLIF(acc.participant_id, ''), 'ESTEE'), '13362', 'ESTEE') DimensionValue  
         FROM StrategyBrokerAccount sba  
              INNER JOIN Account acc ON Account_ID = accountID  
              INNER JOIN Strategy_New sn ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sba.subStrategyID  
         WHERE sn.Strategy_Status = 1  
         ORDER BY sba.subStrategyID, AccountID  
  
     --for banned securities  
  
         SELECT SBA.subStrategyID, SBA.accountID, 'Account' DimensionType, SBA.accountID DimensionValue  
         FROM dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount AS SBA  
              INNER JOIN dbo.Strategy_New AS SN ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sba.subStrategyID  
              INNER JOIN Account A ON A.account_id = sba.accountid  
                                      AND sn.Strategy_Status = 1  
                                      AND a.status = 'Active'  
  
  -- Strategy Category, Position Limit  
  select sb.subStrategyID, sb.accountID, 'StrategyCategory' DimensionType, sg.CategoryID DimensionValue  
   from StrategyGroup sg, Strategy_New s, StrategyBrokerAccount sb  
   where sg.StrategyID = s.Strategy_Id  
   and s.SubStrategy_Id  = sb.subStrategyID  
   and s.Strategy_Status = 1  
   and sg.StrategyName like '%NHB%' 
   
   -- Clearing Account
   SELECT SBA.subStrategyID, SBA.accountID, 'ClearingAccount' DimensionType, SBA.accountID DimensionValue  
    FROM dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount AS SBA  
    INNER JOIN dbo.Strategy_New AS SN ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sba.subStrategyID  
    INNER JOIN Account A ON A.account_id = sba.accountid  
	INNER JOIN RiskLimits RL ON sba.accountID = RL.DimensionValue
	AND RL.DimensionId = 14
    AND sn.Strategy_Status = 1  
    AND a.status = 'Active'
  
  
     END
```

```sql
CREATE proc GetPositionRule     
 @exchanges varchar(20) = null  
  
AS

  from   PositionMeasureRule a cross apply
```

## Function: dbo.GetPreviousExpiryDate

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[GetPreviousExpiryDate] (@date datetime)  
RETURNS datetime  
AS  
-- place the body of the function here  
BEGIN  
 DECLARE @previousExpiryDate datetime  
 SET @previousExpiryDate =  
 (  
  Select DISTINCT TOP 1 EXPIRY_DATE   
  FROM   
  (  
   select expiry_date from esteemaster where  Exchange_Code='IS' and  status = 1 and expiry_date != '' and expiry_date < @date  
   Union  
   select expiry_date from esteemaster_archive where  Exchange_Code='IS' and  status = 1 and expiry_date != '' and expiry_date < @date  
  ) X ORDER BY X.expiry_date desc  
 )  
 return @previousExpiryDate  
END

```

## Function: dbo.GetPreviouStrategyParameterValue

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[GetPreviouStrategyParameterValue] 
(
	-- Add the parameters for the function here
	@SubStrategy_ID int, @Parameter varchar(60), @UpdatedDate datetime
)
RETURNS VARCHAR(60)
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @_Value VARCHAR(60)

	if exists(select 1 From DATAINIT_ARCHIVE Where DATAINIT_ARCHIVE.SubStrategy_ID = @SubStrategy_ID and DATAINIT_ARCHIVE.Parameter = @Parameter and DATAINIT_ARCHIVE.UpdatedDate>@UpdatedDate)
		Select TOP 1  @_Value=[Value] From DATAINIT_ARCHIVE Where DATAINIT_ARCHIVE.SubStrategy_ID = @SubStrategy_ID and DATAINIT_ARCHIVE.Parameter = @Parameter and DATAINIT_ARCHIVE.UpdatedDate>@UpdatedDate Order by DATAINIT_ARCHIVE.UpdatedDate ASC
	else 
		Select  @_Value=[Value] From DATAINIT Where DATAINIT.SubStrategy_ID = @SubStrategy_ID and DATAINIT.Parameter = @Parameter

	RETURN @_Value

END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetPreviousXExpiryFromRunDate

```sql
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Megha Goel
-- Create date: 10 july 2014
-- Description:	GetNextXExpiryFromRunDate
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE GetPreviousXExpiryFromRunDate
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@runDate Date,	
	@ExchangeCode char(2),
	@listSecType LISTSTRING READONLY,
	@count int
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SELECT TOP (@count) * FROM
		(   SELECT DISTINCT Expiry_Date AS DATE 
		      FROM esteemaster E
		INNER JOIN @listSecType LS on E.Security_Type = LS.ListItem
		     WHERE Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode 
			   AND Expiry_Date < @runDate 
			   AND Status = '1'
		       AND Expiry_Date is not null

			UNION

			SELECT DISTINCT Expiry_Date AS DATE 
			  FROM esteemaster_archive E
		INNER JOIN @listSecType LS on E.Security_Type = LS.ListItem
			 WHERE Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode  
			   AND Status = '1' 
			   AND Expiry_Date < @runDate 
			   AND Expiry_Date IS NOT NULL
	) A order by A.date desc
END


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetProcessOrderQueuesForEMS

```sql
  
-- =============================================  
-- Author:  Megha Rani  
-- Create date: 7 Mar 2013  
-- Description: GET process order queue names for strategies for given EMS ID  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetProcessOrderQueuesForEMS]   
 -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here   
 @EmsApplicationId int  
AS  
BEGIN  
 SET NOCOUNT ON;  
   
 Declare @SubstrategyList table(substrategyid int)  
 Declare @POInsertQueues table(substrategyid int, insertQueueName varchar(255))  
 Declare @POUpdateQueues table(substrategyid int, updateQueueName varchar(255))
 Declare @POInsertQtypes table(substrategyid int, QType varchar(255))
 Declare @DefaultPOServer varchar(50)  
   
 Select @DefaultPOServer = Value from DataInit  
 where ApplicationID= @EmsApplicationId and Parameter='POUpdateQServer'  
   
 Insert into @SubstrategyList  
 select substrategy_id from datainit where parameter='Multiexchange' and Value like ('%' + cast(@EmsApplicationId as varchar(50)) + '%')  
 union  
  select substrategy_id from datainit where parameter='MultiEMS' and Value like ('%' + cast(@EmsApplicationId as varchar(50)) + '%')  
 union  
 select substrategy_id from esteeapplications where EMS_Application_ID= @EmsApplicationId and substrategy_id is not null   
   
 Insert into @POInsertQueues  
 select substrategy_id, value from datainit DI inner join @SubstrategyList SL on DI.Substrategy_id = SL.substrategyid  
 where DI.Parameter='POINSERTQ'  
   
 Insert into @POInsertQueues  
 select substrategyid, 'processorderinsertqueue'  
 from @SubstrategyList SL Left Outer join datainit DI   
 on DI.Substrategy_id = SL.substrategyid and DI.Parameter='POINSERTQ'  
 where DI.Substrategy_id is NULL  
   
 Insert into @POUpdateQueues  
 select substrategy_id, value from datainit DI join @SubstrategyList SL on DI.Substrategy_id = SL.substrategyid  
 where DI.Parameter='POUPDATEQ'  
   
 Insert into @POUpdateQueues  
 select substrategyid, 'processorderupdatequeue'  
 from @SubstrategyList SL Left Outer join datainit DI   
 on DI.Substrategy_id = SL.substrategyid and DI.Parameter='POUPDATEQ'  
 where DI.Substrategy_id is NULL   
 
 Insert into @POInsertQtypes
 select substrategy_id, value from datainit DI join @SubstrategyList SL on DI.Substrategy_id = SL.substrategyid  
 where DI.Parameter='POInsertQType'  
   
 select PI.substrategyid, insertQueueName, updateQueueName ,   
 case when di2.Value is not null then isnull(es.IP, DI3.Value)
 else @DefaultPOServer end As POUpdateQServer, 
 isnull(PQ.QType  ,'') as POInsertQType
 from @POInsertQueues PI   
 inner join @POUpdateQueues PO on PI.substrategyid = PO.substrategyid   
 Left join DataInit di on di.substrategy_id = pi.substrategyid and di.Parameter='Multiexchange'  
 Left Join DataInit di2 on di.substrategy_id = di2.substrategy_id and di2.Parameter='RemoteEMS'  
 and di2.Value like '%' + cast(@EmsApplicationId as varchar(255)) + '%'  
 INNER JOIN EsteeApplications EA on EA.SubStrategy_ID = Pi.substrategyid  
 LEFT JOIN DataInit DI3 on EA.EMS_Application_ID = DI3.ApplicationID and DI3.Parameter='POUpdateQServer'    
 LEFT JOIN DataInit DI4 on EA.EMS_Application_ID = DI4.ApplicationID and DI4.Parameter='POUpdateQServerID'
 LEFT JOIN EsteeServers es on es.ID = DI4.value
 LEFT JOIN @POInsertQtypes PQ on PQ.substrategyid = PI.substrategyid
   
    
END  

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetProcessOrderQueuesForStrategies

```sql
  
-- =============================================  
-- Author:  Megha Rani  
-- Create date: 7 Mar 2013  
-- Description: GET process order queue names for strategies for given EMS ID  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetProcessOrderQueuesForStrategies]   
 -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here   
 @substrategyList  IntegerListType Readonly
AS  
BEGIN  
 SET NOCOUNT ON;  
   
   if exists ( select 1 from @substrategyList)
   begin
		Select distinct ea.SubStrategy_ID as substrategyid,  iSNULL(di2.value, 'processorderinsertqueue') as insertQueueName								
			, iSNULL(di4.value, '') as POInsertQType, ISNULL(di1.value, 'processorderupdatequeue') as updateQueueName
		from EsteeApplications ea
		inner join @substrategyList sl on ea.SubStrategy_ID= sl.n
		join Strategy_New sn on ea.SubStrategy_ID = sn.SubStrategy_Id and sn.Strategy_Status=1		
		left join datainit di1 on di1.substrategy_id=ea.SubStrategy_ID and di1.Parameter='POUPDATEQ'
		left join datainit di2 on di2.substrategy_id= ea.SubStrategy_ID and di2.Parameter='POINSERTQ'	
		left join datainit di4 on di4.substrategy_id= ea.SubStrategy_ID and di4.Parameter='POInsertQType'		
		order by substrategyid
    end
	else
	begin
		Select distinct ea.SubStrategy_ID as substrategyid,  iSNULL(di2.value, 'processorderinsertqueue') as insertQueueName								
			, iSNULL(di4.value, '') as POInsertQType, ISNULL(di1.value, 'processorderupdatequeue') as updateQueueName
		from EsteeApplications ea	
		join Strategy_New sn on ea.SubStrategy_ID = sn.SubStrategy_Id and sn.Strategy_Status=1			
		left join datainit di1 on di1.substrategy_id=ea.SubStrategy_ID and di1.Parameter='POUPDATEQ'
		left join datainit di2 on di2.substrategy_id= ea.SubStrategy_ID and di2.Parameter='POINSERTQ'	
		left join datainit di4 on di4.substrategy_id= ea.SubStrategy_ID and di4.Parameter='POInsertQType'	
		order by substrategyid
	end
END 
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetRBIRefRate

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE GetRBIRefRate   
 @ExchangeCodes varchar(300),  
 @AsOfDate date  
AS  
BEGIN  
 Declare @CurrencySpot int
 DECLARE @ExchangeCode TABLE(Exchange_Code [char](10)) 
 set @CurrencySpot = 10  
 INSERT into @ExchangeCode SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) from dbo.split(@ExchangeCodes,',')   
 select EM.Estee_ID, CP.RefRate   
 from esteemaster EM  
 inner join RBIRefRate CP  
 on EM.Security_Type = @CurrencySpot  
 and EM.Exchange_Code in (select Exchange_code from @ExchangeCode)   
 and CP.Estee_ID = EM.Estee_ID  
 and CP.[Date] = @AsOfDate  
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetRebateData

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetRebateData]  
@startDate date,  
@endDate date  
AS  
BEGIN  
SELECT AccountID, SubStrategyID, cast(SUM (TotalRebate) as decimal(20,4)) TotalRebate FROM tblRebateData  
WHERE RebateDate >= @startDate  
AND RebateDate < @endDate  
GROUP BY AccountID, SubStrategyID  

SELECT AccountID, SubStrategyID, cast(SUM (TotalRebate) as decimal(20,4)) TotalCharges FROM tblRebateData  
WHERE RebateDate >= @startDate  
AND RebateDate < @endDate  
AND RebateType in ('Penalty','MinimumChargeCommitment','MISCCharges','Brokerage')
GROUP BY AccountID, SubStrategyID
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetRejectionRatio

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetRejectionRatio]  
  
AS  
BEGIN  

	SET NOCOUNT ON;  
	  
	;with a as (  
		select COUNT(distinct Order_ID) as TotalOrders, Sub_Strategy_ID 
		from OrderTrades  WITH (NOLOCK)
		where Creation_Date > = DATEADD(MI,-1,GETDATE())  
		group by Sub_Strategy_ID),   
	b as (
		select COUNT(distinct Order_ID) as RejectedOrders, Sub_Strategy_ID 
		from OrderTrades  WITH (NOLOCK)
		where Creation_Date > = DATEADD(MI,-1,GETDATE()) and Status = 'Rejected'   
		group by Sub_Strategy_ID)  
	select a.TotalOrders,ISNULL(b.RejectedOrders,0) as RejectedOrders,
	Round(CAST(ISNULL(b.RejectedOrders*100,0) as float )/CAST(a.TotalOrders as float),2) as RejectionRatio,
	a.Sub_Strategy_ID 
	from a   
	left join b on a.Sub_Strategy_ID = b.Sub_Strategy_ID;  

END

```

```sql
CREATE PROC GetRiskLimitIDByDimensionIDandValue

@DimensionID int,

@DimensionValue NVARCHAR(20)

AS


--------------------LOGIC FOR TEMP DATE-------------------------------------------------------------------  
  declare @tempDate date = '0001-01-01'  
  DECLARE @cutOffTime TIME  
  DECLARE @tempDateTime TIME = CONVERT(TIME,GETDATE())  
  SELECT @cutOffTime = value from datainit where ApplicationID = 0 and Parameter = 'TradeDateCutOffTime'  
 
   IF @tempDateTime between '00:00:00' and @cutOffTime  
   BEGIN  
    SET @tempDate = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE() - 1)  
   END   
   ELSE  
   BEGIN  
    SET @tempDate = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE())  
   END  
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------     

 IF EXISTS(select Top 1 ID from RiskLimits where DimensionId = @DimensionID and DimensionValue = @DimensionValue AND [date] = @tempDate)
 begin
 select Top 1 ID from RiskLimits where DimensionId = @DimensionID and DimensionValue = @DimensionValue AND [date] = @tempDate
 end
 else
 begin
select Top 1 ID from RiskLimits where DimensionId = @DimensionID and DimensionValue = @DimensionValue and [date] = '0001-01-01'
end
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetRiskLimits

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetRiskLimits]      

@dimensionID varchar(20)=NULL,      

@dimensionValue varchar(20)=NULL,      

@userID int = NULL      

AS      

BEGIN   

SET NOCOUNT ON   
-------------------Logic for tempDate and cut off time check--------------------------------------
DECLARE @tempDate DATE = CONVERT(date,getdate())
DECLARE @cutOffTime TIME
DECLARE @tempDateTime TIME = CONVERT(TIME,GETDATE())
DECLARE @minDate DATE = '0001-01-01'
SELECT @cutOffTime = value from datainit where ApplicationID = 0 and Parameter = 'TradeDateCutOffTime'

IF @tempDateTime between '00:00:00' and @cutOffTime
BEGIN
	SET @tempDate = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE() - 1)
END 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SELECT * INTO #tempRL FROM 
(
  SELECT  isnull(rl.DimensionId, rlOri.DimensionId) DimensionId ,isnull(rl.RiskParamId, rlOri.RiskParamId) RiskParamId, isnull(rl.DimensionValue, rlOri.DimensionValue)  DimensionValue
,isnull(rl.RiskParameterValue, rlOri.RiskParameterValue) RiskParameterValue,isnull(rl.ID, rlOri.ID) ID FROM (SELECT * FROM RiskLimits WHERE [DATE] = @tempDate) rl 
RIGHT JOIN
 ( SELECT * FROM RiskLimits rlOri WHERE [DATE] = @minDate) rlOri 
 ON rl.DimensionId = rlOri.DimensionId and rl.DimensionValue = rlOri.DimensionValue and rl.RiskParamId = rlOri.RiskParamId) RiskLimitTab

if(@userID = -1 OR @userID IS NULL)      

BEGIN       

 SELECT RL.DimensionId, DimensionName,DimensionValue, RiskParamName, RiskParameterValue ,RL.ID     

 FROM  #tempRL RL (nolock)

 inner join RiskParameters RP (nolock) on  RL.RiskParamId = RP.RiskParamId      

 inner join ParameterDimension pd (nolock) on RL.Dimensionid = pd.Dimensionid      

 WHERE RL.DimensionID  =ISNULL(@dimensionID,RL.DimensionID)      

 AND RL.DimensionValue = ISNULL(@dimensionValue, RL.DimensionValue)      

END      

ELSE      

BEGIN      

 select RL.DimensionId, DimensionName,DimensionValue, RiskParamName, RiskParameterValue  , RL.ID     

 from UserStrategies U (nolock)

 inner Join Strategy_New SN (nolock) on SN.Strategy_ID = U.strategy_id and sn.Strategy_Status = 1

 inner Join #tempRL RL (nolock) ON Right(RL.DimensionValue,4) = SN.SubStrategy_Id         

 inner join RiskParameters RP (nolock) on  RL.RiskParamId = RP.RiskParamId        

 inner join ParameterDimension pd (nolock) on RL.Dimensionid = pd.Dimensionid        

 where U.UserID = @userID and RL.DimensionID  =ISNULL(@dimensionID,RL.DimensionID) and U.dimension_id=6    

   
END      

END


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetRiskLimitsStagingUserEx

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetRiskLimitsStagingUserEx]                

@dimensionID varchar(20)=NULL,                

@dimensionValue varchar(20)=NULL,        

@ApprovalStatus char(1)=NULL,        

@UserID int =NULL,        

@ApproverID int =NULL ,        

@Status bit =NULL  ,  

@NoOfDays int      

AS                

BEGIN

DECLARE @cutOffTime TIME
DECLARE @tempDate DATE = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE())
DECLARE @tempDateTime TIME = CONVERT(TIME,GETDATE())
DECLARE @minDate DATE = '0001-01-01'
SELECT @cutOffTime = value from datainit where ApplicationID = 0 and Parameter = 'TradeDateCutOffTime'


IF @tempDateTime between '00:00:00' and @cutOffTime
BEGIN
	SET @tempDate = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE() - 1)
END          

SELECT RRD.ReqID,RP.RiskParamId, DimensionName,RRD.DimensionId,RRD.DimensionValue,RiskParamName, RRD.RiskParameterValue,        

RAR.ApproversID,RAR.ApprovalStatus,RR.Requester,RR.status ,RR.RequestedTime,RR.Comments as RequesterComments,RAR.ApprovalTime,RAR.comments as ApproverComments,RRD.RiskLimitID

FROM RCFRequestDetail RRD inner join RiskParameters RP on  RRD.RiskParamId = RP.RiskParamId

inner join ParameterDimension pd on RRD.Dimensionid = pd.Dimensionid         

inner join RCFRequest RR on RR.ReqID=RRD.ReqID        

left outer join RCFApprovalRequest RAR on RAR.ReqID=RR.ReqID         

WHERE RRD.DimensionID  =ISNULL(@dimensionID,RRD.DimensionID)              

AND RRD.DimensionValue = ISNULL(@dimensionValue, RRD.DimensionValue)        

and (RAR.ApprovalStatus=ISNULL(@ApprovalStatus,RAR.ApprovalStatus) or  (@ApprovalStatus is null and RAR.ApprovalStatus is null))     

and RR.Requester=ISNULL(@UserID,RR.Requester)        

and (RAR.ApproversID=ISNULL(@ApproverID,RAR.ApproversID) or  (@ApproverID is null and RAR.ApproversID is null))        

and RR.Status=  ISNULL(@Status,RR.Status)        

and (RR.RequestedTime>=Dateadd(day,-@NoOfDays,getdate())  or RAR.ApprovalStatus='P')  

AND (RRD.Date = @tempDate or RRD.Date = @minDate)
     

END 


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetRiskManagerActivityQueuePerStrategy

```sql
-- =============================================

-- Author:		Megha Goel

-- Create date: 26 July 2013

-- Description:	Get strategy and RiskManageractivityQueue mappings

-- =============================================

CREATE PROCEDURE GetRiskManagerActivityQueuePerStrategy
   @applicationId int,
   @defaultIP varchar(50)

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT SN.SubStrategy_Id, 
	Case when di2.Value is not null then 
		ISNULL(es.IP, di.Value) Else @defaultIP 
	END AS RiskManagerActivityQueueServer
    FROM Strategy_New SN 
    INNER JOIN EsteeApplications EA on SN.SubStrategy_Id = EA.SubStrategy_ID  
    INNER JOIN DataInit di on di.ApplicationID = EA.EMS_Application_ID and di.Parameter='RiskManagerActivityQueueServer'
	LEFT JOIN DataInit dir on dir.ApplicationID = EA.EMS_Application_ID and dir.Parameter='RiskManagerActivityQueueServerID'
	LEFT JOIN EsteeServers es on es.ID = dir.value
	LEFT JOIN DataInit di1 with (nolock) on ea.SubStrategy_ID = di1.substrategy_id and di1.parameter = 'MultiExchange'
    LEFT JOIN DataInit di2 with (nolock) on di1.substrategy_id = di2.substrategy_id and di2.Parameter = 'RemoteEMS'
    and di2.Value like '%' + cast(@applicationId as varchar(255)) + '%'

    order by substrategy_id

END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetSettlementExchangeMapping

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[GetSettlementExchangeMapping]      
@exchangeID varchar(2),    
@securityTypes varchar(100),      
@settlementExchangeID varchar(2),  
@instrumentType int  

WITH RECOMPILE
AS
  
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
  
select em1.Estee_ID, em2.Estee_ID as SettlementExchangeEstee_ID   
from esteemaster (nolock) em1,esteemaster (nolock) em2, SyntheticIsinMap (nolock) s   
where s.ISIN = em1.ISIN and s.SyntheticISIN = em2.ISIN  
and em1.Security_Type = em2.Security_Type  
and ISNULL(em1.Strike_Price, 1) = ISNULL(em2.Strike_Price, 1)      
and ((CAST(em1.expiry_date as DATE) = CAST(em2.expiry_date as DATE)) OR (ISNULL(em1.Expiry_Date, '1901-01-01') < '2000-01-01' AND ISNULL(em2.Expiry_Date, '1901-01-01') < '2000-01-01'))  
and em1.Instrument_Type = em2.Instrument_Type  
and em1.Instrument_Type = @instrumentType  
and em1.Exchange_Code = @exchangeID  
and em2.Exchange_Code = @settlementExchangeID  
and em1.Security_Type in (SELECT * FROM dbo.split(@securityTypes, ','))  
  
UNION  
  
select em1.Estee_ID , em2.Estee_ID SettlementExchangeEstee_ID      
from esteemaster (nolock) em1,      
esteemaster (nolock) em2    
where em1.ISIN = em2.ISIN      
and em1.Security_Type = em2.Security_Type      
and ISNULL(em1.Strike_Price, 1) = ISNULL(em2.Strike_Price, 1)      
and ((CAST(em1.expiry_date as DATE) = CAST(em2.expiry_date as DATE)) OR (ISNULL(em1.Expiry_Date, '1901-01-01') < '2000-01-01' AND ISNULL(em2.Expiry_Date, '1901-01-01') < '2000-01-01'))  
and em1.Exchange_Code = @exchangeID      
and em2.Exchange_Code = @settlementExchangeID      
and em1.Security_Type in (SELECT * FROM dbo.split(@securityTypes, ','))  
and em1.Estee_ID <> em2.Estee_ID  
order by em1.Estee_ID , em2.Estee_ID

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetSettlementPriceNonLiquidSecurities

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetSettlementPriceNonLiquidSecurities]
	@rundate date
AS
BEGIN



;with A as (select distinct Exchange,Segment,MAX(SequenceID) SequenceID from Span_Sequence 
group by Exchange,Segment)

select distinct  s.esteeID,s.LTP
from A  inner join Span_Sequence ss on ss.Exchange = a.exchange and ss.Segment = a.segment and ss.SequenceID = a.SequenceID 
inner join ValidCombos v on v.ExchangeCode = ss.Exchange and v.Segment = ss.Segment
inner join SpanData s on s.spanID = ss.SpanID and substring(s.esteeID,13,2) = ss.Exchange and substring(s.esteeID,15,2) = v.SecurityType
where s.date = @rundate
and  s.esteeID in (

select distinct (Estee_ID) from DailyPositions where Long<>short and PositionDate=dateadd(day,-1,@rundate)
union 
select  distinct(esteeid) from subscription_realtime a 
inner join Strategy_New b on a.Strategy_Name=b.SubStrategy_Name
inner join esteemaster c on a.EsteeID=c.Estee_ID 
except 
select distinct(estee_id) from closingprice where Date=@rundate ) 

END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetSGXSpanData

```sql
  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetSGXSpanData]  
  
@runDate Datetime,  
  
@ExcludeSecurityType varchar(50),  
  
@ExchangeSegments varchar (2),  
  
@SpanID varchar(10)  
  
AS                  
  
  
  
BEGIN  
  
IF(select count(distinct c.Source) from esteemaster e inner join closingprice c on e.Estee_ID = c.Estee_ID and e.Exchange_Code = 'SG' and c.Date = @runDate  
and c.Source in( 'BB_ClosingPrice_Upload','MSCI_Index_All','SGX_ClosingPrice_All')) <> 3  
Begin  
  RAISERROR ('Data missing in ClosingPrice table for SGX.',16,1)  
End  
  
 select Z.Estee_ID,Z.DataFeed_Ticker,Y.MaintMargin,Y.InitialMargin,Y.ShortOptionMinimum,Y.IntraCommInitialMargin,C.SpanID,C.SequenceID  
  
 from esteemaster Z join  
  
  (select P.Underlying_Ticker,P.MaintMargin,P.InitialMargin,P.ShortOptionMinimum, Q.IntraCommInitialMargin  
  
  from  
  
  (select A.Underlying_Ticker,B.MaintMargin,B.InitialMargin,B.ShortOptionMinimum  
  
  from esteemaster A  
  
  join SGX_span_staging B  
  
  on A.DataFeed_Ticker=B.ContractCode and B.Tier=1  ) P  
  
  left outer join  
  
  (select A.Underlying_Ticker,B.IntraCommInitialMargin  
  
  from esteemaster A  
  
  join SGX_Span_Staging_IntraCommMarginRate B  
  
  on A.DataFeed_Ticker=B.ContractCode and B.LegATier = 1) Q  
  
  on P.Underlying_Ticker = Q.Underlying_Ticker) Y  
  
 on Y.Underlying_Ticker = Z.Underlying_Ticker  
  
 inner join Span_Sequence C on Z.Exchange_Code=C.Exchange and C.SpanID=@SpanID  and C.Segment = @ExchangeSegments  
  
 where Z.Exchange_Code='SG' and SUBSTRING(Z.Estee_ID,15,2) not in (select items from dbo.Split(@ExcludeSecurityType,','))  
 order by Z.Estee_ID, Y.IntraCommInitialMargin desc
  
   
  
 select R.Estee_ID,T.Close_Price,R.SpanID,R.SequenceID from  
  
  (select Y.Estee_ID,Y.DataFeed_Ticker ,C.SpanID,C.SequenceID  
  
  from esteemaster Y join  
  
  (select A.Underlying_Ticker from esteemaster A join SGX_span_staging B  
  
  on A.DataFeed_Ticker=B.ContractCode and B.Tier=1) X  
  
  on Y.Underlying_Ticker=X.Underlying_Ticker  
  
  inner join Span_Sequence C on Y.Exchange_Code=C.Exchange and C.SpanID=@SpanID and C.Segment = @ExchangeSegments  
  
  where Y.Exchange_Code='SG' and SUBSTRING(Y.Estee_ID,15,2) not in (select items from dbo.Split(@ExcludeSecurityType,',') ))R  
  
 inner join ClosingPrice T on T.Estee_ID=R.Estee_ID  
  
 where  T.Date=@runDate  
  
   
  
 select Priority, em.Estee_ID EsteeIDLeg1, em1.Estee_ID EsteeIDLeg2,Leg1Delta,Leg2Delta,CreditRate Credit, Leg1MarketSide leg1Buy_Sell, Leg2MarketSide leg2Buy_Sell  
  
 from SGX_Span_staging_InterCommCreditRate rate  
  
 inner join esteemaster em on em.DataFeed_Ticker=rate.Leg1ContractCode  
  
 inner join esteemaster em1 on em1.DataFeed_Ticker=rate.Leg2ContractCode  
  
 inner join Span_Sequence C on em.Exchange_Code=C.Exchange and C.SpanID=@SpanID and C.Segment = @ExchangeSegments  
  
END  
  
  
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetStrategiesByApplicationID

```sql
--GetStrategiesByApplicationID '200216', 1  
CREATE PROCEDURE GetStrategiesByApplicationID @applicationID int,@strategystatuscheck bit = 1, @isGlobal bit = 0, @return nvarchar(500) = '' output  
AS   
BEGIN  
   SET NOCOUNT ON;  
   SET @return = ''  
   IF ISNULL(@applicationID, 0) <> 0 
   BEGIN  
         SET @return = 'SUCCESS'  
       
   if @isGlobal = 1
   begin
			select ea.SubStrategy_ID   
			   from EsteeApplications ea,  
			   EsteeServers es,  
			   Strategy_New sn  
			   where ea.EsteeServer_ID = es.ID  
			   and ea.SubStrategy_ID = sn.SubStrategy_Id   
			   and Strategy_Status IN (1, case @strategystatuscheck when 0 then 0 else 1 end)   
			   order by ea.SubStrategy_ID  
   end
   else
	   begin
			select ea.SubStrategy_ID   
			   from EsteeApplications ea,  
			   EsteeServers es,  
			   Strategy_New sn  
			   where es.LocationCode =   
			   (  
				select LocationCode  
				from EsteeServers es,   
				EsteeApplications ea  
				where es.ID = ea.EsteeServer_ID  
				and ea.ApplicationID = @applicationID   
			   )  
			   and ea.EsteeServer_ID = es.ID  
			   and ea.SubStrategy_ID = sn.SubStrategy_Id   
			   and Strategy_Status IN (1, case @strategystatuscheck when 0 then 0 else 1 end)   
			   order by ea.SubStrategy_ID  
	   end   
    END  
   ELSE  
   BEGIN  
      SET @return = 'ERROR: There is no EMS Server configured for this application ID: ' + @applicationID  
   END  
END  
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetStrategyAccountLimits

```sql
   
CREATE PROCEDURE GetStrategyAccountLimits    
 -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here    
 @userId int     
AS    
BEGIN    
 SET NOCOUNT ON;    
 declare @riskLimitsTemp Table(subStrategyID int, accountID int, marginMandate decimal, cashMandate decimal, MTMPercentage decimal)    
     
 insert into @riskLimitsTemp    
 Select subStrategyID,accountId, [MarginMandate],[CashMandate],[MtmPercentage]    
 from (select sba.accountId,sba.subStrategyID,RP.RiskParamName,RL.RiskParameterValue    
 from RiskLimits RL join RiskParameters RP on RL.RiskParamId = RP.RiskParamId     
 join StrategyBrokerAccount sba on SUBSTRING(RL.DimensionValue,0,CHARINDEX('_',RL.DimensionValue)) =  sba.accountID    
 and SUBSTRING(RL.DimensionValue, CHARINDEX('_',RL.dimensionValue)+1, LEN(RL.DimensionValue)) = sba.subStrategyID    
 where DimensionId=3) P    
 PIVOT(max(RiskParameterValue) for RiskParamName in ([MarginMandate],[CashMandate],[MtmPercentage]))    
 As PivotTable    
     
 select RL.subStrategyID as SubStrategy_ID,sg.StrategyName as Strategy_Name,SN.SubStrategy_Name,RL.accountID as Account_ID,    
                        ISNULL((select A.Account_Name as account_name    
                        from Account A    
                        where A.Account_ID = RL.accountID),'PRO') as Account_Name,    
                        CAST(ISNULL(RL.marginMandate/100000, 0) AS decimal(20,4)) Mandate,    
                        CAST(ISNULL(RL.cashMandate/100000, 0) AS decimal(20,4)) as CashMandate,                          
                        ISNULL(RL.MTMPercentage,20) MTMPercentage                            
                        from @riskLimitsTemp RL     
                        inner join Strategy_New SN on SN.SubStrategy_Id = RL.substrategyid  
                        inner join StrategyGroup sg on SN.Strategy_Id = sg.StrategyID  
                        inner join UserStrategies US ON US.strategy_id = SN.Strategy_Id                            
                        WHERE US.UserID = @userId and US.dimension_id=6   
                        ORDER BY SN.SubStrategy_Id   
     
END 
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetStrategyDetails

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetStrategyDetails] 
@exchanges varchar(100) = null,
@applicationID int,
@strategy_status bit = 1,
@isGlobalAllocator bit = 0
AS
BEGIN
 DECLARE @localExchangeCode TABLE(Exchange_Code char(2))
 declare @activeStrategies table (subStrategyID int)
   IF(@exchanges is null OR @exchanges = '')  BEGIN                    
     insert into @localExchangeCode select code from Exchange          
   END ELSE BEGIN                    
     INSERT into @localExchangeCode SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) from dbo.split(@exchanges,',')                    
   END   
	insert into @activeStrategies
	exec GetStrategiesByApplicationID @applicationID, @strategy_status, @isGlobalAllocator
    Declare @marginMandateTable Table(accountId int, substrategyId int, marginMandate decimal) 
Declare @cashMandateTable Table(accountId int, substrategyId int, cashMandate decimal) 
Declare @CashGammaLimitTable Table(substrategyId int, CashGammaLimit decimal) 
Declare @CashDeltaLimitTable Table(substrategyId int, CashDeltaLimit decimal) 
Declare @MTMPercentageTable Table(accountId int, substrategyId int, MTMPercentage decimal) 
--------------------LOGIC FOR TEMP DATE-------------------------------------------------------------------  
  declare @tempDate date = '0001-01-01'  
  declare @minDate date = '0001-01-01' 
  DECLARE @cutOffTime TIME  
  DECLARE @tempDateTime TIME = CONVERT(TIME,GETDATE())  
  SELECT @cutOffTime = value from datainit where ApplicationID = 0 and Parameter = 'TradeDateCutOffTime'  
   IF @isGlobalAllocator =1 AND @tempDateTime between '00:00:00' and @cutOffTime
   BEGIN  
    SET @tempDate = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE() - 1)  
   END   
   ELSE  
   BEGIN  
    SET @tempDate = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE())  
   END  
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-----------------------------------------Margin Mandate -----------------------------------------------------------
	Insert into @marginMandateTable
	SELECT  isnull(rl.AccountId, rlOri.AccountId) AccountId ,isnull(rl.substrategyId, rlOri.substrategyId) substrategyId,
	 isnull(rl.marginMandate, rlOri.marginMandate)  marginMandate from
(
	(select  SUBSTRING(DimensionValue,0,CHARINDEX('_',DimensionValue)) AS AccountId,
	SUBSTRING(DimensionValue, CHARINDEX('_',dimensionValue)+1, LEN(DimensionValue)) as substrategyId, 
	 cast(RiskParameterValue as decimal) as marginMandate
	from RiskLimits RL where RiskParamId=12 and DimensionId=3 and RL.DATE = @minDate) rlOri 
	left join
	(select  SUBSTRING(DimensionValue,0,CHARINDEX('_',DimensionValue)) AS AccountId,
	SUBSTRING(DimensionValue, CHARINDEX('_',dimensionValue)+1, LEN(DimensionValue)) as substrategyId, 
	 cast(RiskParameterValue as decimal) as marginMandate
	from RiskLimits RL where RiskParamId=12 and DimensionId=3 and RL.DATE = @tempDate) rl
	ON rl.substrategyId = rlOri.substrategyId and rl.AccountId = rlOri.AccountId 
)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-----------------------------------------Cash Mandate ------------------------------------------------------------------
Insert into @cashMandateTable
	SELECT  isnull(rl.AccountId, rlOri.AccountId) AccountId ,isnull(rl.substrategyId, rlOri.substrategyId) substrategyId,
	 isnull(rl.cashMandate, rlOri.cashMandate)  cashMandate from
(
	(select  SUBSTRING(DimensionValue,0,CHARINDEX('_',DimensionValue)) AS AccountId,
	SUBSTRING(DimensionValue, CHARINDEX('_',dimensionValue)+1, LEN(DimensionValue)) as substrategyId, 
	 cast(RiskParameterValue as decimal) as cashMandate
	from RiskLimits RL where RiskParamId=13 and DimensionId=3  and RL.DATE = @minDate) rlOri 
	left join
	(select  SUBSTRING(DimensionValue,0,CHARINDEX('_',DimensionValue)) AS AccountId,
	SUBSTRING(DimensionValue, CHARINDEX('_',dimensionValue)+1, LEN(DimensionValue)) as substrategyId, 
	 cast(RiskParameterValue as decimal) as cashMandate
	from RiskLimits RL where RiskParamId=13 and DimensionId=3  and RL.DATE = @tempDate) rl
	ON rl.substrategyId = rlOri.substrategyId and rl.AccountId = rlOri.AccountId 
)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-----------------------------------------@Cash Gamma Limit------------------------------------------------------------------
Insert into @CashGammaLimitTable
	SELECT  isnull(rl.substrategyId, rlOri.substrategyId) substrategyId,
	 isnull(rl.CashGammaLimit, rlOri.CashGammaLimit)  CashGammaLimit from
(
	(select  SUBSTRING(DimensionValue, CHARINDEX('_',dimensionValue)+1, LEN(DimensionValue)) as substrategyId, 
	 cast(RiskParameterValue as decimal) as CashGammaLimit
	from RiskLimits RL where RiskParamId=4 and DimensionId=1   and RL.DATE = @minDate) rlOri 
	left join
	(select  SUBSTRING(DimensionValue, CHARINDEX('_',dimensionValue)+1, LEN(DimensionValue)) as substrategyId, 
	 cast(RiskParameterValue as decimal) as CashGammaLimit
	from RiskLimits RL where RiskParamId=4 and DimensionId=1   and RL.DATE = @tempDate) rl
	ON rl.substrategyId = rlOri.substrategyId
)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-----------------------------------------Cash Delta Limit------------------------------------------------------------------
Insert into @CashDeltaLimitTable
	SELECT  isnull(rl.substrategyId, rlOri.substrategyId) substrategyId,
	 isnull(rl.CashDeltaLimit, rlOri.CashDeltaLimit)  CashDeltaLimit from
(
	(select  SUBSTRING(DimensionValue, CHARINDEX('_',dimensionValue)+1, LEN(DimensionValue)) as substrategyId, 
	 cast(RiskParameterValue as decimal) as CashDeltaLimit
	from RiskLimits RL where RiskParamId=2 and DimensionId=1   and RL.DATE = @minDate) rlOri 
	left join
	(select  SUBSTRING(DimensionValue, CHARINDEX('_',dimensionValue)+1, LEN(DimensionValue)) as substrategyId, 
	 cast(RiskParameterValue as decimal) as CashDeltaLimit
	from RiskLimits RL where RiskParamId=2 and DimensionId=1   and RL.DATE = @tempDate) rl
	ON rl.substrategyId = rlOri.substrategyId
)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-----------------------------------------MTMPercentage------------------------------------------------------------------
Insert into @MTMPercentageTable
	SELECT  isnull(rl.AccountId, rlOri.AccountId) AccountId ,isnull(rl.substrategyId, rlOri.substrategyId) substrategyId,
	 isnull(rl.MTMPercentage, rlOri.MTMPercentage)  MTMPercentage from
(
	(select  SUBSTRING(DimensionValue,0,CHARINDEX('_',DimensionValue)) AS AccountId,
	SUBSTRING(DimensionValue, CHARINDEX('_',dimensionValue)+1, LEN(DimensionValue)) as substrategyId, 
	 cast(RiskParameterValue as decimal) as MTMPercentage
	from RiskLimits RL where RiskParamId=31 and DimensionId=3  and RL.DATE = @minDate) rlOri 
	left join
	(select  SUBSTRING(DimensionValue,0,CHARINDEX('_',DimensionValue)) AS AccountId,
	SUBSTRING(DimensionValue, CHARINDEX('_',dimensionValue)+1, LEN(DimensionValue)) as substrategyId, 
	 cast(RiskParameterValue as decimal) as MTMPercentage
	from RiskLimits RL where RiskParamId=31 and DimensionId=3  and RL.DATE = @tempDate) rl
	ON rl.substrategyId = rlOri.substrategyId and rl.AccountId = rlOri.AccountId 
)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SELECT sn.Strategy_Id, sba.subStrategyID as SubStrategy_ID,
	sba.accountID as Account_ID,
	sba.brokerID as Broker_ID,
	ISNULL(cgt.CashGammaLimit, 0) CashGammaLimit,
	ISNULL(cdt.CashDeltaLimit, 0) CashDeltaLimit,
	ISNULL(cmt.cashMandate, 0) cashMandate,
	ISNULL(mmt.marginMandate, 0) marginMandate,
	ISNULL(mpt.MTMPercentage, 0) MTMPercentage,
	sn.SubStrategy_Name,
	sn.Strategy_Status SubStrategy_Status,
	a.Account_Type,
	--ISNULL(sn.Cash_Balance, 0) Cash_Balance,
	sn.IsArb,
	a.Status, 
	CASE sba.StrategyAccountMode 
	WHEN -1 THEN ISNULL(d.Value, 'Log_Only')
	WHEN 0 THEN 'Log_Only'
	WHEN 1 THEN 'Live'
	WHEN 2 THEN 'Rebalance_Only'
	WHEN 3 THEN 'SquareOff_Only'
	WHEN 4 THEN 'Stopped' 
	WHEN 5 THEN 'Started'
	ELSE 'Log_Only' 
	END AS Mode,
	sba.StrategyAccountMode saMode
	FROM strategybrokeraccount as sba
	left join @CashDeltaLimitTable cdt on cdt.substrategyId = sba.subStrategyID
	left join @CashGammaLimitTable cgt on cgt.substrategyId = sba.subStrategyID
	left join @cashMandateTable cmt on sba.accountID = cmt.accountId and cmt.substrategyId = sba.subStrategyID
	left join @marginMandateTable mmt on sba.accountID = mmt.accountId and mmt.substrategyId = sba.subStrategyID
	left join @MTMPercentageTable mpt on sba.accountID = mpt.accountId and mpt.substrategyId = sba.subStrategyID
	INNER JOIN Strategy_New sn on sn.SubStrategy_Id = sba.subStrategyID
	INNER JOIN Account a on a.Account_ID = sba.accountID
	INNER JOIN @localExchangeCode l on l.Exchange_Code = A.Exchange_Code 
	INNER JOIN @activeStrategies s on s.subStrategyID = sba.subStrategyID
	LEFT JOIN DataInit d on d.substrategy_id = s.subStrategyID and d.Parameter = 'Mode'
	where a.Status = 'Active'
	order by sba.subStrategyID, sba.accountID      
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetStrategyToTraderMapping

```sql



CREATE procedure [dbo].[GetStrategyToTraderMapping]        

AS  

create table #TEMPMULTIEMS      

(      

SubStrategyID int,      

EMSApplicationID varchar(max)      

)      

      

DECLARE cur1 CURSOR for select substrategy_id, value from datainit where Parameter = 'MultiEMS' and value IS NOT NULL  

declare @sid int      

declare @listofems varchar(max)      

      

open cur1      

fetch next from cur1 INTO @sid, @listofems      

      

while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0      

begin      

      insert into #TEMPMULTIEMS (SubStrategyID,EMSApplicationID)      

      select @sid, * from dbo.Split(@listofems, ',')      -- get multi ems configuration  

      fetch next from cur1 INTO @sid, @listofems      

end      

deallocate cur1      

      

insert into #TEMPMULTIEMS (SubStrategyID,EMSApplicationID)      

select substrategy_id,ems_application_id from EsteeApplications where substrategy_id is not null  -- get default ems mapping for each strategy  

  

DECLARE cur2 CURSOR for select substrategy_id, value from datainit where Parameter = 'MultiExchange' and value IS NOT NULL  

declare @sid1 int  

declare @listofems1 varchar(max)  

  

open cur2  

fetch next from cur2 into @sid1, @listofems1  

  

while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0  

begin  

   insert into #TEMPMULTIEMS (SubStrategyID,EMSApplicationID)      

   select @sid1, * from dbo.Split(@listofems1, ',')      

   fetch next from cur2 INTO @sid1, @listofems1      

end      

deallocate cur2     

      

select distinct temp.SubStrategyID,tb.Trader as UserId,sn.Strategy_Status

from #TEMPMULTIEMS temp      

inner join exchangeadapterlogindetails tb on tb.EMSApplicationID = SUBSTRING(temp.EMSApplicationID, 0, 7)

inner join StrategyBrokerAccount sba on sba.subStrategyID = temp.subStrategyID        

inner join Account a on a.Account_ID = sba.accountID    

inner join Strategy_New sn on temp.substrategyid  = sn.SubStrategy_Id

where sn.Strategy_Status = 1

order by SubStrategyID      

      

drop table #TEMPMULTIEMS  




```

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[GetStrikePrice] (@esteeId varchar(50))
RETURNS decimal
AS
-- place the body of the function here
BEGIN
	declare @_strikePrice decimal

if(len(@esteeId)>=25)
    set @_strikePrice = cast(substring( @esteeId, 25, len(@esteeId) - 24) as decimal)
else 
	set @_strikePrice = 0
	return @_strikePrice
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetSubscribedSecurities

```sql
  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetSubscribedSecurities]   
 @locationCode varchar(3)  
AS  
BEGIN   
 SET NOCOUNT ON;  
   
 SELECT DISTINCT EsteeID FROM subscription_realtime SR  
 INNER JOIN esteemaster EM ON EM.Estee_ID = SR.EsteeID  
 INNER JOIN Strategy_New SN ON SN.SubStrategy_Name = SR.Strategy_Name  
 INNER JOIN EsteeApplications EA ON EA.SubStrategy_ID = SN.SubStrategy_Id  
 INNER JOIN EsteeServers ES ON ES.ID = EA.EsteeServer_ID  
 WHERE EA.SubStrategy_ID IS NOT NULL AND SN.Strategy_Status = 1 AND EA.isRunning = 1 AND ES.LocationCode = @locationCode 
 and SN.SubStrategy_Id <> 8269
    
END  

```

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[GetSubscriptionListByTradableExchange]  
(  
	@strategyName varchar(200),
	@exchangeCode varchar(2) = null
)   
AS 
	select EsteeID   
	from subscription_realtime sr,  
	ValidCombos vc,   
	esteemaster em  
	where sr.Strategy_Name = @strategyName  
	and sr.EsteeID = em.Estee_ID  
	and em.Exchange_Code = vc.ExchangeCode
	and em.Security_Type = vc.SecurityType
```

```sql
-- =============================================

CREATE PROCEDURE GetSubscriptions 
    -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here  
    @SubscriptionName varchar(255)
AS
BEGIN
    -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
    -- interfering with SELECT statements.
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
  
    select DISTINCT SR.EsteeID, SR.Field_Name, isnull(e.DataFeed_Ticker, isnull(EST.DataFeed_Ticker, '')) AS DataFeed_Ticker, SR.IsRolloverDisabled
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetTapEmsMap

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetTapEmsMap]

	AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	;WITH A AS 
	(
		SELECT AppID AS EMSAppID,EMSConfigID, NestServer AS ExchangeAccessServerIP FROM 
		vwEMSConfig WHERE NestServer IS NOT NULL
		UNION
		SELECT  AppID,EMSConfigID,c.Value  FROM vwemsconfig v 	
		INNER JOIN ExchangeAdapterConfig c ON c.ID = v.EMSConfigID	
		WHERE c.Parameter = 'HOST_LOOK_UP_IP'
	)
	SELECT distinct  a.*, T.OrdersPerSec,d.ExchangeSegment FROM a 
	INNER JOIN TapCapacity T ON T.IP = A.ExchangeAccessServerIP
	INNER JOIN ExchangeAdapter d ON d.exchangeAdapterConfigID = A.EMSConfigID


END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetTop10BuySellScrips

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetTop10BuySellScrips]
@fromDate datetime = null,      
@toDate datetime = null,    
@listAccountID varchar(100) = null,    
@listBrokerID varchar(100)  = null,    
@listSubStrategyID varchar(500)  = null,
@buySellList varchar(10)  = null,
@useExpiry bit  = 1,
@expiryMonth varchar(12)  = null

AS         
 BEGIN                 

	DECLARE @Account TABLE(accountID int)    
	if(@listAccountID is null OR @listAccountID = '')  
	begin  
	 INSERT into @Account Select account_ID from account  
	end  
	else  
	begin  
	 INSERT into @Account SELECT * from dbo.split(@listAccountID,',')  
	end  
	  
	DECLARE @Broker TABLE(brokerID int)    
	if(@listBrokerID is null OR @listBrokerID = '')  
	begin  
	 INSERT into @Broker Select broker_ID from broker  
	end  
	else  
	begin  
	 INSERT into @Broker SELECT * from dbo.split(@listBrokerID,',')  
	end  
	  
	DECLARE @SubStrategy TABLE(subStrategyID int)     
	if(@listSubStrategyID is null OR @listSubStrategyID = '')  
	begin  
	 INSERT into @SubStrategy Select distinct subStrategy_ID from strategy_New  
	end  
	else  
	begin  
	 INSERT into @SubStrategy SELECT * from dbo.split(@listSubStrategyID,',')  
	end 

	DECLARE @BuySellTable TABLE(BuyOrSell int)     
	if(@buySellList is null OR @buySellList = '')  
	begin  
	 INSERT into @BuySellTable SELECT 1
	 INSERT into @BuySellTable SELECT 2
	end  
	else  
	begin  
	 INSERT into @BuySellTable SELECT * from dbo.split(@buySellList,',')  
	end

	if(@useExpiry = 1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT SUM(A.BuySellValue) AS BuySellValue, MIN(A.buy_sell_indicator) AS buy_sell_indicator, A.underlying_ticker FROM
		(

		SELECT SUM(Z.BuySellValue) AS BuySellValue, MIN(Z.buy_sell_indicator) AS buy_sell_indicator, Z.underlying_ticker FROM
		(
		SELECT SUM(X.BuySellValue) AS BuySellValue, X.buy_sell_indicator, X.underlying_ticker FROM   
		 (  
		 SELECT 
		 Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price AS BuySellValue,  
		 buy_sell_indicator,  
		 underlying_ticker,  
		 estee_id,
		 Traded_Quantity,
		 Traded_Price,
		 OT.Status,
		 CONVERT(float, substring(estee_id, 25, len(estee_id))) AS StrikePrice,
		 CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), OT.Creation_Date, 103) AS Date,
		 Remarks    
		 FROM [Order] O WITH (NOLOCK) 
		 INNER JOIN OrderTrades OT WITH (NOLOCK) ON O.Order_ID = OT.Order_ID and O.Creation_Date = OT.Creation_Date   
		 INNER JOIN Trades T WITH (NOLOCK) ON OT.OrderTrade_ID = T.OrderTrade_ID and OT.Order_ID = T.Order_ID and OT.Creation_Date = T.Creation_Date   
		 WHERE ot.creation_Date >= @fromDate AND ot.creation_Date < @toDate  
		 AND account_ID IN (Select accountID FROM @Account)
		 AND O.Sub_Strategy_ID IN (Select subStrategyID FROM @SubStrategy)
		 AND Broker_ID IN (Select brokerID FROM @Broker)
		 AND substring(estee_id, 15, 2) IN (02, 03, 06, 07) 
		 AND substring(estee_id, 17, 6) = @expiryMonth  
		 AND status in ('Executed', 'Partially Filled')
		 AND ISNULL(Remarks, 'as1') NOT IN ('Exercised', 'Assigned', 'Expired')
	
		UNION ALL

		SELECT 
		CASE 
			 WHEN MAX(Y.BuySellValue) = MIN(Y.BuySellValue) THEN
				ABS(MIN(Y.BuySellValue))
			  ELSE
				ABS(MAX(Y.BuySellValue) + MIN(Y.BuySellValue))
			  END AS BuySellValue, 
		CASE 
			 WHEN MAX(Y.BuySellValue) > MIN(ABS(Y.BuySellValue)) THEN
				1
			 WHEN MAX(Y.BuySellValue) = MIN(Y.BuySellValue) THEN
				MIN(Y.buy_sell_indicator)
			ELSE
				2
			END AS buy_sell_indicator,
		 MIN(Y.underlying_ticker) AS underlying_ticker,  
		 MIN(Y.estee_id) AS estee_id,
		 MAX(Y.Traded_Quantity) - MIN(Y.Traded_Quantity) AS Traded_Quantity,
		 MIN(Y.Traded_Price) AS Traded_Price,
		 MIN(Y.Status) AS Status,
		 MIN(Y.StrikePrice) AS StrikePrice,
		 MIN(Y.Date) AS Date, 
		 MIN(Y.Remarks) AS Remarks
		 FROM ( 
		SELECT CASE (buy_sell_indicator)  
		 WHEN 1 THEN  
		   SUM(Traded_Quantity) * CONVERT(float, MIN(substring(estee_id, 25, len(estee_id)))) 
		 WHEN 2 THEN  
		   SUM(Traded_Quantity) * CONVERT(float, MIN(substring(estee_id, 25, len(estee_id)))) * -1
		 END AS BuySellValue,  
		 buy_sell_indicator,  
		 MIN(underlying_ticker) AS underlying_ticker,  
		 MIN(estee_id) AS estee_id,
		 SUM(Traded_Quantity) AS Traded_Quantity,
		 MIN(Traded_Price) AS Traded_Price,
		 MIN(OT.Status) AS Status,
		 CONVERT(float, MIN(substring(estee_id, 25, len(estee_id)))) AS StrikePrice,
		 CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), MIN(OT.Creation_Date), 103) AS Date, 
		 MIN(Remarks) AS Remarks
		 FROM [Order] O WITH (NOLOCK) 
		 INNER JOIN OrderTrades OT WITH (NOLOCK) ON O.Order_ID = OT.Order_ID and O.Creation_Date = OT.Creation_Date   
		 INNER JOIN Trades T WITH (NOLOCK) ON OT.OrderTrade_ID = T.OrderTrade_ID and OT.Order_ID = T.Order_ID and OT.Creation_Date = T.Creation_Date   
		 WHERE ot.creation_Date >= @fromDate AND ot.creation_Date < @toDate  
		 AND account_ID IN (Select accountID FROM @Account)
		 AND O.Sub_Strategy_ID IN (Select subStrategyID FROM @SubStrategy)
		 AND Broker_ID IN (Select brokerID FROM @Broker)
		 AND substring(estee_id, 15, 2) IN (02, 03, 06, 07)   
		 AND substring(estee_id, 17, 6) = @expiryMonth    
		 AND status in ('Executed', 'Partially Filled')
		 AND ISNULL(Remarks, 'as1') IN ('Exercised', 'Assigned')
		 GROUP BY buy_sell_indicator, estee_id  ) Y GROUP BY Y.estee_id
		 ) X  
		 GROUP BY X.underlying_ticker, X.buy_sell_indicator
		) Z 
		 WHERE Z. buy_sell_indicator IN (SELECT BuyOrSell FROM @BuySellTable)
		 GROUP BY Z.underlying_ticker, Z.buy_sell_indicator 
	
		UNION ALL

		SELECT SUM(Z.BuySellValue) AS BuySellValue, Z.buy_sell_indicator, Z.underlying_ticker FROM
		(
		SELECT SUM(X.BuySellValue) AS BuySellValue, X.buy_sell_indicator, X.underlying_ticker FROM   
		 (  
		 SELECT CASE (buy_sell_indicator)  
		 WHEN 1 THEN  
		  CASE(substring(estee_id, 15, 2))  
		  WHEN 05 THEN  
		   Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price  
		  WHEN 01 THEN  
		   Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price  
		  END   
		 WHEN 2 THEN

		SELECT

			  ELSE

		 INNER JOIN Trades T WITH (NOLOCK) ON OT.OrderTrade_ID = T.OrderTrade_ID and OT.Order_ID = T.Order_ID and OT.Creation_Date = T.Creation_Date

		) Z
```

```sql
@fromDate datetime = null,          
@toDate datetime = null,

@listBrokerID varchar(100)  = null,        
@listSubStrategyID varchar(500)  = null,  
@buySellList varchar(10)  = null,  
@useExpiry bit  = 0,  
@expiryMonth varchar(12)  = null  
  
AS             
 BEGIN                     
--    select @lastArchivalDate
 DECLARE @Account TABLE(accountID int)        
 if(@listAccountID is null OR @listAccountID = '')      
 begin      
  INSERT into @Account Select account_ID from account      
 end      
 else      
 begin      
  INSERT into @Account SELECT * from dbo.split(@listAccountID,',')      
 end      
       
 DECLARE @Broker TABLE(brokerID int)        
 if(@listBrokerID is null OR @listBrokerID = '')      
 begin      
  INSERT into @Broker Select broker_ID from broker      
 end      
 else      
 begin      
  INSERT into @Broker SELECT * from dbo.split(@listBrokerID,',')      
 end      
       
 DECLARE @SubStrategy TABLE(subStrategyID int)         
 if(@listSubStrategyID is null OR @listSubStrategyID = '')      
 begin      
  INSERT into @SubStrategy Select distinct subStrategy_ID from strategy_New      
 end      
 else      
 begin      
  INSERT into @SubStrategy SELECT * from dbo.split(@listSubStrategyID,',')      
 end   
  
 DECLARE @BuySellTable TABLE(BuyOrSell int)         
 if(@buySellList is null OR @buySellList = '')      
 begin      
  INSERT into @BuySellTable SELECT 1  
  INSERT into @BuySellTable SELECT 2

 else      
 begin      
  INSERT into @BuySellTable SELECT * from dbo.split(@buySellList,',')

 if(@useExpiry = 1)

   FROM (   
  SELECT CASE (buy_sell_indicator)      
   WHEN 1 THEN      
     SUM(Traded_Quantity) * CONVERT(float, MIN(substring(estee_id, 25, len(estee_id))))   
   WHEN 2 THEN      
     SUM(Traded_Quantity) * CONVERT(float, MIN(substring(estee_id, 25, len(estee_id)))) * -1  
   END AS BuySellValue,      
   buy_sell_indicator,      
   MIN(underlying_ticker) AS underlying_ticker,      
   MIN(estee_id) AS estee_id,  
   SUM(Traded_Quantity) AS Traded_Quantity,  
   MIN(Traded_Price) AS Traded_Price,  
   MIN(OT.Status) AS Status,  
   CONVERT(float, MIN(substring(estee_id, 25, len(estee_id)))) AS StrikePrice,  
   CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), MIN(OT.Creation_Time), 103) AS Date,   
   MIN(Remarks) AS Remarks  
   FROM tblOrders O WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tblOrderTrades OT WITH (NOLOCK) ON O.Order_ID = OT.Order_ID       
   INNER JOIN tblTrades T WITH (NOLOCK) ON OT.OrderTrade_ID = T.OrderTrade_ID       
   WHERE ot.creatiion_time > @lastArchivalDate AND ot.creatiion_time < @toDate      
   AND account_ID IN (Select accountID FROM @Account)  
   AND Sub_Strategy_ID IN (Select subStrategyID FROM @SubStrategy)  
   AND Broker_ID IN (Select brokerID FROM @Broker)  
   AND substring(estee_id, 15, 2) IN (02, 03, 06, 07)     
   AND status in ('Executed', 'Partially Filled')  
   AND ISNULL(Remarks, 'as1') IN ('Exercised', 'Assigned')  
   GROUP BY buy_sell_indicator, estee_id  ) Y GROUP BY Y.estee_id  
   ) X      
   GROUP BY X.underlying_ticker, X.buy_sell_indicator  
  ) Z   
   WHERE Z. buy_sell_indicator IN (SELECT BuyOrSell FROM @BuySellTable)  
   GROUP BY Z.underlying_ticker, Z.buy_sell_indicator   
    
  UNION ALL  
  
  SELECT SUM(Z.BuySellValue) AS BuySellValue, Z.buy_sell_indicator, Z.underlying_ticker FROM  
  (  
  SELECT SUM(X.BuySellValue) AS BuySellValue, X.buy_sell_indicator, X.underlying_ticker FROM       
   (      
   SELECT CASE (buy_sell_indicator)      
   WHEN 1 THEN      
    CASE(substring(estee_id, 15, 2))      
    WHEN 05 THEN      
     Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price      
    WHEN 01 THEN      
     Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price      
    END       
   WHEN 2 THEN      
    CASE(substring(estee_id, 15, 2))      
    WHEN 05 THEN      
     Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price --* -1      
    WHEN 01 THEN      
     Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price --* -1      
    END       
   END AS BuySellValue,      
   buy_sell_indicator,      
   underlying_ticker,      
   estee_id,  
   Traded_Quantity,  
   Traded_Price,  
   OT.Status,  
   CONVERT(float, substring(estee_id, 25, len(estee_id))) AS StrikePrice,  
   CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), OT.Creation_Time, 103) AS Date        
   FROM tblOrders O WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tblOrderTrades OT WITH (NOLOCK) ON O.Order_ID = OT.Order_ID       
   INNER JOIN tblTrades T WITH (NOLOCK) ON OT.OrderTrade_ID = T.OrderTrade_ID       
   WHERE ot.creatiion_time > @lastArchivalDate AND ot.creatiion_time < @toDate      
   AND account_ID IN (Select accountID FROM @Account)  
   AND Sub_Strategy_ID IN (Select subStrategyID FROM @SubStrategy)  
   AND Broker_ID IN (Select brokerID FROM @Broker)  
   AND substring(estee_id, 15, 2) IN (01, 05)  
   AND status in ('Executed', 'Partially Filled')  
   AND ISNULL(Remarks, 'as1') NOT IN ('Expired')  
  
   UNION ALL  
  
  SELECT   
  CASE   
    WHEN MAX(Y.BuySellValue) = MIN(Y.BuySellValue) THEN  
    ABS(MIN(Y.BuySellValue))  
     ELSE  
    ABS(MAX(Y.BuySellValue) + MIN(Y.BuySellValue))  
     END AS BuySellValue,   
  CASE   
    WHEN MAX(Y.BuySellValue) > MIN(ABS(Y.BuySellValue)) THEN  
    1  
    WHEN MAX(Y.BuySellValue) = MIN(Y.BuySellValue) THEN  
    MIN(Y.buy_sell_indicator)  
   ELSE  
    2  
   END AS buy_sell_indicator,  
   MIN(Y.underlying_ticker) AS underlying_ticker,      
   MIN(Y.estee_id) AS estee_id,  
   MAX(Y.Traded_Quantity) - MIN(Y.Traded_Quantity) AS Traded_Quantity,  
   MIN(Y.Traded_Price) AS Traded_Price,  
   MIN(Y.Status) AS Status,  
   MIN(Y.StrikePrice) AS StrikePrice,  
   MIN(Y.Date) AS Date  
   FROM (   
  SELECT CASE (buy_sell_indicator)      
   WHEN 1 THEN      
    CASE MIN((substring(estee_id, 15, 2)))  
    WHEN 05 THEN      
     SUM(Traded_Quantity) * MIN(Traded_Price)  
    WHEN 01 THEN      
     SUM(Traded_Quantity) * MIN(Traded_Price)  
    END       
   WHEN 2 THEN      
    CASE MIN((substring(estee_id, 15, 2)))      
    WHEN 05 THEN      
     SUM(Traded_Quantity) * MIN(Traded_Price) * -1      
    WHEN 01 THEN      
     SUM(Traded_Quantity) * MIN(Traded_Price) * -1      
    END       
   END AS BuySellValue,      
   buy_sell_indicator,      
   MIN(underlying_ticker) AS underlying_ticker,      
   MIN(estee_id) AS estee_id,  
   SUM(Traded_Quantity) AS Traded_Quantity,  
   MIN(Traded_Price) AS Traded_Price,  
   MIN(OT.Status) AS Status,  
   CONVERT(float, MIN(substring(estee_id, 25, len(estee_id)))) AS StrikePrice,  
   CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), MIN(OT.Creation_Time), 103) AS Date        
   FROM tblOrders O WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tblOrderTrades OT WITH (NOLOCK) ON O.Order_ID = OT.Order_ID       
   INNER JOIN tblTrades T WITH (NOLOCK) ON OT.OrderTrade_ID = T.OrderTrade_ID       
   WHERE ot.creatiion_time > @lastArchivalDate AND ot.creatiion_time < @toDate      
   AND account_ID IN (Select accountID FROM @Account)  
   AND Sub_Strategy_ID IN (Select subStrategyID FROM @SubStrategy)  
   AND Broker_ID IN (Select brokerID FROM @Broker)  
   AND substring(estee_id, 15, 2) IN (01, 05)      
   AND status in ('Executed', 'Partially Filled')  
   AND ISNULL(Remarks, 'as1') IN ('Expired')  
   GROUP BY buy_sell_indicator, underlying_ticker  ) Y GROUP BY Y.underlying_ticker  
  
   ) X      
   GROUP BY X.underlying_ticker, X.buy_sell_indicator  
  ) Z   
   WHERE Z. buy_sell_indicator IN (SELECT BuyOrSell FROM @BuySellTable)  
   GROUP BY Z.underlying_ticker, Z.buy_sell_indicator  
    
  ) A  
  WHERE A. buy_sell_indicator IN (SELECT BuyOrSell FROM @BuySellTable)  
   GROUP BY A.underlying_ticker, A.buy_sell_indicator  
--   ORDER BY A.buy_sell_indicator, MAX(A.BuySellValue) desc


 END  
  
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetTotalTradedLots

```sql
create PROCEDURE GetTotalTradedLots
@estee_Id varchar(200),
@from_Creation_Date DATE,
@to_Creation_Date DATE,
@account_Ids varchar(500)

as
begin
if (LTRIM(RTRIM(@estee_Id)) ! ='')
	begin
		select account_id, substring(Estee_Id, 1, 16) Estee_Id, SUM(Traded_Quantity) TotalTradedLots into #temp from vwAllTrades
		where Creation_date between @from_Creation_Date and @to_Creation_Date
		and Status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and order_source_id not in ('ecm','odin')
		and account_id in (select CAST(items AS INTEGER) FROM Split (@account_Ids, ',')) and Price_Diff <> 0
		and Estee_ID like (@estee_Id+'%')
		group by  account_id, substring(Estee_Id, 1,  16)
		select distinct t.Estee_Id, e.Underlying_Ticker, t.Account_id, t.TotalTradedLots/e.Lot_Size as TotalTradedLots from #temp t inner join esteemaster e on t.Estee_Id = substring(e.Estee_Id, 1 ,16)
		drop table #temp
	end
else
	begin
		select account_id, substring(Estee_Id, 1, 16) Estee_Id, SUM(Traded_Quantity) TotalTradedLots into #temp1 from vwAllTrades
		where Creation_date between @from_Creation_Date and @to_Creation_Date
		and Status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and order_source_id not in ('ecm','odin')
		and account_id in (select CAST(items AS INTEGER) FROM Split (@account_Ids, ',')) and Price_Diff <> 0	
		group by  account_id, substring(Estee_Id, 1,  16)
		select distinct t.Estee_Id, e.Underlying_Ticker, t.Account_id, t.TotalTradedLots/e.Lot_Size as TotalTradedLots from #temp1 t inner join esteemaster e on t.Estee_Id = substring(e.Estee_Id, 1 ,16)
		drop table #temp1
	end
end


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetTPlusXWorkingDate

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE GetTPlusXWorkingDate @runDate VARCHAR(8),@ExchangeSegment Varchar(2),@workingDaysToAdd int,  
    @tPlusXDate DATE OUTPUT  
AS  
BEGIN  
    DECLARE @currentDate DATE = @runDate; -- Start with the current date  
    DECLARE @isHoliday BIT = 0;  
    WHILE @workingDaysToAdd > 0  
    BEGIN  
        SET @currentDate = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @currentDate);; -- Add one day to the current date  
  CREATE TABLE #temp_holiday_table (  
   ExchangeCode VARCHAR(50),  
   Segment VARCHAR(50),  
   OverrideId VARCHAR(50),  
   SubSession bit,  
   Remarks VARCHAR(50),  
   IsWorking bit,  
   IsNormalSession bit,  
  );  
  
  insert into #temp_holiday_table(ExchangeCode,Segment,OverrideId,SubSession,Remarks,IsWorking,IsNormalSession)  
  exec GetHolidayList @currentDate, 'T','BR';  
  select @isHoliday = IsWorking from #temp_holiday_table where Segment = @ExchangeSegment  
  
        -- If the date is not a holiday, decrement the working days to add  
        If @isHoliday = 1  
            SET @workingDaysToAdd = @workingDaysToAdd - 1;  
  drop table #temp_holiday_table  
    END;  
  
    SET @tPlusXDate = @currentDate;  
   
END;  
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetTradesByExchange

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetTradesByExchange]          
@tradeDate date,    
@exchangeCode varchar(2),
@strategyIds varchar(500),
@accIds varchar(500)
AS          
         
BEGIN    

 DECLARE @ssids TABLE(ssid int)
 DECLARE @accountIds TABLE(accId int)

 INSERT into @ssids SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) from dbo.split(@strategyIds,',')
 INSERT into @accountIds SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) from dbo.split(@accIds,',')
    
 SELECT t.estee_id, t.traded_price, t.traded_quantity ,t.transaction_cost, t.buy_sell_indicator, t.brokerage,          
 o.broker_id, o.account_id, o.sub_strategy_id, ot.ClientOrderTrade_ID, ot.OrderTrade_ID
 from [Order] o    
 inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID    
 inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID
 inner join @ssids s on s.ssid = ot.Sub_Strategy_ID
 inner join @accountIds ac on  ac.accId = o.Account_ID
 where o.Creation_Date = @tradeDate     
 AND ot.status IN ('Executed','Partially Filled')     
    
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetTradesForTransactionCost

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetTradesForTransactionCost]            
@tradeDate date,      
@exchangeCode varchar(2) = null      
AS            
       
      
IF @exchangeCode IS NOT NULL      
BEGIN      
            
 SELECT t.trade_id,t.estee_id,isnull(t.traded_price, et.traded_price)as traded_price ,          
 isnull(t.traded_quantity, et.traded_quantity)as traded_quantity,t.transaction_cost,t.buy_sell_indicator,t.brokerage,            
 o.broker_id,o.account_id,o.sub_strategy_id,ot.remarks,o.order_source_id, o.Link_ID,t.ApplyTC, isnull(et.ActiveORpassive,0) as ActiveOrPassive,  
 ot.Order_ID,ot.OrderTrade_ID, t.ExecID as ExecID  
 from [Order] o      
 inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID      
 inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID      
 left join ExchangeTrades et on (et.Exchange_Order_ID = o.Exchange_Order_ID and et.AsofDate = @tradedate and et.execid = t.ExecID)            
 inner join Account A on A.Account_ID = o.Account_ID      
 where o.Creation_Date = @tradeDate       
 AND ot.status IN ('Executed','Partially Filled')       
 AND A.exchange_Code = @exchangeCode AND t.ApplyTC = 1
      
END      
ELSE      
BEGIN      
      
 SELECT t.trade_id,t.estee_id,isnull(et.traded_price,t.traded_price)as traded_price ,          
 isnull(et.traded_quantity,t.traded_quantity)as traded_quantity,t.transaction_cost,t.buy_sell_indicator,t.brokerage,            
 o.broker_id,o.account_id,o.sub_strategy_id,ot.remarks,o.order_source_id, o.Link_ID,t.ApplyTC, isnull(et.ActiveORpassive,0) as ActiveOrPassive,  
 ot.Order_ID,ot.OrderTrade_ID, t.ExecID as ExecID  
 from [Order] o      
 inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID      
 inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID      
 left join ExchangeTrades et on (et.Exchange_Order_ID = o.Exchange_Order_ID and et.AsofDate = @tradedate and et.execid = t.ExecID)            
 where o.Creation_Date = @tradeDate AND t.ApplyTC = 1   
 AND ot.status IN ('Executed','Partially Filled')       
      
END
```

```sql
Create Proc [dbo].[GetTradesonEachUser]  
@ExCode  nvarchar(3),
@StartDate date,
@TodayDate date  

AS

END
```
