## Stored procedure: dbo.GetTradeTableRowCountForArchiveDate

```sql
-- =============================================

-- Author:		Megha Goel

-- Create date: 24 June 2014

-- Description:	Get Archive Table row count

-- =============================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetTradeTableRowCountForArchiveDate]

	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here

	@archiveDate date

AS

BEGIN

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from

	-- interfering with SELECT statements.

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here

	declare @archiveDatePlusOne date

	declare @dbName varchar(255), @serverIP as varchar(255)

	declare @rowCountDataTable Table(ArchiveDate date, Server varchar(255),DatabaseName varchar(255), TableName varchar(255), TableRowCount int)

 

	set @archiveDatePlusOne = DATEADD(dd,1, @archiveDatePlusOne)

	SELECT @dbName = DB_NAME()

	SET @serverIP = Cast(CONNECTIONPROPERTY('local_net_address') as varchar(255))

	Insert into @rowCountDataTable

	select @archiveDate, @serverIP , @dbName , 'Order' , count(*) from [Order] with (nolock) where Creation_Date=@archiveDate

	Insert into @rowCountDataTable

	select @archiveDate,@serverIP  ,@dbName  , 'OrderTrades' , count(*) from [OrderTrades] with (nolock) where Creation_Date=@archiveDate

	Insert into @rowCountDataTable

	select @archiveDate,@serverIP  ,@dbName  , 'Trades' , count(*) from [Trades] with (nolock) where Creation_Date=@archiveDate

	IF Exists(Select 1 FROM SourceDestinationDBMapForArchival WHERE SourceServer=@serverIP and SourceDatabase=@dbname and SourceTable='AllocatedIDs')

	OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SourceDestinationDBMapForArchival WHERE DestinationServer=@serverIP and DestinationDatabase=@dbname and DestinationTable='AllocatedIDs')

	Begin

		Insert into @rowCountDataTable

		select @archiveDate,@serverIP, @dbName, 'AllocatedIDs', count(*) from [AllocatedIDs] with (nolock) where Creation_Date=@archiveDate

	End



	IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME='tblOrderTrail') and 

	(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SourceDestinationDBMapForArchival WHERE SourceServer=@serverIP and SourceDatabase=@dbname and SourceTable='tblOrderTrail')

	OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SourceDestinationDBMapForArchival WHERE DestinationServer=@serverIP and DestinationDatabase=@dbname and DestinationTable='tblOrderTrail'))

	BEGIN

		Insert into @rowCountDataTable

		select @archiveDate,@serverIP as ArchiveServer,@dbName as ArchiveDatabase, 'tblOrderTrail' as ArchiveTableName, count(*) as ArchivedRowCount from [tblOrderTrail] with (nolock) where Exec_Time>=@archiveDate and Exec_Time < @archiveDatePlusOne

	END

	Select * from @rowCountDataTable

END
```

```sql
Create PROCEDURE GetTradingAndSettlementCurrency  
@exchangeCode varchar (2)  
AS  
BEGIN  

 SELECT Estee_ID, TradingCurrency, SettlementCurrency into #temp FROM esteemaster   
 WHERE Exchange_Code = @exchangeCode  

 Insert into #temp
 SELECT ea.Estee_ID, ea.TradingCurrency, ea.SettlementCurrency
```

## Function: dbo.GetTradingHolidaysUsingBankingTable

```sql


Create FUNCTION GetTradingHolidaysUsingBankingTable(@startdate Date, @enddate Date,@exCode char(2), @segment varchar(32), @Trading varchar(32)) RETURNS INTEGER  
AS  
BEGIN 
 Declare @count integer
 Declare @eomDate Date
 set @eomDate=DATEADD(d, -1, DATEADD(m, DATEDIFF(m, 0, @enddate) + 1, 0))

	if @eomDate>=@startdate
	Begin
  set @count = (select (DATEDIFF(dd, @startdate, @eomDate) + 1)  
  -(DATEDIFF(wk, @startdate, @eomDate) * 2)  
  -(CASE WHEN DATENAME(dw, @startDate) = 'Sunday' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  
  -(CASE WHEN DATENAME(dw, @eomDate) = 'Saturday' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  
  -count(DATENAME(dw, date)) from BankingHolidays where segment = @segment  and exchange = @exCode and HolidayType = @Trading  
 and date >= @startdate and date <= @eomDate  
 and DATENAME(dw, date) not in ('Saturday','Sunday'))  
 END
 else
 set @count = 0
 return @count
END


```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[getTurnoverByDate]          
@startDate datetime,  
@endDate datetime,  
@exchange varchar(10)  
           
AS          
BEGIN    
   
 SELECT case   
    when ip in ('172.25.40.2', '172.25.40.3') then '24351(FO), 32783(CM)/BKC (trader 02/10)'      
    when ip in ('172.25.40.6', '172.25.40.5') then '29261(FO), 38637(CM)/BKC (trader 08/12)'     
    when ip in ('172.25.40.7', '172.25.40.8') then '29609(FO), 38621(CM)/BKC (trader 14/16)'      
    else ' '   
   end as 'trader',   
   e.security_type,  
   t.buy_sell_indicator,      
   sum(   
     (case t.traded_quantity when 0 then t.Order_Quantity else t.Traded_Quantity end) *   
     (case   
      when e.security_type in (2, 3, 6, 7, 12, 13) then   
        case t.buy_sell_indicator   
         when 1 then   
          case t.traded_price when 0 then t.Order_Price else t.Traded_Price end  
         else   
          e.strike_price  
        end  
      else   
       case t.traded_price when 0 then t.Order_Price else t.Traded_Price end  
      end  
     )     
    )/100000 As TurnOver  
 from esteeapplications a with (nolock)  
 inner join ordertrades ot with (nolock) on ot.sub_strategy_id = a.substrategy_id   
 inner join trades t with (nolock)  on t.ordertrade_id = ot.ordertrade_id and t.order_id = ot.order_id and t.creation_date = ot.creation_date  
 inner join esteemaster e with (nolock) on e.estee_id = t.estee_id   
 inner join esteeapplications ems with (nolock) on ems.applicationid = a.ems_application_id  
 inner join esteeservers s with (nolock) on s.id = ems.esteeserver_id   
 where e.exchange_code=@exchange and ot.creation_date >= @startDate and ot.creation_date < @endDate  
 and ot.status  in ('Executed', 'Partially Filled', 'Accepted')   
 group by case  
    when ip in ('172.25.40.2', '172.25.40.3') then '24351(FO), 32783(CM)/BKC (trader 02/10)'       
    when ip in ('172.25.40.6', '172.25.40.5') then '29261(FO), 38637(CM)/BKC (trader 08/12)'   
    when ip in ('172.25.40.7', '172.25.40.8') then '29609(FO), 38621(CM)/BKC (trader 14/16)'      
    else ' '             
   end,  
   e.security_type,  
   t.buy_sell_indicator  
 order by trader  
  
 EXEC GetNeatLimit  
      
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetTurnoverForADay

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetTurnoverForADay]              
              
@startDate date,              
@exchange varchar(10)              
              
AS              
BEGIN              
 Declare @endDate date          
 Set @endDate = DATEADD(DD,1,@startDate)          
           
          
 --SELECT SUM(TurnOver) from     
 --(     
     SELECT SUM(t.Traded_Quantity *                
   (case                
    when isnull(e.security_type, ea.Security_Type) in (2, 3, 6, 7, 12, 13) then                              
     (isnull(e.strike_price, ea.Strike_Price) + t.Traded_Price)      
    when isnull(e.security_type, ea.Security_Type) in (1,5,11,20) then                 
     t.Traded_Price                
    end                
   )                
  ) As TurnOver,  
  isnull(e.security_type, ea.Security_Type) As SecurityType               
  from [Order] o    
inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID    
inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID    
left join esteemaster e with (nolock) on e.estee_id = t.estee_id and e.Status = 1          
  left join EsteeMaster_archive ea with (nolock) on t.estee_id = ea.estee_id and ea.Status = 1    
  where ot.Status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and o.Creation_Date >= @startDate and o.Creation_Date < @endDate     
            and ISNULL(e.exchange_code, ea.exchange_code) = @exchange        
            and o.Order_Source_ID <> 'ECM'  
            group by isnull(e.security_type, ea.Security_Type)  
              
            UNION    
    
   SELECT     
      Abs(sum(t.Traded_Quantity * (2*t.Buy_Sell_Indicator-3) *     
      (case                
   when isnull(e.security_type, ea.Security_Type) in (2, 3, 6, 7, 12, 13) then (isnull(e.strike_price, ea.Strike_Price) + t.Traded_Price)      
   when isnull(e.security_type, ea.Security_Type) in (1,5,11,20) then t.Traded_Price                
    end ))) As TurnOver,  
  isnull(e.security_type, ea.Security_Type) As SecurityType    
  from [Order] o    
inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID    
inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID    
  left join esteemaster e with (nolock) on e.estee_id = t.estee_id and ISNULL(e.Status, 1) = 1          
  left join EsteeMaster_archive ea with (nolock) on t.estee_id = ea.estee_id and ISNULL(ea.Status,1) = 1        
  where ot.Status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and o.Creation_Date >= @startDate and o.Creation_Date < @endDate    
            and ISNULL(e.exchange_code, ea.exchange_code) = @exchange    
            and o.Order_Source_ID = 'ECM'     
            and Remarks not like 'Trade Move%'    
            group by ISNULL(e.Estee_ID, ea.Estee_ID),o.Account_ID,isnull(e.security_type, ea.Security_Type)  
  --)as turnover    
 END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetTurnOverFromQuery

```sql
create procedure GetTurnOverFromQuery
@estee_Id varchar(200),
@from_Creation_Date DATE,
@to_Creation_Date DATE,
@account_Ids varchar(500)
as
begin

if(LTRIM(RTRIM(@estee_Id)) != '')
Begin
	select substring(Estee_Id, 1, 16) Estee_Id,Underlying_Ticker AS Contract, ACCOUNT_ID, sum(traded_price*traded_quantity ) as Turnover  into #temp from vwAllTrades   
	where account_id in((SELECT CAST(items AS INTEGER) FROM Split (@account_Ids, ',')))
	and creation_date between @from_Creation_Date and @to_Creation_Date
	and status in ('executed','partially filled')
	and order_source_id not in ('odin', 'ecm') and SUBSTRING(estee_id, 1, 20) = @estee_Id
	group by SUBSTRING(estee_id, 1, 16), ACCOUNT_ID,Underlying_Ticker
	select distinct t.Estee_Id, e.Underlying_Ticker as Contract, t.Account_id, t.Turnover as Turnover from #temp t inner join esteemaster e on t.Estee_Id= substring(e.Estee_Id, 1 ,16)
	drop table #temp
end
else 
begin
	select substring(Estee_Id, 1, 16) Estee_Id,Underlying_Ticker AS Contract, ACCOUNT_ID, sum(traded_price*traded_quantity ) as Turnover  into #temp1 from vwAllTrades   
	where account_id in((SELECT CAST(items AS INTEGER) FROM Split (@account_Ids, ',')))
	and creation_date between @from_Creation_Date and @to_Creation_Date
	and status in ('executed','partially filled')
	and order_source_id not in ('odin', 'ecm')
	group by SUBSTRING(estee_id, 1, 16), ACCOUNT_ID,Underlying_Ticker
	select distinct t.Estee_Id, e.Underlying_Ticker as Contract, t.Account_id, t.Turnover as Turnover from #temp1 t inner join esteemaster e on t.Estee_Id = substring(e.Estee_Id, 1 ,16)
	drop table #temp1
	end
end


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetUndeliveredMTM

```sql


CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetUndeliveredMTM]                               
 @firstDayOfMonth datetime = null,   
 @currentDate datetime,   
 @listSubStrategyID varchar(max)  = null,  
 @accountID int  
   
AS                              
    
BEGIN  
 DECLARE @SubStrategy TABLE(subStrategyID int)  
 IF (@listSubStrategyID is null OR @listSubStrategyID = '')   
  BEGIN  
   INSERT INTO @SubStrategy SELECT DISTINCT SubStrategy_Id FROM Strategy_New WHERE Strategy_Status = 1  
  END   
 ELSE   
  BEGIN  
   INSERT into @SubStrategy SELECT * from dbo.split(@listSubStrategyID,',')                      
  END   
  
 SELECT Sub_Strategy_ID, Estee_ID, (3-2*Buy_Sell_Indicator) * Traded_Quantity, Traded_Price, Account_ID   
 FROM vwAllTrades   
 WHERE Creation_Date = @currentDate
 AND Sub_Strategy_ID IN( @listSubStrategyID) AND Account_ID = @accountID  
 ORDER BY Estee_ID,Update_Time  
END  


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.getUnderlyingByExchange

```sql
CREATE proc getUnderlyingByExchange(@exchanges varchar(100),@securityType varchar(200))            
AS            
BEGIN            
  DECLARE @localExchangeCode TABLE(Exchange_Code char(2))              
     INSERT into @localExchangeCode SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) from dbo.split(@exchanges,',')                                    
        
  DECLARE @security_Type TABLE(SecurityType char(2))                  
     INSERT into @security_Type SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) from dbo.split(@securityType,',')                                    
                 
select Distinct SUBSTRING(Estee_ID,1,12) as ISIN ,ISNULL(ExchangeTicker,Underlying_Ticker)as Underlying_Ticker,Security_Type from esteemaster e left join    
(select distinct ISIN,ExchangeTicker from ISINMaster  where DataSource='Exchange' and ExchangeCode in(select Exchange_Code from @localExchangeCode))as ExSymbols on e.ISIN=ExSymbols.ISIN    
 where   Exchange_Code in(select Exchange_Code from @localExchangeCode) and Security_Type in(select SecurityType from @security_Type) order by ISIN              
             
END 
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetUserStrategy

```sql
Create Proc GetUserStrategy        
@userID int = null          
AS                        
BEGIN          
select ss.ssid,ss.UserID  , ss.Account_ID  
into #tempUserStrategies    
FROM    
(    
select distinct sn.SubStrategy_Id ssid,us.UserID, sba.accountID as Account_ID from UserStrategies us   
inner join Strategy_New sn on sn.Strategy_Id = us.Strategy_ID   
inner join StrategyBrokerAccount sba on sba.subStrategyID = sn.SubStrategy_Id  
where us.dimension_id = 6 and us.UserID = @userID    
UNION    
select distinct sba.subStrategyID ssid,us.UserID, a.Account_ID as Account_ID from UserStrategies  us   
inner join account a on a.ClearingAccountID = us.Strategy_ID  
inner join StrategyBrokerAccount sba on sba.accountID = a.Account_ID where us.dimension_id = 14 and us.UserID = @userID  and a.Status='Active'  
  
) ss     
    
SELECT DISTINCT sn.Strategy_ID, SG.StrategyName as Strategy_Name,SG.Owner as Group_Owner,sn.SubStrategy_Id, sn.SubStrategy_Name, sn.Strategy_Status, sn.ownerUserID, l.FirstName + ' ' +l.LastName as StrategyOwner,                          
  sn.BaseCurrencyID, a.FundID as InvestmentFundID,f.name as FundName,f.OwnerID as FundOwner, sba.AccountID,A.Account_Type,A.Account_Name, a.exchange_Code,A.participant_id,B.Broker_ID,B.Broker_Name,                          
 d.Value as EMS_QUEUE, s.IP as IP, d1.Value as EMBServerType,BA.is_cpcodeenabled,s.LocationCode,sn.ISPresenceStrategy,d2.Value as FormID, ap.StartTime,ap.stoptime,sc.ID as StrategyCategoryID,         
 sc.Owner as StrategyCategoryOwnerID, sc.Name as StrategyCategoryName,a.ClearingAccountID          
 ,li.FirstName + ' ' + li.LastName  as GrpOwner  , BEPnlType, A.CurrencyId AccountCurrency , CA.LegalEntityId, D3.Value AS LinuxInterfaceIP       
 FROM  Strategy_New sn                                           
 LEFT JOIN LoginDetails l on l.UserID = sn.ownerUserID                          
 INNER JOIN StrategyGroup SG with(nolock) on sn.Strategy_Id = SG.StrategyID                          
 LEFT JOIN LoginDetails li with(nolock) on li.UserID = SG.Owner                          
 INNER JOIN StrategyBrokerAccount sba with(nolock) on sba.subStrategyID = sn.SubStrategy_Id      
  LEFT JOIN #tempUserStrategies tmpUS (nolock) On tmpUS.ssid = sn.SubStrategy_Id  and tmpUS.Account_ID = sba.accountID                        
 INNER JOIN Account a with(nolock) on sba.accountID = a.Account_ID        
 INNER JOIN ClearingAccount CA (nolock) on A.ClearingAccountID = CA.ClearingAccountID                      
 LEFT JOIN tblBrokerAccount BA with(nolock) on a.Account_ID = BA.account_id                          
 LEFT JOIN Broker B with(nolock) on BA.broker_id = B.Broker_ID                           
 LEFT JOIN EsteeApplications e  with(nolock) on e.SubStrategy_ID = sn.SubStrategy_Id    
 LEFT JOIN Datainit d with(nolock) on d.ApplicationID = e.ApplicationID                                            
 LEFT JOIN EsteeServers s with(nolock) on s.ID = e.EsteeServer_ID                
 INNER JOIN StrategyCategory sc with(nolock) on sc.ID = SG.CategoryID    
 INNER JOIN InvestmentFund f with(nolock) on f.id = a.FundID                
 LEFT JOIN DataInit d1 with(nolock) on d.ApplicationID = d1.ApplicationID and d1.Parameter = 'EMBServerType'                
 LEFT JOIN DataInit d2 with(nolock) on d.ApplicationID = d2.ApplicationID and d2.Parameter = 'FormID'    
 LEFT JOIN DataInit d3 with(nolock) on d.ApplicationID = d3.ApplicationID and d3.Parameter = 'Platform_Linux_InterfaceIP'                
 LEFT JOIN ApplicationSchedule ap with(nolock) on ap.ApplicationId = e.ApplicationID                
     
 WHERE   
  ISNULL(tmpUS.UserID,-1) = ISNULL(  
    @UserID,   
    Isnull(tmpUS.UserID,-1)  
  )   
  AND (  
    d.Parameter = 'EMSQueueName'   
    OR d.Parameter IS NULL  
  )   
  AND e.SubStrategy_ID IS NOT NULL   
  AND sn.Strategy_Status = 1   
  AND a.Status = 'Active'   
  AND b.Status = 'Active'   
order by   
  sn.Strategy_Id,   
  sn.SubStrategy_Id,   
  sn.SubStrategy_Name   
  
drop   
  table #tempUserStrategies                               
  END  

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetWorkingContractSet

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetWorkingContractSet]
 @exchangeCode varchar(2), @securityTypes varchar(32), @querySubscriptionRealtime varchar(8), @subscriptionName varchar(2000)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	IF @querySubscriptionRealtime = 'false'  -- get esteemaster
		IF @securityTypes = '' -- complete esteemaster
		begin
			select estee_id from esteemaster where exchange_code = @exchangeCode
		end
		ELSE --filtered esteemaster
		begin
			select estee_id from esteemaster where exchange_code = @exchangeCode 
			and security_type in ( SELECT * FROM dbo.split(@securityTypes, ',') )
		end
	ELSE
		IF @subscriptionName <> '' --get subscription realtime
			IF @securityTypes <> '' -- complete subscription realtime
			begin
				SELECT DISTINCT ESTEE_ID FROM SUBSCRIPTION_REALTIME sr INNER JOIN ESTEEMASTER e 
				ON e.ESTEE_ID = sr.ESTEEID AND e.EXCHANGE_CODE = @exchangeCode			
				AND sr.STRATEGY_NAME in ( SELECT * FROM dbo.split(@subscriptionName, ',') )
				AND e.SECURITY_TYPE in ( SELECT * FROM dbo.split(@securityTypes, ',') )
			end
			ELSE
			begin
				SELECT DISTINCT ESTEE_ID FROM SUBSCRIPTION_REALTIME sr INNER JOIN ESTEEMASTER e 
				ON e.ESTEE_ID = sr.ESTEEID AND e.EXCHANGE_CODE = @exchangeCode			
				AND sr.STRATEGY_NAME in ( SELECT * FROM dbo.split(@subscriptionName, ',') )
			end
		ELSE
			IF @securityTypes <> '' 
			begin
				SELECT DISTINCT ESTEE_ID FROM SUBSCRIPTION_REALTIME sr INNER JOIN ESTEEMASTER e 
				ON e.ESTEE_ID = sr.ESTEEID AND e.EXCHANGE_CODE = @exchangeCode
				AND e.SECURITY_TYPE in ( SELECT * FROM dbo.split(@securityTypes, ',') )
			end
			ELSE
			begin
				SELECT DISTINCT ESTEE_ID FROM SUBSCRIPTION_REALTIME sr INNER JOIN ESTEEMASTER e 
				ON e.ESTEE_ID = sr.ESTEEID AND e.EXCHANGE_CODE = @exchangeCode
			end
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetXNextExpiryFromEsteeIDAndRunDate

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetXNextExpiryFromEsteeIDAndRunDate]        
@esteeID varchar(50),
@runDate Date,  
@ExchangeCode char(2),  
@listSecType LISTSTRING READONLY,  
@count int  
         
AS        
BEGIN  
 
select top (@count) x.date as expiry_date from 
(select e1.Expiry_Date as date from esteemaster e 
inner join esteemaster e1 on SUBSTRING(e1.Estee_ID,0,13) = SUBSTRING(e.Estee_ID,0,13) 
and e.Exchange_Code = e1.Exchange_Code and e1.Expiry_Date >= @runDate and e1.status=1
INNER JOIN @listSecType LS on e1.Security_Type = LS.ListItem  
where e.Estee_ID = @esteeID and e.Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode
UNION
select ea.Expiry_Date as date from esteemaster e 
inner join esteemaster_archive ea on SUBSTRING(ea.Estee_ID,0,13) = SUBSTRING(e.Estee_ID,0,13) 
and e.Exchange_Code = ea.Exchange_Code and ea.Expiry_Date >= @runDate
INNER JOIN @listSecType LS on ea.Security_Type = LS.ListItem 
where e.Estee_ID = @esteeID and e.Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode and ea.status=1
) x order by x.date  
    
END 

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetXPrevExpiryFromEsteeIDAndRunDate

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetXPrevExpiryFromEsteeIDAndRunDate]        
@esteeID varchar(50),
@runDate Date,  
@ExchangeCode char(2),  
@listSecType LISTSTRING READONLY,  
@count int  
         
AS        
BEGIN  
 
select top (@count) x.date as expiry_date from 
(select e1.Expiry_Date as date from esteemaster e 
inner join esteemaster e1 on SUBSTRING(e1.Estee_ID,0,13) = SUBSTRING(e.Estee_ID,0,13) 
and e.Exchange_Code = e1.Exchange_Code and e1.Expiry_Date <= @runDate and e1.status=1
INNER JOIN @listSecType LS on e1.Security_Type = LS.ListItem  
where e.Estee_ID = @esteeID and e.Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode
UNION
select ea.Expiry_Date as date from esteemaster e 
inner join esteemaster_archive ea on SUBSTRING(ea.Estee_ID,0,13) = SUBSTRING(e.Estee_ID,0,13) 
and e.Exchange_Code = ea.Exchange_Code and ea.Expiry_Date <= @runDate
INNER JOIN @listSecType LS on ea.Security_Type = LS.ListItem 
where e.Estee_ID = @esteeID and e.Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode and ea.status=1
) x order by x.date desc  
    
END 

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.GetXTXMarginUtilizationData

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetXTXMarginUtilizationData]     
 @ListSSID varchar(100)
AS        
BEGIN  
 declare @starttime1 datetime declare @endtime1 datetime
set @starttime1 = GETDATE()-12
set @endtime1 = GETDATE()
 
select SnapShotTimeStamp, a.strategyID, a.mandate, a.FTD_MoneyDeployed,a.FTD_MoneyDeployed/a.mandate*100 as MoneyDeployed_Percent from AllocatorSnapshot (nolock) a
where convert(date,SnapShotTimeStamp) between @starttime1  and @endtime1
and ((DATEPART(dw, SnapShotTimeStamp) + @@DATEFIRST) % 7) NOT IN (0, 1)
and convert(time,SnapShotTimeStamp) between '09:15am' and '3:30pm'
and a.DimensionType = 3
and a.strategyID in (select strategyID from [dbo].[StringToInt] (@ListSSID))
and a.accID = 635
order by SnapShotTimeStamp
    
END 



```

## View definition: dbo.IndexedOrdersView

```sql
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[IndexedOrdersView]

AS
SELECT     T.Trade_ID, T.OrderTrade_ID, OT.Original_Order_ID, OT.Order_ID, O.Link_ID, O.Broker_ID, O.Account_ID, O.Sub_Strategy_ID, T.Estee_ID, 
                      O.Underlying_Ticker, T.Buy_Sell_Indicator, T.Order_Quantity, T.Order_Price, T.Traded_Quantity, T.Traded_Price, T.Stop_Price, OT.Status, OT.Remarks, 
                      O.Comb_Status, OT.Creation_Time, OT.Update_Time, O.Order_Type, O.Order_Validity, OT.New_Cancel_Modify, T.Transaction_Cost, OT.Price_Diff, 
                      O.Order_Source_ID, O.Broker_Order_ID, O.Exchange_Order_ID, SUBSTRING(T.Estee_ID, 0, 13) AS ISIN, OT.Created_By, OT.Updated_By, 
                      OT.islast
FROM         dbo.tblTrades AS T WITH (nolock) INNER JOIN
                      dbo.tblOrderTrades AS OT WITH (nolock) ON T.OrderTrade_ID = OT.OrderTrade_ID INNER JOIN
                      dbo.tblOrders AS O WITH (nolock) ON O.Order_ID = OT.Order_ID

```

## Function: dbo.InOUpTrade

```sql

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.InOUpTrade (@creationdate date, @orderId int, @orderTradeId int, @tradeId int, @execId varchar(40), @fillQty decimal(20,2), @status varchar(50))
RETURNS int
AS
/*
		if current exec Id - blank
			 if # of records = 0, then insert 
			-else do nothing
		 else 
			 if already exists with same exec Id, then do nothing
			 else if blank exists, then update blank with current
			 else insert
*/

BEGIN
     DECLARE @InOrUp int = -1; -- -1 = do nothing; 0 = update; 1 = insert

	 IF @tradeId is not null BEGIN
		IF @execId = '' BEGIN
			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Trades WHERE Order_ID = @orderId and Creation_Date = @creationdate and Trade_ID = @tradeId and OrderTrade_ID = @orderTradeId) BEGIN
				SET @InOrUp = 1 -- for insert
			END
		END ELSE BEGIN -- execID is not blank
			IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Trades WHERE Order_ID = @orderId and Creation_Date = @creationdate and Trade_ID = @tradeId and OrderTrade_ID = @orderTradeId and ExecID = @execId) BEGIN
				SET @InOrUp = -1 -- do nothing
			END ELSE IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Trades WHERE Order_ID = @orderId and Creation_Date = @creationdate and Trade_ID = @tradeId and OrderTrade_ID = @orderTradeId and ExecID = '') BEGIN
				IF @fillQty <> 0 and @status <> 'Cancelled' BEGIN	
					SET @InOrUp = 0 -- for update
				END ELSE BEGIN -- case where we have non blank execID that is not present already in trade, but fill quantity is zero; or status is cancelled
					--error condition; todo: somehow raise an exception
					SET @InOrUp = -1 -- do nothing
				END		
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SET @InOrUp = 1 -- for insert
			END
		END
	END   

    RETURN(@InOrUp);
END;

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.InsertIntoAggregatedRCFRequest

```sql

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[InsertIntoAggregatedRCFRequest]  

 @RequesterID varchar(255),              

 @Machine varchar(255),              

 @Comments varchar(255),              

 @status bit,              

 @RCFData [RCFDataType] readonly,            

 @ApproversList [NameValuePairType] readonly,  

 @InsertedRequestID INT OUTPUT  ,      

 @error varchar(255) output,  

 @RiskLimitID int,
 
 @tempDate date  

AS              

BEGIN              

            

 SET NOCOUNT ON;              

 BEGIN TRY              

          

   set @error = ''       

   if EXISTS( select 1 from       

  RCFRequestDetail RRD join      

  @RCFData  R on RRD.DimensionId=R.DimensionID and RRD.DimensionValue=R.DimensionValue      

  join RCFRequest rr on rr.ReqID = RRD.ReqID and rr.Status=1      

  join RCFApprovalRequest RAR on RAR.ReqID= RRD.ReqID and RAR.ApprovalStatus in ('P' ,'R'))      

  begin

   set @error = 'Can not create a new request as an Active and Pending request already exists for this strategy'      

   return

  end

  

   if not EXISTS( select 1 from

  RCFRequestDetail RRD join

  RiskLimits  R on RRD.DimensionId=R.DimensionID and R.ID = RRD.RiskLimitID )

  begin

   set @error = 'Limit already updated'      

   return      

  end           

      

  Begin tran       

  Declare @CurrentDimID int, @CurrentDimValue varchar(255),@CurrentRiskParam NameValuePairType,

  @CurrentApprover varchar(255),  @CurrentRole varchar(255)             

                

  Insert into RCFRequest              

  Select @RequesterID,@Machine,GETDATE(),@Comments,@status       

                

            

       

  DECLARE RCFDataCursor CURSOR LOCAL SCROLL STATIC                     

  FOR                     

  Select distinct DimensionID,DimensionValue  FROM @RCFData              

                

  OPEN RCFDataCursor -- open the cursor                    

                     

  FETCH NEXT FROM RCFDataCursor INTO @CurrentDimID, @CurrentDimValue            

                

                  

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0                     

    BEGIN               

                

   delete from @CurrentRiskParam              

   insert into  @CurrentRiskParam select RMName,RMvalue from @RCFData              

   where DimensionId=@CurrentDimID and DimensionValue=@CurrentDimValue                


    INSERT INTO RCFRequestDetail                          

    SELECT IDENT_CURRENT('RCFRequest'),@CurrentDimID,RP.RiskParamId,@CurrentDimValue, TD.Value , @RiskLimitID   ,@tempDate                  

    FROM @CurrentRiskParam TD                           

    inner join RiskParameters RP on TD.Name = RP.RiskParamName                        

                          

    --LEFT OUTER JOIN (select * from RCFRequestDetail where DimensionId = @CurrentDimID and DimensionValue=@CurrentDimValue)                        

    --RL ON RP.RiskParamId = RL.RiskParamId                        

    --WHERE RL.RiskParamId IS NULL              

                

    FETCH NEXT FROM RCFDataCursor INTO @CurrentDimID, @CurrentDimValue               

               

  END                    

                     

  CLOSE RCFDataCursor -- close the cursor                    

  DEALLOCATE RCFDataCursor             

              

              

  DECLARE ApproversCursor CURSOR LOCAL SCROLL STATIC                     

  FOR                     

  Select *  FROM @ApproversList            

              

  OPEN ApproversCursor -- open the cursor            

              

  FETCH NEXT FROM ApproversCursor INTO @CurrentApprover,@CurrentRole             

              

  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0                     

    BEGIN            

   

    insert into RCFApprovalRequest(ReqID,ApproversID,ApprovalStatus,Machine,ApprovalTime,Requester,comments,RoleID)    

     values (IDENT_CURRENT('RCFRequest'),@CurrentApprover,'P','','',@RequesterID,'',@CurrentRole)             

                   

  FETCH NEXT FROM ApproversCursor INTO @CurrentApprover,@CurrentRole            

              

  end            

               

   CLOSE ApproversCursor -- close the cursor                    

  DEALLOCATE ApproversCursor            

                     

                     

    COMMIT TRAN              

    END TRY              

    BEGIN CATCH              

  Rollback tran              

  DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);                

    DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;                

    DECLARE @ErrorState INT;                

                 

    SELECT @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),                

           @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),                

           @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();                

                 

    -- RAISERROR inside the CATCH block will return error information about the original error that caused execution to jump to the CATCH block.                

   RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage, -- Message text.                

               @ErrorSeverity, -- Severity.                

               @ErrorState -- State.                

               );                

    END CATCH              

    SELECT @InsertedRequestID = IDENT_CURRENT('RCFRequest')              

END 

select *from RCFRequestDetail

GRANT EXEC ON [dbo].InsertIntoAggregatedRCFRequest  TO db_execsp

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.InsertIntoClosingPrice

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[InsertIntoClosingPrice]   
 @Date  datetime,  
    @Estee_ID  varchar(50),  
    @Open_Price  decimal(20,5),  
    @High_Price  decimal(20,5),  
    @Low_Price  decimal(20,5),  
    @Close_Price  decimal(20,5),  
    @Volume  decimal(20,0),  
    @Net_Traded_Val  decimal(18,2),  
    @Trades  int,  
    @Open_Interest  decimal(20,5),  
    @Settlement_Price  decimal(20,5)=0.0,
    @Source varchar(50)=''     
AS  
BEGIN  
 DECLARE @LotSize int  
  
SET NOCOUNT ON;  
SET @LotSize=1  
 
IF (SELECT Count(*) FROM ESTEEMASTER WHERE  Exchange_Code='IS' and Estee_id=@Estee_ID and status=1) > 0
	SELECT @LotSize=Lot_Size FROM ESTEEMASTER WHERE  Exchange_Code='IS' and Estee_id=@Estee_ID and status=1 
 ELSE 
	SELECT @LotSize=Lot_Size FROM ESTEEMASTER_ARCHIVE WHERE  Exchange_Code='IS' and Estee_id=@Estee_ID and status=1
       
 INSERT INTO closingprice (  
        DATE,  
        ESTEE_ID,  
        OPEN_PRICE,  
        HIGH_PRICE,  
        LOW_PRICE,  
        CLOSE_PRICE,  
        VOLUME,  
        NET_TRADED_VAL,  
        TRADES,  
        OPEN_INTEREST,  
        Settlement_Price,
        Source   
       )  
 VALUES     (  
        @Date,
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.InsertIntoRCFRequest

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[InsertIntoRCFRequest]                  
 @RequesterID varchar(255),                  
 @Machine varchar(255),                  
 @Comments varchar(255),                  
 @status bit,                  
 @RCFData [RCFDataType] readonly,                
 @ApproversList [NameValuePairType] readonly,      
 @InsertedRequestID INT OUTPUT  ,          
 @error varchar(255) output,      
 @RiskLimitID int,
 @IsTemporaryRCF bit = 0    
AS                  
BEGIN                  
 SET NOCOUNT ON;                  
 BEGIN TRY                  
 --------------------LOGIC FOR TEMP DATE-------------------------------------------------------------------  
  declare @tempDate date = '0001-01-01'  
  DECLARE @cutOffTime TIME  
  DECLARE @tempDateTime TIME = CONVERT(TIME,GETDATE())  
  DECLARE @minDate DATE = '0001-01-01'  
  SELECT @cutOffTime = value from datainit where ApplicationID = 0 and Parameter = 'TradeDateCutOffTime'  
  
   IF @IsTemporaryRCF = 1  
   begin  
   IF @tempDateTime between '00:00:00' and @cutOffTime  
   BEGIN  
    SET @tempDate = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE() - 1)  
   END   
   ELSE  
   BEGIN  
    SET @tempDate = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE())  
   END  
   end   
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------                  
   set @error = ''             
   if EXISTS( select 1 from             
  RCFRequestDetail RRD join            
  @RCFData  R on RRD.DimensionId=R.DimensionID and RRD.DimensionValue=R.DimensionValue  and rrd.date=@tempDate          
  join RCFRequest rr on rr.ReqID = RRD.ReqID and rr.Status=1            
  join RCFApprovalRequest RAR on RAR.ReqID= RRD.ReqID and RAR.ApprovalStatus in ('P')) --removing 'R' from here as, if a rejected req is present we need not wait           
  begin            
   set @error = 'Can not create a new request as an Active and Pending request already exists for this strategy'            
   return            
  end                 
--if Exists (Select 1 from RiskLimits R join @RCFData RD on RD.DimensionID = R.DimensionId and RD.DimensionValue = R.DimensionValue and (R.DimensionId <> 13 OR R.DimensionId <> 11) )        
--BEGIN        
--  if NOT Exists (Select 1 from RiskLimits R join @RCFData RD on RD.DimensionID = R.DimensionId and RD.DimensionValue = R.DimensionValue where  R.ID = @RiskLimitID  )        
--   BEGIN        
--    set @error = 'Limit Already Updated'          
--    return          
--   END        
--END        
  Begin tran             
  Declare @CurrentDimID int, @CurrentDimValue varchar(255),@CurrentRiskParam NameValuePairType ,                  
  @CurrentApprover varchar(255),  @CurrentRole varchar(255)   
                    
  Insert into RCFRequest                    
  Select @RequesterID,@Machine,GETDATE(),@Comments,@status   
              
  DECLARE RCFDataCursor CURSOR LOCAL SCROLL STATIC                           
  FOR                           
  Select distinct DimensionID,DimensionValue  FROM @RCFData                    
  OPEN RCFDataCursor -- open the cursor                          
  FETCH NEXT FROM RCFDataCursor INTO @CurrentDimID, @CurrentDimValue                  
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0                           
    BEGIN                     
   delete from @CurrentRiskParam                    
   insert into  @CurrentRiskParam select RMName,RMvalue from @RCFData                    
   where DimensionId=@CurrentDimID and DimensionValue=@CurrentDimValue   
                        
    INSERT INTO RCFRequestDetail                                
    SELECT IDENT_CURRENT('RCFRequest'),@CurrentDimID,RP.RiskParamId,@CurrentDimValue, TD.Value , @RiskLimitID,@tempDate                           
    FROM @CurrentRiskParam TD    
    inner join RiskParameters RP on TD.Name = RP.RiskParamName                              
    --LEFT OUTER JOIN (select * from RCFRequestDetail where DimensionId = @CurrentDimID and DimensionValue=@CurrentDimValue)                              
    --RL ON RP.RiskParamId = RL.RiskParamId                              
    --WHERE RL.RiskParamId IS NULL                    
    FETCH NEXT FROM RCFDataCursor INTO @CurrentDimID, @CurrentDimValue                     
  END                          
  CLOSE RCFDataCursor -- close the cursor                          
  DEALLOCATE RCFDataCursor   
                    
  DECLARE ApproversCursor CURSOR LOCAL SCROLL STATIC                           
  FOR                           
  Select *  FROM @ApproversList                  
  OPEN ApproversCursor -- open the cursor             
  FETCH NEXT FROM ApproversCursor INTO @CurrentApprover,@CurrentRole                   
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0                           
    BEGIN                  
    insert into RCFApprovalRequest(ReqID,ApproversID,ApprovalStatus,Machine,ApprovalTime,Requester,comments,RoleID)          
     values (IDENT_CURRENT('RCFRequest'),@CurrentApprover,'P','','',@RequesterID,'',@CurrentRole)                   
  FETCH NEXT FROM ApproversCursor INTO @CurrentApprover,@CurrentRole                   
  end                  
   CLOSE ApproversCursor -- close the cursor                          
  DEALLOCATE ApproversCursor                  
    COMMIT TRAN                    
    END TRY                    
    BEGIN CATCH                    
  Rollback tran                    
  DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);                      
    DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;                      
    DECLARE @ErrorState INT;                      
    SELECT @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),                      
           @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),                      
           @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();                      
    -- RAISERROR inside the CATCH block will return error information about the original error that caused execution to jump to the CATCH block.                      
   RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage, -- Message text.                      
               @ErrorSeverity, -- Severity.                      
               @ErrorState -- State.                      
               );                      
    END CATCH                    
    SELECT @InsertedRequestID = IDENT_CURRENT('RCFRequest')                    
END   


```

```sql
Create function [dbo].[IsGivenDateTradingHoliday] (@runDate Date)
	Returns bit
	with execute as caller
	AS
	BEGIN
		if DATEPART(weekday,@runDate) in (1,7)
		BEGIN
			return 1;
			ENd
	    if exists( select * from holidays where Segment='FO' and Exchange='IS' and Date = @runDate)
	    BEGIN
			return 1;
	    END
		return 0;
	END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.IsRequestApproved

```sql
  
CREATE Procedure [dbo].[IsRequestApproved]    
@ReqID int ,    
@IsRequestApproved bit out    
as     
begin    
    
set @IsRequestApproved='1'    
    
if exists(select 1 from RCFApprovalRequest where roleid ='-1' and ApprovalStatus in ('P','R') and ReqID=@ReqID)    
begin    
select @IsRequestApproved='0'    
return    
end    
    
else    
begin    
 declare @CurrentRole varchar(20)    
       declare @rolemap table(roleid varchar(20) )  
   
 DECLARE RCFDataCursor CURSOR LOCAL SCROLL STATIC                     
 FOR                     
 Select distinct roleid  FROM RCFApprovalRequest where roleid <>'-1'  and ReqID=@ReqID    
     
 OPEN RCFDataCursor -- open the cursor                    
                     
 FETCH NEXT FROM RCFDataCursor INTO @CurrentRole    
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0       
  begin    
  delete from @rolemap  
      insert into @roleMap SELECT * from Split(@CurrentRole,',')   
      declare @count int  
      select @count = COUNT(*)  from @rolemap  
 while(@count > 0)  
 Begin  
      declare @value int  
     select   top 1 @value = roleid from @rolemap  
  delete from @rolemap where roleid = @value  
      select @count = COUNT(*)  from @rolemap  
     declare @str varchar(50)  
     set @str  = '%'+Cast(@value as varchar(20))+'%'  
     select @str  
 if (exists(select 1 from RCFApprovalRequest where roleid like @str and ApprovalStatus ='R' and ReqID=@ReqID)  
  or not exists(select 1 from RCFApprovalRequest where roleid like @str and ApprovalStatus ='A' and ReqID=@ReqID)  
  )  
 begin  
  select @IsRequestApproved='0'    
  return      
 end  
 END  
  FETCH NEXT FROM RCFDataCursor INTO @CurrentRole    
      
 end    
end     
    
end    
  
  
```

```sql
	DECLARE @SLICE1 VARCHAR(40)
	DECLARE @SLICE2 VARCHAR(40)
	DECLARE @Delimiter VARCHAR(5)
	SET @Delimiter = 'E+'

	SELECT @IDX = 1
		IF LEN(@STRING)<1 OR @STRING IS NULL 
			RETURN 0	
	--WHILE @IDX != 0
	--BEGIN     
        SET @IDX = charindex(@Delimiter,@STRING)     
        IF @IDX!=0  
        BEGIN   
            SET @SLICE1 = LEFT(@STRING,@IDX - 1) 
            SET @SLICE2 = RIGHT(@STRING,LEN(@STRING) - @idx)  
            --PRINT ' LEFT -> ' + @SLICE1  
           
            --PRINT ' RIGHT -> ' + @SLICE2
        END  
        ELSE     
            set @SLICE1 = @STRING     
      
        if(LEN(@SLICE1)>0)
        BEGIN  
            SET @ISSUECAP = CAST( @SLICE1 AS DECIMAL(38,10)) * POWER(10.0,CAST( @SLICE2 AS INT))

   -- END 
RETURN  @ISSUECAP
END
```

## Function: dbo.isValidIntegerList

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION isValidIntegerList(
				@intList VARCHAR(MAX)
)
RETURNS BIT
AS
	 BEGIN
		 DECLARE @intValue VARCHAR(15);
		 DECLARE @result BIT;
		 DECLARE @pos INT;
		 DECLARE @len INT;
		 SET @pos = 0;
		 SET @len = 0;
		 SET @result = 0;

		 IF CHARINDEX(',', @intList, @pos) = 0
			 BEGIN
				 IF ISNUMERIC(@intList+'.0e0') = 1
					 BEGIN
						 SET @result = 1;
					 END;
			 END;
		 ELSE
			 BEGIN
				 SET @intList = @intList+',';
				 WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @intList, @pos+1) > 0
					 BEGIN
						 SET @len = CHARINDEX(',', @intList, @pos+1)-@pos;
						 SET @intValue = SUBSTRING(@intList, @pos, @len);
						 IF ISNUMERIC(@intValue+'.0e0') = 1
							 BEGIN
								 SET @result = 1;
							 END;
						 ELSE
							 BEGIN
								 SET @result = 0;
							 END;
						 SET @pos = CHARINDEX(',', @intList, @pos+@len)+1;
					 END;
			 END;
		 RETURN @result;
	 END;

```

## Function: dbo.isValidIP

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION isValidIP(
			   @ip VARCHAR(16))
RETURNS BIT
AS
	 BEGIN
		 DECLARE @result BIT;
		 SET @result = 0;

		 IF LEN(@ip+'x')-1 > 15
			 BEGIN
				 SET @result = 0
			 END;

		 IF @ip LIKE '%_.%_.%_.%_'
			AND @ip NOT LIKE '%.%.%.%.%'
			AND @ip NOT LIKE '%[^0-9.]%'
			AND @ip NOT LIKE '%[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]%'
			AND @ip NOT LIKE '%[3-9][0-9][0-9]%'
			AND @ip NOT LIKE '%2[6-9][0-9]%'
			AND @ip NOT LIKE '%25[6-9]%'
			 BEGIN
				 SET @result = 1
			 END;

		 RETURN @result;
	 END;
```

```sql
		 SET @len = 0;
		 SET @result = 0;

		 IF CHARINDEX(',', @intList, @pos) = 0
			 BEGIN
				 IF ISNUMERIC(@intList+'.0e0') = 1
					 BEGIN
						 IF CONVERT(INT, @intList) > 0
							 BEGIN
								 SET @result = 1;
							 END;
					 END;
			 END;
		 ELSE
			 BEGIN
				 SET @intList = @intList+',';
				 WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @intList, @pos+1) > 0
					 BEGIN
						 SET @len = CHARINDEX(',', @intList, @pos+1)-@pos;
						 SET @intValue = SUBSTRING(@intList, @pos, @len);
						 IF ISNUMERIC(@intValue+'.0e0') = 1
							 BEGIN

										 SET @result = 1;

										 SET @result = 0;

							 BEGIN
								 SET @result = 0;

					 END;

				 SET @result = 0
			 END;
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.IsWorkingDay

```sql
CREATE PROC [dbo].[IsWorkingDay]  
    @Exchange VARCHAR(2) = NULL,  
    @ExchangeSegment VARCHAR(2) = NULL,  
    @ClearingOrTrading VARCHAR(1),  
    @runDate DATE ,
	@subSession int=NULL,
	@OverrideId varchar(50) = NULL
 AS

 BEGIN
	DECLARE @var INT  
	SET @var = 0  
	DECLARE @isHoliday bit =0, @isHolidayTrading bit=0
	DECLARE @rtDayofWeek VARCHAR(10)  
	DECLARE @comments VARCHAR(MAX)  
	SET @comments = ''

	if (@Exchange is not null and @ExchangeSegment is not null)
	BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(select * 
			 from holidaytrading 
		    where date = @runDate and Exchange = @Exchange and Segment = @ExchangeSegment and HolidayType = @ClearingOrTrading
			  and SubSession = ISNULL(@subSession,SubSession))          
		BEGIN  
			SET @var = 1
			SET @isHolidayTrading =1
			select @comments  = 'HolidayTrading:'+ Description 
			from holidaytrading 
			where date = @runDate and Exchange = @Exchange and Segment = @ExchangeSegment and HolidayType = @ClearingOrTrading   

			SELECT @var as WorkingDayBit, @comments as Comments  
		END          
		ELSE 	
		BEGIN
			Declare @traingHourTempTable table(subSession int, OverrideId varchar(50))
			Declare @holidayTempTable table(subSession int, OverrideId varchar(50))

			insert into @traingHourTempTable
			select distinct SubSession,'' from TradingHours where Exchange = @Exchange and ExchangeSegments = @ExchangeSegment 
							and IsNormalSession =1 and @runDate >= StartDate and @runDate <= EndDate 
							and SubSession = ISNULL(@subSession, SubSession)
			union
			select distinct SubSession,OverrideId from TradingHoursOverride where Exchange = @Exchange and ExchangeSegments = @ExchangeSegment 
					and IsNormalSession =1 and @runDate >= StartDate and @runDate <= EndDate and SubSession = ISNULL(@subSession, SubSession)
							and OverrideId = ISNULL(@overrideID,OverrideId)		

			Insert into @holidayTempTable
			select distinct SubSession,'' from holidays h					
			where date = @runDate and Exchange = @Exchange and Segment = @ExchangeSegment and HolidayType = @ClearingOrTrading 
			and SubSession = ISNULL(@subSession, SubSession)							
			union 
			select distinct SubSession,OverrideId from HolidaysOverride where date = @runDate and Exchange = @Exchange
				and Segment = @ExchangeSegment and HolidayType = @ClearingOrTrading and SubSession = ISNULL(@subSession, SubSession)
				and OverrideId = ISNULL(@OverrideId, OverrideId)		

			if NOT EXISTS( select 1 from @traingHourTempTable th left join @holidayTempTable h on th.subSession = h.subSession 
						and th.OverrideId = h.OverrideId where h.subSession is null and h.OverrideId is null)												
			BEGIN  
				SET @var = 0  
				set @isHoliday =1  
				SET @comments = 'Holiday:' + (select top 1 [description] from
							(select [description] from holidays where date = @runDate and Exchange = @Exchange 
					and Segment = @ExchangeSegment and HolidayType = @ClearingOrTrading and SubSession = ISNULL(@subSession,SubSession) 
						union select [description] from HolidaysOverride where date = @runDate and Exchange = @Exchange
					and Segment = @ExchangeSegment and HolidayType = @ClearingOrTrading and SubSession = ISNULL(@subSession,SubSession) 
					and OverrideId = ISNULL(@OverrideId, OverrideId))A)

				SELECT @var as WorkingDayBit, @comments as Comments  
			END
		END	
	
	
		IF @isHoliday = 0 and @isHolidayTrading =0 and EXISTS(select * 
				  from tradingweekdays 
				 where Exchange = @Exchange and ExchangeSegment = @ExchangeSegment and ClearingOrTrading = @ClearingOrTrading)  
		BEGIN  
			SELECT @rtDayofWeek = CASE DATEPART(weekday,@runDate)  
							  WHEN 1 THEN 'Sunday'  
							  WHEN 2 THEN 'Monday'  
							  WHEN 3 THEN 'Tuesday'  
							  WHEN 4 THEN 'Wednesday'  
							  WHEN 5 THEN 'Thursday'  
							  WHEN 6 THEN 'Friday'  
							  WHEN 7 THEN 'Saturday'  
						  END             

			DECLARE @query nvarchar(max)     
			DECLARE @tradingonweekday INT  
			SET @tradingonweekday = 0  
			SET @query = N'select @tradingonweekday = ' + @rtDayofWeek + ' from tradingweekdays where Exchange = ''' 
				+ @Exchange + ''' and ExchangeSegment = ''' + @ExchangeSegment + ''' and ClearingOrTrading = ''' + @ClearingOrTrading + ''''   
  
			EXECUTE sp_executesql @query, N'@tradingonweekday int output', @tradingonweekday output  

			SET @var = @tradingonweekday  
			if @tradingonweekday = 1   
				Set @comments = 'WorkingDay:' + @rtDayofWeek  
			else  
				Set @comments = 'NonWorkingDay:' + @rtDayofWeek   

			SELECT @var as WorkingDayBit, @comments as Comments  
		END  
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			select @comments  = 'Data not found for Exchange:' + @Exchange + ' , ExchangeSegment:' 
					+ @ExchangeSegment + ' , HolidayType:' + @ClearingOrTrading + ' in Tradingweekdays table.'
			RAISERROR(@comments,10,1)
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select @comments  = 'Exchange and exchnage segment should be specified'				
			RAISERROR(@comments,10,1)
	END
END

```

## View definition: dbo.JobView

```sql
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[JobView]
AS
SELECT     J.ID,
		   J.Job, 
		   J.Description, 
		   J.JobType, 
           J.JobCategory, 
           J.CutOffTime, 
           J.ExchangeCode,
           LD1.Email as AssignedTo, 
           LD2.Email as CheckedBy, 
           J.Automated, 
           LD3.Email as AlternateCheckedBy, 
		   LD1.FirstName + ' ' + ISNULL(LD1.LastName, '') AssignedPerson,
		   LD2.FirstName + ' ' + ISNULL(LD2.LastName, '') CheckedPerson,
		   LD3.FirstName + ' ' + ISNULL(LD3.LastName, '') AlternateCheckPerson
FROM         dbo.Jobs J
			INNER JOIN dbo.LoginDetails LD1  ON J.AssignedTo = LD1.UserID 
			INNER JOIN dbo.LoginDetails  LD2  ON J.CheckedBy = LD2.UserID
			INNER JOIN dbo.LoginDetails  LD3  ON J.AlternateCheckedBy = LD3.UserID
			INNER JOIN dbo.JobTypes AS JT ON JT.Type = J.JobType

```

## Function: dbo.JsonPairValue

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.JsonPairValue  
(  
    @json NVARCHAR(MAX),      -- e.g. [{"name":"FwdPrice","value":"-.50"}, ...]  
    @key  NVARCHAR(200)       -- e.g. N'FwdPrice'  
)  
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000)  
AS  
BEGIN  
    IF @json IS NULL OR @key IS NULL RETURN NULL;  
    DECLARE @needle NVARCHAR(300);  
    DECLARE @i INT, @j INT, @k INT, @start INT, @len INT;  
    -- Find the object whose name matches @key  
    SET @needle = N'"name":"' + @key + N'"';  
    SET @i = CHARINDEX(@needle, @json);  
    IF @i = 0 RETURN NULL;  
    -- Find the start of the "value" that follows that name  
    SET @j = CHARINDEX(N',"value":"', @json, @i);  
    IF @j = 0 RETURN NULL;  
    SET @start = @j + LEN(N',"value":"');  
    -- Find the ending quote of the value  
    SET @k = CHARINDEX(N'"', @json, @start);  
    IF @k = 0 RETURN NULL;  
    SET @len = @k - @start;  
    RETURN SUBSTRING(@json, @start, @len);  
END  
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.LoadUserPermissions

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[LoadUserPermissions]            
@firstname varchar(50) = null,        
@choice int = 0            
             
AS            
BEGIN            
  if(@choice =0)            
     SELECT FirstName, LastName, Username, Last_Login_Time, R.Role_Name, LD.UserID, R.Role_ID,       
   ISNULL(IsManager, 'False') AS IsManager      
  from LoginDetails LD          
    INNER JOIN UserRoles UR ON LD.UserID = UR.User_ID          
    INNER JOIN Roles R ON UR.Role_ID = R.Role_ID      
    LEFT OUTER JOIN UserPermissions UP ON UP.User_ID = LD.UserID       
  where LD.FirstName = @firstname         
  else if(@choice=1)         
 SELECT DISTINCT/*FirstName, LastName, Username, Last_Login_Time, R.Role_Name, LD.UserID, R.Role_ID, */        
  US.strategy_id, SubStrategy_Name as strategy_name, SubStrategy_Id, SubStrategy_Name, Strategy_Status      
   from LoginDetails LD          
  INNER JOIN UserRoles UR ON LD.UserID = UR.User_ID          
  INNER JOIN Roles R ON UR.Role_ID = R.Role_ID          
  INNER JOIN UserStrategies US ON US.UserID = LD.UserID         
  INNER JOIN Strategy_New SN ON US.strategy_id = SN.Strategy_ID         
  where LD.FirstName = @firstname     and dimension_id=6      
             
END

GRANT EXEC ON [dbo].[LoadUserPermissions] TO db_execsp

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.Login

```sql
   
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Login]              
@username varchar(50),       
@password varchar(50),            
@changedpassword varchar(50) = null,                              
@blocked bit = 0,              
@passwordexpiry int = 10 ,        
@Return int Out         
AS              
BEGIN           
    
if not exists(Select 1 From LoginDetails Where  username = @username)    
begin     
 set @Return = -1    
end    
else     
begin     
 if not exists(Select 1 From LoginDetails Where  username = @username and [password] = @password)    
 begin     
  if(@blocked=0)    
   begin    
    set @Return =  -2    
   end    
  else     
   begin     
    Update LoginDetails Set Blocked = @blocked Where username = @username    
    set @Return =  -5    
   end    
 end     
 else     
 begin     
  if exists(Select 1 From LoginDetails Where  username = @username and [password] = @password and blocked = 1)    
  begin     
   set @Return =  -3    
  end    
  else     
  begin     
   --select DateAdd(dd,@passwordexpiry,  PasswordChangedTime) From LoginDetails Where  username = @username    
   if LEN(@changedpassword)=0 and exists(Select 1 From LoginDetails Where  username = @username and [password] = @password and blocked = 0 and DateAdd(dd,@passwordexpiry,  PasswordChangedTime) < getdate())    
   begin     
    set @Return =  -4    
   end     
   else     
   begin    
     declare @_userID int     
     set @_userID = (Select [UserID] From LoginDetails Where  username = @username)    
         
     if(LEN(@changedpassword)<>0)    
     begin     
      Update LoginDetails Set [Password] = @changedpassword, PasswordchangedTime = getdate(), UpdatedBy =@_userID, UpdatedDate = getdate() Where [UserID] = @_userID    
      set @Return =  2    
     end    
     else     
     begin    
      set @Return =  1    
     end    
         
     Select * From LoginDetails Where  [UserID] = @_userID    
    
     SELECT  Roles.ROLE_ID, Roles.ROLE_NAME FROM UserRoles    
                 Inner Join Roles On UserRoles.Role_ID = Roles.Role_ID     
               WHERE UserRoles.[User_ID] = @_userID    
    
     SELECT     ISNULL(IsManager, 'False') AS IsManager FROM UserPermissions WHERE UserPermissions.[User_ID] = @_userID          
         
SELECT  distinct Strategy_New.Strategy_ID, StrategyGroup.StrategyName as Strategy_Name, Strategy_New.SubStrategy_Id, Strategy_New.SubStrategy_Name, Strategy_New.Strategy_Status, sba.accountID, a.exchange_Code   
FROM  UserStrategies       
Inner Join Strategy_New On Strategy_New.Strategy_ID = UserStrategies.strategy_id  
inner Join StrategyGroup on Strategy_New.Strategy_ID = StrategyGroup.StrategyID   
Inner join StrategyBrokerAccount sba on sba.subStrategyID = Strategy_New.SubStrategy_Id  
inner join Account a on sba.accountID = a.Account_ID  
WHERE  UserStrategies.dimension_id=6 and--Strategy_New.Strategy_Status = 1 and     
UserStrategies.[UserID] = @_userID  
                 
               select Replace(R.Role_Name,' ','') as Role_Name,   
      PermissionName,AccessTypeName   
    from tblrolespermission RP,tblpermissions P, tblAccessType AT,Roles R   
    where R.Role_ID=RP.RoleID   
      and AT.AccessTypeID=RP.AccessTypeID   
      and RP.permissionId= p.PermissionID   
      and roleid in   
       (select role_id from UserRoles where User_ID = @_userID)  
   
 select distinct sba.accountID, A.Account_Name, A.Participant_ID, A.Account_Type, A.exchange_Code from StrategyBrokerAccount sba  
 inner join Strategy_New sn on sn.SubStrategy_Id = sba.substrategyID  
 inner join UserStrategies us on us.strategy_id = sn.Strategy_Id  
 inner join Account A on A.Account_ID = sba.accountID  
 where us.dimension_id=6 and --sn.Strategy_Status = 1 and   
 us.UserID = @_userID   
   end      
  end    
 end     
end           
 return @Return    
END     
    
  
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.LogJobHistory

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[LogJobHistory]  
 @JobCode varchar(200),  
 @ExecutingMachineIP varchar(200),  
 @CodeExecutionPath varchar(400),   
 @StartTime DateTime,  
 @ExecutionStatus varchar(20),  
 @ArgumentPassed varchar(max),
 @EndTime DateTime = null
 
as  
If Exists ( Select * from JobHistory where serverIP=@ExecutingMachineIP and Jobcode = @JobCode and codeExecutionPath = @CodeExecutionPath and StartDateTime = @StartTime )  
BEGIN   
 UPDATE JobHistory  
 SET EndDateTime = @EndTime,  
  ExecutionStatus = @ExecutionStatus  
 WHERE  
  serverIP=@ExecutingMachineIP and JOBCODE = @JobCode and CODEEXECUTIONPATH = @CodeExecutionPath and STARTDATETIME = @StartTime   
End  
Else  
Begin   
 INSERT INTO [dbo].[JobHistory]  
      ([JobCode]  
      ,[ServerIP]  
      ,[CodeExecutionPath]  
      ,[STARTDATETIME]  
      ,[EndDateTime]  
      ,[ExecutionStatus]
      ,[ArgumentPassed])  
   VALUES  
      (@JobCode,@ExecutingMachineIP,@CodeExecutionPath,@StartTime,NULL,@ExecutionStatus,@ArgumentPassed)  
 End

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.MoveRCFLimitsToRiskLimits

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MoveRCFLimitsToRiskLimits]                           
 -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here             
      @RCFData [RCFDataType] readonly        
AS                          
BEGIN                          
 -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from                          
 -- interfering with SELECT statements.                          
 SET NOCOUNT ON;                          
 BEGIN TRY                          
 BEGIN TRAN 

 -----------------------------------------------Logic for temp date--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	DECLARE @cutOffTime TIME
	DECLARE @tempDate DATE = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE())
	DECLARE @tempDateTime TIME = CONVERT(TIME,GETDATE())
	DECLARE @minDate DATE = '0001-01-01'
	SELECT @cutOffTime = value from datainit where ApplicationID = 0 and Parameter = 'TradeDateCutOffTime'


	IF @tempDateTime between '00:00:00' and @cutOffTime
	BEGIN
		SET @tempDate = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE() - 1)
	END 

		DELETE FROM RL
	   from @RCFData rc
	   inner join RiskLimits rl on RC.DimensionId = rl.DimensionId and RC.DimensionValue= rl.DimensionValue  and rc.date = @minDate
	   inner join RiskParameters rp on rp.RiskParamId= rl.RiskParamId and rp.RiskParamName= rc.RMName where rl.Date = @tempDate

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                                
   Update RL
   set rl.RiskParameterValue = rc.RMvalue, rl.ID = rl.ID + 1
   from @RCFData rc
   inner join RiskLimits rl on RC.DimensionId = rl.DimensionId and RC.DimensionValue= rl.DimensionValue and rc.date = rl.Date
   inner join RiskParameters rp on rp.RiskParamId= rl.RiskParamId and rp.RiskParamName= rc.RMName
       
   Insert into RiskLimits
   select rc.DimensionID, rp.RiskParamId, rc.DimensionValue, rc.RMvalue, 1,RC.Date
   from @RCFData rc
   inner join RiskParameters rp on rp.RiskParamName= rc.RMName
   left join RiskLimits rl on RC.DimensionId = rl.DimensionId and RC.DimensionValue= rl.DimensionValue and rp.RiskParamId= rl.RiskParamId and rc.date = rl.Date
   where rl.DimensionId is null 
  
   Update RL
   set RL.ID = B.ID
   from RiskLimits RL 
   Inner join (select Rl.DimensionId, rl.DimensionValue, max(ID) as ID,RL.Date
				from RiskLimits RL
				Inner join (select distinct DimensionID, DimensionValue ,[date] from @RCFData
				) A on A.DimensionID = RL.DimensionId and A.DimensionValue = rl.DimensionValue and A.Date = rl.Date
			  group by rl.DimensionId, rl.DimensionValue ,rl.Date
			  ) B on RL.DimensionId= B.DimensionId and RL.DimensionValue= B.DimensionValue and RL.Date = B.Date

    COMMIT TRAN                          
    END TRY                          
    BEGIN CATCH                          
  Rollback tran                          
  DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);                            
    DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;                            
    DECLARE @ErrorState INT;                            
    SELECT @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),                            
           @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),                      
           @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();                            
    -- RAISERROR inside the CATCH block will return error information about the original error that caused execution to jump to the CATCH block.                            
    RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage, -- Message text.                            
               @ErrorSeverity, -- Severity.                            
               @ErrorState -- State.                            
               );                            
    END CATCH                          
END 


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.Negative_List

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Negative_List]  
 @esteeid varchar(50) = null,  
 @strategyid varchar(10) =null,  
 @substrategyid varchar(10) =null,  
 @tradingstatus int =0,  
 @banextent int =0,  
 @substrategyname varchar(50) =null,  
 @choice int =0  
AS  
BEGIN  
 -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from  
 -- interfering with SELECT statements.  
 SET NOCOUNT ON;  
   if(@choice =0)  
   SELECT Distinct Strategy_ID,SG.StrategyName as Strategy_Name from Strategy_new SN 
   Inner Join StrategyGroup SG on SN.Strategy_Id = SG.StrategyID ;  
   if(@choice=1)  
   SELECT Distinct SubStrategy_ID,SubStrategy_Name,Strategy_ID,SG.StrategyName as Strategy_Name from Strategy_new SN
   Inner Join StrategyGroup SG on SN.Strategy_Id = SG.StrategyID
   where Strategy_ID =@strategyid;  
   if(@choice=2)  
   /*SELECT TOP 50 * from LiquidStocks order by Volume desc, Open_Interest desc*/  
   select datafeed_Ticker as short_name,estee_id from esteemaster where  status=1 and Exchange_Code='IS' and  Security_Type in(0,4);  
   if(@choice=3)  
   SELECT ESTEE_ID,Strategy_ID from NegativeList where Estee_ID =@esteeid and strategy_id = @substrategyid;  
   if(@choice=4) /* from Modify Negative List */  
   UPDATE  A  SET Trading_Status =@tradingstatus , Ban_Extent =@banextent from NegativeList as  A inner join Strategy_new as B on  
   B.SubStrategy_ID = A.Strategy_ID where B.SubStrategy_Name =@substrategyname  and  Estee_ID =@esteeid  
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.Orders

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Orders]      
@choice int =0,      
@substrategyid varchar(10) = null,      
@esteeid varchar(50) = null,      
@OrderDoc xml=null      
AS      
BEGIN      
 -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from      
 -- interfering with SELECT statements.      
 SET NOCOUNT ON;      
 if(@choice=0)      
   SELECT Strategy_ID,SubStrategy_ID,SG.StrategyName as Strategy_Name,SubStrategy_Name from Strategy_New SN  
   INNER JOIN StrategyGroup SG on SN.Strategy_Id = SG.StrategyID  
   where SubStrategy_ID =@substrategyid;      
 if(@choice =1)    
  BEGIN      
   SELECT DISTINCT Broker_ID, Broker_Name from Broker where status = 'Active';      
   SELECT Strategy_ID,SubStrategy_ID,SG.StrategyName as Strategy_Name,SubStrategy_Name from Strategy_New SN  
   INNER JOIN StrategyGroup SG on SN.Strategy_Id = SG.StrategyID  
   where SubStrategy_ID =@substrategyid;      
  END      
 if(@choice =2)      
   Select Lot_Size from Esteemaster where  Exchange_Code='IS' and status=1 and Estee_ID =@esteeid;      
 if(@choice =3)      
  BEGIN      
   SELECT DISTINCT SubStrategy_ID,SubStrategy_Name,SG.StrategyName as Strategy_Name,Strategy_ID from Strategy_new SN  
   INNER JOIN StrategyGroup SG on SN.Strategy_Id= SG.StrategyID;      
   SELECT  distinct top 3 EXPIRY_DATE  FROM ESTEEMASTER WHERE  Exchange_Code='IS' and  status = 1 and expiry_date != '' order by expiry_Date asc;      
   
 /*SELECT TOP 50 * from LiquidStocks order by Volume desc, Open_Interest desc;*/      
     /*select datafeed_ticker as Short_Name,estee_id from esteemaster as A where estee_id in (select top 50 estee_id from Liquidstocks as B order by Volume desc, Open_Interest desc)and security_type in ('Common Stock','Index') order by Datafeed_ticker; */
  
  
    
      
     select Underlying_Ticker as Short_Name,estee_id from esteemaster where  status=1 and Exchange_Code='IS' and   Security_Type = 0      
      SELECT DISTINCT Broker_ID, Broker_Name from Broker where status = 'Active';      
      SELECT DISTINCT ISIN, EsteeUndTicker from ISINMaster where SecurityType = 4 and ExchangeCode='IS';      
     END      
    if(@choice =4)      
      exec sp_XMLOrder @OrderDoc      
      
END

```

```sql
)

and AsDate = @ExecutionDate
and StrategyType = @model
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.Parameters

```sql
CREATE Procedure [dbo].[Parameters]
@choice int =0,
@value decimal(20,4) =0,
@substrategy_id varchar(10) =null
AS
BEGIN

IF(@choice =1)
  Select * from Strategy_New
else if(@choice =2)
  Select  Value from DataInit where Parameter = 'Interest Rate'
else if(@choice =3)
  Update DataInit set Value =@value where Parameter = 'Interest Rate'
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.PopulateExchangeBannedSecurityList

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PopulateExchangeBannedSecurityList]
	@underlyingTickerList VARCHAR(MAX), --UnderLying Ticker CSV
	@exCode VARCHAR(2),
	@exSegments VARCHAR(100), --ExchangeSegments CSV
	@userID INT

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @tblUnderlying TABLE (s VARCHAR(100))
	INSERT INTO @tblUnderlying   
	SELECT * FROM Split(@underlyingTickerList,',')  

	DECLARE @tblSegments TABLE (s VARCHAR(2))
	INSERT INTO @tblSegments   
	SELECT * FROM Split(@exSegments,',') 

	DELETE FROM BanGroupSecurityList WHERE BanGroupID = 1 --TODO : Verify BanGroupID #HardCoding

	;WITH A AS
	(
		SELECT DISTINCT Estee_ID FROM esteemaster WHERE ISIN IN 
			(SELECT ISIN FROM esteemaster WHERE Underlying_Ticker IN (SELECT * FROM @tblUnderlying))
		AND Exchange_Code = @exCode 
		AND Status = 1 
		AND Security_Type IN (SELECT SecurityType FROM ValidCombos WHERE Segment in (select * from @tblSegments) and ExchangeCode = @exCode)
	)
	INSERT INTO BanGroupSecurityList (BanGroupID,EsteeID,BanPermissionID,CreationTime,ModificationTime,CreatedBy,ModifiedBy)
	 SELECT 1,A.estee_ID,4,GETDATE(),GETDATE(),@userID,@userID FROM A
	 
	--TODO : Verify BanGroupID, PermissionID #HardCoding

END

```

## View definition: dbo.POSITIONS

```sql
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[POSITIONS]
AS
SELECT   E.Exchange_Code,  MIN(E.Underlying_Ticker) AS Underlying_Ticker, Tra.Estee_ID, MIN(E.DataFeed_Ticker) AS SecurityName, MIN(Ord.Sub_Strategy_ID) 
                      AS Sub_StrategyID, SUM(CASE buy_sell_indicator WHEN 1 THEN Tra.Traded_Quantity ELSE 0 END) AS Long, 
                      SUM(CASE buy_sell_indicator WHEN 2 THEN Tra.Traded_Quantity ELSE 0 END) AS Short, 
                      SUM(CASE buy_sell_indicator WHEN 1 THEN Tra.Traded_Quantity ELSE - Tra.Traded_Quantity END) AS Net, AVG(Tra.Traded_Price) AS ATP, 
                      CASE SUM(Tra.Traded_Quantity) 
                      WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE buy_sell_indicator WHEN 1 THEN Tra.Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price ELSE - Tra.Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price END)
                       / SUM(CASE Tra.buy_sell_indicator WHEN 1 THEN Tra.Traded_Quantity ELSE - Tra.Traded_Quantity END) END AS Traded_Price, 
                      0 AS Total_Money_Deployed, SUM(Tra.Transaction_Cost) AS Total_TC, MIN(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), OrdTra.Creation_Time, 112)) AS Date, 
                      MIN(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), OrdTra.Creation_Time, 113)) AS Trade_Date, Tra.Trade_ID AS TradeID, MIN(OrdTra.OrderTrade_ID) AS OrderTrade_ID, 
                      MIN(OrdTra.Order_ID) AS Order_ID, B.Broker_ID, MIN(B.Broker_Name) AS BrokerName, MIN(A.Account_Type) AS AccountType, A.Account_ID, 
                      MIN(CASE buy_sell_indicator WHEN 2 THEN 'SHORT' ELSE 'LONG' END) AS Side, MIN(E.ISIN) AS ISIN
FROM dbo.[Order] AS Ord WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN
dbo.OrderTrades AS OrdTra WITH (NOLOCK) ON Ord.Order_ID = OrdTra.Order_ID and Ord.Creation_Date = OrdTra.Creation_Date 
INNER JOIN
dbo.Trades AS Tra WITH (NOLOCK) ON OrdTra.OrderTrade_ID = Tra.OrderTrade_ID and OrdTra.Order_ID = Tra.Order_ID and OrdTra.Creation_Date = Tra.Creation_Date 
INNER JOIN
dbo.Broker AS B WITH (NOLOCK) ON Ord.Broker_ID = B.Broker_ID 
INNER JOIN
dbo.Account AS A ON ISNULL(Ord.Account_ID, 1) = A.Account_ID 
INNER JOIN
dbo.esteemaster AS E ON E.Estee_ID = Tra.Estee_ID
WHERE     (OrdTra.Status IN ('Executed', 'Partially Filled')) and E.Status=1
GROUP BY E.Exchange_Code, B.Broker_ID, Tra.Estee_ID, Tra.Trade_ID, A.Account_ID

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.Prepare_DataCheck

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Prepare_DataCheck]
	@Symbol varchar(50),
	@DateTime datetime
AS
		IF EXISTS (
		  SELECT *
			FROM sys.tables
			JOIN sys.schemas
			  ON sys.tables.schema_id = sys.schemas.schema_id
		   WHERE sys.schemas.name = N'dbo'
			 AND sys.tables.name = N'#temp_lastTrade'
		)
		begin
			drop table #temp_lastTrade
		end
		else 
		begin 
			Create table #temp_lastTrade(RowNumber1 int, RowNumber2 int, Estee_ID varchar(50), TTS datetime, LTP decimal(18,2), LTQ decimal(18,2), Time_Stamp datetime, [Latency] decimal(18,2), [Jump] decimal(18,2))
		end 
		exec('INSERT INTO #temp_lastTrade Select 	ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Estee_ID, TickTime_Stamp ASC ) AS RowNumber1,
				ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY  Estee_ID, Min(Time_Stamp) ASC) AS RowNumber2, Estee_ID, TickTime_Stamp TTS, Min(Field_Value) LTP, Min(Volume) LTQ , Min(Time_Stamp), datediff(ss, Min(Time_Stamp), TickTime_Stamp) as Latency, 0'+
		'/*(select TOP 1 Min(RD.Field_Value) from religare_market_data.dbo.'+@Symbol+'  RD 
			where RD.Estee_ID = OD.Estee_ID  and RD.Field_Name = ''Last_Trade''  and RD.TickTime_Stamp < OD.TickTime_Stamp
			and Year(RD.TickTime_Stamp) =  Year('''+@datetime+''') and Month(RD.TickTime_Stamp) = Month('''+@datetime+''') and Day(RD.TickTime_Stamp) =  Day('''+@datetime+''') 
			group by RD.TickTime_Stamp Order by RD.TickTime_Stamp DESC) PrevLTP */'+
		' FROM religare_market_data.dbo.'+@Symbol+' OD Where Field_Name = ''Last_Trade'' and Year(TickTime_Stamp) =  Year('''+@DateTime+''') and Month(TickTime_Stamp) =  Month('''+@DateTime+''') and Day(TickTime_Stamp) =  Day('''+@DateTime+''') 
		and Year(Time_Stamp) =  Year('''+@DateTime+''') and Month(Time_Stamp) =  Month('''+@DateTime+''') and Day(Time_Stamp) =  Day('''+@DateTime+''')
		group by Estee_ID, TickTime_Stamp') 
	
		--Select * from #temp_lastTrade
			IF EXISTS (
		  SELECT *
			FROM sys.tables
			JOIN sys.schemas
			  ON sys.tables.schema_id = sys.schemas.schema_id
		   WHERE sys.schemas.name = N'dbo'
			 AND sys.tables.name = N'#temp_vwap'
		)
		begin
			drop table #temp_vwap
		end
		else 
		begin 
			Create table #temp_vwap(Estee_ID varchar(50), TTS datetime,  VWAP decimal)
		end 

		exec('INSERT INTO #temp_vwap Select Estee_ID, TickTime_Stamp TTS, Min(Field_Value) VWAP'+
		' FROM religare_market_data.dbo.'+@Symbol+' Where Field_Name = ''VWAP'' and Year(TickTime_Stamp) =  Year('''+@DateTime+''') and Month(TickTime_Stamp) =  Month('''+@DateTime+''') and Day(TickTime_Stamp) =  Day('''+@DateTime+''') group by Estee_ID, TickTime_Stamp') 
	


		Insert Into #Temp_Data(EsteeID, [Open], [Low], [High], [Last], [Close], [TTQ], [TTV], [Latency], [Jump])
		Select 
			X.Estee_ID,
			(Select top 1 LTP from #temp_lastTrade T where T.Estee_ID = X.Estee_ID Order by TTS ASC) [Open], 
			Min(LTP) [Low], 
			Max(LTP) [High],
			(Select top 1 LTP from #temp_lastTrade T where T.Estee_ID = X.Estee_ID Order by TTS DESC) [Last],
			(Select Top 1 VWAP From #temp_vwap V Where V.Estee_ID = X.Estee_ID Order by TTS DESC) [Close],
			sum(LTQ) [TTQ],
			sum(LTQ*LTP) [TTV], 
			Avg(Latency) as Latency , 
			min(Jump)
		From 
			#temp_lastTrade X 
		Where 
			RowNumber1 <= RowNumber2
		Group by 
			X.Estee_ID --order by X.TickTime_Stamp ASC

	--Select * from #Temp_Data

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.Process_SubscriptionDataLog

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Process_SubscriptionDataLog]
	@logFilePath varchar(200), --'\\estee_advisors\backup\Data\Estee.SubscriptionApp.Data.Log.txt'
	@EsteeID varchar(50) = null,
	@DateTime datetime = null, 
	@Result int OUT
AS
	Truncate table QAReportData

	EXEC('BULK INSERT QAReportData FROM ''' + @logFilePath + ''' WITH ( FIELDTERMINATOR =''@'', ROWTERMINATOR =''\n'')')
	--drop table #tmp
	SELECT 
		EsteeID, 
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY EsteeID, convert(datetime, LTT, 103) ASC ) AS RowNumber1,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY  EsteeID, Min(SystemTime) ASC) AS RowNumber2,
		convert(datetime, LTT, 103) TTS, 
		Min(SystemTime) STS, 
		DateDiff(ss, convert(datetime, LTT, 103), convert(datetime, Min(SystemTime), 103)) as Latency,
		DateDiff(ms, convert(datetime, Min(ProcessedTime), 103), convert(datetime, Min(SystemTime), 103)) as ProcessingTime,
		Case LTQ
			WHEN -1 then 0 
			Else LTQ
		End LTQ, 
		Case LTP
			WHEN -1 then 0 
			Else LTP
		End LTP, 
		Min(VWAP) as VWAP
	INTO
		#tmp
	FROM 
		QAReportData 
	WHERE 
		COALESCE(LTQ,0)<> 0 and COALESCE(LTP,0) <> 0 and Year(convert(datetime, LTT, 103)) = Year(@DateTime) and Month(convert(datetime, LTT, 103)) = Month(@DateTime) and Day(convert(datetime, LTT, 103)) = Day(@DateTime) and [TickType]='NSE'

	group by EsteeID, convert(datetime, LTT, 103), LTQ, LTP


	SELECT TOP 1 EsteeID, Min(Latency) Latency INTO #Temp_Latency FROM #tmp T Group by EsteeID Order by Min(TTS) ASC

	declare @_ClockDiff int
	Select 
	@_ClockDiff = Min(Latency)+1
	From #Temp_Latency

	IF EXISTS (
	  SELECT *
		FROM sys.tables
		JOIN sys.schemas
		  ON sys.tables.schema_id = sys.schemas.schema_id
	   WHERE sys.schemas.name = N'dbo'
		 AND sys.tables.name = N'TickData_Analytics'
	)
	BEGIN
		drop table TickData_Analytics
	END
	Select
			EsteeID, 
			Min(DataFeed_Ticker) [Security],
			(SELECT TOP 1 LTP FROM #tmp T WHERE T.EsteeID = X.EsteeID Order by TTS ASC) [Open], 
			Min(LTP) Low, 
			Max(LTP) High, 
			(SELECT TOP 1 LTP FROM #tmp T WHERE T.EsteeID = X.EsteeID Order by TTS DESC) [Last],
			(SELECT TOP 1 VWAP FROM #tmp T WHERE T.EsteeID = X.EsteeID and TTS <='3:30 PM' Order by TTS DESC) [Close], 
			sum(LTQ) TTQ, 
			sum(LTP*LTQ) TTV, 
			Count(Case LTQ WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE 1 END) Trades,
			MIN(CP.Open_Price) as [NSE_Open],
			MIN(CP.Low_Price) as [NSE_Low],
			MIN(CP.High_Price) as [NSE_High],
			MIN(CP.Close_Price) as [NSE_Close],
			MIN(CP.VOLUME) as [NSE_TTQ],
			MIN(CP.NET_TRADED_VAL) as [NSE_TTV],
			Min(CP.Trades) [NSE_Trades],
			(Case WHEN (Avg(Latency)-@_ClockDiff)< 0 THEN 1 ELSE (Avg(Latency)-@_ClockDiff) END) Latency, 
			(SELECT TOP 1 Latency FROM #tmp T WHERE T.EsteeID = X.EsteeID Order by TTS ASC) [FTL],
			Avg(ProcessingTime) ProcessingTime
	INTO 
		TickData_Analytics
	From 
	(
		SELECT * FROM #tmp
	) X 
	INNER JOIN ESTEEMASTER EM ON EM.Estee_ID = X.EsteeID
	 RIGHT OUTER JOIN ClosingPrice CP ON X.EsteeID = CP.Estee_ID 
	WHERE EM.Status=1 and EM.Exchange_Code='IS'and EsteeID =  COALESCE(@EsteeID, EsteeID) AND X.RowNumber1 <= X.RowNumber2 and Year(CP.date) = Year(@DateTime) and Month(CP.date) = Month(@DateTime) and Day(CP.date) = Day(@DateTime)
	
	Group by X.EsteeID Order by X.EsteeID

	SELECT @Result = count(*) FROM TickData_Analytics

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.ProcessExchangePositions

```sql
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Apoorva Mishra
-- Create date: 14 Feb 2013
-- Description:	Multiply lot size to position values
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE ProcessExchangePositions 
	@exchangeCode char(2),
	@rawPositionData ExchangePositionFile readonly
AS
BEGIN
	select 
		PositionDate as [Position Date],
		ClientAccountCode as [Client Account / Code],
		SecurityTypeName [Option Type],
		Symbol,
		ExpiryDate as [Expiry Date],
		StrikePrice [Strike Price],
		RPD.Long * EM.Lot_Size as [Post Ex / Asgmnt Long Quantity],
		RPD.Short * EM.Lot_Size as [Post Ex / Asgmnt Short Quantity],
		SettlementPrice [Settlement Price],
		Estee,
		(RPD.Long * EM.Lot_Size - RPD.Short * EM.Lot_Size) as Net
	from @rawPositionData RPD
	inner join esteemaster EM
	on 
		RPD.Symbol = EM.Underlying_Ticker
		and	Convert(date, RPD.ExpiryDate) = CONVERT(date, EM.Expiry_date)
		and RPD.StrikePrice = EM.Strike_Price
		and EM.Exchange_Code = @exchangeCode
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.QA_EOD_DataCheck

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[QA_EOD_DataCheck]
	@EsteeID varchar(50)=null,
	@DateTime datetime, 
	@Result int out
AS

Begin

		IF EXISTS (
		  SELECT *
			FROM sys.tables
			JOIN sys.schemas
			  ON sys.tables.schema_id = sys.schemas.schema_id
		   WHERE sys.schemas.name = N'dbo'
			 AND sys.tables.name = N'#temp'
		)
		begin
			drop table #temp
		end

	select underlying_ticker into #temp
	from estee.dbo.Subscription_RealTime  R inner join estee.dbo.esteemaster M on R.esteeid = M.Estee_ID 
	Where  M.Status=1 and M.Exchange_Code='IS' and  R.esteeid = COALESCE(@EsteeID, EsteeID)
	group by underlying_ticker
	   
	update #temp set underlying_ticker = 'BANK_NIFTY' where underlying_ticker = 'BANK NIFTY'
	update #temp set underlying_ticker = 'MnM' where underlying_ticker = 'M&M'
	update #temp set underlying_ticker = 'SnP_CNX_NIFTY' where underlying_ticker = 'S&P CNX NIFTY'

		IF NOT EXISTS (
		  SELECT *
			FROM sys.tables
			JOIN sys.schemas
			  ON sys.tables.schema_id = sys.schemas.schema_id
		   WHERE sys.schemas.name = N'dbo'
			 AND sys.tables.name = N'#Temp_Data'
		)
		begin
			Create table #Temp_Data(EsteeID varchar(50), [Open] decimal(18,2), [Low] decimal(18,2), [High] decimal(18,2), [Last] decimal(18,2), [Close] decimal(18,2), [TTQ] int, [TTV] decimal(18,2), [Latency] decimal(18,2), [Jump] decimal(18,2))
		end
		else 
		begin 
			drop table #Temp_Data
		end

--print 'All Underlying Tickers Subscribed'
--SELECT * FROM #temp 
	declare @Subscription varchar(50)
	DECLARE Subscription_cursor CURSOR FOR 
    select underlying_ticker 
	from #temp
	OPEN Subscription_cursor
    FETCH NEXT FROM Subscription_cursor INTO @Subscription

    IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0 
        PRINT '         <<None>>'   

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
		Print @Subscription
        exec('exec Prepare_DataCheck @Symbol = ''' + @Subscription + ''', @DateTime = '''+ @DateTime +'''' )

        FETCH NEXT FROM Subscription_cursor INTO @Subscription
        END

    CLOSE Subscription_cursor
    DEALLOCATE Subscription_cursor

	IF EXISTS (
	  SELECT *
		FROM sys.tables
		JOIN sys.schemas
		  ON sys.tables.schema_id = sys.schemas.schema_id
	   WHERE sys.schemas.name = N'dbo'
		 AND sys.tables.name = N'TickData_Analytics'
	)
	begin
		drop table TickData_Analytics
	end
--select * from #Temp_Data
		SELECT 
		OD.EsteeID,
		OD.[Open], 
		OD.[Low], 
		OD.[High],
		OD.[Last], 
		OD.[Close],
		OD.[TTQ],
		OD.[TTV],
		CP.Open_Price as [NSE_Open],
		CP.Low_Price as [NSE_Low],
		CP.High_Price as [NSE_High],
		CP.Close_Price as [NSE_Close],
		CP.VOLUME as [NSE_TTQ],
		CP.NET_TRADED_VAL as [NSE_TTV],
		OD.[Latency],
		(Case 
			When CP.VOLUME<> OD.[TTQ] THEN 1 
			ELSE 0
		End) MissingTicks,
		OD.[Jump],
		EM.DataFeed_Ticker
	INTO 
		TickData_Analytics
	FROM 
		ClosingPrice CP RIGHT OUTER JOIN #Temp_Data OD ON OD.EsteeID = CP.Estee_ID 
		INNER JOIN ESTEEMASTER EM ON EM.Estee_Id = OD.EsteeID
	WHERE 
		 EM.Status=1 and EM.Exchange_Code='IS' and  EsteeID =  COALESCE(@EsteeID, EsteeID) and Year(CP.date) = Year(@DateTime) and Month(CP.date) = Month(@DateTime) and Day(CP.date) = Day(@DateTime)

	SELECT @Result = count(*) FROM TickData_Analytics

End

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.real_time_data

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[real_time_data] 
    @DataFeed_Ticker varchar (50),
    @Estee_ID varchar(50), 
	@Field_Name varchar (15),
	@Field_Value varchar(20),
	@Volume varchar (20),
	@Time_Stamp varchar (50),
	@TickTime_Stamp varchar (50),
	@Status varchar(50) out
AS
BEGIN
declare @sql varchar (1000), @tablename varchar(20)
set @tablename = @DataFeed_Ticker

-- Create table
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SYSOBJECTS WHERE NAME = @tablename)
BEGIN

EXEC(
'CREATE TABLE [' + @tablename + ']
	(	Estee_ID varchar(50), 
		Field_Name varchar(15),
		Field_Value decimal(15,2),
		Volume decimal(10,0),
		Time_Stamp datetime,
		TickTime_Stamp datetime)')
print('Table created for ' + @tablename)
END

set @sql = 'INSERT INTO '  + @tablename + 
'( Estee_ID, Field_Name, Field_Value, Volume, Time_Stamp, TickTime_Stamp) VALUES' 
 + '(''' + @Estee_ID + ''',''' + @Field_Name + ''','+ @Field_Value + ','+ @Volume + ',' +
 'convert(datetime,'''+@Time_Stamp+''',101)' + ',' + 
 'convert(datetime,'''+@TickTime_Stamp+''',103)' + 
')'

--print (@sql)
exec(@sql)

set @Status = 'Tick sent to ' + @tablename
END

```
