## Stored procedure: dbo.ReportEsteeIDErrorsForDateNExchange

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ReportEsteeIDErrorsForDateNExchange]  
@Date date,  
@Exchange_Code char(2)  
as  
BEGIN  
 select estee_id from EsteeMaster where exchange_code=@Exchange_Code group by Estee_ID having COUNT(estee_id)>1  
  
 select CP.Estee_ID from closingprice CP  
 left join EsteeMaster EM  
 on CP.Estee_ID=EM.Estee_ID  
 left join EsteeMaster_archive EMA  
 on CP.Estee_ID = EMA.Estee_ID  
 where EM.Estee_ID is null and SUBSTRING(CP.Estee_ID,13,2)=@Exchange_Code and CP.Date=@Date and EMA.Expiry_Date<=@Date  
  
 select SR.EsteeID,SR.Strategy_Name from subscription_realtime SR  
 left join EsteeMaster EM  
 on SR.EsteeID=EM.Estee_ID  
 left join EsteeMaster_archive EMA  
 on SR.EsteeID = EMA.Estee_ID  
 where SUBSTRING(SR.EsteeID,13,2)=@Exchange_Code and EM.Estee_ID is null and EMA.Expiry_Date<=@Date  
  
 select SL.Estee_Id,
 case 
	when EM.Underlying_Ticker IS not null then EM.Underlying_Ticker
	else EMA.Underlying_Ticker
end,
 SL.SubStrategyID 
 from subscriptionlist SL  
 left join EsteeMaster EM  
 on SL.Estee_ID=EM.Estee_ID  
 left join EsteeMaster_archive EMA  
 on SL.Estee_ID = EMA.Estee_ID  
 where SUBSTRING(SL.Estee_ID,13,2)=@Exchange_Code and EM.Estee_ID is null and EMA.Expiry_Date<=@Date  
   
PRINT 'DONE CREATING ReportEsteeIDErrorsForDateNExchange'  
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.ResetNeatLimitsToDefault

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Megha Goel
-- Create date: 5 Sep 2013
-- Description:	Update Neat Limits to default values
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ResetNeatLimitsToDefault] 	
@ExchangeCode varchar(4)
AS
BEGIN		 
    Declare @SeqNo int  
	Select @SeqNo=Max(SeqNo) From NeatLimit   
	Update NL
	set NL.FutureBuy = DNL.FutureBuy,
	NL.FutureSell= DNL.FutureSell,
	NL.OptionBuy = DNL.OptionBuy,
	NL.OptionSell = DNL.OptionSell,
	NL.CDFutureBuy = DNL.CDFutureBuy,
	NL.CDFutureSell = DNL.CDFutureSell,
	NL.CDOptionBuy = DNL.CDOptionBuy,
	NL.CDOptionSell = DNL.CDOptionSell,
	NL.CashBuy = DNL.CashBuy,
	NL.CashSell = DNL.CashSell,
	NL.UpdateDateTime = CONVERT(varchar(19),GetDate(),120)
	From NeatLimit NL
	Inner Join DefaultNeatLimit DNL on NL.Trader = DNL.Trader 
	where NL.SeqNo = @SeqNo and (NL.Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode or  Coalesce(@ExchangeCode,'') ='')

	Declare @missingTradersInDefaultLimits varchar(2000)
	Select @missingTradersInDefaultLimits = (COALESCE(@missingTradersInDefaultLimits + ', ', '') + NLS.Trader)
	 from 
	 (select Trader from NeatLimit NL where NL.SeqNo=@SeqNo and (NL.Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode or  Coalesce(@ExchangeCode,'') =''))
	  as NLS
	Left outer Join DefaultNeatLimit DNL on DNL.Trader= NLS.Trader
	where DNL.Trader is null
	
	 Select 'Default limits are missing in database for Traders: '+ @missingTradersInDefaultLimits + 
	 '.Rest of the traders limits have been reset.'	 
		
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.SaveBorrowTransactions

```sql

-----------------------------------------------------SP-----------------------------------------------------------
  
CREATE PROCEDURE SaveBorrowTransactions  
-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here  
@date DATE, @exchgCode VARCHAR(10), @updateTime DATETIME, @updatedBy INT, @borrowTransactions BorrowTransactionType READONLY  
AS  
     BEGIN  
         -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from  
         -- interfering with SELECT statements.  
         SET NOCOUNT ON;  
  
         -- Insert statements for procedure here  
         BEGIN TRY  
     BEGIN Transaction  
         Delete from StockBorrowPositions where PositionDate>=@date  
  
             INSERT INTO StockBorrowTransactions(Date, ID, ExchangeCode, AccountId, SubstrategyId, SecurityName, EsteeId, TransactionType, InterestRate, BorrowDate, MaturityDate, SettlementType, Quantity,  UpdatedBy, UpdateTime)  
                    SELECT @date, bt.Id, @exchgCode, bt.AccountId, bt.SubstrategyId, bt.SecurityName, bt.EsteeId, bt.TransactionType, bt.InterestRate, bt.BorrowDate, bt.MaturityDate, bt.SettlementType, bt.Quantity, @updatedBy, @updateTime  
                      FROM @borrowTransactions bt;  
    Commit Transaction  
         END TRY  
         BEGIN CATCH  
             DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT;  
             SELECT @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();  
  
     IF(XACT_STATE()) <> 0  
             BEGIN  
                 PRINT 'Rolling back transaction.';  
                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;  
             END;  
  
             RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, @ErrorSeverity, @ErrorState);  
         END CATCH;  
     END;  


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.SaveDailyBorrowPositions

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SaveDailyBorrowPositions] @prevWorkingDate DATE= NULL, @currentDate DATE= NULL, @excode CHAR(2)
AS
     BEGIN

         BEGIN TRY
             BEGIN TRANSACTION;

             --Delete Positions for current date if already saved earlier.
             DELETE StockBorrowPositions
              WHERE DATEDIFF(dd, PositionDate, @currentDate) <= 0
                    AND ExchangeCode = @excode;

             --Insert the positions for the previous working date in the BorrowedStockPositions table from BorrowedStockPositions table.    
             INSERT INTO StockBorrowPositions(PositionDate, ExchangeCode, AccountId, SubstrategyId, SecurityName, EsteeId, InterestRate, BorrowDate, MaturityDate, Long, Short, Net)
                    SELECT @currentDate, ExchangeCode, AccountId, SubstrategyId, SecurityName, EsteeId, InterestRate, BorrowDate, MaturityDate, 0, 0, Net
                      FROM StockBorrowPositions
                     WHERE DATEDIFF(dd, PositionDate, @prevWorkingDate) = 0
                           AND ExchangeCode = @excode
                           AND net <> 0;

             DECLARE @mindate DATE= '1900-01-01';
             DECLARE @tempDailyPos TABLE(PositionDate DATE, ExchangeCode VARCHAR(10), AccountId INT, SubstrategyId INT, SecurityName VARCHAR(255), EsteeId VARCHAR(25), InterestRate DECIMAL(20, 4), BorrowDate DATE, MaturityDate DATE, Long INT, Short INT, Net INT);

             INSERT INTO @tempDailyPos
                    SELECT @currentDate, slt.ExchangeCode, slt.AccountId, slt.SubStrategyId, slt.SecurityName, slt.EsteeId, slt.InterestRate, slt.BorrowDate, slt.MaturityDate, SUM(CASE WHEN slt.TransactionType = 1 THEN slt.Quantity ELSE 0 END) AS Long, SUM(CASE WHEN slt.TransactionType = 2 THEN slt.Quantity ELSE 0 END) AS Short, SUM(CASE WHEN slt.TransactionType = 1 THEN slt.Quantity ELSE-1 * slt.Quantity END) AS Net
                      FROM StockBorrowTransactions slt
                     WHERE DATEDIFF(dd, slt.date, @currentDate) = 0
                           AND slt.ExchangeCode = @excode
                     GROUP BY slt.ExchangeCode, slt.AccountId, slt.SubStrategyId, slt.SecurityName, slt.EsteeId, slt.InterestRate, slt.BorrowDate, slt.MaturityDate;

             -- Update Previous Date positions with current date positions
             UPDATE slp
                SET
                    slp.Long = tdp.Long,
                    slp.Short = tdp.Short,
                    slp.Net = slp.Net + tdp.Net
               FROM StockBorrowPositions slp
               INNER JOIN @tempDailyPos tdp ON tdp.EsteeId = slp.EsteeId
                                               AND tdp.AccountId = slp.AccountId
                                               AND tdp.SubstrategyId = slp.SubstrategyId
                                               AND tdp.InterestRate = slp.InterestRate
                                               AND tdp.MaturityDate = slp.MaturityDate
                                               AND tdp.BorrowDate = slp.BorrowDate
              WHERE DATEDIFF(dd, slp.PositionDate, @currentDate) = 0;

             -- Insert positions in new securities

             INSERT INTO StockBorrowPositions(PositionDate, ExchangeCode, AccountId, SubstrategyId, SecurityName, EsteeId, InterestRate, BorrowDate, MaturityDate, Long, Short, Net)
                    SELECT tdp.PositionDate, tdp.ExchangeCode, tdp.AccountId, tdp.SubstrategyId, tdp.SecurityName, tdp.EsteeId, tdp.InterestRate, tdp.BorrowDate, tdp.MaturityDate, tdp.Long, tdp.Short, tdp.Net
                      FROM @tempDailyPos tdp
                      LEFT JOIN StockBorrowPositions slp ON tdp.EsteeId = slp.EsteeId
                                                            AND tdp.AccountId = slp.AccountId
                                                            AND tdp.BorrowDate = slp.BorrowDate
                                                            AND tdp.SubstrategyId = slp.SubstrategyId
                                                            AND tdp.InterestRate = slp.InterestRate
                                                            AND tdp.MaturityDate = slp.MaturityDate
                     WHERE slp.EsteeId IS NULL;           

             COMMIT TRANSACTION;
         END TRY
         BEGIN CATCH
             DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT;
             SELECT @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();

             IF(XACT_STATE()) <> 0
             BEGIN
                 PRINT 'Rolling back transaction.';
                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
             END;

             RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, @ErrorSeverity, @ErrorState);
         END CATCH;
     END;
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.SaveDailyLinkedOrders

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SaveDailyLinkedOrders]                      
@prevWorkingDate datetime = null,      
@currentDate datetime = null      
AS                      
BEGIN                      
    
 DELETE DailyLinkedOrders Where Datediff(dd, LinkedOrderDate, @currentDate) = 0        
 --Insert the Linked orders for the given date.        
 INSERT INTO DailyLinkedOrders(DataFeedTicker, TotalLockedProfit, TotalRealizedProfit, NetProfit, TransactionCost,   
        Account_ID, Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, LinkID, Status, LinkedOrderDate)         
       
    SELECT   
 MIN(E.DataFeed_Ticker) AS DataFeed_Ticker,  
 ISNULL(Sum(link.LockedProfit) / count(LinkID), 0) AS Total_Locked_Profit,   
 ISNULL(SUM(link.RealizedProfit) / count(LinkID), 0) AS Total_Realised_Profit,   
 ISNULL(SUM(link.LockedProfit + link.RealizedProfit - link.TransactionCost) / count(LinkID), 0) AS NetProfit,   
 ISNULL(SUM(link.TransactionCost) / count(LinkID), 0) AS Total_TC,   
 Account_ID,   
 MIN((case    
  When SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 15, 2) in ('05', '06','07') then SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 0, 15) + '04'   
  When SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 15, 2) in ('01', '02','03')  then SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 0, 15) + '00'  
  Else SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 0, 15)
  End))   
  AS Estee_ID,   
 MIN(OrdTra.Sub_Strategy_ID) AS SubStrategy_ID,   
 Broker_ID,  
 Ord.Link_ID,  
 ISNULL(link.PositionStatus, 'Closed')  As Position_Status,   
 min(OrdTra.Creation_Time) AS TradeDate   
 FROM   
 tblLinkOrders link 
 INNER JOIN [Order] Ord ON link.LinkID = Ord.Link_ID   
 INNER JOIN OrderTrades OrdTra ON Ord.Order_ID = OrdTra.Order_ID and Ord.Creation_Date = OrdTra.Creation_Date
 INNER JOIN Trades Tra ON OrdTra.OrderTrade_ID = Tra.OrderTrade_ID and OrdTra.Order_ID = Tra.Order_ID and OrdTra.Creation_Date = Tra.Creation_Date   
 INNER JOIN esteemaster E ON SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 1, 12) = SUBSTRING(E.Estee_ID,0,13)
 WHERE E.Status=1 and E.Exchange_Code='IS' and datediff(dd, OrdTra.Creation_Date, @currentDate) = 0  
 AND OrdTra.status  IN ('Executed', 'Partially Filled')  
 GROUP BY Ord.Broker_ID, Ord.Link_ID, SUBSTRING(Tra.Estee_ID, 0, 15), Account_ID, link.PositionStatus  
    
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.SaveDailyPositions

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SaveDailyPositions]                                               
@prevWorkingDate date = null,                              
@currentDate date = null,                    
@excode char(2)                    
AS                                              
BEGIN            
 exec spAdjustOddLotIntoRoundLot @currentDate, @excode          
 IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 BEGIN                 
  Print 'already an open transaction in this session'                
  RETURN -1                
 END                
 BEGIN TRANSACTION                    
 declare @rowsCount int                                
 declare @error varchar(1000)                    
 set @rowsCount = (Select count(*) from DailyPositions WHERE PositionDate = @prevWorkingDate)            
 DELETE DailyPositions Where PositionDate = @currentDate  AND Exchange_Code = @excode                    
 IF @@ERROR <> 0 BEGIN                    
  SET @error = @@ERROR                    
  Print 'Error while deleting daily position'                    
  GOTO ERROR_HANDLER                    
 END                    
 if(@rowsCount <= 0) BEGIN                                
  --Insert the positions for the given date.                                
  INSERT INTO DailyPositions(SecurityName, Long, Short, InClearingFTD, TransactionCost, Account_ID, SecurityType,             
    Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, PositionDate, AverageTradedPrice, BuyValue, SellValue,Exchange_Code,Rule_ID)                                 
  Select SecurityName,                           
   sum(Long) AS Long,                           
   sum(Short) AS Short,              
   SUM(LongInClear) - SUM(ShortInCLear) AS InClearingFTD,                             
   SUM(Total_TC) AS TransactionCost,                           
   Account_ID,                          
   MIN(ST.TypeName) AS SecurityType,                               
   X.Estee_ID,                          
   X.Sub_StrategyID,                           
   X.BROKER_ID,                           
   @currentDate AS PositionDate,                               
   case (sum(Long) - sum(Short))                           
   when 0 then 0                          
   else (sum(Long*Traded_Price) + sum(Short*Traded_Price))/(sum(Long) + sum(Short))                           
   END AS AverageTradedPrice,                              
   sum(Long*Traded_Price) AS BuyValue,                               
   sum(Short*Traded_Price) AS SellValue,                    
   X.Exchange_Code AS Exchange_Code   ,    
   X.Rule_ID                          
  FROM (                               
   SELECT                              
   ISNULL(E.Underlying_Ticker, EA.Underlying_Ticker) as Underlying_Ticker,                              
   Tra.Estee_ID AS Estee_ID,                              
   ISNULL(E.DataFeed_Ticker, EA.DataFeed_Ticker) AS SecurityName,                              
   Ord.Sub_Strategy_ID  as Sub_StrategyID,                              
   case buy_sell_indicator when 1 then Tra.Traded_Quantity else 0 end Long,                               
   case buy_sell_indicator when 2 then Tra.Traded_Quantity else 0 end Short,                              
   case buy_sell_indicator when 1 then             
   case order_source_ID when 'OdinDirectTransfer' then 0 when 'ECM' then  0          
   else Tra.Traded_Quantity end        
   else 0 end LongInClear,            
   case buy_sell_indicator when 2 then             
   case order_source_ID when 'OdinDirectTransfer' then 0 when 'ECM' then   0      
   else Tra.Traded_Quantity end            
   else 0 end ShortInClear,            
   CASE When @excode = 'BR' AND  CONVERT(int,substring(ISNULL(E.Estee_ID, EA.Estee_ID), 15, 2)) in (35,36) THEN        
   Power(10,5)/Power(1 + (Tra.Traded_Price)*1.0/100, CAST(dbo.GetTradingHolidaysUsingBankingTable(@currentDate, cast(isnull(E.Expiry_Date,EA.Expiry_Date) as date),@excode,'CD','T') as FLOAT)/252)       
   ELSE Tra.Traded_Price end As Traded_Price ,                              
0 AS Total_Money_Deployed,                               
   Tra.Transaction_Cost AS Total_TC,                               
   Convert(VARCHAR(20), OrdTra.creation_time, 112) as Date,                              
   Convert(VARCHAR(20), OrdTra.creation_time, 113) As Trade_Date,                        
   Tra.trade_ID AS TradeID,                              
   B.BROKER_ID AS BROKER_ID,                              
   B.Broker_Name AS BrokerName,                               
   A.Account_ID AS Account_ID,                              
   case buy_sell_indicator when 2 then 'SHORT' else 'LONG' end AS Side,             
   ISNULL(E.ISIN, EA.ISIN) AS ISIN,                    
   ISNULL(E.Exchange_Code, EA.Exchange_Code)  AS Exchange_Code   ,    
   isnull(Ord.Link_ID , -1) as Rule_ID                         
   FROM [Order] Ord WITH (NOLOCK)                  
   INNER JOIN OrderTrades OrdTra WITH (NOLOCK) ON Ord.Order_ID = OrdTra.Order_ID and Ord.Creation_Date = OrdTra.Creation_Date                           
   INNER JOIN Trades Tra WITH (NOLOCK) ON OrdTra.OrderTrade_ID = Tra.OrderTrade_ID and OrdTra.Order_ID = Tra.Order_ID and OrdTra.Creation_Date = Tra.Creation_Date                
   INNER JOIN Broker B WITH (NOLOCK) ON Ord.Broker_ID = B.Broker_ID                               
   INNER JOIN ACCOUNT A WITH (NOLOCK) ON ISNULL(Ord.Account_ID, 1) = A.Account_ID                              
   LEFT OUTER JOIN ESTEEMASTER E WITH (NOLOCK) ON E.Estee_ID =  Tra.Estee_ID AND E.Exchange_Code=@excode and E.Status= 1                         
   LEFT OUTER JOIN EsteeMaster_archive EA WITH (NOLOCK) ON EA.Estee_ID =  Tra.Estee_ID AND EA.Exchange_Code=@excode and EA.Status = 1                    
   WHERE OrdTra.Creation_Date < DateAdd(dd, 1,  @currentDate )                              
    AND ((cast(isnull(E.Expiry_Date,EA.Expiry_Date) as datetime) > @currentDate) OR -- for option future                          
    (len(Tra.Estee_ID) < 17 AND OrdTra.creation_Date >= '10-30-2009')) --for cash trade ********* bcoz of some problem in database we do only for creation_time >= '10-30-2009'                      
    AND OrdTra.status IN ('Executed', 'Partially Filled')                           
    AND ISNULL(E.exchange_code, EA.exchange_code) = @excode                      
  ) X                          
  inner join SecurityType ST ON ST.TypeCode = CONVERT(int,substring(X.Estee_ID, 15, 2))                     
  GROUP BY X.Exchange_Code, X.Broker_ID, X.Account_ID, X.Sub_StrategyID,SecurityName, X.Estee_ID, X.Rule_ID                     
   IF @@ERROR <> 0 BEGIN                    
    SET @error = @@ERROR                    
    Print 'Error inserting into daily position'                    
    GOTO ERROR_HANDLER                    
   END                    
 END ELSE BEGIN                                
    --Insert the positions for the previous working date in the daily positions table from daily positions table.                    
 INSERT INTO DailyPositions(SecurityName, Long, Short,InClearingFTD, TransactionCost, Account_ID, SecurityType,                                  
 Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, PositionDate, AverageTradedPrice, BuyValue, SellValue,Exchange_Code,Rule_ID)                               
    SELECT ISNULL(E.DataFeed_Ticker,EA.DataFeed_Ticker), Long, Short, 0,0, Account_ID, SecurityType,                                  
    dp.Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, @currentDate, AverageTradedPrice, BuyValue, SellValue,dp.Exchange_Code  ,dp.Rule_ID                            
 FROM DailyPositions dp      
 LEFT OUTER JOIN ESTEEMASTER E WITH (NOLOCK) ON E.Estee_ID = dp.Estee_ID AND E.Exchange_Code=@excode and E.Status= 1                         
   LEFT OUTER JOIN EsteeMaster_archive EA WITH (NOLOCK) ON EA.Estee_ID =  dp.Estee_ID AND EA.Exchange_Code=@excode and EA.Status = 1          
 WHERE Datediff(dd, PositionDate, @prevWorkingDate) = 0                       
   AND dp.Exchange_Code = @excode                         
   AND (cast(isnull(E.Expiry_Date,EA.Expiry_Date) as datetime) >= @currentDate                               
   OR len(dp.Estee_ID) < 17) --Added OR condition to carry forward cash positions. But these are carried                           
      --forwarded irrespective of whether they are closed or not as they dont have the                          
      --expiry date. Have to find out the way to stop carry forwarding them when they                           
      --are closed.                          
   IF @@ERROR <> 0 BEGIN                    
    SET @error = @@ERROR                    
    Print 'Error copying yesterday''s position'                    
    GOTO ERROR_HANDLER                    
   END                    
   -----------------------******** Updating and inserting the given date's positions. -------------------------********                              
   -- Creating temp table to store all the positions for the given date only.                              
    DECLARE @TempDailyPositions TABLE(SecurityName nvarchar(75), Long bigint, Short bigint, InClearingFTD int,                              
   TransactionCost decimal(20,4), Account_ID int, SecurityType nvarchar(30), Estee_ID nvarchar(50),                               
   Sub_StrategyID  varchar(5), Broker_ID int, PositionDate datetime, AverageTradedPrice decimal(20,4),                               
   BuyValue decimal(20,4), SellValue decimal(20,4),Exchange_code char(10), Rule_ID int)                               
    -- Saving all the positions for the given date in temp table.                              
    INSERT INTO @TempDailyPositions(SecurityName, Long, Short, InClearingFTD , TransactionCost, Account_ID, SecurityType,             
  Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, PositionDate, AverageTradedPrice, BuyValue, SellValue,Exchange_code, Rule_ID)                               
   Select SecurityName,                           
   sum(Long) AS Long,                           
   sum(Short) AS Short,            
   Sum(LongInClear) - SUm(ShortInClear) InClearingFTD,            
   SUM(Total_TC) AS TransactionCost,                           
   Account_ID,                          
   MIN(ST.TypeName) AS SecurityType,                               
   X.Estee_ID ,                          
   X.Sub_StrategyID,                           
   X.BROKER_ID,                           
   @currentDate AS PositionDate,                               
   case (sum(Long) - sum(Short))                           
   when 0 then 0                          
   else (sum(Long*Traded_Price) + sum(Short*Traded_Price))/(sum(Long) + sum(Short))                     
   END AS AverageTradedPrice,                              
   sum(Long*Traded_Price) AS BuyValue,                               
   sum(Short*Traded_Price) AS SellValue,              
   X.Exchange_Code     ,    
   X.Rule_ID                      
    FROM (                               
   SELECT                              
   ISNULL(E.Underlying_Ticker, EA.Underlying_Ticker) as Underlying_Ticker,                              
   Tra.Estee_ID AS Estee_ID,                              
   ISNULL(E.DataFeed_Ticker, EA.DataFeed_Ticker) AS SecurityName,                              
   Ord.Sub_Strategy_ID  as Sub_StrategyID,                              
   case buy_sell_indicator when 1 then Tra.Traded_Quantity else 0 end Long,                               
   case buy_sell_indicator when 2 then Tra.Traded_Quantity else 0 end Short,            
 case buy_sell_indicator when 1 then             
 case order_source_ID when 'OdinDirectTransfer' then 0 when 'ECM' then  0      
 else Tra.Traded_Quantity end            
 else 0 end LongInClear,            
 case buy_sell_indicator when 2 then             
 case order_source_ID when 'OdinDirectTransfer' then 0 when 'ECM' then  0      
 else Tra.Traded_Quantity end            
 else 0 end ShortInClear,            
   CASE When @excode = 'BR' AND  CONVERT(int,substring(ISNULL(E.Estee_ID, EA.Estee_ID), 15, 2)) in (35,36) THEN        
   Power(10,5)/Power(1 + (Tra.Traded_Price)*1.0/100, CAST(dbo.GetTradingHolidaysUsingBankingTable(@currentDate, cast(isnull(E.Expiry_Date,EA.Expiry_Date) as date),@excode,'CD','T') as FLOAT)/252)       
   ELSE Tra.Traded_Price end As Traded_Price ,                             
   0 AS Total_Money_Deployed,                               
   Tra.Transaction_Cost AS Total_TC,                               
   Convert(VARCHAR(20), OrdTra.creation_time, 112) as Date,                              
   Convert(VARCHAR(20), OrdTra.creation_time, 113) As Trade_Date,                              
   Tra.trade_ID AS TradeID,                              
   B.BROKER_ID AS BROKER_ID,                              
   B.Broker_Name AS BrokerName,                               
   A.Account_ID AS Account_ID,           
   case buy_sell_indicator when 2 then 'SHORT' else 'LONG' end AS Side,                              
   ISNULL(E.ISIN, EA.ISIN) AS ISIN,                    
   ISNULL(E.Exchange_Code, EA.Exchange_Code) AS Exchange_Code   ,    
   isnull(Ord.Link_ID, -1) as Rule_ID                       
   FROM [Order] Ord WITH (NOLOCK)                           
   INNER JOIN OrderTrades OrdTra WITH (NOLOCK) ON Ord.Order_ID = OrdTra.Order_ID and OrdTra.Creation_Date = @currentDate            
   INNER JOIN Trades Tra WITH (NOLOCK) ON OrdTra.OrderTrade_ID = Tra.OrderTrade_ID and OrdTra.Order_ID = Tra.Order_ID and Tra.Creation_Date = @currentDate            
   INNER JOIN Broker B WITH (NOLOCK) ON Ord.Broker_ID = B.Broker_ID                               
   INNER JOIN ACCOUNT A WITH (NOLOCK) ON ISNULL(Ord.Account_ID, 1) = A.Account_ID                              
   LEFT OUTER JOIN ESTEEMASTER E WITH (NOLOCK) ON E.Estee_ID =  Tra.Estee_ID AND E.Exchange_Code=@excode and E.Status= 1                    
   LEFT OUTER JOIN EsteeMaster_archive EA WITH (NOLOCK) ON EA.Estee_ID =  Tra.Estee_ID and EA.Exchange_Code=@excode and EA.Status = 1                    
   WHERE Ord.Creation_Date = @currentDate             
    AND OrdTra.status IN ('Executed', 'Partially Filled')                            
    AND ISNULL(E.exchange_code, EA.exchange_code) = @excode                       
    ) X                                
    INNER JOIN SecurityType ST WITH (NOLOCK) ON ST.TypeCode = CONVERT(int,substring(X.Estee_ID, 15, 2))                               
    GROUP BY X.Exchange_Code ,X.Broker_ID, X.Account_ID, X.Sub_StrategyID,SecurityName, X.Estee_ID, X.Rule_ID                    
  IF @@ERROR <> 0 BEGIN                    
   SET @error = @@ERROR                    
   Print 'Error getting today''s position into temp table'              
   GOTO ERROR_HANDLER              
  END                    
    -- Creating temp table to store all the to be updated positions for the given date.                              
    DECLARE @TempToUpdateDailyPositions TABLE(SecurityName nvarchar(75), Long bigint, Short bigint,  InClearingFTD int,            
   TransactionCost decimal(20,4), Account_ID int, SecurityType nvarchar(30), Estee_ID nvarchar(50),                               
   Sub_StrategyID  varchar(5), Broker_ID int, PositionDate datetime, AverageTradedPrice decimal(20,4),                               
   BuyValue decimal(20,4), SellValue decimal(20,4),Exchange_code char(10),Rule_ID int)                             
    -- Saving all the to be updated positions for the given date in temp table.                              
    INSERT INTO @TempToUpdateDailyPositions(SecurityName, Long, Short,InClearingFTD, TransactionCost, Account_ID, SecurityType,                                  
  Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, PositionDate, AverageTradedPrice, BuyValue, SellValue,Exchange_code,Rule_ID)                               
    Select TDP.SecurityName, TDP.Long, TDP.Short,TDP.InClearingFTD, TDP.TransactionCost, TDP.Account_ID, TDP.SecurityType,                               
   TDP.Estee_ID, TDP.Sub_StrategyID, TDP.BROKER_ID, TDP.PositionDate, TDP.AverageTradedPrice, TDP.BuyValue,    
   TDP.SellValue,TDP.Exchange_code ,TDP.Rule_ID                           
    FROM DailyPositions DP                     
    INNER JOIN @TempDailyPositions TDP ON DP.PositionDate = TDP.PositionDate                    
           AND DP.Estee_ID = TDP.Estee_ID                     
           AND DP.Account_ID = TDP.Account_ID                              
           AND DP.Broker_ID = TDP.Broker_ID                     
           AND DP.Sub_StrategyID = TDP.Sub_StrategyID      
     AND DP.Rule_ID = TDP.Rule_ID                      
    WHERE DP.Exchange_Code = @excode                    
    -- Updating the Daily positions table with the to be updated positions from the to be updated temp table.                              
    UPDATE DailyPositions                              
    SET Long = (DP.Long + TDP.Long), Short = (DP.Short + TDP.Short), InClearingFTD = TDP.InClearingFTD,                               
  TransactionCost = (DP.TransactionCost + TDP.TransactionCost),                               
  AverageTradedPrice =  case ((DP.Long + TDP.Long) - (DP.Short + TDP.Short))                           
        when 0 then 0                          
        else (DP.BuyValue + TDP.BuyValue + DP.SellValue + TDP.SellValue)/((DP.Long + TDP.Long) + (DP.Short + TDP.Short))                     
        end,                           
  BuyValue = (DP.BuyValue + TDP.BuyValue),                               
  SellValue = (DP.SellValue + TDP.SellValue)                              
    FROM DailyPositions DP                     
    INNER JOIN @TempToUpdateDailyPositions TDP ON DP.PositionDate = TDP.PositionDate                    
           AND DP.Estee_ID = TDP.Estee_ID                     
           AND DP.Account_ID = TDP.Account_ID                              
           AND DP.Broker_ID = TDP.Broker_ID                     
           AND DP.Sub_StrategyID = TDP.Sub_StrategyID          
     AND DP.Rule_ID = TDP.Rule_ID                           
  WHERE DP.Exchange_Code = @excode                    
   IF @@ERROR <> 0 BEGIN                    
   SET @error = @@ERROR                    
   Print 'Error updating daily position'                    
   GOTO ERROR_HANDLER                    
   END                    
    -- Inserting the to be inserted positions from to be inserted temp table in Daily Positions table.                              
    INSERT INTO DailyPositions(SecurityName, Long, Short, InClearingFTD, TransactionCost, Account_ID, SecurityType,                                  
  Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, PositionDate, AverageTradedPrice, BuyValue, SellValue,Exchange_Code,Rule_ID)                              
   SELECT * FROM (                    
   select * from @TempDailyPositions                              
   EXCEPT                              
   select * from @TempToUpdateDailyPositions) Y                              
 IF @@ERROR <> 0 BEGIN                    
   SET @error = @@ERROR                    
   Print 'Error inserting into daily position for securities that were not there yesterday'                    
   GOTO ERROR_HANDLER           
   END                    
 END                                
  --Update Positions In Clearing to be 0 if they are not EQUITYSPOT                
  Update DailyPositions set InClearingFTD = 0 where PositionDate = @currentDate and Exchange_Code = @excode and SecurityType not in             
  (select distinct s.TypeName from ValidCombos v             
  inner join NoOfClearingDays c on v.ExchangeCode = c.ExchangeCode and v.Segment = c.segment             
  inner join SecurityType s on s.TypeCode = v.SecurityType              
  where v.IsTraded = 1 and c.NoOfClearingDays > 0 and c.ExchangeCode = @excode)            
  
  ---Create position snapshot for republish positions for back date on position manager on start up      
  
delete from DailyPositions_Snapshot where PositionDate > dateadd(DD, -10, @currentDate) and PositionDate < dateadd(DD, -2, @currentDate)      
if NOT EXISTS ( select * from DailyPositions_Snapshot where PositionDate = @currentDate and ExchangeCode = @excode)      
BEGIN      
 INSERT into DailyPositions_Snapshot      
 select Estee_id,Account_Id,Sub_StrategyId,Long,Short,BuyValue,SellValue,PositionDate,Exchange_Code,Rule_ID      
 from DailyPositions where PositionDate = @currentDate and Exchange_Code = @excode      
END      
  
 IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 BEGIN                    
  COMMIT TRANSACTION                    
  Print 'Committed transaction'                    
 END                    
 RETURN 0                
ERROR_HANDLER:                    
 IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 BEGIN                    
  ROLLBACK                    
  Print 'Rolled back transaction'                    
 END                    
END


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.SaveEncryptedEMSPassword

```sql
-- =============================================  
-- Author:  Megha Goel  
-- Create date: 21 May  
-- Description: Save Encrypted Password for EMS  
-- =============================================  

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.SaveEncryptedEMSPassword   
-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here  
	   @applicationId        INT,
	   @oldPassword          VARCHAR(255),
	   @userId               VARCHAR(255),
	   @EncryptedNewPassword VARBINARY(MAX),
	   @UpdatedBy            VARCHAR(255)
AS
	 BEGIN  
		 -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from  
		 -- interfering with SELECT statements.  

		 SET NOCOUNT ON;
		 BEGIN TRY
			 BEGIN TRANSACTION;

			 DECLARE @passString VARCHAR(50);
			 SET @passString = CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX), @EncryptedNewPassword);

			 UPDATE tu
			   SET
				   PasswordString = @passString,
				   tu.Password = NULL,
				   tu.NewPassword = ''
			 FROM ExchangeAdapterLoginDetails eald
				  JOIN TradersToUserID tu ON eald.Trader = tu.Trader
			 WHERE  eald.emsApplicationID = @applicationId
					AND eald.Trader = @userId;

			 INSERT INTO ExchangeAdapterLoginDetails_Archive
			 SELECT @applicationId, eald.exchangeAdapterID, eald.Trader, @oldPassword, @UpdatedBy, GETDATE()
			 FROM   ExchangeAdapterLoginDetails AS eald
					JOIN TradersToUserID AS tu ON eald.Trader = tu.Trader
			 WHERE  eald.emsApplicationID = @applicationId
					AND eald.Trader = @userId;

			 COMMIT TRANSACTION;
		 END TRY
		 BEGIN CATCH
			 DECLARE @error   INT,
					 @message VARCHAR(4000),
					 @xstate  INT;
			 SELECT @error = ERROR_NUMBER(), @message = ERROR_MESSAGE();

			 IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
				 BEGIN
					 PRINT 'The transaction is in an uncommittable state.'+' Rolling back transaction.';
					 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
				 END;
			 RAISERROR('[SaveEncryptedEMSPassword]: %d: %s', 16, 1, @error, @message);
			 RETURN;
		 END CATCH;
	 END;
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.SaveHealthData

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SaveHealthData]
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SaveLedgerBaseFigures]
@date datetime = null,                 
@accountID int = null,              
@brokerID decimal(20,2) = null,              
@subStrategyID int = 0,          
@BaseCumLedgerBalance decimal(20,4) = null,              
@BaseCumMoneyDeployed decimal(20,4) = null,              
@BaseAnnualPNL decimal(20,4) = null,              
@BaseCumReligareLedgerBalance decimal(20,4) = null,              
@BaseCumFnOMargin decimal(20,4) = null,              
@BaseCumMTM decimal(20,4) = null,              
@BaseDailyPNL decimal(20,4) = null,              
@BaseCumCashBalance decimal(20,4) = null,              
@BaseCumCashMTM decimal(20,4) = null            
AS                          
BEGIN                          
 UPDATE LedgerBalance SET BaseCumLedgerBalance = @BaseCumLedgerBalance, BaseCumMoneyDeployed = @BaseCumMoneyDeployed,
 BaseAnnualPNL = @BaseAnnualPNL, BaseCumReligareLedgerBalance = @BaseCumReligareLedgerBalance,
 BaseCumFnOMargin = @BaseCumFnOMargin, BaseCumMTM = @BaseCumMTM, BaseDailyPNL = @BaseDailyPNL, 
 BaseCumCashBalance = @BaseCumCashBalance, BaseCumCashMTM = @BaseCumCashMTM
WHERE Datediff(day, Date, @date) = 0 AND Account_ID = @accountID AND Broker_ID = @brokerID 
AND StrategyID = @subStrategyID           
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.SaveLedgerDetails

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SaveLedgerDetails]                          
--@choice int = 0,                         
@date datetime = null,                 
@cashPaid decimal(20,4) = null,                          
@fdr decimal(20,4) = null,                
@otherCharges decimal(20,4) = null,              
@accountID int = null,              
@brokerID decimal(20,2) = null,              
@cashTransactionCost decimal(20,4) = null,              
@fnoTransactionCost decimal(20,4) = null,              
@cmBuy decimal(20,4) = null,              
@cmSell decimal(20,4) = null,              
@futureMTMBrokerNet decimal(20,4) = null,              
@netOptionValue decimal(20,4) = null,              
@futurePayout decimal(20,4) = null,              
@optionPayout decimal(20,4) = null,              
@cashPayment decimal(20,4) = null,            
@dailyFOMargin decimal(20,4) = null,          
@netAssignmentValue decimal(20,4) = null,      
@subStrategyID int = 0,          
@cashBalance decimal(20,4) = null,    
@aum decimal(20,4) = null,  
@cashMTM decimal(20,4) = null,
@RealizedProfit decimal(20, 4) = 0,
@LockedProfit decimal(20, 4) = 0   
AS                          
BEGIN                          
 
  IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM LedgerBalance WHERE Datediff(day, Date, @date) = 0 AND Account_ID = @accountID AND Broker_ID = @brokerID 
   AND StrategyID = @subStrategyID )
  BEGIN
   UPDATE LedgerBalance SET Cash_Paid = @cashPaid, FDR = @fdr, otherCharges = @otherCharges,
   CashTransactionCost = @cashTransactionCost, FnOTransactionCost = @fnoTransactionCost,
   CMBuy = @cmBuy, CMSell = @cmSell, FutureMTMBrokerNet = @futureMTMBrokerNet, NetOptionValue = @netOptionValue,
   OptionPayout = @optionPayout, DailyFOMargin = @dailyFOMargin, NetAssignmentValue = @netAssignmentValue, 
   CashMTM = @cashMTM, RealizedProfit = @RealizedProfit, LockedProfit = @LockedProfit, FuturePayout = @futurePayout, CashPayment = @cashPayment,
   CashBalance = @cashBalance, AUM = @aum
   WHERE Datediff(day, Date, @date) = 0 AND Account_ID = @accountID AND Broker_ID = @brokerID 
   AND StrategyID = @subStrategyID 
  END          
  ELSE
   BEGIN
	  INSERT INTO LedgerBalance(Date, Cash_Paid, FDR, otherCharges, Broker_ID, Account_ID, CashTransactionCost,              
		FnOTransactionCost, CMBuy, CMSell, FutureMTMBrokerNet, NetOptionValue, FuturePayout, OptionPayout, CashPayment,           
	 DailyFOMargin, NetAssignmentValue, StrategyID, CashBalance, AUM, CashMTM, RealizedProfit, LockedProfit)              
		SELECT @date, @cashPaid, @fdr, @otherCharges, @brokerID, @accountID, @cashTransactionCost, @fnoTransactionCost,            
		@cmBuy, @cmSell, @futureMTMBrokerNet, @netOptionValue, @futurePayout, @optionPayout, @cashPayment,           
	 @dailyFOMargin, @netAssignmentValue, @subStrategyID, @cashBalance, @aum, @cashMTM, @RealizedProfit, @LockedProfit
   END
 END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.SetNeatLimit

```sql
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


CREATE Procedure [dbo].[SetNeatLimit]
	@updatedLimits NeatLimitType ReadOnly
AS
Declare @SeqNo int
Select @SeqNo=Max(SeqNo) From NeatLimit

Update NL
	set NL.FutureBuy = UL.[Future Buy],
	NL.FutureSell= UL.[Future Sell],
	NL.OptionBuy = UL.[Option Buy],
	NL.OptionSell = UL.[Option Sell],
	NL.CDFutureBuy = UL.[CD Future Buy],
	NL.CDFutureSell = UL.[CD Future Sell],
	NL.CDOptionBuy = UL.[CD Option Buy],
	NL.CDOptionSell = UL.[CD Option Sell],
	NL.CashBuy = UL.[Cash Buy],
	NL.CashSell = UL.[Cash Sell],
	NL.UpdateDateTime = CONVERT(varchar(19),GetDate(),120)
	From NeatLimit NL
	Inner Join @updatedLimits UL on NL.Trader = UL.Trader 
	where NL.SeqNo = @SeqNo



```

## Stored procedure: dbo.SlaCashScrips

```sql




CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SlaCashScrips]    

 @Date DateTime = '2011-06-07',  

 @numberofscrips int = 1,  

 @securitytype int = 1,  

 @MinVol int = 100000,   

 @SubStrategyID int = 9901,

 @ExchangeCode varchar(4) = 'IS'  

  

AS  

  

BEGIN  

  

 select top (@numberofscrips) Q.Estee_ID, Q.Underlying_Ticker, Q.Security_Type, C.Volume   

 from (   

      select Estee_ID, Underlying_Ticker,ISIN, Security_Type   

      from esteemaster where Security_Type = @securitytype  

      and Status=1 and Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode  

      ) Q   

 inner join closingprice C on Q.Estee_ID = C.Estee_ID    

 inner join (  

                  select Estee_Id from subscriptionlist where SubStrategyID = @SubStrategyID and IsSubscribed = 1  

                  ) S  on left(S.Estee_Id, 12) = Q.ISIN where C.Date = @Date and C.Volume > @MinVol   

 order by C.Volume asc   

  

END  





SET ANSI_NULLS ON



```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_checkAllocatedIDsTable

```sql
-- =============================================  
-- Author:  Saurabh Garg  
-- Create date: 30th July 2010  
-- Description: To check if range corresponding to orders inserted manually   
-- or by some other process is reflected in tblAllocatedIDs  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_checkAllocatedIDsTable]  
 -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
@currentDate date, 
@maxOrderID int output,  
@maxOrderTradeID int output,  
@maxTradeID int output,  
@maxAllocatedOrderID int output,  
@maxAllocatedOrderTradeID int output,  
@maxAllocatedTradeID int output
AS  
BEGIN  
 -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from  
 -- interfering with SELECT statements.  
 SET NOCOUNT ON;  
  
    -- Insert statements for procedure here  
DECLARE @returnValue int  
  
 SET @returnValue=0  
  
 SELECT @maxAllocatedOrderID = max(Max_Order_ID) FROM AllocatedIDs where Creation_Date = @currentDate
 SELECT @maxAllocatedOrderTradeID = max(Max_OrderTrade_ID) FROM AllocatedIDs  where Creation_Date = @currentDate 
 SELECT @maxAllocatedTradeID = max(Max_Trade_ID) FROM AllocatedIDs where Creation_Date = @currentDate   
  
 SELECT @maxOrderID = max(Order_ID) FROM [Order] where Creation_Date = @currentDate
 SELECT @maxOrderTradeID = max(OrderTrade_ID) FROM OrderTrades where Creation_Date = @currentDate   
 SELECT @maxTradeID = max(Trade_ID) FROM Trades where Creation_Date = @currentDate   
  
 IF(@maxAllocatedOrderID < @maxOrderID)  
  BEGIN  
   INSERT INTO AllocatedIDs(Creation_Date,Max_Order_ID)   
   VALUES(@currentDate,@maxOrderID)  
   SET @returnValue=@returnValue+1  
 END  
  
 IF (@maxAllocatedOrderTradeID < @maxOrderTradeID)  
  BEGIN  
   INSERT INTO AllocatedIDs(Creation_Date,Max_OrderTrade_ID)   
   VALUES(@currentDate,@maxOrderTradeID)  
   SET @returnValue=@returnValue+2  
 END  
  
 IF (@maxAllocatedTradeID < @maxTradeID)  
  BEGIN  
   INSERT INTO AllocatedIDs(Creation_Date,Max_Trade_ID)   
   VALUES(@currentDate,@maxTradeID)  
   SET @returnValue=@returnValue+4  
 END  
 SELECT @returnValue  
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_createFfixdata

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_createFfixdata]    
 @Ffixdata_path varchar (max),
 @RunDate date ,
 @Asofdate date 
AS  
BEGIN   
BEGIN TRANSACTION
---------------------create a temporary staging table and bulk insert into that table--------------------------------
   CREATE TABLE #FFIXSTAGING
							(
								[INDEX_FLG] [varchar](40) NOT NULL,
								[SYMBOL] [varchar](40) NOT NULL,
								[SERIES] [varchar](40) NULL,
								[SECURITY] [varchar](max) NULL,
								[ISSUE_CAP] [bigint] NULL,
								[INVESTIBLE_FACTOR] [decimal](18, 10) NULL,
								[CLOSE_PRIC] [decimal](18, 5) NULL,
								[FF_MKT_CAP] [varchar](max) NULL,
								[WEIGHTAGE] [decimal](18, 5) NULL
							);
    EXEC('BULK INSERT #FFIXSTAGING FROM ''' + @Ffixdata_path + ''' WITH ( FIRSTROW = 2, FIELDTERMINATOR ='','', ROWTERMINATOR =''\n'')')
   
   --------------delete existing entries in ffixdata and inserting entries from staging table-------------------------------------
   delete from FfixData where RunDate=@rundate 
   insert into FfixData(INDEX_FLG,SYMBOL,SERIES,SECURITY,ISSUE_CAP,INVESTIBLE_FACTOR,CLOSE_PRIC,FF_MKT_CAP,WEIGHTAGE,RunDate,Asofdate)
   select INDEX_FLG,SYMBOL,SERIES,SECURITY,ISSUE_CAP,INVESTIBLE_FACTOR,CLOSE_PRIC,FF_MKT_CAP,WEIGHTAGE,@RunDate,@Asofdate from #FFIXSTAGING
   
   ---------------fixing up the newly inserted data---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   UPDATE Ffixdata SET Ffixdata.EsteeID = esteemaster.Estee_ID FROM esteemaster   
   WHERE esteemaster.Underlying_Ticker = Ffixdata.SYMBOL and Status=1  
	AND  (  
	   esteemaster.security_type = 0   
	  OR esteemaster.security_type =4  
	  )  
    and EsteeMaster.Exchange_Code='IS'  
   
   DELETE FROM Ffixdata WHERE ESTEEID IS NULL  
   
   UPDATE Ffixdata SET Ffixdata.Weightage = Ffixdata.Weightage * 0.01   
   
   UPDATE FFIXDATA SET FFIXDATA.IssueCapital_nseSecurity = (NSE_Security.issued_capital) FROM NSE_Security   
			WHERE NSE_Security.symbol = FFIXDATA.SYMBOL AND NSE_Security.series = 'EQ'   

    DELETE FROM FFIXDATA WHERE SYMBOL = 'NHPC'  

	UPDATE FFIXDATA SET FFIXDATA.IssueCapital_nseSecurity = dbo.ISSUECAPPARSE(FFIXDATA.IssueCapital_nseSecurity)  
  
    UPDATE FFIXDATA SET FFIXDATA.FREEZEPERCENT = NSE_Security.FREEZEPERCENT FROM NSE_Security WHERE NSE_Security.symbol = FFIXDATA.SYMBOL   
  
    UPDATE FFIXDATA SET FFIXDATA.INVESTIBLE_FACTOR_ff = FREEFLOAT.INVESTIBLE_FACTOR FROM FREEFLOAT WHERE FREEFLOAT.SYMBOL = FFIXDATA.SYMBOL   

COMMIT TRANSACTION
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_createSpanCache

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_createSpanCache]           
 @datetime datetime,            
 @esteeid varchar(50),            
 @exchangecode char(10),            
 @exchangeSegment varchar(100),          
 @spanID char(10)            
AS            
BEGIN            
 SET NOCOUNT ON;            
DECLARE @temp_Table TABLE        
(         
      SpanID nvarchar(10),        
      Exchange nvarchar(10),        
      Segment nvarchar(10),        
      SecurityType int        
)        
declare @date varchar(20)        
SET @date = CONVERT(Date, @datetime, 105)        
declare @secType varchar(20)        
declare @spanDataScript nvarchar(max)        
declare @spanRiskArrayScript nvarchar(max)        
DECLARE @tempspanDataCatString varchar(max);        
SET @tempspanDataCatString = '';        
DECLARE @tempspanRiskArrayCatString varchar(max);        
SET @tempspanRiskArrayCatString = '';        
DECLARE @defaultDate varchar(20)    
SET @defaultDate = '0001-01-01'    
if(@exchangeSegment IS NULL)        
 SET @exchangeSegment = 'ALL'        
--Insert Latest SpandID to Temp Table        
IF @spanID = 'ALL'            
 BEGIN        
 select distinct SUBSTRING(esteeid,15,2) SecurityType,spanID into #SpanData from SpanData (NOLOCK) where (date = @date or date = @defaultDate) and SUBSTRING(esteeid,13,2) = @exchangecode
;WITH D as
   (
  select items AS Segments from dbo.Split(@exchangeSegment,',')
   )
INSERT INTO @temp_Table select max(sd.spanID) spanID,Exchange,ssm.Segment,A.SecurityType from Span_Sequence ssm WITH(NOLOCK)
inner join
(
 select max(ss.SequenceID) as SequenceID,vc.segment,vc.SecurityType
 from ValidCombos vc WITH(NOLOCK)
 inner join #SpanData sd WITH(NOLOCK) on vc.SecurityType = sd.SecurityType
 inner join Span_Sequence ss WITH(NOLOCK) on ss.spanID = sd.spanID and ss.segment = vc.Segment and ss.Exchange = vc.ExchangeCode
 where vc.ExchangeCode = @exchangecode  
 group by vc.segment,vc.SecurityType
)
A on ssm.SequenceID = A.SequenceID and ssm.segment = A.segment and ssm.exchange = @exchangecode
inner join D on ssm.Segment = CASE WHEN D.Segments = 'ALL' THEN ssm.Segment ELSE D.Segments END
inner join #SpanData sd on sd.spanID = ssm.SpanID and a.SecurityType = sd.SecurityType
group by Exchange,ssm.Segment,A.SecurityType
drop table #SpanData
END        
ELSE        
BEGIN        
;WITH D as                    
   (                    
  select items AS Segments from dbo.Split(@exchangeSegment,',')               
   )        
INSERT INTO @temp_Table select @spanID,ssm.Exchange,ssm.Segment,vc.SecurityType from Span_Sequence ssm WITH(NOLOCK)        
inner join ValidCombos vc (NOLOCK) on ssm.Exchange = vc.ExchangeCode and ssm.Segment = vc.Segment        
inner join D on ssm.Segment = CASE WHEN D.Segments = 'ALL' THEN ssm.Segment ELSE D.Segments END         
where ssm.spanID = @spanID        
and ssm.Exchange = @exchangecode        
END        
DECLARE @SPID nvarchar(10)        
DECLARE @EID nvarchar(10)        
DECLARE @SID nvarchar(10)        
DECLARE @STYPE int        
SELECT Top 1 @SPID = SpanID,@EID = Exchange,@SID = Segment, @STYPE = SecurityType FROM @temp_Table        
DECLARE @returnValue varchar(MAX)        
select @returnValue = COALESCE(@returnValue + ', ', 'Data not found for segment ') + t.Segments from @temp_Table tt         
right join  (select items AS Segments from dbo.Split(@exchangeSegment,','))t        
on t.Segments = tt.segment          
where tt.segment is null        
WHILE (@SPID IS NOT NULL AND @EID IS NOT NULL AND @SID IS NOT NULL AND @STYPE IS NOT NULL)        
BEGIN        
--SPAN Logic        
SET @secType = CONVERT(int, @STYPE, 105)        
IF @ESTEEID = 'ALL'            
    BEGIN            
  SET @spanDataScript = 'SELECT * FROM SPANDATA WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE (DATE = '''+@date+''' OR DATE = '''+@defaultDate+''') AND SPANID = '''+@SPID+''' and SUBSTRING(esteeid,13,2) = '''+@EID+''' and SUBSTRING(esteeid,15,2) = '+@secType;    
  SET @spanRiskArrayScript = 'SELECT * FROM SPANRISKARRAY WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE (DATE = '''+@date+''' OR DATE = '''+@defaultDate+''') AND SPANID = '''+@SPID+''' and SUBSTRING(esteeid,13,2) = '''+@EID+''' and SUBSTRING(esteeid,15,2) = '+@secType;       
    END             
   ELSE            
    BEGIN             
  SET @spanDataScript = 'SELECT * FROM SPANDATA WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE DATE = '''+@date+'''  AND esteeID = '''+ @ESTEEID+''' AND SPANID = '''+@SPID+''' and SUBSTRING(esteeid,13,2) = '''+@EID+''' and SUBSTRING(esteeid,15,2) = '+@secType;    
  SET @spanRiskArrayScript = 'SELECT * FROM SPANRISKARRAY WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE DATE = '''+@date+'''  AND esteeID = '''+ @ESTEEID+''' AND SPANID = '''+@SPID+''' and SUBSTRING(esteeid,13,2) = '''+@EID+''' and SUBSTRING(esteeid,15,2) = '+@secType;    
    END    
IF @tempspanDataCatString = ''        
 BEGIN            
  SET @tempspanDataCatString = @spanDataScript;        
    END             
   ELSE            
    BEGIN             
  SET @tempspanDataCatString = @tempspanDataCatString + ' UNION ALL ' + @spanDataScript;        
    END          
IF @tempspanRiskArrayCatString = ''        
 BEGIN            
  SET @tempspanRiskArrayCatString = @spanRiskArrayScript;        
    END             
   ELSE            
    BEGIN             
  SET @tempspanRiskArrayCatString = @tempspanRiskArrayCatString + ' UNION ALL ' + @spanRiskArrayScript;        
    END     
--Temp Table Loop Logic        
DELETE FROM @temp_Table WHERE SpanID = @SPID and Exchange = @EID and Segment = @SID and SecurityType = @STYPE         
SET @SPID = null        
SET @EID = null        
SET @SID = null        
SET @STYPE = null        
SELECT Top 1 @SPID = SpanID,@EID = Exchange,@SID = Segment, @STYPE = SecurityType FROM @temp_Table        
END        
EXEC (@tempspanDataCatString)        
EXEC (@tempspanRiskArrayCatString)        
If @returnValue is null        
select 'All Segement data Found.'        
else        
select @returnValue        
END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_createSpanChargeCache]     
 @datetime datetime,            
 @esteeid varchar(50),            
 @exchangecode char(10),            
 @exchangeSegment varchar(100),          
 @spanID char(10)            
AS            
BEGIN            
 SET NOCOUNT ON;            
DECLARE @temp_Table TABLE        
(         
      SpanID nvarchar(10),        
      Exchange nvarchar(10),        
      Segment nvarchar(10),        
      SecurityType int        
)        
declare @date varchar(20)        
SET @date = CONVERT(Date, @datetime, 105)        
declare @secType varchar(20)        
declare @spanDataScript nvarchar(max)        
declare @spanRiskArrayScript nvarchar(max)        
DECLARE @tempspanDataCatString varchar(max);        
SET @tempspanDataCatString = '';   
DECLARE @defaultDate varchar(20)  
SET @defaultDate = '0001-01-01'          
if(@exchangeSegment IS NULL)        
 SET @exchangeSegment = 'ALL'        
--Insert Latest SpandID to Temp Table        
IF @spanID = 'ALL'            
 BEGIN        
  select distinct SUBSTRING(esteeid,15,2) SecurityType,spanID into #SpanUndCharge from SpanUndCharge (NOLOCK) where (date = @date or date = @defaultDate) and SUBSTRING(esteeid,13,2) = @exchangecode
 ;WITH D as                    
   (                    
 select items AS Segments from dbo.Split(@exchangeSegment,',')               
   )        
INSERT INTO @temp_Table select max(sd.spanID) spanID,ssm.Exchange,ssm.Segment,A.SecurityType from Span_Sequence ssm WITH(NOLOCK)        
inner join        
(        
 select max(ss.SequenceID) as SequenceID,vc.segment,vc.SecurityType
 from ValidCombos vc WITH(NOLOCK)
 inner join #SpanUndCharge sd WITH(NOLOCK) on vc.SecurityType = sd.SecurityType
 inner join Span_Sequence ss WITH(NOLOCK) on ss.spanID = sd.spanID and ss.segment = vc.Segment and ss.Exchange = vc.ExchangeCode
 where vc.ExchangeCode = @exchangecode  
 group by vc.segment,vc.SecurityType
)
A on ssm.SequenceID = A.SequenceID and ssm.segment = A.segment and ssm.exchange = @exchangecode
inner join D on ssm.Segment = CASE WHEN D.Segments = 'ALL' THEN ssm.Segment ELSE D.Segments END
inner join #SpanUndCharge sd on sd.spanID = ssm.SpanID and a.SecurityType = sd.SecurityType
group by Exchange,ssm.Segment,A.SecurityType
drop table #SpanUndCharge        
END        
ELSE        
BEGIN        
;WITH D as                    
   (                    
  select items AS Segments from dbo.Split(@exchangeSegment,',')               
   )        
INSERT INTO @temp_Table select @spanID,ssm.Exchange,ssm.Segment,vc.SecurityType from Span_Sequence ssm WITH(NOLOCK)        
inner join ValidCombos vc (NOLOCK) on ssm.Exchange = vc.ExchangeCode and ssm.Segment = vc.Segment        
inner join D on ssm.Segment = CASE WHEN D.Segments = 'ALL' THEN ssm.Segment ELSE D.Segments END         
where ssm.spanID = @spanID        
and ssm.Exchange = @exchangecode        
END        
DECLARE @SPID nvarchar(10)        
DECLARE @EID nvarchar(10)        
DECLARE @SID nvarchar(10)        
DECLARE @STYPE int        
SELECT Top 1 @SPID = SpanID,@EID = Exchange,@SID = Segment, @STYPE = SecurityType FROM @temp_Table        
WHILE (@SPID IS NOT NULL AND @EID IS NOT NULL AND @SID IS NOT NULL AND @STYPE IS NOT NULL)        
BEGIN        
--SPAN Logic        
SET @secType = CONVERT(int, @STYPE, 105)        
IF @ESTEEID = 'ALL'            
    BEGIN            
  SET @spanDataScript = 'SELECT * FROM SpanUndCharge WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE (DATE = '''+@date+''' OR DATE = '''+@defaultDate+''') AND SPANID = '''+@SPID+''' and SUBSTRING(esteeid,13,2) = '''+@EID+''' and SUBSTRING(esteeid,15,2) = '+@secType;        
  END             
   ELSE            
    BEGIN             
  SET @spanDataScript = 'SELECT * FROM SpanUndCharge WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE (DATE = '''+@date+''' OR DATE = '''+@defaultDate+''')  AND esteeID = '''+ @ESTEEID+''' AND SPANID = '''+@SPID+''' and SUBSTRING(esteeid,13,2) = '''+@EID+''' and SUBSTRING(esteeid,15,
2
) = '+@secType;    
    END        
IF @tempspanDataCatString = ''        
 BEGIN            
  SET @tempspanDataCatString = @spanDataScript;        
    END    
   ELSE            
    BEGIN             
  SET @tempspanDataCatString = @tempspanDataCatString + ' UNION ALL ' + @spanDataScript;        
    END          
--Temp Table Loop Logic     
DELETE FROM @temp_Table WHERE SpanID = @SPID and Exchange = @EID and Segment = @SID and SecurityType = @STYPE         
SET @SPID = null        
SET @EID = null        
SET @SID = null        
SET @STYPE = null        
SELECT Top 1 @SPID = SpanID,@EID = Exchange,@SID = Segment, @STYPE = SecurityType FROM @temp_Table        
END        
EXEC (@tempspanDataCatString)        
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_GetAvgValueByForMMinitIDs

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE sp_GetAvgValueByForMMinitIDs
    @Days INT = 10,
    @StrategyID int = NULL
AS
BEGIN
 -- Temp table to store the last available distinct dates
    DECLARE @AvailableDates TABLE (date DATE);
  
    -- Insert the last @Days distinct dates into the temp table
    INSERT INTO @AvailableDates (date)
    SELECT DISTINCT TOP (@Days) date
    FROM LongShortDataBrazil
    ORDER BY date DESC;

    IF @StrategyID IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT lsdb.EsteeID, 
               AVG(lsdb.PX_LAST * lsdb.PX_Volume) AS AvgVolume
        FROM LongShortDataBrazil lsdb
         JOIN @AvailableDates ad ON lsdb.date = ad.date
        JOIN MMInitPrimary mp ON lsdb.EsteeID = mp.Primary_Estee_ID
        WHERE mp.SubStrategyID = @StrategyID
          and mp.isEnabled = 'true'
        GROUP BY lsdb.EsteeID;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT lsdb.EsteeID, 
               AVG(PX_LAST * PX_Volume) AS AvgVolume
        FROM LongShortDataBrazil lsdb
        JOIN @AvailableDates ad ON lsdb.date = ad.date
        GROUP BY lsdb.EsteeID;
    END
END



```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_GetBankingHolidays

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_GetBankingHolidays
(
@startdate Date,
@enddate Date,
@segment varchar(32)
)
as
select (DATEDIFF(dd, @startdate, @enddate) + 1)
  -(DATEDIFF(wk, @startdate, @enddate) * 2)
  -count(DATENAME(dw, date)) from BankingHolidays where segment = @segment
and date >= @startdate and date <= @enddate
and DATENAME(dw, date) not in ('Saturday','Sunday')
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  

[sp_GetBannedSecurities]  


AS  

 BEGIN  
 DECLARE @Date DATE

SELECT @Date = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)--MAX(AsOfDate) FROM indextable WHERE Estee_ID LIKE '%01BR04%'

   SELECT bs.BanDate, 
           em.Estee_ID, 
           bp.BanPermission, 
           bs.BanStatus, 
           bg.BanGroupName  
    FROM BannedSecurities bs
    LEFT JOIN BanGroup bg ON bg.ID = bs.BanGroupId
    LEFT JOIN BanPermission bp ON bp.ID = bs.BanPermissionId

      AND em.Estee_ID IN (
            SELECT Member_Estee_ID 
            FROM IndexTable 
            WHERE Estee_ID = 'IN1000000001BR04' 
              AND AsOfDate = @Date
      )

END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_GetBorrowingCostBrazil

```sql
 
CREATE PROCEDURE
 
[sp_GetBorrowingCostBrazil]
 
--@Date DATE
 
AS
 
BEGIN
DECLARE @LatestDate DATE
DECLARE @BorrowDate DATE
 
SELECT @LatestDate = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) --MAX(AsOfDate) FROM indextable WHERE Estee_ID LIKE '%01BR04%'^M
select @BorrowDate = MAX(PublishDate) from bmf_borrow_data  WHERE EsteeID LIKE '%01BR00%'
 
 
SELECT @BorrowDate as PublishDate, EsteeID,Ticker, AVG(TradedQty) as TradedQty, AVG(MinRate) as MinRate, AVG(AvgRate) as AvgRate, AVG(MaxRate) as MaxRate
FROM bmf_borrow_data
WHERE PublishDate in (select top 10 * from (select distinct PublishDate from BMF_Borrow_Data) a order by PublishDate desc)
    AND EsteeID IN (SELECT Member_Estee_ID FROM indextable WHERE Estee_ID LIKE '%01BR04%' AND AsOfDate = @LatestDate)
GROUP BY EsteeID,Ticker
ORDER BY PublishDate
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_getClientMarginSummary

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_getClientMarginSummary]  
@date datetime,  
@accountId int,  
@listSubStrategyID varchar(max),  
@spanId varchar(10),
@Exchange_code varchar(10)
AS  
Begin  
 Create table #tmp  
 (  
 Exchange_Code varchar(5),  
 SecurityName varchar(50),  
 Long decimal(30,15),  
 Short decimal(30,15),  
 TransactionCost Decimal(30,15),  
 Account_ID int,  
 SecurityType varchar(50),  
 Estee_ID varchar(50),  
 Sub_StrategyID int,  
 BROKER_ID int,  
 PositionDate dateTime,  
 AverageTradedPrice decimal(30,15),  
 BuyValue decimal(30,15),  
 SellValue decimal(30,15),  
 AverageHoldingPrice decimal(30,15),  
 Rule_Id int  
 )  
 INSERT INTO #tmp  
 Exec GetAllPositionsForGivenDate @date, 1, @listSubStrategyID, @Exchange_code, '', '', ''   
 Delete from #tmp where Long - Short = 0  
  
 Select MAX(e.Underlying_Ticker) AS Product, MAX(e.Option_Type) AS [Product type], MAX(e.Strike_Price) Strike_Price,   
 MAX(e.Expiry_Date) Expiry_Date, SUM(Long - Short) AS NETPostion,  
 MAX(srv.r1),MAX(srv.r2),MAX(srv.r3),MAX(srv.r4),MAX(srv.r5),MAX(srv.r6),MAX(srv.r7),MAX(srv.r8),MAX(srv.r9),MAX(srv.r10),MAX(srv.r11),MAX(srv.r12),MAX(srv.r13),MAX(srv.r14),MAX(srv.r15),MAX(srv.r16),MAX(SP.LTP) AS LTP,  
 MAX(cp.LTP) AS UNDLTP, MAX(ISNULL(mt1.ExposureMarginOptions, ISNULL(mt3.ExposureMarginOptions, mt2.ExposureMarginOptions))) AS ELM, MAX(SUC.SpreadCharge) AS SPREADCHARGE, MAX(SP.compositeDelta) AS CompositeDelta  
 from #tmp (nolock) gdp   
 INNER JOIN esteemaster (nolock) e on e.Estee_ID = gdp.Estee_ID  and e.Status = 1  
 INNER JOIN SpanData sp (nolock) on gdp.Estee_ID = sp.esteeID   
 INNER JOIN SpanRiskValues (nolock) srv ON gdp.Estee_ID = srv.esteeID and srv.date= sp.date and srv.spanID = sp.spanID  
 INNER JOIN SpanUndCharge (nolock) suc on suc.esteeID = e.underlyingEstee_id and suc.date = sp.date and suc.spanID = sp.spanID  
 left join MarginTable (nolock) mt1 on mt1.Estee_id = sp.esteeID and mt1.AsOfDate = sp.date  
 left join MarginTable (nolock) mt3 on mt3.Estee_id = e.underlyingEstee_id and mt3.AsOfDate = sp.date  
 left join MarginTable (nolock) mt2 on mt2.Estee_id = e.underlyingEstee_id and mt2.AsOfDate = '0001-01-01'  
 INNER JOIN SpanData (nolock) cp on cp.esteeID = suc.esteeID and cp.spanID = suc.spanID and cp.Date = srv.date  
 where sp.date = @date and sp.spanID = @spanId and gdp.Account_ID = @accountId  
 Group by e.Estee_ID  
  
 drop table #tmp  
End  
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_GetEsteeIDbyExpiry

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_GetEsteeIDbyExpiry
(
@date Date,
@excode varchar(32),
@volume int,
@ointerest int,
@sectype varchar(32),
@monthstoadd int
)
as
select em.estee_id, Expiry_Date, Month(expiry_date) as MonthOfExpiry, Volume,Open_Interest from esteemaster em join closingprice cp 
on em.estee_id = cp.estee_id
where Date = @date 
and Security_Type = @sectype
and Expiry_Date <= DateAdd(mm,@monthstoadd,GETDATE())
and exchange_code = @excode
and ( Volume > @volume and Open_Interest > @ointerest)
order by Expiry_Date
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_GetGSShortLocatesForFixClientCM

```sql

CREATE  PROCEDURE   
[sp_GetGSShortLocatesForFixClientCM]   
@Date DATE,
@StrategyName varchar (30),
@Source varchar (30),
@ExchangeCode varchar (10)
AS  
 BEGIN   
	DECLARE @ExSegment varchar(2) = 'CM';

select
	gslr.TradeDate,
	gslr.ISIN,
	gslr.Quantity_Filled,
	gslr.Status,
	gslr.RequestId,
	e.Estee_ID
from GSSecurityLendingLocatesResponse gslr
inner join esteemaster e
	on e.ISIN = gslr.ISIN
	and e.Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode
	and e.Security_Type = 0
inner join ValidCombos vc
	on vc.SecurityType = e.Security_Type
	and vc.ExchangeCode = @ExchangeCode
	and vc.IsTraded = 1
	and vc.ExSegment = @ExSegment
WHERE  gslr.TradeDate = @date and gslr.StrategyName = @StrategyName and gslr.source = @Source
END 

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_getHaircutForSubStrategy

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_getHaircutForSubStrategy
    @SubStrategyID INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT 
        ca.ClearingAccountID, 
        ca.haircut
    FROM 
        StrategyBrokerAccount sba
    JOIN 
        Account a ON sba.AccountID = a.Account_ID
    JOIN 
        ClearingAccount ca ON a.ClearingAccountID = ca.ClearingAccountID
    WHERE 
        sba.SubStrategyID = @SubStrategyID;
END;

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_GetIDsBuffer

```sql
-- =============================================  
-- Author:  Saurabh Garg  
-- Create date: 27th June 2010  
-- Description: This stored procedure would return buffer of IDs and   
-- insert a row in tblAllocatedIDs  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetIDsBuffer]  
 -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here  
 @IdType int,  
 @Sub_Strategy_ID int,  
 @IncrementValue int,  
 @newMax int OUTPUT
  
AS  
BEGIN  
 -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from  
 -- interfering with SELECT statements.  
 SET NOCOUNT ON;  
    -- Insert statements for procedure here  
--SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE  
BEGIN TRANSACTION  
BEGIN TRY  
SELECT * FROM AllocatedIDs WITH (TABLOCKX, HOLDLOCK) WHERE 1=0  
DECLARE @presentMaxID int  
--declare @currentDate date  
DECLARE @initialExchangewiseSeedID int  
set @initialExchangewiseSeedID = 0  
SELECT @initialExchangewiseSeedID = AllocatedIdsSeed FROM AllocatedIDs_Exchangewise_Seed  
 
 IF(@IdType = 1)  
  BEGIN  
   SELECT @presentMaxID = max(Max_Order_ID) FROM AllocatedIDs   
 if(@presentMaxID is NULL)  
 set @presentMaxID = @initialExchangewiseSeedID   
   IF(@IncrementValue > 0)  
   BEGIN  
    INSERT INTO AllocatedIDs (Min_Order_ID, Max_Order_ID, Sub_Strategy_ID)  
    VALUES (@presentMaxID + 1, @presentMaxID + @IncrementValue, @Sub_Strategy_ID)  
   END  
  END  
  
 ELSE IF(@IdType = 2)   
  BEGIN  
   SELECT @presentMaxID = max(Max_OrderTrade_ID) FROM AllocatedIDs  
 if(@presentMaxID is NULL)  
 set @presentMaxID = @initialExchangewiseSeedID   
   IF(@IncrementValue > 0)  
   BEGIN  
    INSERT INTO AllocatedIDs (Min_OrderTrade_ID, Max_OrderTrade_ID, Sub_Strategy_ID)  
    VALUES (@presentMaxID + 1, @presentMaxID + @IncrementValue, @Sub_Strategy_ID)  
   END  
  END  
  
 ELSE IF(@IdType = 3)   
  BEGIN  
   SELECT @presentMaxID = max(Max_Trade_ID) FROM AllocatedIDs   
 if(@presentMaxID is NULL)  
 set @presentMaxID = @initialExchangewiseSeedID   
   IF(@IncrementValue > 0)  
   BEGIN  
    INSERT INTO AllocatedIDs (Min_Trade_ID, Max_Trade_ID, Sub_Strategy_ID)  
    VALUES (@presentMaxID + 1, @presentMaxID + @IncrementValue, @Sub_Strategy_ID)  
   END  
  END  
  
 SELECT @newMax = (@presentMaxID + @IncrementValue)  
  
COMMIT TRANSACTION  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH  
  ROLLBACK TRANSACTION  
  END CATCH;  
END 
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_GetIDsBufferForBackDateOrder

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_GetIDsBufferForBackDateOrder @IdType          INT,
                                                    @Sub_Strategy_ID INT,
                                                    @IncrementValue  INT,
                                                    @creationDate    DATE,
                                                    @newMax          INT OUTPUT
AS
     BEGIN
         SET NOCOUNT ON;
         BEGIN TRANSACTION;
         BEGIN TRY
             DECLARE @presentMaxSeqNo INT;
             DECLARE @presentMaxID INT, @presentMaxID_Archive INT;
             DECLARE @initialExchangewiseSeedID INT;
             SELECT *
             FROM AllocatedIDs WITH (TABLOCKX, HOLDLOCK)
             WHERE 1 = 0; -- dont think we need a table lock, we just need to lock all the rows with the same creation date
             IF @IncrementValue = 0
                 BEGIN
                     SET @IncrementValue = 1;
                 END; -- reset the increment to 1, incase user incorrectly sent it as zero
             SELECT @initialExchangewiseSeedID = ISNULL(AllocatedIdsSeed, 0)
             FROM AllocatedIDs_Exchangewise_Seed;
             IF @IdType = 1
                 BEGIN-- order ID type for Order      
                     SELECT @presentMaxID = MAX(Max_Order_ID)
                     FROM AllocatedIDs
                     WHERE Creation_Date = @creationDate;
                     IF @presentMaxID IS NULL
                         BEGIN
                             SELECT *
                             FROM AllocatedIDs_Archive WITH (TABLOCKX, HOLDLOCK)
                             WHERE 1 = 0; ---lock allocatedids_archive table
                             SELECT @presentMaxID_Archive = MAX(Max_Order_ID), @presentMaxSeqNo = ISNULL(MAX(SequenceNo), 0)
                             FROM AllocatedIDs_Archive
                             WHERE Creation_Date = @creationDate;
                         END;
                     IF @presentMaxID_Archive IS NULL
                        OR @presentMaxID IS NOT NULL
                         BEGIN -- nothing in archive or already an entry in allocated for the date, have to insert in main                           
                             IF @presentMaxID IS NULL
                                 BEGIN
                                     SET @presentMaxID = @initialExchangewiseSeedID;
                                 END; -- initialize presentMaxID in case both allocated and allocated archive do not have any entry for this date
                             INSERT INTO AllocatedIDs(Creation_Date, Min_Order_ID, Max_Order_ID, Sub_Strategy_ID)
                             VALUES(@creationDate, @presentMaxID + 1, @presentMaxID + @IncrementValue, @Sub_Strategy_ID);
                         END;
                     ELSE
                         BEGIN -- have to insert into archive; archive is not null                  
                             INSERT INTO AllocatedIDs_Archive(Creation_Date, Min_Order_ID, Max_Order_ID, Sub_Strategy_ID, SequenceNo, Creation_Time, Archive_Time)
                         VALUES(@creationDate, @presentMaxID_Archive + 1, @presentMaxID_Archive + @IncrementValue, @Sub_Strategy_ID, @presentMaxSeqNo + 1, CONVERT(TIME, Current_TimeStamp), GETDATE());
                         END;
                 END;
             ELSE
                 BEGIN
                     IF @IdType = 2
                         BEGIN-- order ID type for OrderTrade    
                             SELECT @presentMaxID = MAX(Max_OrderTrade_ID)
                             FROM AllocatedIDs
                             WHERE Creation_Date = @creationDate;
                             IF @presentMaxID IS NULL
                                 BEGIN
                                     SELECT *
                                     FROM AllocatedIDs_Archive WITH (TABLOCKX, HOLDLOCK)
                                     WHERE 1 = 0;
                                     SELECT @presentMaxID_Archive = MAX(Max_OrderTrade_ID), @presentMaxSeqNo = ISNULL(MAX(SequenceNo), 0)
                                     FROM AllocatedIDs_Archive
                                     WHERE Creation_Date = @creationDate;
                                 END;
                             IF @presentMaxID_Archive IS NULL
                                OR @presentMaxID IS NOT NULL
                                 BEGIN -- nothing in archive or already an entry in allocated for the date, have to insert in main                           
                                     IF @presentMaxID IS NULL
                                         BEGIN
                                             SET @presentMaxID = @initialExchangewiseSeedID;
                                         END; -- initialize presentMaxID in case both allocated and allocated archive do not have any entry for this date
                                     INSERT INTO AllocatedIDs(Creation_Date, Min_OrderTrade_ID, Max_OrderTrade_ID, Sub_Strategy_ID)
                                     VALUES(@creationDate, @presentMaxID + 1, @presentMaxID + @IncrementValue, @Sub_Strategy_ID);
                                 END;
                             ELSE
                                 BEGIN -- have to insert into archive; archive is not null                  
                                     INSERT INTO AllocatedIDs_Archive(Creation_Date, Min_OrderTrade_ID, Max_OrderTrade_ID, Sub_Strategy_ID, SequenceNo, Creation_Time, Archive_Time)
                                 VALUES(@creationDate, @presentMaxID_Archive + 1, @presentMaxID_Archive + @IncrementValue, @Sub_Strategy_ID, @presentMaxSeqNo + 1, CONVERT(TIME, Current_TimeStamp), GETDATE());
                                 END;
                         END;
                     ELSE
                         BEGIN
                             IF @IdType = 3
                                 BEGIN-- order ID type for Trade      
                                     SELECT @presentMaxID = MAX(Max_Trade_ID)
                                     FROM AllocatedIDs
                                     WHERE Creation_Date = @creationDate;
                                     IF @presentMaxID IS NULL
                                         BEGIN
                                             SELECT *
                                             FROM AllocatedIDs_Archive WITH (TABLOCKX, HOLDLOCK)
                                             WHERE 1 = 0;
                                             SELECT @presentMaxID_Archive = MAX(Max_Trade_ID), @presentMaxSeqNo = ISNULL(MAX(SequenceNo), 0)
                                             FROM AllocatedIDs_Archive
                                             WHERE Creation_Date = @creationDate;
                                         END;
                                     IF @presentMaxID_Archive IS NULL
                                        OR @presentMaxID IS NOT NULL
                                         BEGIN -- nothing in archive or already an entry in allocated for the date, have to insert in main                           
                                             IF @presentMaxID IS NULL
                                                 BEGIN
                                                     SET @presentMaxID = @initialExchangewiseSeedID;
                                                 END; -- initialize presentMaxID in case both allocated and allocated archive do not have any entry for this date
                                             INSERT INTO AllocatedIDs(Creation_Date, Min_Trade_ID, Max_Trade_ID, Sub_Strategy_ID)
                                             VALUES(@creationDate, @presentMaxID + 1, @presentMaxID + @IncrementValue, @Sub_Strategy_ID);
                                         END;
                                     ELSE
                                         BEGIN -- have to insert into archive; archive is not null                  
                                             INSERT INTO AllocatedIDs_Archive(Creation_Date, Min_Trade_ID, Max_Trade_ID, Sub_Strategy_ID, SequenceNo, Creation_Time, Archive_Time)
                                         VALUES(@creationDate, @presentMaxID_Archive + 1, @presentMaxID_Archive + @IncrementValue, @Sub_Strategy_ID, @presentMaxSeqNo + 1, CONVERT(TIME, Current_TimeStamp), GETDATE());
                                         END;
                                 END;
                         END;
                 END;
             IF @presentMaxID IS NOT NULL
                 BEGIN
                     SELECT @newMax = @presentMaxID + @IncrementValue;
                 END;
             ELSE
                 BEGIN
                     SELECT @newMax = @presentMaxID_Archive + @IncrementValue;
                 END;
             COMMIT TRANSACTION;
         END TRY
         BEGIN CATCH
             ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
             DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);
             DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;
             DECLARE @ErrorState INT;
             SELECT @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();
             -- RAISERROR inside the CATCH block will return error information about the original error that caused execution to jump to the CATCH block.  
             RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, -- Message GO.  
             @ErrorSeverity, -- Severity.  
             @ErrorState -- State.  
             );
         END CATCH;
     END;
```
