## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_GetNestConfigurationParams

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetNestConfigurationParams] 
	@applicationID int = 0
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	SELECT Exchange, EMS_Config_ID from tblEMSNestLoginDetails where EMS_Application_ID = @applicationID
	SELECT ConfigParameter, ConfigValue from tblEMSNestConfig where EMS_Config_ID = 
					(SELECT EMS_Config_ID from tblEMSNestLoginDetails where EMS_Application_ID = @applicationID)

	DECLARE @password VARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @userID VARCHAR(40)
	DECLARE @encryptedPassword VARBINARY(MAX)
	--Get userid and encrypted password
	select @encryptedPassword = password, @userid = UserId from tblEMSNestLoginDetails where EMS_Application_ID = @applicationID
	--Decrypt the password before passing on
	EXEC esteeEncryptionKey.dbo.spDecrypt @encryptedPassword, @password output
	SELECT @UserId as UserId, @password as Password
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_getNseMarginSummary

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_getNseMarginSummary]  
@date datetime,  
@accountId int,  
@listSubStrategyID varchar(max),  
@spanId varchar(4)
AS  
Begin  
 Create table #tmp  
 (  
 Exchange_Code varchar(5),  
 SecurityName varchar(50),  
 Long decimal(30,15),  
 Short decimal(30,15),  
 TransactionCost Decimal(30,15),  
 Account_ID int,  
 SecurityType varchar(50),  
 Estee_ID varchar(50),  
 Sub_StrategyID int,  
 BROKER_ID int,  
 PositionDate dateTime,  
 AverageTradedPrice decimal(30,15),  
 BuyValue decimal(30,15),  
 SellValue decimal(30,15),  
 AverageHoldingPrice decimal(30,15),  
 Rule_Id int  
 )  
 INSERT INTO #tmp  
 Exec GetAllPositionsForGivenDate @date, 1, @listSubStrategyID, 'IS', '', '', '' 
 Delete from #tmp where Long - Short = 0
  
 Select MAX(e.Underlying_Ticker) AS Product, MAX(e.Option_Type) AS [Product type], MAX(e.Strike_Price) Strike_Price,   
	MAX(e.Expiry_Date) Expiry_Date, SUM(Long - Short) AS NETPostion,
	MAX(srv.r1),MAX(srv.r2),MAX(srv.r3),MAX(srv.r4),MAX(srv.r5),MAX(srv.r6),MAX(srv.r7),MAX(srv.r8),MAX(srv.r9),MAX(srv.r10),MAX(srv.r11),MAX(srv.r12),MAX(srv.r13),MAX(srv.r14),MAX(srv.r15),MAX(srv.r16),MAX(SP.LTP) AS LTP,  
	MAX(cp.LTP) AS UNDLTP, MAX(ISNULL(mt1.ExposureMarginOptions, ISNULL(mt3.ExposureMarginOptions, mt2.ExposureMarginOptions))) AS ELM, MAX(SUC.SpreadCharge) AS SPREADCHARGE, MAX(SP.compositeDelta) AS CompositeDelta  
	from #tmp (nolock) gdp 
	INNER JOIN esteemaster (nolock) e on e.Estee_ID = gdp.Estee_ID  and e.Status = 1
	INNER JOIN SpanData sp (nolock) on gdp.Estee_ID = sp.esteeID 
	INNER JOIN SpanRiskValues (nolock) srv ON gdp.Estee_ID = srv.esteeID and srv.date= sp.date and srv.spanID = sp.spanID
	INNER JOIN SpanUndCharge (nolock) suc on suc.esteeID = e.underlyingEstee_id and suc.date = sp.date and suc.spanID = sp.spanID  
	left join MarginTable (nolock) mt1 on mt1.Estee_id = sp.esteeID and mt1.AsOfDate = sp.date  
	left join MarginTable (nolock) mt3 on mt3.Estee_id = e.underlyingEstee_id and mt3.AsOfDate = sp.date  
	left join MarginTable (nolock) mt2 on mt2.Estee_id = e.underlyingEstee_id and mt2.AsOfDate = '0001-01-01'  
	INNER JOIN SpanData (nolock) cp on cp.esteeID = suc.esteeID and cp.spanID = suc.spanID and cp.Date = srv.date 
	where sp.date = @date and sp.spanID = @spanId and gdp.Account_ID = @accountId
	Group by e.Estee_ID  
  
 drop table #tmp  
End

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_GetOrdersFilledAndTotalFills

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Saurabh Garg
-- Create date: 2010.08.24
-- Description:	This stored procedure would get total no of orders filled
-- and total fills for a  particular month
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetOrdersFilledAndTotalFills]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
@Month int,
@Year int,
@TotalOrdersFilled int output,
@TotalNoOfFills int output
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	select @TotalOrdersFilled = count(*) from vwalltrades 
	where status in ('Executed','Partially Filled')
	and  Datepart(mm,Creation_Date) = @Month
	and DatePart(yyyy, Creation_Date) = @Year

	select @TotalNoOfFills = count(*) from tblOrderTrail 
	where fill_Qty > 0
	and Datepart(mm,exec_time) = @Month 
	and DatePart(yyyy, exec_time) = @Year
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_GetTop10BuySellScrips

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Saurabh Garg
-- Create date: 2010.08.24
-- Description:	This stored proc would get top 10 buy sell scrips
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetTop10BuySellScrips] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
@month int,
@year int
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	select top 10 sum(traded_price * traded_quantity)/10000000 as TurnOverInCrs,
	underlying_ticker as UnderlyingTicker from vwalltrades 
	where Datepart(mm,Creation_Date) = @month 
	and DatePart(yyyy, Creation_Date) = @year
	and buy_sell_indicator = 1
	and status in ('executed','Partially Filled')
	and (order_Source_Id not in ('Creating Mid Balance', 'Creating Near Trade') 
	or order_Source_Id is NULL)
	--and account_id in (select account_id 
	--from tblBrokerAccount 
	--where is_active =1 
	--and participant_id is null and 
	--account_type = 'CLIENT')
	and account_id in (select A.account_id 
	from Account as A
	inner join tblBrokerAccount as BA
	on A.Account_ID = BA.account_id
	where BA.is_active =1 
	and A.participant_id is null and 
	A.account_type = 'CLIENT')
	group by underlying_ticker
	order by TurnOverInCrs desc

	select top 10 sum(traded_price * traded_quantity)/10000000 as TurnOverInCrs,
	underlying_ticker as UnderlyingTicker from vwalltrades 
	where Datepart(mm,Creation_Date) = @month 
	and DatePart(yyyy, Creation_Date) = @year
	and buy_sell_indicator = 2
	and status in ('executed','Partially Filled')
	and (order_Source_Id not in ('Creating Mid Balance', 'Creating Near Trade') 
	or order_Source_Id is NULL)
	--and account_id in (select account_id 
	--from tblBrokerAccount 
	--where is_active =1 
	--and participant_id is null and 
	--account_type = 'CLIENT')
	and account_id in (select A.account_id 
	from Account as A
	inner join tblBrokerAccount as BA
	on A.Account_ID = BA.account_id 
	where BA.is_active =1 
	and A.participant_id is null and 
	A.account_type = 'CLIENT')
	group by underlying_ticker
	order by TurnOverInCrs desc
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_INDEXDATA

```sql
 CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_INDEXDATA]      
 @IndexEsteeid varchar(50),      
 @datetime date,       
 @Result bit out      
AS      
  
BEGIN       
  
 SELECT     
 ESTEEMASTER.Underlying_Ticker as DictKey,      
 IndexTable.Member_Estee_ID  as Estee_ID,        
 closingprice.Close_Price as ClosePrice,    
 IndexTable.FFMarketCap as FFMktCap,     
 IndexTable.HasChanged as HasChanged,     
 IndexTable.InvestibleFactor as InvestibleFactor,     
 IndexTable.IssueCap as IssueCapital,     
 IndexTable.Weightage as Weightage,     
 ISNULL(IndexTable.CappingFactor,1) as CappingFactor,
 ISNULL(IndexMarketCap, 1) as IndexMarketCap 
 FROM IndexTable            
 LEFT OUTER JOIN esteemaster ON  IndexTable.Member_Estee_ID = esteemaster.Estee_ID  --and esteemaster.exchange_code = 'IS'      
 LEFT OUTER JOIN closingprice ON  IndexTable.Member_Estee_ID = closingprice.Estee_ID  AND closingprice.Date = @datetime    
 WHERE       
 IndexTable.Estee_ID = @IndexEsteeid --'IB0000000001IB04' --      
 AND IndexTable.LastCheckedDate = @datetime --'2011-12-09' --- 
 AND IndexTable.Estee_ID<> IndexTable.Member_Estee_ID     
  --'2011-12-09' ---      
  
END 
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_InsertIntoSecurity_LSCW]
	@PublishDate varchar(40),
	@StrategyID int,
	@EsteeID varchar(40),
	@Ticker varchar(100) = NULL,
	@LSCW decimal(18, 12) = NULL
AS

END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_MSdel_dboDataStoreMetadata

```sql
create procedure [dbo].[sp_MSdel_dboDataStoreMetadata]
		@pkc1 varchar(250),
		@pkc2 varchar(250),
		@pkc3 varchar(50)
as
begin  
	delete [dbo].[DataStoreMetadata]
```

```sql
		[exposureMarginOptions] = case substring(@bitmap,1,1) & 32 when 32 then @c6 else [exposureMarginOptions] end,
		[impliedVolatility] = case substring(@bitmap,1,1) & 64 when 64 then @c7 else [impliedVolatility] end,
		[LTP] = case substring(@bitmap,1,1) & 128 when 128 then @c8 else [LTP] end,
		[dataImportLogID] = case substring(@bitmap,2,1) & 1 when 1 then @c9 else [dataImportLogID] end
where [date] = @pkc1
  and [esteeID] = @pkc2
  and [spanID] = @pkc3
if @@rowcount = 0
    if @@microsoftversion>0x07320000
        exec sp_MSreplraiserror 20598
end 
end
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_renamediagram

```sql
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_renamediagram
	(
		@diagramname 		sysname,
		@owner_id		int	= null,
		@new_diagramname	sysname

	)
	WITH EXECUTE AS 'dbo'
	AS
	BEGIN
		set nocount on
		declare @theId 			int
		declare @IsDbo 			int
	
		declare @UIDFound 		int
		declare @DiagId			int
		declare @DiagIdTarg		int
		declare @u_name			sysname
		if((@diagramname is null) or (@new_diagramname is null))
		begin
			RAISERROR ('Invalid value', 16, 1);
			return -1
		end

		EXECUTE AS CALLER;
		select @theId = DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID();
		select @IsDbo = IS_MEMBER(N'db_owner'); 
		if(@owner_id is null)
			select @owner_id = @theId;
		REVERT;

		select @u_name = USER_NAME(@owner_id)

		select @DiagId = diagram_id, @UIDFound = principal_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @owner_id and name = @diagramname 
		if(@DiagId IS NULL or (@IsDbo = 0 and @UIDFound <> @theId))
		begin
			RAISERROR ('Diagram does not exist or you do not have permission.', 16, 1)
			return -3
		end

		-- if((@u_name is not null) and (@new_diagramname = @diagramname))	-- nothing will change
		--	return 0;

		if(@u_name is null)
			select @DiagIdTarg = diagram_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @theId and name = @new_diagramname
		else
			select @DiagIdTarg = diagram_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @owner_id and name = @new_diagramname

		if((@DiagIdTarg is not null) and  @DiagId <> @DiagIdTarg)
		begin
			RAISERROR ('The name is already used.', 16, 1);
			return -2
		end	

		if(@u_name is null)
			update dbo.sysdiagrams set [name] = @new_diagramname, principal_id = @theId where diagram_id = @DiagId
		else
			update dbo.sysdiagrams set [name] = @new_diagramname where diagram_id = @DiagId
		return 0
	END



```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_SendEmail

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SendEmail]  @ServerAddr varchar(80), 
@FromAddr varchar(80), 
@Recipient varchar(80), 
@Subject varchar(132),
@BodyText varchar(2000),
@nRet int OUTPUT

AS
DECLARE @hr int
DECLARE @oSmtp int
 
EXEC @hr = sp_OACreate 'AOSMTP.Mail',@oSmtp OUT
EXEC @hr = sp_OASetProperty @oSmtp, 'RegisterKey', 'replace this text by your key'
EXEC @hr = sp_OASetProperty @oSmtp, 'ServerAddr', @ServerAddr
EXEC @hr = sp_OASetProperty @oSmtp, 'FromAddr', @FromAddr
EXEC @hr = sp_OAMethod @oSmtp, 'AddRecipient', NULL, @Recipient, @Recipient, 0 
EXEC @hr = sp_OASetProperty @oSmtp, 'Subject', @Subject 
EXEC @hr = sp_OASetProperty @oSmtp, 'BodyText', @BodyText 
 
EXEC @hr = sp_OAMethod @oSmtp, 'SendMail', @nRet OUT 
EXEC @hr = sp_OADestroy @oSmtp

-- @nRet is zero if succeeded, otherwise @nRet is non-zero.

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_Strat_GetResultsDataByIndex

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_Strat_GetResultsDataByIndex
(
@IndexEsteeID as varchar(50),
@lastWorkingDate as varchar(50)
) 

as

select r.Estee_id,Remarks,RelesedDate,DataFeed_Ticker
from ReleasedDate r
join esteemaster e on e.estee_id = r.estee_id
where date >= (CONVERT(date, @lastWorkingDate)) 
and r.estee_id in 
(
select Member_Estee_ID from indextable where asofdate = CONVERT(date, getdate()) 
and estee_id = @IndexEsteeID
)
and relesedDate = CONVERT(date, getdate())
and Remarks like '%Results%'
group by r.Estee_id,Remarks,RelesedDate,DataFeed_Ticker
order by RelesedDate,DataFeed_Ticker

--This stored procedure takes 2 inputs 
--1. The Index ID whose index components need to be checked for results
--2. Last Working Day
--It will query the results table for all results with date >= lastWorkingDate and Result Date = today
--exec sp_Strat_GetResultsDataByIndex 'IN0000000002IS04','20190226'
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_SubscribeAllUnderlying

```sql
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SubscribeAllUnderlying]
    @SubStrategyID INT,
    @Exchange_Code VARCHAR(10) = 'IS',    -- Default: 'IS'
    @Segments VARCHAR(20) = 'FO'                 -- Default: FO
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
   
   -- Create temp table to hold required security types
   CREATE TABLE #ValidSecurityTypes (
   SecurityType int
   );
   -- Get Valid combinations of Security Types for Exchange and Segment
   insert into #ValidSecurityTypes (SecurityType)
   select SecurityType from ValidCombos vc where vc.ExchangeCode = 'IS' and  vc.Segment in ( select items from dbo.Split(@Segments,',')); 

    -- Create temp table to hold Underlying Estee IDs
    CREATE TABLE #UnderlyingEsteeIDs (
        UnderlyingEstee_Id VARCHAR(50) 
    );

    --  Insert into temp table
    INSERT INTO #UnderlyingEsteeIDs (UnderlyingEstee_Id)
    SELECT DISTINCT UnderlyingEstee_Id
    FROM esteemaster
    WHERE Security_Type  in(select * from #ValidSecurityTypes)
      AND Exchange_Code = @Exchange_Code
      AND UnderlyingEstee_Id IS NOT NULL;

    --  Insert if not present
    INSERT INTO subscriptionlist (Estee_Id, NumStrikes, IsSubscribed, SubStrategyID)
    SELECT u.UnderlyingEstee_Id, 1, 1, @SubStrategyID
    FROM #UnderlyingEsteeIDs u
    LEFT JOIN subscriptionlist s
        ON s.Estee_Id = u.UnderlyingEstee_Id
       AND s.SubStrategyID = @SubStrategyID
    WHERE s.Estee_Id IS NULL;

    -- Update if present but IsSubscribed = 0
    UPDATE s
    SET s.IsSubscribed = 1
    FROM subscriptionlist s
    INNER JOIN #UnderlyingEsteeIDs u
        ON s.Estee_Id = u.UnderlyingEstee_Id
    WHERE s.SubStrategyID = @SubStrategyID
      AND s.IsSubscribed = 0;

    -- Clean up temp table
    DROP TABLE #UnderlyingEsteeIDs;

END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.sp_upgraddiagrams

```sql
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_upgraddiagrams
	AS
	BEGIN
		IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.sysdiagrams') IS NOT NULL
			return 0;

		CREATE TABLE dbo.sysdiagrams
		(
			name sysname NOT NULL,
			principal_id int NOT NULL,	-- we may change it to varbinary(85)
			diagram_id int PRIMARY KEY IDENTITY,
			version int,

			definition varbinary(max)
			CONSTRAINT UK_principal_name UNIQUE
			(
				principal_id,
				name
			)
		);


		/* Add this if we need to have some form of extended properties for diagrams */
		/*
		IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.sysdiagram_properties') IS NULL
		BEGIN
			CREATE TABLE dbo.sysdiagram_properties
			(
				diagram_id int,
				name sysname,
				value varbinary(max) NOT NULL
			)
		END
		*/

		IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.dtproperties') IS NOT NULL
		begin
			insert into dbo.sysdiagrams
			(
				[name],
				[principal_id],
				[version],
				[definition]
			)
			select	 
				convert(sysname, dgnm.[uvalue]),
				DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID(N'dbo'),			-- will change to the sid of sa
				0,							-- zero for old format, dgdef.[version],
				dgdef.[lvalue]
			from dbo.[dtproperties] dgnm
				inner join dbo.[dtproperties] dggd on dggd.[property] = 'DtgSchemaGUID' and dggd.[objectid] = dgnm.[objectid]
				inner join dbo.[dtproperties] dgdef on dgdef.[property] = 'DtgSchemaDATA' and dgdef.[objectid] = dgnm.[objectid]
			
			where dgnm.[property] = 'DtgSchemaNAME' and dggd.[uvalue] like N'_EA3E6268-D998-11CE-9454-00AA00A3F36E_' 
			return 2;
		end
		return 1;
	END



```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spAdjustOddLotIntoRoundLot

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAdjustOddLotIntoRoundLot]        
@tradeDate date,  
@exgCode varchar(2)  
As  
BEGIN  
if @exgCode != 'BR'  
 return  
BEGIN TRY  
BEGIN TRANSACTION  
declare  @rowsCount int, @MaxRows int  
declare @Account_Id int, @ssid int, @eid nvarchar(50), @bs int, @ordQty int, @ordPrice decimal(20,6), @emsID int  
declare  @Order_ID int, @OrderTrade_ID int, @Trade_ID int, @Order_Type char, @Order_Validity int, @Price_Diff decimal(20,6), @Order_Source_ID varchar(50)  
declare  @Remarks varchar(100), @Comb_Status varchar(50), @status varchar(50), @isLast bit, @Original_Order_ID int, @New_Cancel_Modify varchar(1)  
declare  @Created_By int, @Updated_By int, @LinkIDOut int, @NewOrderID int, @Creation_Time DateTime  
select Account_ID, Sub_Strategy_ID, Estee_ID, sum((3- 2*Buy_Sell_Indicator) * Traded_Quantity) NetPos into #TempTrades from vwalltrades   
where creation_date = @tradeDate and status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and Estee_ID like 'ZZ%00'  
group by Account_ID, Sub_Strategy_ID, Estee_ID  
having sum((3- 2*Buy_Sell_Indicator) * Traded_Quantity) <> 0  
declare @tradeTable Table (RowNum int IDENTITY(1,1), Account_Id int, Sub_Strategy_Id int, Estee_Id nvarchar(50), Buy_Sell_Indicator int, Qty int, AvgPrice decimal(20,6), EmsId int, primary key (Account_Id, Sub_Strategy_Id, Estee_Id, Buy_Sell_Indicator))  
insert into @tradeTable (Account_Id, Sub_Strategy_Id, Estee_Id, Buy_Sell_Indicator, Qty, AvgPrice, EmsId)  
select vw.Account_ID, vw.Sub_Strategy_ID, vw.Estee_ID, vw.Buy_Sell_Indicator, sum(Traded_Quantity) Qty, sum(Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price)/sum(Traded_Quantity) AvgPrice, ems_id from   
vwAllTrades vw inner join #TempTrades t on vw.Account_ID = t.Account_Id and vw.Sub_Strategy_ID = t.Sub_Strategy_Id and vw.Estee_ID=t.Estee_Id  
where vw.Creation_Date = @tradeDate and vw.status in ('Executed','Partially Filled')  
group by vw.Account_ID, vw.Sub_Strategy_ID, vw.Estee_ID, vw.Buy_Sell_Indicator, ems_id  
set @rowsCount = 1  
select @MaxRows=count(*) from @tradeTable  
while @rowsCount <= @MaxRows   
begin  
  select @Account_Id = Account_Id, @ssid = Sub_Strategy_Id, @eid=Estee_Id, @bs = Buy_Sell_Indicator, @ordQty = Qty, @ordPrice = AvgPrice, @emsID = EmsId   
  from @tradeTable where RowNum = @rowsCount  
  declare @roundLotEsteeId nvarchar(50)  
  set @roundLotEsteeId = 'BR' + substring(@eid, 3,14)  
  set @order_type = 1; set @order_validity = 0; set @price_diff = 0; set @order_source_id = 'Balancing Odd lot trades'  
  set @Remarks = 'Trade move from odd lot estee Id to round lot estee Id'  
  set @comb_status = 'Complete'; set @status = 'Executed'; set @isLast = 1; set @Original_Order_id = NULL  
  set @New_Cancel_Modify = 'N'; set @created_by = ''; set @updated_by = ''; set @neworderID = 0  
  set @creation_time = DATEADD(hh,09,cast(@tradeDate as datetime))   
  if exists (select 1 from EsteeMaster (nolock) where Estee_Id = @roundLotEsteeId)  
  begin  
   declare @oddLotBuySellIndicatorForBalancing int  
   if @bs = 1 begin  
    set @oddLotBuySellIndicatorForBalancing = 2 end  
   else begin  
    set @oddLotBuySellIndicatorForBalancing = 1 end    
    exec sp_GetIDsBuffer '1',@ssid,'1',@Order_ID out       
    exec sp_GetIDsBuffer '2',@ssid,'1',@OrderTrade_ID out      
    exec sp_GetIDsBuffer '3',@ssid,'1',@Trade_ID out  
    exec spCreateOrder_move @order_type, @order_validity, @price_diff, 3, @account_id, @order_source_id, @Remarks,        
    @ssid, @comb_status, '', @status, @isLast, @Original_Order_id, @New_Cancel_Modify, @created_by,        
    @updated_by, @neworderID, @creation_time,null, -1, @LinkIDOut out, null, @eid, @oddLotBuySellIndicatorForBalancing, @ordQty, @ordPrice,        
    @Creation_Time, @Order_ID, @OrderTrade_ID, @Trade_ID ,@emsID  
    exec sp_GetIDsBuffer '1',@ssid,'1',@Order_ID out       
    exec sp_GetIDsBuffer '2',@ssid,'1',@OrderTrade_ID out      
    exec sp_GetIDsBuffer '3',@ssid,'1',@Trade_ID out  
    set @order_source_id = 'New Balancing Round lot trades'   
    exec spCreateOrder_move @order_type, @order_validity, @price_diff, 3, @account_id, @order_source_id, @Remarks,        
    @ssid, @comb_status, '', @status, @isLast, @Original_Order_id, @New_Cancel_Modify, @created_by,        
    @updated_by, @neworderID, @creation_time,null, -1, @LinkIDOut out, null, @roundLotEsteeId, @bs, @ordQty, @ordPrice,  
    @Creation_Time, @Order_ID, @OrderTrade_ID, @Trade_ID ,@emsID  
  end   
  Select @rowsCount = @rowsCount + 1   
end  
drop table #TempTrades  
COMMIT TRANSACTION  
END TRY  
BEGIN CATCH  
 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION  
 DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);    
   DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;    
   DECLARE @ErrorState INT;    
   SELECT @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),    
       @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),    
       @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();         
   RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage, -- Message text.    
        @ErrorSeverity, -- Severity.    
        @ErrorState -- State.    
        );    
END CATCH  
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spArchiveSpanData

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spArchiveSpanData] @startDate date, @endDate date
AS
	BEGIN

		Declare @error int

		Begin Transaction
	
		Insert into estee_archive.dbo.SpanUndCharge
		Select * from estee.dbo.SpanUndCharge Where Date between @startDate and @endDate
		set @error = @@ERROR		
		if @error <> 0 begin
			RAISERROR('error inserting records into SpanUndCharge', 0, 1) WITH NOWAIT		
			goto error_handler
		end	

		Delete from estee.dbo.SpanUndCharge where date  between @startDate and @endDate
		set @error = @@ERROR		
		if @error <> 0 begin
			RAISERROR('error deleting records from SpanUndCharge', 0, 1) WITH NOWAIT		
			goto error_handler
		end	
	
		Commit transaction
			

		Begin Transaction
	
		Insert into estee_archive.dbo.spanriskarray
		Select * from estee.dbo.spanriskarray Where Date between @startDate and @endDate
		set @error = @@ERROR		
		if @error <> 0 begin
			RAISERROR('error inserting records into spanriskarray', 0, 1) WITH NOWAIT		
			goto error_handler
		end	

		Delete from estee.dbo.spanriskarray where date  between @startDate and @endDate
		set @error = @@ERROR		
		if @error <> 0 begin
			RAISERROR('error deleting records from spanriskarray', 0, 1) WITH NOWAIT		
			goto error_handler
		end	
	
		Commit transaction


		Begin Transaction
	
		Insert into estee_archive.dbo.SpanData
		Select * from estee.dbo.SpanData Where Date between @startDate and @endDate
		set @error = @@ERROR		
		if @error <> 0 begin
			RAISERROR('error inserting records into SpanData', 0, 1) WITH NOWAIT		
			goto error_handler
		end	

		Delete from estee.dbo.SpanUndCharge where date  between @startDate and @endDate
		set @error = @@ERROR		
		if @error <> 0 begin
			RAISERROR('error deleting records from SpanData', 0, 1) WITH NOWAIT		
			goto error_handler
		end	
	
		Commit transaction

	error_handler:
		print 'error during execution, error number - ' + cast(@error as nvarchar(500))
		if @@TRANCOUNT <> 0 begin		
			print 'rolling back transaction'
			rollback transaction
		end
	
	END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spBODQueries

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Vishen
-- Create date: 12/16/2011
-- Description:	gets counts from tables required for BOD/EOD on a given date and from a given exchange
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spBODQueries] 
	@date1 datetime,
	@date2 datetime,
	@date3 datetime,
	@spanID varchar(10) = '00',
	@exCode varchar(10) = 'IS'

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
		declare @counter int = 0;
		declare @date datetime;

		while (@counter < 3)
		begin

		set @date = 
			case @counter
				when 0 then @date1
				when 1 then @date2
				when 2 then @date3
			end
		
		set @counter = @counter + 1;
	
		select @date as [Date],* from 
		(
		select count(*) as number, 'esteemaster' as name from esteemaster where last_update_time >= @date and Exchange_Code = @exCode
		union all 
		select count(*) as number, 'esteemaster_backup'  as name from esteemaster_backup where last_update_time >= @date and Exchange_Code = @exCode
		union all
		select count(*) as number, 'corporateactiontable'  as name from corporateactiontable where lastupdatetime >= @date
		union all
		select count(*) as number, 'dailypositions'  as name from dailypositions where positiondate >= @date
		union all
		select count(*) as number, 'dailyvolatilitytable'  as name from dailyvolatilitytable where date >= @date
		union all
		select count(*) as number, 'closingprice'  as name from closingprice where date = @date
		union all
		select COUNT(*) as number, 'SpanData'  as name from  SpanData where date='2011-12-15' and spanID=@spanID
		union all
		select count(*) as number, 'SpanRiskArray'  as name from SpanRiskArray where date='2011-12-15' and spanID=@spanID
		union all
		select count(*) as number, 'SpanUndCharge'  as name from SpanUndCharge where date='2011-12-15' and spanID=@spanID
		) as srcTable
		Pivot 
		(
		sum(number)
		for name in (esteemaster, esteemaster_backup,corporateactiontable,dailypositions ,dailyvolatilitytable ,closingprice ,spandata ,spanriskarray ,	spanUndCharge)
		) as pvt
		end
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spBulkUpdateOrder

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spBulkUpdateOrder]
@bulkUpdate BulkOrderUpdates READONLY,
@creationDate DATE

AS
BEGIN
BEGIN TRANSACTION

	DECLARE @OrderId INT
	DECLARE @OrderTradeId INT
	DECLARE @TradeId INT
	DECLARE @OrderQty DECIMAL (20,2)
	DECLARE @OrderPrice DECIMAL (20,6)
	DECLARE @StopPrice DECIMAL(20,6)
	DECLARE @PriceDiff DECIMAL(20,6)
	DECLARE @OriginalOrderTradeId INT
	DECLARE @TradeId2 INT
	DECLARE @OrderQty2 DECIMAL(20,2)
	DECLARE @OrderPrice2 DECIMAL(20,6)
	DECLARE @TradeId3 INT
	DECLARE @OrderQty3 DECIMAL(20,2)
	DECLARE @OrderPrice3 DECIMAL(20,6)

	DECLARE cur CURSOR FOR SELECT OrderId, OrderTradeId, TradeId, OrderQty, OrderPrice, StopPrice, PriceDiff, OriginalOrderTradeId, TradeId2, OrderQty2, OrderPrice2, TradeId3, OrderQty3, OrderPrice3 FROM @bulkUpdate
	OPEN cur
	FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @OrderId, @OrderTradeId, @TradeId, @OrderQty, @OrderPrice, @StopPrice, @PriceDiff, @OriginalOrderTradeId, @TradeId2, @OrderQty2, @OrderPrice2, @TradeId3, @OrderQty3, @OrderPrice3
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		UPDATE OrderTrades SET Original_Order_Id = @OriginalOrderTradeId, Price_Diff = @PriceDiff, New_Cancel_Modify = 'M'
			WHERE Order_ID = @OrderId and Creation_date = @creationDate and OrderTrade_ID = @OrderTradeId
		UPDATE Trades SET Order_Quantity = @OrderQty, Order_Price = @OrderPrice, Stop_Price = @StopPrice
			WHERE Order_ID = @OrderId and Creation_date = @creationDate and OrderTrade_ID = @OrderTradeId and Trade_ID = @TradeId
		if(@TradeId2 <> 0)
			UPDATE Trades SET Order_Quantity = @OrderQty2, Order_Price = @OrderPrice2
				WHERE Order_ID = @OrderId and Creation_date = @creationDate and OrderTrade_ID = @OrderTradeId and Trade_ID = @TradeId2
		if(@TradeId3 <> 0)
			UPDATE Trades SET Order_Quantity = @OrderQty3, Order_Price = @OrderPrice3
				WHERE Order_ID = @OrderId and Creation_date = @creationDate and OrderTrade_ID = @OrderTradeId and Trade_ID = @TradeId3
		FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @OrderId, @OrderTradeId, @TradeId, @OrderQty, @OrderPrice, @StopPrice, @PriceDiff, @OriginalOrderTradeId, @TradeId2, @OrderQty2, @OrderPrice2, @TradeId3, @OrderQty3, @OrderPrice3
	END
	DEALLOCATE cur

COMMIT TRANSACTION
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spBulkUpdateTC

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spBulkUpdateTC]
@bulkTC BulkTransactionCost READONLY,
@creationDate DATE
AS
BEGIN
BEGIN TRANSACTION

	DECLARE @OrderId INT
	DECLARE @OrderTradeId INT
	DECLARE @TradeId INT
	DECLARE @ExecID varchar(200)
	DECLARE @TransactionCost DECIMAL (20,6)
	DECLARE @Brokerage DECIMAL(20,6)
	DECLARE cur CURSOR FOR SELECT TradeId, OrderId, OrderTradeId, ExecId, TransactionCost, Brokerage FROM @bulkTC
	OPEN cur
	FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @TradeId, @OrderId, @OrderTradeId, @ExecId, @TransactionCost, @Brokerage
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		update trades set transaction_cost=@TransactionCost, brokerage=@Brokerage where trade_id=@TradeId and Creation_Date=@creationDate and Order_ID=@OrderId and OrderTrade_ID=@OrderTradeId and execid=@ExecID
	
		FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @TradeId, @OrderId, @OrderTradeId, @ExecId, @TransactionCost, @Brokerage
	END
	DEALLOCATE cur
COMMIT TRANSACTION
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spCalculateBrokerage

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spCalculateBrokerage]   
	@startday date,
	@endday date,
	@account_id int
   
AS  
BEGIN  

	declare @brokerage decimal (20,8)
	set @brokerage = 0.0000125 -- set to zero right now in brokerage table, will get it from the table once fixed

	SELECT 
	  cast( sum(        
	   (vw.Traded_Quantity) *        
	   (case        
		when isnull(e.security_type, ea.Security_Type) in (2, 3, 6, 7, 12, 13) then        
		 isnull(e.strike_price, ea.Strike_Price) + vw.Traded_Price
		else          
		 vw.traded_price        
		end        
	   )        
	  ) * @brokerage as decimal (10,2))
	  
	  as Brokerage    
	  from vwAllTrades vw with (nolock)
	  left join esteemaster e with (nolock) on e.estee_id = vw.estee_id and e.Status = 1  
	  left join EsteeMaster_archive ea with (nolock) on vw.estee_id = ea.estee_id and ea.Status = 1  
	  where vw.Creation_Date >= @startday and vw.Creation_Date < @endday   
	  and vw.status  in ('Executed', 'Partially Filled')        
	 and vw.Account_ID = @account_id
   
END

```

```sql
insert into @out (Datatype,CurrentValue,Refvalue)
--MCX_ClosingPrice_Upload : for previous day
SELECT 'Closing Price',COUNT(*) ,150  FROM closingprice(nolock) where Date>=@prevworkday and Estee_ID like '%MX%'
--MCX_DailyMargin_Upload (11.3 - 8:20)
insert into @out (Datatype,CurrentValue,Refvalue)
select 'MCX DailyMargin',COUNT(*),122 from CommodityDailyMargin where asofdate = @today
insert into @out (Datatype,CurrentValue,Refvalue)
--MCX_EquitySpan_Upload : for today
select 'MCX EOD Span Data', COUNT(*) ,160  from SpanData with (nolock) where date >= @prevworkday and spanID = '08' and substring(esteeid,13,2) = 'MX'
insert into @out (Datatype,CurrentValue,Refvalue)
select 'MCX BOD Span Data', COUNT(*) ,160  from SpanData with (nolock) where date >= @today and spanID = '01' and substring(esteeid,13,2) = 'MX'
insert into @out (Datatype,CurrentValue,Refvalue)
select 'MCX EOD Span Risk Array', COUNT(*) ,2600  from SpanRiskArray with (nolock)  where date >= @prevworkday and spanID = '08' and substring(esteeid,13,2) = 'MX'
insert into @out (Datatype,CurrentValue,Refvalue)
select 'MCX BOD Span Risk Array', COUNT(*) ,2600  from SpanRiskArray with (nolock)  where date >= @today and spanID = '01' and substring(esteeid,13,2) = 'MX'
insert into @out (Datatype,CurrentValue,Refvalue)
select 'MCX EOD Span Underlying Charge', COUNT(*) ,37  from SpanUndCharge with (nolock)  where date >= @prevworkday and spanID = '08' and substring(esteeid,13,2) = 'MX'
insert into @out (Datatype,CurrentValue,Refvalue)
select 'MCX BOD Span Underlying Charge', COUNT(*) ,37  from SpanUndCharge with (nolock)  where date >= @today and spanID = '01' and substring(esteeid,13,2) = 'MX'

--TC
insert into @out (Datatype,CurrentValue,Refvalue)
select 'Transaction cost',COUNT(*),0 from vwAllTrades (nolock) where Creation_Date > @prevworkday
and status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and Transaction_Cost != 0	-- it should be around 5k

--Positions
insert into @out (Datatype,CurrentValue,Refvalue)
select 'DailyPositions',COUNT(*),35 from DailyPositions where positiondate = @prevworkday and Exchange_Code = 'MX'
select * from @out
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spCheckBODData_NSE

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spCheckBODData_NSE]                                              
 @today date,                                              
 @prevworkday date,                                              
 @daybeforeprevworkday date                                               
AS                                              
BEGIN                                              
 declare @out table (ID int IDENTITY(1,1),Datatype varchar(100),Securitytype int,CatgType int,[Date] date, CurrentCount int, PrevdayCount int null, Remarks varchar(200))                                         
/*NSE SecurityMaster */                                 
IF EXISTS                           
 (select * from esteemaster with (nolock) where AsOfDate >= @prevworkday and Source = 'NSE_SecurityMaster_Upload')                              
BEGIN                              
insert into @out (datatype,Securitytype,CatgType, date, CurrentCount,PrevdayCount,Remarks)                                    
select 'EsteeMaster ' + Exchange_Code,Security_Type,1, @prevworkday, count(*),'','NSE_SecurityMaster_Upload Job ran successfully' from esteemaster with (nolock) where AsOfDate >= @prevworkday and Source = 'NSE_SecurityMaster_Upload' group by Exchange_Code
,Security_Type order by Security_Type                      
           
update @out set PrevdayCount = '1135' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS' and Securitytype = 0       
update @out set PrevdayCount = '415'  where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'   and Securitytype = 1    
update @out set PrevdayCount = '15550' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'  and Securitytype = 2    
update @out set PrevdayCount = '15550' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'  and Securitytype = 3   
update @out set PrevdayCount = '15' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'   and Securitytype = 4      
update @out set PrevdayCount = '40' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'  and Securitytype =  5       
update @out set PrevdayCount = '2000' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS' and Securitytype = 6      
update @out set PrevdayCount = '2000' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'  and Securitytype =  7      
update @out set PrevdayCount = '275'  where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'  and Securitytype = 8       
update @out set PrevdayCount = '35' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'   and Securitytype = 9         
update @out set PrevdayCount = '5' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'   and Securitytype = 10       
update @out set PrevdayCount = '50' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'   and Securitytype = 11      
update @out set PrevdayCount = '270' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'   and Securitytype = 12      
update @out set PrevdayCount = '270' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'   and Securitytype = 13        
update @out set PrevdayCount = '1' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'   and Securitytype = 15        
update @out set PrevdayCount = '4' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'   and Securitytype = 16        
update @out set PrevdayCount = '1' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'   and Securitytype = 17      
update @out set PrevdayCount = '2' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'   and Securitytype = 18      
update @out set PrevdayCount = '4' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'   and Securitytype = 22      
update @out set PrevdayCount = '181' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'   and Securitytype = 23               
END                              
ELSE                               
insert into @out values ('EsteeMaster IS','',1, @prevworkday, 0,41000,'NSE_SecurityMaster_Upload Job Failed,Run Job on 11.3')                              
                             
/*ETF Components Count */                          
IF EXISTS                           
(select * from esteemaster with (nolock)  where AsOfDate >= @prevworkday and instrument_type = 1)                              
BEGIN                                 
insert into @out (datatype,Securitytype,CatgType, date, CurrentCount,PrevdayCount,Remarks)                                
select 'EsteeMaster -ETF' + Exchange_Code,Security_Type,1, @prevworkday, count(*),38,'ETF Component Count' from esteemaster with (nolock) where AsOfDate >= @prevworkday  and instrument_type = 1 and Source in ('NSE_SecurityMaster_Upload','BB_SecurityMaster
_Upload')                          
group by Exchange_Code,Security_Type                              
order by Security_Type                                    
END                              
ELSE                               
insert into @out values ('EsteeMaster IS','',1, @prevworkday, 0,37,'ETF Components not Uploaded in esteemaster')                                 
                               
/* Closing prices */                              
IF EXISTS                           
(select * from closingprice with (nolock) where Date = @prevworkday and  substring(estee_id,13,2) = 'IS')                              
BEGIN                                 
insert into @out (datatype,Securitytype,CatgType, date, CurrentCount,PrevdayCount,Remarks)                                
                                  
select 'Closing Price ' + 'IS',SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2),1, @prevworkday, COUNT(*),'','Closing Price Upload job on 11.3' from closingprice  with (nolock) where date = @prevworkday and SUBSTRING(estee_id,13,2) = 'IS' group by SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2) order 
by SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2)                                 
                                    
update @out set PrevdayCount = (select COUNT(*) from closingprice where Date = @daybeforeprevworkday and  substring(estee_id,13,2) = 'IS' and SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2) = 0) where Datatype = 'Closing Price IS' and Securitytype = 0   
update @out set PrevdayCount = (select COUNT(*) from closingprice where Date = @daybeforeprevworkday and  substring(estee_id,13,2) = 'IS' and SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2) = 1) where Datatype = 'Closing Price IS' and Securitytype = 1  
update @out set PrevdayCount = (select COUNT(*) from closingprice where Date = @daybeforeprevworkday and  substring(estee_id,13,2) = 'IS' and SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2) = 2) where Datatype = 'Closing Price IS' and Securitytype = 2    
update @out set PrevdayCount = (select COUNT(*) from closingprice where Date = @daybeforeprevworkday and  substring(estee_id,13,2) = 'IS' and SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2) = 3) where Datatype = 'Closing Price IS' and Securitytype = 3   
update @out set PrevdayCount = (select COUNT(*) from closingprice where Date = @daybeforeprevworkday and  substring(estee_id,13,2) = 'IS' and SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2) = 4) where Datatype = 'Closing Price IS' and Securitytype = 4   
update @out set PrevdayCount = (select COUNT(*) from closingprice where Date = @daybeforeprevworkday and  substring(estee_id,13,2) = 'IS' and SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2) = 5) where Datatype = 'Closing Price IS' and Securitytype = 5  
update @out set PrevdayCount = (select COUNT(*) from closingprice where Date = @daybeforeprevworkday and  substring(estee_id,13,2) = 'IS' and SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2) = 6) where Datatype = 'Closing Price IS' and Securitytype = 6  
update @out set PrevdayCount = (select COUNT(*) from closingprice where Date = @daybeforeprevworkday and  substring(estee_id,13,2) = 'IS' and SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2) = 7) where Datatype = 'Closing Price IS' and Securitytype = 7  
update @out set PrevdayCount = (select COUNT(*) from closingprice where Date = @daybeforeprevworkday and  substring(estee_id,13,2) = 'IS' and SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2) = 10) where Datatype = 'Closing Price IS' and Securitytype = 10   
update @out set PrevdayCount = (select COUNT(*) from closingprice where Date = @daybeforeprevworkday and  substring(estee_id,13,2) = 'IS' and SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2) = 11) where Datatype = 'Closing Price IS' and Securitytype = 11    
update @out set PrevdayCount = (select COUNT(*) from closingprice where Date = @daybeforeprevworkday and  substring(estee_id,13,2) = 'IS' and SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2) = 12) where Datatype = 'Closing Price IS' and Securitytype = 12

update @out set PrevdayCount = (select COUNT(*) from closingprice where Date = @daybeforeprevworkday and  substring(estee_id,13,2) = 'IS' and SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2) = 23) where Datatype = 'Closing Price IS' and Securitytype = 23

insert into @out (datatype,Securitytype,CatgType, date, CurrentCount,PrevdayCount,Remarks)                                               
select 'Closing Price - NSE Indices',4,2,@prevworkday, COUNT(*),'','Index Closingprice' from closingprice  with (nolock)                              
where date = @prevworkday and Estee_ID like '%IS04%'                                             
update @out set PrevdayCount = (select COUNT(*) from closingprice  with (nolock) where date = @daybeforeprevworkday and Estee_ID like '%IS04%')  where datatype = 'Closing Price - NSE Indices' and Securitytype = 4

where date = @prevworkday and Estee_ID like '%IS10%'                                             
update @out set PrevdayCount = (select COUNT(*) from closingprice  with (nolock) where date = @daybeforeprevworkday and Estee_ID like '%IS10%')  where datatype = 'Closing Price - NSE Currency' and Securitytype = 10                              
END

where AsOfDate=@today and exchange_code = 'IS' group by 'Price Band (' + Exchange_Code + ')'                                
                              
update @out set PrevdayCount =(select count(*) from pricebands with (nolock) where Cast(AsOfDate as DATE) = @prevworkday and  exchange_code = 'IS') where Datatype = 'Price Band (IS)'

select'Price Band (' + Exchange_Code + ') having 0 value ',substring(estee_id,15,2) ,1,@today, COUNT(*),148,'Should be Blank - lower or Upper band is zero' from PriceBands               
where AsOfDate=@today and exchange_code = 'IS' and (LowerBandValue = 0.0 or UpperBandValue = 0.0) group by 'Price Band (' + Exchange_Code + ') having 0 value ',substring(estee_id,15,2) order by substring(estee_id,15,2)
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spCheckBODData_NSE_CD

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spCheckBODData_NSE_CD]                                                
 @today date,                                                
 @prevworkday date,                                                
 @daybeforeprevworkday date                                                 
AS                                                
BEGIN  
 declare @out table (ID int IDENTITY(1,1),Datatype varchar(100),Securitytype int,[Date] date, CurrentCount int, PrevdayCount int null, Remarks varchar(200))   
 /*NSE SecurityMaster */                                   
IF EXISTS                             
 (select * from esteemaster with (nolock) where AsOfDate >= @prevworkday and Source = 'NSE_SecurityMaster_Upload' and Security_Type in (10,11,12,13))                                
BEGIN                                
insert into @out (datatype,Securitytype,date, CurrentCount,PrevdayCount,Remarks)                                      
select 'EsteeMaster ' + Exchange_Code,Security_Type,@prevworkday, count(*),'','CD-Esteemaster | NSE' from esteemaster with (nolock) where AsOfDate >= @prevworkday and Source = 'NSE_SecurityMaster_Upload' and Security_Type in (10,11,12,13)
group by Exchange_Code,Security_Type 
order by Security_Type   
update @out set PrevdayCount = '4' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'   and Securitytype = 10         
update @out set PrevdayCount = '48' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'   and Securitytype = 11        
update @out set PrevdayCount = '133' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'   and Securitytype = 12        
update @out set PrevdayCount = '133' where [datatype]= 'EsteeMaster IS'   and Securitytype = 13          
END
ELSE                                 
insert into @out values ('EsteeMaster IS','',@prevworkday, 0,41000,'NSE_SecurityMaster_Upload Job Failed,Run Job on 11.3')                                

 /*NSE Closing Price */                                   
IF EXISTS   
(select * from closingprice with (nolock) where Date = @prevworkday and  substring(estee_id,13,2) = 'IS' and substring(estee_id,15,2) in (10,11,12,13))    
BEGIN       
insert into @out (datatype,Securitytype,date, CurrentCount,PrevdayCount,Remarks)      
select 'Closing Price ' + 'IS',SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2),@prevworkday, COUNT(*),'','CD Closing Price Upload job' from closingprice  with (nolock) where date = @prevworkday and SUBSTRING(estee_id,13,2) = 'IS' and substring(estee_id,15,2) in (10,11,12,13)
group by SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2)
order by SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2)    
   
update @out    
set PrevdayCount = x.c     
from @out o    
inner join (select 'Closing Price ' + 'IS' as dt,SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2) as ex,count(*) c from closingprice with (nolock)  where date = @daybeforeprevworkday 
and SUBSTRING(estee_id,13,2) = 'IS' and substring(estee_id,15,2) in (10,11,12,13) group by SUBSTRING(estee_id,15,2)) x  
on x.ex = o.Securitytype
where o.Datatype= x.dt  
END
ELSE                                 
insert into @out values ('Closing price IS','',@prevworkday, 0,350,'NSE_CDClosingprice_Upload Job Failed,Run Job on 11.3')                                

/*NSE BOD CD SPAN DATA*/       

/*SPANDATA*/                    
IF EXISTS (select * from SpanData where date = @today and spanID = 'i01')
BEGIN
insert into @out (datatype,Securitytype, date, CurrentCount,PrevdayCount,Remarks)     
select 'NSE BOD CD Span Data', SUBSTRING(esteeid,15,2),@today, COUNT(*),'','NSE_CDSpan_Upload' from SpanData with (nolock)   
where date = @today and spanID = 'i01'  
group by SUBSTRING(esteeid,15,2)   
order by SUBSTRING(esteeid,15,2)   

update @out    
set PrevdayCount = x.c     
from @out o    
inner join (select 'NSE BOD CD Span Data' as dt, SUBSTRING(esteeid,15,2) as ex,count(*) c from SpanData with (nolock)  where date = @prevworkday and spanID = 'i01'  
group by SUBSTRING(esteeid,15,2)) x    
on x.ex = o.Securitytype  
where o.Datatype=x.dt  
END

/*SPAN RISK ARRAY*/
IF EXISTS (select * from spanriskarray where date = @today and spanID = 'i01')
BEGIN
insert into @out (datatype,Securitytype, date, CurrentCount,PrevdayCount,Remarks)     
select 'NSE BOD CD Spanriskarray Data', SUBSTRING(esteeid,15,2),@today, COUNT(*),'','NSE_CDSpan_Upload' from spanriskarray with (nolock)   
where date = @today and spanID = 'i01'  
group by SUBSTRING(esteeid,15,2)   
order by SUBSTRING(esteeid,15,2)   

update @out    
set PrevdayCount = x.c     
from @out o    
inner join (select 'NSE BOD CD Spanriskarray Data' as dt, SUBSTRING(esteeid,15,2) as ex,count(*) c from spanriskarray with (nolock)  where date = @prevworkday and
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spCheckBODData_Test]      
 @today date,      
 @prevworkday date,      
 @daybeforeprevworkday date       
AS      
BEGIN      
 declare @out table (ID int IDENTITY(1,1), Datatype varchar(100), [Date] date, CurrentVal int, Refval int null, Remarks varchar(100))      
       
 /* EsteeMaster Exchange Code Verification : Usual Count > CG: 23, CO: 14, IB: 38794, IS: 39106, MX: 171, NM: 8, NY: 6 */      
 insert into @out (datatype, date, currentval)       
 select 'EsteeMaster ' + Exchange_Code, @prevworkday, count(*) from esteemaster with (nolock) where AsOfDate >= @prevworkday group by Exchange_Code       
      
 update @out set RefVal = 30000, Remarks = 'Run BSE_SecurityMaster_Upload Job on 11.3' where [datatype] LIKE 'EsteeMaster IB%'      
 update @out set RefVal = 14, Remarks = 'Run BB_SecurityMaster_Upload Job on 11.3'  where [datatype] = 'EsteeMaster CO'  
 update @out set RefVal = 4, Remarks = 'Run BB_SecurityMaster_Upload Job on 11.3'  where [datatype] = 'EsteeMaster BF'  
 update @out set RefVal = 171, Remarks = 'Run MCX_SecurityMaster_Upload Job on 11.3' where [datatype] = 'EsteeMaster MX'           
 update @out set RefVal = 6, Remarks = 'Run BB_SecurityMaster_Upload Job on 11.3'  where [datatype] = 'EsteeMaster RX'  
 update @out set RefVal = 8, Remarks = 'Run BB_SecurityMaster_Upload Job on 11.3'  where [datatype] = 'EsteeMaster NM'  
 update @out set RefVal = 1, Remarks = 'Run BB_SecurityMaster_Upload Job on 11.3'  where [datatype] = 'EsteeMaster LI'      
 update @out set RefVal = 30000, Remarks = 'Run NSE_SecurityMaster_Upload Job on 11.3'  where [datatype] = 'EsteeMaster IS'      
 update @out set RefVal = 14000, Remarks = 'Run MSX_SecurityMaster_Upload_EQ,EDS,CD Job on 11.3'  where [datatype] = 'EsteeMaster MS'  
 update @out set RefVal = 3, Remarks = 'Run BB_SecurityMaster_Upload Job on 11.3'  where [datatype] = 'EsteeMaster DX'   
 update @out set RefVal = 6, Remarks = 'Run BB_SecurityMaster_Upload Job on 11.3'  where [datatype] = 'EsteeMaster NY'      
 update @out set RefVal = 23, Remarks = 'Run BB_SecurityMaster_Upload Job on 11.3'  where [datatype] = 'EsteeMaster CG'      
      
 /* Estee_id which are not in EsteeMaster but in which we have positions */      
 insert into @out (datatype, date, currentval, refval, Remarks)        
 select 'Securities Having Position But are Not in Esteemaster', @prevworkday, COUNT(*), 0,''      
 from dailypositions p with (nolock)       
 left join esteemaster e  with (nolock) on e.Estee_ID = p.Estee_ID       
 where p.PositionDate = @prevworkday and p.Long <> p.Short and e.Estee_ID is null   
   
/* get those securitynames with different estee_id in positions table and esteemaster*/  
insert into @out (datatype, date, currentval, refval, Remarks)  
select 'Securities Having Position and different esteeid in Esteemaster', @prevworkday, COUNT(*), 0,'' from  
( select estee_id,SecurityName,(Long-Short) as Pos,exchange_code from DailyPositions where PositionDate = @prevworkday  
and Long <> Short) Pos  
join   
( select * from esteemaster) E  
on  Pos.SecurityName = E.DataFeed_Ticker where Pos.Estee_ID <> E.Estee_ID and pos.exchange_code = e.exchange_code  
      
 /* Corporate Action */      
 insert into @out (datatype, date, currentval, Refval,Remarks)       
 select 'Corporate Action', @prevworkday, count(*), 10,'Count NA - should be non-zero' from corporateactiontable with (nolock) where lastupdatetime >= @prevworkday      
       
 insert into @out (datatype,date,currentval,Refval,Remarks)      
 select 'Future Corporate Action',@today,COUNT(*),0,'Count NA - Check Details & Take Action' from corporateactiontable with (nolock) where effectivedate > @today and (ActionType like '%split%' or ActionType like '%bonus%')      
             
 /* Daily Positions - make sure positions exist for last night*/     
 insert into @out (datatype, date, currentval,Refval,Remarks)       
 select 'Daily Position', @prevworkday, count(*), 2500,'' from dailypositions  with (nolock) where positiondate >= @prevworkday      
      
 /*Daily Volatality - make sure volatility data was uploaded for yesterday*/      
 insert into @out (datatype, date, currentval,Refval,Remarks)       
 select 'Daily Vol', @prevworkday, count(*),218,'' from dailyvolatilitytable  with (nolock) where date >= @prevworkday      
      
 /* Closing Prices For NSE and BSE*/  
 insert into @out (datatype, date, currentval,Refval,Remarks)       
 select 'Closing Price ' + isnull(e.Exchange_Code, ea.Exchange_Code), @prevworkday, count(*),0,'' from closingprice c  with (nolock)
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spCheckConcurrentOrders

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spCheckConcurrentOrders] @date date  
AS
 
BEGIN
    
	SELECT	DATEPART(hour, ot.creation_time) as 'Hour', 
			DATEPART(minute, ot.creation_time) as 'Minute', 
			DATEPART(second, ot.creation_time) as 'Second',
			s.IP as 'EMS', 
			CASE 
			WHEN e.Security_Type = 0 THEN 'CM' 		
			WHEN e.Security_Type BETWEEN 10 AND 13 THEN 'CD'
			ELSE 'FO' 
			END
			as 'Segment', 
			COUNT(*) as 'Order Count'
	FROM OrderTrades ot WITH (NOLOCK) 
	INNER JOIN Trades t WITH (NOLOCK) on t.OrderTrade_ID = ot.OrderTrade_ID and t.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date
	INNER JOIN EsteeApplications ea WITH (NOLOCK) on ea.SubStrategy_ID = ot.Sub_Strategy_ID
	INNER JOIN EsteeServers s WITH (NOLOCK) on s.ID = ea.EsteeServer_ID
	INNER JOIN esteemaster e WITH (NOLOCK) on e.Estee_ID = t.Estee_ID 
	WHERE ot.Creation_Date >= @date and ot.Creation_Date < DATEADD(d, 1, @date) 
	GROUP BY s.IP, DATEPART(hour, ot.creation_Time), DATEPART(minute, ot.creation_Time), DATEPART(second, ot.creation_Time), 			CASE 
			WHEN e.Security_Type = 0 THEN 'CM' 		
			WHEN e.Security_Type BETWEEN 10 AND 13 THEN 'CD'
			ELSE 'FO' 
			END

	--HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
	ORDER BY DATEPART(hour, ot.creation_Time), DATEPART(minute, ot.creation_Time), DATEPART(second, ot.creation_Time), s.IP, 			CASE 
			WHEN e.Security_Type = 0 THEN 'CM' 		
			WHEN e.Security_Type BETWEEN 10 AND 13 THEN 'CD'
			ELSE 'FO' 
			END


     
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spCheckEODData

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spCheckEODData]
	@today date
AS

BEGIN

	declare @out table (datatype varchar(50), [date] date, c int)

	--check for transaction cost to be non zero for all trades that have applyTC = 1
	insert into @out
	select 'Transaction Cost', @today, COUNT(*) from Trades t with (nolock) where creation_date >= @today and creation_date < DATEADD(d, 1, @today)
	and ApplyTC = 1 and Transaction_Cost = 0

	--daily position check, ensure the position was formed
	insert into @out
	select 'Daily Position', @today, COUNT(*) from DailyPositions p with (nolock) where PositionDate = @today

	--check for duplicates in dailypositions
	insert into @out
	select 'Daily Position Duplicates', @today, COUNT(*) from 
	(select Sub_StrategyID, Account_ID, Estee_ID from DailyPositions p with (nolock) where PositionDate = @today group by Sub_StrategyID, Account_ID, Estee_ID having COUNT(*) > 1) as x

	select * from @out
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spCheckStrategyExistence

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Apoorva Mishra
-- Create date: 03/07/2012
-- Description:
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spCheckStrategyExistence] 
	@templateSubStrategyID int,
	@strategyExists bit OUTPUT,
	@ErrorMessage varchar(255) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @tableList VARCHAR(255) 
SELECT @strategyExists =1
SELECT @tableList = ''

IF NOT EXISTS(Select 1 from Strategy_New where SubStrategy_Id = @templateSubStrategyID)
BEGIN
    SELECT @tableList = 'Strategy_New'
    SELECT @strategyExists = 0
END

IF NOT EXISTS(Select 1 from DataInit where SubStrategy_Id = @templateSubStrategyID)
BEGIN
	SELECT @tableList = @tableList + ',DataInit'
	SELECT @strategyExists = 0
END

IF NOT EXISTS(Select 1 from subscription_realtime r
inner join Strategy_New s on r.Strategy_Name = s.SubStrategy_Name
where s.SubStrategy_Id = @templateSubStrategyID)
BEGIN
	SELECT @tableList = @tableList + ',subscription_realtime'
	SELECT @strategyExists = 0
END

IF NOT EXISTS(Select 1 from StrategyBrokerAccount where subStrategyID = @templateSubStrategyID)
BEGIN
	SELECT @tableList = @tableList + ',StrategyBrokerAccount'
	SELECT @strategyExists = 0
END

IF NOT EXISTS(Select 1 FROM EsteeApplications where SubStrategy_Id = @templateSubStrategyID)
BEGIN
	SELECT @tableList = @tableList + ',EsteeApplications'
	SELECT @strategyExists = 0
END

IF @tableList is NOT NULL and @tableList <>''
BEGIN
	SELECT @ErrorMessage = 'Strategy ' + cast(@templateSubStrategyID as varchar(10)) + ' does not exist in tables: ' + @tableList
END
END

```

```sql
Delete from InterSpreadCredit where date = @runDate and Source=@source and spanID = @eodspanID  
Delete from InterSpreadCredit where date = @nextWorkingDate and Source=@source and spanID = @bodspanID
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spComputeandInsertIndexValues

```sql
/*
--This sp is run everyday after 1) Indexcomponents for BSE and NSE are uploaded 2) closingprice is uploaded 
--3) Freefloat table is uploaded 4) NSE_Security table is uploaded
Purpose - This SP computes InvestibleFactor, SPI, Market Cap and IssueCap and loads them into IndexTable
*/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spComputeandInsertIndexValues]
@runDate Date,
@ExchangeToRun char(2),
@statusMessage varchar(max) out -- this variable can be used as a log source  
as  
BEGIN  
BEGIN TRY  
			 declare @latestDateInIndexTable Date  
			 set @statusMessage = 'SP called with rundate = '+CAST(@runDate as varchar(100)) +'  Exchange = ' + @ExchangeToRun+' 
			 '  
			IF NOT EXISTS ( select * from closingprice where  date=@runDate and SUBSTRING(estee_id,13,2)=@ExchangeToRun)
			BEGIN
				set @statusMessage = 'Exception occured in sp: Records not found in ClosingPrice with runDate '+CAST(@runDate as varchar(100))+ ' and Exchange = '+ @ExchangeToRun + '
						'  
				RETURN
			END
			 --do something only if there are no records for the given day in IndexTable  
			 IF NOT EXISTS(select * from IndexTable where LastCheckedDate=@runDate and SUBSTRING(estee_id,13,2)=@ExchangeToRun)  
					   BEGIN   
								IF (@ExchangeToRun='IS')
								BEGIN  
											--Step 1) update latest values of InvestibleFactor from FreeFloat  
											set @statusMessage+='Updating latest values of InvestibleFactor from FreeFloat  for IS
											'  
											update ITTemp  
											   set ITTemp.InvestibleFactor = FF.Investible_Factor  
											   from  
											   IndexTable_temp ITTemp  
											   inner join EsteeMaster EM  
											   on EM.Estee_ID = ITTemp.Member_Estee_ID and EM.Security_Type=0 and EM.Exchange_Code='IS'  
											   inner join Freefloat FF  
											   on FF.SYMBOL = EM.Underlying_Ticker and FF.SERIES = EM.SERIES  
											set @statusMessage+=CAST(@@ROWCOUNT as varchar(100))+' rows updated  for IS
											'  
										       
											--Step 2) update lastest values of IssueCap from NSESecurity  
											set @statusMessage+='Updating latest values of  IssueCap from NSESecurity  for IS
											'  
											update ITTemp  
												set ITTemp.IssueCap = CAST(CAST(NS.issued_capital as float(50))as decimal(30,10))  
												from  
												IndexTable_temp ITTemp  
												inner join EsteeMaster EM  
												on EM.Estee_ID = ITTemp.Member_Estee_ID and EM.Security_Type=0 and EM.Exchange_Code='IS'  
												inner join NSE_Security NS  
												on NS.symbol = EM.Underlying_Ticker and NS.series = EM.SERIES  
											set @statusMessage+=CAST(@@ROWCOUNT as varchar(100))+' rows updated  for IS
											'  
								END--IF (@ExchangeToRun='IS')    
							
								--Step 3) Computing the next trading day  after @runDate
								declare @nextTradingDay Date  
								declare @isTradingHolidayResult bit  
								set @nextTradingDay = DATEADD(dd,1,@runDate)  
								set @isTradingHolidayResult = (select dbo.IsGivenDateTradingHoliday(@nextTradingDay))  
								WHILE (@isTradingHolidayResult =1)  
								BEGIN  
										 set @nextTradingDay = DATEADD(dd,1,@nextTradingDay)  
										 set @isTradingHolidayResult = (select dbo.IsGivenDateTradingHoliday(@nextTradingDay))  
								END  
								set @statusMessage+='Next trading day for Corporate Action computed as : '+CAST(@nextTradingDay as varchar(100))+'  
								'  
							
								--Step 4) update the value of SPI from formula. spi = (CP * ICap * IFactor) / IndexMarketCap  
								-- where IndexMarketCap = Sum ( IFactor * IC * CorporateActionMultiplier * CP) for all components  
				      			--START CURSOR LOGIC FOR COMPUTING SPI  
								set @statusMessage+='About to compute IndexMarketCap for all records  
								'  
								declare indexCursor cursor for select distinct estee_id from indextable_temp  where Substring(Estee_id,13,2)=@ExchangeToRun
								declare @indexEsteeId varchar(50)  
								open indexCursor  
								fetch next from indexCursor into @indexEsteeID  
								WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0  
								BEGIN  
											 DECLARE @indexMarketCap decimal(38,20)  
											 SET @indexMarketCap =  
											 (  
												--compute indexmarketcap separately for each index using cursors  
												   select SUM(IT.investiblefactor * It.IssueCap* ISNULL(action,1) * CP.Close_Price) as MarketCap  from   
													indextable_temp IT  
													left join CorporateActionTable CT  
													on IT.Member_Estee_id = CT.UnderlyingEsteeId and EffectiveDate >@runDate and EffectiveDate<=@nextTradingDay  
													AND UnderlyingEsteeId IS NOT NULL  
													and (CT.ActionType ='FV SPLIT' or CT.ActionType='BONUS')  
													inner join closingprice CP  
													on CP.Estee_ID= IT.Member_estee_id  
													where Cp.Date = @runDate and IT.Estee_id= @indexEsteeId  
											 )  
											UPDATE IndexTable_temp set indexmarketcap = @indexMarketCap where Estee_ID = @indexEsteeId  
											SET @statusMessage +='For Index: '+@indexEsteeId+ ' IndexMarketCap : ' +CAST(@indexMarketCap as varchar(200))+'  
											'				     
								 fetch next from indexCursor into @indexEsteeID  
								END  
								close indexCursor  
								deallocate indexCursor  
								--END  CURSOR LOGIC FOR COMPUTING SPI  
								set @statusMessage+='Done Computing IndexMarketCap for all records  
								'  
							    
								--Step 5) Check whether any index components have changed before inserting into IndexTable  
								set @latestDateInIndexTable = (select MAX(asofdate) from IndexTable where SUBSTRING(Estee_ID,13,2)=@ExchangeToRun)  
								if(@latestDateInIndexTable is null)  
											BEGIN  
														 set @statusMessage+= 'No records found in IndexTable. Hence inserting directly  
														 '  
														 Insert into IndexTable select  * from IndexTable_Temp where asofdate=@runDate  and SUBSTRING(estee_id,13,2)=@ExchangeToRun
											END  
								ELSE  
											BEGIN  
														set @statusMessage+= 'Records found in IndexTable for : '  + CAST(@latestDateInIndexTable as varchar(100))+'  
														 '  
														 IF EXISTS(  
																select Estee_ID,Member_Estee_ID,weightage,InvestibleFactor,IssueCap,ffmarketcap from Indextable_temp where asofdate=@runDate and SUBSTRING(estee_ID,13,2)=@ExchangeToRun
																except   
																select Estee_ID,Member_Estee_ID,weightage,InvestibleFactor,IssueCap,ffmarketcap from IndexTable where asofdate=@latestDateInIndexTable  and SUBSTRING(estee_ID,13,2)=@ExchangeToRun
																union  
																select Estee_ID,Member_Estee_ID,weightage,InvestibleFactor,IssueCap,ffmarketcap from IndexTable where asofdate=@latestDateInIndexTable   and SUBSTRING(estee_ID,13,2)=@ExchangeToRun
																except  
																select Estee_ID,Member_Estee_ID,weightage,InvestibleFactor,IssueCap,ffmarketcap from Indextable_temp where asofdate=@runDate  and SUBSTRING(estee_ID,13,2)=@ExchangeToRun)
																			 BEGIN  
																						   set @statusMessage+='Some Differing records found  
																						   '  
																						   update indextable_temp set haschanged=1  where SUBSTRING(estee_ID,13,2)=@ExchangeToRun
																						   update IT  
																									set IT.Haschanged = 0  
																									from indextable_temp IT  
																									inner join IndexTable ITOrig  
																									on IT.Estee_id = ITOrig.Estee_ID and
																									IT.Member_estee_id = ITOrig.member_estee_id and  
																									IT.InvestibleFactor = ITOrig.InvestibleFactor and   
																									IT.IssueCap = ITOrig.IssueCap  
																									where SUBSTRING(IT.Estee_id,13,2)=@ExchangeToRun
																		       
																						   INSERT INTO IndexTable  
																						   select Estee_ID,Member_Estee_ID,Weightage,InvestibleFactor,IssueCap,FFMarketCap,SPI,haschanged,@runDate,@runDate,IndexMarketCap 
																						   from IndexTable_temp  where SUBSTRING(Estee_id,13,2)=@ExchangeToRun
																						   
																						   set @statusMessage+=CAST(@@ROWCOUNT as varchar(100))+'  rows inserted into IndexTable for date' + CAST(@runDate as varchar(100))+'  and Exchange = '+@ExchangeToRun + '
																						   '  
																			 END  
														 ELSE  
																			 BEGIN  
																							   set @statusMessage+='No Differing records found. Updating LastCheckDate to '+ CAST(@runDate as varchar(100))+'  
																							   '  
																							   update IT  
																								   set IT.Weightage= ITT.Weightage,  
																								   IT.IndexMarketCap = ITT.IndexMarketCap,  
																								   IT.LastCheckedDate=@runDate  
																								   from IndexTable IT  
																								   inner join IndexTable_temp ITT  
																								   on IT.Estee_ID = ITT.Estee_ID and  
																								   IT.Member_Estee_ID=ITT.Member_Estee_ID  
																								   and IT.AsOfDate=@latestDateInIndexTable  
																								  and SUBSTRING(IT.Estee_ID,13,2)=@ExchangeToRun
																								  
																							   set @statusMessage+=CAST(@@ROWCOUNT as varchar(100))+'  rows updated in IndexTable  
																							   '  
																			 END  
											END  --end of else of if(@latestDateInIndexTable is null)  
							   END  
			 ELSE  -- if records already exist in indexTable with same date and for same exchange
					   BEGIN  
						set @statusMessage = 'Records already Exist with LastCheckedDate = '+CAST(@runDate as varchar(100))+'  and Exchange = ' +@ExchangeToRun + '
						'  
					   END  
			 --set @statusMessage+='Deleting records from indextable_temp.'  
			 --delete from indextable_temp  
			 --set @statusMessage+=CAST(@@ROWCOUNT as varchar(100))+' Rows have been deleted from Indextable_temp  
			 --'  
END TRY  
BEGIN CATCH  
			 set @statusMessage+='Exception occured in sp: ErrorNumber: '+ERROR_NUMBER()+'; ErrorState: '+ERROR_STATE()+'; ErrorSeverity: '+ERROR_SEVERITY()+'; ErrorProcedure: '+  
			 ERROR_PROCEDURE()+'; ErrorMessage: '+ERROR_MESSAGE()+'; UserName: '+SUSER_NAME()+'; Host Name: '+HOST_NAME()+'  
			 '  
END CATCH  
End

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spComputeZScores

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spComputeZScores]
@runDate date 
as
BEGIN
	declare @currentValue decimal(20,10)
	declare @average decimal(20,10)
	declare @stdev decimal(20,10)

	set @currentValue = (select vixindex from RiskMetrics where DateValue=@runDate)
	set @average = (select AVG(vixindex) from RiskMetrics where DateValue<=@runDate and DateValue>=DATEADD(dd,-29,CAST(@runDate as DATE)))
	set @stdev= (select STDEV(vixindex) from RiskMetrics where DateValue<=@runDate and DateValue>=DATEADD(dd,-29,CAST(@runDate as DATE)))
	update RiskMetrics set ZVixIndex = (@currentValue-@average)/@stdev where DateValue=@runDate

	set @currentValue = (select IPC from RiskMetrics where DateValue=@runDate)
	set @average = (select AVG(IPC) from RiskMetrics where DateValue<=@runDate and DateValue>=DATEADD(dd,-29,CAST(@runDate as DATE)))
	set @stdev= (select STDEV(IPC) from RiskMetrics where DateValue<=@runDate and DateValue>=DATEADD(dd,-29,CAST(@runDate as DATE)))
	update RiskMetrics set ZiPC = (@currentValue-@average)/@stdev where DateValue=@runDate

	set @currentValue = (select CAlpha from RiskMetrics where DateValue=@runDate)
	set @average = (select AVG(CAlpha) from RiskMetrics where DateValue<=@runDate and DateValue>=DATEADD(dd,-29,CAST(@runDate as DATE)))
	set @stdev= (select STDEV(CAlpha) from RiskMetrics where DateValue<=@runDate and DateValue>=DATEADD(dd,-29,CAST(@runDate as DATE)))
	update RiskMetrics set ZcAlpla = (@currentValue-@average)/@stdev where DateValue=@runDate

	set @currentValue = (select YieldBSE100-TenYrGovtBondYield from RiskMetrics where DateValue=@runDate)
	set @average = (select AVG(YieldBSE100-TenYrGovtBondYield) from RiskMetrics where DateValue<=@runDate and DateValue>=DATEADD(dd,-29,CAST(@runDate as DATE)))
	set @stdev= (select STDEV(YieldBSE100-TenYrGovtBondYield) from RiskMetrics where DateValue<=@runDate and DateValue>=DATEADD(dd,-29,CAST(@runDate as DATE)))
	update RiskMetrics set ZBSERiskComposite = (@currentValue-@average)/@stdev where DateValue=@runDate

	--update RiskMetrics set OverallRiskComposite = (ZVixIndex+ZiPC+ZcAlpla+ZBSERiskComposite)/4, LastUpdated = GETDATE() where DateValue=@runDate
	set @currentValue = (select Valuepremium from RiskMetrics where DateValue=@runDate)
	set @average = (select AVG(Valuepremium) from RiskMetrics where DateValue<=@runDate and DateValue>=DATEADD(dd,-29,CAST(@runDate as DATE)))
	set @stdev= (select STDEV(Valuepremium) from RiskMetrics where DateValue<=@runDate and DateValue>=DATEADD(dd,-29,CAST(@runDate as DATE)))
	update RiskMetrics set ZValuepremium = (@currentValue-@average)/@stdev where DateValue=@runDate

	update RiskMetrics set OverallRiskComposite = (ZVixIndex+ZiPC+ZcAlpla+ZBSERiskComposite+ZValuePremium)/5, LastUpdated = GETDATE() where DateValue=@runDate

END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spConfigureEMS

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spConfigureEMS]                
@systemIP varchar(20),                
@systemName varchar(50),                
@StrategyList varchar(500),      
@AppId varchar(50),      
@IsApplicationId bit           
as                
  
begin                
  
 -- configure esteeservers         
 declare @esteeServerID int ,       
 @item int            
 if not exists(select * from EsteeServers where IP=@systemIP)                
 begin            
  insert into EsteeServers(Name,IP,frequency,ServiceURL,LocationCode) values(@systemName,@systemIP,null,null,'GGN')                
 end                
 set @esteeServerID = (select top 1 ID from EsteeServers where IP=@systemIP)                
 print 'Estee server ID configured is ' + cast(@esteeServerID as varchar(100))              
  
 -- configure ems in esteeapplications        
 declare @emsApplicationID int        
 if not exists(Select ApplicationID from EsteeApplications where ApplicationName = 'Estee.EMS.64' and esteeserver_id = @esteeServerID)                
 begin        
  set @emsApplicationID = (Select MAX(ApplicationID) from  EsteeApplications)+1              
  insert into esteeapplications(ApplicationID, ApplicationName,EsteeServer_ID,EMS_Application_ID, SubStrategy_ID, [Path], CmdArgs, exeName, isRunning)         
  values(@emsApplicationID,'Estee.EMS.64',@esteeServerID,@emsApplicationID, null,null,null,null,'1')                
 end                
 set @emsApplicationID = (Select top 1 ApplicationID from EsteeApplicationS where ApplicationName = 'Estee.EMS.64' and esteeserver_id = @esteeServerID)                
 print 'EMS App ID configured is ' + cast(@emsApplicationID as varchar(100))      
  
 -- configure datainit for ems  
 if not exists(select applicationid from datainit where ApplicationID = @emsApplicationID)  
 begin  
  -- find an ems id in esteeapplications which has max values in datainit  
  declare @templateEMSId int  
  set @templateEMSId = (select top 1 applicationid from datainit where ApplicationID in (select applicationid from esteeapplications where ApplicationID <> @emsApplicationID and ApplicationName like '%ems%') group by ApplicationID order by count(*) desc)  
  insert into datainit select Parameter, Value, substrategy_id, @emsApplicationID from datainit where ApplicationID = @templateEMSId  
 end  
  
 if @IsApplicationId = 0      
 begin      
  --configure strategies in esteeapplications       
  DECLARE strategy_cursor CURSOR FOR select items from dbo.Split(@StrategyList,',')      
  
  OPEN strategy_cursor      
  FETCH NEXT FROM strategy_cursor INTO @item      
  
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0      
  BEGIN      
   update esteeapplications set EsteeServer_ID = @esteeServerID, EMS_Application_ID = @emsApplicationID where SubStrategy_ID in (@item)       
   FETCH NEXT FROM strategy_cursor INTO @item      
  END        
  CLOSE strategy_cursor      
  DEALLOCATE strategy_cursor      
 end      
  
 print 'Strategies configured - ' + cast(@StrategyList as varchar(100))        
  
 -- configure process order app  
 declare @processOrderID int  
 if not exists(Select ApplicationID from EsteeApplications where ApplicationName = 'Estee.ProcessOrder' and esteeserver_id = @esteeServerID)                
 begin        
  set @processOrderID = (Select MAX(ApplicationID) from  EsteeApplications)+1              
  insert into esteeapplications(ApplicationID, ApplicationName,EsteeServer_ID,EMS_Application_ID, SubStrategy_ID, [Path], CmdArgs, exeName, isRunning)         
  values(@processOrderID ,'Estee.ProcessOrder',@esteeServerID,@processOrderID, null,null,null,null,'1')                
 end                
 set @processOrderID = (Select top 1 ApplicationID from EsteeApplicationS where ApplicationName = 'Estee.ProcessOrder' and esteeserver_id = @esteeServerID)                
 print 'ProcessOrder App ID configured is ' + cast(@processOrderID as varchar(100))      
  
 -- configure datainit for process order  
 if not exists(select applicationid from datainit where ApplicationID = @processOrderID)  
 begin  
  -- find a PO id in esteeapplications which has max values in datainit  
  declare @templatePOId int  
  set @templatePOId = (select top 1 applicationid from datainit where ApplicationID in (select applicationid from esteeapplications where ApplicationID <> @processOrderID and ApplicationName like '%process%') group by ApplicationID order by count(*) desc)  
  insert into datainit select Parameter, Value, substrategy_id, @processOrderID from datainit where ApplicationID = @templatePOId  
 end  
  
 -- configure RMS app  
 declare @RMSId int  
 if not exists(Select ApplicationID from EsteeApplications where ApplicationName = 'Allocator' and esteeserver_id = @esteeServerID)                
 begin        
  set @RMSId = (Select MAX(ApplicationID) from  EsteeApplications)+1              
  insert into esteeapplications(ApplicationID, ApplicationName,EsteeServer_ID,EMS_Application_ID, SubStrategy_ID, [Path], CmdArgs, exeName, isRunning)         
  values(@RMSId ,'Allocator',@esteeServerID,@processOrderID, null,null,null,null,'1')                
 end                
 set @RMSId = (Select top 1 ApplicationID from EsteeApplicationS where ApplicationName = 'Allocator' and esteeserver_id = @esteeServerID)                
 print 'RMS ID configured is ' + cast(@RMSId as varchar(100))      
  
 -- configure datainit for RMS  
 if not exists(select applicationid from datainit where ApplicationID = @RMSId)  
 begin  
  -- find a RMS id in esteeapplications which has max values in datainit  
  declare @templateRMSId int  
  set @templateRMSId = (select top 1 applicationid from datainit where ApplicationID in (select applicationid from esteeapplications where ApplicationID <> @RMSId and ApplicationName like '%allocator%') group by ApplicationID order by count(*) desc)  
  insert into datainit select Parameter, Value, substrategy_id, @RMSId from datainit where ApplicationID = @templateRMSId  
 end  
  
 -- return application id's  
 select @emsApplicationID as EMSApplicationID, @processOrderID as POApplicationID, @RMSId as RMSApplicationID                
   
  
end

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spCopyRiskLimitsFromTemplateStrategy

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spCopyRiskLimitsFromTemplateStrategy
	  @fromDimValue varchar(10),
	  @toDimValue varchar(10),
	  @dimId int
AS
	BEGIN
	    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	    BEGIN TRY
		   BEGIN TRAN;

		   IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM sys.columns
			WHERE Name = N'Date' AND OBJECT_ID = OBJECT_ID(N'RiskLimits'))
			BEGIN

			 declare @permanentRLDate date = '0001-01-01'

				UPDATE RL
				 SET RL.RiskParameterValue = rlO.RiskParameterValue,RL.DimensionValue= @toDimValue
				 FROM dbo.RiskLimits AS RL INNER JOIN RiskLimits RLO
				 ON rlO.dimensionid = rl.DimensionId
				 	AND rlO.riskparamId = rl.RiskParamid 
					and rlo.DimensionValue = @fromDimValue 
					and rl.DimensionValue= @toDimValue
				  WHERE RLO.Date = @permanentRLDate and rlo.DimensionId = @dimId

			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN

				UPDATE RL
				 SET RL.RiskParameterValue = rlO.RiskParameterValue,RL.DimensionValue= @toDimValue
				 FROM dbo.RiskLimits AS RL INNER JOIN RiskLimits RLO
				 ON rlO.dimensionid = rl.DimensionId
				 	AND rlO.riskparamId = rl.RiskParamid 
					and rlo.DimensionValue = @fromDimValue 
					and rl.DimensionValue= @toDimValue
					and rlo.DimensionId = @dimId

			END
		   COMMIT TRAN;
	    END TRY

	    BEGIN CATCH

		   ROLLBACK TRAN;

		   DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);

		   DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;

		   DECLARE @ErrorState INT;

		   SELECT @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity =

		   ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();

		   -- RAISERROR inside the CATCH block will return error information about the original error that caused execution to jump to the CATCH block.          

		   RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, -- Message text.

		   @ErrorSeverity, -- Severity.

		   @ErrorState -- State.

		   );

	    END CATCH;

	END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spCopySubscriptionFromTemplateSubStrategy

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.spCopySubscriptionFromTemplateSubStrategy 
       @templateSubStrategyID INT, 
       @newSubStrategyName    VARCHAR(500)
AS
     BEGIN
         DECLARE @error VARCHAR(255);
         BEGIN TRY
             --check if template strategy exists  
             IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1
                           FROM Strategy_New
                           WHERE SubStrategy_Id = @templateSubStrategyID)
                 BEGIN
                     SELECT @error = 'Invalid template strategy ID - '+CAST(@templateSubStrategyID AS VARCHAR(50));
                     RAISERROR(@error, 16, 1);
                 END;
             INSERT INTO subscription_realtime ( Strategy_Name, EsteeID, Field_Name, IsRolloverDisabled ) 
                    SELECT @newSubStrategyName, R.EsteeID, R.Field_Name, R.IsRolloverDisabled
                    FROM subscription_realtime R
                         INNER JOIN Strategy_New SN ON SN.SubStrategy_Name = R.Strategy_Name
                    WHERE SN.SubStrategy_Id = @templateSubStrategyID;
             PRINT 'Copied subscription real time';
             RETURN 0;
         END TRY
         BEGIN CATCH
             DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);
             DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;
             DECLARE @ErrorState INT;
             SELECT @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();
             -- Use RAISERROR inside the CATCH block to return error
             -- information about the original error that caused
             -- execution to jump to the CATCH block.
             RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, -- Message text.
             @ErrorSeverity, -- Severity.
             @ErrorState -- State.
             );
         END CATCH;
     END;
```
