```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spCreateUpdateStrategyGroup   
@Mode            VARCHAR(10),   
@StrategyGroupId INT OUT,   
@GroupName       VARCHAR(100),   
@GroupCurrency   INT,   
@GroupStatus     BIT,   
@GroupCategoryId INT,   
@GroupOwnerId    INT,  
@CoOwners  varchar(500)  ,
@isColoAggregation bit,
@locationCode VARCHAR(10) =null, 
@emailID VARCHAR(1000),
@ccList VARCHAR(2000)
AS  
BEGIN  
     BEGIN TRAN;  
	  DECLARE @dimensionId INT;  
          SELECT @dimensionId = PD.DimensionId  
          FROM dbo.ParameterDimension AS PD  
          WHERE PD.DimensionName = 'StrategyGroup';  
     IF @Mode = 'Create'  
     BEGIN  
          DECLARE @currentMaxStrategyGroupId INT;  
          SELECT @currentMaxStrategyGroupId = MAX(StrategyID)  
          FROM dbo.StrategyGroup AS SG;  
          SET @StrategyGroupId = @currentMaxStrategyGroupId + 1;  
          INSERT INTO dbo.StrategyGroup(StrategyID, StrategyName, CurrencyID, Enabled, CategoryID, Owner,CoOwners)  
          VALUES(@StrategyGroupId, @GroupName, @GroupCurrency, @GroupStatus, @GroupCategoryId, @GroupOwnerId,@CoOwners);  
          DECLARE @techopsId INT;  
          SELECT @techopsId = role_id  
          FROM dbo.Roles AS R  
          WHERE R.Role_Name = 'Operations';  
          DECLARE @adminId INT;  
          SELECT @adminId = role_id  
          FROM dbo.Roles AS R  
          WHERE R.Role_Name = 'Admin';  
       
          INSERT INTO dbo.UserStrategies  
          SELECT DISTINCT userid, @StrategyGroupId, @dimensionId  
          FROM dbo.LoginDetails AS LD  
               INNER JOIN dbo.UserRoles AS UR ON ld.UserID = ur.User_ID  
          WHERE UR.Role_ID IN (@adminId, @techopsId);  

		  IF(@emailID <> '' AND @emailID IS NOT NULL)
					BEGIN
					IF(@ccList <> '' AND @ccList IS NOT NULL)
						BEGIN
							INSERT INTO dbo.UserMappingDetails VALUES (@dimensionId, @StrategyGroupId, @emailID, @ccList);
						END;
					ELSE
						BEGIN
							INSERT INTO dbo.UserMappingDetails VALUES (@dimensionId, @StrategyGroupId, @emailID, NULL);
						END;
					END;

		  IF(@isColoAggregation=1)
			Insert into cologrouplevelaggregation(dimensionId,dimensionValue,locationCode)
			values (@dimensionId,@StrategyGroupId,@locationCode)
     END;  
     ELSE  
     BEGIN  
          IF @Mode = 'Update'  
          BEGIN  
               UPDATE dbo.StrategyGroup  
               SET dbo.StrategyGroup.StrategyName = @GroupName, dbo.StrategyGroup.CurrencyID = @GroupCurrency, dbo.StrategyGroup.Enabled = @GroupStatus, dbo.StrategyGroup.CategoryID = @GroupCategoryId, dbo.StrategyGroup.Owner = @GroupOwnerId,dbo.StrategyGroup.CoOwners = @CoOwners  
               WHERE dbo.StrategyGroup.StrategyID = @StrategyGroupId;  

			   IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM UserMappingDetails WHERE DimensionID = @dimensionId AND DimensionValue = @StrategyGroupId)
							BEGIN
								IF(@emailID <> '' AND @emailID IS NOT NULL)
									BEGIN
											UPDATE dbo.UserMappingDetails
											SET dbo.UserMappingDetails.EmailID = @emailID
											WHERE dbo.UserMappingDetails.DimensionID = @dimensionId and dbo.UserMappingDetails.DimensionValue = @StrategyGroupId;
									END;
								IF(@ccList <> '' AND @ccList IS NOT NULL)
									BEGIN
											UPDATE dbo.UserMappingDetails
											SET dbo.UserMappingDetails.CCList = @ccList
											WHERE dbo.UserMappingDetails.DimensionID = @dimensionId and dbo.UserMappingDetails.DimensionValue = @StrategyGroupId;
									END;
							END;
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								IF(@emailID <> '' AND @emailID IS NOT NULL)
								BEGIN
								IF(@ccList <> '' AND @ccList IS NOT NULL)
									BEGIN
										INSERT INTO dbo.UserMappingDetails VALUES (@dimensionId, @StrategyGroupId, @emailID, @ccList);
									END;
								ELSE
									BEGIN
										INSERT INTO dbo.UserMappingDetails VALUES (@dimensionId, @StrategyGroupId, @emailID, NULL);
									END;
								END;
							END;

			   IF(@isColoAggregation=1)
			   BEGIN
				if not exists (select 1 from cologrouplevelaggregation where dimensionId=@dimensionId and dimensionValue=@StrategyGroupId)
				BEGIN
					Insert into cologrouplevelaggregation(dimensionId,dimensionValue,locationCode)
					values (@dimensionId,@StrategyGroupId,@locationCode)
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
				update cologrouplevelaggregation set LocationCode = @locationCode where  dimensionid=@dimensionId and dimensionValue=@StrategyGroupId 
				END
				END
				ELSE
					DELETE from cologrouplevelaggregation where dimensionId=@dimensionId and dimensionValue=@StrategyGroupId 
          END;  
     END;  
     COMMIT TRAN;  
END;
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spDecrypt

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Umesh Tripathi
-- Create date: Nov 15 2011
-- Description:	Decrypt data that was encrypted using spEncrypt
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDecrypt]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@BinaryString varbinary(MAX),
	@DecryptedText VARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT 
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Open the private key
	OPEN SYMMETRIC KEY Estee_AES256_Key DECRYPTION BY PASSWORD ='Pa$$w0rd'

	-- Get the Key GUID
	DECLARE @Key_GUID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
	SELECT @Key_GUID = Key_GUID FROM sys.symmetric_keys WHERE Name = 'Estee_AES256_Key'

	-- Decrypt using the key
	SELECT @DecryptedText =  CONVERT (VARCHAR (4000), DecryptByKey (@BinaryString))

	--Close the private key
	CLOSE SYMMETRIC KEY Estee_AES256_Key
END

```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE spDeleteNeatLimit
-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
@trader VARCHAR(100)
AS
     BEGIN
         -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
         -- interfering with SELECT statements.
         SET NOCOUNT ON;
         DECLARE @seqNo INT;
         SELECT @seqNo = MAX(nl.SeqNo)
           FROM dbo.NeatLimit nl;

         BEGIN TRY
             BEGIN TRAN;
             DELETE FROM dbo.NeatLimit
              WHERE dbo.NeatLimit.Trader = @trader
                    AND dbo.NeatLimit.SeqNo = @seqNo;

		   DELETE FROM dbo.DefaultNeatLimit
		   WHERE dbo.DefaultNeatLimit.Trader = @trader

             COMMIT TRAN;
         END TRY
         BEGIN CATCH
             DECLARE @error INT, @message VARCHAR(4000), @xstate INT;
             SELECT @error = ERROR_NUMBER(), @message = ERROR_MESSAGE();

             IF(XACT_STATE()) <> 0
             BEGIN
                 PRINT 'The transaction is in an uncommittable state. Rolling back transaction.';
                 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
             END;

             RAISERROR('%d: %s', 16, 1, @error, @message);

         END CATCH;
     END;
```

```sql
CREATE Procedure [dbo].[spDummySpanData]  
@exgCode char(2),  
@date date,  
@nextWorkingDay date  
  
As  
  
Begin  
  
BEGIN TRY  
  
BEGIN TRANSACTION  
  
delete from SpanData where SUBSTRING(esteeID,13,2) =@exgCode and date >= @date and date <= @nextWorkingDay  
delete from SpanUndCharge where SUBSTRING(esteeID,13,2) =@exgCode and date >= @date and date <= @nextWorkingDay  
  
Insert into SpanData  
select date,Estee_ID,0,0,0,0,0,Close_Price,0,'dummyeod' from closingprice where Date = @date and SUBSTRING(estee_id,13,2) = @exgCode  
  
Insert into SpanData  
select @nextWorkingDay,Estee_ID,0,0,0,0,0,Close_Price,0,'dummybod' from closingprice where Date = @date and   
SUBSTRING(estee_id,13,2) = @exgCode  
  
Insert into SpanUndCharge  
select @date,Estee_ID,0,0,0,'dummyeod' from esteemaster where Exchange_Code = @exgCode and Security_Type in (0,4,10,19)  
  
Insert into SpanUndCharge  
select @nextWorkingDay,Estee_ID,0,0,0,'dummybod' from esteemaster where Exchange_Code = @exgCode and Security_Type in (0,4,10,19)  
  
COMMIT TRANSACTION  
END TRY  
BEGIN CATCH    
 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION  
   
 DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);      
   DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;      
   DECLARE @ErrorState INT;      
            
   SELECT @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),      
       @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),      
       @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();      
            
   -- RAISERROR inside the CATCH block will return error information about the original error that caused execution to jump to the CATCH block.        
   RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage, -- Message text.      
        @ErrorSeverity, -- Severity.      
        @ErrorState -- State.      
        );      
            
END CATCH  
  
End
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Umesh Tripathi
-- Create date: Nov 17 2011
-- Description:	Procedure to encrypt sensitive or environment specific information
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spEncrypt]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@text varchar(4000),
	@EncryptedBinaryString VARBINARY(MAX) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Open the private key
	OPEN SYMMETRIC KEY [Estee_AES256_Key] DECRYPTION BY PASSWORD ='Pa$$w0rd'

	-- Get the Key GUID
	DECLARE @Key_GUID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
	SELECT @Key_GUID = Key_GUID FROM  sys.symmetric_keys WHERE Name = 'Estee_AES256_Key'

	-- Encrypt using the key
	SELECT @EncryptedBinaryString = EncryptByKey (@Key_GUID, @text)
	
	--Close the private key
	CLOSE SYMMETRIC KEY Estee_AES256_Key
END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spEsteeFromUnderlyingTicker]  
@ExchangeCode nvarchar(20),  
@Ticker nvarchar(50),  
@SecurityType int,  
@ExpiryDate DateTime = null,  
@ExpiryDate2 DateTime = null,  
@StrikePrice DateTime = null  
AS  
if exists(select 1 from SecurityType where GroupID=5 and TypeCode=@SecurityType)  
BEGIN  
 select Top 1 em.Estee_ID, DataFeed_Ticker     
 from esteemaster em with (nolock)      
 inner join Exchange ex on ex.code = em.Exchange_Code        
 inner join SecurityType st on st.TypeCode= em.Security_Type         
 Where em.Status = 1  and Exchange_Code= @ExchangeCode and Underlying_Ticker = @Ticker and em.Security_Type = @SecurityType
END  
ELSE if exists(select 1 from SecurityType where GroupID=3 and TypeCode=@SecurityType)  
BEGIN  
select Top 1 em.Estee_ID, DataFeed_Ticker  
 from esteemaster em with (nolock)      
 inner join Exchange ex on ex.code = em.Exchange_Code        
 inner join SecurityType st on st.TypeCode= em.Security_Type         
 Where em.Status = 1  and Exchange_Code= @ExchangeCode and Underlying_Ticker = @Ticker and em.Security_Type = @SecurityType  and em.Expiry_Date = @ExpiryDate  
END  
ELSE if exists(select 1 from SecurityType where GroupID=4 and TypeCode=@SecurityType)  
BEGIN  
select Top 1 em.Estee_ID, DataFeed_Ticker  
 from esteemaster em with (nolock)      
 inner join Exchange ex on ex.code = em.Exchange_Code        
 inner join SecurityType st on st.TypeCode= em.Security_Type         
 Where em.Status = 1  and Exchange_Code= @ExchangeCode and Underlying_Ticker = @Ticker and em.Security_Type = @SecurityType  and em.Expiry_Date = @ExpiryDate  
and Strike_Price = @StrikePrice  
END  
ELSE if exists(select 1 from SecurityType where GroupID=6 and TypeCode=@SecurityType)  
BEGIN  
select Top 1  em.Estee_ID, DataFeed_Ticker  
 from esteemaster em with (nolock)      
 inner join Exchange ex on ex.code = em.Exchange_Code        
 inner join SecurityType st on st.TypeCode= em.Security_Type         
 Where em.Status = 1  and Exchange_Code= @ExchangeCode and Underlying_Ticker = @Ticker and em.Security_Type = @SecurityType  and em.Expiry_Date = @ExpiryDate  
and Expiry_Date2 = @ExpiryDate2  
END 
ELSE if exists(select 1 from SecurityType where GroupID=2 and TypeCode=@SecurityType)  
BEGIN  
select Top 1  em.Estee_ID, DataFeed_Ticker  
 from esteemaster em with (nolock)      
 inner join Exchange ex on ex.code = em.Exchange_Code        
 inner join SecurityType st on st.TypeCode= em.Security_Type         
 Where em.Status = 1  and Exchange_Code= @ExchangeCode and Underlying_Ticker = @Ticker and em.Security_Type = @SecurityType  and em.Expiry_Date = ISNULL(em.Expiry_Date,@ExpiryDate)
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spExpiryRollover

```sql
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[spExpiryRollover]   
@exchangeCode CHAR(2),   
@expiryDate DATE,   
@RolloverDataInit BIT= 0  
AS  
     BEGIN  
         BEGIN TRY  
             -- check if expiry date contracts still exist in esteemaster, if they do, exit  
             IF EXISTS(SELECT 1  
                         FROM esteemaster AS em WITH (NOLOCK)  
                        WHERE em.Exchange_Code = @exchangeCode  
                              AND CONVERT(DATE, em.Expiry_Date) = @expiryDate  
      AND LEN(em.Estee_id) >16  
                      )  
             BEGIN   
			     DECLARE @jobname  TABLE(job_Name VARCHAR(50));   
						 INSERT INTO @jobname                     
								SELECT distinct(Source)  
								FROM esteemaster AS em WITH (NOLOCK)  
								WHERE em.Exchange_Code = @exchangeCode  
								AND CONVERT(DATE, em.Expiry_Date) = @expiryDate  
	                            AND LEN(em.Estee_id) >16 
				 DECLARE @cnt INT = 1;
				 DECLARE @counter INT = 0;
				 DECLARE @MAX INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @jobname)
				 DECLARE @distval VARCHAR(150);
							WHILE @cnt <= @MAX  
								BEGIN
									SET @distval = (SELECT concat('Estee master job has not run yet for source : ',job_Name,',Please run expiry rollover after esteemaster job has run for ',@exchangeCode,'.') FROM @jobname 
									ORDER BY 1 OFFSET @counter 
									ROWS FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY);
									RAISERROR(@distval,16,1);
									SET @cnt = @cnt + 1
									SET @counter = @counter + 1   
								 END
                   END;  
             IF EXISTS(SELECT 1  
                         FROM subscription_realtime_preupdate  
                        WHERE ExchangeCode = @exchangeCode  
                              AND AsOfDate = @expiryDate  
                      )  
             BEGIN  
                 RAISERROR('Expiry has already run for given exchange and expiry date. So can not run expiry again.', 16, 1);  
             END;  
             DECLARE @spreadSecTypes INTEGERLISTTYPE;  
             PRINT 'Get the list of spread security types.';  
             INSERT INTO @spreadSecTypes  
                    SELECT TypeCode  
                      FROM SecurityType WITH (NOLOCK)  
                     WHERE GroupID = 6;  
             DECLARE @rolloverDisabledList TABLE(Strategy_Name VARCHAR(50));  
             PRINT 'Get List of Strategies for which rollover is disabled.';  
             INSERT INTO @rolloverDisabledList  
                    SELECT sn.SubStrategy_Name  
                      FROM subscription_realtime AS sr WITH (NOLOCK)  
                      JOIN Strategy_New AS sn WITH (NOLOCK) ON sr.Strategy_Name = sn.SubStrategy_Name  
                      JOIN DataInit AS di WITH (NOLOCK) ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = di.substrategy_id  
                                                           AND di.Parameter = 'IsRolloverDisabled'  
                                                           AND di.Value = 'true';  
             PRINT 'Get List of Applications for which rollover is disabled.';  
             INSERT INTO @rolloverDisabledList  
                    SELECT di.Value  
                      FROM subscription_realtime AS sr WITH (NOLOCK)  
                      JOIN DataInit AS di WITH (NOLOCK) ON sr.Strategy_Name = di.Value  
                                                           AND (di.Parameter = 'StrategyName'  
                                                                OR di.Parameter = 'STRATEGY_NAME')  
                                                           AND di.substrategy_id IS NULL  
                      JOIN DataInit AS di1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON di1.ApplicationID = di.ApplicationID  
                                                            AND di1.Parameter = 'IsRolloverDisabled'  
                                                            AND di1.Value = 'true';  
             DECLARE @subscribedSec TABLE(esteeId VARCHAR(50));  
             IF @RolloverDataInit = 1  
             BEGIN  
                 PRINT 'Get List of SLA and Synthetic Transfer Apps for which rollover is disabled.';  
                 INSERT INTO @rolloverDisabledList  
                        SELECT DISTINCT  
                               di.ApplicationID  
                          FROM EsteeApplications AS ea WITH (NOLOCK)  
                          INNER JOIN DataInit AS di WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.ApplicationID = di.ApplicationID  
                         WHERE ea.AppNameID IN(41, 42) -- sla and synthetic transfer type  
                          AND di.Parameter = 'IsRolloverDisabled'  
                          AND di.Value = 'true';  
                 DECLARE @datainitSecurities TABLE(ApplicationId INT, Parameter VARCHAR(256), esteeId VARCHAR(1000), sep VARCHAR(1));  
                 PRINT 'Pick the list of esteeIds from Synthetic Transfer App and SLA datainit.';  
   INSERT INTO @datainitSecurities  
                        SELECT B.ApplicationID, B.[Parameter], s2.items,  
                                                                  CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(B.items, CHARINDEX(s2.items, B.items)+LEN(s2.items), 1) = '' THEN B.sep ELSE SUBSTRING(B.items, CHARINDEX(s2.items, B.items)+LEN(s2.items), 1) END AS sep  
                          FROM(SELECT di.ApplicationID, di.[Parameter], s.items, SUBSTRING(di.Value, CHARINDEX(s.items, di.value)+LEN(s.items), 1) AS sep  
                                 FROM dbo.EsteeApplications ea  
                                 JOIN dbo.DataInit di ON ea.ApplicationID = di.ApplicationID  
                                                         AND di.[Parameter] IN('syntheticindexEsteeIds', 'EsteeId')  
                                 CROSS APPLY dbo.Split(di.Value, ',') s  
                                WHERE ea.AppNameID IN(41, 42)  
                              ) B  
                          CROSS APPLY dbo.Split(B.items, '|') s2;  
                 INSERT INTO @subscribedSec  
                        SELECT DISTINCT  
                               Esteeid  
                          FROM @datainitSecurities  
                         WHERE LEN(esteeid) > 16  
                               AND SUBSTRING(esteeid, 13, 2) = @exchangeCode;  
             END;  
             INSERT INTO @subscribedSec  
                    SELECT DISTINCT  
                           EsteeId  
                      FROM subscription_realtime sr WITH (NOLOCK)  
                      LEFT JOIN @rolloverDisabledList rdl ON sr.Strategy_Name = rdl.Strategy_Name  
                     WHERE SUBSTRING(sr.esteeid, 13, 2) = @exchangeCode  
                           AND rdl.Strategy_Name IS NULL  
       AND isRolloverDisabled=0;  
  
    INSERT INTO @subscribedSec  
     SELECT DISTINCT ESTEEID FROM TransferAppConfig WHERE IsRolloverDisabled = 0  
  
             CREATE TABLE #allExpiredContracts(EsteeId VARCHAR(50), undEsteeId VARCHAR(50), strikePrice DECIMAL(18, 2), ExpiryDate DATE, ExpiredDate2 DATE, ContractExpiryCycle int, SecurityType int);  
             PRINT 'Get all expired contracts from esteemaster_archive for given exchange and expiry date.';  
             INSERT INTO #allExpiredContracts  
                    SELECT DISTINCT  
                           ema.Estee_ID, SUBSTRING(ema.Estee_id, 1, 16) AS undEsteeId, ema.Strike_Price, CONVERT(DATE, Expiry_date), CONVERT(DATE, Expiry_date2), ISNULL(ema.ContractExpiryCycle, 3) as ContractExpiryCycle , ema.Security_Type   
                      FROM EsteeMaster_archive ema WITH (NOLOCK)  
                     WHERE ema.Status = 1  
                           AND ema.Exchange_Code = @exchangeCode  
                           AND (CONVERT(DATE, ema.Expiry_Date) = @expiryDate  
                                OR (ema.Expiry_Date > ema.Expiry_Date2  
                                    AND CONVERT(DATE, ema.Expiry_Date2) = @expiryDate));  
             CREATE TABLE #expiredContractsToBeRollover(Esteeid VARCHAR(50), undEsteeId VARCHAR(50), strikePrice DECIMAL(18, 2), Expirydate DATE, ExpiryDate2 DATE, ContractExpiryCycle int, newEsteeid VARCHAR(50),SecurityType int);  
             PRINT 'Add all subscribed contracts which are expired to #expiredContractsToBeRollover temp table.';  
             INSERT INTO #expiredContractsToBeRollover  
                    SELECT DISTINCT  
                           sr.EsteeID, e1.undEsteeId, e1.StrikePrice, e1.ExpiryDate, e1.ExpiredDate2, e1.ContractExpiryCycle, null, e1.SecurityType   
                      FROM #allExpiredContracts e1  
                      JOIN @subscribedSec sr ON e1.EsteeId = sr.EsteeID;  
             PRINT 'Add all subscribed contracts which are mid, far etc to #expiredContractsToBeRollover temp table.';  
             INSERT INTO #expiredContractsToBeRollover  
                    SELECT DISTINCT  
                           sr.EsteeID, e1.undEsteeId, e1.StrikePrice, CONVERT(DATE, em.Expiry_Date), CONVERT(DATE, em.Expiry_Date2), e1.ContractExpiryCycle, NULL  ,e1.SecurityType   
FROM #allExpiredContracts e1  
                      JOIN esteemaster em WITH (NOLOCK) ON e1.undEsteeId = SUBSTRING(em.estee_id, 1, 16)  
                                                           AND e1.strikePrice = em.Strike_Price and e1.ContractExpiryCycle = em.ContractExpiryCycle  
                        AND em.Status = 1  
                      JOIN @subscribedSec sr ON em.Estee_ID = sr.EsteeID  
                     WHERE em.Exchange_Code = @exchangeCode  
                           AND LEN(Estee_id) > 16;   
  
  
    PRINT 'Remove All the Expired Spread Contracts'   
  
    delete e from #expiredContractsToBeRollover e   
    join @spreadSecTypes s on e.SecurityType = s.n  
    where  CONVERT(DATE, e.Expirydate) < @expiryDate OR CONVERT(DATE, e.Expirydate2) < @expiryDate  
  
    PRINT 'Fetch the rollover new esteeid for contracts to be rolled over';  
             UPDATE e  
                SET  
                    e.newEsteeid = y.newEsteeId  
               FROM #expiredContractsToBeRollover e  
               JOIN(SELECT e1.Esteeid, e2.estee_id AS newEsteeId, e1.ContractExpiryCycle, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY e1.EsteeId ORDER BY e2.Expiry_Date, CONVERT(DATE, e2.Expiry_date2) ASC) AS rn  
                      FROM #expiredContractsToBeRollover AS e1  
                      INNER JOIN esteeMaster AS e2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON e1.undEsteeId = SUBSTRING(e2.estee_id, 1, 16)  
                                                                    AND e1.strikePrice = e2.strike_Price  
                 and e1.ContractExpiryCycle = e2.ContractExpiryCycle  
                                                                    AND CONVERT(DATE, e2.Expiry_Date) > e1.Expirydate  
                                                                    AND (Security_Type NOT IN(SELECT n  
                                                                                                FROM @spreadSecTypes  
                                                                                             )  
                                                                         OR CONVERT(DATE, e2.Expiry_Date2) > e1.Expirydate2)  
                     WHERE e2.Exchange_Code = @exchangeCode  
                   ) y ON e.esteeId = y.esteeId and e.ContractExpiryCycle = y.ContractExpiryCycle  
              WHERE y.rn = 1;   
              UPDATE e  
                SET  
                    e.newEsteeid = y.newEsteeId  
               FROM #expiredContractsToBeRollover e  
               JOIN(SELECT e1.Esteeid, e2.estee_id AS newEsteeId, e1.ContractExpiryCycle, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY e1.EsteeId ORDER BY e2.Expiry_Date, CONVERT(DATE, e2.Expiry_date2) ASC) AS rn  
                      FROM #expiredContractsToBeRollover AS e1  
                      INNER JOIN esteeMaster AS e2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON e1.undEsteeId = SUBSTRING(e2.estee_id, 1, 16)  
                                                                    AND e1.strikePrice = e2.strike_Price  
                 and e1.ContractExpiryCycle = e2.ContractExpiryCycle  
                                                                    AND CONVERT(DATE, e2.Expiry_Date) > e1.Expirydate  
                                                                    AND (Security_Type IN(SELECT n FROM @spreadSecTypes )  
                                                                         and CONVERT(DATE, e2.Expiry_Date2) > e1.Expirydate2)  
                     WHERE e2.Exchange_Code = @exchangeCode  
                   ) y ON e.esteeId = y.esteeId and e.ContractExpiryCycle = y.ContractExpiryCycle  
              WHERE y.rn = 1;  
             SELECT *  
               FROM #expiredContractsToBeRollover;   
             IF @RolloverDataInit = 1  
             BEGIN  
                 PRINT 'Set new EsteeIds for @datainitSecurities';  
                 UPDATE di  
                    SET  
                        di.esteeId = e.newEsteeId  
                   FROM @datainitSecurities di  
                   INNER JOIN #expiredContractsToBeRollover e ON di.esteeId = e.Esteeid  
             AND e.newEsteeid is not null  
  
             END;  
             PRINT 'Begin Transaction.';  
             BEGIN TRAN;  
             PRINT 'Delete old Esteeids from subscription_realtime_preupdate for given exchange.';  
             DELETE FROM subscription_realtime_preupdate  
              WHERE SUBSTRING(esteeid, 13, 2) = @exchangeCode  
      and AsOfDate < DATEADD(month, -1, @expiryDate)  
             PRINT 'Move the existing list of Subscription_Realtime to backup for given exchange.';  
             INSERT INTO subscription_realtime_preupdate  
                    SELECT Strategy_Name, Esteeid, Field_Name, @exchangeCode, @expiryDate  
                      FROM subscription_realtime  
                     WHERE SUBSTRING(esteeid, 13, 2) = @exchangeCode;  
             IF @RolloverDataInit = 1  
             BEGIN  
 DECLARE @newDatainit TABLE(parameter VARCHAR(256), value VARCHAR(8000), ApplicationId INT);  
                 INSERT INTO @newDatainit  
                        SELECT parameter, STUFF((SELECT esteeid+sep  
                                                   FROM @datainitSecurities  
                                                  WHERE(Applicationid = nd.Applicationid  
                                                        AND parameter = nd.[Parameter])  
                                                  FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE  
                                                ).value('(./text())[1]', 'VARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 0, '') AS Value, ApplicationId  
                          FROM @datainitSecurities nd  
                         GROUP BY applicationid, Parameter;  
                 PRINT 'Move the old set of values from datainit to Datainit_Archive for SLA and Synthetic Transfer App (which are  going to change).';  
                 INSERT INTO datainit_Archive(Parameter, Value, substrategy_id, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate, ApplicationID)  
             SELECT DISTINCT  
         di.[Parameter], di.[Value], di.substrategy_id, -1, GETDATE(), di.ApplicationID  
                          FROM dbo.DataInit AS di WITH (NOLOCK)  
                          INNER JOIN @newDatainit AS nd ON nd.ApplicationId = di.ApplicationID  
                                                           AND nd.[Parameter] = di.[Parameter]  
                                                           AND nd.value <> di.value;  
                 PRINT 'Update Datainit values with new esteeIds.';  
                 UPDATE di  
                    SET  
                        di.[Value] = nd.value  
                   FROM dbo.DataInit di  
                   INNER JOIN @newDatainit nd ON nd.ApplicationId = di.ApplicationID  
                                                 AND nd.[Parameter] = di.[Parameter]  
                                                 AND nd.value <> di.Value;  
             END;  
             PRINT 'Delete from subscriptionlist where newDate is null.';  
             DELETE sr  
               FROM subscription_realtime AS sr  
               INNER JOIN #expiredContractsToBeRollover AS e ON sr.EsteeID = e.Esteeid  
                                                                AND e.newEsteeId IS NULL  
               INNER JOIN #expiredContractsToBeRollover AS e1 ON sr.EsteeID = e1.newEsteeId --- Need to look at again  
   where sr.IsRolloverDisabled=0;  
             PRINT 'Update subscription_realtime (replace with new esteeId).';  
             UPDATE sr  
                SET  
                    sr.EsteeID = e.newEsteeId  
               FROM subscription_realtime sr  
               LEFT JOIN @rolloverDisabledList rdl ON sr.Strategy_Name = rdl.Strategy_Name  
               INNER JOIN #expiredContractsToBeRollover e ON sr.EsteeID = e.EsteeId  
              WHERE e.newEsteeid IS NOT NULL  
                    AND rdl.Strategy_Name IS NULL  
    and sr.IsRolloverDisabled=0;  
             PRINT 'Delete expired contract from Subscription_Realtime which could not be rolled over or for which rollover is disabled.';  
             DELETE sr  
               FROM subscription_realtime sr   
               JOIN #allExpiredContracts sl ON sr.EsteeID = sl.EsteeId;  
  
      PRINT 'Delete from TransferAppConfig where newDate is null.';  
             DELETE ta  
               FROM TransferAppConfig AS ta  
               INNER JOIN #expiredContractsToBeRollover AS e ON ta.EsteeID = e.Esteeid  
                                                                AND e.newEsteeId IS NULL  
               INNER JOIN #expiredContractsToBeRollover AS e1 ON ta.EsteeID = e1.newEsteeId  
   where ta.IsRolloverDisabled=0;  
             PRINT 'Update TransferAppConfig (replace with new esteeId).';  
             UPDATE ta  
                SET  
                    ta.EsteeID = e.newEsteeId  
               FROM TransferAppConfig ta                 
               INNER JOIN #expiredContractsToBeRollover e ON ta.EsteeID = e.EsteeId  
              WHERE e.newEsteeid IS NOT NULL  
    and ta.IsRolloverDisabled=0;  
             PRINT 'Delete expired contract from TransferAppConfig which could not be rolled over or for which rollover is disabled.';  
             DELETE ta  
               FROM TransferAppConfig ta  
               JOIN #allExpiredContracts sl ON ta.EsteeID = sl.EsteeId;  
  
             COMMIT TRAN;  
             PRINT 'Transaction Committed.';  
             IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#allExpiredContracts') IS NOT NULL  
             BEGIN  
                 DROP TABLE #allExpiredContracts;  
             END;  
             IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#expiredContractsToBeRollover') IS NOT NULL  
             BEGIN  
                 DROP TABLE #expiredContractsToBeRollover;  
             END;  
         END TRY  
         BEGIN CATCH  
             IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#allExpiredContracts') IS NOT NULL  
             BEGIN  
                 DROP TABLE #allExpiredContracts;  
             END;  
             IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#expiredContractsToBeRollover') IS NOT NULL  
             BEGIN  
                 DROP TABLE #expiredContractsToBeRollover;  
             END;  
    Print XACT_STATE();  
             IF(XACT_STATE()) <> 0   
             BEGIN  
                 PRINT 'The transaction is in an uncommittable state. Rolling back transaction.';  
                 ROLLBACK TRAN;  
             END;   
             DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);  
             DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;  
             DECLARE @ErrorState INT;  
             SELECT @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();  
             -- RAISERROR inside the CATCH block will return error information about the original error that caused execution to jump to the CATCH block.    
             RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, -- Message text.    
             @ErrorSeverity, -- Severity.    
    @ErrorState -- State.    
             );  
         END CATCH;  
     END;  

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spFetchFutureIndexConstituents

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spFetchFutureIndexConstituents] 
@esteeId VARCHAR(MAX), 
@date DATE, 
@runDate DATE
AS
     BEGIN
         DECLARE @exchangeCode CHAR(2);
         SET @exchangeCode = dbo.GetExchangeCode(@esteeID);
         DECLARE @exchangeconsituentnotchanged BIT;
         IF(dbo.GetChangedDate(@date, @esteeId) >= @runDate)
         BEGIN
             SET @exchangeconsituentnotchanged = 'FALSE';
         END;
         ELSE
         BEGIN
             SET @exchangeconsituentnotchanged = 'TRUE';
         END;

         ----------------------------------------------------------------------    

         IF(@exchangeCode <> 'IS'
            OR @exchangeconsituentnotchanged = 'TRUE')
         BEGIN
             DECLARE @maxDate DATE;
             SELECT @maxDate = MAX(date)
               FROM closingprice
              WHERE Estee_Id = @esteeID;
             SELECT t.Member_Estee_ID, IssueCap, cp.Close_Price AS ClosingPrice, FFMarketCap AS MarketCap, Weightage, InvestibleFactor, ISNULL(CappingFactor, 1) CappingFactor, ISNULL(IndexMarketCap, 1) IndexMarketCap
               FROM((SELECT DISTINCT
                            Weightage, InvestibleFactor, IssueCap, Member_Estee_ID, FFMarketCap, ISNULL(CappingFactor, 1) CappingFactor, ISNULL(IndexMarketCap, 1) IndexMarketCap
                       FROM IndexTable
                      WHERE ASOfDate = @runDate
                            AND Estee_ID = @esteeID
					   and Member_Estee_id<> Estee_id
                    ) AS t
               INNER JOIN(SELECT *
                            FROM closingprice
                           WHERE [Date] = @maxDate
                         ) AS cp ON cp.Estee_ID = t.Member_Estee_ID);
         END

             ------------------------------------------------------------------------  
             ;
         ELSE
         BEGIN
             DECLARE @Index_ISIN CHAR(12);
             SELECT @Index_ISIN = ISIN
               FROM esteemaster
              WHERE Estee_ID = @esteeID;
             DECLARE @changedDate DATE;
             SELECT @changedDate = dbo.GetChangedDate(@date, @esteeId);
             DECLARE @NewInclusions TABLE(Estee_ID CHAR(16));
             INSERT INTO @NewInclusions
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                           MemberEsteeID
                      FROM NSEIndexData NID
                     WHERE ASOfDate = @changedDate
                           AND Index_ISIN = @Index_ISIN
                           AND RunDate >= @runDate
                    EXCEPT
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                           MemberEsteeID
                      FROM NSEIndexData
                     WHERE ASOfDate = @runDate
                           AND Index_ISIN = @Index_ISIN
                           AND RunDate >= @runDate;
             SELECT e.Estee_ID AS Member_Estee_ID, Issue_Cap AS IssueCap, Close_Price AS ClosingPrice, Mkt_Cap AS MarketCap, Weightage, Investible_Factor AS InvestibleFactor, ISNULL(CappingFactor, 1) CappingFactor, 1 AS IndexMarketCap
               FROM NSEIndexData NID
               INNER JOIN esteemaster e ON e.Estee_ID = NID.MemberEsteeID
                                           AND e.Security_Type = 0
                                           AND e.Exchange_Code = 'IS'
                                           AND NID.AsOfDate = @changedDate
              WHERE Index_ISIN = @Index_ISIN
                    AND NID.ASOfDate = @changedDate
                    AND NID.MemberEsteeID NOT IN(SELECT Estee_ID
                                                   FROM @NewInclusions
                                                )
             UNION
             SELECT DISTINCT
                    cp.Estee_ID AS Member_Estee_ID, CONVERT(DECIMAL(38, 0), CAST(ns.issued_capital AS FLOAT)) AS IssueCap, cp.Close_Price AS closingPrice, (CONVERT(NUMERIC(38, 0), CAST(ns.issued_capital AS FLOAT)) * cp.Close_Price * ff.INVESTIBLE_FACTOR) AS MarketCap, 0 AS weightage, ff.INVESTIBLE_FACTOR AS InvestibleFactor, 1 CappingFactor, 1 AS IndexMarketCap
               FROM @NewInclusions INCL
               INNER JOIN esteemaster E ON INCL.Estee_ID = E.Estee_ID
                                           AND E.Security_Type = 0
                                           AND E.Exchange_Code = 'IS'
               INNER JOIN NSE_Security ns ON ns.SYMBOL = E.Underlying_Ticker
                                             AND ns.series = 'EQ'
                                             AND ns.Eligibility_NormalMkt = 1
               INNER JOIN closingprice cp ON E.Estee_ID = cp.Estee_ID
                                             AND cp.Date = @runDate
               INNER JOIN Freefloat ff ON E.Underlying_Ticker = ff.SYMBOL;
         END;
     END;
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spFetchSubscriptionRealtimeRecords

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spFetchSubscriptionRealtimeRecords]
AS
BEGIN

CREATE TABLE #MyTempTable (Estee_id varchar(100))

DECLARE @MaxCPDate varchar(30)
SET @MaxCPDate = (SELECT MAX(DATE) FROM closingprice)

-- 1. securities with non-zero positions
insert into #MyTempTable
select estee_id from dailypositions
where PositionDate = (select Max(positiondate) from dailypositions) and (Long-Short)!=0
group by estee_id

-- 2. securities traded in last 30 days
insert into #MyTempTable
select distinct estee_id from Trades where Creation_Date< GETDATE() and Creation_Date >= (GETDATE()-30)

--3. Indices : a. spot | b. nearest 3 futures & 15 nearest strikes to closingprice of spot
--a)
insert into #MyTempTable
select e.Estee_ID from esteemaster as e
inner join SecurityType as s
on e.Security_Type = s.TypeCode
where ISIN in (select index_isin from indexlist) and s.TypeName like '%SPOT%'


--b)
DECLARE @mycur CURSOR
DECLARE @Isin VARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @SpotClosingPrice decimal(20,5)

SET @mycur  = CURSOR 
FOR
SELECT INDEX_ISIN FROM INDEXLIST
OPEN @mycur
FETCH NEXT FROM @mycur into @Isin

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS =0
BEGIN
---******FOR EACH INDEX*************
-- GET NEAREST 3 FUTURE CONTRACTS
insert into #MyTempTable
SELECT top 3 e.Estee_ID FROM esteemaster as e
inner join SecurityType as s
on e.Security_Type = s.TypeCode
where ISIN = @Isin and s.TypeName like '%FUTURE%'
order by Expiry_Date asc

-- GET INDEX SPOT CLOSING PRICE
SET @SpotClosingPrice =
(SELECT close_price FROM CLOSINGPRICE as c
INNER JOIN esteemaster as e
on e.Estee_ID = c.Estee_ID
INNER JOIN SecurityType as s
on e.Security_Type = s.TypeCode
where e.ISIN = @Isin and s.TypeName like '%SPOT%'
and c.date = @MaxCPDate
)
print @Isin 
print @SpotClosingPrice

-- GET 15 CLOSEST OPTION STRIKES TO CLOSING PRICE FOR THE THREE NEAREST EXPIRY DATES
insert into #MyTempTable
SELECT top 15 Estee_ID FROM ESTEEMASTER AS E
INNER JOIN SecurityType AS S
ON E.Security_Type = S.TypeCode
WHERE (S.TypeName like '%PUT%' or S.TypeName like '%CALL%') AND ISIN = @Isin
and Expiry_Date in (select top 3 Expiry_Date from esteemaster where ISIN = @Isin order by Expiry_Date asc)
order by abs(@SpotClosingPrice-e.Strike_Price) asc

---****************************
FETCH NEXT FROM @mycur INTO @Isin
END
DEALLOCATE @mycur



--4. 100 most liquid EQ
insert into #MyTempTable
select top 100 c.Estee_ID from closingprice as c
inner join esteemaster as e
on c.Estee_ID = e.Estee_ID
where c.DATE = @MaxCPDate and e.Security_Type=0
order by Volume desc



--5. 50 most liquid EQFUT
insert into #MyTempTable
select top 50 c.Estee_ID from closingprice as c
inner join esteemaster as e
on c.Estee_ID = e.Estee_ID
where c.DATE =@MaxCPDate and e.Security_Type=1
order by Volume desc



--6. 20 most liquid spreads
insert into #MyTempTable
select top 20 c.Estee_ID from closingprice as c
inner join esteemaster as e
on c.Estee_ID = e.Estee_ID
where c.DATE = @MaxCPDate and e.Security_Type in (8,9,14)
order by Volume desc

select 'All',Estee_id,null from 
(select distinct estee_id from #MyTempTable
where estee_id not in (select distinct esteeid from subscription_realtime)) as X
drop table #MyTempTable
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spFileDumpInDatabase

```sql
  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spFileDumpInDatabase]        
 @TableName varchar (50),  
 @File_path varchar (max),  
 @FIRSTROW varchar(5),  
 @FIELDTERMINATOR char(1)  
   
     
AS      
BEGIN       
      
declare @sql varchar(200)  
set @sql = 'delete from ' + @TableName  
BEGIN TRY  
BEGIN TRANSACTION  
exec (@sql)  
      
EXEC('BULK INSERT '+ @TableName +' FROM ''' + @File_path + ''' WITH ( FIRSTROW = ' + @FIRSTROW + ', FIELDTERMINATOR = '''+@FIELDTERMINATOR+''', ROWTERMINATOR = ''\n'')')      
COMMIT TRANSACTION  
END TRY  
  
BEGIN CATCH  
 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION  
   
 DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);    
   DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;    
   DECLARE @ErrorState INT;    
          
   SELECT @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),    
       @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),    
       @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();    
          
   -- RAISERROR inside the CATCH block will return error information about the original error that caused execution to jump to the CATCH block.      
   RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage, -- Message text.    
        @ErrorSeverity, -- Severity.    
        @ErrorState -- State.    
        );    
          
END CATCH       
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spFilterAllOrders

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spFilterAllOrders]  
@Status VARCHAR(100),  
@SubStrategyId VARCHAR(100)  
AS  
  
BEGIN  
      SELECT   
   o.Order_ID,  
   o.Order_Type,  
   o.Order_Validity,  
   o.Broker_ID,  
   o.Account_ID,  
   o.Broker_Order_ID,  
   o.Exchange_Order_ID,  
   ot.Remarks,  
   o.Comb_Status,  
   ot.New_Cancel_Modify,  
   o.Sub_Strategy_ID,  
   o.Order_Source_ID,  
   o.Underlying_Ticker ,  
   ot.OrderTrade_ID,  
   ot.Status,  
   ot.islast,  
   ot.Price_Diff,  
   ot.Original_Order_ID,  
   ot.Creation_Date,
   ot.Creation_Time,  
   ot.Created_By,  
   ot.Update_Time,  
   ot.Updated_By,  
   'ESTEE',  
   o.Link_ID,
   o.Ems_ID as EmsID
   from [Order] o
   inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID
   where o.Creation_Date >= cast(CONVERT(char(12), GETDATE(), 1) as date) 
   AND ot.Status  in (SELECT * from Split(@Status,','))  
   AND o.Sub_Strategy_ID In(SELECT * from Split(@SubStrategyId,','))  
   Order by ot.Update_Time Asc  
  
   SELECT   t.OrderTrade_ID,  
   t.TRADE_ID,  
   t.Estee_ID,  
   t.Buy_Sell_Indicator,  
   t.Order_Quantity,  
   t.Order_Price,   
   t.Traded_Quantity,  
   t.Traded_Price,  
   t.Stop_Price,  
   t.Transaction_Cost,
   o.ems_id as EmsID
   from [Order] o
	inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID
	inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID
	where o.Creation_Date >= cast(CONVERT(char(12), GETDATE()-1, 1) as date)
    AND ot.Status  in (SELECT * from Split(@Status,','))  
    AND o.Sub_Strategy_ID In(SELECT * from Split(@SubStrategyId,','))  
    ORDER BY ot.Update_Time Asc  
   OPTION (MAXDOP 1)  
End

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spFilterAllOrders_Paging

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spFilterAllOrders_Paging]        
 @Status VARCHAR(500),        
 @SubStrategyId VARCHAR(500),        
 @PageNo int,        
 @RecordCount int,        
 @UpdateTime DATETIME Output,  
 @OpenOrderFlag bit=0       
      
 AS        
      
 BEGIN        
  DECLARE @startTime as DATE          
        
  IF @UpdateTime is null SET @UpdateTime = DATEADD(d, 1, getdate())        
  SET @startTime = GETDATE()         
        
  DECLARE @CancelledOrderIDs TABLE (OID int)  
  DECLARE @tblstatus TABLE (s varchar(100))        
  DECLARE @tblStrategy TABLE (sID int)        
  DECLARE @ordertab TABLE (row int, orderID int, orderTradeID int, updateTime datetime)        
        
  INSERT INTO @tblStatus       
  SELECT * from Split(@status,',')        
        
  INSERT INTO @tblStrategy       
  SELECT * from Split(@SubStrategyId,',')          
  
  if(@OpenOrderFlag = 1)  
  begin  
  
   insert into @CancelledOrderIDs  
   select Order_ID from OrderTrades ot WITH (NOLOCK)  
   INNER JOIN @tblStrategy ts on ot.Sub_Strategy_ID = ts.sID where Creation_Date = @startTime and Status = 'Cancelled'  
      
   INSERT INTO @ordertab(row, orderID, orderTradeID, updateTime)        
   SELECT * FROM  (          
    SELECT  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.update_Time DESC) AS Row,   B.Order_ID,   A.OrderTrade_ID,   A.Update_Time         
    FROM [Order] B WITH (NOLOCK)           
    INNER JOIN @tblStrategy ts ON ts.sID = B.Sub_Strategy_ID         
    INNER JOIN OrderTrades  A WITH (NOLOCK, INDEX(IX_ordertrades_orderdatestatus)) on B.Order_ID = A.Order_ID and B.Creation_Date = A.Creation_Date                   
    --INNER JOIN @tblStatus s ON s.s = A.Status      
    WHERE B.Creation_Date BETWEEN @startTime AND @UpdateTime          
   AND A.Status in (SELECT s FROM @tblstatus) and A.Order_ID not in ( select OID from @CancelledOrderIDs) and B.Order_Validity <> 3  
    ) as OrderData        
   WHERE  Row >= @PageNo*@RecordCount AND Row < (@PageNo+1)*@RecordCount   
  end  
  else  
  begin  
  INSERT INTO @ordertab(row, orderID, orderTradeID, updateTime)        
    SELECT * FROM  (          
     SELECT  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.update_Time DESC) AS Row,   B.Order_ID,   A.OrderTrade_ID,   A.Update_Time         
     FROM [Order] B WITH (NOLOCK)           
     INNER JOIN @tblStrategy ts ON ts.sID = B.Sub_Strategy_ID         
     INNER JOIN OrderTrades  A WITH (NOLOCK, INDEX(IX_ordertrades_orderdatestatus)) on B.Order_ID = A.Order_ID and B.Creation_Date = A.Creation_Date                   
     --INNER JOIN @tblStatus s ON s.s = A.Status      
     WHERE B.Creation_Date BETWEEN @startTime AND @UpdateTime          
    AND A.Status in (SELECT s FROM @tblstatus)      
     ) as OrderData        
    WHERE  Row >= @PageNo*@RecordCount AND Row < (@PageNo+1)*@RecordCount   
  end          
        
  SELECT B.ClientOrder_ID, A.ClientOrderTrade_ID , B.Order_ID,   B.Order_Type,        
    B.Order_Validity,   B.Broker_ID,   B.Account_ID,   B.Broker_Order_ID,   B.Exchange_Order_ID,   A.Remarks,         
    B.Comb_Status,   
    A.New_Cancel_Modify,   B.Sub_Strategy_ID,   B.Order_Source_ID,   B.Underlying_Ticker ,         
    A.OrderTrade_ID,     
    CASE WHEN B.Order_Type IN ('Y','Z') and A.Status = 'Partially Filled'   
    THEN 'Executed'  
 ELSE A.Status END AS Status,  
    A.islast,      
    A.Price_Diff,   A.Original_Order_ID,   A.Creation_Date,A.Creation_Time,   A.Created_By,   A.Update_Time,   A.Updated_By,   'ESTEE' as BROKER,         
    B.Link_ID,   t.TRADE_ID,   t.Estee_ID,   t.Buy_Sell_Indicator,   t.Order_Quantity,   t.Order_Price,    t.Traded_Quantity,         
    t.Traded_Price,   t.Stop_Price,   t.Transaction_Cost, B.ems_id as EmsID         
  FROM @ordertab o         
  INNER JOIN [Order] B WITH (NOLOCK) ON B.order_ID = o.orderID           
  INNER JOIN OrderTrades A WITH (NOLOCK) on B.Order_ID = A.Order_ID and o.orderTradeID = a.OrderTrade_ID and B.Creation_Date = A.Creation_Date       
  INNER JOIN Trades t WITH (NOLOCK) on t.OrderTrade_ID = a.OrderTrade_ID and t.Order_ID = a.Order_ID and t.Creation_Date = a.Creation_Date         
  WHERE a.Creation_Date BETWEEN @startTime AND @UpdateTime 
  order by Order_ID, OrderTrade_ID         
End

```

```sql
 ) AS OrderData

  ELSE

 B.Comb_Status, A.New_Cancel_Modify, B.Sub_Strategy_ID, B.Order_Source_ID, B.Underlying_Ticker, A.OrderTrade_ID,  
 CASE WHEN B.Order_Type IN ('Y','Z') and A.Status = 'Partially Filled' THEN 'Executed' ELSE A.Status END AS Status,  
    A.islast, A.Price_Diff, A.Original_Order_ID, A.Creation_Date, A.Creation_Time, A.Created_By, A.Update_Time, A.Updated_By, 'ESTEE' as BROKER,  
 B.Link_ID, t.TRADE_ID, t.Estee_ID, t.Buy_Sell_Indicator, t.Order_Quantity, t.Order_Price, t.Traded_Quantity, t.Traded_Price, t.Stop_Price, t.Transaction_Cost,  
 B.ems_id as EmsID, t.execid as execid, em.DataFeed_Ticker
  FROM @ordertab o  
  INNER JOIN [Order] B WITH (NOLOCK) ON B.order_ID = o.orderID  
  INNER JOIN OrderTrades A WITH (NOLOCK) on B.Order_ID = A.Order_ID and o.orderTradeID = a.OrderTrade_ID and B.Creation_Date = A.Creation_Date  
  INNER JOIN Trades t WITH (NOLOCK) on t.OrderTrade_ID = a.OrderTrade_ID and t.Order_ID = a.Order_ID and t.Creation_Date = a.Creation_Date

  END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGet100ExecutedOrders

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Vishen>
-- Create date: <08/29/2011>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGet100ExecutedOrders]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	SELECT  TOP 100 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.update_Time DESC) AS Row,
		B.Order_ID,
		B.Order_Type,
		B.Order_Validity,
		B.Account_ID,
		B.Underlying_Ticker ,
		A.New_Cancel_Modify,
		B.Sub_Strategy_ID,
		A.OrderTrade_ID,
		A.Status,
		A.Price_Diff,
		A.Update_Time,
		t.TRADE_ID,
		t.Buy_Sell_Indicator,
		t.Order_Quantity,
		t.Order_Price,
		t.Estee_ID,
		t.Traded_Quantity,
		t.Traded_Price
		FROM [Order] B WITH (NOLOCK)  
		INNER JOIN OrderTrades  A WITH (NOLOCK) on B.Order_ID = A.Order_ID and B.Creation_Date = A.Creation_Date			
		INNER JOIN Trades t WITH (NOLOCK) on t.OrderTrade_ID = a.OrderTrade_ID and t.Order_ID = a.Order_ID and t.Creation_Date = a.Creation_Date
		WHERE A.Creation_Date >= CAST(convert(varchar(100), Getdate(), 1) as date)
			AND a.status IN ('Executed','Partially Filled')
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetAccountDASDiffernce

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetAccountDASDiffernce]  
@prevWorkingDate Date,
@tradeDate Date,
@exchangeCode varchar(100)

As

BEGIN  
CREATE TABLE #tempNAE  
(      
       AccountId int,  
       NAE decimal,  
       TC decimal,  
       SecurityTypeName varchar(100)  
)  
CREATE TABLE #tempMTM  
(     
       AccountId int,  
       MTM decimal,	 
)  

CREATE TABLE #tempPosVal
(
	 AccountId int,  
     PosVal decimal,
	 SecurityTypeName varchar(100)
)

--Get NAE  
INSERT INTO #tempNAE  
SELECT Account_ID AS AccountId,SUM(traded_price * traded_quantity * (2*buy_sell_indicator-3)) AS NAE ,  sum(Transaction_Cost) AS TC ,sG.Name AS SecurityTypeName   
FROM vwAllTrades v (nolock)  
left join esteemaster (nolock) e on e.Estee_ID = v.Estee_ID  
left join EsteeMaster_archive (nolock) ea on ea.Estee_ID = v.Estee_ID and ea.Status = 1  
left join SecurityType (nolock) sT on sT.TypeCode = e.Security_Type OR sT.TypeCode = ea.Security_Type  
left join SecurityGroup (nolock) sG on sT.GroupID = sG.ID   
WHERE Creation_Date = @tradeDate
AND v.Status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') GROUP BY Creation_Date,Account_ID,sG.Name

---Fill account Id having carry forward positions

select distinct d.Account_ID as AccountId, 0 AS NAE, 0 AS TC, sg.Name AS SecurityTypeName into #carryfrdAcc from DailyPositions (nolock) d
left join SecurityType (nolock) sT on sT.TypeCode = substring(d.Estee_ID,15,2)
left join SecurityGroup (nolock) sG on sT.GroupID = sG.ID   
left join #tempNAE t 
on d.Account_ID = t.AccountId and sg.Name = t.SecurityTypeName
where d.PositionDate = @tradeDate and d.Long <> d.Short and t.AccountId is null

INSERT INTO #tempNAE
select * from #carryfrdAcc

INSERT INTO #tempNAE
select c.AccountId, c.NAE, c.TC, 'Options' from #carryfrdAcc c

INSERT INTO #tempNAE
select c.AccountId, c.NAE, c.TC, 'Spot' from #carryfrdAcc c

--Get MTM
select distinct d.Account_ID, sum((d.Long-d.Short)*case when isnull(c.Settlement_price,0) = 0 then c.Close_Price else c.Settlement_price end) as MTM, sg.Name into #MTM1 from dailypositions d  (nolock) left join SecurityType (nolock) sT ON sT.TypeName = D.SecurityType  
left join SecurityGroup (nolock) sg on sg.ID = st.GroupID   
left join closingprice (nolock) c  on c.Estee_ID = d.Estee_ID and d.PositionDate = c.Date   
where d.PositionDate =@tradeDate and d.Long <> d.Short  --and sg.Name = 'Futures'
group by d.Account_ID,sg.Name

select d.Account_ID, sum((d.Long-d.Short)*case when isnull(c.Settlement_price,0) = 0 then c.Close_Price else c.Settlement_price end) as MTM into #MTM0 from dailypositions d  (nolock) left join SecurityType (nolock) sT ON sT.TypeName = D.SecurityType  
left join SecurityGroup (nolock) sg on sg.ID = st.GroupID   
left join closingprice (nolock) c  on c.Estee_ID = d.Estee_ID and d.PositionDate = c.Date   
where d.PositionDate = @prevWorkingDate and d.Long <> d.Short  and sg.Name = 'Futures'
group by d.Account_ID

INSERT INTO #tempMTM
select distinct t.AccountId, t.NAE + isNull(m1.MTM, 0) - isnull(m0.MTM, 0) MTM from #tempNAE t 
left join #MTM1 m1 on t.AccountId = m1.Account_ID and m1.Name = 'Futures'
left join #MTM0 m0 on t.AccountId = m0.Account_ID 
where t.NAE + isNull(m1.MTM, 0) - isnull(m0.MTM, 0) <> 0 and t.SecurityTypeName = 'Futures'

INSERT INTO #tempPosVal
select distinct t.AccountId, m1.MTM, m1.Name from #tempNAE t 
left join #MTM1 m1 on t.AccountId = m1.Account_ID and m1.Name <> 'Futures'

--Get Rebate,Dividend,Stipend  
SELECT ISNULL(T4.AccountId , T3.AccountID) AS AccountId , ISNULL(T4.Stipend,0) as Stipend, ISNULL(T4.Rebate,0) as Rebate ,ISNULL(T3.Dividend,0) as Dividend,
ISNULL(T5.Penalty,0) as Penalty, ISNULL(T6.MinimumChargeCommitment,0) as MinimumChargeCommitment, ISNULL(T7.MISCCharges,0) as MISCCharges into #Rebate  FROM  
(  
       SELECT ISNULL(T1.AccountId , T2.AccountID) AS AccountId , ISNULL(T1.Stipend,0) as Stipend ,ISNULL(T2.Rebate,0)  as Rebate  
	   FROM  
       (  
			 (
			  SELECT tReb.AccountId, SUM(tReb.TotalRebate) as Stipend FROM tblRebateData tReb WHERE RebateType LIKE '%Stipend%' and CAST(RebateDate as date) = @tradedate group by AccountID ) AS T1  
       FULL OUTER JOIN  
              (
			  SELECT tReb.AccountId, SUM(tReb.TotalRebate) as Rebate FROM tblRebateData tReb WHERE RebateType = 'ExchangeRebate' and CAST(RebateDate as date) = @tradeDate group by tReb.AccountId) AS T2  
			  ON T1.AccountId = T2.AccountID  
			  )) AS T4  
FULL OUTER JOIN  
       ( select tReb.AccountId, SUM(tReb.TotalRebate) as Dividend FROM tblRebateData tReb WHERE RebateType = 'Dividend' and CAST(RebateDate as date) = @tradeDate group by AccountID
	   ) AS T3  ON T4.AccountId = T3.AccountID  
FULL OUTER JOIN  
	   ( select tReb.AccountId, SUM(tReb.TotalRebate) as Penalty FROM tblRebateData tReb WHERE RebateType = 'Penalty' and CAST(RebateDate as date) = @tradeDate group by AccountID
	   ) AS T5  ON T3.AccountId = T5.AccountID  
FULL OUTER JOIN  
	   ( select tReb.AccountId, SUM(tReb.TotalRebate) as MinimumChargeCommitment FROM tblRebateData tReb WHERE RebateType = 'MinimumChargeCommitment' and CAST(RebateDate as date) = @tradeDate group by AccountID
	   ) AS T6  ON T5.AccountId = T6.AccountID  
FULL OUTER JOIN  
	   ( select tReb.AccountId, SUM(tReb.TotalRebate) as MISCCharges FROM tblRebateData tReb WHERE RebateType = 'MISCCharges' and CAST(RebateDate as date) = @tradeDate group by AccountID
	   ) AS T7  ON T6.AccountId = T7.AccountID  

SELECT distinct tNae.AccountId, tNae.NAE as NAE, tNae.TC, tMTM.MTM, ISNULL(p.PosVal, 0) PosVal, isnull(tNae.SecurityTypeName, 'Invalid') SecurityTypeName into #FinalResult FROM  
#tempNAE tNae left JOIN   
#tempMTM tMTM ON tNae.AccountId = tMTM.AccountId and tNae.SecurityTypeName = 'Futures'
left join #tempPosVal p on tNae.AccountId = p.AccountId and tNae.SecurityTypeName = p.SecurityTypeName

select @tradeDate Date, a.Account_Id as [Account Id],  
  isnull(res.MTM, 0) MTM,  
  case when res.SecurityTypeName = 'Options' then isnull(res.NAE, 0) else 0 end AS [Premium], 
  case when res.SecurityTypeName = 'Options' then isnull(res.PosVal, 0) else 0 end as [Net Option Value],  
  case when res.SecurityTypeName = 'Spot' then isnull(res.PosVal, 0) else 0 end as [Stock Value],  
  isnull(res.TC, 0) TC,   
  case when res.SecurityTypeName = 'Spot' then isnull(res.NAE, 0) else 0 end AS [Cash Payin/PayOut],  
  isnull(rbt.Stipend, 0) Stipend,  
  isnull(rbt.Rebate, 0) Rebate,  
  isnull(rbt.Dividend , 0) Dividend, 
  isnull(rbt.Penalty , 0) Penalty,
  isnull(rbt.MinimumChargeCommitment , 0) MinimumChargeCommitment,
  isnull(rbt.MISCCharges , 0) MISCCharges,
  isnull(res.NAE, 0) NAE,  
  isnull(res.SecurityTypeName,'Spot') SecurityTypeName   --For rebate handling
  from Account a   
left join #FinalResult res on a.account_Id = res.accountId  
left join #Rebate rbt on rbt.AccountId = a.account_Id
where a.Exchange_Code = @exchangeCode  and a.Status = 'Active'
order by a.Account_Id   

DROP TABLE #tempNAE;  
DROP TABLE #tempMTM;  
DROP TABLE #FinalResult;  
DROP TABLE #Rebate  
DROP TABLE #MTM1
DROP TABLE #MTM0
DROP TABLE #tempPosVal
DROP TABLE #carryfrdAcc

END 


```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetAccountLevelTradeSummary]
@startdate datetime = '2010-12-1'
AS

BEGIN
 
	select	account_id,
			sum(CASE buy_sell_indicator
					WHEN 1 then traded_quantity
					ELSE 0
				END
				) as BuyTradeQuantity,
			sum(CASE buy_sell_indicator
					WHEN 2 then traded_quantity
					ELSE 0
				END
				) as SellTradeQuantity
	from vwalltrades WITH (NOLOCK) where status in ('Executed','Partially Filled')
	and Creation_Date  >= @startDate 
	group by account_id
	order by account_id
	OPTION (MAXDOP 1)

END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetAccountScriptLevelTradeSummary

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetAccountScriptLevelTradeSummary]
@startdate datetime = '2010-12-1'
AS

BEGIN

		select v.account_id,e.datafeed_ticker,
			sum(case v.buy_sell_indicator
				when 1 then v.traded_quantity
				else 0
				end ) as BuyTradeQuantity,
			sum(case v.buy_sell_indicator
				when 2 then v.traded_quantity
				else 0
				end ) as SellTradeQuantity
		from vwalltrades v with (nolock)
		inner join esteemaster e with (nolock) on e.estee_id = v.estee_id and e.Exchange_Code='IS' and e.security_type in (0,1) 
		where v.status in ('Executed','Partially Filled')
		and v.Creation_Date  >= @startDate 
		group by v.account_id, e.datafeed_ticker
		order by v.account_id, e.datafeed_ticker
		option (maxdop 1)

END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetAlgoRule]      

	@ruleID int,@userID int 

AS      

BEGIN   

SET NOCOUNT ON 
 
 IF(@ruleID <> 0)
 BEGIN
	SELECT ar.*,arl.*,au.* FROM AlgoRule ar inner join 
	RuleLegMap rlm on ar.RuleID = rlm.RuleID
	inner join AlgoRuleLeg arl on arl.LegID = rlm.LegID
	inner join AlgoUserToEsteeMap au on au.UserID = ar.UserID
	WHERE ar.RuleID = @ruleID and ar.IsActive = 1 and ar.UserID = @userID

	inner join AlgoRuleLeg arl on arl.LegID = rlm.LegID
	inner join AlgoUserToEsteeMap au on au.UserID = ar.UserID
	WHERE ar.IsActive = 1 and ar.UserID = @userID
END


END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetAllBannedSecuritiesAtStrategyAccountLevel

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetAllBannedSecuritiesAtStrategyAccountLevel 
       @banDate DATETIME = NULL
AS
     BEGIN
         BEGIN TRY
             IF @banDate IS NULL
                 BEGIN
                     SET @banDate = GETDATE();
                 END;

             BEGIN
                 SELECT A.DimensionID, A.DimensionValue, E.Estee_ID, A.BanGroupId, A.permissionid, A.SecurityTypes
                 FROM(SELECT BGA.DimensionID, BGA.DimensionValue, BS.ISIN, BS.BanGroupId, Bp.id AS permissionId, BS.SecurityTypes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BS.ISIN ORDER BY BP.Severity DESC) AS RowId
                      FROM dbo.BannedSecurities AS BS
                           LEFT JOIN dbo.BanGroupAllotment AS BGA ON BS.BanGroupId = BGA.BanGroupID
                           INNER JOIN dbo.BanPermission AS BP ON bp.ID = bs.BanPermissionId
                      WHERE BS.BanStatus = 1
                            AND DimensionID = (SELECT PD.DimensionId
                                               FROM dbo.ParameterDimension AS PD
                                               WHERE PD.DimensionName = 'StrategyAccount')
                            AND CONVERT(DATE, BS.BanDate) = CONVERT(DATE, @banDate)) A
                     INNER JOIN dbo.esteemaster AS E ON A.ISIN = E.ISIN
                                                        AND E.Security_Type IN(SELECT *
                                                                               FROM Split(A.SecurityTypes, ','))
                 WHERE rowid = 1
                 UNION
                 SELECT A.DimensionID, A.DimensionValue, E.Estee_ID, A.BanGroupId, A.permissionid, A.SecurityTypes
                 FROM(SELECT BGA.DimensionID, BGA.DimensionValue, BS.ISIN, BS.BanGroupId, Bp.id AS permissionId, BS.SecurityTypes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BS.ISIN ORDER BY BP.Severity DESC) AS RowId
                      FROM dbo.BannedSecurities AS BS
                           LEFT JOIN dbo.BanGroupAllotment AS BGA ON BS.BanGroupId = BGA.BanGroupID
                           INNER JOIN dbo.BanPermission AS BP ON bp.ID = bs.BanPermissionId
                      WHERE BS.BanStatus = 1
                            AND (BGA.DimensionID = (SELECT PD.DimensionId
                                                    FROM dbo.ParameterDimension AS PD
                                                    WHERE PD.DimensionName = 'Account')
                                 OR BGA.DimensionID = (SELECT PD.DimensionId
                                                       FROM dbo.ParameterDimension AS PD
                                                       WHERE PD.DimensionName = 'Exchange'))
                            AND CONVERT(DATE, BS.BanDate) = CONVERT(DATE, @banDate)) A
                     INNER JOIN dbo.esteemaster AS E ON A.ISIN = E.ISIN
                                                        AND E.Security_Type IN(SELECT *
                                                                               FROM Split(A.SecurityTypes, ','))
                 WHERE rowid = 1;

             END;
         END TRY
         BEGIN CATCH
             DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);
             DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;
             DECLARE @ErrorState INT;
             SELECT @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();

             -- RAISERROR inside the CATCH block will return error information about the original error that caused execution to jump to the CATCH block.  

             RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, -- Message text.  

             @ErrorSeverity, -- Severity.  

             @ErrorState -- State.  

             );
         END CATCH;
     END;

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetAllCorporateAction

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetAllCorporateAction]          
@UnderlyingEsteeId VARCHAR(50) = null,   
@EffectiveDate DATETIME  = null,        
@Action VARCHAR(50) = null,                          
@Remarks VARCHAR(500) = null,          
@ActionType VARCHAR(50) = null,  
@FromDate DATETIME=null,  
@ToDate DATETIME=null  
AS          
BEGIN   
 IF @FromDate IS NOT NULL  
 BEGIN  
  IF @ToDate IS NOT NULL  
  BEGIN  
   SELECT UnderlyingEsteeId, EM.DataFeed_Ticker, EffectiveDate,[Action],Remarks,ActionType,LastUpdateTime   
   FROM [CorporateActionTable] CA
   inner join esteemaster EM
   on EM.Estee_ID = CA.UnderlyingEsteeId 
   WHERE EffectiveDate >=@FromDate   
   AND  EffectiveDate <=@ToDate   
   AND  UnderlyingEsteeId IS NOT NULL  
  END  
  ELSE  
  BEGIN  
   SELECT UnderlyingEsteeId,EM.DataFeed_Ticker, EffectiveDate,[Action],Remarks,ActionType,LastUpdateTime   
   FROM [CorporateActionTable] CA
   inner join esteemaster EM
   on EM.Estee_ID = CA.UnderlyingEsteeId 
   WHERE EffectiveDate >=@FromDate    
   AND  UnderlyingEsteeId IS NOT NULL  
  END  
 END  
 ELSE  
 BEGIN  
  SELECT UnderlyingEsteeId, EM.DataFeed_Ticker,EffectiveDate,[Action],Remarks,ActionType,LastUpdateTime   
  FROM [CorporateActionTable] CA
  inner join esteemaster EM
  on EM.Estee_ID = CA.UnderlyingEsteeId  
  WHERE UnderlyingEsteeId IS NOT NULL  
 END  
END

```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetAllCurrentOrders]   
@currentFetchTimeOut Datetime output  

AS  
BEGIN  

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED
   --get PendingOrders  
	SET @currentFetchTimeOut = getDate()  
	DECLARE @today DATETIME
	DECLARE @tomorrow DATETIME
	SET @today = CAST(CONVERT(varchar(10), getDate(), 101) AS DATETIME)
	SET @tomorrow = DATEADD(d, 1, @today)

   
 SELECT   
 o.Order_ID,  
 o.Order_Type,  
 o.Order_Validity,  
 o.Account_ID,  
 o.Broker_Order_ID,  
 o.Exchange_Order_ID,  
 ot.Remarks,  
 o.Comb_Status,  
 ot.New_Cancel_Modify,
 o.Sub_Strategy_ID,  
 o.Order_Source_ID,  
 o.Underlying_Ticker AS Short_Name,  
 ot.OrderTrade_ID,  
 ot.Status,  
 ot.islast,  
 ot.Price_Diff,  
 cast(ot.Original_Order_ID AS varchar(20)) Original_Order_ID,   
 ot.Creation_Date,
 ot.Creation_Time,  
 ot.Created_By,  
 convert(char, ot.Update_Time, 108) Update_Time,  
 ot.Updated_By,  
 C.Broker_Name,  
 o.Broker_ID, 
 t.TRADE_ID,  
 t.Estee_ID,  
 t.Buy_Sell_Indicator,  
 t.Order_Quantity,  
 t.Order_Price,   
 t.Traded_Quantity,  
 t.Traded_Price,  
 t.Stop_Price,  
 t.Transaction_Cost,
 o.Link_ID 
from [Order] o
inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID
inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID
inner join  Broker as C WITH (NOLOCK)  on o.broker_id = C.broker_id   
 WHERE   
  ot.[Status] not in ('Rejected','Executed','Cancelled','Halted','Inactive','Stopped')   
  AND o.Creation_Date >= @today AND o.Creation_Date < @tomorrow  
   
 --get ExecutedOrders  
 SELECT   
 o.Order_ID,  
 o.Order_Type,  
 o.Order_Validity,  
  
 o.Account_ID,  
 o.Broker_Order_ID,  
 o.Exchange_Order_ID,  
 ot.Remarks,  
 o.Comb_Status,  
 ot.New_Cancel_Modify,
 o.Sub_Strategy_ID,  
 o.Order_Source_ID,  
 o.Underlying_Ticker AS Short_Name,  
 ot.OrderTrade_ID,  
 ot.Status,  
 ot.islast,  
  ot.Price_Diff,  
 cast(ot.Original_Order_ID AS varchar(20)) Original_Order_ID,  
 ot.Creation_Date,
 ot.Creation_Time,  
 ot.Created_By,  
 convert(char, ot.Update_Time, 108) Update_Time,  
 ot.Updated_By,  
 C.Broker_Name,  
 o.Broker_ID,   
 t.TRADE_ID,  
 t.Estee_ID,  
 t.Buy_Sell_Indicator,  
 t.Order_Quantity,  
 t.Order_Price,   
 t.Traded_Quantity,  
 t.Traded_Price,  
 t.Stop_Price,  
 t.Transaction_Cost,
 o.Link_ID
 from [Order] o
inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID
inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID
inner join  Broker as C WITH (NOLOCK)  on o.broker_id = C.broker_id   
 WHERE   
  ot.[Status] = 'Executed'   
  AND o.Creation_Date >= @today AND o.Creation_Date < @tomorrow  
  
 --get NotWorking  
 SELECT   
 o.Order_ID,  
 o.Order_Type,  
 o.Order_Validity,  
  
 o.Account_ID,  
 o.Broker_Order_ID,  
 o.Exchange_Order_ID,  
 ot.Remarks,  
 o.Comb_Status,  
 ot.New_Cancel_Modify,
 o.Sub_Strategy_ID,  
 o.Order_Source_ID,  
 o.Underlying_Ticker AS Short_Name,  
 ot.OrderTrade_ID,  
 ot.Status,  
 ot.Price_Diff,  
 ot.islast,  
 cast(ot.Original_Order_ID AS varchar(20)) Original_Order_ID,  
 ot.Creation_Date,
 ot.Creation_Time,  
 ot.Created_By,  
 convert(char, ot.Update_Time, 108) Update_Time,  
 ot.Updated_By,  
 C.Broker_Name,  
  o.Broker_ID, 
 t.TRADE_ID,  
 t.Estee_ID,  
 t.Buy_Sell_Indicator,  
 t.Order_Quantity,  
 t.Order_Price,   
 t.Traded_Quantity,  
 t.Traded_Price,  
 t.Stop_Price,  
 t.Transaction_Cost,
 o.Link_ID 
 from [Order] o
inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID
inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID
inner join  Broker as C WITH (NOLOCK)  on o.broker_id = C.broker_id   
 WHERE   
 ot.[Status]  in ('Rejected','Cancelled','Halted','Inactive','Stopped')  
 AND o.Creation_Date >= @today AND o.Creation_Date < @tomorrow  

END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetAllCurrentOrdersForStrategy

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetAllCurrentOrdersForStrategy]   
 @subStrategyID Datetime output,  
 @openOrdersOnly bit =1  
AS   
BEGIN  
 SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED  
   --get PendingOrders  
 DECLARE @today DATETIME  
 DECLARE @tomorrow DATETIME  
 SET @today = CAST(CONVERT(varchar(10), getDate(), 101) AS DATETIME)  
 SET @tomorrow = DATEADD(d, 1, @today)  
  
 if @openOrdersOnly =1  
  Begin  
   SELECT   
   B.Order_ID,  
   B.Order_Type,  
   B.Order_Validity,  
   B.Broker_ID,  
   B.Account_ID,  
   B.Broker_Order_ID,  
   B.Exchange_Order_ID,  
   A.Remarks,  
   B.Comb_Status,  
   A.New_Cancel_Modify,  
   B.Sub_Strategy_ID,  
   B.Order_Source_ID,  
   B.Underlying_Ticker ,  
   A.OrderTrade_ID,  
   A.Status,  
   A.islast,  
   A.Price_Diff,  
   A.Original_Order_ID,  
   A.Creation_Date,  
   A.Creation_Time,  
   A.Created_By,  
   A.Update_Time,  
   A.Updated_By,  
   C.Broker_Name,  
   B.Link_ID  
   FROM OrderTrades  A WITH (NOLOCK)   
   inner join  [Order] B WITH (NOLOCK)  on B.Order_ID = A.Order_ID AND B.Creation_Date > @today  
   inner join  Broker as C WITH (NOLOCK)  on C.broker_id = B.broker_id   
   WHERE   
    B.Sub_Strategy_ID = @subStrategyID  
    AND A.[Status] not in ('Rejected','Executed','Cancelled','Halted','Inactive','Stopped')   
    AND A.Creation_Date > @today AND A.Creation_Date < @tomorrow  
  
   select   A.OrderTrade_ID,  
   A.TRADE_ID,  
   A.Estee_ID,  
   A.Buy_Sell_Indicator,  
   A.Order_Quantity,  
   A.Order_Price,   
   A.Traded_Quantity,  
   A.Traded_Price,  
   A.Stop_Price,  
   A.Transaction_Cost  
   from Trades A WITH (NOLOCK)  
   inner join  OrderTrades B WITH (NOLOCK)  on A.OrderTrade_ID = B.OrderTrade_ID and A.Creation_Date = B.Creation_Date  
   inner join  [Order] C WITH (NOLOCK)  on C.Order_ID = B.Order_ID AND C.Creation_Date > @today  
   where   
    C.Sub_Strategy_ID = @subStrategyID  
   AND B.[Status] not in ('Rejected','Executed','Cancelled','Halted','Inactive','Stopped')   
   AND B.Creation_Date > @today AND B.Creation_Date < @tomorrow  
   AND A.Creation_Date > @today  
  End  
 Else  
  Begin  
   SELECT   
   B.Order_ID,  
   B.Order_Type,  
   B.Order_Validity,  
   B.Broker_ID,  
   B.Account_ID,  
   B.Broker_Order_ID,  
   B.Exchange_Order_ID,  
   A.Remarks,  
   B.Comb_Status,  
   A.New_Cancel_Modify,  
   B.Sub_Strategy_ID,  
   B.Order_Source_ID,  
   B.Underlying_Ticker ,  
   A.OrderTrade_ID,  
   A.Status,  
   A.islast,  
   A.Price_Diff,  
   A.Original_Order_ID,  
   A.Creation_Date,  
   A.Creation_Time,  
   A.Created_By,  
   A.Update_Time,  
   A.Updated_By,  
   C.Broker_Name,  
   B.Link_ID  
   FROM OrderTrades  A WITH (NOLOCK)   
   inner join  [Order] B WITH (NOLOCK)  on B.Order_ID = A.Order_ID AND B.Creation_Date > @today  
   inner join  Broker as C WITH (NOLOCK)  on C.broker_id = B.broker_id   
   WHERE   
    B.Sub_Strategy_ID = @subStrategyID  
    AND A.Creation_Date > @today AND A.Creation_Date < @tomorrow  
  
   select   A.OrderTrade_ID,  
   A.TRADE_ID,  
   A.Estee_ID,  
   A.Buy_Sell_Indicator,  
   A.Order_Quantity,  
   A.Order_Price,   
   A.Traded_Quantity,  
   A.Traded_Price,  
   A.Stop_Price,  
   A.Transaction_Cost  
   from Trades A WITH (NOLOCK, index (IX_trades_ordertrade))  
   inner join  OrderTrades B WITH (NOLOCK)  on A.OrderTrade_ID = B.OrderTrade_ID and A.Creation_Date = B.Creation_Date  
   inner join  [Order] C WITH (NOLOCK)  on C.Order_ID = B.Order_ID AND C.Creation_Date > @today  
   where   
    C.Sub_Strategy_ID = @subStrategyID  
   AND B.Creation_Date > @today AND B.Creation_Date < @tomorrow  
   AND A.Creation_Date > @today  
  
  End  
   
END  

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetAllEsteeIDs

```sql
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetAllEsteeIDs]
@underlyingEsteeId varchar(33),

@expirtyDate DateTime,
@securityType int
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;
select distinct Estee_ID into #temp from esteemaster where UnderlyingEstee_Id = @underlyingEsteeId and Expiry_Date = @expirtyDate and Security_Type = @securityType

IF NOT EXISTS (Select 1 from #temp)
BEGIN
insert into #temp
select distinct Estee_ID from esteemaster_archive where estee_id like (select SUBSTRING(@underlyingEsteeId,1,14))+'%' and Expiry_Date = @expirtyDate and Security_Type = @securityType and Status = 1
END
select * from #temp
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetAllExecutedOrders

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spGetAllExecutedOrders]     
 @isnotWorking bit  =0,  
 @listAccountID varchar(100) = null,  
 @listBrokerID varchar(100)  = null,  
 @listSubStrategyID varchar(500)  = null  
  
AS    
BEGIN    

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED  
 DECLARE @today datetime
 DECLARE @tomorrow datetime

 SET @today = cast(CONVERT(char(12), GETDATE(), 1) as datetime)  
 SET @tomorrow = DATEADD(dd, 1, @today)

IF(@isNotWorking =0)  
 Begin  
   --get ExecutedOrders    
   SELECT   
   B.Order_ID,    
   B.Order_Type,    
   B.Order_Validity,            
   B.Account_ID,    
   B.Broker_Order_ID,    
   B.Exchange_Order_ID,    
   A.Remarks,    
   B.Comb_Status,      
   B.Sub_Strategy_ID,    
   B.Order_Source_ID,    
   B.Underlying_Ticker AS Short_Name,    
   A.OrderTrade_ID,    
   A.Status,    
   A.islast,    
    A.Price_Diff,    
   cast(A.Original_Order_ID AS varchar(20)) Original_Order_ID,    
   A.Creation_Date,
   A.Creation_Time,    
   A.Created_By,    
   convert(char, A.Update_Time, 108) Update_Time,    
   A.Updated_By,    
   C.Broker_Name,    
   B.Broker_ID,     
   D.TRADE_ID,    
   D.Estee_ID,    
   D.Buy_Sell_Indicator,    
   D.Order_Quantity,    
   D.Order_Price,     
   D.Traded_Quantity,    
   D.Traded_Price,    
   D.Stop_Price,    
   D.Transaction_Cost,  
   cast(B.Link_ID AS varchar(20)) Link_ID
   from [Order] B
   inner join OrderTrades A with(nolock) on B.Creation_Date = A.Creation_Date and B.Order_ID = A.Order_ID
   inner join Trades D with (nolock) on D.OrderTrade_ID = A.OrderTrade_ID and D.Creation_Date = A.Creation_Date and D.Order_ID = A.Order_ID
   inner join  Broker as C WITH (NOLOCK)  on B.broker_id = C.broker_id     
   WHERE     
    A.[Status] IN ('Executed', 'Partially Filled')  
		AND B.Creation_Date >= @today AND B.Creation_Date < @tomorrow
     ORDER BY A.Update_Time desc , B.Order_ID ;  
   end  
 else  
  begin  
    SELECT   
    B.Order_ID,    
    B.Order_Type,    
    B.Order_Validity,    
    B.Account_ID,    
    B.Broker_Order_ID,    
    B.Exchange_Order_ID,    
    A.Remarks,    
    B.Comb_Status,      
    B.Sub_Strategy_ID,    
    B.Order_Source_ID,    
    B.Underlying_Ticker AS Short_Name,    
    A.OrderTrade_ID,    
    A.Status,    
    A.Price_Diff,    
    A.islast,    
    cast(A.Original_Order_ID AS varchar(20)) Original_Order_ID,    
    A.Creation_Date,
    A.Creation_Time,    
    A.Created_By,    
    convert(char, A.Update_Time, 108) Update_Time,    
    A.Updated_By,    
    C.Broker_Name,    
     B.Broker_ID,   
    D.TRADE_ID,    
    D.Estee_ID,    
    D.Buy_Sell_Indicator,    
    D.Order_Quantity,    
    D.Order_Price,     
    D.Traded_Quantity,    
    D.Traded_Price,    
    D.Stop_Price,    
    D.Transaction_Cost,  
    cast(B.Link_ID AS varchar(20)) Link_ID   
    from [Order] B
   inner join OrderTrades A with(nolock) on B.Creation_Date = A.Creation_Date and B.Order_ID = A.Order_ID
   inner join Trades D with (nolock) on D.OrderTrade_ID = A.OrderTrade_ID and D.Creation_Date = A.Creation_Date and D.Order_ID = A.Order_ID
   inner join  Broker as C WITH (NOLOCK)  on B.broker_id = C.broker_id     
    WHERE     
    A.[Status]  in ('Rejected','Cancelled','Halted','Inactive','Stopped','Executed', 'Partially Filled')      
	AND B.Creation_Date >= @today AND B.Creation_Date < @tomorrow
      ORDER BY A.Update_Time desc , B.Order_ID ;  
  end  
 --get NotWorking    
  
   
   
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetAllMDExchangeConfig

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.spGetAllMDExchangeConfig
			@applicationId       VARCHAR(6),

			@adapterName         VARCHAR(20) = 'NSETBT',

			@configType          VARCHAR(100) = 'Production'

AS

BEGIN

DECLARE @appId INT = CAST(@applicationId AS INT);

       DECLARE @MdConfig TABLE(

              MdConfigId  INT,

              ExchangeKey VARCHAR(200),

              Parameter   VARCHAR(200),

              Value       VARCHAR(200)

       );

       DECLARE @mdConfigId INT;

       SELECT @mdConfigId = MDConfigId

       FROM   MarketDataConfigInfo

       WHERE  MDAdapter = @adapterName

              AND configType = @configType;

			  INSERT INTO @MdConfig

              SELECT @mdConfigId, MDC.ExchangeKey, LOWER(MDC.Parameter), MDC.Value                   -- Inserting non stream specific parameters

              FROM   MarketDataExchangeConfig AS MDC

                     INNER JOIN MarketDataConfigInfo AS MDI ON MDC.MDConfigId = MDI.MDConfigId

              WHERE  MDC.MDConfigId = @mdConfigId

                     AND MDI.ConfigType = @configType
       INSERT INTO @MdConfig

       SELECT @mdConfigId, '', LOWER('MDInterfaceIP'), MDS.MDInterfaceIP   --Sending Key as empty as this is not dependant on the exchange key

       FROM   MarketDataServerConfig AS MDS

              INNER JOIN DataInit AS DI ON MDS.EsteeServerIp = DI.Value

              AND DI.Parameter = 'Platform_Linux_InterfaceIP'

       WHERE  DI.applicationid = @appId

          AND @mdConfigId = MDS.MDConfigId;

       SELECT *

       FROM   @MdConfig;

					 END;
```
