## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetAllopenOrdersForFIX

```sql

Create PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spGetAllopenOrdersForFIX]

@appID varchar(max)



AS

BEGIN

   --get PendingOrders

   SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED

   DECLARE @date as datetime

   SET @date = cast(convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 101) as datetime)

   ;WITH A as

   (

    select ot.OrderTrade_ID, ot.Order_ID, ot.Status, ot.islast, ot.Price_Diff, ot.Original_Order_ID, ot.Creation_Date, ot.Creation_Time, ot.Created_By,

		ot.Update_Time, ot.Updated_By, ot.Remarks, ot.New_Cancel_Modify, ot.ClientOrderTrade_ID, ot.BrokerOrderTrade_ID, t.ExecId from OrderTrades ot  WITH (NOLOCK)

		inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID  

		where ot.Status not in ('Rejected','Executed','Cancelled','Halted','Inactive','Stopped') and ot.islast = 0 AND ot.Creation_Date >= @date

   )

   

   SELECT distinct

   B.Order_ID,

   B.Order_Type,

   B.Order_Validity,

   B.Broker_ID,

   B.Account_ID,

   B.Broker_Order_ID,

   B.Exchange_Order_ID,

   A.Remarks,

   B.Comb_Status,

   A.New_Cancel_Modify,

   B.Sub_Strategy_ID,

   B.Order_Source_ID,

   B.Underlying_Ticker,

   A.OrderTrade_ID,

   A.Status,

   A.islast,

   A.Price_Diff,

   A.Original_Order_ID,

   A.Creation_Date,

   A.Creation_Time,

   A.Created_By,

   A.Update_Time,

   A.Updated_By,

   C.Broker_Name,

   B.Link_ID,

   B.ems_id as EmsID,

   A.ClientOrderTrade_ID,

   A.BrokerOrderTrade_ID,

   B.ClientOrder_ID,

   A.ExecId

   FROM [Order] B WITH (NOLOCK)

   inner join  A on B.Order_ID = A.Order_ID and B.Creation_Date = A.Creation_Date

   inner join  Broker as C WITH (NOLOCK) on C.broker_id = B.broker_id

   inner join vwSSConfig vw on vw.EMSId = @appID and vw.SSID = B.Sub_Strategy_ID

   option (maxdop 1)



   ;WITH D as

   (

    select Order_ID, OrderTrade_ID,Creation_Date from OrderTrades  WITH (NOLOCK)

		where Status not in ('Rejected','Executed','Cancelled','Halted','Inactive','Stopped') AND Creation_Date >= @date

   )



   select distinct

   A.OrderTrade_ID,

   A.TRADE_ID,

   A.Estee_ID,

   A.Buy_Sell_Indicator,

   A.Order_Quantity,

   A.Order_Price,

   A.Traded_Quantity,

   A.Traded_Price,

   A.Stop_Price,

   A.Transaction_Cost,

   C.ems_id as EmsID

   from [Order] C WITH (NOLOCK)

   inner join D on C.Order_ID = D.Order_ID  and C.Creation_Date=D.Creation_Date

   inner join Trades A WITH (NOLOCK)  on A.OrderTrade_ID = D.OrderTrade_ID and A.Order_ID = D.Order_ID and A.Creation_Date = D.Creation_Date

   inner join vwSSConfig vw on vw.EMSId = @appID and C.Sub_Strategy_ID = vw.SSID

   option (maxdop 1)

End

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetAllopenOrdersForProcessOrders

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spGetAllopenOrdersForProcessOrders]  
     @appid int = null            
AS      
BEGIN      
   
       
   SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED      
      
   DECLARE @date as datetime      
   SET @date = cast(convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 101) as datetime)  
    
    Declare @substrategyIdList1 table(id int)   
    if exists(select substrategy_id from datainit where substrategy_id is not null and Parameter='POINSERTQ' and value = 'processorderinsertqueue' + Cast(@appid as varchar))  
  BEGIN  
   Insert into @substrategyIdList1   
   select substrategy_id from datainit   
   where substrategy_id is not null   
   and Parameter='POINSERTQ'   
   and value = 'processorderinsertqueue' + Cast(@appid as varchar)  
  END  
    else  
  BEGIN  
   Insert into @substrategyIdList1  
   select distinct DI.substrategy_id from DataInit DI inner join EsteeApplications EA on DI.ApplicationID = EA.ApplicationID  
   and ((DI.substrategy_id is not null or DI.substrategy_id <> '') and DI.substrategy_id <> 0)  
   and EA.EsteeServer_ID in (select EsteeServer_ID from EsteeApplications where ApplicationID = @appid)  
   and DI.SubStrategy_ID not in (  
   select distinct substrategy_id from DataInit where SubStrategy_ID is not null and substrategy_id <> 0  
   and Parameter='POINSERTQ')
    END  
   
     
    ;WITH A as      
   (      
    select OrderTrade_ID, Order_ID, Status, islast, Price_Diff, Original_Order_ID, Creation_Date,Creation_Time, Created_By,  Update_Time,      
 Updated_By, Remarks, New_Cancel_Modify,ClientOrderTrade_ID,BrokerOrderTrade_ID from OrderTrades  WITH (NOLOCK)    
    where Status not in ('Rejected','Executed','Cancelled','Halted','Inactive','Stopped')       
       AND Creation_Date >= @date        
   )   
  
   SELECT       
   B.Order_ID,      
   B.Order_Type,      
   B.Order_Validity,      
   B.Broker_ID,      
   B.Account_ID,      
   B.Broker_Order_ID,      
   B.Exchange_Order_ID,      
   A.Remarks,      
   B.Comb_Status,      
   A.New_Cancel_Modify,      
   B.Sub_Strategy_ID,      
   B.Order_Source_ID,      
   B.Underlying_Ticker ,      
   A.OrderTrade_ID,      
   A.Status,      
   A.islast,      
   A.Price_Diff,      
   A.Original_Order_ID,     
   A.Creation_Date,   
   A.Creation_Time,      
   A.Created_By,      
   A.Update_Time,      
   A.Updated_By,      
   C.Broker_Name,      
   B.Link_ID,  
   B.EMS_ID as EmsID,
   B.ClientOrder_ID,
   A.ClientOrderTrade_ID,
   A.BrokerOrderTrade_ID  
   FROM [Order] B WITH (NOLOCK)       
   inner join @substrategyIdList1 sl on sl.id = B.Sub_Strategy_ID  
   inner join  A on B.Order_ID = A.Order_ID and B.Creation_Date = A.Creation_Date      
   inner join  Broker as C WITH (NOLOCK) on C.broker_id = B.broker_id  
   option (maxdop 1)      
           
           
   ;WITH D as      
   (      
    select Order_ID, OrderTrade_ID,Creation_Date,Creation_Time from OrderTrades  WITH (NOLOCK)     
    where Status not in ('Rejected','Executed','Cancelled','Halted','Inactive','Stopped')       
    AND Creation_Date >= @date      
   )      
      
     
   select   A.OrderTrade_ID,      
   A.TRADE_ID,      
   A.Estee_ID,      
   A.Buy_Sell_Indicator,      
   A.Order_Quantity,      
   A.Order_Price,       
   A.Traded_Quantity,      
   A.Traded_Price,      
   A.Stop_Price,      
   A.Transaction_Cost      
   from [Order] C WITH (NOLOCK)      
   inner join @substrategyIdList1 sl on sl.id = C.Sub_Strategy_ID  
   inner join D on C.Order_ID = D.Order_ID and C.Creation_Date = D.Creation_Date          
   inner join Trades A WITH (INDEX(IX_trades_ordertrade), NOLOCK)  on A.OrderTrade_ID = D.OrderTrade_ID and A.Order_ID = D.Order_ID and A.Creation_Date = D.Creation_Date  
   option (maxdop 1)      
End
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetAllOrders

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetAllOrders]   
AS  
BEGIN  
   --get PendingOrders  
   
   SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED  
  
   SELECT   
   B.Order_ID,  
   B.Order_Type,  
   B.Order_Validity,  
   B.Broker_ID,  
   B.Account_ID,  
   B.Broker_Order_ID,  
   B.Exchange_Order_ID,  
   A.Remarks,  
   B.Comb_Status,  
   A.New_Cancel_Modify,  
   B.Sub_Strategy_ID,  
   B.Order_Source_ID,  
   B.Underlying_Ticker ,  
   A.OrderTrade_ID,  
   A.Status,  
   A.islast,  
   A.Price_Diff,  
   A.Original_Order_ID,  
   A.Creation_Date,
   A.Creation_Time,  
   A.Created_By,  
   A.Update_Time,  
   A.Updated_By,  
   C.Broker_Name,  
   B.Link_ID,
   B.ems_id as EmsID  
   FROM OrderTrades  A WITH (NOLOCK)   
   inner join [Order] B WITH (NOLOCK)  on B.Order_ID = A.Order_ID and B.Creation_Date = A.Creation_Date
   inner join  Broker as C WITH (NOLOCK)  on C.broker_id = B.broker_id   
   WHERE   
   A.Creation_Date >= cast(CONVERT(char(12), GETDATE(), 1) as datetime)     
   Order by A.Update_Time DESC  
  
   SELECT   A.OrderTrade_ID,  
   A.TRADE_ID,  
   A.Estee_ID,  
   A.Buy_Sell_Indicator,  
   A.Order_Quantity,  
   A.Order_Price,   
   A.Traded_Quantity,  
   A.Traded_Price,  
   A.Stop_Price,  
   A.Transaction_Cost,
   C.ems_id as EmsID
   from [Order] C
   inner join OrderTrades B with(nolock) on C.Creation_Date = B.Creation_Date and C.Order_ID = B.Order_ID
   inner join Trades A with (nolock) on B.OrderTrade_ID = A.OrderTrade_ID and B.Creation_Date = A.Creation_Date and B.Order_ID = A.Order_ID
   WHERE   
   C.Creation_Date >= cast(CONVERT(char(12), GETDATE(), 1) as datetime)        
   ORDER BY B.Update_Time DESC  
   OPTION (MAXDOP 1)  
End
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetAllOrdersForPeriod

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetAllOrdersForPeriod] 
@fromDate datetime = null,  
@toDate datetime = null  
AS
BEGIN
   --get PendingOrders
			SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED	 
			SELECT 
			B.Order_ID,
			B.Order_Type,
			B.Order_Validity,
			B.Broker_ID,
			B.Account_ID,
			B.Broker_Order_ID,
			B.Exchange_Order_ID,
			A.Remarks,
			B.Comb_Status,
			A.New_Cancel_Modify,
			B.Sub_Strategy_ID,
			B.Order_Source_ID,
			B.Underlying_Ticker ,
			A.OrderTrade_ID,
			A.Status,
			A.islast,
			A.Price_Diff,
			A.Original_Order_ID,
			A.Creation_Date,
			A.Creation_Time,
			A.Created_By,
			A.Update_Time,
			A.Updated_By,
			C.Broker_Name,
			B.Link_ID

			FROM OrderTrades  A WITH (NOLOCK) 
			inner join  [Order] B WITH (NOLOCK)  on B.Order_ID = A.Order_ID and B.Creation_Date = A.Creation_Date
			inner join  Broker as C WITH (NOLOCK)  on C.broker_id = B.broker_id 
			WHERE 
			A.Creation_Date Between @fromDate and @toDate
				Order by A.Update_Time DESC

			select A.OrderTrade_ID,
			A.TRADE_ID,
			A.Estee_ID,
			A.Buy_Sell_Indicator,
			A.Order_Quantity,
			A.Order_Price,
			A.Traded_Quantity,
			A.Traded_Price,
			A.Stop_Price,
			A.Transaction_Cost
			from [Order] C
			inner join OrderTrades B with(nolock) on C.Creation_Date = B.Creation_Date and C.Order_ID = B.Order_ID
			inner join Trades A with (nolock) on B.OrderTrade_ID = A.OrderTrade_ID and B.Creation_Date = A.Creation_Date and B.Order_ID = A.Order_ID
			where
			b.Creation_Date Between @fromDate and @toDate 
			Order by Update_Time DESC

END
```

```sql
BEGIN    
 SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED     
 DECLARE @today datetime
 DECLARE @tomorrow datetime

 SET @today = cast(CONVERT(char(12), GETDATE(), 1) as datetime)  
 SET @tomorrow = DATEADD(dd, 1, @today)

 SELECT     
 B.Order_ID,    
 B.Order_Type,    
 B.Order_Validity,    
 B.Account_ID,    
 B.Broker_Order_ID,    
 B.Exchange_Order_ID,    
 A.Remarks,    
 B.Comb_Status,    
 A.New_Cancel_Modify,
 B.Sub_Strategy_ID,    
 B.Order_Source_ID,    
 B.Underlying_Ticker AS Short_Name,    
 A.OrderTrade_ID,    
 A.Status,    
 A.islast,    
 A.Price_Diff,    
 cast(A.Original_Order_ID AS varchar(20)) Original_Order_ID,         
 A.Creation_Date,
 A.Creation_Time,    
 A.Created_By,    
 convert(char, A.Update_Time, 108) Update_Time,    
 A.Updated_By,    
 C.Broker_Name,    
 B.Broker_ID,   
 D.TRADE_ID,    
 D.Estee_ID,    
 D.Buy_Sell_Indicator,    
 D.Order_Quantity,    
 D.Order_Price,     
 D.Traded_Quantity,    
 D.Traded_Price,    
 D.Stop_Price,    
 D.Transaction_Cost, 
 cast(B.Link_ID AS varchar(20)) Link_ID 
 from [Order] B
   inner join OrderTrades A with(nolock) on A.Creation_Date = B.Creation_Date and A.Order_ID = B.Order_ID
   inner join Trades D with (nolock) on D.OrderTrade_ID = A.OrderTrade_ID and D.Creation_Date = A.Creation_Date and D.Order_ID = A.Order_ID
 inner join Broker as C WITH (NOLOCK)  on B.broker_id = C.broker_id     
 WHERE     
  A.[Status] not in ('Rejected','Executed','Cancelled','Halted','Inactive','Stopped', 'Partially Filled') 	  
  AND A.Creation_Date >= @today and a.creation_Date < @tomorrow
  ORDER BY A.Update_Time DESC, B.Order_ID;    
  
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetAllPendingOrdersForStatus

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spGetAllPendingOrdersForStatus]     
 @OrderTradeIDs varchar(max) = null
     
AS    
BEGIN    

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED  
DECLARE @OrderTrades TABLE(OrderTrade_ID int)  
INSERT into @OrderTrades   
SELECT * from dbo.split(@OrderTradeIDs,',')   

 --get PendingOrders
			SELECT 
			B.Order_ID,
			B.Order_Type,
			B.Order_Validity,
			B.Broker_ID,
			B.Account_ID,
			B.Broker_Order_ID,
			B.Exchange_Order_ID,
			A.Remarks,
			B.Comb_Status,
			A.New_Cancel_Modify,
			B.Sub_Strategy_ID,
			B.Order_Source_ID,
			B.Underlying_Ticker ,
			A.OrderTrade_ID,
			A.Status,
			A.islast,
			A.Price_Diff,
			A.Original_Order_ID,
			A.Creation_Date,
			A.Creation_Time,
			A.Created_By,
			A.Update_Time,
			A.Updated_By,
			C.Broker_Name,
			B.Link_ID
			from [Order] B WITH (NOLOCK)
			inner join OrderTrades A with(nolock) on B.Creation_Date = A.Creation_Date and B.Order_ID = A.Order_ID
			inner join  Broker as C WITH (NOLOCK)  on C.broker_id = B.broker_id 
			WHERE 
				 A.OrderTrade_ID IN (select OrderTrade_ID from @OrderTrades)
				 AND 
				 DATEADD(DD,0,DATEDIFF(DD,0,A.Creation_Date)) = DATEADD(DD,0,DATEDIFF(DD,0,getdate())) Order by A.Update_Time DESC

			select   t.OrderTrade_ID,
			t.TRADE_ID,
			t.Estee_ID,
			t.Buy_Sell_Indicator,
			t.Order_Quantity,
			t.Order_Price,
			t.Traded_Quantity,
			t.Traded_Price,
			t.Stop_Price,
			t.Transaction_Cost
			from [Order] o
			inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID
			inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID
			WHERE 
				 ot.OrderTrade_ID IN (select OrderTrade_ID from @OrderTrades)
				 AND 
				 DATEADD(DD,0,DATEDIFF(DD,0,o.Creation_Date)) = DATEADD(DD,0,DATEDIFF(DD,0,getdate())) Order by ot.Update_Time DESC
  
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetApplicationDetails

```sql
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetApplicationDetails]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@applicationId int,
	@runDate Date
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
  
	declare @daybit tinyint
	select @daybit = BitValue from Weekdays where daycode=DATEPART(weekday,@runDate)

	IF @applicationId <> -1
	begin
	select ea.ApplicationID, ea.ApplicationName, ea.Path, ea.CmdArgs, ea.ExeName, aps.StartTime, aps.StopTime, ea.SubStrategy_ID, es.LocationCode, ea.PlatformType
	from EsteeApplications ea inner join EsteeServers es on ea.EsteeServer_ID = es.ID
	join ApplicationSchedule aps on ea.ApplicationID = aps.applicationid and (aps.DaysOfWeek & @daybit) = @daybit
	where ea.ApplicationID=@applicationId
	end
	else
	begin
	select ea.ApplicationID, ea.ApplicationName, ea.Path, ea.CmdArgs, ea.ExeName, aps.StartTime, aps.StopTime, ea.SubStrategy_ID, es.LocationCode, ea.PlatformType
	from EsteeApplications ea inner join EsteeServers es on ea.EsteeServer_ID = es.ID
	join ApplicationSchedule aps on ea.ApplicationID = aps.applicationid and (aps.DaysOfWeek & @daybit) = @daybit
	end
END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetApplicationForHealthMonitor
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@applicationId int,
	@runDate Date
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
  
	declare @daybit tinyint
	select @daybit = BitValue from Weekdays where daycode=DATEPART(weekday,@runDate)

	select ea2.ApplicationID, ea2.ApplicationName, ea2.Path, ea2.CmdArgs, ea2.ExeName, aps.StartTime, aps.StopTime, ea2.SubStrategy_ID, ea2.PlatformType
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetAsyncDbQueueAndServerDetails

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetAsyncDbQueueAndServerDetails
    @AppNameID INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT 
        ea.ApplicationID AS AsyncAppId,
        ea1.ApplicationID AS EmsId,
        d2.Value AS QueueServer,
        d1.Value AS QueueName,
        d3.Value,
        ea.SubStrategy_id AS AsyncSSID
    FROM EsteeApplications ea
    INNER JOIN EsteeApplications ea1 
        ON ea.EMS_Application_ID = ea1.ApplicationID
    INNER JOIN DataInit d 
        ON ea1.ApplicationID = d.ApplicationID 
        AND d.Parameter = 'Platform_Linux_StubApplicationID'
    INNER JOIN DataInit d1 
        ON ea1.ApplicationID = d1.ApplicationID 
        AND d1.Parameter = 'QueueName'
    INNER JOIN Strategy_New sn 
        ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = ea.SubStrategy_ID
    INNER JOIN DataInit d2 
        ON CAST(d2.ApplicationID AS VARCHAR) = CAST(d.Value AS VARCHAR) 
        AND d2.Parameter = 'PlatformServiceQueueServer'
    LEFT JOIN DataInit d3 
        ON d3.ApplicationID = ea.ApplicationID 
        AND d3.Parameter = 'platform_linux_isdatabaseentryrequiredfororders'
    WHERE 
        ea.AppNameID = @AppNameID 
        AND ea.isRunning = 1 
        AND ea1.isRunning = 1 
        AND sn.Strategy_Status = 1
        AND ISNULL(d3.Value, 'True') = 'True';
END;

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetBankingHolidaylist

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetBankingHolidaylist @ClearingOrTrading VARCHAR(1), 
@exchgCode VARCHAR(2), 
@Date DATE AS BEGIN DECLARE @BankingHolidays TABLE (
  [segment] [VARCHAR](64) NULL, 
  [date] [DATETIME] NULL, 
  [holidaytype] [VARCHAR](64) NULL, 
  [exchange] [VARCHAR](64) NULL, 
  [description] [VARCHAR](64) NULL, 
  [session] [VARCHAR](64) NULL, 
  [subsession] [INT] NULL, 
  [exsegment] [VARCHAR](64) NULL
);
DECLARE @rowCount INT 
SET 
  @rowCount = (
    SELECT 
      Count(*) 
    FROM 
      bankingholidays 
    WHERE 
      exchange = @exchgCode
      AND holidaytype = @ClearingOrTrading
      AND date = @Date
  ) IF(@rowCount > 0) BEGIN INSERT INTO @BankingHolidays 
SELECT 
  * 
FROM 
  bankingholidays bh 
WHERE 
  bh.exchange = @exchgCode 
  AND holidaytype = @ClearingOrTrading 
  AND date = @date END ELSE BEGIN INSERT INTO @BankingHolidays 
SELECT 
  segment, 
  date, 
  holidaytype, 
  exchange, 
  description, 
  session, 
  subsession, 
  exsegment 
FROM 
  (
    SELECT 
      exchangesegment AS Segment, 
      @date AS Date, 
      clearingortrading AS HolidayType, 
      exchange, 
      'Weekend:' + Datename(weekday, @date) AS Description, 
      'All' AS Session, 
      0 AS Subsession, 
      exchangesegment AS ExSegment, 
      CASE Datepart(weekday, @date) WHEN 1 THEN sunday WHEN 2 THEN monday WHEN 3 THEN tuesday WHEN 4 THEN wednesday WHEN 5 THEN thursday WHEN 6 THEN friday WHEN 7 THEN saturday END AS IsWeekday 
    FROM 
      tradingweekdays
  ) AS tw 
WHERE 
  exchange = @exchgCode
  AND holidaytype = @ClearingOrTrading 
  AND isweekday = 0 END 
SELECT 
  * 
FROM 
  @BankingHolidays END


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetBannedPositionUtilization

```sql

Create procedure spGetBannedPositionUtilization  
@accountId int,  
@date date  
As  
Begin  
 declare @ruleId int  
 select @ruleId = RuleID from PositionMeasureRule where RuleName = 'BannedSecuritiesLimits'  
 DECLARE @TempDailyPositions TABLE(Exchange_Code varchar(2), SecurityName nvarchar(75), Long bigint, Short bigint, TransactionCost decimal(20,4),   
 Account_ID int, SecurityType nvarchar(30), Estee_ID nvarchar(50), Sub_StrategyID  varchar(5), Broker_ID int, PositionDate datetime,   
 AverageTradedPrice decimal(20,4), BuyValue decimal(20,4), SellValue decimal(20,4), AverageHoldingPrice decimal(20,10), Rule_Id int)   
 insert into @TempDailyPositions  
 exec GetAllPositionsForGivenDateAndParameters @date, @accountId, 3  
 select pl.ISIN, MIN(pl.LimitValue) Limit, SUM(ISNULL(tp.Long, 0) - ISNULL(tp.short,0)) Utilization from PositionLimits pl   
 inner join esteemaster e on pl.ISIN=e.ISIN  
 left join @TempDailyPositions tp on e.Estee_ID = tp.Estee_ID and Long<>Short  
 where RuleID = @ruleId and DimensionValue = @accountId   
 group by pl.ISIN  
End  

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetBannedSecuritiesByAccount

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetBannedSecuritiesByAccount 
       @accountId INT, 
       @banDate   DATETIME = NULL
AS
     BEGIN
         BEGIN TRY
             IF @banDate IS NULL
                 BEGIN
                     SET @banDate = GETDATE();
                 END;
             IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1
                           FROM dbo.Account AS A
                           WHERE A.Account_ID = @accountId)
                 BEGIN
                     RAISERROR('Error in storedProcedure spGetBannedSecuritiesByAccount. AccountId does not belong to account table', 16, 1);
                 END;
             ELSE
                 BEGIN
                     DECLARE @accExchange VARCHAR(2);
                     SET @accExchange = (SELECT A.exchange_Code
                                         FROM dbo.Account AS A
                                         WHERE A.Account_ID = @accountId);
                     SELECT E.Estee_ID, A.BanGroupId, A.permissionid, A.SecurityTypes
                     FROM(SELECT BS.ISIN, BS.BanGroupId, Bp.id AS permissionId, BS.SecurityTypes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BS.ISIN ORDER BY BP.Severity DESC) AS RowId
                          FROM dbo.BannedSecurities AS BS
                               LEFT JOIN dbo.BanGroupAllotment AS BGA ON BS.BanGroupId = BGA.BanGroupID
                               INNER JOIN dbo.BanPermission AS BP ON bp.ID = bs.BanPermissionId
                          WHERE BS.BanStatus = 1
                                AND (BGA.DimensionID = (SELECT PD.DimensionId
                                                        FROM dbo.ParameterDimension AS PD
                                                        WHERE PD.DimensionName = 'Account')
                                     OR BGA.DimensionID = (SELECT PD.DimensionId
                                                           FROM dbo.ParameterDimension AS PD
                                                           WHERE PD.DimensionName = 'Exchange'))
                                AND (BGA.DimensionValue = CAST(@accountId AS VARCHAR(3))
                                     OR BGA.DimensionValue = @accExchange)
                                AND CONVERT(DATE, BS.BanDate) = CONVERT(DATE, @banDate)) A
                         INNER JOIN dbo.esteemaster AS E ON E.ISIN = A.ISIN
                                                            AND E.Security_Type IN(SELECT *
                                                                                   FROM Split(A.SecurityTypes, ','))
                     WHERE rowid = 1;
                 END;
         END TRY
         BEGIN CATCH
             DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);
             DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;
             DECLARE @ErrorState INT;
             SELECT @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();

             -- RAISERROR inside the CATCH block will return error information about the original error that caused execution to jump to the CATCH block.  

             RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, -- Message text.  

             @ErrorSeverity, -- Severity.  

             @ErrorState -- State.  

             );
         END CATCH;
     END;

```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetBannedSecuritiesByExchange 
       @exchangeCode VARCHAR(2), 
       @banDate      DATETIME   = NULL
AS
     BEGIN

         BEGIN TRY
             IF @banDate IS NULL
                 BEGIN
                     SET @banDate = GETDATE();
                 END;

             IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1
                           FROM dbo.Exchange AS E
                           WHERE E.code = @exchangeCode)
                 BEGIN
                     RAISERROR('Error in storedProcedure spGetBannedSecuritiesByExchange. Exchange Code not present in Exchange Table', 16, 1);
                 END;
             ELSE
                 BEGIN
                     SELECT E.Estee_ID, A.BanGroupId, A.permissionid, A.SecurityTypes
                     FROM(SELECT BS.ISIN, BS.BanGroupId, Bp.id AS permissionId, BS.SecurityTypes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BS.ISIN ORDER BY BP.Severity DESC) AS RowId
                          FROM dbo.BannedSecurities AS BS
                               LEFT JOIN dbo.BanGroupAllotment AS BGA ON BS.BanGroupId = BGA.BanGroupID
                               INNER JOIN dbo.BanPermission AS BP ON bp.ID = bs.BanPermissionId
                          WHERE BS.BanStatus = 1
                                AND DimensionID = (SELECT PD.DimensionId
                                                   FROM dbo.ParameterDimension AS PD
                                                   WHERE PD.DimensionName = 'Exchange')
                                AND DimensionValue = @exchangeCode
                                AND CONVERT(DATE, BS.BanDate) = CONVERT(DATE, @banDate)) A
                         INNER JOIN dbo.esteemaster AS E ON E.ISIN = A.ISIN
                                                            AND E.Security_Type IN(SELECT *
                                                                                   FROM Split(A.SecurityTypes, ','))
                     WHERE rowid = 1

             DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;

             -- RAISERROR inside the CATCH block will return error information about the original error that caused execution to jump to the CATCH block.

             @ErrorState -- State.  
             );
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetBannedSecuritiesByStrategyAccount

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetBannedSecuritiesByStrategyAccount 
      @strategyId INT, 
      @accountId  INT, 
      @banDate    DATETIME = NULL
AS
     BEGIN
         IF @banDate IS NULL
             BEGIN
                 SET @banDate = GETDATE();
             END;
         IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1
                       FROM dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount AS SBA
                       WHERE SBA.subStrategyID = @strategyId
                             AND SBA.accountID = @accountId)
             BEGIN
                 PRINT('Error in storedProcedure spGetBannedSecuritiesByStrategyAccount. Strategy Account mapping not present in StrategyBrokerAccount table');
             END;
         ELSE
         DECLARE @strategyAccountId VARCHAR(10)
         SET @strategyAccountId = CAST(@accountId AS VARCHAR(5))+'_'+CAST(@strategyId AS VARCHAR(5))

         DECLARE @accExchange VARCHAR(2);

         SET @accExchange = (SELECT A.exchange_Code
                             FROM dbo.Account AS A
                             WHERE A.Account_ID = @accountId);

         BEGIN
             SELECT E.Estee_ID, A.BanGroupId, A.permissionid, A.SecurityTypes
             FROM(SELECT BS.ISIN, BS.BanGroupId, Bp.id AS permissionId, BS.SecurityTypes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BS.ISIN ORDER BY BP.Severity DESC) AS RowId
                  FROM dbo.BannedSecurities AS BS
                       LEFT JOIN dbo.BanGroupAllotment AS BGA ON BS.BanGroupId = BGA.BanGroupID
                       INNER JOIN dbo.BanPermission AS BP ON bp.ID = bs.BanPermissionId
                  WHERE BS.BanStatus = 1
                        AND DimensionID = (SELECT PD.DimensionId
                                           FROM dbo.ParameterDimension AS PD
                                           WHERE PD.DimensionName = 'StrategyAccount')
                        AND DimensionValue = @strategyAccountId
                        AND CONVERT(DATE, BS.BanDate) = CONVERT(DATE, @banDate)) A
                 INNER JOIN dbo.esteemaster AS E ON E.ISIN = A.ISIN
                                                    AND E.Security_Type IN(SELECT *
                                                                           FROM Split(A.SecurityTypes, ','))
             WHERE rowid = 1
             UNION
             SELECT E.Estee_ID, A.BanGroupId, A.permissionid, A.SecurityTypes
             FROM(SELECT BS.ISIN, BS.BanGroupId, Bp.id AS permissionId, BS.SecurityTypes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BS.ISIN ORDER BY BP.Severity DESC) AS RowId
                  FROM dbo.BannedSecurities AS BS
                       LEFT JOIN dbo.BanGroupAllotment AS BGA ON BS.BanGroupId = BGA.BanGroupID
                       INNER JOIN dbo.BanPermission AS BP ON bp.ID = bs.BanPermissionId
                  WHERE BS.BanStatus = 1
                        AND (BGA.DimensionID = (SELECT PD.DimensionId
                                                FROM dbo.ParameterDimension AS PD
                                                WHERE PD.DimensionName = 'Account')
                             OR BGA.DimensionID = (SELECT PD.DimensionId
                                                   FROM dbo.ParameterDimension AS PD
                                                   WHERE PD.DimensionName = 'Exchange'))
                        AND (BGA.DimensionValue = CAST(@accountId AS VARCHAR(3))
                             OR BGA.DimensionValue = @accExchange)
                        AND CONVERT(DATE, BS.BanDate) = CONVERT(DATE, @banDate)) A
                 INNER JOIN dbo.esteemaster AS E ON E.ISIN = A.ISIN
                                                    AND E.Security_Type IN(SELECT *
                                                                           FROM Split(A.SecurityTypes, ','))
             WHERE rowid = 1;
         END;
     END;

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetBanSecuritiesByAccountId

```sql
CREATE procedure spGetBanSecuritiesByAccountId  
@date date,  
@accountIds varchar(MAX)  
  
As Begin  
  
DECLARE @Account TABLE(Account_ID int, ExchangeCode varchar(2))   
  
insert into @Account  
SELECT A.items,AC.exchange_Code    
FROM dbo.split(@accountIds,',') A    
INNER JOIN Account AC WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.items = AC.Account_ID   
  
select *into #tempBan from (  
select distinct account_id, ID, a.ExchangeCode from @Account a, BanGroup b  
where b.BanGroupName in ('NSE','BSE', 'BMF')  
UNION  
select distinct t.account_id, ID, a.exchange_Code  from tblBrokerAccount t  
inner join Account a on a.Account_ID = t.account_id  
inner join @Account  aa on aa.Account_ID = t.account_id, BanGroup b  
where t.IsNRIEnabled = 1   
and b.BanGroupName in ('NRI Limit Breach Securities','NRI Limit Red Flagged Securities','Overall Sectoral limit Breach Securities',  
'Overall Sectoral limit Red Flagged Securities')  
and a.Status = 'Active'  
UNION  
select distinct t.account_id, ID, a.exchange_Code  from tblBrokerAccount t  
inner join Account  a on a.Account_ID = t.account_id  
inner join @Account aa on aa.Account_ID = t.account_id, BanGroup b  
where t.IsFIIEnabled = 1 and b.BanGroupName in ('FPI Limit Breach Securities','FPI Limit Red Flagged Securities','Overall Sectoral limit Red Flagged Securities','Overall Sectoral limit Breach Securities')  
UNION  
select distinct t.account_id, ID, a.exchange_Code  from tblBrokerAccount t  
inner join Account  a on a.Account_ID = t.account_id  
inner join @Account aa on aa.Account_ID = t.account_id, BanGroup b  
where b.BanGroupName in ('NSENON-FOSecurities')   and t.isFIIEnabled=0  and t.AccountUserType <>2  
) X  
  
select distinct c.ContractId as ContractId, Account_ID as AccountId, BanPermissionId as PermissionId from BannedSecurities b   
inner join #tempBan t on b.BanGroupId = t.ID   
INNER JOIN esteemaster e ON e.ISIN = b.ISIN AND e.Security_Type IN (SELECT * FROM Split(b.SecurityTypes, ','))  
and e.Exchange_Code = t.ExchangeCode  
inner join ContractIds c on c.EsteeId = e.Estee_ID  
where BanDate = @date and b.BanStatus = 1  
  
UNION  
  
select ContractId, a.Account_ID, PermissionID from (  
select Estee_id, Account_ID, PermissionID from SpecialInvestorBan b inner join BanGroup bg on b.banGroupID = bg.ID  
inner join LSAccounts ls cross apply dbo.Split(ls.BanGroups, ',') t on RTRIM(LTRIM(t.items)) = bg.BanGroupName  and b.banstatus <> 0) a  
inner join ContractIds c on a.Estee_id=c.EsteeId  
inner join @Account aa on a.Account_ID = aa.Account_ID  
  
drop table #tempBan  
  
End


```

```sql
Create Procedure spGetBenchMarkIndexDataForValidation  
@IndexEstee_id varchar(24),  
@MemberEsteeIds varchar(max)  
  
As  
     Begin  
  Declare @EsteeIdTable TABLE(Eid [char](24))   
  INSERT into @EsteeIdTable SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) from dbo.split(@MemberEsteeIds,',')  
    
  SELECT    e.Estee_ID, e.Underlying_Ticker, dbo.ISSUECAPPARSE(ns.issued_capital) IssueCap, ff.INVESTIBLE_FACTOR as InvestibleFactor  
                  FROM @EsteeIdTable eT  
                  INNER JOIN esteemaster(nolock) e ON eT.Eid = e.Estee_ID                                                      
                  INNER JOIN NSE_Security(nolock) ns ON ns.SYMBOL = E.Underlying_Ticker AND ns.series in('EQ','BE') AND ns.Eligibility_NormalMkt = 1                  
                  INNER JOIN Freefloat ff ON E.Underlying_Ticker = ff.SYMBOL  
     End;
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetBloombergContracts]
	@EXCHANGE_CODE char(2)
 AS
 BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	IF @EXCHANGE_CODE = ''
		BEGIN
			SELECT CD.*,I.INDEX_ISIN FROM CONTRACTDETAILS AS CD
			INNER JOIN INDEXLIST AS I
			ON CD.TICKER=I.EXCHANGE_NAME AND CD.EXCHANGE_CODE = I.EXCHANGE_CODE
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT CD.*,I.INDEX_ISIN FROM CONTRACTDETAILS AS CD
			INNER JOIN INDEXLIST AS I
			ON CD.TICKER=I.EXCHANGE_NAME AND CD.EXCHANGE_CODE = I.EXCHANGE_CODE
			WHERE CD.EXCHANGE_CODE=@EXCHANGE_CODE
		END
 END
```

```sql

-- Tempory with garbadge info | MarketSegmentId to be updated, maybe in BzlISINChannelMapping_Binary structure
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetBMFSBEStructure]
	  @exchange        VARCHAR(10),
	  @segment VARCHAR(10)
AS
	 BEGIN
		 IF @segment = 'XX'
			 BEGIN
				 SELECT em.Estee_id AS EsteeId, em.Lot_Size AS LotSize, ISNULL(bm.ChannelID, -1) AS MarketSegmentId, ISNULL(em.SecurityId, -1) AS SecurityId, ci.ContractId as ContractID, em.DataFeed_Ticker AS DataFeed_Ticker, et.ContractMultiplier AS ContractMultiplier
				 FROM   esteemaster AS em(NOLOCK)
						inner join EsteeIdToExternalTickersMap et on et.EsteeID = em.Estee_ID   
						INNER JOIN ContractIDs AS ci ON em.Estee_ID = ci.EsteeId
						INNER JOIN ValidCombos AS vc(NOLOCK) ON vc.SecurityType = em.Security_Type
						INNER JOIN BzlISINChannelMapping_Binary AS bm ON (SUBSTRING(et.EsteeID, 0, 17) = bm.ISIN_SecurityType)
				 WHERE  vc.ExchangeCode = @exchange
						AND em.Exchange_Code = @exchange;
			 END;
		 ELSE
			 BEGIN
				 SELECT em.Estee_id AS EsteeId, em.Lot_Size AS LotSize, ISNULL(bm.ChannelID, -1) AS MarketSegmentId, ISNULL(em.securityID, -1) AS SecurityId, ci.ContractId as ContractID, em.DataFeed_Ticker AS DataFeed_Ticker, et.ContractMultiplier AS ContractMultiplier
				 FROM   esteemaster AS em(NOLOCK)
						inner join EsteeIdToExternalTickersMap et on et.EsteeID = em.Estee_ID   
						INNER JOIN ContractIDs AS ci ON em.Estee_ID = ci.EsteeId
						INNER JOIN ValidCombos AS vc(NOLOCK) ON vc.SecurityType = em.Security_Type
						INNER JOIN BzlISINChannelMapping_Binary AS bm ON (SUBSTRING(et.EsteeID, 0, 17) = bm.ISIN_SecurityType)
				 WHERE  vc.ExchangeCode = @exchange
						AND em.Exchange_Code = @exchange
						AND vc.Segment = @segment;
			 END;
	 END;
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetBorrowClosingTransactions

```sql
-- =============================================  
-- Author:  <Author,,Name>  
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>  
-- Description: <Description,,>  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetBorrowClosingTransactions  
 -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here  
 @date Date,  
 @exchgList ListString Readonly,  
 @updatedBy int  
AS  
BEGIN  
 -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from  
 -- interfering with SELECT statements.  
 SET NOCOUNT ON;  
 declare @borrowPos Table([PositionDate] [date] ,[ExchangeCode] [varchar](10) , [AccountId] [int] ,  
 [SubStrategyId] [int] , SecurityName varchar(255), [EsteeId] [varchar](255) , [InterestRate] [decimal](20, 4) ,  
 [BorrowDate] [date] , [MaturityDate] [date] , [Long] [int] , [Short] [int] , [Net] [int] )  
  
 Insert into @borrowPos  
 exec spGetBorrowPosition @date=@date, @exchgList=@exchgList  
  
  
 select sbt.ID, sbt.ExchangeCode, sbt.AccountId, sbt.SubstrategyId, sbt.SecurityName, sbt.EsteeId,   
        sbt.InterestRate, sbt.BorrowDate, sbt.MaturityDate, sbt.SettlementType, sum(case transactiontype when 1 then Quantity else -1 * quantity end) as Quantity,  
    @updatedBy, GETDATE()  
 from StockBorrowTransactions sbt  
 join @borrowPos bp on sbt.BorrowDate = bp.BorrowDate   
 and sbt.AccountId = bp.AccountId  
 and sbt.EsteeId = bp.EsteeId  
 and sbt.InterestRate = bp.InterestRate  
 and sbt.MaturityDate = bp.MaturityDate  
 and sbt.SubStrategyId = bp.SubStrategyId  
 where bp.Net <>0  
 group by sbt.id, sbt.BorrowDate, sbt.SubStrategyId, sbt.EsteeId, sbt.ExchangeCode, sbt.AccountId, sbt.SecurityName,  
 sbt.InterestRate, sbt.MaturityDate, sbt.SettlementType  
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetBorrowPosition

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE spGetBorrowPosition   
@date DATE= NULL, @accountIdList INTEGERLISTTYPE READONLY, @ssidList INTEGERLISTTYPE READONLY, @exchgList LISTSTRING READONLY, @useDailyPositionsTable BIT= 0  --do not calculate the position from the trades, force usage of table     
AS  
     BEGIN  
         DECLARE @finalSsidList INTEGERLISTTYPE, @finalExchgList LISTSTRING;  
         DECLARE @dateplusone DATETIME;  
         DECLARE @finalAccIdList TABLE(Account_ID INT, Exchange_Code VARCHAR(4));  
         SET @dateplusone = DATEADD(dd, 1, @date);  
  
         INSERT INTO @finalAccIdList  
                SELECT al.n, A.exchange_Code  
                  FROM @accountIdList al  
                  JOIN Account A ON A.Account_ID = al.n;  
  
         INSERT INTO @finalSsidList  
                SELECT *  
                  FROM @ssidList;  
  
         INSERT INTO @finalExchgList  
                SELECT *  
                  FROM @exchgList;  
  
         IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1  
                         FROM @finalAccIdList  
                      )  
         BEGIN  
             INSERT INTO @finalAccIdList  
                    SELECT account_id, exchange_Code  
                      FROM Account;  
         END;  
  
         IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1  
                         FROM @finalSsidList  
                      )  
         BEGIN  
             INSERT INTO @finalSsidList  
                    SELECT SubStrategy_Id  
                      FROM Strategy_New;  
         END;  
  
         IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1  
                         FROM @finalExchgList  
                      )  
         BEGIN  
             INSERT INTO @finalExchgList  
                    SELECT code  
                      FROM Exchange;  
         END;  
  
         DECLARE @minLastSavedDate DATE;  
         DECLARE @lastSavedDateTable TABLE(lastSavedDate DATE, Exchange_Code CHAR(4), bitNeedIncremental BIT);  
         DECLARE @exchangeLevelMaxTradeDate TABLE(Exchange_Code CHAR(4), maxDate DATE);  
  
         INSERT INTO @lastSavedDateTable  
                SELECT COALESCE(MAX(positiondate), DATEADD(dd, -1, @date)) AS lastSavedDate, EC.ListItem,  
                       CASE WHEN MAX(positiondate) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(positiondate) <> @date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END  
                  FROM @finalExchgList EC  
                  LEFT JOIN StockBorrowPositions dp WITH (NOLOCK) ON dp.ExchangeCode = EC.ListItem  
                                                                     AND dp.PositionDate <= @date  
                 GROUP BY EC.ListItem;  
         IF EXISTS(SELECT 1  
                     FROM @lastSavedDateTable  
                    WHERE bitNeedIncremental = 1  
                  )  
            AND @useDailyPositionsTable = 0  
         BEGIN  
             SELECT @minLastSavedDate = MIN(lastSavedDate)  
               FROM @lastSavedDateTable;  
             INSERT INTO @exchangeLevelMaxTradeDate  
                    SELECT EC.ListItem, MAX(o.Date)  
                      FROM @finalAccIdList a  
                      INNER JOIN StockBorrowTransactions o WITH (NOLOCK) ON o.AccountId = a.Account_ID  
                      INNER JOIN @finalExchgList EC ON EC.ListItem = A.exchange_Code  
                     WHERE o.Date > @minLastSavedDate  
                     GROUP BY EC.ListItem;  
  
             UPDATE LST  
                SET  
                    bitNeedIncremental = 0  
               FROM @lastSavedDateTable LST  
               LEFT JOIN @exchangeLevelMaxTradeDate E ON LST.Exchange_Code = E.Exchange_Code  
              WHERE E.Exchange_Code IS NULL  
                    OR E.maxDate <= LST.lastSavedDate;  
         END;  
  
         DECLARE @TempDailyPositions TABLE(PositionDate DATE, ExchangeCode VARCHAR(10), AccountId INT, SubstrategyId INT, SecurityName VARCHAR(255),   
        EsteeId VARCHAR(50), InterestRate DECIMAL(20, 4), BorrowDate DATE, MaturityDate DATE, Long bigint,  
        Short bigint, Net bigint);  
         IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1  
                         FROM @lastSavedDateTable  
                    WHERE bitNeedIncremental = 1  
                      )  
            OR @useDailyPositionsTable = 1 -- dont need incremental data, just get the position from the daily position  
         BEGIN  
             INSERT INTO @TempDailyPositions(PositionDate, ExchangeCode, AccountId, SubstrategyId, SecurityName, EsteeId, InterestRate, BorrowDate, MaturityDate,Long, Short, Net)  
                    SELECT dp.PositionDate, dp.ExchangeCode, dp.AccountId, dp.SubstrategyId, dp.SecurityName, dp.EsteeId, dp.InterestRate, dp.BorrowDate,  
     dp.MaturityDate, case when dp.PositionDate=@date then dp.Long else 0 end as Long,   
     case when dp.PositionDate = @date then dp.Short else 0 end as Short, dp.Net  
                      FROM StockBorrowPositions dp WITH (NOLOCK)  
                      INNER JOIN @finalAccIdList A ON dp.AccountId = A.Account_ID  
                      INNER JOIN @finalSsidList sn ON sn.n = dp.SubStrategyId  
                      INNER JOIN @lastSavedDateTable LST ON dp.ExchangeCode = LST.exchange_Code  
                                                            AND dp.PositionDate = LST.lastSavedDate;  
         END;  
         ELSE  
         BEGIN  
             SELECT @minLastSavedDate = MIN(lastsaveddate)  
               FROM @lastSavedDateTable  
              WHERE bitNeedIncremental = 1;  
             INSERT INTO @TempDailyPositions(PositionDate, ExchangeCode, AccountId, SubstrategyId, SecurityName, EsteeId, InterestRate, BorrowDate,   
            MaturityDate,Long, Short, Net)  
                    --get position from trades > lastsavedposition  
                    SELECT PositionDate, ExchangeCode, AccountId, SubStrategyId, SecurityName, EsteeId, InterestRate, BorrowDate, MaturityDate,   
       Sum(long) as Long, Sum(Short) as Short, SUM(Net) AS Net  
                      FROM(  
                          SELECT @date AS PositionDate, Ord.ExchangeCode, Ord.AccountId, Ord.SubStrategyId, Ord.SecurityName, Ord.EsteeId,   
         Ord.InterestRate, Ord.BorrowDate, Ord.maturityDate,   
         sum(Case when ord.TransactionType =1 and Ord.Date=@date then Ord.Quantity else 0 end) as Long,  
         sum(case when ord.TransactionType =2 and Ord.Date=@date then Ord.Quantity else 0 end) as Short,   
         SUM(CASE Ord.TransactionType WHEN 1 THEN Ord.Quantity WHEN 2 THEN-1 * Ord.Quantity END) Net          
                            FROM StockBorrowTransactions Ord WITH (NOLOCK)  
                            INNER JOIN @finalAccIdList A ON ISNULL(Ord.AccountId, 1) = A.Account_ID  
                            INNER JOIN @finalSsidList SN ON SN.n = Ord.SubStrategyId  
                            INNER JOIN @lastSavedDateTable LST ON A.exchange_Code = LST.exchange_Code  
                                                                  AND LST.bitNeedIncremental = 1  
                                                                  AND Ord.Date > LST.lastSavedDate  
                           WHERE Ord.Date < @dateplusone  
                                 AND Ord.Date > @minLastSavedDate  
                           GROUP BY ExchangeCode, AccountId, SubStrategyId, SecurityName, EsteeId, InterestRate, BorrowDate, MaturityDate  
                          --for cash trade ********* bcoz of some problem in database we do only for creation_time >= '10-30-2009'  
                          UNION ALL  
                          -- saved position  
                          SELECT @date AS PositionDate, dp.ExchangeCode, dp.AccountId, dp.SubstrategyId, dp.SecurityName, dp.EsteeId,   
        dp.InterestRate, dp.BorrowDate, dp.MaturityDate,0 as Long, 0 as Short, dp.Net  
                            FROM StockBorrowPositions dp WITH (NOLOCK)  
         INNER JOIN @finalAccIdList A ON dp.AccountId = A.Account_ID  
                            INNER JOIN @finalSsidList sn ON sn.n = dp.SubStrategyId  
                          INNER JOIN @lastSavedDateTable LST ON dp.ExchangeCode = LST.exchange_Code  
                                          AND dp.PositionDate = LST.lastSavedDate  
                          ) AS Y  
                     GROUP BY PositionDate, ExchangeCode, AccountId, SubStrategyId, SecurityName, EsteeId, InterestRate, BorrowDate, MaturityDate;  
         END;  
         SELECT PositionDate, ExchangeCode, AccountId, SubstrategyId, SecurityName, EsteeId, InterestRate, BorrowDate, MaturityDate,Long, Short, Net  
           FROM @TempDailyPositions;  
     END; 


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetBorrowTransactions

```sql
-- =============================================  
-- Author:  <Author,,Name>  
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>  
-- Description: <Description,,>  
-- =============================================  
  
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetBorrowTransactions  
-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here  
@date DATE, @exchgCode VARCHAR(10)  
AS  
     BEGIN  
         -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from  
         -- interfering with SELECT statements.  
         SET NOCOUNT ON;  
  
         -- Insert statements for procedure here  
         SELECT sl.ID, sl.AccountId, sl.SubstrategyId, em.Datafeed_Ticker AS DatafeedTicker, min(sl.EsteeId) as EsteeId, sl.TransactionType,   
       sl.SettlementType, SUM(sl.Quantity) AS Quantity, sl.InterestRate, sl.BorrowDate, sl.MaturityDate  
           FROM StockBorrowTransactions sl  
           JOIN EsteeMaster em ON sl.esteeid = em.Estee_ID  
          WHERE Date = @date  
                AND sl.ExchangeCode = @exchgCode  
          GROUP BY sl.ID, sl.AccountId, sl.SubStrategyId, em.DataFeed_Ticker, sl.TransactionType,   
           sl.SettlementType, sl.InterestRate, sl.BorrowDate, sl.MaturityDate;  
     END;
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetBrokerOTIDToOTIDMapping

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spGetBrokerOTIDToOTIDMapping]        
@appID varchar(max)        
            
AS            
BEGIN         
             
   SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED            
            
   DECLARE @date as datetime            
   SET @date = cast(convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 101) as datetime)    
   ;WITH A as            
   (            
    select OrderTrade_ID, Order_ID,BrokerOrderTrade_ID,Creation_Date from OrderTrades  WITH (NOLOCK)          
    where Status not in ('Rejected','Executed','Cancelled','Halted','Inactive','Stopped')             
       AND Creation_Date >= @date        
   )            
               
   SELECT distinct            
   A.OrderTrade_ID,A.BrokerOrderTrade_ID            
   FROM [Order] B WITH (NOLOCK)      
   inner join  A on B.Order_ID = A.Order_ID and B.Creation_Date = A.Creation_Date            
   inner join  Broker as C WITH (NOLOCK) on C.broker_id = B.broker_id           
   inner join vwSSConfig vw on vw.EMSId = @appID and vw.SSID = B.Sub_Strategy_ID          
   option (maxdop 1)   
End

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetBSESpecialTxSecurities

```sql
create procedure spGetBSESpecialTxSecurities  
@date Date
As  
Begin  

select *into #temp from (
select Estee_ID, ISIN, Expiry_Date from esteemaster e where e.Exchange_Code = 'IB' and e.Security_Type in (6,7) and ISIN in ('IB0000000001')
and e.Expiry_Date >= @date
UNION 
select Estee_ID, ISIN, Expiry_Date from EsteeMaster_archive ea where ea.Exchange_Code = 'IB' and ea.Security_Type in (6,7) and ISIN in ('IB0000000001')
and ea.Expiry_Date >= @date
) Y

select distinct substring(e.Estee_ID, 1, 24) from #temp e inner join  
(  
select distinct ISIN, Expiry_date, ROW_NUMBER() over (Partition by ISIN order by ISIN, cast(Expiry_Date as date)) RowNo  
from #temp
) X on X.RowNo = 1 and e.ISIN = X.ISIN and e.Expiry_Date = X.Expiry_Date

drop table #temp
  
End
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetClearingEsteeId

```sql
  
CREATE procedure spGetClearingEsteeId  
@isArchive bit = 0  
As  
Begin  
declare @segements varchar(100) = 'CM,FO,CD'  
CREATE TABLE #tempTable(ClrExchange varchar(2), SecType int)  
   
insert into #tempTable  
select * from(  
select c.ClearingExchange, v.SecurityType from Account a inner join ClearingAccount c on a.ClearingAccountID = c.ClearingAccountID  
cross apply dbo.Split(@segements,',') as r  
Inner join ValidCombos v on v.Segment = r.items and v.ExchangeCode = a.exchange_Code  
Inner join tblBrokerAccount tba on tba.account_id = a.Account_ID  
where a.Status = 'Active' and a.exchange_Code <> c.ClearingExchange and tba.IsInteroperabilityEnabled = 1 and a.Segment = 'XX'  
UNIOn  
select c.ClearingExchange, v.SecurityType from Account a inner join ClearingAccount c on a.ClearingAccountID = c.ClearingAccountID  
Inner join ValidCombos v on v.Segment = a.Segment and v.ExchangeCode = a.exchange_Code  
Inner join tblBrokerAccount tba on tba.account_id = a.Account_ID  
where a.Status = 'Active' and a.exchange_Code <> c.ClearingExchange and tba.IsInteroperabilityEnabled = 1  
) X  
  
if @isArchive = 1  
begin  
 select e.Estee_ID from EsteeMaster e inner join #tempTable t on e.Exchange_Code = t.ClrExchange and e.Security_Type = t.SecType  
 UNION  
 select e.Estee_ID from EsteeMaster_archive e inner join #tempTable t on e.Exchange_Code = t.ClrExchange and e.Security_Type = t.SecType and e.Status = 1  
end  
else  
begin  
 select e.Estee_ID from EsteeMaster e inner join #tempTable t on e.Exchange_Code = t.ClrExchange and e.Security_Type = t.SecType  
end  
drop table #tempTable  
  
  
select a.Account_ID, c.ClearingExchange from Account a inner join ClearingAccount c on a.ClearingAccountID = c.ClearingAccountID  
Inner join tblBrokerAccount tba on tba.account_id = a.Account_ID  
where tba.IsInteroperabilityEnabled = 1  

select distinct a.ClearingAccountID, a.Account_ID from tblBrokerAccount tba inner join Account a on a.Account_ID = tba.account_id
inner join ClearingAccount ca on ca.ClearingAccountID = a.ClearingAccountID
where tba.IsInteroperabilityEnabled = 1 and a.Status = 'Active' and a.exchange_Code = ca.ClearingExchange
  
End  
  
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetClientMarginSummary

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetClientMarginSummary]    
@date datetime,    
@accountId int,    
@listSubStrategyID varchar(max),    
@spanId varchar(10),  
@Exchange_code varchar(10)  
AS    
Begin    
 Create table #tmp    
 (    
 Exchange_Code varchar(5),    
 SecurityName varchar(50),    
 Long decimal(30,15),    
 Short decimal(30,15),    
 TransactionCost Decimal(30,15),    
 Account_ID int,    
 SecurityType varchar(50),    
 Estee_ID varchar(50),    
 Sub_StrategyID int,    
 BROKER_ID int,    
 PositionDate dateTime,    
 AverageTradedPrice decimal(30,15),    
 BuyValue decimal(30,15),    
 SellValue decimal(30,15),    
 AverageHoldingPrice decimal(30,15),    
 Rule_Id int    
 )    
 INSERT INTO #tmp    
 Exec GetAllPositionsForGivenDate @date, 1, @listSubStrategyID, @Exchange_code, '', '', ''   
 Delete from #tmp where Long - Short = 0  
    
 Select MAX(e.Underlying_Ticker) AS Product, MAX(e.Option_Type) AS [Product type], MAX(e.Strike_Price) Strike_Price,     
 MAX(e.Expiry_Date) Expiry_Date, SUM(Long - Short) AS NETPostion,  
 MAX(srv.r1),MAX(srv.r2),MAX(srv.r3),MAX(srv.r4),MAX(srv.r5),MAX(srv.r6),MAX(srv.r7),MAX(srv.r8),MAX(srv.r9),MAX(srv.r10),MAX(srv.r11),MAX(srv.r12),MAX(srv.r13),MAX(srv.r14),MAX(srv.r15),MAX(srv.r16),MAX(SP.LTP) AS LTP,    
 MAX(cp.LTP) AS UNDLTP, MAX(ISNULL(mt1.ExposureMarginOptions, ISNULL(mt3.ExposureMarginOptions, mt2.ExposureMarginOptions))) AS ELM, MAX(SUC.SpreadCharge) AS SPREADCHARGE, MAX(SP.compositeDelta) AS CompositeDelta, MAX(e.UnderlyingEstee_Id) AS ProductUndEsteeID 
 from #tmp (nolock) gdp   
 INNER JOIN esteemaster (nolock) e on e.Estee_ID = gdp.Estee_ID  and e.Status = 1  
 INNER JOIN SpanData sp (nolock) on gdp.Estee_ID = sp.esteeID   
 INNER JOIN SpanRiskValues (nolock) srv ON gdp.Estee_ID = srv.esteeID and srv.date= sp.date and srv.spanID = sp.spanID  
 INNER JOIN SpanUndCharge (nolock) suc on suc.esteeID = e.underlyingEstee_id and suc.date = sp.date and suc.spanID = sp.spanID    
 left join MarginTable (nolock) mt1 on mt1.Estee_id = sp.esteeID and mt1.AsOfDate = sp.date    
 left join MarginTable (nolock) mt3 on mt3.Estee_id = e.underlyingEstee_id and mt3.AsOfDate = sp.date    
 left join MarginTable (nolock) mt2 on mt2.Estee_id = e.underlyingEstee_id and mt2.AsOfDate = '0001-01-01'    
 INNER JOIN SpanData (nolock) cp on cp.esteeID = suc.esteeID and cp.spanID = suc.spanID and cp.Date = srv.date    
 where sp.date = @date and sp.spanID = @spanId and gdp.Account_ID = @accountId  
 Group by e.Estee_ID    
    
 drop table #tmp    
End 
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetClosingPriceExchangeWise

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetClosingPriceExchangeWise]  
@exgCode varchar(100) = 'ALL',
@exgSegment varchar(100) = 'ALL',
@date date,
@esteeIDs varchar(max) = ''
  
AS  
BEGIN  

IF LEN(RTRIM(LTRIM(ISNULL(@esteeIDs,'')))) > 0
	begin
		DECLARE @tblEsteeIDs TABLE (esteeID varchar(30))         
		INSERT into @tblEsteeIDs SELECT * from dbo.split(@esteeIDs,',') 
	
		SELECT Estee_ID,Close_Price FROM closingprice  
		WHERE Date = @date and Estee_ID in ( select EsteeId from @tblEsteeIDs)
	end

else
	begin
		DECLARE @segmentsTable TABLE (segment varchar(20))         
		INSERT into @segmentsTable SELECT * from dbo.split(@exgSegment,',')
	
		DECLARE @exgTable TABLE (exchange varchar(20))         
		INSERT into @exgTable SELECT * from dbo.split(@exgCode,',')
	
		IF @exgCode = 'ALL' and @exgSegment = 'ALL'
			 begin
				SELECT Estee_ID,Close_Price FROM closingprice  
				WHERE Date = @date
			 end
		 
		ELSE IF @exgSegment = 'ALL'
			begin
				SELECT Estee_ID,Close_Price FROM closingprice  
				WHERE Date = @date and SUBSTRING(estee_id,13,2) = @exgCode
			end
		
		ELSE IF @exgCode = 'ALL'
		begin
			SELECT Estee_ID,Close_Price FROM closingprice  
			WHERE Date = @date and SUBSTRING(Estee_Id,15,2) in (select segment from @segmentsTable)
		end

		ELSE
			begin
						  
				SELECT Estee_ID,Close_Price FROM closingprice  
				WHERE Date = @date  
				and substring(Estee_Id,13,2) in (select exchange from @exgTable)
				and SUBSTRING(Estee_Id,15,2) in (select segment from @segmentsTable)
			end
	end

END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetCompletedOrdersForProcessOrder

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spGetCompletedOrdersForProcessOrder]  

     @appid int = null
AS
BEGIN
   SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED
   DECLARE @date as datetime
   SET @date = cast(convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 101) as datetime)

   Declare @substrategyIdList1 table(id int)
   if exists(select substrategy_id from datainit where substrategy_id is not null and Parameter='POINSERTQ' and value = 'processorderinsertqueue' + Cast(@appid as varchar))
	BEGIN
	   Insert into @substrategyIdList1
	   select substrategy_id from datainit
	   where substrategy_id is not null and Parameter='POINSERTQ' and value = 'processorderinsertqueue' + Cast(@appid as varchar)
	END
    ELSE
	BEGIN
	   Insert into @substrategyIdList1
	   select distinct DI.substrategy_id from DataInit DI inner join EsteeApplications EA on DI.ApplicationID = EA.ApplicationID
	   and ((DI.substrategy_id is not null or DI.substrategy_id <> '') and DI.substrategy_id <> 0)
	   and EA.EsteeServer_ID in (select EsteeServer_ID from EsteeApplications where ApplicationID = @appid)
	   and DI.SubStrategy_ID not in (
	   	   select distinct substrategy_id from DataInit where SubStrategy_ID is not null and substrategy_id <> 0 and Parameter='POINSERTQ'
									)
	END

	SELECT distinct order_id as Order_ID from vwAllTrades vw
	inner join @substrategyIdList1 ss on ss.id = vw.Sub_Strategy_ID
	WHERE vw.Creation_Date = @date and vw.islast = 1

END  


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetConfigForDataBarForOAE

```sql



CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetConfigForDataBarForOAE]            
AS            
BEGIN            
  
-- Gets all index component near futures for MCX.
  select  A.* from 
(select (rank() over (partition by e.Underlyingestee_id  order by c.deliveryStartDate)) as [rank],e.Estee_ID,e.Expiry_Date,e.UnderlyingEstee_Id 
, c.AssetName,com.Weight,com.Index_Estee_Id,com.Divisor from CommodityMaster c 
inner join esteemaster e on c.Estee_ID = e.Estee_ID 
inner join CommodityIndexData com on com.Commodity_Estee_Id = e.UnderlyingEstee_Id
where e.Security_Type = 20 and c.DeliveryStartDate > GETDATE() and com.Year = Year(GetDate())) as A 
where  A.[rank] <= 2 order by A.Index_Estee_Id

  
END


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetConfigurationDetails

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spGetConfigurationDetails]   
      @substrategy_id int      
AS  
  
BEGIN  
  
 declare @substrategy_name varchar(100);  
 declare @applicationID int;  
   
 Select @substrategy_name = substrategy_name from strategy_new where substrategy_id = @substrategy_id    
 select @applicationID = ApplicationID from EsteeApplications where SubStrategy_ID = @substrategy_id  
   
 --get configuration detail  
 select distinct A.Parameter, A.[Value], B.substrategyid  
 from DATAINIT A  
 inner join StrategyBrokerAccount B on B.substrategyid = A.substrategy_id  
 where A.substrategy_id = @substrategy_id;  
  
   
 -- get Banned security  
 select distinct A.substrategy_id, A.estee_id, A.ban_status, B.underlying_ticker  
 from tblbansecurities A  
 inner join esteemaster B on A.estee_id = B.estee_id   
 where B.Status=1 and A.substrategy_id  in (0, @substrategy_id);  
  
  
 Select Top 1 UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate From DataInit_Archive Where UpdatedDate > GetDate() - 90  and substrategy_id = @substrategy_id Order by DataInitID Desc;  
   
 -- get Banned ETF  
 SELECT a.UnderlyingTicker, a.ETFEstee_Id ,a.Enabled ,a.BuyPenalties,a.SellPenalties FROM BANETF a WHERE SubStrategy_Id=@substrategy_id;  
   
 SELECT a.Ticker, a.BuyPenalty,a.SellPenalty FROM BuySellPenalties a WHERE SubStrategy_Id=@substrategy_id;  
   
 select top 1 es.IP as EMS_SERVER from esteeservers es inner join esteeapplications ea on es.ID = ea.EsteeServer_ID where ea.SubStrategy_ID = @substrategy_id;  
  
 --returns AccID and Broker ID from StrategyBrokerAccount  
 select accountID,  
  brokerID,   
  A.participant_id   
 from StrategyBrokerAccount SBA   
 inner join Account A on A.Account_ID = SBA.accountID  
 Where subStrategyID = @substrategy_id;  
   
 --select distinct B.estee_id, B.underlying_ticker  
 --from subscription_realtime A  
 --inner join ESTEEMASTER B on A.ESTEEID  = B.ESTEE_ID  
 --inner join SecurityType S on S.TypeCode = B.Security_Type  
 --where  B.Status=1   
 --AND A.strategy_name = @substrategy_name  
 --and S.TypeName like '%SPOT%';  
  
 select @substrategy_name as substrategy_name, @applicationID as ApplicationID  
END  
  
  
  
  
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetConnectionString

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetConnectionString
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@applicationId int,
	@dataStoreType varchar(50)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @temp varbinary(max), @connectionString varchar(255)

	    SELECT @temp = dsm.DataStoreConnectionString
		  FROM DataStoreMetadata dsm
	INNER JOIN esteeservers es on dsm.LocationCode = es.LocationCode
	INNER JOIN EsteeApplications ea on ea.EsteeServer_ID = es.id
	     WHERE dsm.DataStoreType=@dataStoreType 
	       AND ea.ApplicationID = @applicationId

	EXEC esteeEncryptionKey..spDecrypt @temp, @connectionString OUTPUT

	SELECT @connectionString

END

```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetConstraintColumnsOnTables]	 
@tableString varchar(max)
AS
BEGIN

SELECT ColumnName = col.column_name , col.TABLE_NAME ,tc.CONSTRAINT_TYPE,*

    FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc 

    INNER JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage col 


    ON col.Constraint_Name = tc.Constraint_Name 

    AND col.Constraint_schema = tc.Constraint_schema 

	inner join dbo.Split(@tableString , ',')
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetContractIdToEsteeIdMapping

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.spGetContractIdToEsteeIdMapping



	@applicationId       VARCHAR(6) = '1000',--Temporary Change done for backward compatibility



	@esteeIds	VARCHAR(MAX) = ''



AS



BEGIN



	IF @esteeIds = ''



		BEGIN



			IF(@applicationId > 9999)



				BEGIN

			

					DECLARE @querySubscriptionRealtime VARCHAR(5);



					SELECT @querySubscriptionRealtime = value



						FROM   datainit as DI



						WHERE  DI.applicationid = @applicationId



						AND DI.parameter = 'query_subscriptionin_realtime';







					IF LOWER(@querySubscriptionRealtime) = 'true'

				

						BEGIN

					

							DECLARE @subscriptionName VARCHAR(50);



							SELECT @subscriptionName = value



							FROM   datainit AS DI



							WHERE  DI.applicationid = @applicationId



							AND parameter = 'subscription_name';



		



							IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#SubscribedEids') IS NOT NULL



								BEGIN



									DROP TABLE #SubscribedEids;



								END



							CREATE TABLE #SubscribedEids( Eid VARCHAR(100) );







							IF @subscriptionName = ''



								BEGIN



									INSERT INTO #SubscribedEids



									SELECT EsteeId FROM subscription_realtime AS SR;



								END



							ELSE



								BEGIN



									INSERT INTO #SubscribedEids



									SELECT EsteeId FROM subscription_realtime AS SR



										WHERE SR.STRATEGY_NAME = @subscriptionName;



								END



							END





						

							SELECT CIDS.ContractId, CIDS.EsteeId FROM ContractIds(NOLOCK) AS CIDS

	

								INNER JOIN #SubscribedEids AS SE



								ON CIDS.EsteeId = SE.Eid 



								AND CIDS.ContractId >= 0



								AND CIDS.EsteeId IS NOT NULL

							

								AND CIDS.ContractId IS NOT NULL;



						END



					ELSE



						BEGIN



							SELECT ContractId, EsteeId FROM ContractIds(NOLOCK) AS CIDS



								WHERE CIDS.ContractId >= 0



						END



				



				END



	



	ELSE



		BEGIN



			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#SubscribedEids1') IS NOT NULL



			BEGIN



				DROP TABLE #SubscribedEids1;



			END



		



			CREATE TABLE #SubscribedEids1( Eid VARCHAR(100) );



			INSERT INTO #SubscribedEids1



				SELECT * FROM   dbo.Split(@esteeIds, ',');



			SELECT CIDS.ContractId, CIDS.EsteeId FROM ContractIds(NOLOCK) AS CIDS



				RIGHT JOIN #SubscribedEids1 AS SE



				ON SE.Eid = CIDS.EsteeId



				AND CIDS.ContractId >= 0;



		END



















END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetContractsForBBCorporateAction

```sql
Create procedure spGetContractsForBBCorporateAction
@exgCode varchar(16)
As
Begin
if @exgCode = 'IB'
begin
	select '/isin/' + e.ISIN as BBIsin, e.Estee_ID, bb.BBExchangeCode from EsteeToExternalDataSource bb 
	inner join esteemaster (nolock) e on bb.ExchangeCode = e.Exchange_Code
	where e.Security_Type = 0 and e.Exchange_Code = @exgCode and CreateCorpAction = 1
	and e.SERIES not in ('F')---ignoring list (F is a series in BSE for corporate fund securities)
end
else if @exgCode = 'BR'
begin 
select '/isin/' + e.ISIN as BBIsin, e.Estee_ID, bb.BBExchangeCode from EsteeToExternalDataSource bb 
		inner join esteemaster (nolock) e on bb.ExchangeCode = e.Exchange_Code
		where e.Security_Type = 0 and e.Exchange_Code = @exgCode and CreateCorpAction = 1 and e.estee_id not like 'ZZ%'
		UNION
		select '/isin/' + e2.ISIN as BBIsin, e.Estee_ID, bb.BBExchangeCode from EsteeToExternalDataSource bb 
		inner join esteemaster (nolock) e on bb.ExchangeCode = e.Exchange_Code
		inner join esteemaster (nolock) e2 on SUBSTRING(e.Estee_ID,3 ,14) = SUBSTRING(e2.Estee_ID,3 ,14) and e.Security_Type = 0 and e2.Security_Type = 0
		where e.Security_Type = 0 and e.Exchange_Code = @exgCode and CreateCorpAction = 1 and e.Estee_ID like 'ZZ%' and e2.Estee_ID not like 'ZZ%'
end
else if @exgCode = 'HK'
begin
		select '/isin/' + e.ISIN as BBIsin, e.Estee_ID, bb.BBExchangeCode,e.Datafeed_Ticker from EsteeToExternalDataSource bb 
		inner join esteemaster (nolock) e on bb.ExchangeCode = e.Exchange_Code
		where e.Security_Type = 0 and e.Exchange_Code = @exgCode and CreateCorpAction = 1
end
else
begin
		select '/isin/' + e.ISIN as BBIsin, e.Estee_ID, bb.BBExchangeCode from EsteeToExternalDataSource bb 
		inner join esteemaster (nolock) e on bb.ExchangeCode = e.Exchange_Code
		where e.Security_Type = 0 and e.Exchange_Code = @exgCode and CreateCorpAction = 1
end
End;

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetCorporateActionByExchange

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetCorporateActionByExchange]                 
@EffectiveDate DATETIME  = null,         
@ExchangeCode varchar(20)= null
AS            
BEGIN      
  IF @EffectiveDate IS NOT NULL  
  BEGIN  
   SELECT UnderlyingEsteeId, EM.DataFeed_Ticker, EffectiveDate,[Action],Remarks,ActionType,LastUpdateTime   
   FROM [CorporateActionTable] CA  
   inner join esteemaster EM  
   on EM.Estee_ID = CA.UnderlyingEsteeId   
   WHERE EffectiveDate = @EffectiveDate
   AND EM.Exchange_Code= @ExchangeCode    
   AND  UnderlyingEsteeId IS NOT NULL  
   AND ActionType <> 'FORECAST DIVIDEND'
	AND action<>'0'
  END  
  ELSE  
  BEGIN  
   SELECT UnderlyingEsteeId,EM.DataFeed_Ticker, EffectiveDate,[Action],Remarks,ActionType,LastUpdateTime   
   FROM [CorporateActionTable] CA  
   inner join esteemaster EM  
   on EM.Estee_ID = CA.UnderlyingEsteeId   
   WHERE EffectiveDate = GETDATE()   
   AND EM.Exchange_Code= @ExchangeCode   
   AND  UnderlyingEsteeId IS NOT NULL  
      AND ActionType <> 'FORECAST DIVIDEND'
	AND action<>'0'
  END   
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetCorporateActionValuesMail

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetCorporateActionValuesMail] 
	@DATETIME datetime 
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SELECT COUNT(1) FROM	corporateactiontable a 
	WHERE	a.LastUpdateTime IN 
	(
	SELECT DISTINCT TOP 3 EffectiveDate FROM corporateactiontable WHERE EffectiveDate > @DATETIME ORDER BY EffectiveDate ASC)
	AND		(		a.ActionType IS NULL 
				OR	UnderLyingESTEEID IS NULL 
				OR	(	a.Action='0' 
						AND	a.ActionType NOT IN('ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING')
					)
			)
	SELECT	e.Underlying_Ticker,cast(a.EffectiveDate as date) as EffectiveDate ,a.Action,a.ActionType, a.remarks, e.Estee_ID, cast(max(a.LastUpdateTime) as DATE) as LastUpdateTime,
		CASE 
			WHEN a.ActionType LIKE '%SPLIT%' THEN '1'
			WHEN a.ActionType LIKE '%BONUS%' THEN '2'
			WHEN a.ActionType LIKE '%RIGHTS%' THEN '3'
			WHEN a.ActionType LIKE '%DIVIDEND%' THEN '4'
			WHEN a.ActionType LIKE '%SPECIAL DIVIDEND%' THEN '5'
			WHEN a.ActionType is null THEN 'Z'
			ELSE a.ActionType
		END as sortExtra
		,a.AnnouncementDate
		FROM	corporateactiontable a 
		INNER JOIN EsteeMaster e on e.Estee_ID = a.UnderlyingEsteeId
		WHERE a.EffectiveDate IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT TOP 3 EffectiveDate FROM corporateactiontable WHERE EffectiveDate > @DATETIME ORDER BY EffectiveDate ASC)
		group by e.Estee_ID, e.Underlying_Ticker, cast(a.EffectiveDate as DATE),a.Action,a.ActionType,a.Remarks, 
		CASE 
			WHEN a.ActionType LIKE '%SPLIT%' THEN '1'
			WHEN a.ActionType LIKE '%BONUS%' THEN '2'
			WHEN a.ActionType LIKE '%RIGHTS%' THEN '3'
			WHEN a.ActionType LIKE '%DIVIDEND%' THEN '4'
			WHEN a.ActionType LIKE '%SPECIAL DIVIDEND%' THEN '5'
			WHEN a.ActionType is null THEN 'Z'
			ELSE a.ActionType
		END
		,a.AnnouncementDate
		ORDER BY sortExtra, cast(a.EffectiveDate as date), e.Underlying_Ticker
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetCurrentLedgerBalance

```sql

Create procedure spGetCurrentLedgerBalance  
@startDate date,  
@endDate date  
As  
Begin  
select * from (  
select Account_Id, Sub_StrategyID, Estee_ID, PositionDate, sum(Long) as Long, sum(Short) as Short, sum(TransactionCost) as TransactionCost, sum(BuyValue) as BuyValue, sum(SellValue) as SellValue,  
DENSE_RANK() over (partition by Estee_Id, Account_Id, Sub_StrategyID order by Estee_Id, Account_Id, Sub_StrategyID, PositionDate desc) as RNo from DailyPositions   
where PositionDate >= @startDate and PositionDate <= @endDate group by Account_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Estee_ID, PositionDate) X  
where X.RNo = 1  
  
select Account_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Estee_ID ,SUM(TransactionCost) AS TC from DailyPositions where PositionDate >= @startDate and   
PositionDate < @endDate  
group by Account_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Estee_ID   
  
select Account_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Estee_ID, SUM(TransactionCost) AS TC from DailyPositions where PositionDate = @endDate  
group by Account_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Estee_ID  
  
End 


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetDailyOperationalMetrics

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetDailyOperationalMetrics] 
@date DATE = NULL,
@exCode char(2)  
   
AS  
   
BEGIN  
  
 DECLARE @today AS DATE  
 IF @date IS NOT NULL  
  SET @today = @date  
 ELSE  
  SET @today = GETDATE()  
 SELECT @today;  
 
 Declare @SelectedTrades Table(SSID int, Orders int, Trades int)
 
 Insert into @SelectedTrades
  SELECT OT.SUB_STRATEGY_ID,  
  COUNT(*),  
  SUM(CASE OT.[Status]   
   WHEN 'EXECUTED' THEN 1   
   WHEN 'PARTIALLY FILLED' THEN 1   
   ELSE 0   
   END)  
  FROM Account A
  INNER JOIN  StrategyBrokerAccount SBA 
	ON A.exchange_Code = @exCode
	and A.Account_ID = SBA.accountID
  INNER JOIN OrderTrades OT WITH (NOLOCK) 
	ON SBA.subStrategyID = OT.Sub_Strategy_ID  
  INNER JOIN Trades T WITH (NOLOCK) 
	ON OT.Order_ID = T.Order_ID 
	AND OT.Creation_Date = T.Creation_Date 
	AND OT.OrderTrade_ID = T.OrderTrade_ID   
  WHERE T.Creation_Date = @today AND OT.STATUS <> 'CANCELLED' AND New_Cancel_Modify <> 'C' -- DONOT COUNT CANCEL REQUESTS TO EXCHANGE AS NEW Orders  
  AND NOT (OT.STATUS = 'REJECTED' AND OT.Remarks LIKE '%[NOT FOUND IN EMS MEMORY]%')  -- DONOT COUNT INTERNAL EMS REJECTIONS AS NEW Orders  
  GROUP BY OT.Sub_Strategy_ID    
  
 SELECT SSID 'Sub_Strategy_Id',  
 Orders 'Orders',  
 Trades 'Trades',  
 CASE Trades  
  WHEN 0 THEN 0  
  ELSE Orders/Trades  
 END AS 'Order/Trade Ratio'   
 FROM @SelectedTrades  
 Order BY SSID  
  
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetDailyOperationalMetrics_1

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Puneet Rakheja
-- Create date: Feb 22 2011
-- Description:	operational metrics
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetDailyOperationalMetrics_1] @date date = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	declare @today as date
	if @date IS NOT NULL
	 set @today = @date
	else
	 set @today = getdate()
	select @today;
	 
	With SelectedTrades(SSID,Orders,Trades) as
	(
	 select ot.Sub_Strategy_ID,
	 count(*),
	 sum(case status 
			when 'executed' then 1 
			when 'partially filled' then 1 
			else 0 
		 end)
	 from tbltrades t with (nolock)
	 inner join tblordertrades ot with (nolock) on ot.ordertrade_id = t.ordertrade_id
	 where ot.creation_time > @today and ot.status <> 'cancelled' and new_cancel_modify <> 'C'
	 and NOT (ot.status = 'rejected' and ot.remarks like '%[not found in EMS memory]%')	 
	 group by ot.Sub_Strategy_ID
	)
	select SSID 'Sub_Strategy_ID',
	Orders 'Orders',
	Trades 'Trades',
	case Trades
		when 0 then 0
		else Orders/Trades
	end as 'Order/Trade ratio'
	from SelectedTrades
	--group by SSID
	order by SSID




END

```
