## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetDataFeedTickerFromISIN

```sql
CREATE Procedure [dbo].[spGetDataFeedTickerFromISIN]
@ISIN varchar(20),  
@ExgCode char(2),  
@Expiry varchar(10) = null  
  
AS  
Begin 
Declare @TempEsteeMaster Table(Estee_ID varchar(50),DataFeed_Ticker varchar(50))
if(@Expiry is null OR @Expiry = '')  
 begin  
  select distinct Estee_ID,DataFeed_Ticker from esteemaster where status=1 and ISIN=@ISIN and Exchange_Code = @ExgCode  
 end  
else  
 begin
  insert into @TempEsteeMaster
  select distinct Estee_ID,DataFeed_Ticker from esteemaster e where status=1 and ISIN=@ISIN and Exchange_Code = @ExgCode 
  
  select Estee_ID,DataFeed_Ticker from @TempEsteeMaster
  union select distinct Estee_ID,DataFeed_Ticker from esteemaster_archive ea  
  where ISIN=@ISIN and Exchange_Code = @ExgCode and expiry_date=@Expiry and Status =1 
  and ea.Estee_ID not in   
  ( select distinct Estee_ID from @TempEsteeMaster)  
 end  
  
End

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetDataForFIXinitiation

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetDataForFIXinitiation]

@emsApplicationID int = null  

AS         

BEGIN         

   SET NOCOUNT ON;     

    Declare @SubstrategyList table(substrategyid int)  

  

 IF @emsApplicationID is null   

 begin   

  Insert into @SubstrategyList    

  select substrategy_id from EsteeApplications where ApplicationID like '10%'  

 end  

 else   

  begin   

  Insert into @SubstrategyList    

  select substrategy_id from datainit where parameter='Multiexchange' and Value like ('%' + cast(@emsApplicationID as varchar(50)) + '%')    

  union    

  select substrategy_id from datainit where parameter='MultiEMS' and Value like ('%' + cast(@emsApplicationID as varchar(50)) + '%')    

  union    

  select substrategy_id from esteeapplications where EMS_Application_ID= @emsApplicationID and substrategy_id is not null      

 end  

  

 select A.account_id as accountId, A.account_type as accountType, BA.broker_id as brokerId, A.participant_id as participantId, A.UCC as uniqueClientCode, A.Pan as pan  

 from Account as A  

 inner join tblBrokerAccount as BA with (nolock) on A.Account_ID = BA.account_id WHERE BA.is_active =1  

  

 select distinct a.strategy_id, SG.StrategyName as Strategy_Name, a.SubStrategy_Id, a.SubStrategy_Name, a.Strategy_Status, a.AlgoID as AlgoID, d1.Value as ems_queue, d2.Value as logonly, s.IP as EMS_SERVER,  

 d3.Value as EMBServerType  

 from Strategy_New a with (nolock)  

 INNER JOIN StrategyGroup SG with (nolock) on a.Strategy_Id = SG.StrategyID  

 INNER JOIN @SubstrategyList sl on sl.substrategyid = a.SubStrategy_Id  

 left join EsteeApplications ea with (nolock) on ea.SubStrategy_ID = a.SubStrategy_Id  

 left join EsteeServers s with (nolock) on s.ID = ea.EsteeServer_ID  

 left join DataInit d1 with (nolock) on d1.ApplicationID = ea.ApplicationID and d1.Parameter = 'emsqueuename'  

 left join DataInit d2 with (nolock) on d2.ApplicationID = ea.ApplicationID and d2.Parameter = 'logonly'  

 left join DataInit d3 with (nolock) on d3.ApplicationID = ea.ApplicationID and d3.Parameter = 'EMBServerType'  

 where s.IP is not null and a.Strategy_Status = 1

  

 select di.Value from datainit di  

 inner join @SubstrategyList sslist on sslist.substrategyid = di.substrategy_id

 inner join Strategy_New sn on sn.SubStrategy_Id = sslist.substrategyid

 where (di.Parameter = 'MultiEMS' or di.Parameter = 'MultiExchange' or di.Parameter = 'EMSEMBServerType')  

 and sn.Strategy_Status = 1

 END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetDataForFIXinitiationAkuna

```sql
--DATASYNCFROM_119 @DATE='2021-12-16', @LASTWORKINGDATE='2021-12-15', @LASTToLastWOR/KINGDATE='2021-12-14' --select top 1 * from esteemaster  --select * from vwssconfig  where ssid = 5530 --spGetDataForFIXinitiationAkuna 200263  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetDataForFIXinitiationAkuna] 
@emsApplicationID int = null AS BEGIN 
SET 
  NOCOUNT ON;
Declare @SubstrategyList table(substrategyid int) IF @emsApplicationID is null begin Insert into @SubstrategyList 
select 
  substrategy_id 
from 
  EsteeApplications 
where 
  ApplicationID like '10%' end else begin Insert into @SubstrategyList 
select 
  substrategy_id 
from 
  datainit 
where 
  parameter = 'Multiexchange' 
  and Value like (
    '%' + cast(
      @emsApplicationID as varchar(50)
    ) + '%'
  ) 
union 
select 
  substrategy_id 
from 
  datainit 
where 
  parameter = 'MultiEMS' 
  and Value like (
    '%' + cast(
      @emsApplicationID as varchar(50)
    ) + '%'
  ) 
union 
select 
  substrategy_id 
from 
  esteeapplications 
where 
  EMS_Application_ID = @emsApplicationID 
  and substrategy_id is not null end 
select 
  A.account_id as accountId, 
  A.account_type as accountType, 
  BA.broker_id as brokerId, 
  A.participant_id as participantId, 
  A.UCC as uniqueClientCode, 
  A.Pan as pan, 
  A.Segment as segment,
  BA.accountUserType as accountUserType -- Latest Change
from 
  Account as A 
  inner join tblBrokerAccount as BA with (nolock) on A.Account_ID = BA.account_id 
  inner join strategybrokeraccount sba (nolock) on a.account_id = sba.accountID INNER JOIN @SubstrategyList sl on sl.substrategyid = sba.subStrategyID 
WHERE 
  BA.is_active = 1 
select 
  distinct a.strategy_id, 
  SG.StrategyName as Strategy_Name, 
  a.SubStrategy_Id, 
  a.SubStrategy_Name, 
  a.Strategy_Status, 
  a.AlgoID as AlgoID, 
  d1.Value as ems_queue, 
  d2.Value as logonly, 
  s.IP as EMS_SERVER, 
  d3.Value as EMBServerType 
from 
  Strategy_New a with (nolock) 
  INNER JOIN StrategyGroup SG with (nolock) on a.Strategy_Id = SG.StrategyID 
  INNER JOIN @SubstrategyList sl on sl.substrategyid = a.SubStrategy_Id 
  left join EsteeApplications ea (nolock) on ea.SubStrategy_ID = a.SubStrategy_Id 
  left join EsteeServers s with (nolock) on s.ID = ea.EsteeServer_ID 
  left join DataInit d1 with (nolock) on d1.ApplicationID = ea.ApplicationID 
  and d1.Parameter = 'emsqueuename' 
  left join DataInit d2 with (nolock) on d2.ApplicationID = ea.ApplicationID 
  and d2.Parameter = 'logonly' 
  left join DataInit d3 with (nolock) on d3.ApplicationID = ea.ApplicationID 
  and d3.Parameter = 'EMBServerType' 
where 
  s.IP is not null 
  and a.Strategy_Status = 1 
select 
  di.Value 
from 
  datainit di 
  inner join @SubstrategyList sslist on sslist.substrategyid = di.substrategy_id 
  inner join Strategy_New sn on sn.SubStrategy_Id = sslist.substrategyid where 
  (
    di.Parameter = 'MultiEMS' 
    or di.Parameter = 'MultiExchange' 
    or di.Parameter = 'EMSEMBServerType'
  ) 
  and sn.Strategy_Status = 1 
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.SpGetDataForSGXEsteeMaster

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SpGetDataForSGXEsteeMaster]   
AS  
BEGIN  
select SS.InsId, IM.EsteeUndTicker, IM.ISIN, ISTM.SecurityType, SS.StrikePrice, SIC.DecInStrikePrice, SIC.TickSize, SIC.DecInPremium, SIC.ContractSize,SIC.PriceQuotFactor, SS.DateLastTrading,       
SS.SeriesStatus, SIC.BaseCur, IsNull(CU.CurrencyCode,SIC.SettlCurid) as SettlCurid, SS.Country, SS.Market, SS.InstrumentGroup, SS.Modifier, SS.Commodity, SS.ExpirationDate,SS.TimeLastTrading,SS.SettlementDate,    
SS.DateFirstTrading,SS.DateLastTrading from SGXSeries SS              
Inner join SGXunderlying SU on SS.Commodity = SU.Commodity         
inner join ISINMaster IM on SU.name = IM.ExchangeTicker  
left join Currency CU on CU.ID=IM.SettlementCurrency  
Inner join InstrumentSecurityTypeMap ISTM on SS.InstrumentGroup = ISTM.InstrumentGroup and SU.UnderlyingType = ISTM.UnderlyingType              
Inner Join SGXInstrumentClass SIC on SS.Country = SIC.Country and SS.Market = SIC.Market and SS.InstrumentGroup = SIC.InstrumentGroup                 
and SS.Commodity = SIC.Commodity         
where ss.Country=83 and IM.DataSource = 'Exchange' and IM.ExchangeCode = 'SG'  
UNION  
select SS.InsId, su.Name, su.IsinCode, ISTM.SecurityType, SS.StrikePrice, SIC.DecInStrikePrice, SIC.TickSize, SIC.DecInPremium, SIC.ContractSize,SIC.PriceQuotFactor, SS.DateLastTrading,       
SS.SeriesStatus, SIC.BaseCur, SIC.SettlCurid, SS.Country, SS.Market, SS.InstrumentGroup, SS.Modifier, SS.Commodity, SS.ExpirationDate,SS.TimeLastTrading,SS.SettlementDate,    
SS.DateFirstTrading,SS.DateLastTrading from SGXSeries SS              
Inner join SGXunderlying SU on SS.Commodity = SU.Commodity         
Inner join InstrumentSecurityTypeMap ISTM on SS.InstrumentGroup = ISTM.InstrumentGroup and SU.UnderlyingType = ISTM.UnderlyingType              
Inner Join SGXInstrumentClass SIC on SS.Country = SIC.Country and SS.Market = SIC.Market and SS.InstrumentGroup = SIC.InstrumentGroup                 
and SS.Commodity = SIC.Commodity         
where ss.Country=83 and SU.IsinCode <> ''  
order by ISTM.SecurityType  
END  


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetDataInitConfig

```sql


CREATE PROCEDURE spGetDataInitConfig

-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here

       @appNameId INT         = NULL, 

       @appID     INT         = NULL, 

       @mode      VARCHAR(50),

	   @platformType varchar(50)

AS

     BEGIN

         -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from

         -- interfering with SELECT statements.

         SET NOCOUNT ON;

         IF @appID IS NOT NULL

             BEGIN

                 SELECT @appNameId = EA.AppNameID

                 FROM dbo.EsteeApplications AS EA

                 WHERE EA.ApplicationID = @appID;

             END;

         DECLARE @True BIT= 1, @False BIT= 0;

         IF @mode = 'Create'

             BEGIN

                 SELECT DIP.ParameterName AS Parameter, DIP.DataType, --, DIP.DefaultValue AS Value, 

                 '' AS Value, DIP.AppNameId, DIP.IsMandatory, DIP.CanCopy, DIP.IsMandatory AS AddToDataInit, DIP.EnumName, DIP.DefaultValue,DIP.PlatformType

                 FROM dbo.DataInitParameters AS DIP

                 WHERE DIP.AppNameId = @appNameId AND (DIP.PlatformType IS NULL OR DIP.PlatformType = @platformType OR DIP.PlatformType = '');

             END;

         ELSE

             BEGIN

                 SELECT DIP.ParameterName AS Parameter, DIP.DataType,

                                                            CASE

                                                                WHEN @mode = 'Copy'

                                                                     AND DIP.CanCopy = 0

                                                                THEN ''

                                                                ELSE ISNULL([Value], '')

                                                            END AS Value, DIP.AppNameId, DIP.IsMandatory, CanCopy,

                                                                                                          CASE

                                                                                                              WHEN di.Parameter IS NULL

                                                                                                              THEN DIP.IsMandatory

                                                                                                              ELSE @True

                                                                                                          END AS AddToDataInit, DIP.EnumName, DIP.DefaultValue,DIP.PlatformType

                 FROM dbo.DataInitParameters AS DIP

                      LEFT JOIN dbo.DataInit AS DI ON di.[Parameter] = dip.ParameterName

                                                      AND DI.ApplicationID = @appID

                 WHERE dip.appnameid = @appNameId AND (DIP.PlatformType IS NULL OR DIP.PlatformType = @platformType OR DIP.PlatformType = '');

             END;

     END;
```

```sql
inner join Account a on a.Account_ID = sba.accountID  
inner join EsteeApplications ea on ea.SubStrategy_ID = sn.SubStrategy_Id  
inner join EsteeServers es on es.ID = ea.EsteeServer_ID  
where sn.Strategy_Status = 1 and es.LocationCode = @locationCode and a.Status = 'Active'

--inner join EsteeServers es on es.ID = ea.EsteeServer_ID  
--where sn.Strategy_Status = 1 and es.LocationCode = @locationCode and a.Status = 'Active'
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetDistinctSSIDDetailsForTradeMatching

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetDistinctSSIDDetailsForTradeMatching
    @CreationDate DATE,
    @StartTime TIME,
    @EndTime TIME,
    @EmsIds VARCHAR(MAX) -- Pass EMS IDs as a comma-separated string
AS
BEGIN
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        ems_id AS EMSId,
        sub_strategy_id AS SSID,
        account_id AS AccountId,
        estee_id AS EsteeId
    FROM 
        vwAllTrades
    WHERE 
        creation_date = @CreationDate
        AND creation_time BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime
        AND ems_id IN (select LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) from dbo.Split(@EmsIds, ','))  
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetDummyOrdersFromDB

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spGetDummyOrdersFromDB]
@LocationCode varchar(3),
@IncludeLinuxDOS bit = 0
AS
BEGIN
	IF(@IncludeLinuxDOS = 0)
	BEGIN
		Select sba.accountID as AccountID,sba.brokerID as BrokerID,do.substrategyid as SubStrategyID,do.orderquantity as OrderQuantity,
		do.underlyingticker as UnderlyingTicker, do.underlyingesteeid as UnderlyingEsteeID,do.securitytype as SecurityType,do.OrderValidity as OrderValidity,
		do.exchangecode as ExchangeCode from dummyorders do
		inner join strategybrokeraccount sba on sba.subStrategyID = do.substrategyid
		inner join Account ac on ac.exchange_Code = do.exchangecode and ac.Account_ID = sba.accountID
		inner join EsteeApplications eap on eap.SubStrategy_ID = do.SubStrategyID
		inner join EsteeApplications eap1 on eap.EMS_Application_ID = eap1.ApplicationID
		inner join EsteeServers ese on ese.ID = eap.EsteeServer_ID
		inner join Strategy_New sn on sn.SubStrategy_Id = do.SubStrategyID and sn.Strategy_Status = 1
		where ese.LocationCode = @LocationCode and eap1.PlatformType = 'Windows'
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		Select sba.accountID as AccountID,sba.brokerID as BrokerID,do.substrategyid as SubStrategyID,do.orderquantity as OrderQuantity,
		do.underlyingticker as UnderlyingTicker, do.underlyingesteeid as UnderlyingEsteeID,do.securitytype as SecurityType,do.OrderValidity as OrderValidity,
		do.exchangecode as ExchangeCode from dummyorders do
		inner join strategybrokeraccount sba on sba.subStrategyID = do.substrategyid
		inner join Account ac on ac.exchange_Code = do.exchangecode and ac.Account_ID = sba.accountID
		inner join EsteeApplications eap on eap.SubStrategy_ID = do.SubStrategyID
		inner join EsteeApplications eap1 on eap.EMS_Application_ID = eap1.ApplicationID
		inner join EsteeServers ese on ese.ID = eap.EsteeServer_ID
		inner join Strategy_New sn on sn.SubStrategy_Id = do.SubStrategyID and sn.Strategy_Status = 1
		where ese.LocationCode = @LocationCode and eap1.PlatformType in ('Windows','Linux')
	END

END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetEMSAccountData

```sql
-- Bug 17672: Add check to get active strategies in SP spGetDataForFIXinitiationAkuna
--
-- 1) Renamed spGetDataForFIXinitiationAkuna -> spGetEMSAccountData.
--    The old name was misleading: the SP is used by every EMS initialization
--    path (inline/inline-extended/TCP, TradeMatcher, all exchanges), not just
--    FIX EMS, and it is not specific to any one client (Akuna).
-- 2) Fixed: @SubstrategyList could contain substrategies belonging to inactive
--    strategies (Strategy_New.Strategy_Status <> 1) or with no Strategy_New row
--    at all. RS2 (strategies) and RS3 (DataInit) already filtered on
--    Strategy_Status = 1, but RS1 (accounts) did not, so callers could receive
--    account rows for inactive strategies (e.g. EMS 202627 / SSID 1314 leaking
--    account 40). A single check right after @SubstrategyList is populated now
--    removes any substrategy that is not tied to an active Strategy_New row,
--    so every result set consistently only ever sees active strategies.
--
-- C++ callers (eaExecutionAdapterHelper::getAccountStructureMap,
-- eaTradeMatcher::Init) have been updated to call spGetEMSAccountData.
--
-- Bug 17161 (reopened, depends on this one): RS1 now also returns the owning SSID as a trailing
-- `ssid` column. eaExecutionAdapterHelper::getAccountStructureMap() builds ssidToAccountIdsMap from
-- it, so eaExecutionManager::InitFastOrder() can count the accounts configured for the strategy(SSID)
-- which is running, instead of counting accounts for the whole EMS. This allows the valid case of one
-- EMS shared by several strategies (ems1 -> s1:a1, s2:a2) where only one strategy runs at a time,
-- while still failing init when a single SSID owns more than one account.
-- The new column is appended last, so consumers that read columns 0..7 only (e.g. eaTradeMatcher) are
-- unaffected. eaExecutionAdapterHelper::getAccountStructureMap() requires all 9 columns and fails EMS
-- init (ACCOUNT_LOAD_FAILED) if an older layout is returned, so this script and the binaries must be
-- deployed together.
--
-- Rollback: Bug17672_spGetEMSAccountData_Rollback.sql

 CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetEMSAccountData]
    @emsApplicationID int = null
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @SubstrategyList TABLE(substrategyid int);

    IF @emsApplicationID IS NULL
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @SubstrategyList
        SELECT substrategy_id FROM EsteeApplications WHERE ApplicationID LIKE '10%'
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @SubstrategyList
        SELECT substrategy_id FROM datainit WHERE parameter = 'Multiexchange' AND Value LIKE ('%' + CAST(@emsApplicationID AS VARCHAR(50)) + '%')
        UNION
        SELECT substrategy_id FROM datainit WHERE parameter = 'MultiEMS' AND Value LIKE ('%' + CAST(@emsApplicationID AS VARCHAR(50)) + '%')
        UNION
        SELECT substrategy_id FROM esteeapplications WHERE EMS_Application_ID = @emsApplicationID AND substrategy_id IS NOT NULL
    END

    -- Bug 17672: only keep substrategies that belong to an active strategy.
    -- Applied once, up front, so RS1/RS2/RS3 below are all consistently
    -- restricted to active strategies.
    DELETE sl
    FROM @SubstrategyList sl
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM Strategy_New sn WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE sn.SubStrategy_Id = sl.substrategyid AND sn.Strategy_Status = 1
    );

    -- RS1: accounts
    -- Bug 17161: the trailing "ssid" column tells which strategy (SSID) an account belongs to. It is
    -- consumed by eaExecutionAdapterHelper (ssidToAccountIdsMap) and lets EMS validate that the strategy
    -- running in inline mode has exactly one account configured, instead of counting accounts EMS wide.
    SELECT
        A.account_id AS accountId,
        A.account_type AS accountType,
        BA.broker_id AS brokerId,
        A.participant_id AS participantId,
        A.UCC AS uniqueClientCode,
        A.Pan AS pan,
        A.Segment AS segment,
        BA.accountUserType AS accountUserType,
        sba.subStrategyID AS ssid
    FROM Account AS A
        INNER JOIN tblBrokerAccount AS BA WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.Account_ID = BA.account_id
        INNER JOIN strategybrokeraccount sba WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.account_id = sba.accountID
        INNER JOIN @SubstrategyList sl ON sl.substrategyid = sba.subStrategyID
    WHERE BA.is_active = 1;

    -- RS2: strategies
    SELECT DISTINCT
        a.strategy_id,
        SG.StrategyName AS Strategy_Name,
        a.SubStrategy_Id,
        a.SubStrategy_Name,
        a.Strategy_Status,
        a.AlgoID AS AlgoID,
        d1.Value AS ems_queue,
        d2.Value AS logonly,
        s.IP AS EMS_SERVER,
        d3.Value AS EMBServerType
    FROM Strategy_New a WITH (NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN StrategyGroup SG WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.Strategy_Id = SG.StrategyID
        INNER JOIN @SubstrategyList sl ON sl.substrategyid = a.SubStrategy_Id
        LEFT JOIN EsteeApplications ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.SubStrategy_ID = a.SubStrategy_Id
        LEFT JOIN EsteeServers s WITH (NOLOCK) ON s.ID = ea.EsteeServer_ID
        LEFT JOIN DataInit d1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON d1.ApplicationID = ea.ApplicationID AND d1.Parameter = 'emsqueuename'
        LEFT JOIN DataInit d2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON d2.ApplicationID = ea.ApplicationID AND d2.Parameter = 'logonly'
        LEFT JOIN DataInit d3 WITH (NOLOCK) ON d3.ApplicationID = ea.ApplicationID AND d3.Parameter = 'EMBServerType'
    WHERE s.IP IS NOT NULL AND a.Strategy_Status = 1;

    -- RS3: DataInit multi-EMS config
    SELECT di.Value
    FROM datainit di
        INNER JOIN @SubstrategyList sslist ON sslist.substrategyid = di.substrategy_id
        INNER JOIN Strategy_New sn ON sn.SubStrategy_Id = sslist.substrategyid
    WHERE (di.Parameter = 'MultiEMS' OR di.Parameter = 'MultiExchange' OR di.Parameter = 'EMSEMBServerType')
        AND sn.Strategy_Status = 1;
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetEMSTradedLocation

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetEMSTradedLocation
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @emsLocList table(emsApplicationId int, LocationCode varchar(10))
  
    INSERT INTO @emsLocList
    SELECT distinct ea2.ApplicationID, es.LocationCode
    FROM dbo.Strategy_New sn
    JOIN dbo.EsteeApplications ea ON sn.SubStrategy_Id=ea.SubStrategy_ID AND sn.Strategy_Status=1
    JOIN dbo.EsteeApplications ea2 ON ea2.ApplicationID=ea.EMS_Application_ID
    JOIN dbo.EsteeServers es ON ea2.EsteeServer_ID=es.ID
    union
    SELECT distinct ea3.ApplicationID, es.LocationCode
    FROM datainit di
    JOIN dbo.EsteeApplications ea2 ON di.[Parameter]='RemoteEMS' AND di.[Value] LIKE '%' + cast(ea2.ApplicationID AS varchar(10)) +'%' AND ea2.ApplicationID<>0
    JOIN dbo.EsteeApplications ea ON di.substrategy_id = ea.SubStrategy_ID
    JOIN dbo.Strategy_New sn ON sn.SubStrategy_Id=ea.SubStrategy_ID AND sn.Strategy_Status=1
    JOIN dbo.EsteeApplications ea3 ON ea3.ApplicationID=ea.EMS_Application_ID
    JOIN dbo.EsteeServers es ON ea3.EsteeServer_ID=es.ID
    UNION
    SELECT distinct ea3.ApplicationID, es.LocationCode
    FROM datainit di
    JOIN dbo.EsteeApplications ea2 ON di.[Parameter]='MultiEMS' AND di.[Value] LIKE '%' + cast(ea2.ApplicationID AS varchar(10)) +'%' AND ea2.ApplicationID<>0
    JOIN dbo.EsteeApplications ea ON di.substrategy_id = ea.SubStrategy_ID
    JOIN dbo.Strategy_New sn ON sn.SubStrategy_Id=ea.SubStrategy_ID AND sn.Strategy_Status=1
    JOIN dbo.EsteeApplications ea3 ON ea3.ApplicationID=ea.EMS_Application_ID
    JOIN dbo.EsteeServers es ON ea3.EsteeServer_ID=es.ID

    SELECT * FROM @emsLocList

END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetEODPhysicalMargin

```sql

--Create a stored procedure to fetch EODPhysicalMargin
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.spGetEODPhysicalMargin
    @tradeDate DATE,
    @accountIds VARCHAR(500),
    @strategyIds VARCHAR(500)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @Acc TABLE (AccountId INT)
    INSERT INTO @Acc
    SELECT RTRIM(LTRIM(r.items)) 
    FROM dbo.split(@accountIds, ',') r
    WHERE ISNUMERIC(RTRIM(LTRIM(r.items))) = 1

    DECLARE @strategies TABLE (strategy INT)
    INSERT INTO @strategies
    SELECT RTRIM(LTRIM(r.items)) 
    FROM dbo.split(@strategyIds, ',') r
    WHERE ISNUMERIC(RTRIM(LTRIM(r.items))) = 1

    -- Fetch the latest entry for each SSID-AccountID combo on the given tradeDate
    SELECT
        epm.tradeDate,
        epm.SSID,
        epm.accountID,
        epm.physicalMargin * 10000.0 as 'physicalMargin',
        epm.updateDateTime
    FROM
        dbo.EODPhysicalMargin epm
    WHERE
        epm.tradeDate = @tradeDate
        AND epm.SSID IN (SELECT strategy FROM @strategies)
        AND epm.accountID IN (SELECT AccountId FROM @Acc)
    ORDER BY
        epm.SSID, epm.accountID;
END



```

```sql
 CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.spGetEsteeETIStructure  
  
  @exchange        VARCHAR(10),  
  
  @exchangeSegment VARCHAR(10),  
  
  @exSegment VARCHAR(10)=null  
  
AS  
  
 BEGIN  
  
 IF @exSegment != null  
  
 BEGIN  
  
  set @exchangeSegment = @exSegment  
  
 END  
  
  
  
 IF @exchangeSegment = 'XX'  
  
 BEGIN  
  
 SELECT em.Estee_id AS EsteeId, em.Lot_Size AS LotSize, et.marketSegmentID AS MarketSegmentId, 
 et.PartitionID AS PartitionId, et.securityID AS SecurityId, et.simpleSecurityID AS SimpleSecurityId, 
 ci.ContractId as ContractID, et.isCASEnabled , et.IsEligibleForPreOpen 
  
 FROM   esteemaster AS em(NOLOCK)  
  
INNER JOIN BSEETIStructure AS et ON et.Estee_ID = em.Estee_ID  
  
INNER JOIN ValidCombos AS vc(NOLOCK) ON vc.SecurityType = em.Security_Type  
  
inner join  CONTRACTIDS ci (nolock) on ci.EsteeId = et.Estee_ID  
  
 WHERE  vc.ExchangeCode = @exchange  
  
AND em.Exchange_Code = @exchange;  
  
 END;  
  
 ELSE  
  
 BEGIN  
  
 SELECT em.Estee_id AS EsteeId, em.Lot_Size AS LotSize, et.marketSegmentID AS MarketSegmentId, 
 et.PartitionID AS PartitionId, et.securityID AS SecurityId, et.simpleSecurityID AS SimpleSecurityId, 
 ci.ContractId as ContractID, et.isCASEnabled , et.IsEligibleForPreOpen 
  
 FROM   esteemaster AS em(NOLOCK)  
  
INNER JOIN BSEETIStructure AS et ON et.Estee_ID = em.Estee_ID  
  
INNER JOIN ValidCombos AS vc(NOLOCK) ON vc.SecurityType = em.Security_Type  
  
inner join  CONTRACTIDS ci (nolock) on ci.EsteeId = et.Estee_ID  
  
 WHERE  vc.ExchangeCode = @exchange  
  
AND em.Exchange_Code = @exchange  
  
AND vc.Segment = @exchangeSegment;  
  
 END;  
  
 END;
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetEsteeIdByDate

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetEsteeIdByDate 
@Date         DATETIME, 
@ExchangeCode VARCHAR(2), 
@SecurityType INT, 
@Symbol       VARCHAR(50)
AS
BEGIN

     DECLARE @prevDate DATETIME;
     SET @prevDate = DATEADD(DD, DATEDIFF(Dy, 0, @Date), -1);

	 DECLARE @t TABLE
     (
     EsteeId varchar(100)
     );

      INSERT INTO @t
          SELECT DISTINCT 
                 Estee_ID
          FROM dbo.esteemaster AS E
          WHERE E.Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode
                AND E.Security_Type = @SecurityType
                AND E.Underlying_Ticker = @Symbol
                AND e.status = 1;

          INSERT INTO @t
          SELECT DISTINCT 
                 Estee_ID
          FROM dbo.EsteeMaster_archive AS EMA
          WHERE ema.Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode
                AND ema.Security_Type = @SecurityType
                AND EMA.Underlying_Ticker = @Symbol
                AND ISNULL(ema.Last_update_time, @prevDate) >= @prevDate
                AND ema.Status = 1
                AND EMA.Estee_ID NOT IN ( SELECT EsteeId
                                          FROM @t );
SELECT TOP 1* FROM @t
END;

```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.spGetEsteeIdComponentsArchive
@ExCode  VARCHAR(2),

@EsteeId varchar(50),
@ExpiryDate date,
@ExpiryDate2 date

AS
BEGIN
if(@EsteeId != null OR @EsteeId != '')
Begin
declare @expDate date
select @expDate = Expiry_Date from EsteeMaster_archive where Estee_ID = @EsteeId and status = 1
select Estee_ID,ISIN,Expiry_Date,Strike_Price,Expiry_Date2,UnderlyingEstee_Id from EsteeMaster_archive (nolock) where Status = 1 and Security_Type = @SecType and Exchange_Code = @ExCode and Expiry_Date = @expDate
UNION
select Estee_ID,ISIN,Expiry_Date,Strike_Price,Expiry_Date2,UnderlyingEstee_Id from EsteeMaster_archive_archive (nolock) where Status = 1 and Security_Type = @SecType and Exchange_Code = @ExCode and Expiry_Date = @expDate
End
else
Begin
declare @EsteeComp Table(Estee_ID varchar(50),ISIN varchar(20), Expiry_Date date, Strike_Price decimal(20,6), Expiry_Date2 date,UnderlyingEstee_Id varchar(50))
insert into @EsteeComp
select Estee_ID,ISIN,Expiry_Date,Strike_Price,Expiry_Date2,UnderlyingEstee_Id from EsteeMaster_archive (nolock) where Status = 1 and Security_Type = @SecType and Exchange_Code = @ExCode and UnderlyingEstee_Id is not null and UnderlyingEstee_Id <> '' and Expiry_Date = @ExpiryDate and @ExpiryDate != '0001-01-01'
UNION
select Estee_ID,ISIN,Expiry_Date,Strike_Price,Expiry_Date2,UnderlyingEstee_Id from EsteeMaster_archive_archive (nolock) where Status = 1 and Security_Type = @SecType and Exchange_Code = @ExCode and UnderlyingEstee_Id is not null and UnderlyingEstee_Id <> '' and Expiry_Date = @ExpiryDate and @ExpiryDate != '0001-01-01'
insert into @EsteeComp
select Estee_ID,ISIN,Expiry_Date,Strike_Price,Expiry_Date2,UnderlyingEstee_Id from EsteeMaster_archive (nolock) where Status = 1 and Security_Type = @SecType and Exchange_Code = @ExCode and UnderlyingEstee_Id is not null and UnderlyingEstee_Id <> '' and Expiry_Date2 = @ExpiryDate2 and @ExpiryDate2 != '0001-01-01'
UNION
select Estee_ID,ISIN,Expiry_Date,Strike_Price,Expiry_Date2,UnderlyingEstee_Id from EsteeMaster_archive_archive (nolock) where Status = 1 and Security_Type = @SecType and Exchange_Code = @ExCode and UnderlyingEstee_Id is not null and UnderlyingEstee_Id <> '' and Expiry_Date2 = @ExpiryDate2 and @ExpiryDate2 != '0001-01-01'
select distinct * from @EsteeComp
End
```

```sql
create PROCEDURE spGetEsteeIdsFromSubscriptionRealtime
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetEsteeIDToExternalTickerMap  
 @DataSource varchar(20),    
 @ExchangeCodes varchar(20) = ''    
 AS    
 BEGIN     
 SET NOCOUNT ON;    
   
 DECLARE @ExchangeCode TABLE(Exchange_Code [char](50))   
 INSERT into @ExchangeCode SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) from dbo.split(@ExchangeCodes,',')   
   
 IF @ExchangeCodes = ''    
  BEGIN    
    select EsteeID,ExternalTicker,ExternalTickerType,ContractMultiplier from EsteeIdToExternalTickersMap where SourceType = @DataSource   
  END    
 ELSE    
  BEGIN

 and substring(EsteeID,13,2) in ( select Exchange_Code from @ExchangeCode)  
  END    
 END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].spGetEsteeMasterArchiveRecordForToken

	@Exchange varchar(max),

	@ExchangeSegment varchar(max),

	@Token varchar(max)

AS                            

  

BEGIN       

 SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;



 if(@Exchange = 'IS' or @Exchange = 'IB')

 begin

	select * from EsteeMaster_archive em

	inner join ValidCombos vc on vc.ExchangeCode = em.Exchange_Code and vc.SecurityType = em.Security_Type

	where vc.ExchangeCode = @Exchange and vc.Segment = @ExchangeSegment and vc.IsTraded = 1 and Token = @Token and em.Security_Type not in (8,9,14)
	AND em.Status = 1

 end

 else

 begin

	select * from EsteeMaster_archive em

	inner join ValidCombos vc on vc.ExchangeCode = em.Exchange_Code and vc.SecurityType = em.Security_Type

	where vc.ExchangeCode = @Exchange and vc.Segment = @ExchangeSegment and vc.IsTraded = 1 and Token = @Token
	AND em.Status = 1

 end

 

END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetEsteeMasterForEMS

```sql

Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetEsteeMasterForEMS] @emsApplicationId INT
	,@isLoadAllContracts INT = 0
	,@underlyingEsteeID VARCHAR(max) = NULL
	,@MaxExpiryDate DATE = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	IF (@underlyingEsteeID LIKE '%subscriptionlist%')
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @UnderlyingEsteeIdsTemp VARCHAR(max)

		SELECT @UnderlyingEsteeIdsTemp = COALESCE(@UnderlyingEsteeIdsTemp + ',', '') + e.UnderlyingEstee_Id

		FROM subscriptionlist s
		INNER JOIN dbo.Split(@UnderlyingEsteeId, ',') r ON cast(s.SubStrategyID AS VARCHAR) = r.items
		INNER JOIN esteemaster e ON e.Estee_ID = s.Estee_Id

		SET @UnderlyingEsteeId = @UnderlyingEsteeIdsTemp
	END

	DECLARE @exchange VARCHAR(20)
	DECLARE @XXSeg VARCHAR(20)

	SELECT ExSeg
	INTO #exchangeSegment
	FROM vwadapterconfig
	WHERE emsApplicationID = @emsApplicationId

	SET @XXSeg = (
			SELECT TOP 1 ExSeg
			FROM #exchangeSegment
			)

	SELECT @exchange = ExCode
	FROM vwadapterconfig
	WHERE emsApplicationID = @emsApplicationId

	IF (
			(@XXSeg = 'XX')
			OR (@XXSeg IS NULL)
			)
	BEGIN
		SET @XXSeg = 'CM,FO,CD,CO'
	END

	IF (
			@exchange = 'CG'
			OR @exchange = 'NM'
			OR @exchange = 'CX'
			OR @exchange = 'CO'
			)
	BEGIN
		SET @exchange = 'CG,NM,CX,CO'
	END

	DECLARE @acc TABLE (AId INT)

	INSERT INTO @acc
	SELECT accountID
	FROM StrategyBrokerAccount
	WHERE subStrategyID IN (
			SELECT ssid
			FROM vwssconfig
			WHERE EMSId = @emsApplicationId
				AND STATUS = 1
			)

	IF NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM @acc t
			WHERE t.AId = 609
			)
	BEGIN
		IF @underlyingEsteeID IS NULL
			OR @underlyingEsteeID = ''
		BEGIN
			IF @isLoadAllContracts = 0
			BEGIN
				SELECT DISTINCT em.Estee_ID AS esteeid
					,0 AS MDSource /* setting market data source as 0*/
				FROM esteemaster em
				INNER JOIN ValidCombos vc ON vc.SecurityType = em.Security_Type
				WHERE em.Exchange_Code IN (
						SELECT items
						FROM dbo.Split(@exchange, ',')
						)
					AND vc.ExchangeCode IN (
						SELECT items
						FROM dbo.Split(@exchange, ',')
						)
					AND (
						vc.Segment IN (
							SELECT items
							FROM dbo.Split(@XXSeg, ',')
							)
						OR vc.Segment IN (
							SELECT ExSeg
							FROM #exchangeSegment
							)
						)
					AND vc.IsTraded = 1
					AND (
						(
							em.Exchange_Code = 'IS'
							AND (
								em.Series <> 'BE'
								OR em.Series IS NULL
								)
							)
						OR em.Exchange_Code <> 'IS'
						)
					AND vc.SecurityType NOT IN (
						SELECT TypeCode
						FROM SecurityType
						WHERE GroupID = 6
						)
			
				INTERSECT
			
				SELECT *

					SELECT DISTINCT esteeid AS esteeid
						,0 AS MDSource /* MD Data Source */
					FROM subscription_realtime

					UNION
				
					SELECT DISTINCT esteeid AS esteeid
						,0 AS MDSource /* MD Data Source */
					FROM subscription_realtime
					WHERE Strategy_Name = 'OptionsContracts'
						AND esteeid LIKE '%IS06%'
						OR esteeid LIKE '%IS07%'
						OR esteeid LIKE '%IS12%'
						OR esteeid LIKE '%IS13%'
					) x
			END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetEsteeMasterForExchangeAndSecurity

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetEsteeMasterForExchangeAndSecurity
@exchanges varchar(max),
@security_type varchar(max) = NULL
 
AS

BEGIN
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;


if @security_type is null
begin
	SELECT DISTINCT EM.ESTEE_ID, ETM.EXTERNALTICKER, EM.DataFeed_Ticker FROM ESTEEMASTER AS EM
					INNER JOIN ESTEEIDTOEXTERNALTICKERSMAP AS ETM
					ON EM.ESTEE_ID = ETM.ESTEEID WHERE EXCHANGE_CODE IN (@exchanges)
end

else
begin
	SELECT DISTINCT EM.ESTEE_ID, ETM.EXTERNALTICKER, EM.DataFeed_Ticker FROM ESTEEMASTER AS EM
					INNER JOIN ESTEEIDTOEXTERNALTICKERSMAP AS ETM
					ON EM.ESTEE_ID = ETM.ESTEEID WHERE EXCHANGE_CODE IN (@exchanges)
					AND SECURITY_TYPE IN (SELECT items from dbo.split(@security_type,','))
end



END
grant execute on [dbo].spGetEsteeMasterForExchangeAndSecurity to db_execsp
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetEsteeMasterFromEsteeids

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetEsteeMasterFromEsteeids @lstEsteeID VARCHAR(MAX) = ''
AS
     BEGIN
         DECLARE @EsteeID TABLE(estee_ID [CHAR](50));

         IF(@lstEsteeID != '')
         BEGIN
             INSERT INTO @EsteeID
                    SELECT *
                      FROM dbo.split(@lstEsteeID, ',');
         END;

         DECLARE @t TABLE
         (Estee_ID          VARCHAR(50),
          Underlying_Ticker VARCHAR(50),
          DataFeed_Ticker   VARCHAR(50),
          lot_size          INT,
          Security_Type     INT,
          Strike_Price      DECIMAL(18, 2),
          Expiry_Date       DATETIME,
          Expiry_Date2      VARCHAR(50)
         );

         INSERT INTO @t
                SELECT em.Estee_ID, em.Underlying_Ticker, em.DataFeed_Ticker, em.lot_size, em.Security_Type, em.Strike_Price, em.Expiry_Date, em.Expiry_Date2
                  FROM esteemaster em
                  INNER JOIN @EsteeId e ON em.Estee_ID = e.estee_ID;

         DECLARE @EsteeIDNotFound TABLE(estee_ID [CHAR](50));

         INSERT INTO @EsteeIDNotFound
                SELECT e.estee_id
                  FROM @t t
                  RIGHT JOIN @EsteeID e ON t.Estee_ID = e.estee_ID
                 WHERE t.estee_id IS NULL;

         IF EXISTS
           (
               SELECT 1
                 FROM @EsteeIDNotFound
           )
         BEGIN
             INSERT INTO @t
                    SELECT em.Estee_ID, em.Underlying_Ticker, em.DataFeed_Ticker, em.lot_size, em.Security_Type, em.Strike_Price, em.Expiry_Date, em.Expiry_Date2
                      FROM esteemaster_archive em
                      INNER JOIN @EsteeIDNotFound e ON em.Estee_ID = e.estee_ID
                                                       AND em.status = 1;
         END;

         SELECT *
           FROM @t;

     END;
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetEsteeMasterRecordForToken

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].spGetEsteeMasterRecordForToken

	@Exchange varchar(2),  

 @ExchangeSegment varchar(2),  

 @Token varchar(50) = null

AS                            

  

BEGIN       

 SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;



 if(@Exchange = 'IS' or @Exchange = 'IB')  

 begin  

	 if @Token is null

	 begin

		 select em.Estee_ID, em.Security_Type, em.Token from esteemaster em  

		 inner join ValidCombos vc on vc.ExchangeCode = em.Exchange_Code and vc.SecurityType = em.Security_Type  

		 where vc.ExchangeCode = @Exchange and vc.Segment = @ExchangeSegment and vc.IsTraded = 1 and em.Security_Type not in (8,9,14,37)

	 end

	else 

	 begin

		 select em.Estee_ID, em.Security_Type, em.Token from esteemaster em  

		 inner join ValidCombos vc on vc.ExchangeCode = em.Exchange_Code and vc.SecurityType = em.Security_Type  

		 where vc.ExchangeCode = @Exchange and vc.Segment = @ExchangeSegment and vc.IsTraded = 1 and Token = @Token and em.Security_Type not in (8,9,14,37)  

	 end

 end  

 else  

 begin   

	 if @Token is null

	 begin

		select em.Estee_ID, em.Security_Type, em.Token from esteemaster em  

		inner join ValidCombos vc on vc.ExchangeCode = em.Exchange_Code and vc.SecurityType = em.Security_Type  

		where vc.ExchangeCode = @Exchange and vc.Segment = @ExchangeSegment and vc.IsTraded = 1

	 end

	else

	 begin

		 select em.Estee_ID, em.Security_Type, em.Token from esteemaster em  

		 inner join ValidCombos vc on vc.ExchangeCode = em.Exchange_Code and vc.SecurityType = em.Security_Type  

		 where vc.ExchangeCode = @Exchange and vc.Segment = @ExchangeSegment and vc.IsTraded = 1 and Token = @Token  

	 end

 end  

 

END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetEsteeMasterSubscriptionRealTime

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetEsteeMasterSubscriptionRealTime   
@strategyName varchar(max) = NULL,  
@channelid varchar(max) = NULL  
AS   
BEGIN   
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;   
  
DECLARE @ChannelIdTable TABLE(        
 channelId int  
);   
    
INSERT INTO @ChannelIdTable    
 SELECT * FROM dbo.split(@channelid, ',')      
  
select distinct e.datafeed_ticker, ee.ExternalTicker, i.channelid , e.Estee_ID, ISNULL(m.Factor, 1) PriceMultiplier ,   
ISNULL(m.Factor, 1) * ee.ContractMultiplier QuantityMultiplier, e.SERIES   
from esteemaster e   
inner join EsteeIdToExternalTickersMap ee on (e.Estee_ID = ee.EsteeID and ee.SourceType = 'Exchange')   
inner join BzlISINChannelMapping i on (SUBSTRING(e.estee_id, 0, 17) = i.ISIN_SecurityType)   
inner join (select distinct EsteeId,strategy_name from subscription_realtime) sr  
      on sr.EsteeID = e.Estee_ID
left join EsteeMultiplierFactor m on (e.ISIN = m.ISIN)
inner join @ChannelIdTable cid on ((i.channelid = cid.channelId) )--or @channelid = 0)  
where ((@strategyName <> '' and sr.Strategy_Name in (Select items From dbo.Split(@strategyName, ','))) or (@strategyName = ''))
order by e.Estee_ID  
end 
```

```sql
AS    
BEGIN    
 SET NOCOUNT ON;    
    
 -- Check if isCASEnabled column exists in BSEETIStructure for backward compatibility  
 DECLARE @hasIsCASEnabled BIT = 0;  
 IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('dbo.BSEETIStructure') AND name = 'isCASEnabled')  
  SET @hasIsCASEnabled = 1;  
    
 DECLARE @SegmentTable TABLE (Segment VARCHAR(10));    
    
 IF @segments = 'XX'    
  OR @exchangeCode = 'BI'    
  OR @segments = ''    
 BEGIN    
  INSERT INTO @SegmentTable    
  VALUES ('CM')    
    
  INSERT INTO @SegmentTable    
  VALUES ('CD')    
    
  INSERT INTO @SegmentTable    
  VALUES ('FO')    
    
  INSERT INTO @SegmentTable    
  VALUES ('CO')    
 END    
 ELSE    
 BEGIN    
  INSERT INTO @SegmentTable    
  SELECT *    
  FROM dbo.split(@segments, ',')    
 END    
    
 IF @querySubscriptionRealtime = 'false'    
 BEGIN --get esteemaster        
  IF @securityTypes = '' -- complete esteemaster        
  BEGIN    
   SELECT E.ESTEE_ID    
    ,CASE     
     WHEN @exchangeCode = 'BI' OR @exchangeCode = 'MX'  
      THEN 'XX'    
     WHEN VC.Segment = 'FO'    
      THEN 'CM'    
     ELSE VC.Segment    
     END    
    ,CASE     
     WHEN VC.Segment = 'FO'    
      THEN 1    
     ELSE BES.streamID    
     END    
    ,BES.PartitionID    
    ,BES.marketSegmentID    
    ,CASE     
     WHEN BES.securityID = 0    
      THEN BES.simpleSecurityID    
     ELSE BES.securityID    
     END simpleSecurityID    
    ,E.Lot_Size    
     ,CASE WHEN @hasIsCASEnabled = 1 THEN BES.isCASEnabled ELSE 0 END AS isCASEnabled    
   FROM VALIDCOMBOS(NOLOCK) AS VC    
   INNER JOIN ESTEEMASTER(NOLOCK) AS E ON E.EXCHANGE_CODE = VC.EXCHANGECODE    
   INNER JOIN BSEETIStructure(NOLOCK) AS BES ON BES.Estee_ID = E.Estee_ID    
    AND E.EXCHANGE_CODE = @exchangeCode    
    AND E.SECURITY_TYPE = VC.SECURITYTYPE    
    AND E.TOKEN > 0    
    AND E.Estee_Id IS NOT NULL    
    AND VC.Segment IN (    
     SELECT *    
     FROM @SegmentTable    
     )    
  END;    
  ELSE --filtered esteemaster        
  BEGIN    
   SELECT E.ESTEE_ID    
    ,CASE     
     WHEN @exchangeCode = 'BI'   OR @exchangeCode = 'MX'  
      THEN 'XX'    
     WHEN VC.Segment = 'FO'    
      THEN 'CM'    
     ELSE VC.Segment    
     END    
    ,BES.streamID    
    ,BES.PartitionID    
    ,BES.marketSegmentID    
    ,CASE     
     WHEN BES.securityID = 0    
      THEN BES.simpleSecurityID    
     ELSE BES.securityID    
     END simpleSecurityID    
    ,E.Lot_Size    
    ,CASE WHEN @hasIsCASEnabled = 1 THEN BES.isCASEnabled ELSE 0 END AS isCASEnabled    
   FROM VALIDCOMBOS(NOLOCK) AS VC    
   INNER JOIN ESTEEMASTER(NOLOCK) AS E ON E.EXCHANGE_CODE = VC.EXCHANGECODE    
   INNER JOIN BSEETIStructure(NOLOCK) AS BES ON BES.Estee_ID = E.Estee_ID    
    AND E.EXCHANGE_CODE = @exchangeCode    
    AND E.SECURITY_TYPE = VC.SECURITYTYPE    
    AND E.TOKEN > 0    
    AND E.Estee_Id IS NOT NULL    
    AND VC.Segment IN (    
     SELECT *    
     FROM @SegmentTable    
     )    
    AND E.Security_Type IN (    
     SELECT *    
     FROM dbo.split(@securityTypes, ',')    
     )    
  END;;    
 END    
 ELSE    
 BEGIN    
  IF @subscriptionName <> ''    
  BEGIN --get subscription realtime        
   IF @securityTypes <> '' -- complete subscription realtime        
   BEGIN    
    SELECT DISTINCT e.ESTEE_ID    
     ,CASE     
      WHEN @exchangeCode = 'BI'    OR @exchangeCode = 'MX'  
       THEN 'XX'    
      WHEN VC.Segment = 'FO'    
       THEN 'CM'    
      ELSE VC.Segment    
      END    
     ,CASE     
      WHEN VC.Segment = 'FO'    
  THEN 1    
      ELSE BES.streamID    
      END    
     ,BES.PartitionID    
     ,BES.marketSegmentID    
     ,CASE     
      WHEN BES.securityID = 0    
       THEN BES.simpleSecurityID    
      ELSE BES.securityID    
      END simpleSecurityID    
     ,E.Lot_Size    
     ,CASE WHEN @hasIsCASEnabled = 1 THEN BES.isCASEnabled ELSE 0 END AS isCASEnabled    
    FROM SUBSCRIPTION_REALTIME AS sr    
    INNER JOIN ESTEEMASTER AS e ON e.ESTEE_ID = sr.ESTEEID    
    INNER JOIN BSEETIStructure AS BES ON BES.Estee_ID = e.ESTEE_ID    
    INNER JOIN ValidCombos AS VC ON vc.ExchangeCode = e.Exchange_Code    
     AND e.EXCHANGE_CODE = @exchangeCode    
     AND sr.STRATEGY_NAME = @subscriptionName    
     AND e.Security_Type = VC.SecurityType    
     AND E.TOKEN > 0    
     AND E.Estee_Id IS NOT NULL    
     AND VC.Segment IN (    
      SELECT *    
      FROM @SegmentTable    
      )    
     AND E.Security_Type IN (    
      SELECT *    
      FROM dbo.split(@securityTypes, ',')    
      )    
   END;    
   ELSE    
   BEGIN    
    -- when segment is FO return stream id 1 by default as equity and equity derivatives come on same ip in BSE        
    SELECT DISTINCT e.ESTEE_ID    
     ,CASE     
      WHEN @exchangeCode = 'BI'    OR @exchangeCode = 'MX'  
       THEN 'XX'    
      WHEN VC.Segment = 'FO'    
       THEN 'CM'    
      ELSE VC.Segment    
      END    
     ,CASE     
      WHEN VC.Segment = 'FO'    
       THEN 1    
      ELSE BES.streamID    
      END    
     ,BES.PartitionID    
     ,BES.marketSegmentID    
     ,CASE     
      WHEN BES.securityID = 0    
       THEN BES.simpleSecurityID    
      ELSE BES.securityID    
      END simpleSecurityID    
     ,E.Lot_Size    
     ,CASE WHEN @hasIsCASEnabled = 1 THEN BES.isCASEnabled ELSE 0 END AS isCASEnabled    
    FROM SUBSCRIPTION_REALTIME AS sr    
    INNER JOIN ESTEEMASTER AS e ON e.ESTEE_ID = sr.ESTEEID    
    INNER JOIN BSEETIStructure AS BES ON BES.Estee_ID = e.ESTEE_ID    
    INNER JOIN ValidCombos AS VC ON vc.ExchangeCode = e.Exchange_Code    
     AND e.EXCHANGE_CODE = @exchangeCode    
     AND sr.STRATEGY_NAME = @subscriptionName    
     AND e.SECURITY_TYPE = VC.SECURITYTYPE    
     AND E.TOKEN > 0    
     AND E.Estee_Id IS NOT NULL    
     AND VC.Segment IN (    
      SELECT *    
      FROM @SegmentTable    
      )    
   END;    
  END;    
  ELSE    
  BEGIN    
   IF @securityTypes <> ''    
   BEGIN    
    -- when segment is FO return stream id 1 by default as equity and equity derivatives come on same ip in BSE        
    SELECT DISTINCT e.ESTEE_ID    
     ,CASE     
      WHEN @exchangeCode = 'BI'   OR @exchangeCode = 'MX'   
       THEN 'XX'    
      WHEN VC.Segment = 'FO'    
       THEN 'CM'    
      ELSE VC.Segment    
      END    
     ,CASE     
      WHEN VC.Segment = 'FO'    
       THEN 1    
      ELSE BES.streamID    
      END    
     ,BES.PartitionID    
     ,BES.marketSegmentID    
     ,CASE     
      WHEN BES.securityID = 0    
       THEN BES.simpleSecurityID    
      ELSE BES.securityID    
      END simpleSecurityID    
     ,E.Lot_Size    
     ,CASE WHEN @hasIsCASEnabled = 1 THEN BES.isCASEnabled ELSE 0 END AS isCASEnabled    
    FROM SUBSCRIPTION_REALTIME AS sr    
    INNER JOIN ESTEEMASTER AS e ON e.ESTEE_ID = sr.ESTEEID    
    INNER JOIN BSEETIStructure AS BES ON BES.Estee_ID = e.ESTEE_ID    
    INNER JOIN ValidCombos AS VC ON vc.ExchangeCode = e.Exchange_Code    
     AND e.EXCHANGE_CODE = @exchangeCode    
     AND e.Security_Type = VC.SecurityType    
     AND E.TOKEN > 0    
     AND E.Estee_Id IS NOT NULL    
     AND VC.Segment IN (    
      SELECT *    
      FROM @SegmentTable    
      )    
     AND E.Security_Type IN (    
      SELECT *    
      FROM dbo.split(@securityTypes, ',')    
      )    
    WHERE sr.STRATEGY_NAME NOT IN (          
      'Strade_MRT_BSE','MCX_MRT'    
      )    
   END;    
   ELSE    
   BEGIN    
    -- when segment is FO return stream id 1 by default as equity and equity derivatives come on same ip in BSE        
    SELECT DISTINCT e.ESTEE_ID    
     ,CASE     
      WHEN @exchangeCode = 'BI'  OR @exchangeCode = 'MX'  
       THEN 'XX'    
      WHEN VC.Segment = 'FO'    
       THEN 'CM'    
      ELSE VC.Segment    
      END    
     ,CASE     
      WHEN VC.Segment = 'FO'    
       THEN 1    
      ELSE BES.streamID    
      END    
     ,BES.PartitionID    
     ,BES.marketSegmentID    
     ,CASE     
      WHEN BES.securityID = 0    
       THEN BES.simpleSecurityID    
      ELSE BES.securityID    
      END simpleSecurityID    
     ,E.Lot_Size    
     ,CASE WHEN @hasIsCASEnabled = 1 THEN BES.isCASEnabled ELSE 0 END AS isCASEnabled    
    FROM SUBSCRIPTION_REALTIME AS sr    
    INNER JOIN ESTEEMASTER AS e ON e.ESTEE_ID = sr.ESTEEID    
    INNER JOIN BSEETIStructure AS BES ON BES.Estee_ID = e.ESTEE_ID    
    INNER JOIN ValidCombos AS VC ON vc.ExchangeCode = e.Exchange_Code    
     AND e.EXCHANGE_CODE = @exchangeCode    
     AND e.SECURITY_TYPE = VC.SECURITYTYPE    
     AND E.TOKEN > 0    
     AND E.Estee_Id IS NOT NULL    
     AND VC.Segment IN (    
      SELECT *    
      FROM @SegmentTable    
      )    
    WHERE sr.STRATEGY_NAME NOT IN (          
      'Strade_MRT_BSE','MCX_MRT'    
      )    
   END;;    
  END;    
 END;    
END;
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.spGetEsteeMasterSubscriptionRealTimeMCX

	@exchangeCode              VARCHAR(2),

	@segments                  VARCHAR(32),

	@securityTypes             VARCHAR(32),

	@querySubscriptionRealtime VARCHAR(8),

	@subscriptionName          VARCHAR(32)

AS

	BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @SegmentTable TABLE(

		Segment VARCHAR(10)

	);

	IF @exchangeCode = 'MX' or @segments = ''

		BEGIN

			insert into @SegmentTable values('CO')

		END

	ELSE

		BEGIN

			insert into @SegmentTable

				SELECT * FROM dbo.split(@segments, ',')

		END

	IF @querySubscriptionRealtime = 'false'

		BEGIN --get esteemaster

			IF @securityTypes = '' -- complete esteemaster

				BEGIN

					SELECT E.ESTEE_ID, E.Lot_Size, E.Token

					FROM VALIDCOMBOS(nolock) AS VC

					INNER JOIN ESTEEMASTER(nolock) AS E ON E.EXCHANGE_CODE = VC.EXCHANGECODE

									AND E.EXCHANGE_CODE = @exchangeCode

									AND E.SECURITY_TYPE = VC.SECURITYTYPE

									AND E.TOKEN > 0

									AND E.Estee_Id IS NOT NULL

									AND VC.Segment in (select * from @SegmentTable)

				END;

			ELSE --filtered esteemaster

				BEGIN

					SELECT E.ESTEE_ID, E.Lot_Size, E.Token

					FROM VALIDCOMBOS(nolock) AS VC

					INNER JOIN ESTEEMASTER(nolock) AS E ON E.EXCHANGE_CODE = VC.EXCHANGECODE

						AND E.EXCHANGE_CODE = @exchangeCode

						AND E.SECURITY_TYPE = VC.SECURITYTYPE

						AND E.TOKEN > 0

						AND E.Estee_Id IS NOT NULL

						AND VC.Segment in (select * from @SegmentTable)

						AND E.Security_Type in (

							SELECT *

							FROM dbo.split(@securityTypes, ',')

						)

				END;

		END

	ELSE

		BEGIN

			IF @subscriptionName <> ''

				BEGIN --get subscription realtime

					IF @securityTypes <> '' -- complete subscription realtime

						BEGIN

						SELECT DISTINCT e.ESTEE_ID, E.Lot_Size, E.Token 

						FROM SUBSCRIPTION_REALTIME AS sr

							INNER JOIN ESTEEMASTER AS e ON e.ESTEE_ID = sr.ESTEEID

							INNER JOIN ValidCombos as VC on vc.ExchangeCode = e.Exchange_Code

							AND e.EXCHANGE_CODE = @exchangeCode

							AND sr.STRATEGY_NAME = @subscriptionName

							AND e.Security_Type = VC.SecurityType

							AND E.TOKEN > 0

							AND E.Estee_Id IS NOT NULL

							AND VC.Segment in (select * from @SegmentTable)

							AND E.Security_Type in (

								SELECT *

								FROM dbo.split(@securityTypes, ',')

							)

						END;

					ELSE

						BEGIN

							SELECT DISTINCT e.ESTEE_ID, E.Lot_Size, E.Token FROM SUBSCRIPTION_REALTIME AS sr

								INNER JOIN ESTEEMASTER AS e ON e.ESTEE_ID = sr.ESTEEID

								INNER JOIN ValidCombos as VC on vc.ExchangeCode = e.Exchange_Code

								AND e.EXCHANGE_CODE = @exchangeCode

								AND sr.STRATEGY_NAME = @subscriptionName

								AND e.SECURITY_TYPE = VC.SECURITYTYPE

								AND E.TOKEN > 0

								AND E.Estee_Id IS NOT NULL

								AND VC.Segment in (select * from @SegmentTable)

						END;

					END;

			ELSE

				BEGIN

					IF @securityTypes <> ''

						BEGIN

							SELECT DISTINCT e.ESTEE_ID, E.Lot_Size, E.Token FROM SUBSCRIPTION_REALTIME AS sr

								INNER JOIN ESTEEMASTER AS e ON e.ESTEE_ID = sr.ESTEEID

								INNER JOIN ValidCombos as VC on vc.ExchangeCode = e.Exchange_Code

								AND e.EXCHANGE_CODE = @exchangeCode

								AND e.Security_Type = VC.SecurityType

								AND E.TOKEN > 0

								AND E.Estee_Id IS NOT NULL

								AND VC.Segment in (select * from @SegmentTable)

								AND E.Security_Type in (

									SELECT *

									FROM dbo.split(@securityTypes, ',')

								)

						END;

					ELSE

						BEGIN

							SELECT DISTINCT e.ESTEE_ID, E.Lot_Size, E.Token FROM SUBSCRIPTION_REALTIME AS sr

							INNER JOIN ESTEEMASTER AS e ON e.ESTEE_ID = sr.ESTEEID

							INNER JOIN ValidCombos as VC on vc.ExchangeCode = e.Exchange_Code

							AND e.EXCHANGE_CODE = @exchangeCode

							AND e.SECURITY_TYPE = VC.SECURITYTYPE

							AND E.TOKEN > 0

							AND E.Estee_Id IS NOT NULL

							AND VC.Segment in (select * from @SegmentTable)

						END;

				END;

		END;

	END;
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetEsteeMasterSubscriptionRealTimeQed

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetEsteeMasterSubscriptionRealTimeQed]
@strategyName varchar(max) = NULL,
@exchangeCode varchar(max)=NULL  
AS
BEGIN 
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; 
  
IF @exchangeCode='LM'
    select i.ExchangeTicker, e.Estee_ID, e.Lot_Size as LotSize, cme.DisplayFactor, isnull(emf.EsteeFactor,0) EsteeFactor
    from esteemaster e
	inner join CMESecurityDefinition (nolock) cme on e.Token = cme.SecurityId 
    inner join subscription_realtime r on (e.Estee_ID = r.EsteeID and r.Strategy_Name = @strategyName)
    inner join isinmaster i on (e.ISIN = i.ISIN and  i.ExchangeCode = @exchangeCode)
	left join EsteeMultiplierFactor emf on e.ISIN = emf.ISIN and e.Exchange_Code = emf.ExchangeCode 
ELSE
    IF @exchangeCode <>''
        IF @strategyName <>''  
            select DISTINCT e.datafeed_ticker, e.Estee_ID, e.Lot_Size as LotSize, cme.DisplayFactor, isnull(emf.EsteeFactor,0) EsteeFactor
            from esteemaster e
			inner join CMESecurityDefinition (nolock) cme on e.Token = cme.SecurityId  
            inner join subscription_realtime r on (e.Estee_ID = r.EsteeID and r.Strategy_Name = @strategyName)
			left join EsteeMultiplierFactor emf on e.ISIN = emf.ISIN and e.Exchange_Code = emf.ExchangeCode 
            where e.exchange_code = @exchangeCode
        ELSE
            select DISTINCT e.datafeed_ticker, e.Estee_ID, e.Lot_Size as LotSize, cme.DisplayFactor, isnull(emf.EsteeFactor,0) EsteeFactor
            from esteemaster e
			inner join CMESecurityDefinition (nolock) cme on e.Token = cme.SecurityId  
            inner join subscription_realtime r on (e.Estee_ID = r.EsteeID)
			left join EsteeMultiplierFactor emf on e.ISIN = emf.ISIN and e.Exchange_Code = emf.ExchangeCode 
            where e.exchange_code = @exchangeCode
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetEsteeMasterValidationResult

```sql
Create procedure spGetEsteeMasterValidationResult 
 @tradeDate date,  
 @nextDate date,
 @exgCode varchar(2),
 @runType varchar(10)

As  
  
Begin  
  
-------------------------------------Validation 1 (check esteeids in positions table and esteemaster table) ------------------------------  
DECLARE @TempDailyPositions TABLE(Exchange_Code varchar(2), SecurityName nvarchar(75), Long bigint, Short bigint, TransactionCost decimal(20,4), Account_ID int, SecurityType nvarchar(30), Estee_ID nvarchar(50), Sub_StrategyID  varchar(5), Broker_ID int, PositionDate datetime, AverageTradedPrice decimal(20,4), BuyValue decimal(20,4), SellValue decimal(20,4), AverageHoldingPrice decimal(20,10))  
INSERT INTO @TempDailyPositions(Exchange_Code, SecurityName, Long, Short, TransactionCost, Account_ID, SecurityType, Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, PositionDate, AverageTradedPrice, BuyValue, SellValue, AverageHoldingPrice)  
exec GetAllPositionsForGivenDate @tradeDate,1,null, @exgCode  

select distinct dp.Estee_ID from @TempDailyPositions dp 
left join esteemaster (nolock) e on dp.Estee_ID = e.Estee_ID 
left join SecurityType st on dp.SecurityType = st.TypeName
left join EsteeMaster_archive EA ON EA.Estee_ID =  dp.Estee_ID  and EA.Status = 1  
where Long <> Short  and e.Estee_ID is null  and st.GroupID =4
and substring(ea.Estee_ID,0,15) not in (SELECT substring(CA.UnderlyingEsteeId,0,15) FROM [CorporateActionTable] CA  
	WHERE  EffectiveDate =(select case @runType when 'EOD' then @nextDate  else @tradeDate end)    
	AND  UnderlyingEsteeId IS NOT NULL   )
union
select distinct dp.Estee_ID from @TempDailyPositions dp 
left join esteemaster (nolock) e on dp.Estee_ID = e.Estee_ID 
left join SecurityType st on dp.SecurityType = st.TypeName
where Long <> Short  and e.Estee_ID is null  and st.GroupID <>4

-----------------------------------Validation 2 (Check duplicate token records) ---------------------------------------------------  
select Token, TOKEN2, Security_Type, count(*) cnt into #duplicateEsteeMasterTokens from esteemaster (nolock) where Exchange_Code = @exgCode and Token <> 0  
group by Token, TOKEN2, Security_Type  
having count(*) > 1  
  
select distinct Estee_ID from #duplicateEsteeMasterTokens d inner join esteemaster (nolock) e on d.Token = e.Token and d.TOKEN2 = e.TOKEN2 and d.Security_Type = e.Security_Type  
where e.Exchange_Code = @exgCode  
  
  
-----------------------------------Validation 3 (Check duplicate securityId records) ---------------------------------------------------  
select SecurityId, Security_Type, count(*) cnt into #duplicateEsteeMasterSecurityIds from esteemaster (nolock) where Exchange_Code = @exgCode and (SecurityId <> '' and SecurityId is not null)  
group by SecurityId, Security_Type  
having count(*) > 1  
  
select distinct Estee_ID from #duplicateEsteeMasterSecurityIds d inner join esteemaster (nolock) e on d.SecurityId = e.SecurityId and d.Security_Type = e.Security_Type  
where e.Exchange_Code = @exgCode  
  
  
drop table #duplicateEsteeMasterTokens  
drop table #duplicateEsteeMasterSecurityIds  
  
  
End  



```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetEsteeNDFStructure

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetEsteeNDFStructure   
AS                                      
BEGIN                   
  
 declare @tenorDate date  
 set @tenorDate = GETDATE()   
   
 select DataFeed_Ticker as Symbol, 'FX_SPOT' as SecurityType, SUBSTRING(DataFeed_Ticker, 0, charindex('/', DataFeed_Ticker,0)) as Currency, cast(GETDATE() as DATE) as ExpiryDate, Estee_ID as EsteeId, Null as Tenor, CONVERT(char(8), em.SettlementDate,112)  as SettlementDate from Esteemaster em              
 inner join SecurityType st on st.typeCode = em.security_type            
 inner join SecurityGroup sg on sg.id = st.GroupID        
 where em.Exchange_Code = 'FX' and sg.ID = 5 /*Spot*/     
 UNION          
 select DataFeed_Ticker as Symbol, 'FX_NDF' as SecurityType, SUBSTRING(DataFeed_Ticker, 0, charindex('/', DataFeed_Ticker,0)) as Currency, Expiry_Date as ExpiryDate, Estee_ID as EsteeId, t.TenorString as Tenor,  CONVERT(char(8), em.SettlementDate,112)  as SettlementDate from Esteemaster em           
 inner join SecurityType st on st.typeCode = em.security_type     
 inner join SecurityGroup sg on sg.id = st.GroupID          
 inner join tenordetails t on em.Estee_ID = t.EsteeId      
 where em.Exchange_Code = 'FX' and sg.ID = 3 /*Futures*/   
 and t.TradeDate = @tenorDate           
  
END
```

```sql
CREATE procedure spGetEsteeNSEStructureValidationResult
@exgCode varchar(5),
@source varchar(50)
As
Begin

select ns.Estee_ID, ns.Symbol from NSEEsteeStructure (nolock) ns left join esteemaster (nolock) e on ns.Estee_ID = e.Estee_ID
where substring(ns.Estee_Id,13,2) = @exgCode and ns.InstrumentName in ('FUTCOM','OPTIDX','OPTCUR','UNDSTK','OPTSTK','FUTCUR','FUTIDX','FUTSTK','0','FUTIRC')  and e.Estee_ID is null
and ns.Source = @source

select e.Estee_ID, e.Underlying_Ticker from Esteemaster (nolock) e left join NSEEsteeStructure (nolock) ns on e.Estee_ID = ns.Estee_ID
where e.Exchange_Code = @exgCode and e.Security_Type not in (4,10,19,35, 15,17) and e.Estee_ID != 'IN0000000000IS00' and ns.Estee_ID is null
and e.Source = @source

End
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetEsteeStructure

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetEsteeStructure

@exchange varchar(10),

@exchangeSegment varchar(10)

AS  

BEGIN

if(@exchangeSegment = 'FO')  

begin

 SELECT em.Estee_ID,em.Underlying_Ticker,em.Lot_Size,em.Token, ContractIds.contractId from esteemaster em

 inner join ValidCombos vc on vc.SecurityType = em.Security_Type

 inner join ContractIds on em.Estee_ID = ContractIds.EsteeId

 where em.Exchange_Code = @exchange and vc.ExchangeCode =  @exchange and LTRIM(RTRIM(vc.Segment)) in ('FO','CO')

end

else

begin

SELECT em.Estee_ID,em.Underlying_Ticker,em.Lot_Size,em.Token, ContractIds.contractId  from esteemaster em

 inner join ValidCombos vc on vc.SecurityType = em.Security_Type

 inner join ContractIds on em.Estee_ID = ContractIds.EsteeId

 where em.Exchange_Code = @exchange and vc.ExchangeCode =  @exchange and vc.Segment = @exchangeSegment

end

END



```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetEsteeTitanStructure

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].spGetEsteeTitanStructure
	@exchange varchar(10),
	@exchangeSegment varchar(10)
AS
BEGIN
 SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
 if(@exchangeSegment = 'XX')
	select distinct e.Estee_ID as EsteeId, e.Lot_Size as LotSize, cp.PartitionID as PartitionId , et.ExternalTicker as Token, POWER(10, et.PriceMultiplier) as DecimalLocator, ci.ContractId from esteemaster e
	INNER JOIN ValidCombos vc (nolock) on vc.SecurityType = e.Security_Type
	inner join  CONTRACTIDS ci (nolock) on ci.EsteeId = e.Estee_ID
	INNER JOIN EsteeIdToExternalTickersMap et on et.EsteeID = e.Estee_ID
	INNER JOIN ContractPartitionID cp on cp.ISIN = SUBSTRING(Estee_ID,1,12)
	where vc.ExchangeCode = @exchange and e.Exchange_Code = @exchange
	and vc.IsTraded = 1 and et.SourceType = 'Titan'
 else
 	select e.Estee_ID as EsteeId, e.Lot_Size as LotSize, cp.PartitionID as PartitionId , et.ExternalTicker as Token, POWER(10, et.PriceMultiplier) as DecimalLocator, ci.ContractId from esteemaster e
	INNER JOIN ValidCombos vc (nolock) on vc.SecurityType = e.Security_Type
	inner join  CONTRACTIDS ci (nolock) on ci.EsteeId = e.Estee_ID
	INNER JOIN EsteeIdToExternalTickersMap et on et.EsteeID = e.Estee_ID
	INNER JOIN ContractPartitionID cp on cp.ISIN = SUBSTRING(Estee_ID,1,12)
	where vc.ExchangeCode = @exchange and e.Exchange_Code = @exchange and vc.Segment = @exchangeSegment
	and vc.IsTraded = 1 and et.SourceType = 'Titan'
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetExchangeCodeAndExchangeSegmentsFromEmsId

```sql
Create Procedure spGetExchangeCodeAndExchangeSegmentsFromEmsId
@emsId int = -1
As
BEGIN
if(@emsId = -1)
	Begin
		select eal.emsApplicationID, r.items as ExchangeCode, exgSeg.items as ExchangeSegment from ExchangeAdapter ea inner join ExchangeAdapterLoginDetails eal
		on ea.ID = eal.exchangeAdapterID
		cross apply dbo.Split(ea.exchangecode,',') as r
		outer apply dbo.Split(ea.ExchangeSegment,',') as exgSeg
		order by r.items
	End
Else
	Begin
		select eal.emsApplicationID, r.items as ExchangeCode, exgSeg.items as ExchangeSegment from ExchangeAdapter ea inner join ExchangeAdapterLoginDetails eal
		on ea.ID = eal.exchangeAdapterID
		cross apply dbo.Split(ea.exchangecode,',') as r	
		outer apply dbo.Split(ea.ExchangeSegment,',') as exgSeg 
		where eal.emsApplicationID = @emsId
		order by r.items
	End
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetExchangeOrderIDToEsteeID

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spGetExchangeOrderIDToEsteeID]
@appID varchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
   SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED

   DECLARE @date as datetime
   SET @date = cast(convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 101) as datetime)

   DECLARE @tempOrderTrades TABLE(OrderTrade_ID int, Order_ID int, BrokerOrderTrade_ID varchar(50),Creation_Date date)
   Insert into @tempOrderTrades
   select OrderTrade_ID, Order_ID,BrokerOrderTrade_ID,Creation_Date from OrderTrades  WITH (NOLOCK)
   where Status not in ('Rejected','Executed','Cancelled','Halted','Inactive','Stopped')
   AND Creation_Date = @date

   --------------------------------------ExchangeOrderID to OrderID mapping for open orders-------------------------------------------
   SELECT distinct B.Exchange_Order_ID, B.Order_ID 
   FROM [Order] B WITH (NOLOCK)
   inner join  @tempOrderTrades A on B.Order_ID = A.Order_ID and B.Creation_Date = A.Creation_Date
   where (B.Exchange_Order_ID is not null OR B.Exchange_Order_ID <> '')  and B.Ems_ID = @appID

   -----------------------------Exchange Order ID to Sent Cancel order Trades----------------------------------------------------------
   ;WITH CancelOrders as
   (
    select OrderTrade_ID, Order_ID,BrokerOrderTrade_ID,Creation_Date from OrderTrades  WITH (NOLOCK)
    where Status = 'Sent Cancel' AND Creation_Date = @date
   )
   
   SELECT distinct B.Exchange_Order_ID, CancelOrders.OrderTrade_ID
   FROM [Order] B WITH (NOLOCK)
   inner join CancelOrders on B.Order_ID = CancelOrders.Order_ID and B.Creation_Date = CancelOrders.Creation_Date where B.Ems_ID = @appID
   
   -----------------------------------OrderTradeIds for IOC orders ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   SELECT distinct ots.OrderTrade_ID
   FROM [Order] o WITH (NOLOCK)
   inner join  OrderTrades ots on o.Order_ID = ots.Order_ID and o.Creation_Date = ots.Creation_Date
   where o.Creation_Date >= @date and ots.Status in ('Sent New','Accepted') and o.Order_Validity = 3 and o.Ems_ID = @appID
   option (maxdop 1)      

End

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetExecutedOrders

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetExecutedOrders]  
AS  
  
BEGIN  
   SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED  
      SELECT   
   B.Order_ID,  
   B.Order_Type,  
   B.Order_Validity,  
   B.Broker_ID,  
   B.Account_ID,  
   B.Broker_Order_ID,  
   B.Exchange_Order_ID,  
   A.Remarks,  
   B.Comb_Status,  
   A.New_Cancel_Modify,  
   B.Sub_Strategy_ID,  
   B.Order_Source_ID,  
   B.Underlying_Ticker ,  
   A.OrderTrade_ID,  
   A.Status,  
   A.islast,  
   A.Price_Diff,  
   A.Original_Order_ID,  
   A.Creation_Date,
   A.Creation_Time,  
   A.Created_By,  
   A.Update_Time,  
   A.Updated_By,  
   'ESTEE',  
   B.Link_ID,
   B.ems_id as EmsID
   from [Order] B
   inner join OrderTrades A with(nolock) on B.Creation_Date = A.Creation_Date and B.Order_ID = A.Order_ID
   WHERE   
   A.Creation_Date >= cast(CONVERT(char(12), GETDATE(), 1) as datetime)  
   AND A.Status  in ('Executed','Partially Filled')   
   Order by A.Update_Time Asc  
   SELECT ot.OrderTrade_ID,  
   t.TRADE_ID,  
   t.Estee_ID,  
   t.Buy_Sell_Indicator,  
   t.Order_Quantity,  
   t.Order_Price,   
   t.Traded_Quantity,  
   t.Traded_Price,  
   t.Stop_Price,  
   t.Transaction_Cost ,
   o.ems_id as EmsID 
   from [Order] o
   inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID
   inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID
   where ot.Status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and ot.Creation_Date >= cast(CONVERT(char(12), GETDATE()-1, 1) as datetime)  
   ORDER BY ot.Update_Time Asc  
   OPTION (MAXDOP 1)  
End

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetExecutedOrders_Paging

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spGetExecutedOrders_Paging]  
(  
 @PageNo int,  
 @RecordCount int,  
 @UpdateTime DATETIME Output  
)  
AS  
  
BEGIN  
 SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED  
 IF @UpdateTime is null SET @UpdateTime = DATEADD(d, 1, getdate())  
  
 SELECT * FROM  
 (  
  SELECT  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ot.update_Time DESC) AS Row,  
  o.Order_ID,  
  o.Order_Type,  
  o.Order_Validity,  
  o.Broker_ID,  
  o.Account_ID,  
  o.Broker_Order_ID,  
  o.Exchange_Order_ID,  
  ot.Remarks,  
  o.Comb_Status,  
  ot.New_Cancel_Modify,  
  o.Sub_Strategy_ID,  
  o.Order_Source_ID,  
  o.Underlying_Ticker ,  
  ot.OrderTrade_ID,  
  ot.Status,  
  ot.islast,  
  ot.Price_Diff,  
  ot.Original_Order_ID,  
  ot.Creation_Date,
  ot.Creation_Time,  
  ot.Created_By,  
  ot.Update_Time,  
  ot.Updated_By,  
  'ESTEE' as BROKER,  
  o.Link_ID,  
  t.TRADE_ID,  
  t.Estee_ID,  
  t.Buy_Sell_Indicator,  
  t.Order_Quantity,  
  t.Order_Price,   
  t.Traded_Quantity,  
  t.Traded_Price,  
  t.Stop_Price,  
  t.Transaction_Cost,
  o.ems_id as EmsID 
  from [Order] o
  inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID
  inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID
  where ot.Status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and o.Creation_Date >= cast(CONVERT(char(12), GETDATE(), 1) as datetime)  
  AND ot.update_Time < @UpdateTime 
 
 )  
as OrderData  
 WHERE  Row >= @PageNo*@RecordCount AND Row < (@PageNo+1)*@RecordCount  
 OPTION (MAXDOP 1)  
  
End

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetExecutedOrdersForMTM

```sql
--exec [spGetExecutedOrdersForMTM_Zero] '2014-7-31', '2014-08-21'  
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spGetExecutedOrdersForMTM]           
 @startDate datetime,          
 @endDate datetime          
AS          
  
BEGIN          
      
 select ot.Sub_Strategy_ID, o.Account_ID, sum(traded_quantity*traded_price*(2*buy_sell_indicator-3)) as NAE,          
 sum(transaction_cost) as TC, SUM(brokerage) brokerage,      
 estee_id,      
 SUM(traded_quantity*(3-2*buy_sell_indicator)) as TTQ       
 from [Order] o  
 inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID  
 inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID  
 where ot.Status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and o.Creation_Date >= @startDate and o.Creation_Date < @endDate   
 group by ot.Sub_Strategy_ID, o.Account_ID, estee_id  
   
      
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetExecutedOrdersForMTMoverloaded

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spGetExecutedOrdersForMTMoverloaded]  
 @startDate date,  
 @endDate date,  
 @securityType varchar(50)  
AS  
BEGIN  

	select ot.Sub_Strategy_ID, o.Account_ID,sum(traded_quantity*traded_price*(2*buy_sell_indicator-3)) as NAE,   
	t.Estee_ID  
	FROM  dbo.tblTrades AS t WITH (NOLOCK, INDEX(IX_tbltrades_ordertrade))  
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblOrderTrades AS ot WITH (NOLOCK) ON t.OrderTrade_ID = ot.OrderTrade_ID  
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblOrders AS o WITH (NOLOCK) ON o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID  
	INNER JOIN dbo.esteemaster AS em WITH (NOLOCK) ON em.Estee_ID = t.Estee_ID and   
	em.Security_Type in (select distinct CAST(items as int) as item from dbo.Split(@securityType,','))  
	where ot.Creation_Time > @startDate  
	and ot.creation_time < @endDate  
	and ot.Status in ('Executed','Partially Filled')  
	group by ot.Sub_Strategy_ID, o.Account_ID,t.Estee_ID  

END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetExpiringContracts

```sql
CREATE Proc [dbo].[spGetExpiringContracts] @numberOfDays int
AS    
BEGIN    


	declare @today date;
	set @today = GETDATE();

	-- get all commodity contracts across all exchanges that are expiring in next x days   
	select e.Underlying_Ticker 'Underlying Ticker', e.DataFeed_Ticker 'Datafeed Ticker'
	, s.TypeName 'Security Type', cast(e.Expiry_Date as DATE) 'Expiry Date'
	, x.name
	from esteemaster e with (nolock)
	inner join securitytype s with (nolock) on s.TypeCode = e.Security_Type
	inner join Exchange x with (nolock) on x.code = e.Exchange_Code
	where e.Exchange_Code in ('MX','NM','CO','CG')
	and e.Expiry_Date between @today and dateadd(d,@numberOfDays,@today)
	order by e.Expiry_Date asc

	--get all contracts that have delivery date in next 5 days
	select e.Underlying_Ticker 'Underlying Ticker', e.datafeed_ticker 'Datafeed Ticker' 
	, cast(DeliveryStartDate as date) 'Delivery Start Date'
	, cast(DeliveryEndDate as DATE) 'Delivery End Date'
	from CommodityMaster c with (nolock)
	inner join esteemaster e with (nolock) on e.Estee_ID = c.Estee_ID
	where DeliveryStartDate between @today and dateadd(d,@numberOfDays,@today)
	and e.Security_Type in (20,21)
	order by DeliveryStartDate asc, e.Expiry_Date asc

END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetExposureMarginTable

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetExposureMarginTable]  
@exchange char(2),  
@date date = NULL  
AS  
BEGIN  
SET NOCOUNT ON;   
SET ARITHABORT ON;  
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exchange WHERE code = @exchange)  
BEGIN  
  IF(@date is null)  
   BEGIN  
    SELECT @date = MAX(AsOfDate) FROM MarginTable WHERE Exchange_Code=@exchange   
   END  
DECLARE @month int, @year int, @asOfDate Date  
SELECT @month = MONTH(@date)  
SELECT @year = YEAR(@date)  
if EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM MarginTable m INNER JOIN esteemaster E on e.Estee_ID = m.Estee_id WHERE e.Exchange_Code=@exchange  
    AND MONTH(m.AsOfDate) = @month and YEAR(m.AsOfDate) = @year AND e.Status = 1)  
    Begin  
     set @asOfDate = @date   
    End  
IF @asOfDate IS NOT NULL  
  BEGIN  
   SELECT isnull(e.Underlying_Ticker, ea.Underlying_Ticker) Underlying_Ticker, m.Estee_id, m.ExposureMarginOptions, m.ExposureMarginFutures  
   FROM MarginTable m  
   left JOIN esteemaster e ON e.Estee_ID = m.Estee_id  
   left JOIN EsteeMaster_archive ea on ea.Estee_ID = m.Estee_id and ea.Status = 1  
   WHERE isnull(e.Exchange_Code, ea.Exchange_Code) = @exchange  
   AND m.AsOfDate = @asOfDate  
   AND isnull(e.status, ea.status) = 1  
   union  
   /* Add nse index components */  
   SELECT e.Underlying_Ticker, m.Estee_id, m.ExposureMarginOptions, m.ExposureMarginFutures  
   FROM MarginTable m  
   INNER JOIN esteemaster e on e.Estee_ID = m.Estee_id  
   WHERE e.Exchange_Code = @exchange  
   AND m.AsOfDate='0001-01-01'  
   AND e.status=1  
   AND (m.estee_id like '%' + @exchange + '04%' or   
   m.estee_id like'%' + @exchange + '10%' or   
   m.estee_id like'%' + @exchange + '35%' or   
   m.estee_id like'%' + @exchange + '19%')  
  END  
ELSE  
  BEGIN  
   SELECT e.Underlying_Ticker, m.Estee_id, m.ExposureMarginOptions, m.ExposureMarginFutures  
   FROM MarginTable m  
   INNER JOIN esteemaster e ON e.Estee_ID = m.Estee_id  
   WHERE e.Exchange_Code = @exchange  
   AND m.AsOfDate='0001-01-01'  
   AND e.status=1  
  END  
END  
ELSE  
BEGIN  
   RAISERROR('Invalid exchange code passed', 11, 1)  
END  
END





```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetExposureMarginTableTemp]  
 @exchange char(2)  
   
AS  
BEGIN  
  
 SET NOCOUNT ON;  
  
 if exists (select 1 from exchange where code = @exchange) begin  
  
  select m.Symbol, m.Estee_id, m.ExposureMarginOptions, m.ExposureMarginFutures   
  from MarginTableTemp m   
  inner join esteemaster e on e.Estee_ID = m.Estee_id  
  where e.Exchange_Code = @exchange  
  and e.status=1  
  
 end else begin  
   
  RAISERROR('Invalid exchange code passed', 11, 1)  
   
 end   
    
END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetExternalTickerConfig    
 @DataSource varchar(20),      
 @ExchangeCodes varchar(200) = ''      
 AS      
 BEGIN       
 SET NOCOUNT ON;      
     
 DECLARE @ExchangeCode TABLE(Exchange_Code [char](50))     
 INSERT into @ExchangeCode SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) from dbo.split(@ExchangeCodes,',')     
     
 IF @ExchangeCodes = ''      
  BEGIN      
  select m.EsteeUndTicker, m.ExchangeTicker, t.Ticker, t.SecondaryTicker, m.ExchangeCode, m.SecurityType, c.ContractCycle,    
  c.NumFutures, c.NumStrikes, c.StrikeInterval, c.MaxPollInterval, c.InstrumentType, m.ISIN, c.IsSpot,c.MakeEM,c.MakeCP,c.ExternalTickerType,   
  c.OptionStyle, c.PriceMultiplier, c.MakeCM, c.isOOF, isnull(t.YearCode,'') YearCode
  from ISINMaster m inner join ExternalContractTickers t on m.ISINMasterID = t.ISINMasterID    
  inner join ExternalContractConfig c on t.ContractConfigID = c.ID    
  where m.DataSource = @DataSource    
  END      
 ELSE      
  BEGIN      
  select m.EsteeUndTicker, m.ExchangeTicker, t.Ticker, t.SecondaryTicker, m.ExchangeCode, m.SecurityType, c.ContractCycle,    
  c.NumFutures, c.NumStrikes, c.StrikeInterval, c.MaxPollInterval, c.InstrumentType, m.ISIN, c.IsSpot,c.MakeEM,c.MakeCP,c.ExternalTickerType,   
  c.OptionStyle, c.PriceMultiplier, c.MakeCM, c.isOOF, isnull(t.YearCode,'') YearCode 
  from ISINMaster m inner join ExternalContractTickers t on m.ISINMasterID = t.ISINMasterID    
  inner join ExternalContractConfig c on t.ContractConfigID = c.ID    
  where m.DataSource = @DataSource and m.ExchangeCode in ( select Exchange_Code from @ExchangeCode)    
  END      
 END 
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetExternalTickerConfigForCP

```sql
 CREATE PROCEDURE spGetExternalTickerConfigForCP        
  
 @DataSource varchar(20),          
  
 @ExchangeCodes varchar(200) = ''          
  
 AS          
  
 BEGIN           
  
 SET NOCOUNT ON;          
  
         
  
 DECLARE @ExchangeCode TABLE(Exchange_Code [char](50))         
  
 INSERT into @ExchangeCode SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) from dbo.split(@ExchangeCodes,',')         
  
         
  
 IF @ExchangeCodes = ''            
  
  BEGIN            
  
     select e.Estee_ID, m.ExchangeTicker, tm.ExternalTicker,e.Exchange_Code, tm.PriceMultiplier        
  
  from ISINMaster(nolock) m inner join ExternalContractTickers(nolock) t on m.ISINMasterID = t.ISINMasterID          
  
  inner join ExternalContractConfig(nolock) c on t.ContractConfigID = c.ID        
  
  inner join EsteeMaster(nolock) e on e.ISIN = m.ISIN and e.Exchange_Code = m.ExchangeCode        
  
  inner join EsteeIdToExternalTickersMap(nolock) tm on tm.EsteeID = e.Estee_ID and tm.SourceType = m.DataSource      
  
  where m.DataSource =@DataSource and c.MakeCP = 1 and c.IsSpot = 0 and e.Security_Type not in (select TypeCode from SecurityType where GroupID = 5)        
  
        
  
  UNION      
  
        
  
  select e.Estee_ID, m.ExchangeTicker, tm.ExternalTicker,e.Exchange_Code, tm.PriceMultiplier       
  
  from ISINMaster(nolock) m inner join ExternalContractTickers(nolock) t on m.ISINMasterID = t.ISINMasterID          
  
  inner join ExternalContractConfig(nolock) c on t.ContractConfigID = c.ID        
  
  inner join EsteeMaster(nolock) e on e.ISIN = m.ISIN and e.Exchange_Code = m.ExchangeCode        
  
  inner join EsteeIdToExternalTickersMap(nolock) tm on tm.EsteeID = e.Estee_ID and tm.SourceType = m.DataSource    
  
  where m.DataSource =@DataSource and c.MakeCP = 1 and c.IsSpot = 1 and e.Security_Type in (select TypeCode from SecurityType where GroupID = 5)    
  
        
  
  END            
  
 ELSE            
  
  BEGIN            
  
 select e.Estee_ID, m.ExchangeTicker, tm.ExternalTicker ,e.Exchange_Code, tm.PriceMultiplier       
  
 from ISINMaster(nolock) m inner join ExternalContractTickers(nolock) t on m.ISINMasterID = t.ISINMasterID          
  
 inner join ExternalContractConfig(nolock) c on t.ContractConfigID = c.ID        
  
 inner join EsteeMaster(nolock) e on e.ISIN = m.ISIN and e.Exchange_Code = m.ExchangeCode        
  
 inner join EsteeIdToExternalTickersMap(nolock) tm on tm.EsteeID = e.Estee_ID and tm.SourceType = m.DataSource      
  
 --and tm.ExternalTicker = (t.Ticker + ' ' + t.SecondaryTicker)      
  
 where m.DataSource =@DataSource and c.MakeCP = 1 and c.IsSpot = 0  and m.ExchangeCode in ( select Exchange_Code from @ExchangeCode)    
  
 and e.Security_Type not in (select TypeCode from SecurityType where GroupID = 5)          
  
       
  
 UNION      
  
       
  
  select e.Estee_ID, m.ExchangeTicker, tm.ExternalTicker, e.Exchange_Code, tm.PriceMultiplier        
  
 from ISINMaster(nolock) m inner join ExternalContractTickers(nolock) t on m.ISINMasterID = t.ISINMasterID          
  
 inner join ExternalContractConfig(nolock) c on t.ContractConfigID = c.ID        
  
 inner join EsteeMaster(nolock) e on e.ISIN = m.ISIN and e.Exchange_Code = m.ExchangeCode        
  
 inner join EsteeIdToExternalTickersMap(nolock) tm on tm.EsteeID = e.Estee_ID and tm.SourceType = m.DataSource    
  
 --and tm.ExternalTicker = (t.Ticker + ' ' + t.SecondaryTicker)      
  
 where m.DataSource =@DataSource and c.MakeCP = 1 and c.IsSpot = 1  and m.ExchangeCode in ( select Exchange_Code from @ExchangeCode)    
  
 and e.Security_Type in (select TypeCode from SecurityType where GroupID = 5)    
  
       
  
  END            
  
 END
```
