## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetFIIandBannedSecurities

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.spGetFIIandBannedSecurities  
-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here  
 @emsId nvarchar(max),  
 @date nvarchar(max),
 @isCMBan INT=0
AS  
	BEGIN
		IF (@isCMBan = 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT DISTINCT  x.Estee_ID, x.accountID,x.BanStatus INTO #temp1 from
					(	SELECT DISTINCT E.Estee_ID, sba.accountID,A.BanGroupId, A.SecurityTypes ,a.BanStatus 
						FROM
							(
								SELECT BS.ISIN, BS.BanGroupId,BS.SecurityTypes,BS.BanStatus  
								FROM dbo.BannedSecurities AS BS    WHERE BS.BanStatus = 1    AND CONVERT(DATE, BS.BanDate) = CONVERT(DATE, @date)
							) A  
						INNER JOIN dbo.esteemaster AS E ON E.ISIN = A.ISIN    AND E.Security_Type IN(SELECT *    FROM Split(A.SecurityTypes, ','))   AND E.Exchange_Code='IS' 
						JOIN 
							( 
								SELECT DISTINCT sa.accountID     FROM StrategyBrokerAccount sa     JOIN esteeApplications ea ON sa.subStrategyID = ea.SubStrategy_ID     WHERE ea.EMS_Application_ID = @emsId     AND sa.accountID IS NOT NULL 
							) sba ON 1 = 1
					) x   
				-- Query for fiibansecurities 
				-- TO BE REMOVED | Not being populated
				SELECT DISTINCT Estee_ID, Account_ID, ban_status AS Ban_Status INTO #temp2 FROM fiibansecurities WHERE ban_status = 1; 
				-- Combine results from both queries 
				SELECT * FROM #temp1 UNION SELECT * FROM #temp2; 
				-- Drop temporary tables 
				DROP TABLE #temp1; 
				DROP TABLE #temp2;
			END
		ELSE
			BEGIN
				-- Set No-Lock and read uncommited since BOD / Non realtime update data is beign referred
				SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED

				-- Fetch Ban account-wise
				SELECT DISTINCT e.Estee_ID, sba.accountID, A.BanStatus INTO #temp3 FROM 
				(
					SELECT BS.ISIN, BS.BanGroupId,BS.SecurityTypes,BS.BanStatus 
					FROM dbo.BannedSecurities AS BS    WHERE BS.BanStatus = 1    AND CONVERT(DATE, BS.BanDate) = CONVERT(DATE, @date)
				) A  
				INNER JOIN BanGroup bg ON A.BanGroupId = bg.ID
				INNER JOIN esteemaster e ON e.ISIN = A.ISIN AND e.Security_Type IN (SELECT *    FROM Split(A.SecurityTypes, ',')) AND e.Exchange_Code = 'IS'
				JOIN
					(
						SELECT DISTINCT sa.accountID FROM StrategyBrokerAccount sa     JOIN esteeApplications ea ON sa.subStrategyID = ea.SubStrategy_ID     WHERE ea.EMS_Application_ID = @emsId     AND sa.accountID IS NOT NULL 
					)  sba ON 1 = 1
				INNER JOIN tblBrokerAccount tba ON sba.accountID = tba.account_id
				WHERE (tba.IsFIIEnabled = 1 AND (bg.BanGroupName = 'FPI Limit Red Flagged Securities' OR bg.BanGroupName = 'FPI Limit Breach Securities')) 
				OR (tba.IsNRIEnabled = 1 AND (bg.BanGroupName = 'NRI Limit Red Flagged Securities' OR bg.BanGroupName = 'NRI Limit Breach Securities')) 
				OR ((tba.IsFIIEnabled = 1 OR tba.IsNRIEnabled = 1) AND (bg.BanGroupName = 'Overall Sectoral limit Red Flagged Securities' OR bg.BanGroupName = 'Overall Sectoral limit Breach Securities'))
				OR bg.BanTypeId = 1

				-- Combine results from both queries 
				SELECT * FROM #temp3;
				-- Drop temporary tables 
				DROP TABLE #temp3; 
			END
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetFIITradeLimitsStatArb

```sql
-- =============================================  
-- Author:  Apoorva Mishra   
-- Create date: 24 Jan, 2013  
-- Description: Get FII Trade Limits for StatArb strategies  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetFIITradeLimitsStatArb]   
 @NotionalExposure float,  
 @date date,  
 @PreviousWorkingDate date  
AS  
BEGIN  
   
Declare @ExpDates Table (Expiry_date datetime)  
insert into @ExpDates  
Select distinct Expiry_Date from esteemaster where Exchange_Code = 'IS' and Security_Type = 1 order by Expiry_date  
  
select distinct   
@date as [Date],  
EM.ISIN as ISIN,  
EM.Security_Type as Security_Type,  
Convert(date, EM.Expiry_Date) as Expiry,  
EM.Strike_Price as Strike_Price,  
EM.DataFeed_Ticker as DataFeed_Ticker,  
EM.Underlying_Ticker as Underlying_Ticker,  
'Future' as Segment,  
FLOOR((@NotionalExposure/ CP.Close_Price)/EM.Lot_Size)*EM.Lot_Size as BuyLimit,  
FLOOR((@NotionalExposure/ CP.Close_Price)/EM.Lot_Size)*EM.Lot_Size as SellLimit  
from esteemaster EM  
inner join subscriptionlist SL  
on EM.Estee_ID = SL.Estee_Id  
inner join closingprice CP  
on EM.Estee_ID = CP.Estee_ID  
where EM.Security_Type in (1, 5)  
and SL.SubStrategyID = 1572  
and Exchange_Code = 'IS'  
and Expiry_Date in (Select top 2 Expiry_Date from @ExpDates)  
and CP.Date = @PreviousWorkingDate  
   
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetFtdTurnoverByStrategyAccount

```sql
  
CREATE procedure spGetFtdTurnoverByStrategyAccount  
@tradeDate date,  
@exchange varchar(2)  
  
As  
          
Begin  
  
SELECT SUM(t.Traded_Quantity * (case when isnull(e.security_type, ea.Security_Type) in (2, 3, 6, 7, 12, 13) then isnull(e.strike_price, ea.Strike_Price) else t.Traded_Price end)) As TurnOver,        
SUM(t.Traded_Quantity * t.Traded_Price) as PremiumTurnover,ot.Sub_Strategy_ID, o.Account_ID, ISNULL(ISNULL(e.TradingCurrency, ea.TradingCurrency), 1) TradingCurrency, 
ISNULL(ISNULL(e.SettlementCurrency, ea.SettlementCurrency), 1) SettlementCurrency                                          
from [Order] o          
inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID          
inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID          
left join esteemaster e with (nolock) on e.estee_id = t.estee_id and e.Status = 1                
left join EsteeMaster_archive ea with (nolock) on t.estee_id = ea.estee_id and ea.Status = 1          
where ot.Status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and o.Creation_Date = @tradeDate and ISNULL(e.exchange_code, ea.exchange_code) = @exchange and o.Order_Source_ID not in ('ECM','OdinDirectTransfer','ODIN','New Balancing','Balancing')
group by ot.Sub_Strategy_ID, o.Account_ID, ISNULL(e.TradingCurrency, ea.TradingCurrency), ISNULL(e.SettlementCurrency, ea.SettlementCurrency)
UNION  
SELECT SUM(t.Traded_Quantity * (case when isnull(e.security_type, ea.Security_Type) in (2, 3, 6, 7, 12, 13) then (isnull(e.strike_price, ea.Strike_Price) + t.Traded_Price) else t.Traded_Price end)) As TurnOver,                
SUM(t.Traded_Quantity * t.Traded_Price) as PremiumTurnover,ot.Sub_Strategy_ID, o.Account_ID, ISNULL(ISNULL(e.TradingCurrency, ea.TradingCurrency),1) TradingCurrency, 
ISNULL(ISNULL(e.SettlementCurrency, ea.SettlementCurrency), 1) SettlementCurrency                    
from [Order] o          
inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID          
inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID          
left join esteemaster e with (nolock) on e.estee_id = t.estee_id and e.Status = 1                
left join EsteeMaster_archive ea with (nolock) on t.estee_id = ea.estee_id and ea.Status = 1          
where ot.Status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and o.Creation_Date = @tradeDate and ISNULL(e.exchange_code, ea.exchange_code) = @exchange  
and o.Order_Source_ID = 'ECM' and Remarks not like 'Trade Move%' 
group by ot.Sub_Strategy_ID, o.Account_ID, ISNULL(ISNULL(e.TradingCurrency, ea.TradingCurrency), 1), ISNULL(ISNULL(e.SettlementCurrency, ea.SettlementCurrency), 1)
  
End  
  
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetHierarchyStructureForAllocatorReport

```sql

Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetHierarchyStructureForAllocatorReport]                        
 @stratAccList ListString READONLY              
AS                        
BEGIN          
DECLARE @ClearingAccId TABLE(ClrAccId int, ssid int)    
DECLARE @Exchanges Table(ClrAccId int, eCode varchar(500))    
;with cte(  ClearingAccountID, Exchange_code) As    
(    
select distinct ClearingAccountID, RTRIM(LTRIM(Exchange_code)) from Account where Status = 'Active'    
)    
insert into @Exchanges    
SELECT     
  ClearingAccountID,    
  STUFF((    
    SELECT ', ' + exchange_Code    
    FROM cte     
    WHERE (ClearingAccountID = Results.ClearingAccountID)     
    FOR XML PATH(''),TYPE).value('(./text())[1]','VARCHAR(MAX)')    
  ,1,2,'') AS NameValues    
FROM     
cte Results    
GROUP BY ClearingAccountID    
insert into @ClearingAccId    
select distinct CA.ClearingAccountID, SubStrategy_Id from StrategyBrokerAccount sba inner join Strategy_New sn on sba.subStrategyID = sn.SubStrategy_Id    
inner join Account A on A.Account_ID = sba.accountID    
inner join ClearingAccount ca on ca.ClearingAccountID = A.ClearingAccountID    
where sn.Strategy_Status = 1  

DECLARE @StrategyAccount TABLE(ssId int, accId int)    
Insert into @StrategyAccount
SELECT ParseName(Replace(ListItem, '_', '.'), 2) , ParseName(Replace(ListItem, '_', '.'), 1)  FROM   @stratAccList
              
--select * from parameterdimension    
--Fund - SC    
select distinct 7 as ParentDimensionId, F.id as ParentDimensionValue, F.id as ParentId, F.name as ParentName, F.BaseCurrencyID as ParentCurrency,    
F.OwnerID as ParentOwner, '' as ParentExchange,'Mode' as ParentMode,    
11 as ChildDimensionId, SC.ID as ChildDimensionValue, SC.ID as ChildId, SC.Name as ChildName, SC.Currency as ChildCurrency,    
Sc.Owner as ChildOwner, '' as ChildExchange,'Mode' as ChildMode    
from StrategyCategory SC    
inner join InvestmentFund F on sc.FundId= F.id    
inner join StrategyGroup Sg on sc.ID=sg.CategoryID    
inner join Strategy_new sn on sn.Strategy_Id= sg.StrategyID and sn.Strategy_Status=1 
inner join @StrategyAccount sa on sn.SubStrategy_Id = sa.ssId    
inner join Account a on a.Account_ID = sa.accId  AND a.Status='Active'
order by ParentId, ChildId    
-- SC - SG    
select distinct 11 as ParentDimensionId, SC.ID as ParentDimensionValue, SC.id as ParentId, SC.name as ParentName, SC.Currency as ParentCurrency,    
sc.Owner as ParentOwner, '' as ParentExchange, 'Mode' as ParentMode,    
6 as ChildDimensionId, SG.StrategyID as ChildDimensionValue, SG.StrategyID as ChildId, SG.StrategyName as ChildName, SG.CurrencyID as ChildCurrency,    
sg.Owner as ChildOwner, '' as ChildExchange,'Mode' as ChildMode , SG.CategoryID as CategoryId , SC.FundId as FundId   
from StrategyGroup SG    
inner join StrategyCategory SC on SG.CategoryID = SC.ID    
inner join Strategy_new sn on sn.Strategy_Id= sg.StrategyID and sn.Strategy_Status=1    
 inner join @StrategyAccount sa on sn.SubStrategy_Id = sa.ssId   
 inner join Account a on a.Account_ID = sa.accId AND a.Status='Active'
order by ParentId, ChildId    
-- SC - SCA    
select distinct 11 as ParentDimensionId, sc.ID as ParentDimensionValue, SC.id as ParentId, SC.name as ParentName, SC.Currency as ParentCurrency,    
sc.Owner as ParentOwner, '' as ParentExchange, 'Mode' as ParentMode,    
13 as ChildDimensionId, cast(sc.ID AS varchar(10))+'_' +cast(CA.ClearingAccountID AS varchar(10)) as ChildDimensionValue, CA.ClearingAccountID as ChildId, CA.ClearingAccountName as ChildName, CA.BaseCurrencyID as ChildCurrency,    
sc.Owner as ChildOwner, Ex.eCode as ChildExchange,'Mode' as ChildMode  , SC.FundId as FundId  
from dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount sba    
inner join Strategy_new sn on sn.SubStrategy_Id= sba.subStrategyID and sn.Strategy_Status=1      
inner join StrategyGroup Sg on sg.StrategyID=sn.Strategy_Id    
inner join StrategyCategory sc on sc.ID=sg.CategoryID    
INNER JOIN dbo.Account a ON a.Account_ID=sba.accountID AND a.Status='Active'    
inner join ClearingAccount CA on CA.ClearingAccountID = a.ClearingAccountID --and A.Status='active'    
inner join @Exchanges Ex on Ex.ClrAccId = CA.ClearingAccountID  
inner join @StrategyAccount sa on sba.accountID= sa.accId and sba.subStrategyID = sa.ssId  
order by ParentId, ChildId  
-- SG - SA    
select distinct 6 as ParentDimensionId, SG.StrategyID as ParentDimensionValue, SG.StrategyID as ParentId, SG.StrategyName as ParentName, SG.CurrencyID as ParentCurrency,     
SG.Owner as ParentOwner, '' as ParentExchange,'Mode' as ParentMode,    
3 as ChildDimensionId, cast(A.Account_ID as varchar(10)) + '_' + cast(sn.SubStrategy_Id as varchar(10)) as ChildDimensionValue, sn.SubStrategy_Id as ChildId, sn.SubStrategy_Name as ChildName, A.CurrencyId as ChildCurrency,    
sn.ownerUserID as ChildOwner, A.exchange_Code as ChildExchange, SG.CategoryID as CategoryId, SC.FundId as FundId,  
'Log_Only' ChildMode   
from StrategyGroup SG    
Inner join Strategy_New sn on sn.Strategy_Id = sg.StrategyID and sn.Strategy_Status=1   
inner join StrategyBrokerAccount sba on sba.subStrategyID = sn.SubStrategy_Id    
inner join Account A on sba.accountID = A.Account_ID and A.Status='active' 
inner join @StrategyAccount sa on sba.accountID= sa.accId and sba.subStrategyID = sa.ssId
inner join StrategyCategory sc on SG.CategoryID = SC.ID   
--inner join DATAINIT d on d.substrategy_id = sn.SubStrategy_Id and d.Parameter='Mode'    
order by ParentId, ChildId    
-- Onwer - SA    
select ''    
--CA - SA    
select distinct 14 as ParentDimensionId, A.ClearingAccountID as ParentDimensionValue, A.ClearingAccountID as ParentId, CA.ClearingAccountName as ParentName, CA.BaseCurrencyID  as ParentCurrency,    
'' as ParentOwner, '' as ParentExchange,'Mode' as ParentMode,    
3 as ChildDimensionId, cast(A.Account_ID as varchar(10)) + '_' + cast(sn.SubStrategy_Id as varchar(10)) as ChildDimensionValue, sn.SubStrategy_Id as ChildId, sn.SubStrategy_Name as ChildName, A.CurrencyId as ChildCurrency,    
sn.ownerUserID as ChildOwner, A.exchange_Code as ChildExchange,    
'Log_Only' ChildMode   
from StrategyBrokerAccount sba      
inner join Strategy_New sn on sba.subStrategyID= sn.SubStrategy_Id and sn.Strategy_Status=1   
inner join Account A on sba.accountID = A.Account_ID and A.Status='active'   
inner join ClearingAccount CA on CA.ClearingAccountID = A.ClearingAccountID
inner join @StrategyAccount sa on sba.accountID= sa.accId and sba.subStrategyID = sa.ssId    
--inner join DATAINIT d on d.substrategy_id = sn.SubStrategy_Id and d.Parameter='Mode'      
order by ParentId, ChildId      
-- CA - SCA    
select distinct 14 as ParentDimensionId, CA.ClearingAccountID as ParentDimensionValue, CA.ClearingAccountID as ParentId, CA.ClearingAccountName as ParentName, CA.BaseCurrencyID as ParentCurrency,    
'' as ParentOwner,'' as ParentExchange,'Mode' as ParentMode,    
13 as ChildDimensionId,  cast(sc.ID AS varchar(10))+'_' +cast(CA.ClearingAccountID AS varchar(10)) as ChildDimensionValue, SC.ID as ChildId, SC.Name as ChildName, CA.BaseCurrencyID as ChildCurrency,    
SC.Owner as ChildOwner, ex.eCode as ChildExchange, 'Mode' as ChildMode    
from dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount sba    
inner join Strategy_new sn on sn.SubStrategy_Id=sba.subStrategyID and sn.Strategy_Status=1    
inner join StrategyGroup Sg on sg.StrategyID = sn.Strategy_Id    
inner join StrategyCategory sc on sc.id =sg.CategoryID    
inner join Account A on sba.accountID = A.Account_ID and A.Status='active'         
inner join ClearingAccount CA on CA.ClearingAccountID = a.ClearingAccountID and A.Status='active'    
inner join @Exchanges ex on ex.ClrAccId = CA.ClearingAccountID   
inner join @StrategyAccount sa on sba.accountID= sa.accId and sba.subStrategyID = sa.ssId   
order by ParentId, ChildId    
--S - SA    
select distinct 1 as ParentDimensionId, sn.SubStrategy_Id as ParentDimensionValue, sn.SubStrategy_Id as ParentId, sn.SubStrategy_Name as ParentName, sn.BaseCurrencyID as ParentCurrency,    
sn.ownerUserID as ParentOwner, '' as ParentExchange,    
'Log_Only' ParentMode,    
3 as ChildDimensionId, cast(A.Account_ID as varchar(10)) + '_' + cast(sn.SubStrategy_Id as varchar(10)) as ChildDimensionValue, sn.SubStrategy_Id as ChildId, sn.SubStrategy_Name as ChildName, A.CurrencyId as ChildCurrency,    
sn.ownerUserID as ChildOwner, A.exchange_Code as ChildExchange,    
'Log_Only' ChildMode    , sn.isGlobalAggregation as IsColo  
from StrategyBrokerAccount sba    
inner join Strategy_New sn on sba.subStrategyID= sn.SubStrategy_Id and sn.Strategy_Status=1    
--inner join DATAINIT d on d.substrategy_id = sn.SubStrategy_Id and d.Parameter='Mode'     
inner join Account A on sba.accountID = A.Account_ID and A.Status='active'   
inner join @StrategyAccount sa on sba.accountID= sa.accId and sba.subStrategyID = sa.ssId    
order by ParentId, ChildId    
-- LE - A    
select distinct 15 as ParentDimensionId, LE.LegalEntityId as ParentDimensionValue, LE.LegalEntityId as ParentId, LE.LegalEntityName as ParentName,LE.BaseCurrencyId as ParentCurrency,    
LE.OwnerId as ParentOwner, '' as ParentExchange, 'Mode' as ParentMode,    
14 as ChildDimensionId, CA.ClearingAccountID as ChildDimensionValue, CA.ClearingAccountID as ChildId, CA.ClearingAccountName as ChildName, CA.BaseCurrencyID as ChildCurrency,    
'' as ChildOwner, ex.eCode as ChildExchange,'Mode' as ChildMode    
from LegalEntity LE    
inner join ClearingAccount CA on LE.LegalEntityId = CA.LegalEntityId    
inner join @Exchanges ex on ex.ClrAccId = CA.ClearingAccountID    
inner join Account A on A.ClearingAccountID=CA.ClearingAccountID and A.Status='active' 
inner join StrategyBrokerAccount sba on sba.accountID = A.Account_ID    
inner join Strategy_new sn on sba.subStrategyID=sn.SubStrategy_Id and sn.Strategy_Status=1 
inner join @StrategyAccount sa on sba.accountID= sa.accId and sba.subStrategyID = sa.ssId  
order by ParentId, ChildId    
--LE-SC    
select distinct 15 as ParentDimensionId, LE.LegalEntityId as ParentDimensionValue, LE.LegalEntityId as ParentId, LE.LegalEntityName as ParentName,LE.BaseCurrencyId as ParentCurrency,    
LE.OwnerId as ParentOwner, '' as ParentExchange, 'Mode' as ParentMode,    
16 as ChildDimensionId, cast(LE.LegalEntityId AS varchar(10))+'_' +cast( SC.ID AS varchar(10)) as ChildDimensionValue, sc.ID as ChildId, SC.Name as ChildName, SC.Currency as ChildCurrency,    
SC.Owner as ChildOwner, '' as ChildExchange,'Mode' as ChildMode    
from LegalEntity LE    
inner join ClearingAccount CA on CA.LegalEntityId = le.LegalEntityId    
inner join Account A on A.ClearingAccountID=CA.ClearingAccountID and A.Status='active' 
inner join StrategyBrokerAccount sba on sba.accountID = A.Account_ID    
inner join Strategy_new sn on sn.SubStrategy_Id=sba.subStrategyID and sn.Strategy_Status=1 
inner join StrategyGroup Sg on sg.StrategyID = sn.Strategy_Id    
inner join StrategyCategory sc on sc.id =sg.CategoryID 
inner join @StrategyAccount sa on sba.AccountID = sa.accId   and sa.ssId = sba.subStrategyID  
order by ParentId, ChildId    
--CA-SG    
select distinct 14 as ParentDimensionId, CA.ClearingAccountID as ParentDimensionValue, CA.ClearingAccountID as ParentId, CA.ClearingAccountName as ParentName, CA.BaseCurrencyID as ParentCurrency,    
'' as ParentOwner,'' as ParentExchange,'Mode' as ParentMode,    
17 as ChildDimensionId,  cast(CA.ClearingAccountID AS varchar(10))+'_' +cast(SG.StrategyID AS varchar(10)) as ChildDimensionValue, Sg.StrategyID as ChildId, Sg.StrategyName as ChildName, SG.CurrencyID as ChildCurrency,    
SG.Owner as ChildOwner, ex.eCode as ChildExchange, 'Mode' as ChildMode    
from dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount sba    
inner join Strategy_new sn on sn.SubStrategy_Id=sba.subStrategyID and sn.Strategy_Status=1    
inner join StrategyGroup Sg on sg.StrategyID = sn.Strategy_Id    
inner join StrategyCategory sc on sc.id =sg.CategoryID    
inner join Account A on sba.accountID = A.Account_ID and A.Status='active'     
inner join ClearingAccount CA on CA.ClearingAccountID = a.ClearingAccountID and A.Status='active'    
inner join @Exchanges ex on ex.ClrAccId = CA.ClearingAccountID
inner join @StrategyAccount sa on sba.AccountID = sa.accId   and sa.ssId = sba.subStrategyID       
order by ParentId, ChildId    
--LE-SG    
select distinct 15 as ParentDimensionId, LE.LegalEntityId as ParentDimensionValue, LE.LegalEntityId as ParentId, LE.LegalEntityName as ParentName,LE.BaseCurrencyId as ParentCurrency,    
LE.OwnerId as ParentOwner, '' as ParentExchange, 'Mode' as ParentMode,    
18 as ChildDimensionId, cast(LE.LegalEntityId AS varchar(10))+'_' +cast( Sg.StrategyID AS varchar(10)) as ChildDimensionValue, Sg.StrategyID as ChildId, Sg.StrategyName as ChildName, SG.CurrencyID as ChildCurrency,    
SG.Owner as ChildOwner, '' as ChildExchange,'Mode' as ChildMode    
from LegalEntity LE    
inner join ClearingAccount CA on CA.LegalEntityId = le.LegalEntityId    
inner join Account A on A.ClearingAccountID=CA.ClearingAccountID and A.Status='active' 
inner join StrategyBrokerAccount sba on sba.accountID = A.Account_ID    
inner join Strategy_new sn on sn.SubStrategy_Id=sba.subStrategyID and sn.Strategy_Status=1  
inner join StrategyGroup Sg on sg.StrategyID = sn.Strategy_Id    
inner join StrategyCategory sc on sc.id =sg.CategoryID    
inner join @StrategyAccount sa on sba.AccountID = sa.accId   and sa.ssId = sba.subStrategyID
order by ParentId, ChildId    
--SG-CA    
select distinct 6 as ParentDimensionId, SG.StrategyID as ParentDimensionValue, SG.StrategyID as ParentId, SG.StrategyName as ParentName, SG.CurrencyID as ParentCurrency,    
sg.Owner as ParentOwner,'' as ParentExchange,'Mode' as ParentMode,    
19 as ChildDimensionId,   cast(SG.StrategyID AS varchar(10))+'_'+cast(CA.ClearingAccountID AS varchar(10)) as ChildDimensionValue, CA.ClearingAccountID as ChildId, CA.ClearingAccountName as ChildName, CA.BaseCurrencyID as ChildCurrency,    
'' as ChildOwner, ex.eCode as ChildExchange, 'Mode' as ChildMode    
from dbo.StrategyBrokerAccount sba    
inner join Strategy_new sn on sn.SubStrategy_Id=sba.subStrategyID and sn.Strategy_Status=1   
inner join StrategyGroup Sg on sg.StrategyID = sn.Strategy_Id    
inner join StrategyCategory sc on sc.id =sg.CategoryID    
inner join Account A on sba.accountID = A.Account_ID and A.Status='active'     
inner join ClearingAccount CA on CA.ClearingAccountID = a.ClearingAccountID and A.Status='active'    
inner join @Exchanges ex on ex.ClrAccId = CA.ClearingAccountID    
inner join @StrategyAccount sa on sba.AccountID = sa.accId   and sa.ssId = sba.subStrategyID
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.spGetIBContract
AS
BEGIN
	select e.Estee_ID, e.Token SecurityId, e.Underlying_Ticker Symbol, RTRIM(ltrim(e.Exchange_Code)) SecurityExchange, e.Option_Type,


	LEFT(CONVERT(varchar, e.Expiry_Date,112),6) MaturityMonthYear, RIGHT(CONVERT(varchar, e.Expiry_Date,112),2) MaturityDay, ec.ContractType SecurityType, 1 DisplayFactor, e.Lot_Size,
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetIncrementalCurrentOrders

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spGetIncrementalCurrentOrders] 

	@lastFetchTime Datetime,
	@currentFetchTimeOut Datetime output

AS
BEGIN
   --get All Orders created | updated after @lastFetchTime
	SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED
	SET @currentFetchTimeOut = getDate()

	SELECT 
	B.Order_ID,
	B.Order_Type,
	B.Order_Validity,
	B.Account_ID,
	B.Broker_Order_ID,
	B.Exchange_Order_ID,
	A.Remarks,
	B.Comb_Status,
	B.Sub_Strategy_ID,
	B.Order_Source_ID,
	B.Underlying_Ticker AS Short_Name,
	A.OrderTrade_ID,
	A.Status,
	A.islast,
	A.Price_Diff,
	A.Original_Order_ID,
	A.Creation_Time,
	A.Created_By,
	convert(char, A.Update_Time, 108) Update_Time,
	A.Updated_By,
	C.Broker_Name,
	 B.Broker_ID, 
	D.TRADE_ID,
	D.Estee_ID,
	D.Buy_Sell_Indicator,
	D.Order_Quantity,
	D.Order_Price,
	D.Traded_Quantity,
	D.Traded_Price,
	D.Stop_Price,
	D.Transaction_Cost

	FROM tblOrderTrades  A WITH (NOLOCK) 
	inner join  tblOrders B WITH (NOLOCK)  on A.Order_ID = B.Order_ID
	inner join tblTrades D WITH (NOLOCK, index (IX_tbltrades_ordertrade))  on D.OrderTrade_ID = A.OrderTrade_ID
	inner join  Broker as C WITH (NOLOCK)  on B.broker_id = C.broker_id 
	WHERE A.Update_Time >= @lastFetchTime

 
   select   A.OrderTrade_ID,
			A.TRADE_ID,
			A.Estee_ID,
			A.Buy_Sell_Indicator,
			A.Order_Quantity,
			A.Order_Price,
			A.Traded_Quantity,
			A.Traded_Price,
			A.Stop_Price,
			A.Transaction_Cost
			from tblTrades A WITH (NOLOCK, index (IX_tbltrades_ordertrade)) 
			inner join  tblOrderTrades B WITH (NOLOCK)  on A.OrderTrade_ID = B.OrderTrade_ID
			WHERE B.Update_Time >= @lastFetchTime
 




END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetIndexConstituents

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetIndexConstituents] 
@esteeID VARCHAR(MAX), 
@date DATE, 
@runDate DATE= NULL
AS
     BEGIN
         DECLARE @exchangeCode VARCHAR(2);
         SET @exchangeCode = dbo.GetExchangeCode(@esteeID);
         SET @runDate = ISNULL(@runDate, (SELECT TOP 1 RunDate
                                            FROM NSEIndexData
                                           ORDER BY RunDate DESC
                                         ));
         IF(@date >= @runDate)
         BEGIN
             SET @runDate = (SELECT TOP 1 RunDate
                               FROM NSEIndexData
                              ORDER BY RunDate DESC
                            );
             EXEC spFetchFutureIndexConstituents
                  @esteeID,
                  @date,
                  @runDate;
         END;
         ELSE
         BEGIN
             SELECT Member_Estee_ID, IssueCap, c.Close_Price AS ClosingPrice, FFMarketCap AS MarketCap, Weightage, InvestibleFactor, ISNULL(CappingFactor, 1) CappingFactor, ISNULL(IndexMarketCap, 1) IndexMarketCap
               FROM IndexTable
               INNER JOIN closingprice c ON Member_Estee_ID = c.estee_ID
                                            AND c.Date = @date
              WHERE IndexTable.Estee_ID = @esteeID
                    AND LastCheckedDate = @date
				and IndexTable.Estee_ID <> IndexTable.Member_Estee_ID;
         END;
     END;
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetIndexDataForFutureDate

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetIndexDataForFutureDate]   
@esteeID VARCHAR(MAX),   
@date DATE,   
@runDate DATE= NULL,   
@closingPriceDate DATE= NULL  
AS  
BEGIN  
 DECLARE @exchangeCode VARCHAR(2);  
 SET @exchangeCode = dbo.GetExchangeCode(@esteeID);  
 IF(@date < @runDate)  
  BEGIN  
   -- when Querying data for old date  
   SELECT it.Member_Estee_ID, it.IssueCap, c.Close_Price AS ClosingPrice, it.FFMarketCap AS MarketCap, it.Weightage, it.InvestibleFactor,   
   ISNULL(it.CappingFactor, 1) CappingFactor, ISNULL(it.IndexMarketCap, 1) IndexMarketCap, it.ClosingPrice as AdjustedClosingPrice
    FROM dbo.IndexTable it  
   LEFT JOIN dbo.closingprice c ON it.Member_Estee_ID = c.estee_ID AND c.[Date] = @closingPriceDate  
   WHERE it.Estee_ID = @esteeID AND it.AsOfDate = @date and it.Estee_ID<> it.Member_Estee_ID;  
  
  END;  
 ELSE  
  BEGIN  
   DECLARE @indexConstituentChanged BIT;  
   DECLARE @changedConstituentDate DATE;  
   SELECT @changedConstituentDate = MAX(IT.AsOfDate) FROM dbo.IndexTable IT WHERE IT.AsOfDate <= @date AND IT.Estee_ID = @esteeID;  
   IF(@changedConstituentDate > @runDate)  
    BEGIN  
     SET @indexConstituentChanged = 1;  
    END;  
   ELSE  
    BEGIN  
     SET @indexConstituentChanged = 0;  
    END;  
   IF(@indexConstituentChanged = 0)  
    BEGIN  
     --If Index constituents are not changed then return the data for rundate  
     SELECT IT.Member_Estee_ID, IT.IssueCap, cp.Close_Price AS ClosingPrice, IT.FFMarketCap AS MarketCap, IT.Weightage, IT.InvestibleFactor,   
     ISNULL(IT.CappingFactor, 1) CappingFactor, ISNULL(IT.IndexMarketCap, 1) IndexMarketCap  , it.ClosingPrice as AdjustedClosingPrice
     FROM dbo.IndexTable IT  
     LEFT JOIN dbo.closingprice cp ON cp.Estee_ID = it.Member_Estee_ID AND cp.[Date] = @closingPriceDate  
     WHERE it.AsOfDate = @runDate AND IT.Estee_ID = @esteeID AND IT.Member_Estee_ID <> IT.Estee_ID;  
    END;  
   ELSE  
    BEGIN  
    --Fetch the data for already existing constituents from IndexTable for latest date  
     SELECT e.Estee_ID AS Member_Estee_ID, IT.IssueCap AS IssueCap, cp.Close_Price AS ClosingPrice, IT.FFMarketCap as MarketCap, IT.Weightage,   
     IT.InvestibleFactor AS InvestibleFactor, IT.CappingFactor as CappingFactor, ISNULL(IT.IndexMarketCap, 1) AS IndexMarketCap, IT.ClosingPrice as AdjustedClosingPrice
	 FROM dbo.IndexTable IT    
     INNER JOIN dbo.esteemaster e ON e.Estee_ID = IT.Member_Estee_ID   
     AND e.Security_Type = 0 AND IT.AsOfDate = @changedConstituentDate  
     LEFT JOIN closingprice cp ON IT.Member_Estee_ID = cp.Estee_ID AND cp.Date = @closingPriceDate  
     WHERE IT.Estee_ID = @esteeID AND IT.ASOfDate = @changedConstituentDate and IT.Estee_ID<> IT.Member_Estee_ID  
    END;  
  END;  
END;

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetInitData

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetInitData]   
 -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here  
 @isManager int = 1, /*value 1 indicates the user requesting this operation is a manager*/  
 @userPermissionSubStrategyValues varchar(max)= null /* comma separted user permission values relevant when isManager = 0*/   
AS  
BEGIN  
   SET NOCOUNT ON;  
 -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets FROM  
 -- interfering with SELECT statements.  
 IF( @isManager = 1 )  
  SELECT A.Strategy_id, SG.StrategyName as Strategy_Name, A.SubStrategy_ID, A.SubStrategy_Name, A.Strategy_Status,   
         (SELECT TOP 1 DI.[Value]    
          FROM DataInit DI   
          WHERE DI.Parameter = 'EMSQueueName' and DI.SubStrategy_ID = A.SubStrategy_ID)   
          AS EMS_QUEUE,   
                es.IP AS IP   
                FROM Strategy_new A   
                Inner Join StrategyGroup SG on A.Strategy_Id = SG.StrategyID  
                join esteeapplications ea   
                ON ea.SubStrategy_ID = A.SubStrategy_Id   
                JOIN EsteeServers es   
                on es.ID = ea.EsteeServer_ID  
        --WHERE A.Strategy_Status=1   
  ORDER BY A.SubStrategy_Name ASC;   
      
 ELSE  
  SELECT A.Strategy_id,sg.StrategyName as Strategy_Name,A.SubStrategy_ID,A.SubStrategy_Name,A.Strategy_Status ,  
      (SELECT TOP 1 DI.[Value]    
    FROM DataInit DI   
    WHERE DI.Parameter = 'EMSQueueName' and DI.SubStrategy_ID = A.SubStrategy_ID)   
          AS EMS_QUEUE,  
                es.IP AS IP   
        FROM Strategy_new A   
        inner join StrategyGroup sg on A.Strategy_Id = sg.StrategyID  
        join esteeapplications ea   
                ON ea.SubStrategy_ID = A.SubStrategy_Id   
                JOIN EsteeServers es   
                on es.ID = ea.EsteeServer_ID   
        WHERE --A.Strategy_Status=1 and   
              /*To Check* A. or not in the next line*/  
     A.SubStrategy_Id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT CAST(items as int)   
                           AS item FROM dbo.Split(@userPermissionSubStrategyValues,','))  
  ORDER BY A.SubStrategy_Name ASC;  
   
 SELECT Broker_ID, Broker_Name   
 FROM Broker   
 WHERE Broker.Status ='Active'   
 ORDER BY Broker_Name ASC;  
   
 --SELECT  DISTINCT A.Account_ID, BA.Account_Type, A.Account_Name   
 SELECT  DISTINCT A.Account_ID, A.Account_Type, A.Account_Name, A.exchange_code   
 FROM Account AS A Inner join tblBrokerAccount BA    
   On A.Account_ID = BA.Account_ID   
   and BA.Broker_ID   
   in ( SELECT Broker_ID   
        FROM Broker   
        WHERE Broker.Status ='Active')   
        --ORDER BY BA.Account_Type, A.Account_Name, A.Account_ID  ASC;  
        ORDER BY A.Account_Type, A.Account_Name, A.Account_ID  ASC;  
   
 SELECT Underlying_Ticker as Short_Name,estee_id   
 FROM esteemaster   
 WHERE Exchange_Code='IS' and status=1 and Security_Type in( 0 ,4,10)   
 ORDER BY Underlying_Ticker ASC;  
   
 SELECT DISTINCT ISIN, EsteeUndTicker  
 FROM ISINMaster   
 WHERE SecurityType = 4 and ExchangeCode='IS' and DataSource = 'Exchange'  
 ORDER BY EsteeUndTicker ASC;  
   
 SELECT  distinct top 3 EXPIRY_DATE    
 FROM ESTEEMASTER   
 WHERE Exchange_Code='IS' and status = 1 and expiry_date != '' ORDER BY expiry_Date ASC;  
      
    SELECT underlying_Ticker as Short_Name, estee_id   
    FROM esteemaster   
    WHERE Exchange_Code='IS' and Security_Type in (10) and status=1  
    ORDER BY Underlying_Ticker;  
   
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetISINFromOtherExchanges

```sql

CREATE PROC spGetISINFromOtherExchanges
@contractList varchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
Declare @tempTab TABLE (ContractSymbol varchar(200))
INSERT INTO @tempTab
Select CAST(Items as varchar(200))
from dbo.Split(@contractList , ',')
SELECT distinct tt.ContractSymbol,em.ISIN , em.Exchange_Code AS ExchangeCode,em.Underlying_Ticker into #Finaltemp FROM esteemaster em 
inner join @tempTab tt on em.Underlying_Ticker = tt.ContractSymbol 
where em.Exchange_Code in ('IS')
INSERT into #Finaltemp
SELECT im.[ExchangeTicker] as ContractSymbol, im.ISIN as ISIN , IM.[ExchangeCode] as ExchangeCode ,IM.EsteeUndTicker  AS Underlying_Ticker FROM ISINMASTER im
inner join @tempTab tt on im.ExchangeTicker = tt.ContractSymbol 
where im.ExchangeTicker not in (select Underlying_Ticker from esteemaster where Exchange_Code in ('IS'))
SELECT * FROM #Finaltemp
DROP TABLE #Finaltemp
END


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetLatestEODPhysicalMarginUpdatedTime

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetLatestEODPhysicalMarginUpdatedTime]
    @date VARCHAR(10),
    @strategyIds VARCHAR(500) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @SubStrategy TABLE(SubStrategy_Id INT)

    IF(@strategyIds IS NOT NULL AND @strategyIds <> '')
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @SubStrategy
        SELECT RTRIM(LTRIM(r.items)) 
        FROM dbo.split(@strategyIds, ',') r
        WHERE ISNUMERIC(RTRIM(LTRIM(r.items))) = 1
    END

    DECLARE @lastSavedDate DATE
    SELECT @lastSavedDate = MAX(tradeDate)
    FROM EODPhysicalMargin WITH(NOLOCK)
    WHERE tradeDate <= @date
      AND SSID in (SELECT SubStrategy_Id FROM @SubStrategy)

  
    SELECT MAX(updateDateTime) AS Update_Time
    FROM EODPhysicalMargin WITH(NOLOCK)
    WHERE tradeDate = @lastSavedDate
      AND SSID in (SELECT SubStrategy_Id FROM @SubStrategy)
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetLauncherInfo

```sql

Create procedure spGetLauncherInfo 
 @serversList ListString readonly 

AS                        
BEGIN   


select x.* from (
select ean.ExeName,li.*, di.Value as [Server] from LauncherInfo li  
inner join EsteeApplications ea (nolock) on ea.ApplicationID = li.AppId  
left join EsteeApplicationNames ean on ean.ID=ea.AppNameID
left join Strategy_New sn (nolock) on sn.SubStrategy_Id = ea.SubStrategy_ID 
inner join DataInit di (nolock) on di.ApplicationID = li.AppId and di.Parameter = 'Platform_Linux_InterfaceIP'  
where ea.isRunning = 1   and sn.SubStrategy_Id is null
union
select ean.ExeName,li.*,di.Value as [Server] from LauncherInfo li  
inner join EsteeApplications ea (nolock) on ea.ApplicationID = li.AppId 
inner join EsteeApplicationNames ean on ean.ID=ea.AppNameID
inner join Strategy_New sn (nolock) on sn.SubStrategy_Id = ea.SubStrategy_ID 
inner join DataInit di (nolock) on di.ApplicationID = li.AppId and di.Parameter = 'Platform_Linux_InterfaceIP'  
where sn.Strategy_Status =1  ) as x 
inner join @serversList s on s.ListItem = x.Server
order by AppId


END

```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].spGetLinuxAPIConfiguration
	@ApplicationID varchar(max)
AS                            
  
BEGIN       
 SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
declare @EMSApplicationID int
select lac.Parameter, lac.Value from LinuxAPIConfig lac left join LinuxAPI la on lac.ID=la.LinuxAPIConfigID where la.ApplicationID=@ApplicationID
select distinct EMSId as EMSApplicationID from vwSSConfig where ssid=@ApplicationID
select @EMSApplicationID=EMSId from vwSSConfig where ssid=@ApplicationID
select Parameter, Value from datainit where applicationId=@EMSApplicationID and parameter in ('OrderModuleTcpServerIP', 'OrderModuleTcpServerPort')
END  
  

```

```sql
Create PROCEDURE spGetLinuxAPIConfigurationFromDataInit  
   @ApplicationID VARCHAR(MAX),  
   @IsStrategy    bit  
AS  
  BEGIN  
  
   SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;  
  
   IF @IsStrategy = 1  
    BEGIN  
     SELECT *  
     FROM   dbo.DataInit AS DI  
     WHERE  DI.ApplicationID = '10' + @ApplicationID  
      AND DI.[Parameter] LIKE 'Platform_Linux_%';  
  
     SELECT DISTINCT  
      EMSId AS EMSApplicationID  
     FROM   vwSSConfig  
     WHERE  ssid = @ApplicationID;  
  
    END;  
   ELSE  
    BEGIN  
     SELECT *  
     FROM   dbo.DataInit AS DI  
     WHERE  DI.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID  
      AND DI.[Parameter] LIKE 'Platform_Linux_%';  
    END;  
  END;
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetListOfExpiries2ByDate 
@Date         DATETIME, 
@ExchangeCode VARCHAR(2), 
@SecurityType INT, 
@Symbol       VARCHAR(50),
@Expiry1 datetime
AS
BEGIN

     DECLARE @prevDate DATETIME;
     SET @prevDate = DATEADD(DD, DATEDIFF(Dy, 0, @Date), -1);

	DECLARE @t TABLE
     (
     ExpiryDate2 varchar(50)
     );

     INSERT INTO @t
          SELECT DISTINCT 
                 Expiry_Date2
          FROM dbo.esteemaster AS E
          WHERE E.Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode
                AND E.Security_Type = @SecurityType
                AND E.Underlying_Ticker = @Symbol
			 AND e.Expiry_Date = @Expiry1
                AND e.status = 1;

          INSERT INTO @t
          SELECT DISTINCT 
                 Expiry_Date2
          FROM dbo.EsteeMaster_archive AS EMA
          WHERE ema.Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode
                AND ema.Security_Type = @SecurityType
                AND EMA.Underlying_Ticker = @Symbol
			 AND ema.Expiry_Date = @Expiry1
                AND ISNULL(ema.Last_update_time, @prevDate) >= @prevDate
                AND ema.Status = 1
                AND EMA.Expiry_Date2 NOT IN ( SELECT ExpiryDate2
                                          FROM @t );

SELECT * FROM @t

END;

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetLocationTimeZone

```sql

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetLocationTimeZone]  

 @locationCode varchar(3) = ''

AS                          
BEGIN     

 IF(@locationCode is null or @locationCode='')

	BEGIN

		SELECT LocationCode, LocationTimeZone,LocationDSTimeZone,DSStartTime,DSEndTime
		FROM (SELECT LocationCode, LocationTimeZone,LocationDSTimeZone,DSStartTime,DSEndTime,
        rank() over (partition by LocationCode order by DSEndTime) as rnk
		FROM LocationTimeZones ) as Tab where tab.rnk = 1	
	END

  ELSE

	BEGIN

		SELECT LocationCode, LocationTimeZone,LocationDSTimeZone,DSStartTime,DSEndTime
		FROM (SELECT LocationCode, LocationTimeZone,LocationDSTimeZone,DSStartTime,DSEndTime,
        rank() over (partition by LocationCode order by DSEndTime) as rnk
		FROM LocationTimeZones ) as Tab where tab.rnk = 1 and Tab.LocationCode=@locationCode

	END

END  

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetLotSizeByDate

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetLotSizeByDate 
@Date         DATETIME, 
@ExchangeCode VARCHAR(2), 
@SecurityType INT, 
@Symbol       VARCHAR(50), 
@ExpiryDate   DATETIME    = NULL, 
@ExpiryDate2  DATETIME    = NULL
AS
BEGIN

     DECLARE @prevDate DATETIME;
     SET @prevDate = DATEADD(DD, DATEDIFF(Dy, 0, @Date), -1);

     DECLARE @t TABLE
     (
     LotSize INT
     );

     IF @ExpiryDate IS NULL
        AND @ExpiryDate2 IS NULL
     BEGIN
          INSERT INTO @t
          SELECT DISTINCT 
                 E.Lot_Size
          FROM dbo.esteemaster AS E
          WHERE E.Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode
                AND E.Security_Type = @SecurityType
                AND E.Underlying_Ticker = @Symbol
                AND e.status = 1;

          INSERT INTO @t
          SELECT DISTINCT 
                 EMA.Lot_Size
          FROM dbo.EsteeMaster_archive AS EMA
          WHERE ema.Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode
                AND ema.Security_Type = @SecurityType
                AND EMA.Underlying_Ticker = @Symbol
                AND ISNULL(ema.Last_update_time, @prevDate) >= @prevDate
                AND ema.Status = 1
                AND EMA.Lot_Size NOT IN ( SELECT LotSize
                                          FROM @t );
     END;
     ELSE
     IF @ExpiryDate IS NOT NULL
        AND @ExpiryDate2 IS NULL
     BEGIN
          INSERT INTO @t
          SELECT DISTINCT 
                 E.Lot_Size
          FROM dbo.esteemaster AS E
          WHERE E.Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode
                AND E.Security_Type = @SecurityType
                AND E.Underlying_Ticker = @Symbol
			 AND e.Expiry_Date = @ExpiryDate
                AND e.status = 1;

          INSERT INTO @t
          SELECT DISTINCT 
                 EMA.Lot_Size
          FROM dbo.EsteeMaster_archive AS EMA
          WHERE ema.Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode
                AND ema.Security_Type = @SecurityType
                AND EMA.Underlying_Ticker = @Symbol
			 AND ema.Expiry_Date = @ExpiryDate
                AND ISNULL(ema.Last_update_time, @prevDate) >= @prevDate
                AND ema.Status = 1
                AND EMA.Lot_Size NOT IN ( SELECT LotSize
                                          FROM @t );
     END;
     ELSE
     IF @ExpiryDate IS NOT NULL
        AND @ExpiryDate2 IS NOT NULL
     BEGIN
          INSERT INTO @t
          SELECT DISTINCT 
                 E.Lot_Size
          FROM dbo.esteemaster AS E
          WHERE E.Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode
                AND E.Security_Type = @SecurityType
                AND E.Underlying_Ticker = @Symbol
			 AND e.Expiry_Date = @ExpiryDate
			 AND e.Expiry_Date2 = @ExpiryDate2
                AND e.status = 1;

          INSERT INTO @t
          SELECT DISTINCT 
                 EMA.Lot_Size
          FROM dbo.EsteeMaster_archive AS EMA
          WHERE ema.Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode
                AND ema.Security_Type = @SecurityType
                AND EMA.Underlying_Ticker = @Symbol
			 AND ema.Expiry_Date = @ExpiryDate
			 AND ema.Expiry_Date2 = @ExpiryDate2
                AND ISNULL(ema.Last_update_time, @prevDate) >= @prevDate
                AND ema.Status = 1
                AND EMA.Lot_Size NOT IN ( SELECT LotSize
                                          FROM @t );
     END;;
	SELECT TOP 1*  FROM @t
END;
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetLotSizeFromUnderlyingTicker 
@ExchangeCode NVARCHAR(20), 
@Ticker NVARCHAR(50), 
@SecurityType INT, 
@ExpiryDate DATETIME
AS
     BEGIN
	    declare @lotsize int

         SELECT @lotsize = em.Lot_Size
           FROM esteemaster em WITH (nolock)
           INNER JOIN Exchange ex ON ex.code = em.Exchange_Code
          WHERE em.Status = 1
                AND Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode
                AND Underlying_Ticker = @Ticker
                AND em.Security_Type = @SecurityType
                AND em.Expiry_Date = @ExpiryDate;

	    if @lotsize is null
	    begin
	       SELECT @lotsize = em.Lot_Size
           FROM EsteeMaster_archive em WITH (nolock)
           INNER JOIN Exchange ex ON ex.code = em.Exchange_Code
          WHERE em.Status = 1
                AND Exchange_Code = @ExchangeCode
                AND Underlying_Ticker = @Ticker
                AND em.Security_Type = @SecurityType
                AND em.Expiry_Date = @ExpiryDate			 
	    end

	    Select @lotsize
     END;
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetLRMultiplierData

```sql


CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetLRMultiplierData]  
    @StartDate DATE,  
    @EndDate DATE,  
    @ExchangeCodes NVARCHAR(MAX),  
    @PreviousWorkingDates NVARCHAR(MAX)  
AS  
BEGIN  
    SET NOCOUNT ON;  
  
    -- Convert ExchangeCodes to table  
    DECLARE @ExchangeTable TABLE (Exchange_Code NVARCHAR(50));  
  
    INSERT INTO @ExchangeTable  
    SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(m.n.value('.', 'NVARCHAR(50)')))  
    FROM (  
        SELECT CAST('<XMLRoot><RowData>'   
            + REPLACE(@ExchangeCodes, ',', '</RowData><RowData>')   
            + '</RowData></XMLRoot>' AS XML) AS x  
    ) t  
    CROSS APPLY x.nodes('/XMLRoot/RowData') m(n);  
  
    -- Convert PreviousWorkingDates to table  
    DECLARE @DateTable TABLE (WorkingDate DATE);  
  
    INSERT INTO @DateTable  
    SELECT CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(m.n.value('.', 'NVARCHAR(50)'))) AS DATE)  
    FROM (  
        SELECT CAST('<XMLRoot><RowData>'   
            + REPLACE(@PreviousWorkingDates, ',', '</RowData><RowData>')   
            + '</RowData></XMLRoot>' AS XML) AS x  
    ) t  
    CROSS APPLY x.nodes('/XMLRoot/RowData') m(n);  
  
  
    -- Result Set 1  
    SELECT   
        cp.Estee_ID,  
        e.Exchange_Code,  
        AVG(cp.Volume) AS AvgVolume  
    FROM closingprice cp WITH (NOLOCK)  
    INNER JOIN esteemaster e WITH (NOLOCK)   
        ON cp.Estee_ID = e.Estee_ID  
    INNER JOIN @ExchangeTable ex   
        ON e.Exchange_Code = ex.Exchange_Code  
    WHERE cp.Date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate  
        AND e.Security_Type NOT IN   
            (SELECT TypeCode FROM SecurityType WHERE GroupID = 5)  
    GROUP BY cp.Estee_ID, e.Exchange_Code;  
  
  
    -- Result Set 2  
    SELECT   
        cp.Date,  
        cp.Estee_ID,  
        e.Exchange_Code,  
        e.Security_Type,  
        cp.Open_Interest  
    FROM closingprice cp WITH (NOLOCK)  
    INNER JOIN esteemaster e WITH (NOLOCK)   
        ON cp.Estee_ID = e.Estee_ID  
    INNER JOIN @ExchangeTable ex   
        ON e.Exchange_Code = ex.Exchange_Code  
    INNER JOIN @DateTable dt   
        ON cp.Date = dt.WorkingDate  
    WHERE e.Security_Type NOT IN   
            (SELECT TypeCode FROM SecurityType WHERE GroupID = 5)  
        AND cp.Open_Interest > 0  
    ORDER BY cp.Date DESC;  
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetMandateForStrategyCategoryClearingAccount

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetMandateForStrategyCategoryClearingAccount]
@CategoryID INT,
@ClearingAccountID INT,
@DimensionId INT,
@RiskParamId INT,
@TotalRiskParamValue DECIMAL(18, 6) OUTPUT

AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Declare variables
    DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);
    DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;
    DECLARE @ErrorState INT;
	DECLARE @tempDate DATE = CONVERT(date,getdate())  
	DECLARE @cutOffTime TIME  
	DECLARE @tempDateTime TIME = CONVERT(TIME,GETDATE())  
	DECLARE @minDate DATE = '0001-01-01'  
	SELECT @cutOffTime = value from datainit where ApplicationID = 0 and Parameter = 'TradeDateCutOffTime'  
  
	IF @tempDateTime between '00:00:00' and @cutOffTime  
	BEGIN  
	 SET @tempDate = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE() - 1)  
	END 

	select @tempDate
    BEGIN TRY
        -- Get all active strategy accounts for the given Category and ClearingAccount
        -- Then sum up their RiskParameterValue from RiskLimits table
      
        SELECT @TotalRiskParamValue = ISNULL(SUM(CAST(COALESCE(rlTemp.RiskParameterValue, rlMin.RiskParameterValue) AS DECIMAL(18,6))),0) --ISNULL(SUM(CAST(rl.RiskParameterValue AS DECIMAL(18, 6))), 0)
        FROM Strategy_New sn 
        INNER JOIN StrategyGroup sg ON sn.Strategy_Id = sg.StrategyID 
        INNER JOIN StrategyBrokerAccount sb ON sb.subStrategyID = sn.SubStrategy_Id 
        INNER JOIN Account ac ON ac.Account_ID = sb.accountID
        INNER JOIN ClearingAccount ca ON ca.ClearingAccountID = ac.ClearingAccountID 
        LEFT JOIN RiskLimits rlTemp
		ON rlTemp.DimensionValue = CAST(sb.AccountID AS VARCHAR) + '_' + CAST(sn.SubStrategy_Id AS VARCHAR)
	    AND rlTemp.DimensionId = @DimensionId
	    AND rlTemp.RiskParamId = @RiskParamId
	    AND rlTemp.Date = @tempDate

		LEFT JOIN RiskLimits rlMin
		ON rlMin.DimensionValue = CAST(sb.AccountID AS VARCHAR) + '_' + CAST(sn.SubStrategy_Id AS VARCHAR)
	    AND rlMin.DimensionId = @DimensionId
	    AND rlMin.RiskParamId = @RiskParamId
	    AND rlMin.Date = @minDate
        WHERE sn.Strategy_Status = 1 
          AND ac.Status = 'Active'
          AND sg.CategoryID = @CategoryID
          AND ca.ClearingAccountID = @ClearingAccountID --and rl.Date=@tempDate;

        -- Return the sum as a result set as well
        SELECT @TotalRiskParamValue AS TotalRiskParameterValue;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        SELECT 
            @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
            @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),
            @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();

        -- Return error information
        RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, @ErrorSeverity, @ErrorState);
    END CATCH
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetMarginDetailsForAllExchanges

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].spGetMarginDetailsForAllExchanges                          
@UnderlyingEsteeIds varchar(Max),                                
@RunDate date,                                
@PreviousWorkingDate date,                                
@MaxExpiryDate date,                          
@NewSpanId varchar(5),
@exgCode varchar(2) = 'IS'
as              
begin              
declare @UnderlyingEsteeIdsTemp varchar(max)                                
declare @RunDateTemp date                                
declare @PreviousWorkingDateTemp date                                
declare @MaxExpiryDateTemp date                                
if(@UnderlyingEsteeIds like '%subscriptionlist%') BEGIN ��� select @UnderlyingEsteeIdsTemp = COALESCE(@UnderlyingEsteeIdsTemp+',' ,'') + e.UnderlyingEstee_Id� from subscriptionlist s ��� inner join dbo.Split(@UnderlyingEsteeIds,',') r on cast(s.SubStrategyID as varchar) = r.items ��� inner join esteemaster e on e.Estee_ID = s.Estee_Id ��� set @UnderlyingEsteeIds = @UnderlyingEsteeIdsTemp END ELSE BEGIN ��� set @UnderlyingEsteeIdsTemp = @UnderlyingEsteeIds�������������� END                            
set @RunDateTemp = @RunDate                                
set @PreviousWorkingDateTemp = @PreviousWorkingDate                                
set @MaxExpiryDateTemp = @MaxExpiryDate                                
declare @defaultExposureMarginDate date = '0001-01-01'                                                                
declare @exposureMarginDate date = @RunDateTemp                                
declare @spanId varchar(10)                              
if @NewSpanId is null                          
Begin                          
 select distinct @spanId = SpanID from Span_Sequence where Exchange = @exgCode and SequenceID = 1                             
End                          
else                          
begin                          
 set @spanId = @NewSpanId                          
end                          
select @exposureMarginDate = MAX(Asofdate) from MarginTable where Exchange_Code = @exgCode and asofdate > DATEADD(d, -31, @RunDateTemp)            
set @exposureMarginDate =  @RunDateTemp          
select Estee_id, ExposureMarginFutures, ExposureMarginOptions into #exposureMargin from MarginTable where Exchange_Code = @exgCode and AsOfDate = @exposureMarginDate                                
insert into #exposureMargin                                
select m.Estee_id, m.ExposureMarginFutures, m.ExposureMarginOptions from MarginTable m left join #exposureMargin mTemp                                 
on mTemp.Estee_id = m.Estee_id                                
where  m.AsOfDate = @defaultExposureMarginDate and m.Exchange_Code = @exgCode and mTemp.Estee_id is null                            
                          
select LTRIM(RTRIM(r.items)) UndEsteeId, isnull(sd.ltp, c.Close_Price) UndLTP into #underlyingEsteeIds from dbo.Split(@UnderlyingEsteeIdsTemp,',') r                            
left join spanData sd on sd.EsteeID = LTRIM(RTRIM(r.items)) and sd.spanID = @spanId and sd.date = @RunDate                          
left join closingprice c on c.Estee_ID = LTRIM(RTRIM(r.items)) and c.Date = @PreviousWorkingDateTemp                              
                          
select e.Estee_ID, u.UndEsteeId, u.UndLTP, case when LEN(e.Estee_ID) > 26 then m.ExposureMarginOptions else m.ExposureMarginFutures end ELM, CONVERT(VARCHAR, e.Expiry_Date, 112) Expiry_Date                                
into #AllContracts from esteemaster (nolock) e                                 
inner join #underlyingEsteeIds u                                 
on e.UnderlyingEstee_Id = u.UndEsteeId                                 
left join #exposureMargin m on m.Estee_id = e.Estee_ID                                
where Expiry_Date <= @MaxExpiryDateTemp                                
update a set a.ELM =  case when LEN(a.Estee_ID) > 26 then m.ExposureMarginOptions else m.ExposureMarginFutures end from #AllContracts a                                 
inner join #exposureMargin m on a.UndEsteeId= m.Estee_id           
where a.ELM is null                                
  
select srv.esteeId, r1, r2, r3, r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, r9, r10, r11, r12, r13, r14, r15, r16, sd.compositeDelta*10000 compositeDelta, c.ELM, suc.SpreadCharge,                 
suc.ShortOptMinCharge somc, sd.LTP*10000 LTP, c.UndLTP*10000 UndLTP, c.Expiry_Date into #finalSpanData              
from SpanRiskValues srv                                 
inner join #AllContracts c on srv.esteeID = c.Estee_ID and srv.date = @RunDateTemp                                
inner join SpanData sd on sd.esteeID=c.Estee_ID and sd.date= @RunDateTemp and sd.spanID = @spanId                                
inner join SpanUndCharge suc on suc.esteeID = c.UndEsteeId and suc.date = @RunDateTemp and suc.spanID = @spanId                                
where srv.date = @RunDateTemp and srv.spanID = @spanId       
  
select X.UnderlyingEstee_Id, X.Estee_ID into #defaultSpanList from (                              
select e.UnderlyingEstee_Id, e.Estee_ID, ROW_NUMBER() over (Partition by e.UnderlyingEstee_Id order by e.expiry_date) RowNo                              
from esteemaster e inner join dbo.Split(@UnderlyingEsteeIds,',') r on e.UnderlyingEstee_Id = r.items                              
inner join SecurityType s on s.TypeCode = e.Security_Type                              
where s.GroupID = 3  and cast(substring(r.items,15,2) as int) in (4, 10)) X where X.RowNo = 1    
  
select c.UnderlyingEstee_Id, r1, r2, r3, r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, r9, r10, r11, r12, r13, r14, r15, r16 into #defaultSpanMargin                              
from SpanRiskValues srv                                 
inner join #defaultSpanList c on srv.esteeID = c.Estee_Id and srv.date = @RunDateTemp                                
where srv.date = @RunDateTemp and srv.spanID = @spanId                              
  
update f set f.r1 = d.r1, f.r2 = d.r2, f.r3 = d.r3, f.r4 = d.r4, f.r5 = d.r5, f.r6 = d.r6, f.r7 = d.r7, f.r8 = d.r8, f.r9 = d.r9,                              
f.r10 = d.r10, f.r11 = d.r11, f.r12 = d.r12, f.r13 = d.r13, f.r14 = d.r14, f.r15 = d.r15, f.r16 = d.r16                              
from #finalSpanData f inner join #defaultSpanMargin d on f.esteeID = d.UnderlyingEstee_Id        
  
select * from #finalSpanData                              
  
drop table #underlyingEsteeIds                                
drop table #AllContracts                                
drop table #exposureMargin                               
drop table #finalSpanData                              
drop table #defaultSpanList                              
drop table #defaultSpanMargin                              
End
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetMarginDetailsForAllExchangesAndMCX

```sql


-- SP: Get Margin Details for MCX and all other exchanges

CREATE procedure spGetMarginDetailsForAllExchangesAndMCX
@UnderlyingEsteeIds varchar(Max),
@RunDate date,
@PreviousWorkingDate date,
@MaxExpiryDate date,
@NewSpanId varchar(5),
@exgCode varchar(2) = 'IS'
as
begin
declare @UnderlyingEsteeIdsTemp varchar(max)
declare @RunDateTemp date
declare @PreviousWorkingDateTemp date
declare @MaxExpiryDateTemp date
if(@UnderlyingEsteeIds like '%subscriptionlist%') BEGIN  select @UnderlyingEsteeIdsTemp = COALESCE(@UnderlyingEsteeIdsTemp+',' ,'') + e.UnderlyingEstee_Id from subscriptionlist s  inner join dbo.Split(@UnderlyingEsteeIds,',') r on cast(s.SubStrategyID as varchar) = r.items  inner join esteemaster e on e.Estee_ID = s.Estee_Id  set @UnderlyingEsteeIds = @UnderlyingEsteeIdsTemp END ELSE BEGIN  set @UnderlyingEsteeIdsTemp = @UnderlyingEsteeIds END
set @RunDateTemp = @RunDate
set @PreviousWorkingDateTemp = @PreviousWorkingDate
set @MaxExpiryDateTemp = @MaxExpiryDate
declare @defaultExposureMarginDate date = '0001-01-01'
declare @exposureMarginDate date = @RunDateTemp
declare @spanId varchar(10)
if @NewSpanId is null
Begin
select distinct @spanId = SpanID from Span_Sequence where Exchange = @exgCode and SequenceID = 1
End
else
begin
set @spanId = @NewSpanId
end

select @exposureMarginDate = MAX(Asofdate) from MarginTable where Exchange_Code = @exgCode and asofdate > DATEADD(d, -31, @RunDateTemp)
set @exposureMarginDate =  @RunDateTemp
select Estee_id, ExposureMarginFutures, ExposureMarginOptions into #exposureMargin from MarginTable where Exchange_Code = @exgCode and AsOfDate = @exposureMarginDate

insert into #exposureMargin
select m.Estee_id, m.ExposureMarginFutures, m.ExposureMarginOptions from MarginTable m left join #exposureMargin mTemp
on mTemp.Estee_id = m.Estee_id
where  m.AsOfDate = @defaultExposureMarginDate and m.Exchange_Code = @exgCode and mTemp.Estee_id is null

select LTRIM(RTRIM(r.items)) UndEsteeId, isnull(sd.ltp, c.Close_Price) UndLTP into #underlyingEsteeIds from dbo.Split(@UnderlyingEsteeIdsTemp,',') r
left join spanData sd on sd.EsteeID = LTRIM(RTRIM(r.items)) and sd.spanID = @spanId and sd.date = @RunDate
left join closingprice c on c.Estee_ID = LTRIM(RTRIM(r.items)) and c.Date = @PreviousWorkingDateTemp

IF @exgCode = 'MX'
BEGIN
	-- For MCX options contracts has future contracts as underlyiny. So adding future contracts in underlylingEsteeIds.
	insert into #underlyingEsteeIds
	select e.Estee_ID as UndEsteeId, isnull(sd.ltp, c.Close_Price) UndLTP
	from dbo.Split(@UnderlyingEsteeIdsTemp,',') r
	inner join esteemaster e on e.UnderlyingEstee_Id = LTRIM(RTRIM(r.items))
	left join spanData sd on sd.EsteeID = e.Estee_ID and sd.spanID = @spanId and sd.date = @RunDate
	left join closingprice c on c.Estee_ID = e.Estee_ID and c.Date = @PreviousWorkingDateTemp
	WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM #underlyingEsteeIds u
        WHERE u.UndEsteeId = e.Estee_ID
    )
END

select e.Estee_ID, u.UndEsteeId, u.UndLTP, case when LEN(e.Estee_ID) > 26 then m.ExposureMarginOptions else m.ExposureMarginFutures end ELM, CONVERT(VARCHAR, e.Expiry_Date, 112) Expiry_Date
into #AllContracts from esteemaster (nolock) e
inner join #underlyingEsteeIds u
on e.UnderlyingEstee_Id = u.UndEsteeId
left join #exposureMargin m on m.Estee_id = e.Estee_ID
where Expiry_Date <= @MaxExpiryDateTemp
update a set a.ELM =  case when LEN(a.Estee_ID) > 26 then m.ExposureMarginOptions else m.ExposureMarginFutures end from #AllContracts a
inner join #exposureMargin m on a.UndEsteeId= m.Estee_id
where a.ELM is null

IF @exgCode = 'MX'
BEGIN
	-- For commodity exposure margin value, we are using ELMShort (if it is 0 then use ELMLong). Need to revisit this later.
	update a set a.ELM =  CASE WHEN cdm.ELMShort = 0 THEN cdm.ELMLong ELSE cdm.ELMShort END from #AllContracts a
	inner join CommodityDailyMargin cdm on a.Estee_ID = cdm.Estee_ID and cdm.AsOfDate = @RunDate
	where a.ELM is null
	update a set a.ELM =  CASE WHEN cdm.ELMShort = 0 THEN cdm.ELMLong ELSE cdm.ELMShort END from #AllContracts a
	inner join CommodityDailyMargin cdm on a.UndEsteeId = cdm.Estee_ID and cdm.AsOfDate = @RunDate
	where a.ELM is null

	update a set a.ELM = a2.ELM from #AllContracts a INNER JOIN #AllContracts a2 on a2.UndEsteeId = a.Estee_ID  and a.Estee_ID != a2.Estee_ID
	where a.ELM is null

	UPDATE opt SET opt.UndEsteeId = fut.UndEsteeId FROM #AllContracts opt
	INNER JOIN #AllContracts fut ON opt.UndEsteeId = fut.Estee_ID
	WHERE LEN(opt.Estee_ID) > 26  AND opt.UndEsteeId != fut.UndEsteeId
END

select srv.esteeId, r1, r2, r3, r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, r9, r10, r11, r12, r13, r14, r15, r16, sd.compositeDelta*10000 compositeDelta, c.ELM, suc.SpreadCharge,
suc.ShortOptMinCharge somc, sd.LTP*10000 LTP, c.UndLTP*10000 UndLTP, c.Expiry_Date into #finalSpanData
from SpanRiskValues srv
inner join #AllContracts c on srv.esteeID = c.Estee_ID and srv.date = @RunDateTemp
inner join SpanData sd on sd.esteeID=c.Estee_ID and sd.date= @RunDateTemp and sd.spanID = @spanId
inner join SpanUndCharge suc on suc.esteeID = c.UndEsteeId and suc.date = @RunDateTemp and suc.spanID = @spanId
where srv.date = @RunDateTemp and srv.spanID = @spanId

select X.UnderlyingEstee_Id, X.Estee_ID into #defaultSpanList from (
select e.UnderlyingEstee_Id, e.Estee_ID, ROW_NUMBER() over (Partition by e.UnderlyingEstee_Id order by e.expiry_date) RowNo
from esteemaster e inner join dbo.Split(@UnderlyingEsteeIds,',') r on e.UnderlyingEstee_Id = r.items
inner join SecurityType s on s.TypeCode = e.Security_Type
where s.GroupID = 3  and cast(substring(r.items,15,2) as int) in (4, 10)) X where X.RowNo = 1

select c.UnderlyingEstee_Id, r1, r2, r3, r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, r9, r10, r11, r12, r13, r14, r15, r16 into #defaultSpanMargin
from SpanRiskValues srv
inner join #defaultSpanList c on srv.esteeID = c.Estee_Id and srv.date = @RunDateTemp
where srv.date = @RunDateTemp and srv.spanID = @spanId

update f set f.r1 = d.r1, f.r2 = d.r2, f.r3 = d.r3, f.r4 = d.r4, f.r5 = d.r5, f.r6 = d.r6, f.r7 = d.r7, f.r8 = d.r8, f.r9 = d.r9,
f.r10 = d.r10, f.r11 = d.r11, f.r12 = d.r12, f.r13 = d.r13, f.r14 = d.r14, f.r15 = d.r15, f.r16 = d.r16
from #finalSpanData f inner join #defaultSpanMargin d on f.esteeID = d.UnderlyingEstee_Id

select * from #finalSpanData

drop table #underlyingEsteeIds
drop table #AllContracts
drop table #exposureMargin
drop table #finalSpanData
drop table #defaultSpanList
drop table #defaultSpanMargin
End

```

```sql
CREATE procedure spGetMarginDetailsNewSpanID      
@UnderlyingEsteeIds varchar(Max),      
@RunDate date,      
@PreviousWorkingDate date,      
@MaxExpiryDate date,  
@NewSpanId varchar(5) = null  
As      
Begin      
declare @UnderlyingEsteeIdsTemp varchar(max)      
declare @RunDateTemp date      
declare @PreviousWorkingDateTemp date      
declare @MaxExpiryDateTemp date      
set @UnderlyingEsteeIdsTemp = @UnderlyingEsteeIds      
set @RunDateTemp = @RunDate      
set @PreviousWorkingDateTemp = @PreviousWorkingDate      
set @MaxExpiryDateTemp = @MaxExpiryDate      
declare @defaultExposureMarginDate date = '0001-01-01'      
declare @exgCode varchar(2) = 'IS'      
declare @exposureMarginDate date = @RunDateTemp      
declare @spanId varchar(10)    
if @NewSpanId is null  
Begin  
 select distinct @spanId = SpanID from Span_Sequence where Exchange = @exgCode and SequenceID = 1   
End  
else  
begin  
 set @spanId = @NewSpanId  
end  
select @exposureMarginDate = MAX(Asofdate) from MarginTable where Exchange_Code = @exgCode and asofdate > DATEADD(d, -31, @RunDateTemp)      
select Estee_id, ExposureMarginFutures, ExposureMarginOptions into #exposureMargin from MarginTable where Exchange_Code = @exgCode and AsOfDate = @exposureMarginDate      
insert into #exposureMargin      
select m.Estee_id, m.ExposureMarginFutures, m.ExposureMarginOptions from MarginTable m left join #exposureMargin mTemp       
on mTemp.Estee_id = m.Estee_id      
where  m.AsOfDate = @defaultExposureMarginDate and m.Exchange_Code = @exgCode and mTemp.Estee_id is null  
  
select LTRIM(RTRIM(r.items)) UndEsteeId, isnull(sd.ltp, c.Close_Price) UndLTP into #underlyingEsteeIds from dbo.Split(@UnderlyingEsteeIdsTemp,',') r  
left join spanData sd on sd.EsteeID = LTRIM(RTRIM(r.items)) and sd.spanID = @spanId and sd.date = @RunDate  
left join closingprice c on c.Estee_ID = LTRIM(RTRIM(r.items)) and c.Date = @PreviousWorkingDateTemp    
  
select e.Estee_ID, u.UndEsteeId, u.UndLTP, case when LEN(e.Estee_ID) > 26 then m.ExposureMarginOptions else m.ExposureMarginFutures end ELM       
into #AllContracts from esteemaster (nolock) e       
inner join #underlyingEsteeIds u       
on e.UnderlyingEstee_Id = u.UndEsteeId       
left join #exposureMargin m on m.Estee_id = e.Estee_ID      
where Expiry_Date <= @MaxExpiryDateTemp      
update a set a.ELM =  case when LEN(a.Estee_ID) > 26 then m.ExposureMarginOptions else m.ExposureMarginFutures end from #AllContracts a       
inner join #exposureMargin m on a.UndEsteeId= m.Estee_id      
where a.ELM is null      
select srv.esteeId, r1, r2, r3, r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, r9, r10, r11, r12, r13, r14, r15, r16, sd.compositeDelta, c.ELM, suc.SpreadCharge,      
suc.ShortOptMinCharge somc, sd.LTP, c.UndLTP into #finalSpanData    
from SpanRiskValues srv       
inner join #AllContracts c on srv.esteeID = c.Estee_ID and srv.date = @RunDateTemp      
inner join SpanData sd on sd.esteeID=c.Estee_ID and sd.date= @RunDateTemp and sd.spanID = @spanId      
inner join SpanUndCharge suc on suc.esteeID = c.UndEsteeId and suc.date = @RunDateTemp and suc.spanID = @spanId      
where srv.date = @RunDateTemp and srv.spanID = @spanId     
select X.UnderlyingEstee_Id, X.Estee_ID into #defaultSpanList from (    
select e.UnderlyingEstee_Id, e.Estee_ID, ROW_NUMBER() over (Partition by e.UnderlyingEstee_Id order by e.expiry_date) RowNo    
from esteemaster e inner join dbo.Split(@UnderlyingEsteeIds,',') r on e.UnderlyingEstee_Id = r.items    
inner join SecurityType s on s.TypeCode = e.Security_Type    
where s.GroupID = 3  and cast(substring(r.items,15,2) as int) in (4, 10)) X where X.RowNo = 1    
select c.UnderlyingEstee_Id, r1, r2, r3, r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, r9, r10, r11, r12, r13, r14, r15, r16 into #defaultSpanMargin    
from SpanRiskValues srv       
inner join #defaultSpanList c on srv.esteeID = c.Estee_Id and srv.date = @RunDateTemp      
where srv.date = @RunDateTemp and srv.spanID = @spanId    
update f set f.r1 = d.r1, f.r2 = d.r2, f.r3 = d.r3, f.r4 = d.r4, f.r5 = d.r5, f.r6 = d.r6, f.r7 = d.r7, f.r8 = d.r8, f.r9 = d.r9,    
f.r10 = d.r10, f.r11 = d.r11, f.r12 = d.r12, f.r13 = d.r13, f.r14 = d.r14, f.r15 = d.r15, f.r16 = d.r16    
from #finalSpanData f inner join #defaultSpanMargin d on f.esteeID = d.UnderlyingEstee_Id    
select * from #finalSpanData    
drop table #underlyingEsteeIds      
drop table #AllContracts      
drop table #exposureMargin     
drop table #finalSpanData    
drop table #defaultSpanList    
drop table #defaultSpanMargin    
End
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetMatchedTradesForLiveMatching

```sql
Create PROCEDURE spGetMatchedTradesForLiveMatching      
@tradeDateIn DATE,                 
@keys varchar(500)  = null   
AS          
     BEGIN   
 declare @tradeDate DATE                 
 set @tradeDate = @tradeDateIn     

 if(@keys is not null or @keys <>'')
 BEGIN
 select  dbo.columnsplit(items, 1, '_') AS exgOrdId ,dbo.columnsplit(items, 2, '_') AS execId,
  dbo.columnsplit(items, 3, '_') AS BuySell,dbo.columnsplit(items, 4, '_') AS traded_quantity,   dbo.columnsplit(items, 5, '_') AS AccountId,
  dbo.columnsplit(items, 6, '_') AS EmsId into #temp from dbo.Split(@keys,',')
        
  SELECT t.Buy_Sell_Indicator AS BuyOrSell, t.traded_quantity AS TradedQuantity,             
  t.ExecId, o.exchange_order_id AS ExOrderId, a.Account_ID AS AccountId, o.Ems_ID EmsId ,t.Estee_ID as Estee_Id, t.Traded_Price as Traded_Price
  FROM [Order] o WITH (nolock) INNER JOIN ordertrades ot WITH (nolock) ON o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID AND o.creation_date = ot.creation_date           
  INNER JOIN trades t WITH (nolock) ON t.ordertrade_id = ot.ordertrade_id  and t.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID AND t.creation_date = ot.creation_date AND t.Traded_Quantity<>0             
  INNER JOIN Account a ON o.Account_ID = a.Account_ID          
  LEFT JOIN esteemaster e WITH (nolock) ON e.estee_id = t.estee_id AND e.Status = 1       
  Inner join #temp c on c.EMSId = o.Ems_ID and c.AccountId= a.Account_ID and c.BuySell = t.Buy_Sell_Indicator and c.execId = t.ExecID and c.exgOrdId = o.Exchange_Order_ID
  WHERE o.Creation_Date = @tradeDate    
  AND ot.status IN ('Executed', 'Partially Filled') 
  AND o.order_source_id NOT IN('Odin', 'ECM','OdinDirectTransfer','Balancing','New Balancing')                     
  AND  ot.Remarks = 'Missing trade' 
  drop table #temp
  END
   else
   BEGIN
    SELECT t.Buy_Sell_Indicator AS BuyOrSell, t.traded_quantity AS TradedQuantity,             
  t.ExecId, o.exchange_order_id AS ExOrderId, a.Account_ID AS AccountId, o.Ems_ID EmsId ,t.Estee_ID as Estee_Id, t.Traded_Price as Traded_Price      
  FROM [Order] o WITH (nolock) INNER JOIN ordertrades ot WITH (nolock) ON o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID AND o.creation_date = ot.creation_date           
  INNER JOIN trades t WITH (nolock) ON t.ordertrade_id = ot.ordertrade_id  and t.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID AND t.creation_date = ot.creation_date AND t.Traded_Quantity<>0             
  INNER JOIN Account a ON o.Account_ID = a.Account_ID          
  LEFT JOIN esteemaster e WITH (nolock) ON e.estee_id = t.estee_id AND e.Status = 1       
  WHERE o.Creation_Date = @tradeDate    
  AND ot.status IN ('Executed', 'Partially Filled') 
  AND o.order_source_id NOT IN('Odin', 'ECM','OdinDirectTransfer','Balancing','New Balancing')                     
  AND  ot.Remarks = 'Missing trade' 
  END
      END           

```

```sql
Create procedure spGetModelPriceInfo  
@locationCode varchar(6)  
  
As  
Begin  
  
if @locationCode = '' or @locationCode = 'EODJOB'  
Begin  
  
select m.UndEsteeId, em.Estee_ID, m.SecurityTypes, em.Security_Type, m.ModelAPIName, m.ModelClassName, m.ModelParamConfig  from ModelPriceEngine m inner join esteemaster em  
on substring(m.UndEsteeId,0,15) = SUBSTRING(em.Estee_ID,0,15)  
cross apply dbo.Split(m.SecurityTypes,',') as r   
where r.items = em.Security_Type and m.LocationCode = 'EODJOB'  
end  
else

 select distinct m.UndEsteeId, em.Estee_ID, m.SecurityTypes, em.Security_Type, m.ModelAPIName, m.ModelClassName, m.ModelParamConfig  from ModelPriceEngine m inner join esteemaster em  
 on substring(m.UndEsteeId,0,15) = SUBSTRING(em.Estee_ID,0,15)   
 cross apply dbo.Split(m.SecurityTypes,',') as r   
 where r.items = em.Security_Type and m.LocationCode = @locationCode  
end  
  
end
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetMostActiveContracts

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetMostActiveContracts] 
@EXCHANGE_CODE VARCHAR(2), @STARTDATE DATETIME, @COUNT INT, @IGNORE_ZERO_VOL smallint = 0
AS          
BEGIN  
SELECT X.SECURITY_TYPE,X.ESTEE_ID,X.TRADES,X.VOLUME,X.NET_TRADED_VAL , X.RANKING
FROM
(
SELECT E.SECURITY_TYPE,E.ESTEE_ID,SUM(C.VOLUME) AS VOLUME,SUM(C.TRADES) AS TRADES, SUM(C.NET_TRADED_VAL) AS  NET_TRADED_VAL,
       RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY E.SECURITY_TYPE ORDER BY SUM(C.TRADES) DESC, SUM(C.VOLUME) DESC, SUM(C.NET_TRADED_VAL) DESC,E.ESTEE_ID ASC) AS RANKING 
FROM CLOSINGPRICE (NOLOCK) AS C
INNER JOIN ESTEEMASTER (NOLOCK) AS E
ON E.EXCHANGE_CODE =@EXCHANGE_CODE AND C.DATE >= @STARTDATE AND C.ESTEE_ID = E.ESTEE_ID 
GROUP BY E.SECURITY_TYPE, E.ESTEE_ID
) X
WHERE X.RANKING<=@COUNT  AND (@IGNORE_ZERO_VOL = 1 OR X.VOLUME >0)
ORDER BY X.SECURITY_TYPE, X.RANKING
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetMultiEmsListForCUI

```sql
    
Create procedure [dbo].[spGetMultiEmsListForCUI]            
AS 
create table #TEMPMULTIEMS (SubStrategyID int, EMSApplicationID varchar(max), EMSEMBServerType varchar(50))  
DECLARE cur2 CURSOR for select substrategy_id, value from datainit where Parameter = 'MultiEMS'  
declare @sid1 int      
declare @listofems1 varchar(max)      
open cur2      
fetch next from cur2 into @sid1, @listofems1      
  
while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0      
begin      
   insert into #TEMPMULTIEMS (SubStrategyID, EMSApplicationID)  
      select @sid1, * from dbo.Split(@listofems1, ',')  
      fetch next from cur2 INTO @sid1, @listofems1          
end          
deallocate cur2       
  
select distinct temp.SubStrategyID as SubStrategyID,  SUBSTRING(temp.EMSApplicationID, 0, 7) EMSApplicationID,  
case   
when temp.emsembservertype is not null then temp.emsembservertype  
when LEN(temp.EMSApplicationID) = 6 then 'MSMQ' else  
SUBSTRING(temp.EMSApplicationID, charindex('-',temp.EMSApplicationID, 0) + 1, LEN(temp.EMSApplicationID)) end EMSEMBServerType
from #TEMPMULTIEMS temp  
inner join exchangeadapterlogindetails tb on tb.EMSApplicationID = SUBSTRING(temp.EMSApplicationID, 0, 7)--temp.EMSApplicationID          
order by temp.SubStrategyID, EMSApplicationID 
drop table #TEMPMULTIEMS  
 


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetMultiExchangeEMSForCUI

```sql

CREATE procedure [dbo].[spGetMultiExchangeEMSForCUI]            
AS   
create table #TEMPMULTIEMS (SubStrategyID int, EMSApplicationID varchar(max), EMSEMBServerType varchar(50))  
  
insert into #TEMPMULTIEMS (SubStrategyID, EMSApplicationID, EMSEMBServerType)  
select EA.substrategy_id, EA.ems_application_id, ISNULL(DI1.Value, 'MSMQ') EMSEMBServerType from EsteeApplications EA  
left join DataInit DI1 on EA.SubStrategy_ID = DI1.substrategy_id and DI1.Parameter = 'EMSEMBServerType'  
where EA.substrategy_id is not null and EA.SubStrategy_ID not in (select substrategy_id from datainit where Parameter = 'MultiExchange')  
  
DECLARE cur2 CURSOR for select substrategy_id, value from datainit where Parameter = 'MultiExchange'  
declare @sid1 int      
declare @listofems1 varchar(max)      
open cur2      
fetch next from cur2 into @sid1, @listofems1      
  
while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0      
begin      
   insert into #TEMPMULTIEMS (SubStrategyID, EMSApplicationID)  
      select @sid1, * from dbo.Split(@listofems1, ',')  
      fetch next from cur2 INTO @sid1, @listofems1          
end          
deallocate cur2       
  
select distinct temp.SubStrategyID as SubStrategyID,  SUBSTRING(temp.EMSApplicationID, 0, 7) EMSApplicationID,  
case   
when temp.emsembservertype is not null then temp.emsembservertype  
when LEN(temp.EMSApplicationID) = 6 then 'MSMQ' else  
SUBSTRING(temp.EMSApplicationID, charindex('-',temp.EMSApplicationID, 0) + 1, LEN(temp.EMSApplicationID)) end EMSEMBServerType, r.items as ExchangeCode  
from #TEMPMULTIEMS temp  
inner join exchangeadapterlogindetails tb on tb.EMSApplicationID = SUBSTRING(temp.EMSApplicationID, 0, 7)--temp.EMSApplicationID          
inner join ExchangeAdapter ea on ea.ID = tb.exchangeAdapterID    
inner join Strategy_New sn on sn.SubStrategy_Id = temp.SubStrategyID
cross apply dbo.Split(ea.exchangecode,',') as r 
where sn.Strategy_Status = 1
order by temp.SubStrategyID, EMSApplicationID, r.items  
drop table #TEMPMULTIEMS  
  

```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetNDClientSecuritySet
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT DISTINCT Estee_ID
	FROM esteemaster e
	INNER JOIN AllowedSecuritiesForFII b
	ON e.Estee_ID LIKE b.ISINFromEsteeId + '%'
	AND e.Security_Type = b.SecurityType
	AND e.Exchange_Code = b.ExchangeCode;
END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.spGetNeatLimitConfig
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @seqNo INT;
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetNewPasswordById
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@EsteeUserId int
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

   DECLARE @passCriteria INT    
  SELECT @passCriteria=PasswordCriteria FROM EsteeUser WHERE EsteeUserId = @EsteeUserId
       
  DECLARE @maxId INT    
  SELECT @maxId=MAX(ID) FROM EMSPASSWORDS where PassCriteria = @passCriteria
     
  DECLARE @currentIndex INT
  SELECT @currentIndex=PasswordIndex FROM EsteeUser WHERE EsteeUserId = @EsteeUserId  
     
  IF (@currentIndex = @maxId OR @currentIndex = 0)
  BEGIN    
   SELECT @currentIndex = MIN(ID) FROM EMSPASSWORDS where PassCriteria = @passCriteria    
  END    
  ELSE    
  BEGIN    
   select @currentIndex = MIN(id) from EMSPasswords where PassCriteria = @passCriteria and Id > @currentIndex
  END    
      
  SELECT [Password] as NewPassword, [id] as NewPasswordIndex FROM EMSPasswords WHERE Id = @currentIndex and PassCriteria = @passCriteria

END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetNonRejectedReleaseSubTasks

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetNonRejectedReleaseSubTasks]
    @ReleaseRequestId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT
        [SubTaskId],
        [ReleaseRequestId],
        [TaskId],
        [BinaryPath],
        [OS],
        [Server],
        [Location],
        [ApplicationName],
        [ApplicationIds],
        [IsActive],
        [DeploymentStatus],
        [CreatedDate],
        [UpdatedTimestamp],
        [Comments]
    FROM [dbo].[ReleaseSubTask]
    WHERE [ReleaseRequestId] = @ReleaseRequestId
      AND [IsActive] = 1
      AND (
            [DeploymentStatus] IS NULL
            OR [DeploymentStatus] != 'Rejected'
          )
    ORDER BY
        [TaskId],
        [ApplicationName];
END;
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spGetNSEContractStreamInfoWithSpread]      
  
@ASOFDATE DATETIME = '',      
  
@SUBSCRIPTIONLISTNAME VARCHAR(100) = '',  
  
@APPLICATIONID INT = -1  
  
AS      
  
BEGIN      
  IF @APPLICATIONID <> -1 AND @SUBSCRIPTIONLISTNAME = ''  
 Begin  
  select @SUBSCRIPTIONLISTNAME = SubStrategy_Name from Strategy_New where SubStrategy_Id in  
  (select CAST(SubStrategy_ID as varchar) from EsteeApplications where ApplicationID = @APPLICATIONID)   
 End  
  
 IF @SUBSCRIPTIONLISTNAME <>''     
  
 SELECT E.ESTEE_ID,E.DATAFEED_TICKER,VC.SEGMENT,CSI.STREAM_ID,CSI.TOKEN, ISNULL(CSI.TOKEN2, 0) TOKEN2,E.LOT_SIZE,CID.CONTRACTID  
  
  FROM VALIDCOMBOS (nolock) AS VC      
  
  INNER JOIN ESTEEMASTER (nolock) AS E      
  
  ON E.EXCHANGE_CODE=VC.EXCHANGECODE AND E.EXCHANGE_CODE='IS' AND E.SECURITY_TYPE=VC.SECURITYTYPE      
  
  --AND E.SECURITY_TYPE NOT IN (SELECT TYPECODE FROM SECURITYTYPE WHERE TYPENAME LIKE '%SPREAD%')               
  AND E.TOKEN>0                       
  INNER JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_REALTIME (nolock) AS SR            
  ON SR.ESTEEID = E.ESTEE_ID AND SR.STRATEGY_NAME = @SUBSCRIPTIONLISTNAME                    
  INNER JOIN CONTRACTSTREAMINFO (nolock) AS CSI                   
  ON ((CSI.token2 = e.TOKEN2 AND CSI.TOKEN=E.TOKEN) OR (csi.Token2 = 0 AND CSI.TOKEN=E.TOKEN AND e.Token = e.TOKEN2))AND CSI.ASOFDATE=@ASOFDATE AND CSI.SEGMENT=VC.SEGMENT                 
  INNER JOIN CONTRACTIDS (nolock) AS CID                   
  ON (CID.ESTEEID = E.Estee_ID)   
  ORDER BY SEGMENT             
 ELSE            
SELECT E.ESTEE_ID,E.DATAFEED_TICKER,VC.SEGMENT,CSI.STREAM_ID,CSI.TOKEN,ISNULL(CSI.TOKEN2, 0) TOKEN2,E.LOT_SIZE,CID.CONTRACTID          
  FROM VALIDCOMBOS (nolock) AS VC         
  INNER JOIN ESTEEMASTER (nolock) AS E             
  ON E.EXCHANGE_CODE=VC.EXCHANGECODE AND E.EXCHANGE_CODE='IS' AND E.SECURITY_TYPE=VC.SECURITYTYPE            
  --AND E.SECURITY_TYPE NOT IN (SELECT TYPECODE FROM SECURITYTYPE WHERE TYPENAME LIKE '%SPREAD%')     
         
  AND E.TOKEN>0              
  INNER JOIN CONTRACTSTREAMINFO (nolock) AS CSI           
  ON ((CSI.token2 = e.TOKEN2 AND CSI.TOKEN=E.TOKEN) OR (csi.Token2 = 0 AND CSI.TOKEN=E.TOKEN AND e.Token = e.TOKEN2)) AND CSI.ASOFDATE=@ASOFDATE AND CSI.SEGMENT=VC.SEGMENT        
  INNER JOIN CONTRACTIDS (nolock) AS CID                   
  ON (CID.ESTEEID = E.ESTEE_ID)   
  ORDER BY SEGMENT               
END      
          
```
