## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetNseELMFactorForOptions

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetNseELMFactorForOptions] 

	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@PreviousDate as datetime=null
	--exec spGetNseELMFactorForOptions '20230109'
AS

BEGIN
	-- SELECT statements.  

	select distinct X.Estee_ID, X.ELM from (
	select distinct em.Estee_ID, 3 ELM from esteemaster em 
	left outer join EsteeMaster_archive ema on em.Estee_ID = ema.Estee_ID 
	join closingprice cp on em.UnderlyingEstee_Id = cp.Estee_ID where cp.Date = @PreviousDate 
	and  ((ISNULL(em.Security_Type, ema.Security_Type) = 7 and ISNULL(em.Strike_Price,ema.Strike_Price) < cp.Close_Price * 0.9) OR (ISNULL(em.Security_Type, ema.Security_Type) = 6 and ISNULL(em.Strike_Price,ema.Strike_Price) > cp.Close_Price * 1.1)) 
	and ISNULL(em.Expiry_Date,ema.Expiry_Date) <= cast (DATEADD(MM, 9, GETDATE()) as date) and ISNULL(em.Exchange_Code,ema.Exchange_Code) = 'IS'
	union
	select distinct em.Estee_ID, 5 ELM from esteemaster em 
	left outer join EsteeMaster_archive ema on em.Estee_ID = ema.Estee_ID
	join closingprice cp on em.UnderlyingEstee_Id = cp.Estee_ID where cp.Date = @PreviousDate 
	and ISNULL(em.Security_Type, ema.Security_Type) in (6,7) and ISNULL(em.Expiry_Date,ema.Expiry_Date) > cast (DATEADD(MM, 9, GETDATE()) as date) and ISNULL(em.Exchange_Code,ema.Exchange_Code) = 'IS'
	union
	select distinct em.Estee_ID, 5.25 ELM from esteemaster em 
	left outer join EsteeMaster_archive ema on em.Estee_ID = ema.Estee_ID 
	join closingprice cp on em.UnderlyingEstee_Id = cp.Estee_ID where cp.Date = @PreviousDate 
	and ((ISNULL(em.Security_Type, ema.Security_Type) = 3 and ISNULL(em.Strike_Price,ema.Strike_Price) < cp.Close_Price * 0.7) OR (ISNULL(em.Security_Type, ema.Security_Type) = 2 and ISNULL(em.Strike_Price,ema.Strike_Price) > cp.Close_Price * 1.3)) and em.Exchange_Code = 'IS'
	) X order by Estee_ID

END


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetNSEEsteeStructure

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetNSEEsteeStructure]  
@exchange varchar(10),  
@exchangeSegment varchar(50),  
@listEids varchar(max) = null,
@accountIds varchar(500) = null
AS  
BEGIN

declare @acc Table(AId int)
if @accountIds is not null
begin
	insert into @acc
	select a.items from dbo.Split(@accountIds,',') a
end

 if(@exchangeSegment='XX')  
 begin  
 set @exchangeSegment='CM,FO,CD,CO'  
 End  

 IF (@listEids is not null and @listEids != '')  
 BEGIN  
   if not exists (select 1 from @acc t where t.AId = 609)
  Begin
  SELECT nse.Estee_ID as EsteeId, nse.Token as Token, nse.Symbol as Symbol,  
  nse.InstrumentName as InstrumentName, nse.ExpiryDate as ExpiryDate, nse.StrikePrice as StrikePrice,  
  nse.Option_Type as OptionType, nse.Series as Series, nse.LotSize as LotSize, ci.ContractId as ContractID  
  from NSEEsteeStructure (nolock) nse  
  inner join ValidCombos vc (nolock) on vc.SecurityType = Cast(SUBSTRING(nse.estee_id, 15 ,2) as int)   
  inner join  CONTRACTIDS ci (nolock) on ci.EsteeId = nse.Estee_ID  
  cross apply dbo.Split(@listEids,',') as r  
  WHERE vc.ExchangeCode = @exchange and vc.Segment in ( select items from dbo.Split(@exchangeSegment,',') )   
  and r.items = nse.Estee_ID  and (nse.Series <> 'BE' or nse.Series is null) 
  end
  else
  begin
	  SELECT nse.Estee_ID as EsteeId, nse.Token as Token, nse.Symbol as Symbol,  
	  nse.InstrumentName as InstrumentName, nse.ExpiryDate as ExpiryDate, nse.StrikePrice as StrikePrice,  
	  nse.Option_Type as OptionType, nse.Series as Series, nse.LotSize as LotSize, ci.ContractId as ContractID  
	  from NSEEsteeStructure (nolock) nse  
	  inner join ValidCombos vc (nolock) on vc.SecurityType = Cast(SUBSTRING(nse.estee_id, 15 ,2) as int)   
	  inner join  CONTRACTIDS ci (nolock) on ci.EsteeId = nse.Estee_ID  
	  cross apply dbo.Split(@listEids,',') as r  
	  WHERE vc.ExchangeCode = @exchange and vc.Segment in ( select items from dbo.Split(@exchangeSegment,',') )   
	  and r.items = nse.Estee_ID 
  end
 END  
 ELSE   
 BEGIN  
  if not exists (select 1 from @acc t where t.AId = 609)
  Begin
	  SELECT nse.Estee_ID as EsteeId, nse.Token as Token, nse.Symbol as Symbol,  
	  nse.InstrumentName as InstrumentName, nse.ExpiryDate as ExpiryDate, nse.StrikePrice as StrikePrice,  
	  nse.Option_Type as OptionType, nse.Series as Series, nse.LotSize as LotSize, ci.ContractId as ContractID   
	  from NSEEsteeStructure (nolock) nse  
	  inner join ValidCombos vc (nolock) on vc.SecurityType = Cast(SUBSTRING(nse.estee_id, 15 ,2) as int)   
	  inner join  CONTRACTIDS ci (nolock) on ci.EsteeId = nse.Estee_ID   
	  WHERE vc.ExchangeCode = @exchange and vc.Segment in ( select items from dbo.Split(@exchangeSegment,','))  
	  and (nse.Series <> 'BE' or nse.Series is null)
  End
  Else
  Begin
	  SELECT nse.Estee_ID as EsteeId, nse.Token as Token, nse.Symbol as Symbol,  
	  nse.InstrumentName as InstrumentName, nse.ExpiryDate as ExpiryDate, nse.StrikePrice as StrikePrice,  
	  nse.Option_Type as OptionType, nse.Series as Series, nse.LotSize as LotSize, ci.ContractId as ContractID   
	  from NSEEsteeStructure (nolock) nse  
	  inner join ValidCombos vc (nolock) on vc.SecurityType = Cast(SUBSTRING(nse.estee_id, 15 ,2) as int)   
	  inner join  CONTRACTIDS ci (nolock) on ci.EsteeId = nse.Estee_ID   
	  WHERE vc.ExchangeCode = @exchange and vc.Segment in ( select items from dbo.Split(@exchangeSegment,','))	  
  End
 END  
END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.spGetNSIContractStreamInfoWithSpread
@ASOFDATE DATETIME = '',      
  
@SUBSCRIPTIONLISTNAME VARCHAR(100) = '',  
  
@APPLICATIONID INT = -1  
  
AS
 BEGIN

	IF @APPLICATIONID <> -1 AND @SUBSCRIPTIONLISTNAME = ''  
	Begin  
		select @SUBSCRIPTIONLISTNAME = SubStrategy_Name from Strategy_New where SubStrategy_Id in  
		(select CAST(SubStrategy_ID as varchar) from EsteeApplications where ApplicationID = @APPLICATIONID) 
	End  
	IF @SUBSCRIPTIONLISTNAME <> ''
    BEGIN
		SELECT E.ESTEE_ID, E.DATAFEED_TICKER, 'XX' as SEGMENT, CSI.STREAM_ID, CSI.TOKEN, ISNULL(CSI.TOKEN2, 0) AS TOKEN2, E.LOT_SIZE, CID.CONTRACTID
		FROM   ESTEEMASTER(nolock) AS E
			INNER JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_REALTIME(nolock) AS SR ON SR.ESTEEID = E.ESTEE_ID
				AND SR.STRATEGY_NAME = @SUBSCRIPTIONLISTNAME
			INNER JOIN CONTRACTSTREAMINFO(nolock) AS CSI ON(CSI.token2 = e.TOKEN2
				AND CSI.TOKEN = E.TOKEN
				OR csi.Token2 = 0
				AND CSI.TOKEN = E.TOKEN
				AND e.Token = e.TOKEN2)
				AND CSI.ASOFDATE = @ASOFDATE
				AND E.TOKEN > 0
				AND E.EXCHANGE_CODE = 'NI'
				AND CSI.EXCHANGECODE = 'NI'
			INNER JOIN CONTRACTIDS (nolock) AS CID  ON (CID.ESTEEID = E.ESTEE_ID)
		ORDER BY SEGMENT;
	END;
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT E.ESTEE_ID, E.DATAFEED_TICKER, 'XX' as SEGMENT, CSI.STREAM_ID, CSI.TOKEN, ISNULL(CSI.TOKEN2, 0) AS TOKEN2, E.LOT_SIZE, CID.CONTRACTID
		FROM   ESTEEMASTER(nolock) AS E
			INNER JOIN CONTRACTSTREAMINFO(nolock) AS CSI ON(CSI.token2 = e.TOKEN2
				AND CSI.TOKEN = E.TOKEN
				OR csi.Token2 = 0
				AND CSI.TOKEN = E.TOKEN
				AND e.Token = e.TOKEN2)
				AND CSI.ASOFDATE = @ASOFDATE
				AND E.TOKEN > 0
				AND E.EXCHANGE_CODE = 'NI'
			INNER JOIN CONTRACTIDS (nolock) AS CID  ON (CID.ESTEEID = E.ESTEE_ID)																								 AND CSI.EXCHANGECODE = 'NI'
		ORDER BY SEGMENT;
	END;
	END;
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetOidToLatestOtid

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spGetOidToLatestOtid]
@appID varchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
   SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED
   DECLARE @date as datetime
   SET @date = cast(convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 101) as datetime)
   -------------------------OrderID to LatestOTID mapping -----------------------------------------------
   ;WITH OT as
   (
    select case when Original_Order_ID > 0 then Original_Order_ID else OrderTrade_ID end as OrderTrade_ID, Order_ID, BrokerOrderTrade_ID, Creation_Date from OrderTrades  WITH (NOLOCK)
    where Status in ('Sent New','Accepted','Replaced','Partially Filled') AND Creation_Date = @date
   )
   SELECT distinct B.Order_ID as OrderId, OT.OrderTrade_ID as OrderTradeId
   FROM [Order] B WITH (NOLOCK)
   inner join  OT on B.Order_ID = OT.Order_ID and B.Creation_Date = OT.Creation_Date
   where B.Ems_ID = @appID 
   option (maxdop 1)
End
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetOperationalMetrics

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetOperationalMetrics]  
 @startDate date,            
 @endDate date             
AS            
BEGIN            
   SET NOCOUNT ON;            
 -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets FROM            
 -- interfering with SELECT statements.            
 DECLARE @numOfDays INT          
  
--select Exchange, securitygroup,   
--AVG(percentile_50) p50, avg(percentile_95) p95, avg(percentile_99) p99, avg([count]) [count]   
--from tblemstimesegmentwise  
--where date between @startDate and @endDate  
--group by exchange, securitygroup  
--order by exchange, securitygroup  
           
  
 SELECT serverID,             
 Parameter,             
 AVG(t8)             
 FROM OrderExec o            
 WHERE DATE between @startDate and @endDate             
 GROUP BY serverID, parameter            
 ORDER BY ServerID, parameter            
  
             
 SELECT @numOfDays = COUNT(DISTINCT Date) FROM OrderExec WHERE DATE  between @startDate and @endDate           
   
 --SELECT serverID, AVG(cast([count] as decimal(18,0)))           
 --FROM OrderExec o            
 --WHERE DATE between @startDate and @endDate             
 --AND Parameter = 'percentile_95'      
 --GROUP BY serverID        
 --ORDER BY ServerID      
      
 SELECT s.IP,              
 COUNT(*)/@numOfDays           
 FROM OrderTrades ot with (nolock)            
 INNER JOIN EsteeApplications ea with (nolock) on ea.SubStrategy_ID = ot.Sub_Strategy_ID            
 INNER JOIN EsteeServers s with (nolock) on s.ID = ea.EsteeServer_ID            
 WHERE ot.Creation_Date between @startDate and @endDate            
 GROUP BY s.IP            
 ORDER BY s.IP            
            
 SELECT s.IP,              
 COUNT(*)/@numOfDays           
 FROM estee_archive.dbo.OrderTrades ot with (nolock)            
 INNER JOIN EsteeApplications ea with (nolock) on ea.SubStrategy_ID = ot.Sub_Strategy_ID            
 INNER JOIN EsteeServers s with (nolock) on s.ID = ea.EsteeServer_ID            
 WHERE ot.Creation_Date between @startDate and @endDate            
 GROUP BY s.IP            
 ORDER BY s.IP            
  
            
             
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetOrderAnalyticEngine

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetOrderAnalyticEngine]          
AS        
BEGIN         
    SELECT 
        Name,        
        SUBSTRING(ReportClass, 0, CHARINDEX('^', ReportClass)) AS DllName,        
        Port,        
        SUBSTRING(ReportClass, CHARINDEX(':', ReportClass) + 1, LEN(ReportClass)) AS ClassName,    
        BatchKey        
    FROM 
        OrderAnalyticEngine 
    WHERE 
        Port IS NOT NULL 
        AND ReportClass IS NOT NULL   
        AND IsEnabled = 1     
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        Name,        
        SUBSTRING(ReportClass, 0, CHARINDEX('^', ReportClass)) AS DllName,        
        Port,        
        SUBSTRING(ReportClass, CHARINDEX(':', ReportClass) + 1, LEN(ReportClass)) AS ClassName,    
        BatchKey        
    FROM 
        ClearingRiskAlert
    WHERE 
        port IS NOT NULL 
        AND ReportClass IS NOT NULL   
END;


```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spGetOrderFromTradeOrderID] 
	@OrderTrade_ID varchar(50),
	@date date
AS
BEGIN
    --Select Lot_Size, Estee_ID,[Status],remarks from Trades where trade_id = @trade_id
	Select 
	o.Order_ID,
	o.Order_Type,
	o.Order_Validity,
	o.Link_ID,
	o.Broker_ID,
	o.Account_ID,
	o.Broker_Order_ID,
	o.Exchange_Order_ID,
	ot.Remarks,
	o.Comb_Status,
	--B.Money_Deployed,
	o.Sub_Strategy_ID,
	o.Order_Source_ID,
	o.Underlying_Ticker,
	ot.OrderTrade_ID,
	ot.Status,
	ot.islast,
	ot.Price_Diff,
	ot.Original_Order_ID,
	ot.Creation_Date,
	ot.Created_By,
	ot.Update_Time,
	ot.Updated_By,
	ot.New_Cancel_Modify,
	ot.Creation_Time,
	o.Ems_ID as EmsID
	from [Order] o
inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID
where ot.OrderTrade_ID = @OrderTrade_ID
	and ot.Creation_Date = @date

	select TRADE_ID,
			Estee_ID,
			Buy_Sell_Indicator,
			Order_Quantity,
			Order_Price,
			Traded_Quantity,
			Traded_Price,
			Stop_Price,
			Transaction_Cost
			from Trades WITH (NOLOCK) where OrderTrade_ID  =@OrderTrade_ID and Creation_Date = @date

END

```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spGetOrderFromTradeOrderIDWithTrail]   
 @OrderTrade_ID varchar(50),  
 @date date  
AS  
BEGIN  
    --Select Lot_Size, Estee_ID,[Status],remarks from Trades where trade_id = @trade_id  
 Select   
 o.Order_ID,  
 o.Order_Type,  
 o.Order_Validity,  
 o.Link_ID,  
 o.Broker_ID,  
 o.Account_ID,  
 o.Broker_Order_ID,  
 o.Exchange_Order_ID,  
 ot.Remarks,  
 o.Comb_Status,  
 --B.Money_Deployed,  
 o.Sub_Strategy_ID,  
 o.Order_Source_ID,  
 o.Underlying_Ticker,  
 ot.OrderTrade_ID,  
 ot.Status,  
 ot.islast,  
 ot.Price_Diff,  
 ot.Original_Order_ID,  
 ot.Creation_Date,  
 ot.Created_By,  
 ot.Update_Time,  
 ot.Updated_By,  
 ot.New_Cancel_Modify,  
 ot.Creation_Time  
 from [Order] o  
inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID  
where ot.OrderTrade_ID = @OrderTrade_ID  
 and ot.Creation_Date = @date  
  
 select TRADE_ID,  
   Estee_ID,  
   Buy_Sell_Indicator,  
   Order_Quantity,  
   Order_Price,   
   Traded_Quantity,  
   Traded_Price,  
   Stop_Price,  
   Transaction_Cost  
   from Trades WITH (NOLOCK) where OrderTrade_ID  =@OrderTrade_ID   
   and Creation_Date = @date  
SELECT [Exec_ID]  
      ,[Trade_ID]  
      ,[Status]  
      ,[Fill_Price]  
      ,[Fill_Qty]  
      ,[Exec_Time]  
      ,[OrderTrail_ID]  
      ,[Exec_Type]  
  FROM [dbo].[tblOrderTrail] WITH (NOLOCK) Where [Trade_ID] in (select TRADE_ID from Trades where OrderTrade_ID =@OrderTrade_ID)  
Order by [OrderTrail_ID] ASC  
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetOrderInfoForGivenExchangeOrderId

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
Create PROCEDURE spGetOrderInfoForGivenExchangeOrderId
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@tradeDate date,
	@exchgOrderIdList ListString READONLY
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	SELECT vw.Order_ID,vw.OrderTrade_ID, vw.Trade_ID, vw.Order_Type, vw.Order_Validity, vw.Broker_ID, vw.Account_ID, 
	vw.Sub_Strategy_ID, vw.Exchange_Order_ID, vw.execid , vw.Estee_ID	     
	FROM vwAllTrades vw
	JOIN @exchgOrderIdList et ON vw.Exchange_Order_ID=et.ListItem
	AND vw.Status NOT IN ('Executed', 'Partially Filled', 'Cancelled')
	WHERE vw.Creation_Date=@tradeDate
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetOrderInfoProcessorInitData_100x

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetOrderInfoProcessorInitData_100x]
@serverid VARCHAR(50),
@appid VARCHAR(50)

AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @temp VARCHAR(MAX)
SELECT @temp=Value FROM datainit WHERE ApplicationID = @appid and Parameter like 'POINSERTQ'

Declare @substrategyIdList TABLE(id INT)
Declare @substrategyIdList1 TABLE(id INT)
Declare @CancelledOrderIds TABLE(oid INT)

   INSERT INTO @substrategyIdList
   SELECT EA1.SubStrategy_ID FROM esteeapplications EA1
   INNER JOIN esteeapplications EA2  on EA1.EMS_Application_ID = EA2.ApplicationID
   INNER JOIN EsteeServers ES  on EA2.EsteeServer_ID = ES.ID and ES.IP=@serverid
   WHERE EA1.SubStrategy_ID is not null  and EA1.SubStrategy_ID>0              
   ORDER BY EA1.SubStrategy_ID

 IF @temp is NULL
 BEGIN
 DELETE sl FROM @substrategyIdList sl join DataInit dt ON dt.substrategy_id = sl.id and dt.Parameter='POINSERTQ' and dt.Value <> 'processorderinsertqueue'
 INSERT @substrategyIdList1 SELECT * FROM @substrategyIdList
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO @substrategyIdList1
 SELECT sl.id FROM @substrategyIdList sl join DataInit dt on dt.substrategy_id = sl.id and dt.Parameter='POINSERTQ' and dt.Value = @temp
 END

 SELECT id AS ssid FROM @substrategyIdList1
 INSERT INTO @CancelledOrderIds
 SELECT Order_ID FROM OrderTrades ot WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN @substrategyIdList1 s ON ot.Sub_Strategy_ID = s.id
 WHERE ot.Creation_Date >= CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(12), GETDATE(), 1) AS DATE) and STATUS = 'Cancelled'
 
 SELECT SUM(X.OrderCount) AS OrderCount, X.Sub_Strategy_ID AS Sub_Strategy_Id,X.Status AS Status,SUM(X.MessageCount) as MessageCount
 FROM (
		SELECT COUNT(t.execid) as OrderCount, o.Sub_strategy_Id,
		CASE WHEN o.Order_Type IN ('Y','Z') and ot.Status = 'Partially Filled' THEN 'Executed' 
			 WHEN c.OID is not null and ot.Status = 'Partially Filled' THEN 'Executed'
			 ELSE ot.Status END AS Status,
		COUNT(1) AS MessageCount FROM esteeapplications ea
		INNER JOIN esteeservers es ON es.ID = ea.EsteeServer_ID and es.IP = @serverid
		INNER JOIN [Order] o  WITH (NOLOCK) ON o.Sub_Strategy_ID = ea.SubStrategy_ID
		INNER JOIN OrderTrades ot WITH (NOLOCK) ON ot.Creation_Date=o.Creation_Date and o.Order_id=ot.Order_id
		INNER JOIN trades t WITH (NOLOCK) ON t.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and t.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID
		INNER JOIN @substrategyIdList1 sl on sl.id = o.Sub_Strategy_ID
		LEFT JOIN @CancelledOrderIds c ON ot.Order_ID = c.oid
		WHERE  o.Creation_Date > =  CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(12), GETDATE(), 1) AS DATE)
	    GROUP BY o.Sub_strategy_Id, ot.Status, o.Order_Type,c.oid
	  ) X
    GROUP BY X.Sub_Strategy_ID,X.Status
    ORDER BY X.Sub_Strategy_ID,X.Status

 SELECT COUNT(distinct(o.order_ID)) AS distinctCount, o.Sub_Strategy_Id FROM esteeapplications ea
 INNER JOIN esteeservers es on es.ID = ea.EsteeServer_ID and es.IP = @serverid
 INNER JOIN [Order] o  WITH (NOLOCK) ON o.Sub_Strategy_ID = ea.SubStrategy_ID
 INNER JOIN OrderTrades ot WITH (NOLOCK) ON ot.Creation_Date=o.Creation_Date and o.Order_id=ot.Order_id
 INNER JOIN @substrategyIdList1 sl on sl.id = o.Sub_Strategy_ID
 WHERE  o.Creation_Date > =  CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(12), GETDATE(), 1) AS DATE)
 GROUP BY o.Sub_strategy_Id
 ORDER BY o.Sub_strategy_Id
 
 SELECT * FROM OrderTradeRatioCounts OT
 INNER JOIN @substrategyIdList1 S1 ON CAST(S1.id AS VARCHAR(4)) = OT.DimensionValue
 WHERE AsOfDate = (SELECT CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(10), GETDATE(), 1) AS DATE))

END

--exec spGetOrderInfoProcessorInitData '191.191.191.15','200221'


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetOrderQuantityLimits

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetOrderQuantityLimits] @date date = null, @esteeIDs varchar(max) = ''    
AS    
    
BEGIN    
    
 DECLARE @esteeIDLimits Table(Estee_Id varchar(100), LimitValue Decimal(10,0))    
    
 IF LEN(RTRIM(LTRIM(ISNULL(@esteeIDs,'')))) > 0 BEGIN    
    
  DECLARE @tblEsteeIDs TABLE (esteeID varchar(100))     
  INSERT into @tblEsteeIDs SELECT * from dbo.split(@esteeIDs,',')        
    
  select o.Estee_Id,o.LimitValue     
  from OrderQuantityLimit o   
  INNER JOIN @tblEsteeIDs t on SUBSTRING(t.esteeID,0,15) =SUBSTRING(o.Estee_Id,0,15)  
  where o.AsOfDate=@date      
  union    
  Select s.Estee_Id,s.LimitValue     
  from StaticOrderQuantityLimit s    
  LEFT JOIN OrderQuantityLimit o on o.Estee_Id = s.Estee_Id AND o.AsOfDate = @date  
  INNER JOIN @tblEsteeIDs t on SUBSTRING(t.esteeID,0,15) =SUBSTRING(s.Estee_Id,0,15)  
  WHERE o.estee_ID IS NULL    
      
 END ELSE BEGIN    
    
  select o.Estee_Id,o.LimitValue     
  from OrderQuantityLimit o    
  where o.AsOfDate=@date      
  union all    
  Select s.Estee_Id,s.LimitValue     
  from StaticOrderQuantityLimit s    
  LEFT JOIN OrderQuantityLimit o on o.Estee_Id = s.Estee_Id AND o.AsOfDate = @date    
  WHERE o.estee_ID IS NULL    
     
 END    
 --exec spGetOrderQuantityLimits '2012-06-11', 'IN0000000002IS04,IN0000000003IS04,IN0000000004IS04,IN0000000005IS04,IN0000000006IS10'    
    
END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetOrderQuantityLimitsForCUI

```sql
Create PROCEDURE spGetOrderQuantityLimitsForCUI      
@date date = null     ,      
@exCodeList varchar(max)=null    
AS                      
                    
BEGIN                      
      
          
 IF  @exCodeList is not null    
 BEGIN                 
  select distinct o.Estee_Id,e.Underlying_Ticker as Underlying_ticker,o.Exchange_Code,o.LimitValue , 'Job' Source, e.Lot_Size as Lot_Size          
  from OrderQuantityLimit o                      
  left join esteemaster e on substring(e.estee_ID,0,17) = substring(o.estee_ID,0,17)   and e.Status = 1        
  where o.AsOfDate=@date    and e.Exchange_Code in(select * from dbo.Split(@exCodeList, ','))                    
  union                       
    Select distinct s.Estee_Id,e.Underlying_Ticker as Underlying_ticker ,s.Exchange_Code,s.LimitValue  ,'Static' Source , e.Lot_Size as Lot_Size          
  from StaticOrderQuantityLimit s                      
  LEFT JOIN OrderQuantityLimit o on o.Estee_Id = s.Estee_Id AND o.AsOfDate = @date    
  left join esteemaster e on substring(e.estee_ID,0,17) = substring(s.estee_ID,0,17)    and e.Status = 1           
  WHERE o.estee_ID IS NULL and e.Exchange_Code in(select * from dbo.Split(@exCodeList, ','))               
  END      
  ELSE      
  BEGIN      
    select distinct  o.Estee_Id,e.Underlying_Ticker as Underlying_ticker,o.Exchange_Code,o.LimitValue , 'Job' Source , e.Lot_Size as Lot_Size              
  from OrderQuantityLimit o                      
  left join esteemaster e on substring(e.estee_ID,0,17) = substring(o.estee_ID,0,17)    and e.Status = 1           
   where o.AsOfDate=@date                        
  union                       
  Select distinct  s.Estee_Id,e.Underlying_Ticker as Underlying_ticker ,s.Exchange_Code,s.LimitValue  ,'Static' Source   , e.Lot_Size as Lot_Size            
  from StaticOrderQuantityLimit s                      
  LEFT JOIN OrderQuantityLimit o on o.Estee_Id = s.Estee_Id AND o.AsOfDate = @date                      
  left join esteemaster e on substring(e.estee_ID,0,17) = substring(s.estee_ID,0,17)   and e.Status = 1                     
  WHERE o.estee_ID IS NULL       
   END               
               
                       
END
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetOrderSummary

```sql
CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetOrderSummary]  
AS  
  
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED  
  
SELECT  COUNT(distinct(ot.Order_id))AS CurrentCount ,  
   o.Sub_strategy_Id,  
   ot.Status ,  
   COUNT(1) AS MessageCount
from [Order] o
inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID
where o.Creation_Date >= CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(12), GETDATE(), 1) AS DATETIME) 
  GROUP BY o.Sub_strategy_Id,  
   ot.Status   
ORDER BY o.Sub_strategy_Id

```

```sql
CREATE Procedure [dbo].[spGetOrderTrail]
@subStrategyID varchar(500),
@date date
As
Begin

DECLARE @tblStrategy TABLE (sID int)

INSERT INTO @tblStrategy       
SELECT * from Split(@SubStrategyId,',')

select t.Trade_ID, t.OrderTrade_ID, t.Estee_ID, t.Buy_Sell_Indicator, t.Order_Quantity, t.Order_Price, t.Stop_Price,     
                      t.Transaction_Cost,t.ApplyTC, t.ExpectedPrice, ot.OrderTrade_ID AS Expr1, ot.Order_ID, tr.Status, ot.islast, ot.Original_Order_ID, ot.Creation_Date ,ot.Creation_Time, ot.Update_Time,     
                      ot.Created_By, ot.Updated_By, ot.New_Cancel_Modify, ot.Remarks, ot.Price_Diff, o.Order_ID AS Expr2, o.Order_Type, o.Order_Validity, o.Broker_ID,     
                      o.Account_ID, o.Order_Source_ID, o.Broker_Order_ID, o.Exchange_Order_ID,o.ClientOrder_ID,ot.ClientOrderTrade_ID,ot.brokerOrderTrade_ID ,o.Comb_Status, o.Sub_Strategy_ID, o.Underlying_Ticker, o.Link_ID,     
                      o.Participant_ID, ot.emstime, t.Brokerage, o.ems_id,tr.Fill_Qty, tr.Fill_Price,tr.Exec_ID, e.Lot_Size, tr.Update_Receive_Time

from [Order] o with(nolock)   
inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID    
inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID 
inner join  tblOrderTrail tr with (nolock) on tr.Trade_ID = t.Trade_ID and CAST( tr.Exec_Time as date) = t.Creation_Date
inner join @tblStrategy s on s.sID = ot.Sub_Strategy_ID
inner join EsteeMaster e on e.Estee_ID = t.Estee_ID 
where tr.Status in ('Partially Filled','Executed') and o.Creation_Date = @date
order by ot.OrderTrade_ID, t.Trade_ID

End
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetOtidToOid

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spGetOtidToOid]
@appID varchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
   SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED
   DECLARE @date as datetime
   SET @date = cast(convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 101) as datetime)

   --------------------------------------- OrderTradeID to OrderID mapping for open orders ----------------------------
   DECLARE @tempOrderTrades TABLE(OrderTrade_ID int, Order_ID int, BrokerOrderTrade_ID varchar(50),Creation_Date date)
   Insert into @tempOrderTrades
   select OrderTrade_ID, Order_ID,BrokerOrderTrade_ID,Creation_Date from OrderTrades  WITH (NOLOCK)
   where Status not in ('Rejected','Executed','Cancelled','Halted','Inactive','Stopped') AND Creation_Date = @date

   SELECT distinct A.OrderTrade_ID as OrderTradeId, B.Order_ID as OrderId
   FROM [Order] B WITH (NOLOCK)
   inner join  @tempOrderTrades A on B.Order_ID = A.Order_ID and B.Creation_Date = A.Creation_Date
   where B.Ems_ID = @appID

   option (maxdop 1)
End

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetPayOut

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spGetPayOut]   
 @brokerID varchar(max),  
 @accountID varchar(max),  
 @listOfSubstrategyID varchar(max),  
 @startDate date,  
 @endDate date  
AS  
BEGIN  

select e.Estee_ID,SUM(traded_price * traded_quantity * (2*buy_sell_indicator-3)) as OptionPayOut
from vwAllTrades v 
join ( 
select estee_ID, security_type from esteemaster where exchange_code='IS' and status=1 
union 
select estee_ID, security_type from esteemaster_Archive where exchange_code='IS' and Status=1) e 
on v.Estee_ID = e.Estee_ID
where Creation_Date >= @startDate and Creation_Date < @endDate
and v.Status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') 
and e.Security_Type in (0,2,3,6,7,12,13)
and broker_id = @brokerID
and account_id = @accountID
and Sub_Strategy_ID in (
select distinct CAST(items as int) as item from dbo.Split(@listOfSubstrategyID,',')) 
group by e.Estee_ID

END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetPeekReturnforMDD

```sql

Create procedure spGetPeekReturnforMDD
@startDate date,
@endDate date
As
Begin
declare @maxReturnDate date
select cast(DATE as date) as Date, DimensionTypeID as dimensionId, 
CASE DimensionTypeID WHEN 13 THEN cast(Strategy_Id AS varchar(10)) + '_' + cast(Account_Id AS varchar(10))
else cast(strategy_id AS varchar(10)) end as dimensionValue, BEPnL, Mandate, DailyBEPnL/Mandate as DailyReturn into #tempAllcatorData
from AllocatorData where cast(DATE as date) >= @startDate and cast(DATE as date) <= @endDate and Mandate > 0
and IsIntraday = 0 and DimensionTypeID <> 3
and DATEPART(WEEKDAY, date) not in (1,7)
select t1.Date, t1.dimensionId, t1.dimensionValue, t1.DailyReturn, sum(t2.DailyReturn) as CumelativeSum into #aggregatedData from #tempAllcatorData t1 
inner join #tempAllcatorData t2 on t1.dimensionId = t2.dimensionId and t1.dimensionValue = t2.dimensionValue
and t1.Date >= t2.Date
group by t1.Date, t1.dimensionId, t1.dimensionValue, t1.DailyReturn
select dimensionId, dimensionValue, Max(CumelativeSum) as MaxSum into #MaxReturnAllocatorData from #aggregatedData
group by dimensionId, dimensionValue
select @maxReturnDate = Max(date) from #aggregatedData
select a.dimensionId, a.dimensionValue, b.CumelativeSum as CumelativeBEPNLReturn, a.MaxSum as PeekBEPnlReturn from #MaxReturnAllocatorData a
inner join #aggregatedData b on a.dimensionId = b.dimensionId and a.dimensionValue = b.dimensionValue
and b.Date = @maxReturnDate
drop table #tempAllcatorData
drop table #aggregatedData
drop table #MaxReturnAllocatorData
End


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetPositionForCrystallizedLoss

```sql

CREATE procedure [dbo].[spGetPositionForCrystallizedLoss]    
@currentWorkingDate date,    
@previousWorkingDate date,    
@accountIds varchar(500),    
@spanId varchar(5),
@listSubStrategyID varchar(max) = null   
    
As  
  
Begin    
    
declare @Account Table(accId int)    
insert into @Account    
SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(items)) from dbo.split(@accountIds,',')

-- Populate SubStrategy table based on parameter
declare @SubStrategy TABLE(SubStrategy_Id int)
IF (@listSubStrategyID IS NOT NULL AND @listSubStrategyID <> '') BEGIN
	INSERT INTO @SubStrategy
	SELECT S.items
	FROM dbo.split(@listSubStrategyID,',') S
	INNER JOIN Strategy_New SN WITH(NOLOCK) ON S.items = SN.SubStrategy_Id
	WHERE SN.Strategy_Status IN (1)
END

select gp.account_id AccountId, gp.Estee_ID, sum(long-short) Pos, sum((long-short) * isnull(isnull(c.Close_Price, sd.LTP), 0)) PosValue into #temp1
from DailyPositions gp
left join closingprice c on gp.Estee_ID = c.Estee_ID
left join SpanData sd on sd.date = @currentWorkingDate and sd.esteeID = gp.Estee_Id
inner join @Account a on a.accId = gp.Account_ID
left join @SubStrategy sn on sn.SubStrategy_Id = gp.Sub_StrategyID
where gp.PositionDate = @previousWorkingDate and gp.Exchange_Code = 'IS'
and Long <> Short and len(gp.estee_id) = 24
and c.Date = @previousWorkingDate
and sd.spanID = @spanId
and (@listSubStrategyID IS NULL OR @listSubStrategyID = '' OR sn.SubStrategy_Id IS NOT NULL)
group by gp.account_id, gp.Estee_ID

select account_id, estee_id, SUM(case when buy_sell_Indicator = 1 then Traded_Quantity else 0 end) BuyQty,
SUM(case when buy_sell_Indicator = 1 then Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price else 0 end) BuyValue,
SUM(case when buy_sell_Indicator = 2 then Traded_Quantity else 0 end) SellQty,
SUM(case when buy_sell_Indicator = 2 then Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price else 0 end) SellValue into #temp2
from vwalltrades vw
inner join @Account a on vw.account_id = a.accId
left join @SubStrategy sn on sn.SubStrategy_Id = vw.Sub_Strategy_ID
where creation_date = @currentWorkingDate
and status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and len(estee_id) = 24
and order_source_id not in ('ECM')
and (@listSubStrategyID IS NULL OR @listSubStrategyID = '' OR sn.SubStrategy_Id IS NOT NULL)
group by account_id, estee_id
order by account_id, estee_id  
  
select isnull(t1.AccountId, t2.Account_ID) Account_Id,   
isnull(t1.Estee_ID, t2.Estee_ID) Estee_ID,  
isnull(t1.Pos, 0) Pos, isnull(t1.PosValue, 0) PosValue,  
isnull(t2.BuyQty, 0) BuyQty, isnull(t2.BuyValue, 0) BuyValue,  
isnull(t2.SellQty, 0) SellQty, isnull(t2.SellValue, 0) SellValue  
from #temp1 t1 full join #temp2 t2 on t1.AccountId = t2.Account_ID and t1.Estee_ID = t2.Estee_ID  
  
drop table #temp1  
drop table #temp2  
    
End


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetPositionsForMatchPosition

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetPositionsForMatchPosition]



-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here



      @exchgCodeList LISTSTRING READONLY, 

      @positionDate  DATE

AS

     BEGIN



         -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from



         -- interfering with SELECT statements.



         SET NOCOUNT ON;



         BEGIN TRY







             -- Insert statements for procedure here



             CREATE TABLE #TempDailyPositions(

                          exchangeCode        VARCHAR(10), 

                          SecurityName        NVARCHAR(75), 

                          Long                BIGINT, 

                          Short               BIGINT, 

                          TransactionCost     DECIMAL(20, 4), 

                          Account_ID          INT, 

                          SecurityType        NVARCHAR(30), 

                          Estee_ID            NVARCHAR(50), 

                          Sub_StrategyID      VARCHAR(5), 

                          Broker_ID           INT, 

                          PositionDate        DATETIME, 

                          AverageTradedPrice  DECIMAL(20, 4), 

                          BuyValue            DECIMAL(20, 4), 

                          SellValue           DECIMAL(20, 4), 

                          AverageHoldingPrice DECIMAL(20, 10));







             DECLARE @exCodeString VARCHAR(500)= '';



             SELECT @exCodeString = @exCodeString+','+ListItem

             FROM @exchgCodeList;







             SET @exCodeString = SUBSTRING(@exCodeString, 2, LEN(@exCodeString)-1);







             INSERT INTO #TempDailyPositions(exchangeCode, SecurityName, Long, Short, TransactionCost, Account_ID, SecurityType, Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, PositionDate, AverageTradedPrice, BuyValue, SellValue, AverageHoldingPrice)



             EXEC GetAllPositionsForGivenDateAndParameters @date = @positionDate, @listexchange = @exCodeString, @useDailyPositionsTable = 1;







             UPDATE t

               SET t.Account_ID = MainAccountId, t.Estee_ID = em1.Estee_ID, t.exchangeCode = em1.Exchange_Code, t.SecurityName = em1.DataFeed_Ticker

             FROM #TempDailyPositions t

                  JOIN BenchMarkContractsMap bm ON t.Account_ID = bm.RefAccountId

                                                   AND SUBSTRING(t.Estee_id, 1, 14) = SUBSTRING(bm.RefUndEsteeId, 1, 14)

                  JOIN EsteeMaster em ON em.Estee_ID = t.Estee_ID

                  JOIN esteemaster em1 ON CONVERT(DATE, em1.Expiry_Date) = CONVERT(DATE, em.Expiry_Date)

                                          AND em.Strike_Price = em1.Strike_Price

                                          AND SUBSTRING(em1.Estee_id, 1, 14) = SUBSTRING(bm.MainUndEsteeId, 1, 14)

                                          AND ISNULL(em1.Expiry_date2, '') = ISNULL(em.Expiry_date2, '');







             UPDATE t

               SET t.SecurityName = em.DataFeed_Ticker

             FROM #TempDailyPositions t

                  JOIN EsteeMaster em ON em.Estee_ID = t.Estee_ID

                                         AND em.DataFeed_Ticker <> t.SecurityName







             DECLARE @TempBorrowPositions TABLE(

                                                PositionDate  DATE, 

                                                ExchangeCode  VARCHAR(10), 

                                                AccountId     INT, 

                                                SubstrategyId INT, 

                                                SecurityName  VARCHAR(255), 

                                                EsteeId       VARCHAR(50), 

                                                InterestRate  DECIMAL(20, 4), 

                                                BorrowDate    DATE, 

                                                MaturityDate  DATE, 

                                                Long          INT, 

												 Short         INT, 

                                                Net           INT

                                                );



             INSERT INTO @TempBorrowPositions



             EXEC spGetBorrowPosition @date = @positionDate, @exchgList = @exchgCodeList







             DECLARE @pos TABLE(

                                exchangecode VARCHAR(10), 

                                SecurityName VARCHAR(255), 

                                Long         BIGINT, 

                                Short        BIGINT, 

                                Net          INT, 

                                Account_ID   INT, 

                                Estee_ID     VARCHAR(255));







             INSERT INTO @pos

             SELECT exchangecode, SecurityName, SUM(Long), SUM(Short), SUM(Net), accountId, EsteeId

             FROM(

                 SELECT ExchangeCode, SecurityName, SUM(Long) AS Long, SUM(Short) AS Short, SUM(Long - Short) AS Net, Account_ID AS AccountId, Estee_ID AS EsteeID

                 FROM #TempDailyPositions

                 GROUP BY exchangeCode, Account_ID, SecurityName, Estee_ID

                 UNION

                 SELECT tb.ExchangeCode, tb.SecurityName, SUM(Long), SUM(Short), SUM(tb.Net) AS Net, tb.AccountId, tb.EsteeId

                 FROM @TempBorrowPositions tb

                 GROUP BY tb.ExchangeCode, tb.AccountId, tb.EsteeId, tb.SecurityName) A

             GROUP BY exchangeCode, AccountId, EsteeId, SecurityName

             ORDER BY SecurityName;







             SELECT *

             FROM @pos;







             IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempDailyPositions') IS NOT NULL



                 BEGIN



                     DROP TABLE #TempDailyPositions;



                 END;

         END TRY

         BEGIN CATCH



             IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempDailyPositions') IS NOT NULL



                 BEGIN



                     DROP TABLE #TempDailyPositions;



                 END;







             DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);



             DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;



             DECLARE @ErrorState INT;



             SELECT @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();







             -- RAISERROR inside the CATCH block will return error information about the original error that caused execution to jump to the CATCH block.  



             RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, -- Message text.  



             @ErrorSeverity, -- Severity.  



             @ErrorState -- State.  



             );

         END CATCH;



     END;


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetPositionsForMatchPositionNew

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetPositionsForMatchPositionNew]
-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
      @exchgCodeList LISTSTRING READONLY, 
      @positionDate  DATE
AS
          BEGIN
         -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
         -- interfering with SELECT statements.
         SET NOCOUNT ON;
         BEGIN TRY
             -- Insert statements for procedure here
             CREATE TABLE #TempDailyPositions(
                          exchangeCode        VARCHAR(10), 
                          SecurityName        NVARCHAR(75), 
                          Long                BIGINT, 
                          Short               BIGINT, 
                          TransactionCost     DECIMAL(20, 4), 
                          Account_ID          INT, 
                          SecurityType        NVARCHAR(30), 
                          Estee_ID            NVARCHAR(50), 
                          Sub_StrategyID      VARCHAR(5), 
                          Broker_ID           INT, 
                          PositionDate        DATETIME, 
                          AverageTradedPrice  DECIMAL(20, 4), 
                          BuyValue            DECIMAL(20, 4), 
                          SellValue           DECIMAL(20, 4), 
                          AverageHoldingPrice DECIMAL(20, 10));
			 
			 declare @accIdList IntegerListType

			 insert into @accIdList
			 select distinct a.Account_ID from @exchgCodeList ex inner join ClearingAccount c on ex.ListItem = c.ClearingExchange
			 inner join Account a on a.ClearingAccountID = c.ClearingAccountID			 
			 where a.Status = 'Active' and a.exchange_Code in (select a.exchange_Code from tblBrokerAccount tba inner join account a on a.account_id = tba.account_id and tba.IsInteroperabilityEnabled = 1)
			 			             			 
			 if EXISTS(select 1 from @accIdList)
			 Begin
				 DECLARE @accountsString VARCHAR(500)= '';
				 SELECT @accountsString = @accountsString+','+ cast(n as varchar)
				 FROM @accIdList;
				 SET @accountsString = SUBSTRING(@accountsString, 2, LEN(@accountsString)-1);

				 INSERT INTO #TempDailyPositions(exchangeCode, SecurityName, Long, Short, TransactionCost, Account_ID, SecurityType, Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, PositionDate, AverageTradedPrice, BuyValue, SellValue, AverageHoldingPrice)
				 EXEC GetAllPositionsForGivenDateAndParameters @date = @positionDate, @listAccountID = @accountsString, @useDailyPositionsTable = 1;
			 End
			 else
			 Begin			 
				 DECLARE @exCodeString VARCHAR(500)= '';
				 SELECT @exCodeString = @exCodeString+','+ListItem
				 FROM @exchgCodeList;
				 SET @exCodeString = SUBSTRING(@exCodeString, 2, LEN(@exCodeString)-1);

				 INSERT INTO #TempDailyPositions(exchangeCode, SecurityName, Long, Short, TransactionCost, Account_ID, SecurityType, Estee_ID, Sub_StrategyID, Broker_ID, PositionDate, AverageTradedPrice, BuyValue, SellValue, AverageHoldingPrice)
				 EXEC GetAllPositionsForGivenDateAndParameters @date = @positionDate, @listexchange = @exCodeString, @useDailyPositionsTable = 1;
			 End
             UPDATE t
               SET t.Account_ID = MainAccountId, t.Estee_ID = em1.Estee_ID, t.exchangeCode = em1.Exchange_Code, t.SecurityName = em1.DataFeed_Ticker
             FROM #TempDailyPositions t
                  JOIN BenchMarkContractsMap bm ON t.Account_ID = bm.RefAccountId
                                                   AND SUBSTRING(t.Estee_id, 1, 14) = SUBSTRING(bm.RefUndEsteeId, 1, 14)
                  JOIN EsteeMaster em ON em.Estee_ID = t.Estee_ID
                  JOIN esteemaster em1 ON CONVERT(DATE, em1.Expiry_Date) = CONVERT(DATE, em.Expiry_Date)
                                          AND em.Strike_Price = em1.Strike_Price
                                          AND SUBSTRING(em1.Estee_id, 1, 14) = SUBSTRING(bm.MainUndEsteeId, 1, 14)
                                          AND ISNULL(em1.Expiry_date2, '') = ISNULL(em.Expiry_date2, '');
             UPDATE t
               SET t.SecurityName = em.DataFeed_Ticker
             FROM #TempDailyPositions t
                  JOIN EsteeMaster em ON em.Estee_ID = t.Estee_ID
                                         AND em.DataFeed_Ticker <> t.SecurityName
             DECLARE @TempBorrowPositions TABLE(
                                                PositionDate  DATE, 
                                                ExchangeCode  VARCHAR(10), 
                                                AccountId     INT, 
                                                SubstrategyId INT, 
                                                SecurityName  VARCHAR(255), 
                                                EsteeId       VARCHAR(50), 
                                                InterestRate  DECIMAL(20, 4), 
       BorrowDate    DATE, 
                                                MaturityDate  DATE, 
                                                Long          BIGINT, 
												 Short         BIGINT, 
                                                Net           BIGINT
                                                );
             INSERT INTO @TempBorrowPositions
             EXEC spGetBorrowPosition @date = @positionDate, @exchgList = @exchgCodeList
             DECLARE @pos TABLE(
                                exchangecode VARCHAR(10), 
                                SecurityName VARCHAR(255), 
                                Long         BIGINT, 
                                Short        BIGINT, 
                                Net          BIGINT, 
                                Account_ID   INT, 
                                Estee_ID     VARCHAR(255));
             INSERT INTO @pos
             SELECT exchangecode, SecurityName, SUM(Long), SUM(Short), SUM(Net), accountId, EsteeId
             FROM(
                 SELECT ExchangeCode, SecurityName, SUM(Long) AS Long, SUM(Short) AS Short, SUM(Long - Short) AS Net, Account_ID AS AccountId, Estee_ID AS EsteeID
                 FROM #TempDailyPositions
                 GROUP BY exchangeCode, Account_ID, SecurityName, Estee_ID
                 UNION
                 SELECT tb.ExchangeCode, tb.SecurityName, SUM(Long), SUM(Short), SUM(tb.Net) AS Net, tb.AccountId, tb.EsteeId
                 FROM @TempBorrowPositions tb
                 GROUP BY tb.ExchangeCode, tb.AccountId, tb.EsteeId, tb.SecurityName) A
             GROUP BY exchangeCode, AccountId, EsteeId, SecurityName
             ORDER BY SecurityName;
             select * from @pos p where p.Net <> 0
             IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempDailyPositions') IS NOT NULL
                 BEGIN
                     DROP TABLE #TempDailyPositions;
                 END;
         END TRY
         BEGIN CATCH
             IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempDailyPositions') IS NOT NULL
                 BEGIN
                     DROP TABLE #TempDailyPositions;
                 END;
             DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);
             DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;
             DECLARE @ErrorState INT;
             SELECT @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();
             -- RAISERROR inside the CATCH block will return error information about the original error that caused execution to jump to the CATCH block.  
             RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, -- Message text.  
             @ErrorSeverity, -- Severity.  
             @ErrorState -- State.  
             );
         END CATCH;
     END;
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetPositionsForPMOnStartup

```sql

Create procedure spGetPositionsForPMOnStartup
@prevPosDate date,
@exchangeCode varchar(2)

As
Begin

IF EXISTS (select * from DailyPositions_Snapshot where PositionDate = @prevPosDate and ExchangeCode = @exchangeCode)
BEGIN
	select Sub_StrategyID, Account_ID, DP.Estee_ID, Long, Short, BuyValue, SellValue from DailyPositions DP inner join ContractIds C ON DP.Estee_ID = C.EsteeId where PositionDate = @prevPosDate and Exchange_Code = @exchangeCode
	except
	select SubStrategy_ID, Account_ID, DPS.Estee_ID, Long, Short, BuyValue, SellValue from DailyPositions_Snapshot DPS inner join ContractIds C ON DPS.Estee_ID = C.EsteeId where PositionDate = @prevPosDate and ExchangeCode = @exchangeCode
END
else
BEGIN
	select SubStrategy_ID, Account_ID, Estee_ID, Long, Short, BuyValue, SellValue from DailyPositions_Snapshot where 1=2
END

End
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetPositionsForTSession

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].spGetPositionsForTSession  
 @PrevToPrevPositionDate DATE, --Prev to Date on which we have EOD positions  
 @previousPositionDate DATE, --Date on which we have EOD positions  
 @TradeDate            DATE, --Date on which trading took place till T-Session   
 @exCode varchar(5),  
 @accId int = null,  
 @dtTradingHours TradingHoursDataTable READONLY  
AS  
     BEGIN  
   declare @startDateTime datetime = @previousPositionDate  
   declare @endDateTime datetime = @tradeDate  
         -- interfering with SELECT statements.  
         SET NOCOUNT ON;  
         /****************************************************************************Non Currency*****************************************************************/  
         --Check All SourceDB's DB's where we have Positions   
   if(@PrevToPrevPositionDate = @previousPositionDate OR @accId = null OR @accId = -1)  
   begin  
    SELECT x.exchangecode AS exchangecode, x.SecurityName AS SecurityName, Sum(Long/isnull(e.Lot_Size, ea.Lot_Size)) 'Long', Sum(Short/isnull(e.Lot_Size, ea.Lot_Size)) 'Short', SUM(x.NetPosition/isnull(e.Lot_Size, ea.Lot_Size)) 'Net', x.AccountID AS   
    Account_ID, x.EsteeID AS Estee_ID  
    FROM(  
     SELECT ac.exchange_Code 'exchangecode', ac.account_id 'AccountID', dp.securityname 'SecurityName', dp.estee_id 'EsteeID', Sum(long) 'Long', Sum(dp.Short) Short, SUM(long - short) 'NetPosition'  
     FROM dailypositions(nolock) dp  
       INNER JOIN account ac(nolock) ON ac.Account_ID = dp.account_id  
     WHERE positiondate = @previousPositionDate  
        AND long <> short  
        AND ac.exchange_Code = @exCode  
     GROUP BY ac.exchange_code, ac.account_id, dp.securityname, dp.estee_id  
     UNION ALL  
      SELECT ac.exchange_Code 'exchangecode', ac.account_id 'AccountID',  isnull(e.datafeed_ticker, ea.datafeed_ticker) 'SecurityName', v.estee_id 'EsteeID', Sum (CASE WHEN buy_sell_indicator=1 THEN traded_quantity ELSE 0 end) 'Long',Sum (CASE WHEN buy_sell_indicator=2 THEN traded_quantity ELSE 0 end) 'Short', SUM((3 - 2 * Buy_Sell_Indicator) * traded_quantity) 'NetPosition'  
     FROM vwalltrades v(nolock)  
       LEFT JOIN esteemaster e(nolock) ON e.Estee_ID = v.Estee_ID  
       left join EsteeMaster_archive ea(nolock) on ea.Estee_ID = v.Estee_ID  
       AND ea.status=1  
       INNER JOIN account ac(nolock) ON ac.Account_ID = v.account_id 
       INNER JOIN @dtTradingHours t on isnull(e.Estee_ID, ea.Estee_ID) = t.Estee_ID  
     WHERE v.creation_date = @TradeDate  
        AND v.status IN('Executed', 'Partially Filled')  
        AND ac.exchange_Code = @exCode
        AND CAST(v.TradeTime AS TIME) <= t.EndTime  
     GROUP BY ac.exchange_code, ac.account_id,  isnull(e.datafeed_ticker, ea.datafeed_ticker), v.estee_id  
      ) X  
     LEFT JOIN esteemaster e(nolock) ON e.Estee_ID = x.EsteeID  
     LEFT JOIN EsteeMaster_archive ea(nolock) ON ea.Estee_ID = X.EsteeID  
                AND ea.status = 1  
    GROUP BY x.exchangecode, x.AccountID,  x.SecurityName, x.EsteeID  
    ORDER BY x.SecurityName  
   end  
   else  
   Begin  
   ------------------------------Step 1 (Current Day T session position)-------------------------------------------------  
  
   SELECT x.exchangecode AS exchangecode, x.SecurityName AS SecurityName, Sum(Long/isnull(e.Lot_Size, ea.Lot_Size)) 'Long', Sum(Short/isnull(e.Lot_Size, ea.Lot_Size)) 'Short', SUM(x.NetPosition/isnull(e.Lot_Size, ea.Lot_Size)) 'Net', x.AccountID AS   
   Account_ID, x.EsteeID AS Estee_ID  
         FROM(  
             SELECT ac.exchange_Code 'exchangecode', ac.account_id 'AccountID', dp.securityname 'SecurityName', dp.estee_id 'EsteeID', Sum(long) 'Long', Sum(dp.Short) Short, SUM(long - short) 'NetPosition'  
             FROM dailypositions(nolock) dp  
                  INNER JOIN account ac(nolock) ON ac.Account_ID = dp.account_id  
             WHERE positiondate = @previousPositionDate  
                   AND long <> short  
                   AND ac.exchange_Code = @exCode and dp.account_id = @accid  
        GROUP BY ac.exchange_code, ac.account_id, dp.securityname, dp.estee_id  
             UNION ALL  
     SELECT ac.exchange_Code 'exchangecode', ac.account_id 'AccountID',  isnull(e.datafeed_ticker, ea.datafeed_ticker) 'SecurityName', v.estee_id 'EsteeID', Sum (CASE WHEN buy_sell_indicator=1 THEN traded_quantity ELSE 0 end) 'Long',Sum (CASE WHEN buy_sell_indicator=2 THEN traded_quantity ELSE 0 end) 'Short', SUM((3 - 2 * Buy_Sell_Indicator) * traded_quantity) 'NetPosition'  
             FROM vwalltrades v(nolock)  
                  LEFT JOIN esteemaster e(nolock) ON e.Estee_ID = v.Estee_ID  
      left join EsteeMaster_archive ea(nolock) on ea.Estee_ID = v.Estee_ID  
      AND ea.status=1  
                  INNER JOIN account ac(nolock) ON ac.Account_ID = v.account_id  
      INNER JOIN @dtTradingHours t on isnull(e.Estee_ID, ea.Estee_ID) = t.Estee_ID  
             WHERE creation_date = @TradeDate  
                   AND v.status IN('Executed', 'Partially Filled') and v.Account_Id=@accId  
                   AND ac.exchange_Code = @exCode  
                   AND CAST(Update_Time AS TIME) <= t.EndTime  
             GROUP BY ac.exchange_code, ac.account_id,  isnull(e.datafeed_ticker, ea.datafeed_ticker), v.estee_id  
     ) X  
             LEFT JOIN esteemaster e(nolock) ON e.Estee_ID = x.EsteeID  
             LEFT JOIN EsteeMaster_archive ea(nolock) ON ea.Estee_ID = X.EsteeID  
                                                         AND ea.status = 1  
         GROUP BY x.exchangecode, x.AccountID,  x.SecurityName, x.EsteeID  
         ORDER BY x.SecurityName  
  
   ------------------------------Step 2 (Previous Day T session position)-------------------------------------------------  
  
   SELECT x.exchangecode AS exchangecode, x.SecurityName AS SecurityName, Sum(Long/isnull(e.Lot_Size, ea.Lot_Size)) 'Long', Sum(Short/isnull(e.Lot_Size, ea.Lot_Size)) 'Short', SUM(x.NetPosition/isnull(e.Lot_Size, ea.Lot_Size)) 'Net', x.AccountID AS   
   Account_ID, x.EsteeID AS Estee_ID  
         FROM(  
             SELECT ac.exchange_Code 'exchangecode', ac.account_id 'AccountID', dp.securityname 'SecurityName', dp.estee_id 'EsteeID', Sum(long) 'Long', Sum(dp.Short) Short, SUM(long - short) 'NetPosition'  
             FROM dailypositions(nolock) dp  
                  INNER JOIN account ac(nolock) ON ac.Account_ID = dp.account_id  
             WHERE positiondate = @PrevToPrevPositionDate  
                   AND long <> short  
                   AND ac.exchange_Code = @exCode and dp.account_id = @accId  
             GROUP BY ac.exchange_code, ac.account_id, dp.securityname, dp.estee_id  
             UNION ALL  
     SELECT ac.exchange_Code 'exchangecode', ac.account_id 'AccountID',  isnull(e.datafeed_ticker, ea.datafeed_ticker) 'SecurityName', v.estee_id 'EsteeID', Sum (CASE WHEN buy_sell_indicator=1 THEN traded_quantity ELSE 0 end) 'Long',Sum (CASE WHEN buy_sell_indicator=2 THEN traded_quantity ELSE 0 end) 'Short', SUM((3 - 2 * Buy_Sell_Indicator) * traded_quantity) 'NetPosition'  
             FROM vwalltrades v(nolock)  
                  LEFT JOIN esteemaster e(nolock) ON e.Estee_ID = v.Estee_ID  
      left join EsteeMaster_archive ea(nolock) on ea.Estee_ID = v.Estee_ID  
      AND ea.status=1  
                  INNER JOIN account ac(nolock) ON ac.Account_ID = v.account_id  
      INNER JOIN @dtTradingHours t on isnull(e.Estee_ID, ea.Estee_ID) = t.Estee_ID  
             WHERE creation_date = @previousPositionDate  
                   AND v.status IN('Executed', 'Partially Filled')  
                   AND ac.exchange_Code = @exCode and v.Account_Id=@accId  
                   AND CAST(Update_Time AS TIME) <= t.EndTime  
             GROUP BY ac.exchange_code, ac.account_id,  isnull(e.datafeed_ticker, ea.datafeed_ticker), v.estee_id  
     ) X  
             LEFT JOIN esteemaster e(nolock) ON e.Estee_ID = x.EsteeID  
             LEFT JOIN EsteeMaster_archive ea(nolock) ON ea.Estee_ID = X.EsteeID  
                                                         AND ea.status = 1  
         GROUP BY x.exchangecode, x.AccountID,  x.SecurityName, x.EsteeID  
         ORDER BY x.SecurityName  
  
  
   ------------------------------Step 3 (Current Day T session Payout)-------------------------------------------------     
  
   SELECT ac.account_id 'AccountID', v.estee_id 'EsteeID', Sum(Transaction_Cost) TC, Sum((3-2*Buy_Sell_Indicator) * traded_Price * Traded_Quantity * -1) NAE  
             FROM vwalltrades v(nolock)  
                  LEFT JOIN esteemaster e(nolock) ON e.Estee_ID = v.Estee_ID  
      left join EsteeMaster_archive ea(nolock) on ea.Estee_ID = v.Estee_ID  
      AND ea.status=1  
                  INNER JOIN account ac(nolock) ON ac.Account_ID = v.account_id  
      INNER JOIN @dtTradingHours t on isnull(e.Estee_ID, ea.Estee_ID) = t.Estee_ID  
             WHERE creation_date between @previousPositionDate and @tradeDate  
                   AND v.status IN('Executed', 'Partially Filled') and v.Account_Id=@accId  
                   AND ac.exchange_Code = @exCode  
                   AND Update_Time > DATEDIFF(dd, 0, @startDateTime) + CONVERT(DATETIME,t.EndTime) and Update_Time <= DATEDIFF(dd, 0, @endDateTime) + CONVERT(DATETIME,t.EndTime)  
             GROUP BY ac.account_id, v.estee_id     
   end  
     END


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetPreviousIVReturns

```sql


Create procedure spGetPreviousIVReturns
@tradeDate date
As
Begin

DECLARE @AsOfDate date = getdate()
set @AsOfDate = @tradeDate

----------Last latest IV return by EsteeId-----------------
;WITH cte AS (
    SELECT 
        UnderlyingEsteeId,
        TenorMonth,
        HistoricalIV,
        HistoricalDate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY UnderlyingEsteeId, TenorMonth
            ORDER BY HistoricalDate DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM HistoricalIVReturns
    WHERE HistoricalDate > '20251205' and HistoricalDate < @AsOfDate
)
SELECT 
    UnderlyingEsteeId,
    TenorMonth,
    HistoricalIV,
    HistoricalDate
FROM cte
WHERE rn = 1;

------------------Default Return--------------------
;WITH cte AS (
    SELECT 
        UnderlyingEsteeId,
        TenorMonth,
        HistoricalIVReturn,
        HistoricalDate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY UnderlyingEsteeId, TenorMonth
            ORDER BY HistoricalDate DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM HistoricalIVReturns
    WHERE HistoricalDate > '20251001' and HistoricalDate < @AsOfDate
)
SELECT 
    UnderlyingEsteeId,
    TenorMonth,
    HistoricalIVReturn,
    HistoricalDate
FROM cte
WHERE rn = 1;
End


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetPriceBandData

```sql
Create procedure spGetPriceBandData
@exCode varchar(2)

AS
BEGIN

declare @tempPriceBands table 
(
	Estee_id varchar(50),
	LowerBandValue [decimal](10, 2) NOT NULL,
	UpperBandValue [decimal](10, 2) NOT NULL
)

-- Equity and Index Spots
Insert into @tempPriceBands
select em.Estee_ID, Cast(SUBSTRING(ns.CreditRating,1,CHARINDEX('-',ns.CreditRating)-1) as decimal), Cast(SUBSTRING(ns.CreditRating,CHARINDEX('-',ns.CreditRating)+1 ,LEN(ns.CreditRating)) as decimal) from NSE_Security ns (nolock)
inner join esteemaster em (nolock) on em.Token = ns.Token and ns.ISIN = em.ISIN
inner join SecurityType st on st.TypeCode = em.Security_Type
inner join SecurityGroup sg on sg.ID = st.GroupID
WHERE em.Exchange_Code = @exCode and sg.ID = 5 and em.Status = 1

-- Equity and Index FO
Insert into @tempPriceBands
select em.Estee_ID, Cast(nc.operating_ranges_low_price_range as decimal)/100 , Cast(nc.operating_ranges_high_price_range as decimal)/100 from NSE_Contract nc (nolock)
inner join esteemaster em (nolock) on  em.Token = nc.Token and nc.ISIN = em.ISIN
inner join SecurityType st on st.TypeCode = em.Security_Type
inner join SecurityGroup sg on sg.ID = st.GroupID
where Exchange_Code = @exCode and  sg.ID in (3,4) and em.Status = 1

--Currency Derivatives
Insert into @tempPriceBands
select em.Estee_ID, Cast(nc.operating_ranges_low_price_range as decimal)/10000000, Cast(nc.operating_ranges_high_price_range as decimal)/10000000 from NSE_Contract_Cd nc (nolock)
inner join esteemaster em (nolock) on  em.Token = nc.Token and nc.ISIN = em.ISIN
inner join SecurityType st on st.TypeCode = em.Security_Type
inner join SecurityGroup sg on sg.ID = st.GroupID
where Exchange_Code = @exCode and sg.ID in (3,4,5) and em.Status = 1

--Commodity
Insert into @tempPriceBands
select em.Estee_ID, Cast(nc.operating_ranges_low_price_range as decimal)/10000, Cast(nc.operating_ranges_high_price_range as decimal)/10000 from NSE_Contract_Com nc (nolock)
inner join esteemaster em (nolock) on  em.Token = nc.Token and nc.ISIN = em.ISIN
inner join SecurityType st on st.TypeCode = em.Security_Type
inner join SecurityGroup sg on sg.ID = st.GroupID
where Exchange_Code = @exCode and sg.ID in (3,4,5) and em.Status = 1

select * from @tempPriceBands

END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetPriceBandPercentages

```sql
Create PROCEDURE spGetPriceBandPercentages           
@today date,       
@previousWorkingDay date,      
@exchangeCodes varchar(50) = 'ALL',      
@exchangeSegments varchar(max) = 'ALL',  
@lstEsteeID varchar(max) = '',
@isPercentage bit =1    
as            
BEGIN    

set nocount ON;

  DECLARE @segmentsTable TABLE (segment int)       
	IF (@exchangeSegments <> 'ALL')  
	INSERT into @segmentsTable SELECT cast(items as int) from dbo.split(@exchangeSegments,',')           
 
 DECLARE @exgTable TABLE (exchange varchar(20))                 
 INSERT into @exgTable SELECT * from dbo.split(@exchangeCodes,',')      
 
 Create Table #EsteeID(estee_ID [char](50))  
 
  IF( @lstEsteeID != '')  
  begin  
     INSERT into #EsteeID 
	 SELECT * from dbo.split(@lstEsteeID,',') 
  end   
  else
  begin
	 IF(@exchangeCodes = 'ALL' and @exchangeSegments = 'ALL')
	 BEGIN
	 INSERT into #EsteeID 
	 select Estee_ID from esteemaster e  (nolock)  
	 where e.Status ='1' 
	end
	ELSE IF (@exchangeSegments = 'ALL')      
    begin      
		Insert into #EsteeID
		select e.Estee_ID from esteemaster e (nolock)
		where e.Exchange_Code in (select exchange from @exgTable)  and    e.Status ='1'  
    end   
	ELSE IF (@exchangeCodes = 'ALL')
	BEGIN
		Insert into #EsteeID
		select e.Estee_ID from esteemaster e (nolock)
		where  e.Security_Type in (select segment from @segmentsTable) and    e.Status='1'
		END
		else      
    begin        
	 Insert into #EsteeID
		select e.Estee_ID from esteemaster e (nolock)
		where e.Security_Type in (select segment from @segmentsTable) and e.Exchange_Code in (select exchange from @exgTable)  and    e.Status ='1'
   end    
	END  

	;With tempClosePrice (Estee_id) as
	(
		select cp.Estee_ID from closingprice cp (nolock)
		where cp.Date = @previousWorkingDay 
	),
	  tempPriceBands AS
	(
		select pb.* from PriceBands pb (nolock)
		inner join #EsteeID e on pb.Estee_ID = e.estee_ID
		where AsOfDate = @today
	),
	 tempPriceBands2 (Estee_Id,LowerBandValue,UpperBandValue,LowerBandValue2,UpperBandValue2,LowerBandValue3,UpperBandValue3,BandIndex) AS 
	(
		select pb.Estee_Id,LowerBandValue,UpperBandValue,LowerBandValue2,UpperBandValue2,LowerBandValue3,UpperBandValue3,BandIndex 
		from tempPriceBands pb 
		inner join tempClosePrice cp  on cp.Estee_ID = pb.Estee_Id
		where pb.Exchange_Code <> 'IS' 
		union
		select Estee_Id,LowerBandValue,UpperBandValue,LowerBandValue2,UpperBandValue2,LowerBandValue3,UpperBandValue3,BandIndex          
		from PriceBands (nolock) where AsOfDate>=@today and Estee_Id like '%*%'    
		UNION
		select Estee_Id,LowerBandValue,UpperBandValue,LowerBandValue2,UpperBandValue2,LowerBandValue3,UpperBandValue3,BandIndex from PriceBands (nolock) where Estee_Id like '%ALL'   
	),
	tempPriceBands3(Estee_Id,LowerBandValue,UpperBandValue,LowerBandValue2,UpperBandValue2,LowerBandValue3,UpperBandValue3,BandIndex) AS 
	(
		select pb.Estee_Id,LowerBandValue,UpperBandValue,LowerBandValue2,UpperBandValue2,LowerBandValue3,UpperBandValue3,BandIndex  
		from tempPriceBands pb  
		where pb.Exchange_Code = 'IS' and pb.isPercentage = @isPercentage  
	)

SELECT * from tempPriceBands2 
union
select * from tempPriceBands3 
option (maxrecursion 0, optimize for unknown)

drop table #EsteeID

END 



```

```sql
	;With tempClosePrice (Estee_id) as

		from PriceBands (nolock) where AsOfDate>=@today and Estee_Id like '%*%'    
		UNION
		select Estee_Id,LowerBandValue,UpperBandValue,LowerBandValue2,UpperBandValue2,LowerBandValue3,UpperBandValue3,BandIndex from PriceBands (nolock) where Estee_Id like '%ALL'   
	),
	tempPriceBands3(Estee_Id,LowerBandValue,UpperBandValue,LowerBandValue2,UpperBandValue2,LowerBandValue3,UpperBandValue3,BandIndex) AS 
	(
		select pb.Estee_Id,LowerBandValue,UpperBandValue,LowerBandValue2,UpperBandValue2,LowerBandValue3,UpperBandValue3,BandIndex  
		from tempPriceBands pb  
		where pb.Exchange_Code in ('IS','BR') and pb.isPercentage = @isPercentage  
	)

SELECT * from tempPriceBands2 
union
select * from tempPriceBands3 
option (maxrecursion 0, optimize for unknown)

drop table #EsteeID

END 



```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetReferenceData

```sql


CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].spGetReferenceData

 @EsteeIds varchar(max),

 @CPDate date,

 @AsOfDate date,

 @RunDate date

AS

BEGIN       

 SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;  

 DECLARE @esteeid TABLE(eid varchar(150))

 INSERT INTO @esteeid

 SELECT items

 FROM dbo.split(@EsteeIds,',')

 select distinct em.AsOfDate, em.estee_id, em.DataFeed_Ticker, em.ISIN, em.Exchange_Code, vc.Segment as ExchangeSegment, em.Security_Type, cast(em.Strike_Price * 10000 as int) as Strike_Price,

	cast(em.Tick_Size * 10000 as int) as Tick_Size,

	em.Lot_Size, cm.QuotationUnit * 10000 as QuotationUnit, cm.QuotationMetric,

	em.Expiry_Date, em.Expiry_Date2, em.SERIES,

	cast(cp.Open_Price * 10000 as int) as Open_Price, cast(cp.Close_Price * 10000 as int) as Close_Price, cast(cp.Low_Price * 10000 as int) as Low_Price,

	cast(cp.High_Price * 10000 as int) as High_Price, cp.Volume, cast(cp.Open_Interest as int) as Open_Interest, bs.ban_status, em.SettlementIndicator

	--, ca.ActionType, ca.Action, ca.EffectiveDate

	from esteemaster em

	inner join @esteeid eids on eids.eid = em.Estee_ID

	left join CommodityMaster cm on cm.Estee_ID = em.Estee_ID

	left join closingprice cp on em.Estee_ID = cp.Estee_ID and cp.Date = @CPDate

	left join tblBanSecurities bs on bs.estee_id = em.Estee_ID

	inner join ValidCombos vc on vc.ExchangeCode = em.Exchange_Code and vc.SecurityType = em.Security_Type

	select UnderlyingEsteeId, ActionType,Action,EffectiveDate from CorporateActionTable ca inner join @esteeid eids on ca.UnderlyingEsteeId = eids.eid and ca.EffectiveDate>=@RunDate order by EffectiveDate

END

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetRestartConfig

```sql
Create procedure spGetRestartConfig
@objectName varchar(100),
@exchangeCode varchar(2) = null,
@colocation varchar(20) = null

As

Begin

	declare @exchangeList Table(ExchangeCode varchar(2))
	declare @locationsList Table(LocationCode varchar(3))
	declare @restartApplicationConfig Table (ApplicationName varchar(100),ObjectType varchar(50),
		ObjectName varchar(50),Exchange varchar(100))

	if(@exchangeCode is null)
	BEGIN
		Insert into @exchangeList
		select code from Exchange
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		Insert into @exchangeList values
		(@exchangeCode)
	END

	if(@colocation is null)
	BEGIN
		Insert into @locationsList
		select LocationCode from Locations
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		Insert into @locationsList values
		(@colocation)
	END

	declare @exchangeCSV varchar(100)
	select @exchangeCSV = COALESCE(@exchangeCSV+ ',','')  + code from Exchange

	Insert into @restartApplicationConfig
	select ApplicationName,ObjectType,ObjectName,case when Exchange = 'ALL' then @exchangeCSV ELSE Exchange END  from RestartApplicationConfig

	select ApplicationName,ObjectType,ObjectName,exCode.items as Exchangecode into #RestartAppConfig from @restartApplicationConfig CROSS APPLY dbo.Split(Exchange, ',') as exCode

	IF(@objectName = 'IndexTable')
	BEGIN 
		select distinct Substring(indexConstituent.items,13,2) as ExchangeCode into #tempExchangeList from DataInit d
		inner join EsteeApplications ea on ea.ApplicationID = d.ApplicationID
		inner join EsteeServersProd es on es.ID = ea.EsteeServer_ID
		inner join @locationsList l on l.LocationCode = es.LocationCode
		CROSS APPLY dbo.Split(d.Value, ',') as indexConstituent
		where Parameter = 'UseIndexConstituents'

		select ApplicationName, rac.Exchangecode from #RestartAppConfig rac
		inner join #tempExchangeList e on e.ExchangeCode = rac.Exchangecode
		inner join @exchangeList el on el.ExchangeCode = e.ExchangeCode
		where ObjectName = @objectName

		drop table #tempExchangeList
	END

	ELSE
	BEGIN
		declare @positionDate DateTime
		declare @prevMonthDate DateTime

		set @positionDate = (select MAX(PositionDate) from DailyPositions)
		set @prevMonthDate = DATEADD(MONTH,-1,@positionDate)

		set @prevMonthDate = (select distinct top 1 PositionDate from dailypositions where PositionDate >= @prevMonthDate order by PositionDate)

		select sn.SubStrategy_Id into #tempStrategyList from strategy_new sn
		inner join EsteeApplications ea on ea.SubStrategy_ID = sn.SubStrategy_Id
		inner join EsteeServersProd es on es.ID = ea.EsteeServer_ID
		inner join @locationsList ll on ll.LocationCode = es.LocationCode
		where sn.Strategy_Status = 1 

		select distinct Account_ID,Sub_StrategyID, Exchange_Code into #tempPositions from (
		select SecurityName,Long,Short,Account_ID,SecurityType,Sub_StrategyID, Exchange_Code from DailyPositions dp
		inner join #tempStrategyList sl on dp.Sub_StrategyID = sl.SubStrategy_Id
		where PositionDate = @positionDate and Long<>short
		except
		select SecurityName,Long,Short,Account_ID,SecurityType,Sub_StrategyID, Exchange_Code from DailyPositions dp
		inner join #tempStrategyList sl on dp.Sub_StrategyID = sl.SubStrategy_Id
		where PositionDate = @prevMonthDate and Long<>short
		) as x 

		if exists(select * from #tempPositions)
		BEGIN
			select distinct rac.ApplicationName,rac.Exchangecode from EsteeServersProd es 
			inner join EsteeApplications ea on es.ID = ea.EsteeServer_ID
			inner join EsteeApplicationNames ean on ean.id = ea.AppNameID
			inner join #RestartAppConfig rac on rac.ApplicationName = ean.ApplicationName
			inner join @locationsList ll on ll.LocationCode = es.LocationCode
			inner join @exchangeList exl on exl.ExchangeCode = rac.Exchangecode
			inner join #tempPositions ex on ex.Exchange_Code = exl.ExchangeCode
			where  rac.ObjectName = @objectName  and ea.isRunning =1 
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
		PRINT 'There is no difference in positions in a month'
		END

		drop table #tempPositions
		drop table #tempStrategyList
		drop table #RestartAppConfig
	END
End

```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetScripsMM

```sql
--sp_helptext [spGetScripsMM]  
  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetScripsMM]        
 @Date1 DateTime = NULL,  
 @Date2 DateTime = NULL,       
 @MinSpread decimal(18,2) = NULL,     
 @SubStrategyID int = NULL    
    
AS    
    
BEGIN    
   
 declare @__TempMMTable1 table   
 (  
 DateofTrade Date,  
 sub_strategy_id int,  
 Estee_id varchar(30),  
 TotalQuantity int,  
 avgprice decimal(18,5),  
 spreadcaptured decimal(18,2),  
 TradedQuantity int  
 )  
  
 insert into @__TempMMTable1   
 select ot.Creation_Date,  
   ot.sub_strategy_id,      
   t.Estee_id,      
   sum(t.traded_quantity*(2*t.Buy_Sell_Indicator-3)),   
   sum(t.traded_quantity * t.traded_price)/sum(t.traded_quantity),  
   (sum(2*t.traded_price*t.traded_quantity*(2*t.Buy_Sell_Indicator-3))/sum(t.Traded_Quantity*t.traded_price))*10000,  
   sum(t.traded_quantity)   
 from [Order] o  
inner join OrderTrades ot with(nolock) on o.Creation_Date = ot.Creation_Date and o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID  
inner join Trades t with (nolock) on ot.OrderTrade_ID = t.OrderTrade_ID and ot.Creation_Date = t.Creation_Date and ot.Order_ID = t.Order_ID  
where ot.Status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') and o.Creation_Date >= @Date1 and o.Creation_Date < @Date2   
and ot.sub_strategy_id = @SubStrategyID  
and t.traded_price <> 0
 group by ot.Creation_Date, t.Estee_id, ot.Sub_Strategy_ID  
  
  
 select   
 sum(TradedQuantity * spreadcaptured * avgprice) / sum(TradedQuantity * avgprice) as spreadcaptured,   
 Estee_id,   
 sum(TradedQuantity) as TradedQuantity ,   
 sum(TotalQuantity) as TotalQuantity from   
 @__TempMMTable1 where TotalQuantity = 0 and DateofTrade not in   
 (      
   select DateofTrade     
   from @__TempMMTable1   
   group by DateofTrade   
   having SUM(spreadcaptured * TradedQuantity)/SUM(TradedQuantity) < @MinSpread  
 )  
 group by Estee_id  
  
  
    
END    
  
  
  
SET ANSI_NULLS ON  
```
