```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE spGetTradeInfoForLiveMatchingOrient @tradeDateIn DATE,
	@exchangeCodesList LISTSTRING READONLY,
	@startTimeIn TIME,
	@endTimeIn TIME,
	@securityTypeList LISTSTRING READONLY,
	@includeXTXAccount BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from                  
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.                  
	DECLARE @tradeDate DATE
	DECLARE @startTime TIME
	DECLARE @endTime TIME

	SET @tradeDate = @tradeDateIn
	SET @startTime = @startTimeIn
	SET @endTime = @endTimeIn
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @XTXStartTime TIME
	DECLARE @XTXEndTime TIME

	SET @XTXStartTime = cast(cast(@startTime AS DATETIME) - cast('04:30' AS DATETIME) AS TIME)
	SET @XTXEndTime = cast(cast(@endTime AS DATETIME) - cast('04:30' AS DATETIME) AS TIME)

	DECLARE @sectypes ListString
	DECLARE @excgCodes ListString

	IF NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM @securityTypeList
			)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @sectypes
		SELECT st.TypeCode
		FROM dbo.SecurityType st;
	END;
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @sectypes
		SELECT ListItem
		FROM @securityTypeList;
	END
	insert into @excgCodes
	select ListItem from @exchangeCodesList

	IF (@includeXTXAccount = 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT t.Buy_Sell_Indicator AS BuyOrSell,
			t.traded_quantity AS TradedQuantity,
			t.ExecId,
			o.exchange_order_id AS ExOrderId,
			a.Account_ID AS AccountId,
			o.Ems_ID EmsId,
			t.Estee_ID AS Estee_Id,
			t.Traded_Price AS Traded_Price,
			CONVERT(DATETIME, t.Creation_Date) + CONVERT(DATETIME, isnull(t.Creation_Time, cast(ot.Update_Time AS TIME))) AS Update_Time
		FROM [Order] o WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ordertrades ot WITH (NOLOCK) ON o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID
			AND o.creation_date = ot.creation_date
		INNER JOIN trades t WITH (NOLOCK) ON t.ordertrade_id = ot.ordertrade_id
			AND t.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID
			AND t.creation_date = ot.creation_date
			AND t.Traded_Quantity <> 0
		INNER JOIN Account a ON o.Account_ID = a.Account_ID
		LEFT JOIN esteemaster e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.estee_id = t.estee_id
			AND e.STATUS = 1
		INNER JOIN @sectypes st ON e.Security_Type = st.ListItem
		inner join @excgCodes ec on ec.ListItem=e.Exchange_Code
		WHERE o.Creation_Date = @tradeDate
			AND ot.STATUS IN ('Executed', 'Partially Filled')
			--AND e.exchange_code = @exchgCode
			AND o.order_source_id NOT IN ('Odin', 'ECM', 'OdinDirectTransfer', 'Balancing', 'New Balancing')
			AND a.UCC <> 'FIXXTX0001' and a.Account_ID <> 764 
			AND isnull(t.Creation_Time, cast(ot.Update_Time AS TIME)) > @startTime
			AND isnull(t.Creation_Time, cast(ot.Update_Time AS TIME)) <= @endTime
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT t.Buy_Sell_Indicator AS BuyOrSell,
			t.traded_quantity AS TradedQuantity,
			t.ExecId,
			o.exchange_order_id AS ExOrderId,
			a.Account_ID AS AccountId,
			o.Ems_ID EmsId,
			t.Estee_ID AS Estee_Id,
			t.Traded_Price AS Traded_Price,
			CONVERT(DATETIME, t.Creation_Date) + CONVERT(DATETIME, isnull(t.Creation_Time, cast(ot.Update_Time AS TIME))) AS Update_Time
		FROM [Order] o WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ordertrades ot WITH (NOLOCK) ON o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID
			AND o.creation_date = ot.creation_date
		INNER JOIN trades t WITH (NOLOCK) ON t.ordertrade_id = ot.ordertrade_id
			AND t.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID
			AND t.creation_date = ot.creation_date
			AND t.Traded_Quantity <> 0 
		INNER JOIN Account a ON o.Account_ID = a.Account_ID
		LEFT JOIN esteemaster e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.estee_id = t.estee_id
			AND e.STATUS = 1
		INNER JOIN @sectypes st ON e.Security_Type = st.ListItem
		inner join @excgCodes ec on ec.ListItem=e.Exchange_Code
		WHERE o.Creation_Date = @tradeDate
			AND ot.STATUS IN ('Executed', 'Partially Filled')
			--AND e.exchange_code = @exchgCode
			AND o.order_source_id NOT IN ('Odin', 'ECM', 'OdinDirectTransfer', 'Balancing', 'New Balancing')
			AND a.UCC <> 'FIXXTX0001' and a.Account_ID <> 764 
			AND isnull(t.Creation_Time, cast(ot.Update_Time AS TIME)) > @startTime
			AND isnull(t.Creation_Time, cast(ot.Update_Time AS TIME)) <= @endTime
	
		UNION
	
		SELECT t.Buy_Sell_Indicator AS BuyOrSell,
			t.traded_quantity AS TradedQuantity,
			t.ExecId,
			o.exchange_order_id AS ExOrderId,
			a.Account_ID AS AccountId,
			o.Ems_ID EmsId,
			t.Estee_ID AS Estee_Id,
			t.Traded_Price AS Traded_Price,
			CONVERT(DATETIME, t.Creation_Date) + CONVERT(DATETIME, isnull(t.Creation_Time, cast(ot.Update_Time AS time))) AS Update_Time
		FROM [Order] o WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ordertrades ot WITH (NOLOCK) ON o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID
			AND o.creation_date = ot.creation_date
		INNER JOIN trades t WITH (NOLOCK) ON t.ordertrade_id = ot.ordertrade_id
			AND t.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID
			AND t.creation_date = ot.creation_date
			AND t.Traded_Quantity <> 0
		INNER JOIN Account a ON o.Account_ID = a.Account_ID
		LEFT JOIN esteemaster e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.estee_id = t.estee_id
			AND e.STATUS = 1
		INNER JOIN @sectypes st ON e.Security_Type = st.ListItem
		inner join @excgCodes ec on ec.ListItem=e.Exchange_Code
		WHERE o.Creation_Date = @tradeDate
			AND ot.STATUS IN ('Executed', 'Partially Filled')
			--AND e.exchange_code = @exchgCode
			AND o.order_source_id NOT IN ('Odin', 'ECM', 'OdinDirectTransfer', 'Balancing', 'New Balancing')
			AND a.UCC = 'FIXXTX0001' and a.Account_ID <> 764 
			AND isnull(t.Creation_Time, cast(ot.Update_Time AS TIME)) > @XTXStartTime
			AND isnull(t.Creation_Time, cast(ot.Update_Time AS TIME)) <= @XTXEndTime
	END
END;

```

```sql
           )

     t.ExecId, o.exchange_order_id AS ExOrderId, a.UCC AS Account, o.Ems_ID,o.Creation_Time,  ot.Update_Time  
               FROM [Order] o WITH (nolock)  
               INNER JOIN ordertrades ot WITH (nolock) ON o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID

                                                    AND t.creation_date = ot.creation_date  
               INNER JOIN Account a ON o.Account_ID = a.Account_ID  
               LEFT JOIN esteemaster e WITH (nolock) ON e.estee_id = t.estee_id  
                                                        AND e.Status = 1  
               LEFT JOIN EsteeMaster_archive ea WITH (nolock) ON t.estee_id = ea.estee_id  
                                                                 AND ea.Status = 1  
               JOIN @securityTypeList st ON ISNULL(e.Security_Type, ea.Security_Type) = st.ListItem  
               join vwadapterconfig v on (v.emsApplicationID=o.Ems_ID OR cast(o.Ems_ID as varchar) = v.UserId)

              WHERE o.Creation_Date = @tradeDate

               AND ISNULL(e.exchange_code, ea.exchange_code) = @exchgCode  
               AND o.order_source_id NOT IN('Odin', 'ECM','OdinDirectTransfer')  
              ORDER BY o.Exchange_Order_ID, t.ExecId;  
         END;  
         ELSE  if(@excludeXTXAccount=1)
         BEGIN  
             SELECT t.Estee_ID AS EsteeId, t.Buy_Sell_Indicator AS BuyOrSell, t.traded_quantity AS TradedQuantity, t.Traded_Price AS TradedPrice,   
     t.ExecId, o.exchange_order_id AS ExOrderId, a.UCC AS Account, o.Ems_ID, ot.Update_Time

               INNER JOIN Account a ON o.Account_ID = a.Account_ID

                                                        AND e.Status = 1  
               LEFT JOIN EsteeMaster_archive ea WITH (nolock) ON t.estee_id = ea.estee_id  
                                                                 AND ea.Status = 1  
               INNER JOIN @securityTypeList st ON ISNULL(e.Security_Type, ea.Security_Type) = st.ListItem  
WHERE o.Creation_Date = @tradeDate  
                AND ot.status IN('Executed', 'Partially Filled')  
                AND ISNULL(e.exchange_code, ea.exchange_code) = @exchgCode  
                AND o.order_source_id NOT IN('Odin', 'ECM','OdinDirectTransfer')  
				and a.UCC <> 'FIXXTX0001' 
              ORDER BY o.Exchange_Order_ID, t.ExecId;  
         END;  
		 ELSE 
         BEGIN  
             SELECT t.Estee_ID AS EsteeId, t.Buy_Sell_Indicator AS BuyOrSell, t.traded_quantity AS TradedQuantity, t.Traded_Price AS TradedPrice,   
     t.ExecId, o.exchange_order_id AS ExOrderId, a.UCC AS Account, o.Ems_ID, ot.Update_Time  
               FROM [Order] o WITH (nolock)  
               INNER JOIN ordertrades ot WITH (nolock) ON o.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID  
                                                          AND o.creation_date = ot.creation_date  
               INNER JOIN trades t WITH (nolock) ON t.ordertrade_id = ot.ordertrade_id  and t.Order_ID = ot.Order_ID   
                                                    AND t.creation_date = ot.creation_date  
               INNER JOIN Account a ON o.Account_ID = a.Account_ID  
               LEFT JOIN esteemaster e WITH (nolock) ON e.estee_id = t.estee_id  
                                                        AND e.Status = 1  
               LEFT JOIN EsteeMaster_archive ea WITH (nolock) ON t.estee_id = ea.estee_id  
                                                                 AND ea.Status = 1  
               INNER JOIN @securityTypeList st ON ISNULL(e.Security_Type, ea.Security_Type) = st.ListItem  
WHERE o.Creation_Date = @tradeDate  
                AND ot.status IN('Executed', 'Partially Filled')  
                AND ISNULL(e.exchange_code, ea.exchange_code) = @exchgCode  
                AND o.order_source_id NOT IN('Odin', 'ECM','OdinDirectTransfer')
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetTradesForExchangeRebate

```sql

CREATE Procedure spGetTradesForExchangeRebate
@tradeDate date,
@locationCode varchar(10)

As
Begin
declare @isBackDate int
set @isBackDate = 0
if (@tradeDate < cast(GETDATE() as date))
begin
	set @isBackDate = 1
end

DECLARE @TempRebateConfig TABLE(Id int, EsteeId varchar(50), Lot_Size int, AccountId int, Amount decimal(20,6),  AmountMinCap decimal(30,6), AmountMaxCap decimal(30,6), ChargeType int, OrderType varchar(2), StartTime Time, EndTime Time, StrategyId int)
DECLARE @RebateConfig TABLE(UndEsteeId varchar(50), EsteeId varchar(50), Lot_Size int, SecurityType int, ContractExpiryCycle int, ExpiryMonth int)

if(@isBackDate = 1)
begin

DECLARE @TempContracts TABLE(UndEsteeId varchar(50), EsteeId varchar(50), Lot_Size int, SecurityType int, ContractExpiryCycle int, ExpiryDate date)
insert into @TempContracts
select distinct e.Estee_ID UndEsteeId, e1.Estee_ID EsteeId, e1.Lot_Size, e1.Security_Type, isnull(e1.ContractExpiryCycle, 3) ContractExpiryCycle, e1.Expiry_Date from esteemaster (nolock) e inner join esteemaster (nolock) e1 on e.ISIN = e1.ISIN and e.Exchange_Code = e1.Exchange_Code 
inner join ExchangeRebateConfig (nolock) con on con.UnderlyingEsteeId = e.Estee_ID and con.SecType = e1.Security_Type
where LocationCode = @locationCode and e.Security_Type in (0,4,10,19,35)
UNION
select distinct e.Estee_ID UndEsteeId, e1.Estee_ID EsteeId, e1.Lot_Size, e1.Security_Type, isnull(e1.ContractExpiryCycle, 3) ContractExpiryCycle, e1.Expiry_Date from esteemaster (nolock) e inner join esteemaster (nolock) e1 on e.ISIN = e1.ISIN and e.Exchange_Code = e1.Exchange_Code 
inner join ExchangeRebateConfig (nolock) con on con.SecType = e1.Security_Type and con.UnderlyingEsteeId = e.Exchange_Code
where LocationCode = @locationCode and e.Security_Type in (0,4,10,19,35) and e.Estee_ID like '' +con.FilterStartWith+ '%' and con.FilterStartWith <> '' and con.FilterStartWith is not null

UNION

select distinct e.Estee_ID UndEsteeId, e1.Estee_ID EsteeId, e1.Lot_Size, e1.Security_Type, isnull(e1.ContractExpiryCycle, 3) ContractExpiryCycle, e1.Expiry_Date from esteemaster (nolock) e inner join EsteeMaster_archive (nolock) e1 on e.ISIN = e1.ISIN and e.Exchange_Code = e1.Exchange_Code 
inner join ExchangeRebateConfig (nolock) con on con.UnderlyingEsteeId = e.Estee_ID and con.SecType = e1.Security_Type and e1.Status = 1
where LocationCode = @locationCode and e1.Expiry_Date >= @tradeDate and e.Security_Type in (0,4,10,19,35)

UNION

select distinct e.Estee_ID UndEsteeId, e1.Estee_ID EsteeId, e1.Lot_Size, e1.Security_Type, isnull(e1.ContractExpiryCycle, 3) ContractExpiryCycle, e1.Expiry_Date from esteemaster (nolock) e inner join EsteeMaster_archive (nolock) e1 on e.ISIN = e1.ISIN and e.Exchange_Code = e1.Exchange_Code 
inner join ExchangeRebateConfig (nolock) con on con.UnderlyingEsteeId = e.Exchange_Code and con.SecType = e1.Security_Type and e1.Status = 1
where LocationCode = @locationCode and e1.Expiry_Date >= @tradeDate and e.Security_Type in (0,4,10,19,35) and e.Estee_ID like '' +con.FilterStartWith+ '%' and con.FilterStartWith <> '' and con.FilterStartWith is not null

insert into @RebateConfig
select distinct t.UndEsteeId, t.EsteeId, t.Lot_Size, t.SecurityType, t.ContractExpiryCycle, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY UndEsteeId ORDER BY ExpiryDate) AS ExpiryMonth from @TempContracts t

end
else
begin

insert into @RebateConfig
select distinct e.Estee_ID UndEsteeId, e1.Estee_ID EsteeId, e1.Lot_Size, e1.Security_Type, isnull(e1.ContractExpiryCycle, 3) ContractExpiryCycle, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY e.Estee_Id ORDER BY e1.expiry_date) AS ExpiryMonth from esteemaster (nolock) e inner join esteemaster (nolock) e1 on e.ISIN = e1.ISIN and e.Exchange_Code = e1.Exchange_Code
inner join ExchangeRebateConfig (nolock) con on con.UnderlyingEsteeId = e.UnderlyingEstee_Id and con.SecType = e1.Security_Type
where e.Security_Type in (0,4,10,19,35)
UNION
select distinct e.Estee_ID UndEsteeId, e1.Estee_ID EsteeId, e1.Lot_Size, e1.Security_Type, isnull(e1.ContractExpiryCycle, 3) ContractExpiryCycle, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY e.Estee_Id ORDER BY e1.expiry_date) AS ExpiryMonth from esteemaster (nolock) e inner join esteemaster (nolock) e1 on e.ISIN = e1.ISIN and e.Exchange_Code = e1.Exchange_Code
inner join ExchangeRebateConfig (nolock) con on con.UnderlyingEsteeId = e.Exchange_Code and con.SecType = e1.Security_Type
where e.Security_Type in (0,4,10,19,35) and e.Estee_ID like '' +con.FilterStartWith+ '%' and con.FilterStartWith <> '' and con.FilterStartWith is not null

end

insert into @TempRebateConfig
select distinct con.Id, r.EsteeId, r.Lot_Size, AccountId,Amount,AmountMinCap,AmountMaxCap,ChargeType, OrderType, StartTime, EndTime, StrategyId from @RebateConfig r inner join ExchangeRebateConfig con on r.UndEsteeId = con.UnderlyingEsteeId where con.ExpiryContractCycle = -1 and con.ExpiryMonth = -1 and con.SecType = r.SecurityType and con.LocationCode = @locationCode
UNION 
select distinct con.Id,r.EsteeId, r.Lot_Size, AccountId,Amount,AmountMinCap,AmountMaxCap,ChargeType, OrderType, StartTime, EndTime, StrategyId from @RebateConfig r inner join ExchangeRebateConfig con on r.UndEsteeId = con.UnderlyingEsteeId where con.ExpiryContractCycle = r.ContractExpiryCycle and con.ExpiryMonth = r.ExpiryMonth and con.SecType = r.SecurityType and con.LocationCode = @locationCode
UNION  
select distinct con.Id,r.EsteeId, r.Lot_Size, AccountId,Amount,AmountMinCap,AmountMaxCap,ChargeType, OrderType, StartTime, EndTime, StrategyId from @RebateConfig r inner join ExchangeRebateConfig con on r.UndEsteeId = con.UnderlyingEsteeId where con.ExpiryContractCycle = r.ContractExpiryCycle and con.ExpiryMonth = -1 and con.SecType = r.SecurityType and con.LocationCode = @locationCode
UNION  
select distinct con.Id,r.EsteeId, r.Lot_Size, AccountId,Amount,AmountMinCap,AmountMaxCap,ChargeType, OrderType, StartTime, EndTime, StrategyId from @RebateConfig r inner join ExchangeRebateConfig con on r.UndEsteeId = con.UnderlyingEsteeId where con.ExpiryContractCycle = -1 and con.ExpiryMonth = r.ExpiryMonth and con.SecType = r.SecurityType and con.LocationCode = @locationCode

select distinct Id, temp.EsteeId, temp.ChargeType, temp.AccountId, vw.Sub_Strategy_ID, Min(temp.Lot_Size) LotSize, Min(temp.Amount) Amount, Min(temp.AmountMinCap) AmountMinCap, Min(temp.AmountMaxCap) AmountMaxCap, Sum(vw.Traded_Quantity) AgQty, Sum(vw.Traded_Price) AgTrdPrice, Sum(Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price) Turnover, Count(*) TradeCount, MIN(temp.StartTime) StartTime  from vwalltrades vw inner join @TempRebateConfig temp on vw.Estee_ID = temp.EsteeId and vw.Account_ID = temp.AccountId
where Creation_Date = @tradeDate and vw.status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') 
and vw.Creation_Time > temp.StartTime and vw.Creation_Time < temp.EndTime
and vw.Order_Source_ID  not in ('ECM','Odin') and temp.OrderType = '-1'
group by Id, temp.EsteeId, temp.ChargeType, temp.AccountId, vw.Sub_Strategy_ID, temp.StartTime

UNION

select distinct Id, temp.EsteeId, temp.ChargeType, temp.AccountId, isnull(temp.StrategyId, vw.Sub_Strategy_ID) Sub_Strategy_ID, Min(temp.Lot_Size) LotSize, Min(temp.Amount) Amount, Min(temp.AmountMinCap) AmountMinCap, Min(temp.AmountMaxCap) AmountMaxCap, Sum(vw.Traded_Quantity) AgQty, Sum(vw.Traded_Price) AgTrdPrice, Sum(Traded_Quantity * Traded_Price) Turnover, Count(*) TradeCount, MIN(temp.StartTime) StartTime  from vwalltrades vw inner join @TempRebateConfig temp on vw.Estee_ID = temp.EsteeId and vw.Account_ID = temp.AccountId
where Creation_Date = @tradeDate and vw.status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') 
and vw.Creation_Time > temp.StartTime and vw.Creation_Time < temp.EndTime
and vw.Order_Source_ID  not in ('ECM','Odin') and vw.Order_Type = temp.OrderType
group by Id, temp.EsteeId, temp.ChargeType, temp.AccountId, isnull(temp.StrategyId, vw.Sub_Strategy_ID), temp.StartTime

End


```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetTradesToIgnoreDueToOdinOrCA

```sql
Create procedure spGetTradesToIgnoreDueToOdinOrCA
@tradeDate date
As
Begin

select vw.Account_ID, vw.Sub_Strategy_ID, vw.Estee_ID,
SUM(case when Buy_Sell_Indicator = 1 then Traded_quantity * Traded_Price else 0 end) as BuyValue,
SUM(case when Buy_Sell_Indicator = 2 then Traded_quantity * Traded_Price else 0 end) as SellValue
from vwAllTrades vw inner join tblBrokerAccount t on vw.Account_ID = t.account_id 
where Creation_Date = @tradeDate and status in ('Executed','Partially Filled') 
and Order_Source_Id in ('ECM','OdinDirectTransfer','ODIN','New Balancing','Balancing') and ApplyTC = 0
and t.is_active = 1 and t.AccountUserType in (1,2)
group by vw.Account_ID, vw.Sub_Strategy_ID, vw.Estee_ID

End
```

## Stored procedure: dbo.spGetTradeTableExecutionReport

```sql
CREATE procedure spGetTradeTableExecutionReport
@Sub_Strategy_ID INT,
@tradedate DATE
 
As
 
Begin
 
;WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        t.Link_ID                    AS RuleId,
        CONVERT(DATE, t.Creation_Date) AS TradeDate,   -- date-only
        t.TradeTime                  AS TradeDateTime,  -- keep time for LastTradeTime
        pos.orientation,
        vLatest.VersionId,
        em.Underlying_Ticker         AS Symbol,
        ISNULL(em.Lot_Size, 1)        AS Lot_Size,
        em.Expiry_Date               AS ExpiryDateRow,  -- carry row-level expiry
        -- choose desired price once per row
        CASE 
            WHEN UPPER(pos.orientation) = 'FWD' AND ISNUMERIC(jp.FwdPriceRaw) = 1
                THEN CAST(jp.FwdPriceRaw AS DECIMAL(38,6))
            WHEN UPPER(pos.orientation) = 'REV' AND ISNUMERIC(jp.RevPriceRaw) = 1
                THEN CAST(jp.RevPriceRaw AS DECIMAL(38,6))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS DesiredPrice,
        -- row-level execution value, normalized by lot size
        CAST(
            ((3 - 2 * t.Buy_Sell_Indicator) * -1.0) 
            * (t.Traded_Quantity * t.Traded_Price)
            / NULLIF(CAST(ISNULL(em.Lot_Size, 1) AS DECIMAL(38,6)), 0)
            AS DECIMAL(38,6)
        ) AS RowExecPerLot
    FROM vwAllTrades t
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 VersionId
        FROM atpRuleFillVersion rfv
        WHERE rfv.RuleId = t.Link_ID
          AND rfv.TradeId <= t.ExecId
        ORDER BY rfv.TradeId DESC
    ) vLatest
    LEFT JOIN atpRuleVersion rv
        ON rv.RuleId    = t.Link_ID
       AND rv.VersionId = vLatest.VersionId
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT 
            dbo.JsonPairValue(rv.Constants, N'FwdPrice') AS FwdPriceRaw,
            dbo.JsonPairValue(rv.Constants, N'RevPrice') AS RevPriceRaw
    ) jp
    LEFT JOIN atpSbPosition pos
        ON  pos.strategyId = t.Link_ID
        AND pos.esteeId    = t.Estee_ID
        AND (
             (pos.direction = 'BUY'  AND t.Buy_Sell_Indicator = 1) OR
             (pos.direction = 'SELL' AND t.Buy_Sell_Indicator = 2)
        )
    LEFT JOIN esteemaster em
        ON em.Estee_ID      = t.Estee_ID
    WHERE
        t.Sub_Strategy_ID = @Sub_Strategy_ID
        AND t.Creation_Date = @tradedate   -- if datetime: >= @tradedate AND < DATEADD(DAY,1,@tradedate)
        AND rv.VersionId IS NOT NULL	
)
SELECT
    RuleId,
    COALESCE(Symbol, tTrades.Underlying_Ticker) AS Symbol,
    TradeDate,
    orientation,
    DesiredPrice,
    SUM(RowExecPerLot) AS ExecutionPrice,                                        -- per-lot execution
    CAST( (CASE WHEN DesiredPrice IS NOT NULL THEN DesiredPrice END)
          - SUM(RowExecPerLot) AS DECIMAL(38,6) ) AS Slippage,                   -- DesiredPrice - ExecutionPrice
    CAST( ( (CASE WHEN DesiredPrice IS NOT NULL THEN DesiredPrice END)
           - SUM(RowExecPerLot) )
          * CAST(MAX(Lot_Size) AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS DECIMAL(38,6) ) AS TotalSlippage,  -- Slippage * LotSize
    VersionId,
    MIN(ExpiryDateRow) AS ExpiryDate,                                            -- min expiry for this VersionId
    Min(base.Lot_Size) As LotSize,
    MAX(TradeDateTime) AS LastTradeTime
FROM base
LEFT JOIN vwAllTrades tTrades
    ON tTrades.Link_ID = base.RuleId
   AND CONVERT(DATE, tTrades.Creation_Date) = base.TradeDate
GROUP BY
    RuleId,
    COALESCE(Symbol, tTrades.Underlying_Ticker),
    TradeDate,
    orientation,
    DesiredPrice,
    VersionId, base.Lot_Size
ORDER BY
    RuleId, orientation, VersionId, TradeDate, Symbol, base.Lot_Size;
 
--TradeDate, LastTradeTime as Time, RuleId, Symbol, ExpiryDate (only date), VersionId, Orientation, DesiredPrice, ExecutionPrice, Slippage, Total Slippage, LotSize
End
```
